dpe khrun gsal bshad/bka' thang sde lnga zhes pa de ni gtso bo sbyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod rgyal khri srong sde'u btsan gyi skabs o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du bzhugs ring gi mdzad pa bcu gcig ste/ lha 'dre bka' thang gi 'gor/ /'gro drug don mdzad brgyad lnga che ba mdzad/ /lha 'dre 'dul mdzad gtsug lag khang bzhengs mdzad/ /mdo rgyud bsgyur mdzad 'phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad/ /spyor sgol gnyis mdzad mnan bsreg 'phang gsum mdzad/ /dus bzhi mkhyen mdzad bston zhabs gter skyong mdzad/ /rgya bod drin che gang la gang 'dul mdzad//ces bkod yod pa ltar gyi mdzad pa rnams dang / gzhan yang bye sgod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar chags tshul/ nang bcud kyi sems can ji ltar grub tshul/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal ji ltar byon tshul/ bde gshegs rgyal ba ji ltar byon tshul/phyi nang theg pa ji ltar gsungs tshul/ zhu dang sdud po ji ltar byon tshul/ bod khams tshas rgyal ji ltar byon tshul/ lo0paṇa skyes bu ji ltar byon tshul/ pod du dam chos ji ltar dar tshul/ sngags 'chang grub thob ji ltar byon tshul/ rgyal po'i thugs dam ji ltar bzhengs tshul/ rgyal brgyud gtsug lag khang chen brtsigs tshul/ srong gi bang so ji ltar mchod tshul/ bzhengs pa'i lha khang ji ltar bzhengs tshul/ bzhugs pa'i sku mkhar ji ltar brtsigs tshul/ bka' yi nan thag ji ltar gdam tshul/ rtsis kyi rdo ring ji ltar bslangs tshul/ ma 'ongs rgyal sded nor skal ji ltang sbas tshul/ mtha' ma'i dus su ji ltar 'byung tshul rnams 1

dang / gzhan yang blon po'i 'byung khungs bshad pa dang / sto+ong sde'i dmag snye dpyad pa/ chos khrims bcas pa/ rgyal khrims bcas pa/ 'bangs kyi spyi chis bcas pa/ rgyal po dang / btsun mo/ lo baṇa/ blon po/ 'bangs mi bcas kyi spyod tshul sogs skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi mang po 'khod pa zhig yin par brten bajod ma dang rjod chig yongs dzogs sde dge'i par ma zhig gzhir bzung zhing / par ma der le'u so so'i mjug tu mkha' 'gro'i ban yig ces pa'i yig 'byu lnga re yod pa de dag ni go don rtogs mkhan mi rnyed la/ lcags par gyi yig 'bru'i gras su bsgrig kyang dka' bas mi dgos pa pyas thog gziṭa bde'i dkar chag dang bca par skrun byas pa yin/ nang don thad dngos gtso dang sems gartsa'i lta ba tha dad pa'i dbang dang / skabs de'i mthong thos rig gsum gyi bkag rgya'i dbang gis rigs dang mi rigs ci yang yong ba smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang skabs de'i lo rgyus rnams sgro skur gyis ma bslad cing / tshig rgyan gyis ma spras par go sla cagazhig yirna thago klog pa po rdoms kyi dpyad gsumog nom pa ra rdag pa'i sgo nas gzigs par zhu/mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 1 ra'ilo'i zla tshes la/2

4 stong sde'i dmag rta dpyad pa'i skabs/ / 437 5 r+shadros /sgom ro/ rngogacathag pa//ri //13ra / 440 6 rgyal khrims bcas pa'i zhibs/ rdo / — 4427 'bangs kyi spyi tshid bcas pa'i skabs/ / 443 3 yul khams rgya bskyed mtha' dmag rnams btul ba'i /gapa zug/ 444 9 mnga' 'og bod kyi rnam thar bstan pa'i skabs/ 445 10 drang don rim gyis pa yod smra'i sde pa'i skabs/ 44711 bstan pa cig car ba'i skabs/ rdo 450 12 rtse men rim gyis pa'i skabs/ 45313 ston mun cig car 'jug pa'i skabs/ 0 459 14 bod kyi sde pa lta ba dbu ma dang spyod pa yod smra'i /sto cesan saskapasas/ 468 15 mi cesas bstan pa'i skabs/ 46( 16 sku gsum gyis gsungs pa chos yin pa'i skabs/ 472 17 chos dang chos min phye ba'i skabs/ 484 18 bstan pa'i gzhi bzhab//pa'i skabs/ 48713 blon po'i lag ris ji ltar byas pa'i skabs/ 433 20 mchod pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i skabs/ rta 431ci1 ma mchod pa'i nyes dmigs bstan pa'i skabs/ 49ci2tshi bon gtan la phab pa'i skabs/ 493༷ci3 rtsis nga tan la 24ba pa'i skabs/ 497 24 sman gtan la phab pa'i skabs/ 493 7

25 chos gtan la phab pa'i skabs/ 500—26 dus gsum mkhyen pas snga ma ci yin de ltar shes pa/'i /gapa /ga/ 50627 dus gsum mkhyen pas da lta ci yin gsungs pa'i /skarwas/ga/ 51128 phyi ma ci 'gyur bstan pa'i skabs/ 51223 bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong ba'i skabs/ 52930 gter min gter 'dra bstan pa'i skabs/ 533 zug(byepa/gab/sa /ba/ 53543

chadadza po/'go brjod dang 'bre' dasprul ba'i 'gro don mdzad tshuli bsten pa/ rgya gar skad du/ /a ma nu dz+nyā na nā ma/ /bod sbu de du/ lha 'dre 3paka' yi thang yig ces bya ba/ 'dzam gling theg dgu ston la phyag 'chel lo/ /'dren ba'i skyes bu ko sha'i mtsho larga byon/ /dri med mdangs sden dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig dbyibs rlum 'khyil ba mtsho rgya che la dngas/ /rgya gar mdzad pa bcu gcig gzhan du shes/ /bod du grags pa'i mdzad pa bcu gcig ma1 /'gro drug don mdzad brgyad sde che ba mdzad/ /lha 'odre btul medzad ༷gtsug lag khang bzhengs mdzad/ /mdo rgyud bsgyur mdod 'phrin las rnam bzhi samadzad/ /sbyor sgrol gnyis mdzad mnan bsreg 'phang gsum mdzad/ /dus bzhi 3 khyen mdzad bstan zhabs gter skyong mabhed/ /rgya bod drin che gange la gang ca'adul mdzad/ /dang bo 'gro drug don gyi mdzad tshul ni/ /sku mchog sku yi ༷mtshan mchog pad+ma 'byung / /yab med khyem med u dusku ra'i tshal1 /lo skor /re na gsar rnying brjes nas skye/ /nyin par gting du bying bas mdangs dang lasden/ /mtshan mo kha ru 'thon pas 'od dang ldan/ /sdong po phang gis mi31da page sar sdong / /me tog rigs byed mi 'dra lnga ru skyes/ /bram ze'i me tog dmar po'i nang dbus su/ /snang ba mtha' yas thugs ka'i sa bon tī/ /'od du zhu bas rdzus skyes sprul pa'i sku/ /padz+ra 'byung gnas zhi zhing rab tu zhi/ /de sal sprin gyi gseb nas lha rnams kun/ /rol mo sna tshogs kyis ni mchod pa 'bul/ /mkhu' 'gro mang po bar/sneng gar ni bsgyur/ /lha srin sde borgyad mtsho 3

'grams bskor ba byed/ /me tog rin po che yi char chen 'bebs/ /klu chen brgyad rnams pad sdong skor ba skor/ /nod bu rin cen mang po 'thor bar byed/ /gu ru gsang sngags che ba'i ma chog /pad+ma rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zag bcas mngon par shes pa lnga/ /thun thong mngon par shes pa lnga/ /khyad par mngon par shes pa lnga/ /bla med mngon par shes pa lnga/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes pa lnga/ /'das pa'i mngon par shes pa lnga/ /ma 'ongs mngon par shes pa lnga/ /da sta'i mngon par shes pa lnga/ /ma nges mngon par shes pa lnga/ /zhabs gnyis mthil nas yi ge du nag gnyis/ /zhe sdong khong khro dmyal ba'i gnas thu 'phros/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i rnam par gnon du gyur/ /las kyi dbang gis dmyal ba'i sems can 'dren/ /bde mchog dus kyi snyeng po dge ba'i mchog /don dam bde stong ngang las mi g.yo bas/ /bde ba'i dngos grub smra bsam tshig las 'das/ /tsha grang thams cad kun la phan 'dogs pa'i/ /nag po spyod pa bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub/ /grang dmyal brgyad kyi sdug bsngal mya ngan 'das/ /gzi brjid 'od 'bar bde ba'i ngang lo bkod/ /'chal pa med pa'i 'dul khrims chen por ldan/ /bi rū pa ni tsha dmyal brgyad sgrib sbyong / /btang stoms med pa'i brtson 'grus gsum dang ldan/ /pad+ma kun sgyur nyi tshe nye 'khor spyong / /'gyur ldog med pa bsam gtan chen po'i ngang / khye'u chung mkha' sdeng mnar med dmyal ba 'joms/ /dmyal ba'i 'gro kun rang sems rang gis bsreg /bdag phyogs med pa'i snying rje chen pos phyug /sa ra ha ni rdo rje'i dmyal ba 'dren/ /dmyal ba'i 'gro don mdzad pa'i lezhu ste dang po'o// //༷ yi dwags kyi 'gro don mdzad pa/ — rang byung sku bltams rgyal ba'i gsang gnas nas/ /yi ge pre ser yi 4

dwags gnas su 'phros/ /'dzin chags med pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po ston/ /rnam par snang byed sbyin pa drug la spyod/ /'khrul pa med pa'i shes rab gsum dang ldan1 /dbang po'i bde ba 'phags pa'i nor bdun skyong / /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs pa'i yi dwags gnas/ /shārta rakhri ci bzhed nam mkha' mdzod/ /bkres skom mi bde'i sdug bsngal kun las thar/ /shor ba gzhon nu gdug pa'i sems ni zhi/ /su ni tra ni 'dod dgu char du dbab/ /pad+ma badz+ra rnag khrug phyi sprib sel/ /ḍi 'i nye rus yi dwags nang sgrib 'khru/ /pad+ma dkar po dkon cog nor 'bags 'dul/ /pad+ma dhū tīr spyi mthun sgrib pa sbyong / /mi lo khri dang lnga stong 'gro don mdzad/ /yi dwags kyi 'gro don mdzad ba'i le'u ste gnyis //shes// //dud 'gro'i 'gro don mdzad pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lte ba nas/ /yi ge tre nag dud 'gro'i gnas su 'phros/ /mig pa kha dbrag rmig rlum sder chags dang / /'greng bu dang ni 'dab chags dud 'gro'i riges/ /seng ge rab brtan gti mug khyu gling 'dren/ /res ka tshogs 'khor res ka bcud len mdzad/ /dud 'gro klu yi rigs byed nges med tshogs/ /srid pa'i 'byung shenas bdud rtsi'i bcud len mdzad/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas sha yi bcud len mdzad/ /dag pa'i 'byung gnas sman gye bcud len mdzad/ /gter gyi 'byung gnas nam mkha'i bcud len mdzad/ /shin tu 'byung gnas chu yi bcud len mdzad/ /budhe 'byung gnas sa diyi bcud len mdzad/ /dbang gi 'byung gnas rdo yi bcud len mdzad/ /'phrin las 'byung gnas rlung gi bcud len mdzad/ /la la 'dab chags la la 5

sder chags khri/ /la la rmig blum la la kha dbrag khri/ /dud 'gro'i 'gro don mdzad pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //mi'i 'gro don rjedzad pa/gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa'i thugs ka nas/ /gro yig ljang gu mi yul gling bzhir 'phros/ /lha mi kun bstod u rgyan pad+ma 'byung / /skal ldan thams cad thar pa'i lam la 'dren/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje dug lnga'i sa bon zad/ /pad+ma rgyal po legs pa'i yon tan tshang / /pad+ma saṃ 1 mos gus can byin rlob/ /rdo rje gro lod thabs lam gnad dang bcas/ /nyi ma 'od zer nyams rtogs keng nas shar/ /shākya seng ge sdug bsngal bde chen bsgyur/ /seng ge sgra sgrog lha 'dre mi gsume 'dul/ /blo ldan mchog sred ye shes sku lngar ldan/ /sku gecig mtshan brgyad 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa gcod/ /drang don rgyu 'bras spyod pa mas kyis 'dzeg /lta ba yas 'bub yin lugs thog tu go /rig pa'i gnas 'jun sems la sgom med 'char/ /chos sku rang ngo 'phrod par dpe yis ston/ /car phog sems la gnas lugs dpe don 'das/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas u rgyan dang / /rgya bod 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan chen 'di/ /nyi ma ba lta bur kun la grags/ /gi'i 'gro don mdzad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// 1/lha ma yin gyi 'a11don mdzad pa/chos dbyengs mnyam gzhag rgyal sras mgrin pa nas/ /yi ge a dmar lha sin gnag snya nagros/ /thugs rje tshad med skyes pas kun la byams/ /lha ma 6

yin gyi gu ru rnam par rgyal/ /zhal mthong mos pas byin rlabs gzhan la phog 'thab rtsod rgyu rkyen lha mo yid 'phrog len/ /dharma thod phreng bsod nams de na che/ /zhe sdang bums pa'i sasto thod phreng rtsal/ /'dod chags phyin pa'i nirma thod phreng rtsal/ /gti mug ye shes badz+ra thod phreng rtsal/ /phrag dog spangs pa'i bud+ngha thod breng rtsal/ /nga rgyal zhi ba'i rat+na thod phreng rtsal/ /skye ba bzhi bsgral pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /lam lnga sbyangs pa'i karma thod phreng rtsal/ /kun kyang rgyan dab cha lugs mdzes par byas/ /dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i 'dod yon lnga/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas chos kyi dbyings su brdal/ /lha mi'i sprin phung thod phreng rtsal brgyad 'dud/ /byin rlabs char pa 'gro ba yongs la 'bebs/ /sku lnga'i rdzing bu las 'phro can rnams 'khyil/ dad pa brtson 'grus shes rab can zhing spangs/ /yon tan 'bru bcud gung shing dgu yis brdas/ //lha ma yin gyi 'gro don mdzad pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //lha'i 'gro don mdzad pa/dpe byad brgyad cu'i rang bzhin spyi bo nas/ yi ge su dkar lha yi yul du 'phros/ /thad phyogs dga' bdes longs spyod snang srid gaje// /ma lus gu ru mid thub 'dzin gyi zhing / /cir snang chos sku sgogs chen gzhal yas khang / /chos kyi 'byung gnas a nu'i gzhal yas khang / /rig pa'i 'byung gnas ma hā'i gzhwal yas khang / /dga' ba'i 'byung gnas yo ga'i gzhal yas khang / /chaṭa mchog 'byung gnas u pa'i gzhal yas khang / /yon tan 'byung gnas kri ya'i gzhwal yas khang / /shes rab 'byung gnas dbu ma'i gzhal yas khang /ye 7

shes 'byung gnas sems tsam gzhal yas khang / /dri med 'byung gnas nyan thos gzham yas khang / /chos sko gsal byed theg pa'i lam phye nas/ /blo yi bag chags 'khrul pa'i rtog pa sangs/ /lha'i 'gro don mdzad pa'i le'u ste drug 14shes// //

nga /)/ga pa /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung ga nas kyi che ba bzhi bcu/gnyis pa brgyad lnga che ba'i mdzad pa ni/ /sku yi che ba brgyad dang gsung gi brgyad/ 1thugs kyi che brgyad yon tan 'phrin las brgyad/ /dang po sku yi che ba brgyad la ni/ /pha ma'i rgyu rkyen ma bskyed sku bltams che/ /rgyal sar 'byung ba'i cho/ga med pas che/ /rol rtsed sna tshogs do mnyam med pas che/ /sku tshe 'das spyongs med pas sku yi che/ /gdul bya dngos 'dren bgres rgud med pas che/ /sku la 'byung bzhi'i dgras mi tshugs pas che/ /so thar sngages nas sdom gsum bsrungs pas che/ /mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe byad ldan /u rgyan pad 'byung sku yi che ba yin/ /gnyis pa gsung gi che ba brgyad 'a ni/ /tshangs pa'i gsung ldan yan lag drug cus che/ /gsung gleng yi dam lha dang sgrogs pas che/ /skad rigs gyur tshad thams cad mkhyen pas che/ /tha mal gsung ni ye mi 'byon pas che/ /'byon tshad chos su 'byon pas gsung gi che1 /rigs druka skad ris chos ston gsung gi che/ /lha 'dre dam 'og tshud pas bka' nyan che/ /gsung dbyangs bram ze tshangs pa'i dbyangs bzhis che/ /ngol mo'i mchod pa gsung gi che ba yin/ /gsum pa thugs kyi che ba brgyad la yang / /thugs la 'khrug pa med pas thugs kyi che/ /chos la phyogs ris med pas thugs kyi che/ /rtogs pa mkha' ltar mtho bas thugs kyi che1 /sgom pa ri bas brtan pas thugs kyi che/ /spyod pa nyi rdul ltar zhib thugs kyi che/ /'bras bu gzhan don grub pas thugs kyi che/ /dus bzhi mngon par mkhyen pas thugs kyibyuste

che/ gdul bya ris thu mi 'byed thugs kyi che/ /bzhi pa yon tan che ba brgyad bstan pa1 /mtho ris yon tan bdun zhen thos pas che/ yongs grags mkhas pa chen po'i grub thob ni/ /pho mo stong dang rtsa brgyad bsten pas che/ /rig pa'i gnas lngar mkhas pas yon tan che/ /sde sgod gsum la sbyangs pas yon tan che/ /bung chub thugs bskyed nyer lnga rgya yis che/ /sbyor sgol dbang gis dithams cad smin par+sā che/ /dgon gnas bdag tu ma bzunge ba yis che/ /'phaṭa —pa'i nor bdun phyug pas che ba'o1 /lnga pa 'phrin las che brgyad la/ /bstan pa snyigs mar rgyas pas che/ /bstan pa 'phel 'grib med pas che/ /bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong bas che/ /mchog dman grogs su 'gro bas che/ /chos dang chos min 'byed pas che/ /lha 'dre bran du 'khol bas che/ /bstan pa 'idzin skyonge bsrung bas che/ /srin po'i kha gnon mdzad pas che/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung ra nas kyi che ba bzhi bcu'i lenyu ste bdun pa'o// //10

gsum pa/ /bal mo shākya de ba/bdud kyis bslus ga ma bskrus pa sorten mi/gsum pa/ /lha 'dre btul mdzad gtsug lag khab bzhengs mdzad/ ces pas/ mtha' 'khob bod yul mun ba'i gling 'di ru/ /pre ta pu ri snying 'dres yul phyogs 'dir/ /bod kyi rgyasha po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /dus gsum sprul sku kun las khyad 'phags pa/ /'od mi 'gyur ba tshe/dpag med pa dngos/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan 'dren btang / / lha 'dre thams cad 'dus shing rab tu 'khruge /ser ba thog dang glog dang sku 'od dang / /rlung nag 'tshub mas sa yang rab tu g.yos/ /mes 'jigs chus 'jiṭa dug 'jigs dgras 'jigs pa/ /'jigs pa brgyad kyis bod rnams skrag cing 'phar/ /chu'i nya bye tshan bton pa bzhin du gyur/ /u rgyan slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /mang yul gung du sto bar phebs ba'i dus/ /dge bsnyen ༷nyi shu rtsa gcig bsu ba byas/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshogs rnams thams cad 'dus/ /lus ni 'dun kyang sems ni gyong zhing khengs/ /gye rgyan/pad+mas de dag mkhyen nas su/ ga /dge bsnyen gnod sbyin rnams la bka' bstsal/ba/ /bka' thub sdom pa mi zad pas/ /lus/skabs 'gyur zhing sdug bsngal la/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yengs te/ /g.yeng bas dngos grub gzhan du 'gyur/ /'dod shogs zhe sdang gti mug gsum1 /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum mo /rab tu skye sha'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de bas don chen bstan par bya/ /dug gsum nye ༷bar zhi gyur na/ /dug di dug ged bya ba yin/ /bdud rtsi rim gyis bsten 1

byas nas1 /bdud rtsi nyid du gyur pa yido/ /dper na grong khyer chen po'i lud/ bu ram shing gi zhing dag dang / /'bras zhing rgun 'brum zhing la phan/ /de bzhin nyon mongs lus gang yin/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la phan/ /sman pa che mchog gtso bo ste/ /zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med1 /sngags dang sman gyis yongs su zin/ /dug gis 'chi bar mi nus so/ /shes rab thabs mkhas wangs sa zin/ /nyon mongs dug gim ltang mi nas/ /gang gib ban po 'chi ri sde na sde bsde sde sde ///shā la rdo gyur pa/ /de yis mkhas pa yongs su grol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /der mi ma yin lha 'dre gdug rtsub can rnams kyis/ /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong gi sman chu ga lo/ /de nas u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du bdud rtsi sma:/ sgrub mdzad/ /sa bdag glu yis bar gcod byas pa ni/ /rtsangs pa sbal ba sdig pa rta bla 'od/ 1sdom dang sbur krog bshol mo srin bu dang / /mug ma sad ma shig 'ju sbrang bu dang / /'bu dang grog ma byang khru dmar yul rigs/ /po 'ug wa sprel sre mong sna tshogs mang / /sngar ma mthong ba'i ltas dang rten 'brel byung / /rgya mtsho'i gling gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bsdus/ /mkha' legro ma bzhis glu blangs pa/ /panyu partsi/ /sgrub dang bsgrub par bya ba'i spyod/ /sgrub pa po ni kun rdzob bden/ /sgrub pa don dam bden pa'o/ /bsgrub bya gnyis med ye shes gcig /rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis su med/ /'bras bu rgyur ni rgyas btab cing // rgyu yang 'bras bur rgyas btab par/ /bsgom zhing gzhan du dngos grub ni/ 1bskol ba bye bar 'byung mi 'gyur/ /dge ba bcu yi las kyi lam/ /byed pa ye shes spangs pa'o/ /'di dag thams cad phyin ci log /gang gis rmongs khu1 'ching gyur cing / /ngu 'bod thar ni de 'gyur ba/ /de nyid kyis ni grol 'gyur zhing / /shes rapa stobs kyis bde ba 'thob/ /ces blangs so/ /de nas mthab/ ma/༷nor rgyas 'jog po dang / /pad+ma pad+ma chen po dung skyong dang / /stobs kyi

/rgyu ba dang ni rigs rdzan dang / /gza' chen bzhud dang rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad1 ltag par mos pa brtan par bskyed nas ni/ /a liṅga na dang / /cudze ge dang / /tsu sha na dang / /na ga pra ha raṇa dang / /ti ta ka ra dang / /gi ku la dad / /bung ba'i sgra dang / yang dgi par bskul/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal du btags/ /de nas che yi rig 'dzin thob gyur kyang / /phyarge rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin ma thob na/ /don dam bden pa med pas mi phan dgongs//stong pa nyid kyi lta ba tshar gcod phyir/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong ma yin pas/ / lta ba ngan pa tshar bcad phan thogs mdzad/ /bkra shis sa gnas sa yi snying 'tshol dgongs/ /bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug ri/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bkra shis gnas/ /sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad bkra shis gnas/ /loṭa bkra shis rjas brgyad bkra shis gnas/ /ri rdo rje dgu brtsegs 'dug pa bkra shis gnas/ /brag seng ge rgyab bsgol 'dug pa bku shis gnas/ shing 'ja' tshon 'od 'bad 'dug pa bkra shis gnas/ /rtswa me tog gling tshol 'dug pa bkra rgeshis gnas/ /gsos bdud rtsi smon nags 'dug pa pakra shis gnas/ /me long sbyab pa bzhin du dbyibs mtho sar 'dug pa bkra shis/ /gsang sngags kyi//bstan pa me bzhin du 'bar bar dgongs/ /yang dag mar me dgu pa'i lha tshoṭa ༷bsgrubs/ /klu gyong po gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/ /byang phyogs dur khrod ma la ya//༷gnam lcags spu gri yod pa'i tshal/ /gnod sbyin rgod ma kha yi gnas/ /bse sbal khru bo lcags kyi sme ba can/ /spu gri lcags kyu gri gug mdung yod pa/ /bu ga dgu nas khrug dang dug chu 'bab/ /bse yi rus sbal sa bo'i sto ba nas1 sa srid pa gtsum gyi rgyu la dbang byed pa/ /las kyi dbang gis rang gi bstan gnod la/ /stobs sdud gzhan 'dren gzhom par byed/ /thug chos chen po ri rab ma bum bsnyil tsam1 /gnam sa kha sbyar nyi zla gza' skar med/ /ba snang glog 13

ma sprino snying 'byin/snyam byed/ /tsha ba ma bzhi la sogs mtho btsarmas byung / 1lo gsum gnam khusga char pa ma babs shing / sa la spu gu ma skyes rtsi thog skam/ /rgya gar bal por lo gsum mu ge byung / /mi nad phyugs nad sprin nag mched ltar byung / /lha srin mi ma yin gyi bar chad dgongs/ /shing kun bal po ji la ji sa dang / /mtshan brag ba'/rdomo kun la kun sa zhi/ /pho mo gnyis la gser phye bre gang brdzangs/ /rgya gar yul gyi pardo ta rnams la/ /byi to ta ma 'buyo sde'i nang nas su/ /bdag la bar gcod bgegs bsgog gnang bar zhu/ /rgya garwa mkhas pa paṇa chen thams cad kyis/ /phur pa phun tshogs mi khur gcig ga nang ba/ /yang le shod du phebs bas rang bzhin dul/ /gnam las char babs sa la myu gu smin/ /mi nad phyugs nad mu ge rgyun chad sangs/ /de tshe bal yul shing rtse bod mgo bltas/ /me tog bod yul phyogag su kha paltas bye/ / nyi zla gza' skar bod yul phyogs la shar/ /dam tshos bod yul phyogs la dar ba 'i ltas/ /lha lcam bal mo shākya de ba yis/ /slob dpon/mi bzhud bzhugs par gsol ba btab/ /u rgyan chego po dgongs mdzod kye/ /rtsi shid rtse mo'i ston phyogs sam/ /me tog kha yi blta phyogs sam/ /bal mo'i rmi lam ngan lugs sam/ /dkyil 'khor mdangs yal skyen lugs sam/ /slob dpon bod du bzhud bzhud 'dra/ /sgob dpon ma gshegs bzhugs par zhu/ 1de nas slob dpon bkakai/stsal pa/ /bud med 'khor ba'i gzhi ma yin/ /ngan song gsum /gyi1sa bon yin/ /thar par zhagro ba'i sgo 'gegs yin/ /nyon mongag dug lnga'i rgyu rkyen gin/ 1bdag gis 'khor gyur gtogs pa la/ /sems can ba sam gyes mi khyab snyang//1 nges pa'i don ma rtogs pa'i yid gzugs can/ /rang dang lta spyod mi mthun/gnod/cing 'tshe/ /duka lnga'i sa bon bskyed pa 'dre yi lus/ /klu spyongashegardod1sprin/rgod ma kha/ /bar snang glog ma sprin dad bcas1 /bdag lang1/

'gran btsugs do bdos nas/ /rgya gar bal por bkra mi shis pa btang / /rdophur pa med na bar gcod mi bzlog pas/ khyod la cho 'phrul byung ba yang / /klu spyong de yi sprul pa'o/ /cho 'phrul sna re rdugs tsa na/ /yi mug byas shing mya ngan byed/ /tshad pa che la bal yul gting / khrag mtsho zhag mtsho yod pa'i gnas/ /rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil dbus na/ /glang rog chen po mig nas glog 'gyu bar sprul1 /sna nas zangs kyi rlung dmar 'tshub/ kha nas lcags kyi ser ba 'bab pa/ /rwa'i rtse mo gnyis las me 'bad zhing / /srid pa gsum po rwa'i rtse mo la g.yeng ba/ /rmig pa lcags kyi phur par snang ba/ /spu mtshon char 'khrigs shing nga ro 'bu 'bu zer/ kha dog du mar snang ba mang po 'phros/ 'bu 'bu ldi ri ri 'dug nas su/ /slob dpon gyes kha shā ga zhig gzir/ /༷bal yul 'phags pa gu lang gnas su bros/ /glu gedug pho brang nang du 'gro /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bal yul a su ra'i brag phug bzhugs/ 1rnam lnga zhing gi mchod pa bkram nas su/ /sgrub pa zhag bdun mardod pa'i nub/ / zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum dang / /lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu dang / /gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad dang / /shel gyi khyi mo gdong brgyad bzhi/ /bya ba thams da 'grub cing zer du byung / /slob dpon khyed rnams su yin gsungs pa dang / /ded ni bdud po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /bdud mo nag mo mi sdug ma dang gnyis/ / bshos pa'i drod khams grod pa cig skyes te/ /nang nas ce spyang ༷lnga ni byung ba las/ /de tsho'i nang nas mthu che rtsal drag pa/ /nged bzhi yin pas bden pa bsgo ba gces/ /sngar yang sems can sha khrag la dbang byas/ snyed yang sems can sha khrug la dbang zhu/ /slob dpon sbyor ba mdzad pas dan lo btags/ /rdo rje lag tu gtad nas dbang bzhi bskur/ /bdud rtsi lce la ba zhag nas lung yang bstan/ /gzengs/bstod dbugs dbyung mngan gsol sho/ /15

de nas mchod rten bya rung kha shor la/ /a ma'i drin len mchod pa phul/ / sems can don 'jug bskor bar gshegs/ /bal mo shākya de ba dang / /bal po ji la ji sa dang / /bal mo kun la kun sa zhi/ /bal yul e yi gtsug lag khang / /tsha ba tsha shod mchod rten dmar po dang / /go ta pi ra'i gtsug lag khang / /nyi nub dad can skor ba bskor du phyin/ /mtshan dpe ldan pa'i khye'u chung brgya/ /bskor ba byed cing lha phyag 'tshal/ /de nas tshigs bcad 'di skad smra/ /u rgyan pad 'byung thugs su byon pa yi/ /lha gcig bal mo shākya de ba lags/ /bdag cag rnams ni lha phrug klu phrug brgya/ /dad pa chos la skyes nas spyan sngar mchis/ /slob dpon gsungs pa'i chos rnams bstan du gsol/ /de skad smras nas mdun phus btsugs/ /bal mo shākya de bas bka' stsal pa/ /dad pa skyes pa'i lha phrug klu phrug brgya/ /chos la mos pa skyes nas zhu ba stegs so kye/ /dbang po brtan pas yid la bzung zhing nyon/ /ci 'dod sems kyi dkyil du bstan par bya/ /shākya de bas de skad bka' bstsal pas/ /bdud kyis bslu ba rnams kyis lan btab pa/ /a ma jo mo shākya de ba lags/ /da lta dus kyi tha mar gyur/ byams pas sems can 'tshang mi rgya/ /zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i chos shig shod/ /shākya de bas 'di skad bka' bstsal pa/ zhe sdang can ni dmyal ba'i gnas su skye/ /gal ste mi ru skyes na bshan par skye/ /les ngan rgyu bsags dmyal bar skye/ /log chos de 'dra bdag la ma gsungs so/ /bdud kyis bslu ba rnams kyis yang zhus pa/ /sbyin pa gtong ste yo dudwa med/ /'dod chags chu ltar 'khrug pa'i chos shig shod/ /'dod chags can ni yi dwags gnas su skye/ /gal te mi ru skyes kyang dbul por skye/ /yang ni las bsags yi dwags gnas su skye/ /log chos de 'dra bdag la ma gsungs so/ 1ye shes bskyed pas nyan pa nyung / /gti mug mun ltar 'a bas pa'i chos shig 16

༷ shod/ /gti mug can ni byol song gnas su skye/ /gal te mir skyes glen skugs sa ga par skye/ /log chos de 'dra bdag la ma gsungs so/ /yangs sa bskyed salas dog pa mang / /phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshub pa'i chos shig shod/ /phrag dog can ni mtha' 'khob gla klor skye/ /gal te mir skyes dmag dpon dar thogs /snye/ /las kyi rgyu bsags mtha' 'khob srin por skye/ /log chos de 'dra bdag sal ma gsungs so/ /zhi bas sems can 'dul ba nyung 1 1nga rgyal ri klungs ༷'tshub pa'i tshos shig shod/ /nga rgyal can ni lha gin gnas su skye/ /gal te mir bskyes sdig spyod mtshon thogs skye/ /las ngan rgyu bsags lha min gnas su skye/ /log chos de 'dra bdag la ma gsungs so/ /bdud kyis baspu ba rnams kyis yang sazhus pa/ /nges pa'i lung gis 'tshang mi rgya/ /gol ba'i lung gis bsgoms na rgya//sdig spyod chad par lta ba'i chos shig zhu/ /log pa'i lung la bsgoms pa na/ /tshe ring po yi lha ru skye/ /gal te mir skyes dge med spung por skye/ /las rgyun bsags nas tshe ring lha ru skye/ /log chos de 'dra bdag la ma gsungs so/ /slob dpon gsungs pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ma yin pa yi lung du 'dug /dzoṭa ༷pa'i ting 'dzin rtogs mi nus/ /de la bdag cag 'jug mi nyan/ /de skad zer cing mkha' la 'phur te song / /de dus a su ra yi sman gye nags/ /sems can gsos gyur bdud rtsi sman gyi tshal/ /'gro ba sems can rnams la phan gdags ched/ ༄ /slob ma bal po ji la ji sa khong / /nad gdon bar du gartsod pa/'i sems can la/ /dpyad kyi bye brag 'bum sdes nad rnams 'chos/ /bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i sman bshad/mdo rgyud 'chad/ /hasta sma bya la cang ka la phyung phyung shig shig /'og ma phyogs kyi 'byung po dang / /sa 'og 'di na gnas pa yi/ glu dang thu srin srin po rnams/ /kun kyang dam la gnas pa'i phyir/ /'ga' yang 'di ru ma gnas par/ /so so bde ba'i gnas la dengs/ /bal po'i 17

rgyal po shī la ma ñju'i 'khor/ /de gral mtshan dang ldan pa'i khye'u chung bcu (tsogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis nas babs/ /bal po/ji la ji sa'i sadun du byung / /pus btsugs thal sbyar zhu don ched kha smras/ /slob dpon sras gyur ji la ji sa lags/ /'di na mchis pa'i bdag cag grogs mched rnams/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og gnyis te bcu/ /de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /drang srong 'tsho byed khyed rnams spyan sngar badzongs/ /'dir mchis lags pas nged kyi ngag brjod gson/ /sems can nad kyis bar bcad 'chi pa la/ /'tsho byed sman gyi sbyor sde mang po yis/ /'chi ba'i nad rnams btul nas ma gso zhig /da ni dus la 'gyur ldog 'ong dus 'dir/ /sems can gsos na 'phel zhing grangs mang nas/ /lto dpyad bstan pa spur du nub ste 'gro /brgya gsos pas kyang gcig bsad ba sod nams che/ /dpyad kyi sman sdebs zhog las dug sbyor sdebs/ /sman sgrub na/byed dug gi sgrub ba bgye1 /sga tshag phye ma leb dang stag phye ma/ /sman sgrub byed pa'i nang du byung na bzang / /mi la bkra mi shis pa rtsub 'gyur 'ong / 1dgongs la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bka' ma bcag /ces smras so/ /bal po ji la ji sas lan btab pa/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs 'khrul lam/ khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /bar gcod sdug bsngal rnam gnyis yod/ /'dre gdon bgegs kyi bar gcod dang / /nad kyi bar du gcod pa ste/ /bar gcod gnyis po de yis ni/ /sems can thams cad kun sdug sbyong / /sems can bar gcod bzlog pa'i phyir/ /u rgyan pad 'byung thugs rje las/ /bdag cag lcam sringe sprul pa mdzad las kyi rnam par smin pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang bzlog ma gasrungs/ /'phral gyi rkyen dbang par gcod rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyangs nas su/ /bdag cag lcam sring gnyis kyis bzlog /phyogs bcu'i sangs 13

rgyas bka' de 'khrul/ /gzhan nyams rad chad bdag la 'ong / /sems can rnams la dug phan na/ khye'u chung khyo da bcu sems can yin/ /sman la mkhas na dug la mkhas/ /'chi bar byed pa dug sbyar gyi/ khye 'u chung khyod rnams dug la 'thung / /zhes gsungs pas/ khye'u chung rnams kyi mtshang la phog /lan med ngo gnong bros nas song / /klu spyong gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /thugs sras ji la ji sa thugs rig can/ /pho skyes bye ba lha yi rigs/ /bdud kyis bslus pas ma bslus so/ /bdud kyang yi mug ga chad de/ /cho 'phrul bskyar nas ston du song / /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /sems can thams cad don ched du/ khab bzhes shākya de ba la/ /bal yul bdag po klu spyong pos/ /gnod sbyin cho 'phrul bstan pa ni/ /btsun mo shākya de ba dang / /gal mo kun la kun sa zhi/ /a su sman nags sman gyi tshal/ /me tog tshal la sku 'chag phyin/ /lus po mi yi lus po la/ /mgo bo dung gi mgo bo can/ /de la ming dang mtshan btags pa/ /rje'u gnyan thogs rgyal ba lags/ /mi bzang de ni rta ru bzang / /lus po mi yi lus po ga/ /mgo bo zangs kyi mgo bo can/ /de la ming dang mtshan btags pa/ /gnyan bzang thos rgyal bya ba lags/ /mi bzang de ni rta ru bzang / /lus po mi yi lus po la/ mgo bo spyang ki'i mgo bo can/ /de la ming dang mtshan btags pa/ /gnyan kha spyong rgyal bya ba lags/ /mi bzang de ni rta ru bzang / /lus po mi yi lus po la/ /mgo bo sbrul gyi mgo po can/ /de la ming dang mtshan btags pa/ gnyan kha sbrul 'bum chen po lags/ 1mi bzang de ni rta ru bzang / /lus po mi yi lus po la/ /mgo bo g.yag gi mgo bo can/ /de la ming dang mtshanardo btags pa/ /gnyan rje gong sngon bya ba lags/ /mi bzang de ni rta ru bzang // lus po mi yi lusnya sho/la/ /mgo bo stag gi mgo bo can/ /de la ming dang 1

mtshan btags pa/ /gnyan stag thod rgyal bya ba lags/ /mi bzang de ni rta ru /bzang / /lus po mi yi lus po la/ /mgo bo spre'u'i mgo bo can/ 1de la ming dang mtshan btags pa/ /gnyan sprel brdal pa chen po lags/ /mi bzang de ni rta ru bzang / /bal mo shākya de ba dang / /bal mo kun la kun sa zhi/ /—rta skya dgu ste de yis smras/ /zla ba sro ba'i yul 'di na/ /khyad par can gyi lha chagacig gnyis/ /bsod nams can gyis bsten ba'i sa/ /gang gi btsun mo dam pa lags/ /de skad slu ba dgu rnams mgrin gcig smras/ /kun la kun sa snye yis lan btab pa/ /mthong yul chung la gsan khung nan/ /rdzu bag yin nam nyams sad yin/ 1yul ni bal yul sman nags mag/ /go ta bi ri'i gtsug ༷lag khang / /bdag ga mchod 'bul bskor ba byed du 'ong / /'gran gyi zla med pad 'byung btsun mo yin/ /ji tsam pa yi mi zhig mthong myong ste/ /mgo brnyan mi 'dra mi chung rta chung zhon/ khyed tsho'i rigs ni mthong ma myong / /khyed dgu nyal na gang du nyal/ /rta dgu 'gro na gang du 'gro/ khyed rnams gar cha'acha' gang du don/ /de skad lha gcig smras pa dang / 1bdud kyi cho 'phrul lan btab pa/ /mdzes pa'i lha gcig ci mi gsung / /phyi yul bzang la nang sgo ngan/ /mthong thos shes rgya chung bar nges/ /nged tsho mi chung ma yin mi chen yin/ /rta chung ma shin rta chen yin/ /mi ni tshangs pa lha yi bu/ /rta ni dpyod ldan khyung gi gshog rta/da lta klu yul sing brang na/ /klu rje gtsug na rin cen la//mdzes pa'i bu mo spun dgu yod/ /de la rol rtsed byed du 'gro 1nged dang gang ༷zhig yin nam bsam/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bya ba des/ /btsun mo lnga brgya bor ba yin/ /mi ngan de 'dras ci zhig byed/ /mi ngan de med bar skabs 'dir/ /grogs su tshangs pa de rigs bzang / /pad 'byung ngan pa bor las thong / /sted gnyis de la 'dud pa phongs/ /nged kyi phyi la skyod cig ther/ /bal rma 20

shākya de bas lan btab pa/ /sim can lta ba med na thoms can ga ma min/ khyung chen gnam 'phang bskyod pa mthob tsa na rgya gyizhu shims ra man bapasnying re rje/ /gangs ri'i rtse mor seng ge'i rtsal mthong na/ /byi ri'i rtser rgyug wa spyong ma re sdug /rgya mtsho'i gting gi chu srin 'dug mthong na/ /ko mog deng gi sbal spyong snying re rje/ /stobs chen rgyad kyis 'degs pa'i rtsal mthong na/ /byis nga /sor rdo lajin pa ma re sdug /sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gari brjed mthong tsa na1 'khyal chig smra ba'i lta ngan snyeng re rje/ /sprul sku mchog la ngan smos gtong ba 'di/ kha lag spyod gsum thub pa'i gdengs ci yod/ /de ska da ces smras pa dang / 1bslu bas lan ma thebs par bros te song / /bal mo shākya de'ib bdud kyis bslus pas ma bslus pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/ / bar snang glog ma sbrin gsum/de nas bal mo kun la kun sa zhi/ /go ta 'i ra'i gtsug lag khang du nyal/ /sngas su klu gyong gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/ /yid la bsran dang dpa' bzhag nas/ /bdud rlung 'tshub ma nag por brdzus/ /bal tho kun la kun zhi'i khode par song / /dbang po snying gi bu gar zhugs/ /dkar nag snying gi mtshams su nyal/ /lha gcig kun la kun sa zhi'i/ /mag pa mang bos stod nas 'khyud/ /rkang pa mang pos smad nas 'khyud/ /klu spyong gdug bas dbang du bsdus/ 1sang gi nam langs gung sangs nas/ /kun la kun zhi snying ma dga'/ lus po 'dar la phyod phyod khyer/ /bal mo shākya de ba la/ /ma gcig sems kyi sgrom bu ma/ /mdang sum nyal ba'i rmi lam ngan/ /'tshub ma mang pos bdag g.yogs nas/ /yul 'di mig gis ma mthong bar/ /gzhan dag cig tu khyer ཿ1

ba rmis/ /da nang sad nas snyeng ma dga'/ /lus kyang lci la sims kyang 'phyo/ /ci lags ma gcig bshad du gsol/ /bal mo shākya de bas lan chagasungs pa/ /lha gcig kun 'a kurna sa zhi/ /nga dang lhan cig mi 'dug par/ bud med bya ba ngan las byed/ /bud med bya ba srin gyi rigs/ /bud med bya sa ba dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /thar pa'i lam la 'dzeg pa dang / /'khor ba'i rgyun lam pa'abab pa gnyis/ /'dod du rung ba ma shor ram/ /rmi ltas de kun ngan pa sayin/ /nyams skongs bshags pa rem la gyis/ sngags dang mchod gtor 'phro ༷ma bcad/ /me tog sna dgu lag gi sa 'thus/ / bal yul yi yi gtsug lag mkhang / /go ta be ra'i gtsug lag khang 1 /'phags pa shing kun gtsug lag mkhang / /mchod 'bul bskor ba gus phyag 'tshol/ /las kyi sgrib pa spur du cha'adag /bdud kyis bslus b.re mi 'gyur ro/ /kun la zhi mo dad pa skyes/ /mtshal nags me tog 'thu ru phyin/ /pho brang yid dga'i mtsho chu nas/ /glu yi longs phywod bsam mi khyab/ /bar snang khams kyi glog ma sprin/ /lha gcig kun sa'i drung du 'ongs/ /bdag ni klu sras skye gachadang rgyu/ /dregs dang phrag dog dang ldan la/ /shes rab zhan cing log lta mang / /las ngan la sogs kun la chadaga'/ /yul 'dir rkun sa zhi khyod 'dug /nga ni shin tu phangs pas sems skyes nar/ /de nas da lta bas ru 'ongs pa yin/ /ji srid gsodo brali mi byed gshin bral byed/ khyod min gzhan la mngon par mi dga' bas/ /nga yi rta chagazhug 'di la khyod zhon darnga / /nga la skyid pa'i yul yod rang/cag gshegs/ //lha lcam rta gzhug zhon nasanabros te phyin/ /snying du 'dre gdon bgegs dang —bdud zhugs pas/ /shin tu mang dag tshul gyi bdag nyid can/ /skyes pa de sas bza nga gin mdzes me med/ /bal po'i yushe la phyir bltas ma dga' ste/ /sasteng du sdug na glog ma sprin na'ang sprin/ /yi gar 'ong na klu spyong na yange spyong / maḥ

skyid po byung na rgod ma kha na'ang kha/ /gang mi bslu ba de ni bdag po'o/ 1glog ma sprin dang 'grogs pas spungs pa skyes/ /bal mo tsha rong chu mig byang chub rir/ /me tog pad+ma dgun skyes bya ba'i gnas/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas sku stoms mdzad/ /srod dus sku nyams spungs pa cig byung nas/ /phyag gis bzung nas dbu zhwa'i nang du gtums/ /phyog rgyas de bsdams nang bar gzigs tsa na/ /spungs pa mi yi bu mo mi 'dra ba/ /lha yi gras mo 'dra ba bzhi byung nas//slob dpon khyed rnams su yin bka' bstsal pa/ /bdig cag mi yi bu mo ma yin zhing / /sa bdag mtsho chen bzhi zhes bya ba yin/ /sngar yang mi/phyugs mang po'i grog la dbang / /da yang da ltar dbang byed dbang bskur gsol/ /slob dpon zhus pa bzhin du ma gnang ste/ /bse yi lha mo mched bzhi dang / /dkar sham ma bzhi ma mo 'dre ka bzhi/ /mtshan gsol ming btags lag tu rdo rje byen/ /rdo rje phur pa'i srung mar dbang bskur ro/ /ma mo rnams kyis mgrin gcig bstod pa ni/ /e ma ho/ /sems can thams cad rjes su gzung ba'i don/ /dus gsum 'gyur med nam mkha' lta bu'i sku/ /'gro 'dul gsung dbyangs mkha' la 'brug sgra spog byin rlabs char gyis sems can smin mdzad pa'i rgyal sras pad 'byung sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod khas blangs dam bcas so/ /bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ /glu gyong po dang / /gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/ /bar snang glog ma sprin gsum gyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //ga' dzo/kun sa zhi bdud kyis bslus nga//de nas mi ma yin gdug pa can rnams kyis sprul pa mang po bkye nas slob/dpon 'dul bar bgros/ /'gro ba'i bla ma pad+ma rgyal po de/ /mang yul gung 23

thang stson pa dang / /lcags kyi seng ge chen po bzhi/ /slob dpon sku la rgol du byung / /ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bsdus pas/ /bud med chen mo bzhir song ngo / /slob dpon nyid la phyag btsal nas/ /slob dpon zhal nas khyed bzhi ga nas 'ongs/ /'di ru ci byed ji lta bu yin gsungs/ /nged bzhi nyi ma byang shar mtshams nyid nas/ khug mtsho mu le sding gi nang nas 'ongs/ /nad kyi bdag mo rims kyi rkyen mo dang / /ma yams chen mo bstan ma chen mo yin/ /sngon yang sems can sha khrug srog la dbang / /da yang sems can sha khug srog dbang zhu1 /slob dpon dbang bskur gzengs bstod dbugs phyung nas/ /gsang mtshan dpal ldan gnyen gyi re ma ti/ /sku las sprul pa'i re ma dza/ /gsung las sprul pa'i re ma ti/ /thugs las sprul pa'i re ma dzu/ /pra mo srog tig snying tig bra mo ha/ /zhes srog gi snying po phul/ /rno myur sgrub thabs brgya dpa rtsa brgyad mdzad/ /lha 'dre rnams kyi+os rin cen gdan khri bshams/ /sgra snyan rol mo thams cad dus gcig bsgrags/ /sgos kyi rigs byed sngordon a ka ru/ /dri zhim thams cad mang yul dud par 'khregs/ /bla bhe gdugal dang rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur/spyir/ /sna tshogs ltad mo rtsed mo mi 'dra ba/ /dar sna'i tshogs phyar rnga shon gar tshogs dang / /stag seng la sogs rgya bod lha 'dre'i dmag /gnam sa bar snang thams cad khrom du brdal/ /ro mtshog ldan pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs phul/ /zla ba gsum du sems bskyed tshogs bsags nas/ /ma pham g.yu mtsho'i napa du lha khang bzhengs/ /mi yi yul du pad rgya'i lha khang bzhengs/ /mang yul byams sprin ston la mkhar du byon/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/ /u rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /bal bo'i rgyal po shrī la mañju yis/ /e ma/ /byin gyi rlabs kyis sems can kun tshogs na/ /kun la kun sa mi 'dug bshing/ltar thal/ /zhu rgyan pad+ma 'byung 2

gnas bga' bstsal pa/ /me ma/ /bal rje lha khyod snyan gson cig /kun rdzob ma rtogs don dam ci la rtogs/ /ma rtogs klu spyong sde ris gnyis su bcad/ /'dod yon du ma'i tshogs kyes kun sa brid/ /nga la khams gsum mnyam por drang ba las/ /lha 'dre gdug pa'i sde ris ci yang med/ /bal rje rngamasam pa ma chung las la soms/ /gu ru'i thugs rjes sems can las gtso na/ ༅/bal mo kun sa las ngan sems la yod/ 1brtag dpyad bsams pa'i yin lugs mad po btang / /don med log pa'i 'dun ma che 'di'i ched/ /bsod nams bsags sam ma bsags lha gcig kun sar dris/ /bdud kyis bslus pas bal rje lha khri spyan chab shor/ /e ma/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung / /lha gcig kun sa ngan song gnas nas drongs/ /ji zid skyo bar mi 'gyur bar/ sgom ༷ba'i sems la zhen pa bya/ /de lta bas na dam tshog ldan gyur cing / /byin gyis 0rlob par mdzad du gsol/ /u rgyan pad+mas bka' bstsa' ba/ /kye ma/ /bu —mo kun sa bdud kyis bslus pa 'di/ /sdug bsngal nyams su ma myong 'grongs mi 'gyur/ /dus la ma babs sems can las dbang che/ /kun sa'i sems ni sa ༷bon mes tshig 'dra/ /chu lud rmo brkal byas kyang stong las yin/ /mi lus zil thub btang stoms chen por bzhag /dus la ma bab brtson 'grus shugs kyis rdugs/ /dul zhing mi 'dul bdud kyi las yin gyi/ /mi 'thul bzhin du 'dul ba bdud kyi las yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bal rje lha khri mya ngan sems la gcags/ /gdong pa mchi mas dag dag gsol ba btab/ /u rgyan pad+mas bka')bstsal pa/ /bal rje sems la gcags gyur kyang / /kun sa 'dod chags sems dang ldan/ /gyong po klu grogs chung mar thal/ khyem thab 'dam rdzab nang du bzhugs/ /skyed po dmyal ba'i gdos la btags/ /rgyags sris stug bsnga'i chu rgyun sneng / /zhes gsungs so/ /lcags kyi bar snab 3ོga 25

mo 'gyu pa yi/ khams gsum sems can dam nyams bsgral du 'a jug /gnod sbyin rgod kha rang dbang med par khrog/ /srigo po lang ka rmagrin bcu'i dmag sde bkug /bdud rgyal re te mgo yag dmag sde bkug /bgegs rgyal byi nā ya kha'i dmag sde bkug /gnod sbyin rgon ma kha yis rting mnan nas/ /lha gcig kun sa bsad nas sha za zer/ /sa steng mi yi sras mo kun sa zhi/ /sa 'og gdon gyi pho brang klu yi yul/ /bdud kyis bslus pas lha lcam snying re rje/ /klu gyong lam du ma bor kha rje che/ /kun sa zhi ni 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying / /drid kyi 'brel med mi dge bcu dang 'brel/ /lus kyi sha nyams bkrag shor zazang rgyan chase rnams med/ /lha lcam klu ni gyong po'i phyir 'brangs pas/ /rnam smin la sogs 'phral la byung nas gda'/ /lha lcam 'aspyod lugs 'dren pa'i dus la babs/ /bal mo shāka khris mya ngan smre sngags 'don/ /bu mo chags pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /ngus pas sems can kun kyang skrag /mi yang skyi 'dar bla chig gzengs/ /rtag tu bu mo zhes brjod/ngu / /bal mo kun sa zhi bdud kyis paspus pa'i le'u ste pacu pa'o// //lha lcam kun sa zhi bdud kyis ngan song gnas su khri da pa1u rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung shenade dang / /bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro rnams/ /nam mkha'i skar tshogs rgyas pa tsam/ /'khor du ye shes mkha' 'gro til gang kha phye tsam/ /mab ni rgyal po shrī la maṣ+ṭṛ dang / /sras ni rgyal po ba su rte ra dang / yum ni bal mo shākya khri/ /snying po rnam gsum zlos shing ngu/ /slob dpon chas nas sa 'og gdon gyi yul/ /gdug pa klu rnams 'dar sha khyar/ /sngar sun pas na slob dpon 'phrad ma nus/ /'jigs shing skrag nas 26

poms cad pros/ /lha lcam mdun du rgyal rngo/ rnams kyis pyon/ /lha gcig kun sa zhi yi kha dog nyams/ /ngo gdong bkrag shor mgo yi skra bye thal kha ma/ /'a/nga rgo spa dman so nyams ser spyo zhig /mig nag sna skam rta rgan 'khrugs chan 'dra/ /mgo/che brang rus bkra bas bgrang du btub/ 1bzhin nyams lus kung mdog log sngo skya la/ /mdzes pa'i bkrag kung gtib yal ro dang mtshungs/ /sha yang yo shor pags pas g.yogs pa tsam/ /lhu tshegs rtsib ma bgrang du ngatub pa tsam/ /klu yi dug phog mdze rigs bco brgyad byung 1 /mig ni spu gsum kha ni zla gam song / /rnag gi dri ma mnam zhing shig nad zhugs/ /yapa yum pha ma ming po mthong bas dngangs/ /mchi ma khrug 'dzag yab yum spyan sngar byung / /'gyel gyin bub kyin 'dar gyin dngangs kyin byung / /de mthong bas ni yab yum spyan chab shor/ /rig 'dzin pho mo lnga brgya snying rje'i mchi ma zhor/ /slob dpon byen rlabs mdzad cing smon lam btab/ /bu mo 'di 'dra'i gud pa bya lam byed phyogs dor/ /snga ma'i tshad du bzang rgyan chas dang ldan/ /rtsedo gos bzang bas dad pa skyes/ /lha phyag btsal zhing bskor ba byas/ /lto gcig kun sa yab yum ming po 'grogs/ /bal po'i yul du gshegs nas 'gro ba la/ /bu mo yab kyi rjes la ma zin nas/ /yab dang rig 'dzin pho mo rnams/ /mdun nas je ring je ring 'gro 'phro la/ /gar song cha med phod de med nas song / /de dus lha gcig kun sa zhi/ /ma dang ming po stong nas med/ /sngar ma mthong ba'i yul khams shig tu slebs/ /yul yang shin tu rtsub cing rong dog pa/ /lcags kyi khang pa 'bar ba zhig tu phyin/ /mgo brnyan mi gcig skyes pa 'dug sgab brjes kha nas ngu sgra g.yab kyis 'debag/ 1lha lcam skyo nas de yi mdun du phyin/ /skyes pa pho brgya de rnams ci byed bdi+os/ /rgya shong zangs shig bab tu btsugs nas 'dug zangs kyi nang na ci 'dug bsta /421

0pa yis1 /bud yed badrang sdug can rnamab/ bcug nasaḥ/doduge khug chu ngatshod cing skabs bkrug kha gcod 'dug /sbud pa thogs pa bcu yis 'bud cing 'dug /tho ba thogs pa bcu yis gshog gin 'dug /spu gri thogs pa bcu yis gcod kyin 'dug /gsor chen thogs pa bcu yis 'be+egs kyin 'dug /gzong chen thogs pa bcu yis 'dra yin 'dug /star chen thogs pa bcu yis gtubs kyin 'dug /gzer chen thogs pa bcu gis 'debs kyin 'dug 1garbar bu thogs bcu yis 'chu yin 'dug /phor pa thogs pa bcu yim 'thung gin 'dug 1shin tu mi bzod dmyal sgra 'byin/ /lha lcam de la snying rje skyes/ /kye ma kyi hud/ /skyes pa brgya la snying rje mi 'dug pa/ /zangs su bcug pa'i bud med 'di nyid la/ /'di tsam pa yi spyod sbyong byed pa ni/ /'di yis khyod la ci yi nyes pa byas/ /de skad lha lcam kun sa zhi yis smras/ /spu ba badze+es nga'i ji panyupa lago btab pa/ /'di ni 'jig rterdo mi yul 'dug tsa na /shin tu dge 0 bcu wa be+e mos par/ /mi dge bcu la mos pas terdo /'dod chags che zhing g.yem la dga'/ /skyes pa bslus shing khyim la dad/ /semaso can bsad nas gnyen 'khor skyong / /bden ba'i bka' la mi nyan par//mi bden byed pa'i/ phyi rtselededu'edubrongs/ /shi nas da lta rnam smin byung ba yin1 /de skad mgrin gcig skyes pa brgyas smras pas/ rdolha lcam kun sa rang gi mtshang la phog /bdag kyang las de byas pa'i nyes yod pas/ /shi nas ji lta bu ru skye'am bsam/ shin tu sha rus spyi bung rgya/ dga'o/ 1de nas gom gcig gom gnyis bros te phyin/ /lcags kyi khang pa 'bar ba zhig nang na/ /skyes pa pho brgya 'dus nas 'dug zangs de khrug gis bkang nas 'dug /me yi studwa pa bsasgos nas 'dug sa nas nam 'ong nam 'ong zer/ /phyopa/sa bzhi kun la 3 shā+o/yin 'dug /de la lha lcam 4ོga pa zos/ /skyes pa brgya la 'de skad ཿ3

smras/ /snyeng rje med pa'i pho khrom brgya/ /zangs 'di btsugs nas khyed ci byed/ /'jigs pa'i lag cha thogs pa rnams/ /sems can gang la brdeg pa yin/ /nam 'ong zer zhing phyogs bzhir blta/ khyed brgya'i gan du su zhig 'ong / /de skad lha lcam smras pa dang / /skyes brgya dus gcig 'di skad smras//nged ni 'jig rten mi yul na1 /bud med ngan la g.yo sgyu che/ /bal rje'i sras mo kun sa zhi/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'dra ba bor/ /ming po ba su ste ra 'dra ba bor/ /mched grogs shākya de ba 'dra ba bor/ /yab yum gnyis ka ring du bor nas su/ /gdug pa mi ma yin gyi phyi la 'brangs1 /las ngan sa 'og klu yi yul du phyon/ /dud 'gro klu yi sdug bsngal myong nas su/ /rig 'dzin yab dang slob dpon rjes ma zin/ /de lta bu yi lha lcam kun sa zhi/ /da ni mi thogs phyur du 'chi rgyu yin/ /shi ma thag tu gshin rjes 'dir khrid 'ong //bud med pha gi spyod sbyong byed pa bzhin/ /nged kyang kun sa zhi la spyod mjeng byed/ /de skad ces pa pho brgyas smras pa dang / /bal mo lha lcam kun sa zhi/ /shin tu dngangs gos bred de brgyal/ /lha lcam kun sa zhi bdud kyis ngan song gnas su khrid pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //lha lcam kun sa zhi ngan song nas bton pa/de nas u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /bal mo shākya de ba dang yab ni bal rje lha khri dang / yum ni shākya khri ma dang / /ming po ba su dha ra yis//lha lcam kun sa brgyal ba'i sngas 'ongs bteg bu mo khyod ni ma brgyal yar longs dang / /snga ma'i las la 'gyod pa drag po skyes/ /sbyin pa phangs med gtong nus shing / /bshags pa drag po byed nus pa/ /mchod pa bzang po 2

'bul nus te/ /yan lag padun pa byed nus na/ /dmyal zangs 'di nang mi 'tshod la/ /skyes pa 'di brgyas skyod spyong mi byed na/ /sdig pa bcu spangs dge bcu spyad pa yis/ /ngan song sdug bsngal nyams su myong don med/ /ces sgob dpon pad+mas gsungs so/ /bu mo brgyal sangs dga' ba'i sems bye+os nas/ /gnas mchog dam par lha lcam khrid nas phyin/ /lha lcam kun sa zhi yis 'di skad zhus/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas mkhas pa'i mtshog /rnam pa ci yang mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gcig pu/ /bdag ni mo shesas mi dge bcu/ /sngon kyang las ngan sdig bsags pas /da lta za ma mo yi lus/ /mo yi nang nas chags pa che/ /las ngan glu gyong 'khor bar sbrel/ /dud 'gro'i yul nas dmyal bar phyin/ /thabs mkhas rgyal pos bton ༷pa lags/ /da rung sems ni ma bde thugs rjes zungs/ /zhes zhus so/ //sku rgyan chen pos bka' bstsal pa/ /sngar byas sdig tshogs sems can ma rig blo/ /rig nas bshags byed phyis spong dge ba rab/ /dad pa brtan po phyir mi sdog pa'i rgyu/ /bka' 'dus lha tshogs mtshan nas bajod/ /lus kyis gcer sbyangs gdab pyag sems kyis 'gyod/ /ngan song gsum du dogs mi 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bal mo kun sa zhi yis gsol/ /bud med shin tu rig pa blo chung na/ /mchod pa rnam lnga gsung bar zhu/ /u rgyan chen pos bka' bstsal pa/ /gang zag dbang po rab 'breng tha ma gasrum/ /de dang bstun pa'i theg pa rim pa dgu /theg pa re la mchod pa lnga lnga 'byung / /dug lnga'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i gnas su skye/ /zhe sdang byams pa'i mchod dang gcig /'dod chags sbyin pa'i mtshod dang gnyis/ /gti mug ye shes mtshod dang gsum/ /phrag dog dag snang mchod dang bzhi/ /nga rgyal zhi ba'i mtshod dang lnga/ /de lnga rgyu yi theg pa gsum gyi mchod pa'o/ /skye ba rnam bzhi sgom ba'i mchod dang gcig 130

'khor ba'i lam lnga sbyor ba'i mchod dang gnyis/ /ston mongs bag chags sbyong ba'i mchod dang gsum/ /lha mo'i tshogs bskyed mchod pa dang ni bzhi/ /ting ngadzin ye shes klong mchod dang lnga ste/ /de lnga lam gyi theg pa gsum gyi mchod pa'o/ /lus gus pa'i mchod pa dang gcig ngag snyan pa'i mchod pa dang gnyis/ /yid dang ba'i marmod pa dpa gsum/ /'dod yon gtsang ma'i mchod pa dang bzhi/ /rdzas mdzes pa'i mchod pa dang lnga/ /de lda 'bras bu'i theg pa gsum gyi mchod pa'o/ /mar me mun sel mchod pa dang gcig /sbyar sgos dri bzang mchod pa dang gnyis/ /be+e sman ro mchog mchod pa dang gsum/ /yon chab zhal zas mchod pa dang bzhi/ me tog mdzes pa'i mchod pa dang lnga/ sa/de lnga phyi mchod rnam pa lnga'o/ /sku'i mchod pa phyag rgya dang gcig gsung gi mchod pa snyeng po dang gnyis/ /thugs kyi mchod pa ting nge 'dzin dang gsum/ /yon tan gyi mchod pa yo byad dang bzhi/ /'phrin las kyi mchod pa sner sgom dang lnga'o/ /nyer lnga drang don tsam du bye ba las/ /nges don rtogs na gcig gi nang/ du gcig tshang ngo / /ting 'dzin mchod pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /rgyal jid sna bdun pakra shis rdzas brgod do/ /rdzas la brten pa'i sdig sgrib sbyar ngasgyur bstan/ /gang zag blo rab ting 'dzin mchod pa yin/ /tha mal mtshod pa /bas da yo byad sogs/ /bka' 'dus pho brang bzhengs la dbul bar bya/ 1nyin par mchod pa spos dang me tog bzang / /mtshan mo'i mchod pa spos sbar mar me bzang / /nyin mtshan rgyun du sbyar spos bzang ba'o/ /snying po ngan song dong sprug yig brgya bzang / /sman rag gtor gsum nang gi mchod par bzang / /sku mdog phyag mtshan gdan khri rgyan chas la/ /spro bsdu 'od zer phyogs bcur spro zhing bsdu/ /lus ngag yid gsum thang bcad phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon thongag sgrib pa1 /shes bya'i sgrib pa/ /ma rig sgrib pa/ /bag chags sgrib 31

pa/ /rnam smin hrib pa/ /las kyi sgrib pa/ /stoms 'jug gi sgrib pa/ 1sprul ba'i sgrib pa/ /tshos kyi sprib pa/ /btang snyoms kyi sgrib pa/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems tan sdig sgrib spyongs/ /bsdu na lus ngag yid gsum sgrib par 'dus/ /khams gsum las kyis 'khor ba'i sems can 'khor/ /sdug pasngal las kyis 'khor ba'i sems can 'khrul/ /las kyis gdungs nas sbyong ba restobs po che/ /'di lta bu yi 'gyod tshangs sdig bshags bstan/ /phyi rabs rnams kyi dpe ru bzhag nas song / /zhes gsungs so/ /lha gcig kun sa zhi yis bsgrubs/ /lha lcam kun sa'i sgo gsum sdig sgrib rnams/ /me long phyis pa g.ya' dag bzhin du song / /lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag pa thob/ /lha sku shel sgong phyis 'dra ba bzhin/ /dri med zhod zer 'phro ba mkha' spyod yal/ /lha lcam kun sa zhi ngan song nas bton pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //lha 'dre g.yul phog pe/de nas sto bal ma'i' 'khob yul/ /pur+ṇa yangari glang chen sna ru byon/ /—krid la nye bstan 'khor bcas rnams/ /mi mtshar dkar po dar thod can/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shub g.yon/ /rta di sngon po 'ja' 'dra rgon/ /lag tu dar chen phyar nas byung / /bod khams skye 'gro yongs la phan pa yi/ /bka' dam btags nas gces phreng gtad / /bas sgom 'di nyid la dbang ba/ /yo rgya brtson 'grus seng ge zhes/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ /khyad par gsang sngags rnying ma sbyangs/ /grub chen brgyad kyis byin gyis chabarlabs/ /rgya nas bod 'gror 'ongs pas phyin/ /de bar khyed kyis rgyadazha shig 32

gsungs/ /klu gyong bar snang glog ma spren/ /gnod sbyin rgod kha 'bum phrag btsas/ /srid pa rgya mtsho'i gting rum nas/ /glu yi yul khams cho ngem gang / /srid pa gsum gyi dmag sde bcas/ /drag shul khros pa'i nga ro sgog /klu bdud 'bum gyi dmag sde bcas/ /gnag pa'i las kyiso 'idiraskad lo/ /mi shes dgu shes pad+ma 'byung / /mi byed dgu byed shar shor byed/ /mthong gsal rig ba'i dbang po 'phrog /nged kyi lha gasnyeg kun sa brkus/ /srid pa'i bud med de 'dra ba/ /mthong ba tsam gyis mi khyim 'tshangs/ /bal rje'i bu mo ya mtshon can/ /rgya gar yul nas phur pa khyer/ /yang le shod du phebs pas brlag 'phung byed las kyi rdzun byed pad+ma 'byung / /mig nos bltas kyang nar sas mi mthong na/ /nged gnyis gsad kyang rung la sbas kyang rung / /nor gyis phye nas bslus kyang mi yong ge gang byung dag gis rgyug cing gsad pa 'thad/ sbyoḥmang yul la 'phro nga thams cad rnams/ /yar lha sham pos dgo gcig gdams/ she:༅ la kha chen skungs rgya byas pa yis/ /skungs gcig ma gsod gcig gis gesod par 'gyur/ /'dzam gling mi phyugs bla tshe brkus/ /dmag ston byas nosi kha bar bskos/ /zhang zhung dgra lha mu tsa med/ /kong btsun de mo sman btsun de mo bzhi/ /lha rigs pha ma mched sogs gnod sbyin bzhi/ /gnam sman dkar mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi/ /las su bcol na ci yang nyan/ /don du baspyobs1na ci yang 'grub/ /pad 'byung ngan byed pa la shog zer degos/ /'u lug bre mo sna ru skungs chug bgros/ /gnam thang skungs chug thog thob gsod cig bsgos/ /rdo rje legs pas 'u yug nang gong skungs/ khyod ni pho nya 'khor tshogs mang / /shin hūṃ mi bzad khro gtum che/ /rang la rang tshig g.yab mos thob/ /'o dod 'bod cing 'dun ma bsdus/ /ku la thang lhar thang lha ya bzhur dang / /rgyab dpung shab kyi 'bar ba nag po dang / /gnyan chen thang lha 33

jo tho chen po gsum/ /gzhi bdag ku lung btsan bzhi 'jog /glu gyong bdag gis mngags pa'i tshe na 'dun/ /nyin mtshan dmyal ba gnam gyi chu tshan du/ /las ngo mi len so sha yu3chung 'jog rgya mtsho mer ba'i khyud 'gram du/ /dzong slon skyes chung phan mo dar/ /ma bcol spung mar khas 'ches pa/ /pad 'byung 'gro rkang bcag pa'i dus la bab/ /stod lung ko ba brag phug tu/ /ma mo 'apar ma gsum skungs gzhug /mun mtsho 'khrug pa'i rba glong du/ /bdud doms yongs la dbang sgyur gzhug khams kyi gla ba rkang gcig tu/ /rdor leṭa the'u rang dbang skyur gzhug /sing ge brag phug gu lang 'phen/ /dbang phyug chen po dbyug pa thogasga/ /mdo smad an chung gnam rdzong brag phug tu1 //ma sangs rgyal po 'ging ba gzhug /dmu bdud rje rgyal zhe sdang che/ /dmu rje sman shung yib chags rno/ /bra'u re gdong re rgyal can/ /srid pa'i rgya' mo dmag la rngams/ /skyes bu lung btsan las ngo len/ /srog bdag rgyal po mi stong med/ /srid ba'i rgyal mo rgyab dpung mdzod/ /ma srid rgyal mo 'dun ma sdud/ /byang sman rgyal mo mkha' la gnas/ /sa bdag klu gnyan snying nas 'dren/ /sa srin glu srin cho/'phrul che/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu 'dun ma dril/ /ldateng ldams bud med sa bdag mo/ /gnod sbyin bu mo gshin rje'i thu lo dang / /klu yi bu mo gnyan gyi bu mo dang / /bdud kyi bu mo glu bdud glu btsan dang / /bsam gyis mi khyab brjod mi lang / /'phan yul gtsang ra mo ru ting lo sman/ /g.yu mtsho gting gi sman gcig mo/ /las sru mngags pa'i pad 'byung sribs/ /gting gi 'tsho sman sha gdong ma/ /sku mdog g.yu mthing 'od du 'tsher/ /sbrul nag ral pas lus kun khebs/ /stag sman gdong dan srin po gsum/ /srog gcod lag na ral gri thogs/ /zas mu mi sha rta sha za/ /skom du mi khrag rta khrug 'thung / /mi grogs stong gi thul ba gyon/ /nad kyi rkyal 34

pa mchan na sgosda/ mtshon gyidophyo bu klad na 'thul/ /stod lung gram bu yul tshal du/ /gnod sbyin gtsug na me 'bar skungs/ /gzhong pa mda' dzu lha 'dre /gar 7ོ/skungs/ /mal gro mda' dang phu rgya mtshor/ /klu rigs kun gyi rjer byur pa/ /glu ni mal gro gzi can skungs/ kha la brag ring sma chen skungs/ / btsan dang bdude dme thams cad skungs/ /g.ya' ri gong du thenyu rang 'gong po skungs/ /hes po ri ru glu rigs skungs/ /mang/yul bye ma'i rang kha ru/ rdolha srin sde brgyad skungs kha btsugs/ /ro ha lung pa khru mo ru/ /ma larmes pho nya ma rnarmes spungs/ /rgetsad/gi gsil ma gangs dkar du/ /sman mo shid rmedo khrorme tshogs skungs/ ༷/gtsang gi kha dag gshe' kig tu/ /'brog mo mi mo snyelda tshogs skunges/ /bzheg pa'i las su pad 'byud 'duX/ /mang yul kha gung sheng sa rdes/ /sa stode srin go/rdod/dang stag ri brag lha rtse rdzong dang shangs snyi zam bu ljong / /phag ri spa gro mon du rdzong rnams brtsigs/ /stod du rganga' ris skor gsum dmag gis bkang / /bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi dmag gis bkad / /smad du mdo khams bco brgyad dmag gis bkang / /drwag ngar/'dul stobs che ba lha 'dre'i dmag /no mtshon mgyogs lus dpa' sde che pa ga gang// /gnag pa'i las su slob dpon pad 'byung dgug 1dben cing drag po'i mogo tan tshang ba'i gnas/ /pad 'byung khyer dogs lha 'dres bdagabazwang rdas/ /ro langs bdun pas las kyi pho nya 'gyed1 /rlung 'tshub rdzu 'phrul mang po 'gyed la brtson/ /me chu dug spyogs mda' mdung gri pya/niX// 'phur/ /thog dang serā ba sad/dang mu ge rims/ /ma /sa nad dmag 'khru1na khings log byed rngo/ra 'cham/ /lha 'dre g.yus pog pa'i yethu ste bcu gsum nga 'o// // 3/ da

bal yu tā/ yang pe rke+ogod du phur pa phebs patsushe sa lha 'dres zhe bsnyegs byung ba/de nas dge bsnyen chen po kha ri dang / /gnas po chen po ba bla dang /1banas po chen po ze sngon dang / /dge bsnyen chen po ston dga' bzhis/ /glu jur po dang gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/ /bar snang glog ma sprin la gros btab pa/ 1tha ma bud med min pas 'phung mi g.yo/ /rta yo ma min pas tshangs mi nus/ /rdor brkus sgor min pas sgog mi skyel/ /tshod med pham pa min pas rgyal mi zin/ /rgyus med tsab tsub mangs na 'bub pa'i rgyu/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi ni ngo mi thub/ phur pa'i dbal ni sus kyang mi bzod pa/ /dper na nam mkha'i sdog babs lta bus mtshon/ /gang la phog pa rdul phran ltar gtong na/ /lta 'dro'i srid ni zhig na'ang zhig /dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas su mi tshugs mod/ /ces/smras nas song ngo / /glu gyong po dang gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/ /sgog ma sprin gsum gros byas te/ /gros 'cham byang phyogs ge sar khrom gyi yul/ /yi dwags phre ta pu ri bod kyi yul/ /de yi nang nas gdug pa can gyi yul/ /dwags po kong po nyang po gsum gyi yul/ /nag po bdud dang cha lugs mthun pa'i yul/ /kong yul srid dbang che ba kong rje dkar po skungs/ /rgya lag thod rje kong yul srid dmag gcod/ /nyang srid kong srid dwags srid dmag sde gcod/ /kong rje dkar pos dmag gi gros byas pa/ /bdud shor ba rkya bdun mdun du bkug gyong bo'i dmag tshogs 'bum sde kong yul lhags/ /kong po thams cad 'jigs shing skrag par gyur/ /kong rje dkar pos dmag pha lan spur ba/ /sngar nas ma mthong dmag tshogs gang du gshegs/ /de la klu gyong 36

rgod ma kha dang ni/ /par snang glog ma sprin gsum lan btab pa/ /nged ni lta ma srin rnams 'dus pa'i dmag /kong rje nyid dang srid la 'ongs/ /nged kyi lha gcig kun sa zhi1 1nged gsum thob pa pad 'byung phrogs/ /dgra ma thub pas khyod la skyabs/ khyed rnams 'jigs skrag mi dgos kyi/ /nged cag bdud kyis kho ma thub/ /bdud dmag mang po gros byas pas/ /mi yi gnyen por mi nyid yin/ /gnyal la ka bzhi gdung drug lod/ /stod na bya dang gnyos gnyis dmag srid gcod/ /smad na gnye ba thag sde dmag srid gcod/ /bar na rog shang ro rje dmag/srid gcod/ /gdung drug dmag gis pad 'byung gsod par nges/ /sho chos gnyis dang yo la stong gleng gi sa/ /ka bzhi'i dmag brgyab sham po gangs zhal 'jog /g.ye mo yul drug mkharwa bzhis sa 'gag sdom/ /lo ro mi sde chen po drug /stod na sgru dang grum gnyis dmag srid gcod/ /bar na gro chadang nyang gnyis dmag srid gcod1 /smad na gdug dang skrag gnyis dmag srid gcod/ /lho brage ya brgyad gdug pa can gyi yul/ /dge bsnyen ston dga' bros song yang / /gnod sbyin rgod ma kha/gis bkug pas khugs/ /yar 'brog sgang gsum dmag sde srid du gcod/ /mu tig sru ma gong du dzong rtsig 'jug /pho spyog brag la dmag sgar 'debs/ /yar mo sna ba bzhi po dmag srid gcod/ /rgya mtsho yar gsum mar gsum dmag dpon pa la bos/ /bar snang glog ma sprin gyes bos pas 'ong / /de skad gyong po glu yis smras pa dang / /kong rje dkar po dmar po nag po gsum/ /dmag tshogs mang po tshur nyon dang / /'di dang nged gsum 'thab yun shin tu ring / /sngon dus ru dra thar pa nag po yis/ /las kyi skye ba ngan pa stong nyams nas/ /skye ba brgyad khri tshan pa gsum du blangs/ /skye ngan skye chung gshed pos bsad pa'i lus/ /dpag tu med pa blangs pa'i phyi ma ni/ /srin yul lang ka phu ri'i slad 'tshong ma/ pa /kun 37

tu rgyu yi bu ru skyes pa'i dus/ /'jig rten khams rnams dbang du bsdus pa yin/ /dam pa tog dkar gyes kyang ma thub par/ /pad 'byung rta phag gnyis stsa sprul nas btul/ /nged kyang kong po dgos pa byung ba yin/ /rdzus skyes yin na dze+e+o/'dres ye mi thub/ /mngal skyes yin na ji lta bu yang thub/ /rdzu 'phrul thabs kyis ci sod ma byas na/ /no ba'i mtshon gyis 'di ni ye mi gsod/ /drag po'i dmag tshan che yang kho mi thub/ /pad 'byung rdzu 'phrul thabs kyis ngasad do zer/ /kong rje mched gsum gros la bsdus te 'cham/ /bal yul yang le shod du phur pa phebs pas lha 'dre'i zhe bsnyegs byung ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //dam can rdo rje legs pa dam la btagam pa/de nas u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /lha 'dre gdug pa'i zhe bsnyegs ca khyen nas su/ /bal yul lam 'phrang lam la gshegs tsa na/ /yar lha sham pos kaungs thog brgyab/ /g.yag dkar ri tsam zhig tu sprul/ /'us 'debs brag rnams thams cad rlog /lam 'phrung bcad nas 'gro sa med par byas/ /kha rlangs sna rlangs na bun bzhin du 'thibs/ kha char babs pas lam mi mthong ba byas/ /slob dpon rked nas gser gyi rdo rje bton/ /brag la brgyab pas brag phug hur gyis brdol/ /bug pa'i nang na tshur la 'dzul nas byon/ /ming yang rdo rje phug lam zhes su grags/ /da lta 'grim tshad de nas tshur la rgyu/ /slob dpon g.yag dkar ri rab tsam phyag rgyas bsdoms/ /rdo rjes btsogs pas khye'u chung zhige tu gyur/ /mang yul phug mda'i nang du khye'u chung khrid/ /nga la 'di bzhin byed pa ji lta bu/ khyod bsad bam sgrub byed nga yin no gsungs/ /38

khye'u rlung dngangs bred ngadar grob zhus/ /log par lta ba'i spyong po glu/ /slob dpon thugs rjesam btul na/ /skyo 'brul 'phro mi chad par 'ong / /gtam snyan sgogs pas katong bar zhu/ /nga yi srog snying 'di nyid bzhes par zhu/ /a cig sa dza/ /nga yi gnas su bam sgrub mi mdzad zhu/ /srog snying phul bas dam la btags/ /gter kha gcig gi gnyer byang bcol/ /gar 'gro zhes gsungs gangs la song / /de nas kha la la can byon tsa na/ /zhang zhung dgra mu tsa med skungs su tshud/ /slob dpon gdan 'drin bang chen mi gsum dang / /slob dpon dpon g.yog ri gnyis bar du bcar/ /slob dpon gsod par brtsam pa las/ /slob dpon ri yi kha la byon/ /g.yas g.yon phyag mkhar btsugs nas lam btod de/ /sgol lang rje gsal snang dang / /seng marga lha lung dang / /klu gzig gsum gyis lam btod shul la 'ongs/ /lam/phyed pas ni dngangs skrag skyes/ /go ni rab tu bred par gyur/ /thugs rje mi phyogs pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /srog gi snying po 'di 'bul lo/ /la lā partsi/ /srung mar khas blangs dam bcas gter gcig gtad/ /gsang mtshan rdo rje g.yu bun ma ru btags/ /de nas 'u yug bre mo sna ru byon/ /bod khams bstan ma bcu gnyis par gcod byas/ /ri gnyis bar du bcar bar byas pa la/ /slob dpon bar snang mkha' la byon/ /pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pas ngo mtshar rtags/ /nged cag bar chod mi tshugs bkra shis zhu/ /sku la mi bdo zhabs la skyabs su mchi/ /gro na snying phul nas dam la btags1 /gter kha gcig gtad gnyer byang bcol/ /de nas kha rag la khar byon tsa na/ /gangs dkar mo yi skungs thog 'thums/ / thog mdang dgu ni dus gcig phab/ /slob dpon phyag mdzub dkris nas chu nang bsgyur/ /mo bred dpal mo/dpal mtsho'i nang du bros/ /mtsho khar rdo rje bzhag pas mtsho bakhol lo/ /mo yi sha rus sde nas keng rus dkar sang song / /gatshog dumi

/naka spyod mtsho 'di yi sgo chod dam/ /de skad zer cing mtsho khar bros nas ༷ sprung / /slob dpon rdo rje 'phangs bas mig zhar ro/ /bar gcod byed na de khyer de la 'gom/ /zhes gsungs pas/ /slob dpon spyan sngar 'di skad zhus/ /ke ston pa'i zhal skyin rdo rje thod phreng rtsal/ /bar gcod mi bgyid thugs dam dgongs pa glod/ /sgyu ma'i phung po nyon mongs snying re rje/ /'bras bu sems ༷'di zhe ma 'tsho bas nyams/ /ci bgyi'i bka' nyan slob dpon 'bangs su mchi/ /sgog snying phul nas dam la btags/ /gsang mtshan sha sted rdo rje g.yu bsgon ma/ /garter kha gcig gi gnyer gtad bcol/ /de nas 'u yug nang gong /byon tsa na/ /yang ma pecu gnyis thog mda' bcu gnyis phab/ /pad+ma 'byung /gnas log po can/ /'khor ba'i sa ru ci la 'ongs/ /klu dang 'thab zla ci la ༷byed/ /lha lhom khyod kyis log par khrid/ /mtho ris drongs zer rdzun so/che/ / /—ngo tsha sted pa'i khrel med po/ /bud med khrom tshogs mang pos cho nges btab/ / sa slob dpon thog la phyag mdzub gtad/ /thog mda' gron ma tsam du zhu nas song //༷lang ma bcu gnyis sol dum bcu gnyis song / /srog snying phul nas 'di sgad / do/ /e e ming po rdo rje gro bo lod/ /dbang chen rngams pas lha 'dre dbang du sdud/ /ye shes rngams pas log lta gnas su sgol/ /'brin las rdzogs pa'i /sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgog snying phul nas dam la btags/ /gter kha gcig 1gi gnyer gtad bcol/ /de nas rdo rje legs pas bsu ba byas/ /gu ru chan kos bka' bstsal pa/ /dam long dam long rdo rde legs pa khyod/ /tshog long tshig long mgar ba nag po khyod/ /de nas 'u yug bye tshang rdzong mkhar byon/ / shar brang chu gong kha'i glang po sna la gzigs/ /pho/rog pas kyang mi rigs sdug ma'i sa/ /gnas 'di chos brgyad sgrub pa'i sa bon can/ /sto khe'u gtsang po ༷rnan cen rta la gzigs/ /nyug pa bas kyang mi rigs sdug pa'i hor/ /sprel bhe40

bas ngan song gsum gyi so nam rem rem 'dra/ /nupa chu mig ne'u gsing rma bu'i mdongs la gzigs/ /pho rog 'ug pa'i bar pa sus mi yong / /mi bde—rlung 'tshub ldang ba'i sde chen 'ong / /byang spun po ri'i mkha' sding gshog lasagazigs/ /btsun pa 'dul khrims med pa'i spyang po dang / /sngags pa dam chig med pa'i glen pa dang / /bud med dad pa med pa'i drag mo gsum/ /'di gsum kun la mi gtogs mi srid do/ /'di gsum ngas brtsams chos kyi bstan pa 'jig /sa phyogs dkar po seng ge'i gdong la gzigs/ /bdud khyab pa lag ring 'di ru 'khrungs/ /zhe sdang las gyur dmag gi 'jigs pa 'byung / / 'dod chags las gyur mu ge'i 'jigs po 'byung / /gti myag las gyur nad yams 'dzigs pa 'byung / /zhes gsungs so1 /de nas rdor legs mched bcas bas ba byas/ /e ma ho/ /sku lnga yongs rdzogs bla ma rdo rje 'chang / rtemi bde ba ye rlung 'tshub ldang la gzigs/ /mi skyid pa yi nyi ma shar la gzigs/ 'jig rten khams ni g.yo 'gulo gling log gzigs/ /ma dag 'di la mya ngan bya mi rung / /pad 'byung sems kyis ma bzod nga da pa med/ /bar gcod mi bgyid bstan pa bsrung phyir du/ /ma mo'i lag skyogs nang nas rdeg pa 'bul/ /the'u rang rkang gcig phyi nas rdeg pa 'bul/ /de la 'dra ba'i dpe brgyad bstan par bya/ /skyon med drang po rdo ba kho na yin/ /dma' mor 'gro zhing mthon por thog pa yin/ /dpe ni skrung ka tshang du 'gro ba 'dra/ /thur la rgyag pa'i dpe ni kho na ste/ /dgra ri yid tsam smad la bya/ /zun ri yid tsam steng la bya/ /thag 'then bag tsam dma' bar bya/ /rang sa yid tsam mtho bar bya/ 1mdzub mo yid tsam bkug la bya/ /shing 'dren bstungs la sun 'dren bsrings/dper na ci 'dra byas tsa na/ /rgya khru ga na la gcum pa 'dra/ /gyen la rgyag pa'i dpe bstan pa1 /gong ma las ni ldog pas te/ /dper na ci 'dra byas441

tsa na/ /bya nag gzan khyer ba dang 'dra/ /chang thab byed pa'i gnad bstan /pa1 /bya jis smad la mdzub mo bskyod/ /'ur thog bstungs la bcug la 'phangs/ /dper na ci 'dra byas tsa na/ /sgong pa yed de rtse ba 'dra/ /nga ni spyogs kyi khams bstan pa/ /spyogs mde'u me yi khams yin pas/ /phra la khyug pa dgos pa yi na/ khang pa nam mkha'i khams yin pas/ /che/la yangs pa dgos pa yin/ /mdzub mo lcags kyi khams yin pas/ /mnyergo/la 'jam pe nagos pa yin/ /rdo ni thog gi khams yin pas/ /drag cing tsha ba dgos pa yiste/ /bya spre'u/sa yi khams yin pas/ /mi 'igul brtan pa dgos pa yin/ / / di rgyag pa'i man ngag bstan/ /sa la gzhag thabs rnam lnga yod/ /sho yi stan la dpe long la/ /shar ni lta bur rgyag pa na/ /rdo nar ba ni g.yas su 'gro //sdeb na g.yon du 'gro ba sten/ /hril ba dbus su 'gro ba yin/ /de bzhin lto dang nub dang byang / /mtshams bzhi yang ni de bzhin shes/ /spyogs mkhan brang gi lte sna nas/ /pus mo'i lha nga yan chod la/ /'dzin pa dgu bcu go dgu yod/ /g.yas su shor na g.yon nas bsgyed/ /g.yon du shor na g.yas nas bskyed/ /'bugs na snyingadagi dkyil nas bskyed/ /gshog na pus mo'i lha nga nas/ /gcod na rked pa'i dkyil nas bskyed/ /de la ma tshad bu khrid dang / /bu tshad ma ni khrid pa dang / /nar tshad leb ni khrid pa dang / /leb tshad nad ni khred pa dang / /zur tshad 'jong ni khrid pa dang / /'jong tshad zur ni khrid pa dang / /che lam chung ni khrid pa dang / /chung mal che ni khrid pa'o/ /rdo rigs mi 'dra mtha' yas shāng / /'gran kyi do med gsum la 'dus/ /sgo nga 'dra na 'gran gyi do med yin/ /snying ni 'dra na 'gran gye do med yigo/ /mkhal me 'dra na 'gran gyi do med yin/ /rdo rigs mi 'dra zad med yod byur kyang / /nar ni ji ltan dzhardo la gzhag yar bya/ /zur ni ji ltar mnan nas gzhag par 42

bya/ /rdo mgo dgra sar bstan la 'phangs/ /de ni 'phrul can rdo yi man ngag yin/ /de la mkhas pas go long ci rigs mdzod/ /mkhas pa rab 'cha' ba la mkhas pa dnge / /'bring/tshad 'tshol ba la mkhas pa dang / /tha ma rgyag pe 'a/ mkhas pa'o/ /dang po spyogs khang / /bar du shing bzo/ /mtha' ma rgyag thabs so/ /de 'a ras bal gyi skul mo rgyang ring / /ko ba'i sgul mo kha gze/ /rang phyogs 'di yi sor bzhi la/ /pha gi dgra phyogs 'dom gang yod/ /de la do/log byung na gzhug log bya/ /shing log byung na 'then log bya/ /dgra log byung na skor log bya/ /mtho na gnya' gcog pa'i gdams ngag gsum la/ /mda' mos gcog pa dang / /mdzub mos gcog pa dang 1 /'ur thog gis gcog pa dang gsum/ /rdo zha bo gso ba la gsum/ /dbung pas gso ba darnga / skul mos gso be dang / /rdo rang ges gso ba dnge gsum mo/ /thung na sgab rkyang pa la gsum/ /spyogs mde'us rkyang pa dang / /mdzub mos rkyang pa dang / /sgul mos rkyang pa dang gsum/ /spyogs kyi gnad nyen bstan pa ni/ /thu dkar na ne ma has dang gsum/ /de gsum 'dzom par ma song na1 /phyi la pagyeb pas nang du 'ong / /gnam du 'gro zhing stag kyang chag 'gro mi btub la spyogs kyi mde'u chog /bya thag phyir 'then ma shes na/ /byartami thebs pa'i skyode du 'gyur/ /gagyer thag nang 'then ma shes na/ /tshur 'ikhor mi btub skyon du 'gyur/ /thage 'then spyogs mkhan ma 'a chem na/ /spyogase mdang chag pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /mkhar spyogs thad kar ma song na/ /ya yor 'chor ba'i skyon du 'gyur/ /shar na yangs dog ma ran na/ /'khor du mi btub skyon du shegyur/ /spar nan tshad la ma phebs na/ /res mtho res thung skyon du 'gyur/ /ladzub 7ོ'i dgye dgu ma ran na/ /stag chag gnam ldings skyon du 'gyur/ /rdo ye gzharge thabs ma shes na/ /nang du 'khor ba'i skyon du 'gyur/ /stog mgo'i 43

mtho tshad ma shes na/ /tshabs chung rgyang thung skyon du 'gyur/ /skyon gyi nang nas yon tan shes par mdzod/ /da ni sprogs kyi dgra lha mchod thabs la/ /spyogs mkhan gyis sngags 'di rgyun du bzla/ /badz+ra ma dhu sa mā ya du pa tre dgra lha dza/ /shā pe ho/ /dung dung dza/ /dza/ /'phen pa'i dus su snying po batho/ /mdun du chang dang ra marga bshos bu bshams/ /chang phud 'brang rgyas ra'i dbang po lnga/ /chang la btab la mdun du gzhag /dang po/yul der sgogs‘ma 'phangs par 'dug na/ /yul bdag kun la bshos bu nyi shu dang / /spud ni nyi zhu rtsa gcig dang / /yul de'i 'dre ngan rnams la yang / /sha dum zan dum mgal pa mgo gsum 'phangs/ /chang phud 'thor zhing dam bdar bcol/ /bgos bu btang la bka' bsgo bya/ /rang yang chang ran 'thungs la gyeg pa'i dus/ /stong sdeb lan gsum gal che'o/ /de nas lha rdo yin pas dkar po 'phangs/ /de nas 'dre rdo yin pas ra mgo 'phang ngo / /de nas gor ma rdo rnams brgyag par bya/ /sheg pa 'then pa dam tshig rnam gsum bsrung / kha phyir mi blta ba dang gcig /gtam smra mi 'jug pa dang gnyis/ /skyogs mkhan gyi skad la nyan pa dang gsum/ /dam tshig 'di gsum ma nyams bsrung ba gces/ 1god ni 'di skad brngod par bya/ /smo ya rgo ya/ /drag thung drag thung phya'o/ /nyon cig zer ba shin ༄ོ/gces/ /de la mkhas pas ci rigs mdzod/ /da ni skyogs kyi sgra bshad bstan/ /sangaso rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /srid pa 'phyul gyi spyogs maṣan du bskos so/ /bstan srung pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rjes su 'jug pa/ /log parwa lta ba dang log par 'dren pa 'dul pa/ /kye dge bsnyen chen po sku la ngur sprig gi ber chen gsol/ chibs su rta nag rteng dkar chibs ba/ /phyag nanasbyo gas dang dar mdung dril ba/ /phyi na spyang ki khrid pa/ /steng na bya khru lding ba/ /lha ma srin gyi kha lo sgyur ba/ /skyes pa drag rim dang 4

rang chas su 'grogs pa/ /gser skyems la dgyes pa/ /ra'i krums gsol ba//dgra lha chen po de ring ming nas bos so/ /rten pa'i dam rdzas 'di na yod/ /dam tshig ma nyams/ /khyim du tho mi gtong / /skyes bu khyod kyes nga sma ma dbab cig /khyod la re nges so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad pa'i spyogs 'di/ /rteng gi lha la mi rgyag go /'og gi glu la mi rgyag go /bar gyi btsan la mi rgyag go /chos skyong srung ma la mi rgyag go /pho lha dgra lha rnams la mi rgyag go /yul lha yul bdag sa rten rnams la mi rgyag go /snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad la mi rgyag go /'go ba'i lha lnga la mi rgyag go /mkhar gye rtse lha la mi rgyag go /'o na drag po'i spyogs 'di gang la rgyag na/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ /sdang ba'i dgra /gnod pa'i bgegs/ /za 'dre dang phung 'dre dang / /sku la bdo ba rigs la snyeg pa/ /kha lag spyod pa gsum mi sri pa/ //dgra bo'i mkhar rdzong la rgyag pa yin/ /'di na kha mang gis glengs/ /mig mang gis blta/ /log par gleng du ma gzhug cig /dgra mkhar 'di rtsa nas phud/ /gzhung du gshogs/ /rked par gtubs/ rtse lha khyod mkhar de sgyel la nga'i ༷rogs shig gyis shig /de nas bshos bu phyogs kun la 'phang ngo / /spyogs kyi dgra lha gnyen po la rmed nas 'phen no/ /drag zhan med pa la gzhur mkhas pa nas 'then/ /mang nyung mnyam par bya/ /bya thag chod byas gcig gis gcig phyir bskyed/ /drag zhan ran par bya/ /mdzub mo dgye dgu thag gi tshad/ /ring na dgye la thung na dgu /mdzub mo'i dgye dgu skabs su bcos/ /lus mnyen po bas bya/ /'ur thog ring thung spyogs kyi tshad/ /che na ring la chung na thung / /de yang ma 'tshams 'dzol ba'i skyon bstan pa/ /smyogs mda' ring la spul mo thung ba ni/ /rdo che ba rnams lam la lus yin/ /skyogs mda' thung la /skul mo ring ba ni/ /rdo chung ba rnams lam du lus pa yin/ /thag cha dang byang 45

che chung ma stoms pa'i/ /rdo yi ljid ni shing la shong ba yin/ /bsdegs mar mi 'gro dgra la mi bsgyel lo/ /rdo yi ljed du ma mo shor ba yin/ /phan phogs gsum pa yin/ /de nas chung na thed chung gnad tshod sbyar/ /shes rab che dgos rig pa no ba gces/ /lig lig byas na phan par mchi/ /snga ma'i pyang 'phro med pa'i mtha' 'khob mi/ /las bzang bag chags med pa'i mtha' 'khob tu/ /sde brgyad spyogs rnams tshang bar ma bstan sbos/ /dgra la de ltar don dang ldan pa na/ /'dir yang srid sde /de dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bye ma bla med 'bras bu 'thob par zhu ba 'bul/ /log na nyes skyon rang la yod pas gzab/ /'di yi byed spyod sme ba lnga ser steng / /stag lo pa la nag po dud kha byug /mgo la 'bog zhu chen po bskon par bya/ 1g.yas sru tho ba g.yon du mgar sbud 'bu/ /lus la dar nag ber chen bsko+on par bya/ /mdun du gser khang g.yu khang phub/ /gser dang dengul gyi sgyed bu gzugs/ /gser gyi zangs bur zhim dgu zas g.yos byed/ /gser phor dngul phor sna dgu'i zas kyis bkang / /dam can rdo rje legs pa'i phyag tu drangs/ /'di ltar dgos pa'i bla rdo ma bcas na/ /sol dum btsugs pas ljon shing mi skye'o/ /sa bon mes tshig zhing btab 'bras bu yed/ /skyon gye phung por yon tan re thag chad/ /sems can gyis ni sdug bsngal snye+od nges so/ /de skad slob dpon nyid la phul/ /bka' dam mi 'da' dam bcas so/ /slob dpon pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ /ji ltar snyigs ma'i b.lasas can 'dul dka' yang / /sbyin pa btang na mi 'dod zer mgan med/ /'dul khrims gtsang ma de la thams cad brtse/ /zo bo bzang po de la thams cad mos/ /zhe 'dod bsgrub la slob ma ga la mos/ /bstan pa pashig pas bde gshegs ga la mnyes/ /spyod log byas pas mi nag ci ste mgu /ro ba/ngas bdun pa'i bstan pa 'byung bar nges/ /zha nye'i sdong po lcags kyis 46

/gcod pa ltar/ /rmedo r+shags ya bral chos rnams ma 'ongs 'byung / /dus ngan thams can dran rgya can blo ba/ /chos rnams thams cad bka' garter gnyis su 'dus/ /bstan pa gso phyir gsang gter brgya dang bcu/ /rdo rje ligs pa khyod la bcol lo gnyer/ /'khor ba'i chos la yid 'byung dpa' blo skye1 /tshoṭa bsags smon lam dag pas len du 'ong / /zhes gsungs gter gye gnyer pyang /gtad/ /dam can sdo rje legs pa dam la btags pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //sku la thang lha sha yu chung 'bar gsum dam la btags pa/de nas sku la thang lhar byon tsa/na/ /thang lha ya bzhur slob dpon nyams /tshad byas/ /gnod sbyin chen po mgo bo ri rab tsam/ /rkang pa khams kyi g.yer mo thang du brkyangs/ /lag g.yes la stod dgon pa nang yar brkyangs/ /lag /g.yon gtsang la dgon du slebs shig brkyangs/ /sbrul chen zhig tu bajus nas lam bkag go /slobaXdapon phyag gis sdigs mdzub yug gi mdzad/ /byis pa zur phud can pa zhig tu gyur/ /slob dpon zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /thang lha ya bzhur zhes bya ba/ /mi yod 'dod can 'dir 'dug pa1 /nga ni bal po'i yul na yod tsa na/ /a su ra yi brag phug kho yis 'ongs/ /de ring kho la bro zhig slong gsungs nas/ /gangs dkar ti se'i gangs la gshegs so gsung / /cha yod kun la ma spos gyod cig mchi/ /gsol zas 'o mi brgyal bar 'drin 'tshal na/ khyod ni dri za'i rgya' po zur phud lnga/ /rgyal blon 'khor tshogs sbyin par mi gtong ngam/ /glu yi rgyal po de le thod dkar zhes/ /mu ges gdungs pa 3khrigs pa phar song gsungs/ /ñcag bor seng ge chen po zhig tu brdzus/ kho sto7

la la deg ni bar snang 'khrigs/ /la la dag ni sa gzhi khengs/ /slob dpon /steng du rlung gi bskal pa phab/ /bye ma'i kha tshub 'tshub ma dang / /sa yi char )phab sa yis mnan pa la/ /slob dpon nam mkha' dkar nag mtshams su byon/ /g.ya' spang brag rir lha 'dre gnas pa dang / /da lta bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad rnams/ /u rgyan gad+ma nga la do 'dzugs pa'i/ /sgo sha gtsang po'i gzhung ga phus btab bskyur/ /srog snying phul nas dam la btags/ /de nas stod khyang ko ba brag tu byon/ /'bar ma gsum gyis bar gcod byas/ /dbang phyug 'bar ma shes rab 'bar ma dang / /rdo rje 'bar ma bdud pho mthing nag r+sha/sum/ /mgo gsum mig dgu nyi ma lta bur 'bar/ /sdang mig phyogs bcur bgrad nas bdud dmag g.yob/ /ral pa 'bum brgyan khro gnyer mche ba chagatsigs/ /g.yas kyis gri gug nam mkhar gdengs tshul bsnams/ /g.yon pa chand kyi rkyal pa kha phye bsnams/ /mi la tsha ba nad kyi dbal gtong ba/ /lte yis 00ra snang khams khebs rkan rdeb pa/ /ral pa gsig dkrug skra gsepa glog 'khyug pa/ /thog dang ser ba'i bu yug tshub ma 'tshub/ /stag mo rol pa'i rtagadan steng dor stabs bgrad/ /brjid pa'i che ba sku ni ri rab mnyam/ /rol ༷du seng ge dkar mo ma smad khrid/ /sngon nas bshul 'dren sha za ma mo 'bum/ rdolon mo mon pho mkha' 'gro ma/ /la la sha za la la khrug 'thung ba/ rdom sapags 5ོna la la ngo la zhon1 /la la klad bldag la la 'o dod 'bod/ la la rgya ca/tsho chen po hub kyis 'thung / /srid gsum zas su zos kyang mi 'grangs pa/ /mdun bsu sngon nas bshul 'dren na/ /g.yas nas/gdon chen bco brgyad g.yas ru 'dren/ /lag na ral gri dang ni be con dang / /sgo ba dgra sta dbyug to shags pas bcings/ /gri thug gtun shing ba dan nag po dmar ser /'phyar/ /ro langs zhon nag g.yas nas zasbos 'dengs so/ /mo/yi g.yon gyi — 43

phyogs nas ru 'dren pa/ /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga ste/ /stag chas gzig chas gung chas bcug nas chas/ /go cha sra zhing mtshon non pho brgya phub dang bcas/ /rgob sod bsos 'debs mo yi g.yon ru 'dren/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang 'khor g.yog gnod sbyin te/ /so so rang rang chas dang 'a/ga cha bsnams/phyi gzhug sdud cing mo yi rting skul byed/ /ma mo 'khor dang pacas pa de rnams kyis/ /slob dpon steng na mar la khrug thun phab/ /mtshon cha'i char dang bu yug char pa phab/ /lung pa'i mi rnams gtub cing gsod pa dang / /nab khrol don snying/phyung nas za ba dang / /bla 'ded pa dang zhags pa 'debs pa dang / /khrid/nas byung dang bsad nas za ba dang / /mi rnams dngangs shing 'bros 'jug cho/'phrul ston/ 1mi yi lus la bya mgo gsum yod pa/ kha gdangs mig bgrad phrag g.yas 'ug pa 'gyed/ /phrag g.yon pho rog spyi gtsug srin pya 'gyed/ /lag pa g.yas na mi ro g.yon na wa/ /phag pa nag po zhon nas spre'u khrid/ /la la lung pa'i khang thog lding / /la la gos dang sgyed bu'i kha la bab/ /la la mal sar zhugs nas skad log 'don/ /phu na lings pa mda' na nya pasakhengs /bar na khe pa srin po gdong dmar yul/ /u rgyan)pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs khrel rte/ /bud med nga la ur nas 'dug /lung pardo'adi la stod lung zer ba yin/ /bud med blo la snying po med pas skyo/ /dper na chu dang chu snyegs khru ba yin/ /'di la bstos na sangs rgyas bstan pa nub/ /'khor ba'i sems can las kyis 'khor ba la/ /rgyu 'bras mang po 'di ru bstan mi lang / /dgras 'brel bdud mo phrad pas stod lung 'phung / /skyon rnams sems kyis dran pa'i mi kun gyes/ /'jig rten phyi ma brjed par byus nas su/ /spyang po mdo can khas ma men/ /zhes gsungs phaṭa brgyab bu mo gzhon nur gyur/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' bstol pa/ /lus phyir sdig pa bsags pa'i bu mo du0
