rnams/ /zhig cing phye na lus la snyirnga posamed/ 1dbang po'i sgo nas ngan skrugs thams cad 'dzag ji ltar legs kyang mtha' mar 'jig pa yin/ /mi gtsang rdzas mang gum cu rtsa gnyis gang 1 /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan la sogs pa/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gzhi ru gyur/ /gos zas rgyan sgor 'dod pa'i sgo slags mang / /gon zos ji tsam byas kyang chog shes med/ /tsha grang gang yang mi bzod phyi ru lus/ /nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra'o bu mo gzhon nu ma/ /mgo dkar gnyer ma 'dus kyang gshed ma byed/ /mi bkren pa la kha g.yos ni tshogs song / /bstan par gnod pa'i chos mi bya ba gces/ /nga ni sngags pa pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /ngo langs bdun stobs pad 'byung 'joms pa yin/ /sgol ba tshad du phyin pa'i pad+ma 'byung / /lta spyod sbyor sgol gnyis su la dor yang / /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i tshas kyis ma gos pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rgyud la yod/ /sems can don byed phan pa'i rak+ta lnga/ /bu mo khyed rnams bdag la mi 'bukhri/ na/ /'bru sna lnga la nya bo brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sbyin sreg phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi/dog mthun bzhag dug dang mi khrug bong bu'i gcin dang ni/ /rnam snang khyi khrab/ skye tshe bra bo nas/ /sran ma bong sbangs bya nag lug nag khrag /phan sems med pa'i 'dre mo dpung bcas bgreg ces gsupas pas rab tu dngangs shing 'dar ro/ /de che de dus kha kha rong sgoranas/ /lha ma dri za ma dang gshin rje ma/ /gnong sbyin ma dang mdangs can ma noms nyushe/ /ci 'dod dngos grub nam mkha'i glong las blangs/ /e e/ /slob dpon chen po lags/ /snying ga tam lags pas gsan ngar zhu/ /bdud mo 'bar ma spun gsum 'di/ /rgya mo smad 'tshong ma yi yul nas sprugs/ /gnas༄med ko ba brag byeg brten/ /ma nyes 'gro ba mang po/la/ /zas med zas su za ba yin/ /gos med gos su gyon pa yin/ /dal yams gcod par khas leg/51

na/ /dug tsher me la mi sreg 'tshal/ /u rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can kun ra bas/ /ci zer mi bden ci byed bden/ /nad kyis gdungs pa'i za ma mo/ /rgyal sras sku la skyabs su mchi/ /dug lnga rgyas pa'i za ma mo/ rgyal sras gsung la skyabs su mchi/ /skyon gyi gzhi ma za ma mo/ /rgyal sras thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen za ma mo/ ste /rgyal sras yon tan skyabos su mchi/ /blo rtse gnyis pa'i za ma mo/ /rgyal sras 'phrin las skyabs su mchi/ /spyir na 'jig rten gtsang ris lha 'dre ni/ /phal cher phar la chaganod pa ma bgyes na/ /tshur la 'tshe ba mi byed dam tshig yin/ /zhes smras te dam nos song ngo / /bdud mo spun gasrum rgan mo ra be+eg can gathum du pong / /brang la lag pa gnyis bkab gdong bshums nas/ /mig 'phangs smad de skyengs ༷bzhin logs su 'dug /rgan mo gsum gyis slob dpon la 'di skad gsol/ / sos rgan mo spun gsum 'di/ /sngon byas las kyi bsod nams ma mthun na/ /ston pa gcig gi bstan la smon lam mi thebs lags/ /bsam zhing slob dpon bka' la brnyas pa'am/ /ched du dmigs rte 'gro la gnod byas pa/ /bgyid dam bgyed du bstsal ba ma mchis te/ /phu ru ri sdog mda' ru chu sdog cing / /bar du kha khram g.yo sgyu ar rku spungs/ /nged cag ma mo mkha' 'akro khros pa yin/ kho mo cag gi rigashe su gyur pa rnams/ /sde tshan gtogs pa'i 'khor ༷g.yog gyur pa dang / /yang g.yog sha za 'tshe ba bgyid pa lags/ /de yang kho mo spun gasrum bde gyur na/ /slob dpon bka' la nyan pas las rnams 'grub/ /mi nad sngags nad ched du bsal bar bgyi/ /ci nas kyang kho mo cag rgan mo gasrum/ /snying rtsa 'phar zhing lus po 'dar ro/ /thugs rjes gathigs 'tshal rje na mo gu ru/ /rasta lnga phul zhu ba nan 'bul byung / /de nas slob dpon bka' bstsal pa/ /nga lus rig 'dzin skye shi gnyis med kye gzhi 62

bting / /snying rje gzhan don min pa bya rgyu med pas khog phub/ /dbang po nam/langs sprin med nyi mas lam drangs/ /blo rig pa ye shes dang ldan pas lce 'phrul bde/ /nga mi lus rin cen thob ste nor pa med/ /gsang gcig ma ni mchu la smra ma myong / /zlos gcig ma ni khong pa'i nang du bskyil ma myong 1 /las sgor dus 'dir bdud mo/spun gsum 'gyod pas 'dun/ /ma 'opas phan byed bsgyed pa'i dge ba lam du lus/ /phyi rabs dus su bdud mo spun gsum snying la 'jug /bud med thams cad gson 'drer gnod pa 'ong / 1mi phyugs sha khrug dbang byed mi rnams 'jigs pa brgyad/ /bstan baspung dgra la bod pod du ma mdzad/ /srog snying phul nas dam la btags/ /gter kha gsum gtad bka' srung bcol/ /sku la thang lha so sha yu chung 'bar gsum dam la btags༄pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //'bar ma gsum dang gnod sbyin gtsug na me 'bar dam sa btags pa/de nas 'phan yul yo mo brag phug dang / /dar yul gtsang/ra mo rugabyon/ /rdzong sman skyes chung phan mo dang / /ting lo sman dang stag sman gdong //nyang srin dwags srin kong srin gsum/ khong drug khyim byas 'phan yul bzung / /slob dpon drung du srin mo spun gsum byung / /rno mtshon mang po rgyob sod7zer/ /'jigs pa'i tshul du brjid bcos byung / /brag sog po khros 'dra'i 'gram 'dul dgongs/ /'phan yul spras kyi lha khang nang du bros/ /slob dpon bdas pas zal mo sgang du bros/ /slob dpon ting 'dzin pho nyas bkug /dgyes rtsa lha khang nang du bro sa/ /srin gyi rgyal po ha ta ya nag po zhes bya ba/ /༷63

phag nag mgo/dgu zhon pa kong po na yod pas/ /nam gung blun po'i dmag 'bod pa la bros/ /srin rgyal ha ta nag pos smras pa/ khyed gsum ci byung ci nyes ci byed smras/ /srin po spun gsum 'di skad spos/ /stag gzig bsgol ba'i brag la srin rdzong btab/ /mtsho bsubs ri bcad rtse la srin mkhar brtsi nas/ /dge bas sdig pa che ba'i 'jigs po cig /ga nas byung dang 'di nas byung med par 'phan yul byung / 1mi la khyad 'don bya byer de gsuca/ bton/ /zhes smras so/ /byang gi ting lo sman dang stag sman gdong / /sgong sa sman skyes chung phan mo da ra/ /pyang phugs rnams kyis lhags pa dus gcig bsdus/ /rlung 'tshub chen po slob dgon dpon g.yog gtad/ /'khor rnams gasgrebs shing slob dpon shasil tsam byung / /slob dpon gangs ri mer bsgoms pas/ /mar la lcags tshan phog bzhin lhan gyis zhu/ /bod hrūng srog snying phul nas dam la btags/ /gaster kha chen po gcig ge gnyer gtad bcol/ /de chanas stod lung gram bu tshal du byon/ /gnod spyin gtsug na me 'bar gyis/ /yongs sru ma bzung mchod pa phul/ /dpa' lus yod na mtshon cha thang la ga'akhyams/ /mchod rdzas dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab dang / /gser gyi ri bdun rol ba'i mtsho bdun dang / /ma sna sa lo tog 'dod 'jo'i ba bzang dang / rdos yi zhag bcud phur sum tshogs pa'i ro/ /'dam bu'i tshal dang sgos kyi shing spron dang / /tsan+dan sa mchog go ro shi sha dang 1 /sbrul gye snying po rgya mtsho rin po che/ /rgya mtsho'i gling la rin cen rdo sna bcu/ kha che'i yul na gur gum rtsa/ /ma la ya na tsan dan nags/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du nor bu rdo/ khrus kyi dzingabu cang shes rta pho dang rgyal srid sna bdun yan lag bdun pas mchod/ /u rgyan pad+mas bkazha1basmra' pa/ /gtong phod can gyi gnod sbyin khyod/ /ngargya gar sa su ra'i brag phug yod ca no/ khrod byung gtong phod can ni khyod 5

yin bas1 /bsod nams chen po thob ba'i dpe/ /ngas bshad khyod kyis legs par nyon/ /dper na tsadin khur ba sngon phyin na/ /rlung gis bskyod nas dri ma sdun 'byung bzhin/ /sems can tha dad mang po 'dul ba'i phyir/ /nam dgos tsa na spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /phan lan gcig ni stod lung dong pa'i gdong / /bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal tshab ston la sbyin/ /zhes gsungs stod/lung gzhong pa mda' ru sbyon/ /de nas brag gi dkyil du phyag mkhar btsugs/ /phyag gang min pa thams cad thim nas song / /phyag gis 'then shul chu che ka bzang tsam//lha bzang chu byung gro bar thob cig gsungs/ /da lta gzhong pa'i lha chu zhes su grags/ /'jig rten khams na chu ris grangs mang yang / /sgrub chu thon pa pad+ma 'byung gnas tsam/ /gzhan dang khyad par yod pa'i lha chu 'di/ khrus 'thungs sus byas sdig sprib bdag /phan sems bsod nams gsog snyeng 'dod/ /'jig rten mi yi longs spyod bsam pa 'grub/ /mal gro'i chu tshan mi yi 'dod pa chim/ /bdud rtsi skomu gyi sbyin pa dus rgyun gtong / /sa steng 'di ru sman chu mang du 'byung / /sdug bsngal nad kyis gdungs rnasgas bdud rtsi sman/ /'chi sos bdud rtsi sman dang ldan par byas/ 1sa steng 'di ru chu tshan mang du 'byung / /gcong nad zhugs pa'i ci 'dod yid bzhin skyong / /gzugs phung 'byung bzhi cha stoms chos phyogs nas/ /phyi rabs sems can gsil bur chad kyang bstan/ /sdug bsngal nad kyis gdungs sel 'phral skyid tsam/ /dge ba'i gegs shing bya ru mi rung bas/ /dus kyi tha ma sgor chen bdun yin no/ /dge ba'i stobs mchog 'di las che ba med/ /ces gsungs pas/ /gnod sbyin gtsug na me 'bar rengs shing brgyal/ /gnod sbyin gro bo gdong gi mgo nas bteg /gtsug na me 'bar 'di skad sngas/ /sngon chad ma mthong skyes mchog khyad par can/ /'di yi sku ni shin tu byin rlabs/che/ /gdug pa'i lha 'dre 53

thams cad 'di na tshogs/ /'jigs pa'i rig 'dzin pho/mo mang pos bskor/ 1rin cen srog dang ngan thu ma bral na/ /phyi ma ci gsung khyed kyi paka' mi gcog gtsug na me 'bar gyis gsol to/ /de nas u rgyan pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ khyod dang nga gnyis da nas sde ris gcig /gnod sbyin yin pa blo la 'gyur ldog med/ /de la lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad kyis/ /u rgyan pad+ma'i bstan pa rjes gzhag phyir/ /gdug pa'i bdud btul log lta thams cad bzlog/'bar ma gsum dang gnod sbyin gtsug na me 'bar dam la btags pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //klu ma' gro gzi can dam la btags pa/de nas mal gro'i mda' ru byon/ /klu rigs thams cad rjer gyur pa/ mal gro gzi can shin tu 'tshub/ /ba lam grom pa brag phug bzhugs/ /rgyun du mya ngan byed pa la/ /klu rigs ma sring mang po 'dus/ /gnyer pa se 'phang nag po yi/ /g.yas kyi ru 'dren tshong dpon nag po dang// /g.yon gyi ru 'dren khams kyi bya thul dang / /sngon gyi bshul sel gangs kyi gcung po dang / 1 spa gro skyer chu'i lha ni kha rgyal zha mdong 'od/ /de 'khor gdug pa can bzhi la gsol pa/ /glu yi nang 'khor 'bum sde lnga/ /glu rgyal mal gro gzi can khyod//gnyer pa se 'phang ngag la glu rje gapon/ /bal yul gyong po glu dang gnod sbyin glog ma sprin/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas ma thub pas/ /khyod nyid mya ngan rgyun du ma byed dang / /pham rgyal bya ba kun la 'byung / /ba lam grom mtsho'i nang nas phyung / /sdug bsngal ma mdzad sgobs pa bskyed/ /da dung cho 'phrul bstan thabs pod/ /u rgyan pad 'byung pham nas thub kyang srid/ /de skad smras sa rta6

lan btab pa/ /glu chen mal gro mya ngan byed pa bden/ /'jig rten khams kyi sems can la/ /'o/skol glu las khas drag med/ /de 'og bdud las khas /drag med/ /klu rje mal gro gzi can ngas/ /sems can yongs la dbang sgyur na/ /dus la 'gyur ldog 'di ltar gyur/ /nga yi gong na dpang che ba/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas rdzun cig mkhan/ /lha 'dre dbang du 'dis bsdus pas/ /nga la dbang ni ci yang med/ /pad 'byung phar la 'dul phyin pas/ /phar la 'thul bar ga la 'gyur/ /tshur la glu 'khor grangs med pa/ kho yi dbang du bsdus ste song / /klu rjes nga bdag gcig pu ring por shor/ /'di las dgra ru —gnod pa ga na yod/ /'di yi thub thabs se 'phang ji lta bu/ /pad 'byung ma thub nga yi snying mi don/ /zhes len btab bo/ /gnyer pa se/'phang nag po /mis/ /klu rigs thams cad rjer gyur pa'i/ /mal gro gzi can la smras pa/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas ma thub kyang / /bstan pa bshig dang blod thabs yod/ /༷yon bdag khri srong sde'u btsan gyi/ /dang po yul la cho 'phrul ston/ /sman dang 'bru bcud thams cad dang / /rtsi shing thams cad rtsad nas phyungs/ /yul la /chags pa'i rten med na/ /chos byed thams cad ci la 'khor/ /bon gyi rgyal po glang dar ma/ /klu rnams khengs log sprul nas su/ /yab mes chos lugs thams cad snub tu gzhug /bstan pa bsnubs pa de yin no/ /klu brdud dmag tshogs mang po kun/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas gnas pa yi/ /bod yul sa khul ma lus par/ /skyes pa'i 'bru bcud rtsi shing rnams/ /gcig kyang lus pa med pa ru/ rtsa ba drungs nas gcod cing phyungs/ /bod yul yon tan bcud med pas/ /rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan la/ /mdze rigs bco brgyad dus gcig gtong / /'o skol klu yi bstan pa dar te 'ong / /de skad se 'phang rje 'khor rnams ga smras/ /nam gyi phar phyed tshur phyed na/ /klu bdud dmag tu chas nas 57

su/ /bsam yas lha khang bzhengs pa yi/ /dngos grub rtsa shing sbyong du byin/ 1pad 'byung thugs rje sprul pa'i byen rlabs kyis/ /dngos grub rtsa shing ma 'byongs par/ /klu gdug dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog /zhe sdang gdug pa'i dmag tshoṭa kyis/ /phyogs su nye yang ma nus so/ /glu rnams yi mug ga chad de/ /sdug pa'i mya ngan chas rnams bsten/ /se 'phang nag pos 'di skad smus/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas ma thub kyang / /chos rgyal khri srong sde'u btsan gye/ /bstan pa smad thabs 'di ltar yod/ /gnas pa'i mkhar la cho 'phrul ston/ /klu bdud lcaṭa ngar mang pos byel/ /bod kyi btsan mkhar rmang nas bsgyel/ /rgyal po rten pa'i gakhar med na/ /pad 'byung bod du ci la 'khor/ /bstan pa bshig thabs de yin no/ /rten mgar brgya dang rtsa brgyad phyin/ /rgyal po yon mchod nyal ba'i khar/ /bshig pas ma shigs reg ma nus/ /klu rnams mya ngan khang par zhugs/ /lus la mya ngan chas su bsten1 /gnyer ba se 'phang 'di skad smras/ /be+e bzhin byas pas pad 'byung ga la thub/ /lan cig rdugs kyang lan cig skyor/ /gad 'byung 'thab zla byed pa la/ /snying stobs sna bsran che bar dgos/ /pad 'byung cho 'phrul grangs med ston/ /bu dang chung ma bu mo dang / 1nor dang slob bu tshun chad la/ /cho 'phyul tshugs tshad yod pa ston/ /cis kyang ye nas ma tshugs na/ /sa bdag klu yi bstan pa dang / /nag po bdud kyi bstan pa gnyis/ /cis kyang nub tu tho ba yin/ /u rgyan pad 'byung bstan pa 'di/ ༄ /cis kyang yod du tho ba yin/ /sems la 'gyod pa ye med do/ /rang cag lha 'dre sde brgyad rnams/ /pad 'byung 'khor g.yog byed la 'ding / /de skad/gnyer pas 'khor la bstan/ /de nas u rgyan pad 'byung gis/ /glu mal gro la ni bka' bstsal pa1 /ba lam grom pa brag phug grom pa mtsho/ khyod kyi rten gnas 'di brten g.yul 'khrug 'ong / /ma brtsol gnyen ka du8

ma byed kha3mchu'i ste+on ma yin/ /bcol ma dos can ma skyel sems khral 'phra‘tha ma 'jug /dpa' yang 'khrug pa ma byed srog lus ngan gyis byed/ /dal yang tsho lo ma rtse mis 'phya so nam chag kha smras mang na rogag kyis zhe khrel 'dopas/ /ma bos mgron la phyin na 'phral la dad pa ldog /ma byin zos khyer byas na 'di ༅ོ'i tshe mi phyid/ 1 /phyi 'brang gzhogs bsrun bya ba'i rigs ma yin/ /chig chung don med col med bsten la dga'/ /bsten la dga' bas las rnams 'grub mi srid/ /le lo dgra lu brtson 'grus don par 'gro /de skad ces bka' bstsal pas/ /klu mi 'dra ba la la ni rtsa na 'dug la la ni de bas ring ba na 'dug /la la ni de bas kyang ring ba na 'dug /la 'a ni kha phyir phyogs su bstas nas 'dug /slob dpon gyis mkhyen bzhin du dris pas/ khyed rnams chos la mi mos par 'dug nga bsam yas mchims phur 'gro ba yin/ /de skad gsungs pas mal gro gzi can gyis gsol pa/ /nged cag chos la mi mos pa ma yin te/ /bdag cag rnams la dug rigs rnam pa bzhi yod/ /slob dpon 'a gnod kyis dogs pa yin/ /rtsa na 'dug pa bsam pa'i dug can yin/ /ma bsams na mi gnod/ /ma bsams tsam du sdod pa yin/ /de bas ring ba re ga pa'i dug can yin te/ /ma reg na mi gnod/ /ma reg tsam du sdod pa yin/ /de bas ring ba kha rlangs dug can yin/ kha rlangs song gi dogs pas na/ kha rlangs mi sleb tsam du sdod pa yin/ kha phyir blta ba ni mthong ba'i dug can yin/ /mthong gi dogs nas kha phyir blta ba yin/ /slob dpon gyes gsungs pa/ /'o na dug/ris bzhi po cis thub gsungs pas/ /mal gros gsol pa/ /bsam pa'i dug ni/ting de 'dzin gyes thub/ kha rlangs kyi dug ni sman dris thub/ /mthong ba'i dug ni rma bya'i mdongs kyes so/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon gyis pastan pa baspung na zi ltar byed gasdengs/ /mal gros 5zhu

gse+ol pa/ /nag po glu la gtad khrom byas/ /shin tu gdug pa bdag nyid nyan/ /zab mo'i gdams pas ma brgyan pas/ /bstan bcos rjes su 'brangs nas su/ /'dod pas gdungs pa'i skyes bu yis/ /spyod log byas pas klu rnams ga la nyan/po /zhe sdang bsgrubs pas lha 'dre ga la 'khrul1 /deper na rin chen 'dod pa'i mi /bsod nams lam rgyus bral gyur na/ /'dod pa'i dbang mgis rgya mtshor 'jug rin cen ma rnyed rang nyid brlag /'gron mang chu srin gdug pas 'joms/ /de bzhin nyon mongs dbang gis tsam/ /rang dang ༷'brel par gyur pa rnams/ /nag po klu yis rnam par 'dzin/ /mtshan/nyid ldan pa'i sngags pas kyang / /bstan pa 'jig dang bla mar brnyas/ /chos 'khor ༷'joms dang sems can 'tshe/ /mtshams med las rnams byed pa'i mi/ /ma ma'ongs sdug bsngal dgag pa'i phyir/ /snying rjes kun blangs sbyor ba brtsams/ /de las gzhan du byas gyur na/ /de yi skye ba phyi ma la/ /mi 'dod 'bras bu phyong bar 'gyur1 /nag po glu ni bskal pa'i bar/ /mi 'chi mngon shes rab ldan pas/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa'i tshe/ /gdug pa klu yis 'che bar byed1 /des na gtam khrom klu la ni/ /chos dang mi ldan mi bya'o/ /zhes gsol gser gyi dong tse bdun stong phul/ /bdag gis bka' nyan gsung bstod shin btu dka'/ /phyi rabs rnams la klu yi gnod pa 'ong / /las gu 'jig rten 'thor bar byed pa'o/ /drug cu rtsa lnga gter gnyer gtad/ /glu mal gro gzi can btul ba'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //༷ zethu brang btu' pa/de nas kha la brag rir byon tsa na/ /btsan rnams thams cad 'dus nas 60

bengs log bshams/ /bdud rnams thams cad 'dus nas khengs log༄bshams/ /lta btsan rigs byed mang po dang / /klu btsan rigs byed mang po dang / /bdud btsan rigs byed mang po dang / /gza' btsan rigs byed mang po dang / /ya bdud rigs byed mang po dang / /glu bdud rigs byed mang po dang / /ma bdud rigs byed mang po dang / /bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs mang / /'o dod sgra dang tug chom che/ /mtshon cha mang po zings se zings/ 1rta pa mang po jag la chas/ khyi ra mang po ri dwags bshor/ / skya shar khrom dang dmag mi'i khrom/ /'jig rten 'phung byed dmag g.yos byed//bdud nag g.yab dor lings se lings/ /bdud mo mang po gdung pa'i glu rgyang len/ /las su dmag chas zhub can 'bum/ /g.yog mo mang po dpon la bko/ /rgyal khams khu gnyags gnyis kyis bzung / /dgra jag rkun mas lam 'phrang rtsub/ /'gro sbas mi 'cham 'khrug pa byed/ /zhe sdang zing rtsub gsod 'phrog dar/ /mdang mdung gri skyogs rdo phub dal dus med/ /rgyal khams thams cad 'khrugs te nyi tshe ba/ /rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /yab mes rnams kyi rdo rings yi ge gzigs/ /rgyal khams bde ba'i thabs shig bya dgos bsam/ /mi nad phyugs nad mu ge med thabs bya dgos bsam/ /yab kyi bla mkhyen sbrang ston khu lu la/ /gab rtse sum brgya drug cu'i rtsis su brtsis/ / sde brgyad khengs log yin pa rtsis la shar/ /sa bdag klu gnyan sprul pa'i pho nyar 'gyed/ /'jig rten khams su dal yams 'khrug pa gtong / /lha khang mchod rten bzhengs dang lha sku bzhengs/ /'chad grwa sgrub grwa slob grwa khrims bcas nas/ /chos kyi bstan pa btsugs na bde bar shar/ /de nas mosam pra se na dang ni/ /stas mkhan mo mas mo phywa btab/ /kun kyang kha 'cham phyag ris la/ /bod khrims 'chos par lnga ba kha che'i yul/ khrims kyi mkhan po byi 61

ta rte/ /bha ra ti ta ha rdu gnyis/ /spyan drangs bod du khrims bcos pa/ /ma byen len dang mi tshangs spyod/ /srog gcod pa gsum sdom dgos gsungs/ /ngag 'khyal tshig rtsub phra ma rdzun/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta bcu/ /mi bde'i rtsa ba 'di bcus len/ /mkhan po zhal 'cham yid ma 'ches/ /bod la longs spyod mi 'ong rgyal blon mthun/ kha che a nas dang rab gsal bkug /mi dge bcu sgong sngar dang mthun/ /sing ga yi rgyal po rte na shrī/ /phyo /li yi yul nas mkhan po li bzhu'o/ /spyan drangs mi dge bcu sgong sngar dang mthun/ /mkhan chen sde lnga mthun kyang yid ma 'ches/ 1za hor mkhan po bo dhi sa ha bos/ /mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu sgrub dgos gsungs/ /bsam yas sa btsal byin brlabs sa ma 'thul/ /rdzus skyes pad+ma so bha lung du bstan/ /sum stong lon nase bod yul dbus su 'ongs/ /bdud chen myos byed 'bog byed dang / /bdud chen rgyal byed sdigs mdzub g.yas la dkris/ /kong po rta bar kog 'phrang mda' 'phrang bor/ /lha btsan dam la btags te gter gnyer chabacol/ /paṇa chen shrī mañjur gsang mtshan gsol/ /gnas po ze sngon dam la /btags/ /gter kha bcu gcig gter gnyer bcol/ /de nas g.ya' ri gong du byon/ /the'u brang thel 'gong mang pos bas ba byas/ /'dzam bu gleng gi chang rigs thams cad bsdus/ /'bru chan rigs byed ma lus pa/ /shing tog rigs byed ma lus dang / /sha mo spyag sha dkar sha ser sha'i rigs/ /la nyung gang srubs btsong sgog brag sgog rigs/ /sgog rtse sha ba rtse dang btsong rigs sgog /sgo nga nya dang sha digs ri klung med/ 1nor gyi rigs byed ma lus sna tshang ba/ /the'u brang sde brgyad dpag tshad rgyang grags spungs/ / nyi ma'i zer ni chu bur mig phog bzhin/ /slob dpon sku la blta mi bzod par 'khums/ /skad thos mam na 'jag zhwa gzhug btags skyor/ /lus 'dar mig 'phang smad nas 'dug/61

lha dres mnga' gsol u rgyan pad+ma 'byung / /mkhyen bzhin the'u brang rnams la 'di skad bka' bstsal pa/ /'dir mchis ka ca khyed tshos ga nas khyongs/ /tre'u brang sde brgyad mgrin gcig tu smras pa/ /gye/ /thams cad khros pa'i rgyal po te ru ka /drag po'i gdangs can lha 'dre zil gyis gnon/ /brjid pa'i sku yis snang srid bran du 'khol/ /gzi mdangs yon tan phun sum tshogs zha bstod/ /bdag cag rngo mi thogs pa'i tshogs sna rnams/ /'dzam bu gling gi dbus kyi rdo rje gdan/ /rol mtsho 'dus pa mal gro'i phyogs mtshams nas/ /pho nya sprul pa bkye nas bsgrubs pa bdog /ma rtogs ma rig sgrib can the'u brang rnams/ /nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal ba/sa kyis bcings/ /srid pa thog ma las byung rku 'grog slong / /cha lugs ngan pas gzhug ma mgo la zetags/ / las kyi mi rnams gsog pa'i 'dod po che/ /mi dge bcu sgod dge bcu spyod pa 'joms/ /u rgyan pad+ma'i sku la mthol lo bshags/ /ci bgyis bka' bzhin sgrub pas dgongs pa glod/ /ces gathol pa dang / /slob dpon gyis ka ca rnams la tshogs brgya mdzad/ /the'u brang sde brgyad dam la btags nas lung bstan/ /'di na 'dug pa'i the'u brang ye shes grags/ /'khrul pa'i bag chags khrun ci log pa yis/ /bstan gnyis zung 'jug 'dug pa'i don ma rtogs/ /nyod mongs dbang gis chos la mtho non shor/ /ya ma zung gis 'dzam gling da1jang byed cing / /tshos spong la sogs chos brgyad mkhyen rgya can/ /tu ya rā dza mdo+o/rgyud khrel bas shing / /'di na mchis pa'i gnam the'u dkar po khyod/ /zid rmad las byed khyi sha 'bung ba'i lus/ /ngan song so nam byed pa'i rgyal por skyes/ /rlabs chen mi 'jigs dpa' rtsal mi krog len/ /nga la hu la'i 'ur chem pod du sgrog se chen hu la e mo ka srid gting / /srid pa sbrul ba bdud kyi ngaltan pa 'byung / /'gyur zhing mi rtag sa to ngazhi 'gror 'gro /gling 63

mthog chen po nam mkha'i dbyings nas lding / /sa hor sa mtshams them par zug pa'i dus/ /gom gsum phyin na dgra dang 'phrad pa'i dus/ /tshig gsum smras na mi bden zer ba'i dus/ /gu ru rgyal po dmigs pa'i rmiltas bzung / /'brug mgo lag rtags gnam sa brag la btab/ /sngon gyi las 'phros bstan pa mtha' ru bzhag /srin po ngo dmar gzugs can rngon pa'i dgra /the'u brang brgyud pa'i dur sa dbus su 'byung / /yi dwags mi mngon phag gi gnod pa 'a gegs/ /mi rnasas spyod ngan mtshams med las byed cing / rnal 'byor yang chadag don la gnas pa la/ /bar chad bdud dang ru dra'i gnod pa 'byung / /lha 'dre bka' yi thang yig dran pa 'tshal/ /sems can bsod nams chung zhing 'tshe ba mang / /nyon mojas sred pas mi tshe sdug byed 'khril/ /dgra yi bu gsos phugs su gnod pa ltar/ /sems can mang po ngan song gnas su 'gro /ngan 'gro sgrub pa 'ong tshul nga yis shes/ /ma rig pa sel 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /man ngag dbang dang slob dpon zhal ta gces/ /chos med yongs spyod sgrub pa tshe 'dir 'thoms/ /bstan pa 'jig cing dkon cog smod pa mang / /gsang sngags khyad du gsod cing bka' bslu mang / /slob dpon sku ༷bdo mched lcam dkor la 'bag /dben gnas 'joms shing gardog lag khang rnams 'jig /de dus the'u brang sde brgyad bstan ba dar/ kha ton long gtam byed pa'i gos ser khyu/ /dben par sdod kyang g.yeng ba 'du 'dzi can/ /chos la dad pa skyes pa'i rkyen mi thub/ /phar log tshur log skye bo kun gyis shes/ ༷'tshab 'tshub langs pa thethu brang bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /grog snyeng phul nas dam la btags/ /the'u brang btul ba'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //6

lha 'dre btu' pa/de nas bsam yas has po ri la byon/ /me 'bar mtsho nas lcags kyi —sdig pa ni/ /mgo dgu rwa ni brtso brgyad kha gdangs pa/ /sdig rwa bco brgyad g.yas rtse me 'bar 'phyo/ /g.yon pa bco brgyad rwa rtse chu 'byub mtsho/ /mgo dgu kha nas na bun dud pa 'thul/ /gzhug ma'i rtse nas rlung dmar tshub ma 'tshub/ /bud med mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor nas byung / /gnag khyu mang po'i mtshan dang bcas nas byung / /mtsho dang 'bapa chu thug pas rgyal khams khengs/ /nya sbrul sbal spyong khye'u pho mo mang / /dud 'gro srog chags snang srid stong khams gang / /slob dpon sdig par kha ṭī ga gzir bas/ /rgya mtsho'i gting du khyer ram snyam pa byung / /dar cig dran pa rnyed nas yod tsa na/ / blta bas chog mi shes pa'i khye'u zhig /bdag gi mdun du 'dug ste 'di skad zer/ / nga ni klu yi rgyal po breng 'dzin gyi/ /gcung po glu rgyal gtsug na rin cen yin/ /bod kyi ri chen bzhi dang mtsho chen bzhi/ /gnam sa'i bdage po nga yin gzhan ni min/ /gdug pa che yul nyang dwags kong gathum yin/ /de gsum gdug che gong rje dkar dmar yin/ /kong po ri nag lha ri gyang rdor che/ /de na mar gshegs mi nag mched po 'dul/ /rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po'i babs sa yin/ /gti mug can gyi yul du ri gcig srid/ /brtag dpyad dbu ru glung ri tshugs po yin/ /'dab chags rgyal po khyung gi babs sa yin/ /ser sna can gyi yul du ri gcig srid/ /de na phar gshegs dge ba'i las 'phro spel/ /gtsang g.yas ru rtsa la de rtse thon che/ /lha 'dre gnyan dgu klu ske 'tshog sa yin/ /bdag gi don la sems na byams sems min/ /mi bde 'dod kyi 65

longase spyo+od de na che/ /bka' zab mo ston na de ru ston/ /dben 'gol ru lag ri bo sul mang che/ /thar pa 'gog pa brgya yi bsgoms pa yin/ /rgya chagar rdo rje gdan na mu stegs mang / 1yang dag rten 'brel shar lugam/ bshad pa yin/ /bod kyi khri shorwa rgyal mo'i mtsho chen de/ /byang phyogs khams kyi g.yer po thang na yod/ /bskor na zhag bdun rta yis 'khor ba yin/ /yu(go phyogs mi sayo3yin pa lha 'dres gang / /nga bsdad sa yi yul 'dir ma sdod par/ /'di dang thugs rje 'dres na gzhan don 'byung / /pad rgyas lha khang bzhengabo/ na klu rnams mos1 /bod kyi ma pham g.yu mtsho skad pa de/ /bod dang zhang zhung gnyis kyi mtshams na yod/ rta lam nyi ma gcig gis 'khor ro skad/ /mchod kyi gnam mtsho phyug mo skad pa de/ /byang phyogs skar ma spe bdun 'og na yod/ /rta lam dgung zhag bcu gcig mtsho mtha' 'khor/ /lho na stubs mtsho gling dgu skan pa de/ /na thang yar 'brog phyogs na yod/ /na tsho mtha' rta lam dgung zhag drug gis 'khor/ /rang bzhin gshis sam babs kyi 'dug lugs 'di/ /brjod pa'i ngag la slob dpon gsan par zhu/ /de nas slob dpon nyid kyis bka' ༷bstsal pa/ khyed rnams klu 'di la la chos la mos/ /'ga' zhig la la sdig la mos1 /'ga' zhig la la bon la mos/ /'ga' zhig la la rtsis la mos/ /'ga' zhig la la sman la mos/ /'ga' zhig la la mu stegs mos/ /nang ni mi chagashin gdug pa zhe sdang che/ /nga ni za hor yul na yod pa'i dus/ /za hor rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti'i sras/ /go ma de phyir rdzogs chen gastangs pa'i tshe/ /glu yi rgyal po/phreng 'dze+en sras/ /klu yi rgyal po 'jog pos nyan/ /de dus glu rgyal rgetsug na rin chen khyod/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gi nor bu brkus dogs nas/ /dzoṭa chen nyan par ma khom 'khor bar 'khyams/ /da ni kheng mi log par gro spyol ma//༷rgyul po khri srong sde'u btsan pasam pa sgrubs/ /zhes gsungs/ /dwags po kong 66

po gshong pod gshegs so/ /lha 'dre btul ba'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //gnas po ze sdon ma gtsug lag khang lung bstan pa/de nas byar dgas kong e'i lta zhadre 'dus/ /'jig rten khams kyang g.yo dang 'dar ba dang / /na bun char glog kha ser rlung dmar dang / /mi nad phyugs nad mi dge sna tshogs 'byung / /de nas yul smon lung gagum sngong du1phebs/ /brtan mtho lha 'dre rnams kyis skyel thung byas/ /bod 'bangs khams gsum gling dgu'i longs spyod bsdus/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dod pa'i yon rtan lnga/ /sde brgyad rim pa bzhin du tshogs 'khor bskor/ /gzhi bdag rgyal po tshangs pa 'brug zhon zhus/ /u rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas lags/ /bdag cag rnams ni khyed kyis ngo shes sam/ /ngo mi shes na rgya ni lha yi tshong dpon/ /nor la dbang bsgyur bya ba lags/ /rgya ni bdud kyi dmag dpon yin/ /dres pa'i rtsal ldan bya ba lags/ /da lta khyod kyi spyono sngar mchis/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas lags/ /tshong dpon phyi la tshong la gshegs/ /nor bu rin cen sna lnga len/ /nor yod pa de kun la bzang / /nor med tsa na kun la ngan/ /de bas tshong bya rin cen blang / /mu rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas lags/ /dmag dpon phyi la dmag la gshegs/ /gzhan dag mi rnams 'og tu 'jug /la la nga gad la la la gzhom/ /yul mkhar zas sgor 'grog ris gnod/ /skyes pa pho khyad gtam yin mod/ /pho yis pho zhig ma btul na1 /za ma mo dang ci mi 'dra1 /'o skol dgra bo 'dul du gshegs/ /de skad ces ni/zhus pa dang / /de la u rgyan chen pos bka' bstsal pa/ /lus ni sag ri skad ni khu rta'i sgad//lto gos mi dge bcu la lceb zas byed1 /sna tshogs rgyal po tshapas pa 'brug zhon 67

nyon/ /lha yi tshong dpon nor la dbang gyur rgya/ khyod kyis tshong byas zas nor nga mi slon/ /'thags pa'i nore bdun phyug pas dbul dang bral/ /mi zad gter dang ldan pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /'dod sems spangs nas chog shes ma ldan na/ /rin cen ri rab yod kyang sdug bsngal che/ /tshong khi pham rgyal rtse ba mya ngan grogs/ khal mar bkal bas dmyal ba'i sa bon 'debs/ /nor yod che sa bzung bas bdud dang 'dra/ /sgyu ma'i zang zing nor la bdag mi brtsi/ /bdud kyi dmag dpon seng gdong rtsan lhan rgya/ khyod kyi spyod pa de la nga mi smon/ /bdag dang gzhan med snying rje chen po yis/ /sems can mnyam pa'i cha la ma bzhag na/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod drag bshul gdug rtsub kyis/ /lus po sa rdo bzhin du bor tsa na/ /sems ni mi 'chi gsod gcod dmyal bar 'gro1sdug bsngal nyams myong 'gyod kyang 'gyod mi phan/ /phar btul tshur log rnam byun 'phral la 'byung / /'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas kyang mi sleb bo/ /drag shul gdug rtsub lha 'dre'i spyod pa skyong / /gsod gcod srin gyi las la nga mi brtsi/ /de skad ces ni bka' bsnal pas/ /rgyal po tshangs pas 'tshang brag phob pa la/ /u rgyan pad+mas phyag mkha ra brgyab nas btul/ /brag phug mtshan ma a ta rdo lung btags/ /lke shes mkha' 'gro lha 'dres bskor ba byed/ /gnas po ze sngon gyis smras pa/ 'jig rten khams kyi sems can kun/ /slu chig rdzun la mkha'irde pa yi/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas zer ba 'dis/ /lha 'dre'i bstan pa stongs la khad/ /bdag kyang shin tu ma dga' nas/ /bdud dasnyang rgya lag khong yang /'du'/ /rgyal po tshangs ba 'o skom ji ltar bgyi1 /sha la za ba'i sha yang dkon/1khrig la 'thung ba'i khug kyang dkon/ /pags pa phyon pa'i lngags kyang dkon/ /rus/la 'cha' ba'i rus pa dkon/ /zhes smras pa dang / /mtsho smon spun lngas 'di skad rgyus/ /u rgyan cherna po nyid kyis bkyib tu gsol/ /dus gsum snye6

sakhyen pa thar par 'drerge pa'i gtso/ /ma 'ongs sa ler mkhyen pa sgon me'i mchob/ /'gro ba'i skyabs migon byams pa'i thugs/ /cir yang sprul nas thams cad 'dul/ /bad 'byung 'dul ba'i dus 'di la/ /thams cad bde skyid kun la dga' bas na/ /thar pa'i bde gnas ma thob lha 'dre rnams/ /da lta'i dus dang gnas skabs 'dir/ /na thun 'thibs pas ma rig nas/ /sgu yang ngan la 'od kyang nag /sa yang g.yo la ri yang 'dar/ /rlung yang 'tshub la ser ba 'dril/ /mi phyugs kun la nad yams dar/ /'di nyid ji ltar yin pa gsung du gsol/ /de ni gnas po ze sngon la bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs te bka' bstsal pa/ /'khor du gtogs pa'i snang srid lha 'dre rnams/ /de yi rgyu rkyen 'di ltar ro/ /da lta'i dus 'dir khyad par 'phags/ /'jam dpal sprul pa'i rgyal po byon/ 1bsam yas 'gro don phyogs bcur bstan/ /de yi thugs rje byin rlabs kyis/ /da lta sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogaso rnams/ /thar pa'i go 'phang thob ste song / /bsam yas thugs rjes kun khyab kyang / /sems can las kyis baspribs pa rnams/ /thar pa ma thob phyi ma lus/ /bsod nams tshogs dang ma ldan pa'i/ /'gro ba rigs drug sems can la/ /dwage ba yod na sdig pa mod/ /dkar ba yod na nag pa yod/ /nyi ma yod na thun pa yod/ /dug lnga'i nad kyis dub pa yis/ /log par phyogs pa'i sems can rnams/ /bdud dang mthun /pa'i las byed do/ /sems tsun 'ga' tsam ma lus par/ /med par byed pa'i /hor sna 'dren/ /sa jing yon mchod thabs ngan mkhan/ /skyon can khams gsum /gling dgur 'byung / /wa la za ma snying re na/ /bdud spyo dmag rnams btub 0kyis 'tshog /dmag bsdus dmag gis 'khrigs pa'i yul/ /gnas bcu drug bya ba ngas sa sgong pa'i yul/ /col med po tsho yar klungs 'du/ /kwa ye gnas po ze sngon tshur nyon dang / /sngar 'das bshad na ro la1san po 'di/ /shākya thub 63

pa 'das nas ring por ma lon na/ /lnga rā ṇa ster dge bsnyen mtshan grags pa/ /zhe ba'i rga tsha lcags kyi byin pa can/ /yon tan chos mang po mnga' ba zhig yod/ /ri po ta la u rgyan yul dang ni/ /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga sham+bha la/ /de dag 'gro ba'i lam yig yod pas su/ /ri po ta lar spyan ras gzigs zhal ltar/ /lam ring bgrod phyin lam po kha zhig nas/ /btsun pa'i gzugs byas ston nga'i rtags bzung nas/ /zhing rmod bu tsha bud med las byed mthong / /de ni yid la ma ran ngan bsgrags pas/ /btsun gzugs ston pa'i rtags rnams bzhag nas su/ /skya chas byas nas zhing rmos byas pa yin/ /zhi ba go cha spyan ras gzigs dang mjal/ /dge bsnyen khyod kyis mtho ris mi thob gsungs/ /zhing rmod ston pa'i rtags rnams byin na 'thob/ /dge bsnyen 'gyod nas ston༄pa'i rtags rnams byin/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis dge bsnyen lung bstan pa/ 1spre'u brag srin gnyis kyis mi rnams spel/ /sangs rgyas bstan zhabs lnga brgya phrag gsum na/ /byang mi 'dul spyong gnam pa'i bdag po 'byung / /zo thang gong po ri zhol sto lam du/ /zhing rmo'i dge bsnyen mi lus len pare 'gyur/ /gnas brtan chos kyi mtshan can bstan mos 'dzin/ /gtsug lag khang gso chos kyi so nam byed/ /bshad grwa sgom grwa bstan pa rgyas par byed/ /yar chen lha khang sprel phag tshos bcu 'dzin pa nabyung / /bstan pa 'jig pa dmag gis 'joms par byed/ /dgra ru rmon glang gnyis ldang mi lus len/ /mi nag mdung thung can gye skye ba 'byung / /nyin 'khrug mtshan 'khrug lcags ma rab gnyis 'khrug mi la bsad shi gnyis las med pa 'byud / /gnyen du bud med bu tsha mi lus len/ /rgya/dmag 'dren pa'i khab byed dbus gtsang 'joms//sde gsar sde rnying thams cad 'o re brgyal/ /'dra min mang pos mgo 'thoms nas/ /hod gyi bstan pa rgya la 'chor bar 'gyur/ /sa steng thaca sa cad rtsub rdozhu

'gyur rlung tshub ldang / /zlog thazas mod de byed mkhan med par lus/ /de dus skyes pa'i sems can dal med kun/ /zlog thabs bsrings nas thabs kyis byed pa la/ 1ru dra kun bye rkyen gsum rus sbal 'dra/ /rdzu 'phrul dmyo/ga gis ri sna glang chen stobs/ /rang dbang med pa snyigs ma'i dus su 'byung / thug na rdo rje'i sprul par ngas lung bstan/ /thub pa'i mdzad pa gnas brtan bcu drug bzlog /gnas po ze sngon la gtsug lag khang lung bstan pa'i le'u sto ter gcib/sapa'o// //bstan pa gling log byung tshu'/de nas jo bo rdzong btsan gyis zhus pa/ /rgya nag 'phung bar byed pa'i la༄yogs rnam smin ji lta bu zhig gis skyed par byed/ /bstan pa ji tsam gnas/ /sngon las ci las byung / /ma 'ongs mkhyen pas gsung bar zhu/ /sru rgyan pad+masga gsungs pa/ /btsan gyi rgyal pos zhus pa de legs so/ /ma brjed par yid ladethob cig ma 'ongs bu mo gtsang ma la pra ru phob cig rgya nag 'phung bar byed pa'i la yogs rnam smin ji lta bu zhig gis bskyed pa ni/ rgya gar chu bo ni raji na'i 'gram/ /shākya thub pas dka' thub mdzad/ /byang chub shing drung seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mngon gyur nas/ /mngon par dzogs bar sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i tshe/ /'bum phrag bdun du yul ngan byung / /glu yi rgyal po btang bzung gnas na bzhugs/ /rgyu gnyis rkyen kyis rkyen gsum rus sbal 'dra/ /sbrul mig rna ba ri bo glang chen stobs/ /rang dbang med par snyigs ma'i dus thu 'byung / /lus kyis bcom ldan sku la lan bdun dkris/ /mgo bo'i gdengs ka rnams kyis bkab pa la/ /byang phyogs tshong pa ga gon sprun 7/

chaganyis kyi/ /glang bu cang shes legs skyes dang / /gīt+ta zhes pa gnyis kyis shing rta 'dren/ /shing sbrul rgyu nas glang bu 'gror ma nyan/ /tshong pa gnyis kyis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong / /dad pa thob nas sbrang rtsi bu ram phul/ /de bzhin gshegs pas shis pa brjod pa gsungs/ /sbrang rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyal por lung bstan cing / /rdu bo rgya nag rgyal por lung bstan mdzad/ /sangs rgyas bka' yis sems can bskru mi srid/ /nga ni sto nub srin yul phyin 'og tu/ /lo ni brgyad brgya dgu nye na/ /rgya nag ka shing ka yi nye lam du/ /sbrang rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyal po mi lus len/ /ga gon bzang po gu ru'i macon can cig /mi srid pa cig srid nas rgyal po byed/ /mu stegs ro langs bdun gyes ma bsgus na/ /srid pa bstan pa'i sku lus sgeg pa'i lus/ /ste ba'i g.yon la rgyal rigs sme ba can/ /dpung pa g.yon la rje rigs sle ba can/ /brla sha g.yon la bram ze'i rigs sme can/ /gdong pa la ni dmangs rigs spe ba can/ /can bzhi rgyal pos dgra bgegs ru dra sgrol/ /ngas brtsams chos la shin tu mos pa 'byung / /cha lugs pad 'byung nga yi lugs su byed/ /'di yi btsun mo sgol ma'i sprul pa sa sprel lo/ /'di la rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa 'byung / /bstan pa ji tsam dag tu gnas pa ni/ /gnam bab khro chu'i pho brang gser gsol 'byung / /pad 'byung sku 'dra shel rigs lnga las bzhengs/ /lha khang ma nu sarba ya na 'byung / / pad 'byung nga yi skyes rabs bris snga 'bri/ /ras ta yis rab tu gnas par byed/ /de yi rab gnas legs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /bstan pa mi rabs bco brgyad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i ming btags brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'byung / /yo ni stong dang sum brgya lhag tsam na/ /chos kyi+o/rgyal pos bya ba rnam bzhi byed/ /zasam yas gtsug lag khang la zhig gsos byed/ khrims dam 'bangape rnam /bde la bkod spyong byed/ /sku la bdo ba'i dmag sde chen po 'joms/ /nyan 72

'chad sgom pa'i grwa 'dzugs mthun rkyen sbyor/ /de dus u rgyan pad 'byung bsnyan pa dar/ /bdud kyi mi rnams ci tsug byed na'ang byed/ /bstan pa'i bdag po u rgyan gling pa cig /skyes pa'i yul du lha khang ra sa tsam/ /yar chen lta khang lung bstan zhabs tog byed/ /dbus gtsang mi rnams yar chen bas / yas 'du/ khyad par can gyi/gser thog g.yu thog 'gel/ /yang dag yin lugs ma bshad rjes mi 'jug bstan pa bzhag pa'i gnas med sbal yul bros/ /mi skya dra mas mi byed brdes byed/ /chos kha gcig la gcig gis bzung nas smod1 /khe dregs bskyed de 'khor dang khe dregs 'gran/ /de dag dbang song bstan pa 'phel 'grib 'byung / /res 'ga' bstan pa 'phel ste res 'ga' 'grib/ /dgra ru gnam the'u dkar po yon mchod ldang / /sa hor rgya nag sde 'khrug byed pa 'byung / /sngon las ci las byung ba ni/ /rgya gar yul gyi dgra zla zhes pa na/ /dgra zla'i rgyal po me sbyin zhes bya bas/ /sangs rgyas btsom ldan 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dbyar zla gsum du bshos 'dren dam bcas te/ /gzhan la bshos ni 'dren pa'i dbang med nas/ /de nub rgyal po me sbyin rmi lam du/ /sdig pa'i ltas med rmi lam bzang por rmis/ /the tshom skyes te bram ze la dris pas/ /bram ze zla gsal phrag dog dbang gis khros/ /rgyal po mnal lam shin tu ngan sgo smras/ /rgyal po me sbyin dad pa ldog pa'i phyir/ /de nas dbyar zla gsum mtshams dam bcad nas/ /mi la gtam ma smras na sdog go zer rdza /de bar rgyal pos bram ze'i ngag ltar byas/ /sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'tsho ba chad/ /gzhan gyis 'tsho ba 'dren dbang med/ /tshong pa phyug po med pa spangs shig gis/ /sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'tsho ba drangs/ /tshong phrug lnga brgya dang bcas zas yon phul/ /bsngo ba smon lam nyid kyis rgyas btab bzhag /bram ze zla gsal ring por ma lon shi/ /yi 3

5gas rigs gyung sum cu tso drug skyes/ /de nas hor yul pe chego rgyal byusda skyes1 /dge ba byed pa'i go bkag dad lob/ bcug /rnam smin bsod nams thad pasko bcing bcings po/ /tshong pa phyug po rgya nag rgyal po'o/ tshong phrug lnga brgya de yi blon po'o/ /nya chen yor mo dpag tshad bzhi khri'i lus/ 1glu yi rgul po btango bzung spul pa 'di/ /hūṃbha/ /gung spu/ /gu ta ya/ /bod yo lon/ /mag shi/ ma 'ongs yor che/ /gu ru mo ru/ /tshong sgeg lnga brgya'i ming du bshad/ /tor la dbu yogs bka' chad che lanamyud/ /rgya'u min pa rnams kyang bstan pa'i dgra/ /bo yan du/ /go dan/ /bo la/ /a yu hu nu//de ri rte / /bing rdzog /ma du bu khrid rgyal brgyud bodwa du/'byung / /can bzhi rgyal po'i dngangs skrag 'di tsam pa/ /mi blo 'dres pa las ngan byed/ /lus po phag pa mgo bo bya yi mgo /mi khyi gshog nya gzhug spul sgo nga rgyu/ /phyin ci log la blo mthun mang du 2byung / /bsnyan pa gling log 'byung tshul gyi lenyu ste nyer gnyis pa'o// // bstaṅge zhabs gter skyor mdzad pa/rgyal ba'i dgongs brgyud ma bsrubs pa/ /rig 'dzin brda brgyud ma chad pa/ /thugs rje'i byin brgyud ma bskamasapa//mkha' 'gro'i gtad brgyud ma zags pa/ /lung bstan smon brgyud ma 'phyugs pa/ /grub thob kyi dngos grub ma bo ba/ /gang zag bka' brgyud ma nyams pa/ /las can snyan brgyud ma bye ba/ /gter bdag tshig pargyud ma bslad pa/ /skal ldan don brgyud ma shor ba/ /gsang gter bcu drug gter phran bzhi/ /thugs gter lnga dang dgongs gteng gsum/ /gter kha nyer brgyad gter du smras/ /dgongs gter gsum ni jo 74

sami gling gaphum sbas/ /rgyal po'i thang lig dge rgyas bye ma gling / /btsun mo'i //thang yig khams gsum zangs khang gling / /lha 'dre'i thang yig bu tshal gser khang gling / /thugs gter lnga ni gling bzhi gling phran sbas/ /war+ṇa bzo pobs /phan gnod be tsa ming / /chu gter dang ni phyir zlog rgya gar gling / /tshogs rgyud 'dus pa tshang mang gling du sbas/ /rlung 'khod bstan srung dpe kar gling du sbas/ /gsang sngags gsang ba'i gter kha bcu drug ni/ /zhi drag sgor pas yar kluras shel brag phug /thun mong lnga dang khyad par lnga sogs gter/ /zung mkhar rdo yi mchod rten dbus la sbas/ /'dus pa bzhi dang zur pa bzhi la sogs/ /gra yi g.yu sgong brag la gter du sbas/ /gnyis pa rgya mtsho 'on gyi stag tshang phug /gter gtad bka' dbang rab 'byams rnam snang rgyab/ /snyan brgyud rnarma sras yum bu bla mkhar sngas/ /char 'bum zhi brag 'dus pa sham po gangs/ /phyag rdor rta mgrin khyung sgrub pho stog brag /de dag gagong gter pha /bzhi ma bzhi'o/ /da ni gsang gter thu bzhi bu mo bzhi/ /spu gu rdo 'bum mon mkhar mgon po gdong / /skyid po ri gdong zangs kyi mtsho brag bzhi/ /bsam yas mchims phu ru ra mechod rten 'khor/ /gsal rje gangs/sto lha yul /phug pa'i nang / /'ol dwags mtshams kyi lung gesum dkar mo ljongs/ /bston sgabs gter skyong mdzad pa'i lethu ste stor gsum pa'o// //rgya bod drin chen gang 'a rgang 'dupha mdzad pa/rgya bod drin che gang la gang 'dul mdzad/ /ces pas/ /phyi nang gsang /ba'i lha ma srin sde pargyad/ /spras yul gshong po hong por tshogs shing 'ardus/ 1/snyi yi lta srin sde brgyad myur mgyogs brgyad/ /'gong po/ /the'u brang / nashā/ 75

ma/ sa bdag yul lha/ sman/ btsan/ klu dang brgyad do/ /nang gi lha ma srin sde brgyad rang rgyud brgyad/ sgog bdag ma mo/ gshin rje/ bdud/gnod sbyin/ dmu/ dgra lha/ 'gong po dang brgyad do/ /gsang ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ gza' mchog byi tri pa du dang / ljang sngon drag po/ /du ba mjug rings/ 'bar ba ra tsa/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ byi nu ra tsa/ rā hu la/khyab 'jug chen po dang brgyad do/ /phyi nang lha 'dre khengs log mi dmag g.yob/ 'khon gye gdung brgyud chu mo lug la 'khrug sa bdag rgyal po pa la pa tra phag mgo can/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po/ ga'i lha mo bstan ma/ sto'i sa bdag gtsang kun/ nub kyi sa bdag hang phan/ byang gi sa bdag the khyim/ shar gye sa bdag stag dkar bdun/ lho'i sa bdag 'brug rje sngon po/ nub kyi sa bdag bya dmar po/ byang gi sa bdag rus sbal nag po/ shar sto'i sa bdag pi ling 'phar ma/ sto nub sa bdag 'brug rje lag pa/ nub byang sa bdag gra te mi bo che/ klu'i rgyal po sa 'dzin/ byang shar gyi sa bdag snyir ti nag po/yang / /shar phyogs sa bdag nag po 'khor can/ sto'i sa bdag ba dan ser po/ rdub kyi sa bdag gzig gi mjug ma can/ byang gi sa bdag bya'i ze ba can/ the se dang / rtsang kun dang / tha khyim dang / se ba bla mkhyen dang /hang phan dang / pi ling dang / se shar mi gsod dang / se ba rang rta dang /hal khyi nag po dang / se 'ug sngon po dang / te so dmar po dang / se lo ser po dang / 'grol bu'i yul lha lnga dang / sa bdag chen po lnga dang /'aspug lha gsang ba dang / g.yu 'dzin sngon mo dang / gser 'dzin ser mo dang / pi 'ing nag po dang / gnam khyi dang / sprin lha chen po a tsa ra dang /dregs pa can dang / ral pa can dang / hab gsal can dang / sgrub po can dang / a tsar can la sogs te/ mi yul rgyug cing 'grim pa'i sa bdag go / 76

gru'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad kyi rdze/ glu mal gro gzi can/ de thog tshong dpon narge po/ de 'og khams kyi bya thul/ gangs kyi gcung po spa gro skyer chu'i /lha/ kha rgyal zha mo 'od/ de'i 'khor na gdug pa can bzhi'o/ /de dag zhudze/sa cad rab tu smyo ba/ bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ spyan khrug gi rgya mtsho 'khyil pa/khug gi nyi zer rab tu 'khrugs pa/ shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub cing / kha rlangs sprin nag po/'khrugs pa/ zhal rges 'brug stong sgogs shing / ljags las bskal pa'i blog 'khyug pa/ sku la thod pa sna tshogs pa dang / snying mang po'i phreng ba bsdams pa/ phyag na mtshon cha'i rigs byed thogs shing / 'jig rten 'phung bar byed pa/ ral pa kham rtag mun ltar 'dzar ba/ gnam lcags kyi /zor ba dang / dgra sta dang / kha shāka dang / gser gye zor ba dang / gnam ༷lcags kyi thur ma bsnams pa/ 'od zer rab tu 'khrug pa/ lung pa thams cad ku co dang khu dir 'gro ba/ mon pa bya rog mgo can dang / bdud stag gi mgo can dang / srin po kang ka'i mgo can dang / gnod sbyin bya rog zhon pa dang / bud med lcagag kyu can dang / brjed byed dar ral can dang / srin 0mo dred zhon la sogs pa grangs med do/ /la la ni mkha' 'gro'i bro brdung /sal la ni mi mgo'i dung 'bud/ la la ni lcug pa'i glu len/ la la ni gnam lcaṭa ༷rku zor 'phen/ la la ni ro khyer nas bar snang la rgyug la la ni 'jigs pa'i chagar byed/ la la ni ku co chen po 'don/ la la ni nyi ma zla ba ltor mid/ la ༷la ni ri rab sgor du rtse/ la la ni rgya mtsho zor du 'phen/ la la ni 'jig rten bla jog bskyur/ la la ni 'gro dang rab tu 'gro la la ni sa banag dang gnyan gyi dmag sdud/ la la ni bdud so dang gnod sprin gyi dmag sdud/ la la ni klu 0dang gza'i dmag sdud/ la la ni rgyal po dang the'u brang gi dmag sdud me /lo phag lo yang klungs khrims dmag 'byung / mtshal ba'i bstan be+e dpon rabs 77

bdun gyi rjes/ /lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can snying la zhugs/ /rang rang bstan pa rang rang 'jig par 'gyur/ /bsod nams zad pa'i gyel po cig /a la hu yi phra ma'i ngag la nyan/ /dmag las shed mo/gdab pas srog dang 'bral/ /ma nyes pa la spyon phog rgyal sa 'khyig thal skya bing dbang pho brang zhugs kyes bsgon/ /sog po'i mi dpon ngo log mi 'tsham ga byed/ /hor rnams bsgal pa 'khu ba'i dus shig 'byung / /hor rul pho ru bye ste cha mi phyed/ /bod rnams bcom pa'i la yogs yin te mchi/ /tshos sde bshig pa'i rnam smin 'os ci bdog pad 'byung bzhin na rgya nag byung gis dogs/ /can bzhi rgyal pos dngangs skrag 'di tsam pa/ /rgyal po gnam gyi ming can rtsub 'gyur can/ /sa po sprel la jing gir rgyal sa 'chor/ /ta shing pho brang 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pas 'joms/ /gnam thes g.yung 'chi dben be+eng bod 'chos 'byung / /sa yi stong 'dir mi sde rlung 'tshub ldang / /dpa' tho yin kyang 'thab pas thub pa min/ /sdar ma yin kyang bros pas thar sa med/ /lha 'bod glu 'bod gyas kyang phan pa med/ /yar chen mtshan thos tsam byis steng chub 'thob/ /lha khang lā rā ṇa sī ma ga dha/ /nā len+d+ra dang rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /be+e kra mā la shī la u rgyan gan sto lo/ /mchod rten pad+ma 'khor lo can/ /dpa' du ba med pa'i mchod rten dpa / /dpal reg pa med pa'i mtshod rten dang / ri po ta la yo ṭan sturi dang1/ /mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa dge gnas brgyad/ 1mchod rten rnam dag lha las babs pa dang / /bal yul go da bi ra'i gtsug lag khang / /ba tsa thur dang pad rgyas lha khang dang / /lha sa bsam yas khru 'brug yar chedo kyi/ /bstan pa 'grib pa'i skabs med ma go'arma/ /ma 'ongs gsang gartam stugapo la shar ba bshad/ /ljang khur khar meg lha ris mnga' gsol mod/ /de bgu/ yid bajin yaro blungs mthil nas 'ongs/ /gsal byen chos kyi me long 1thu

bstan pa rnams/ kha ba can sprongs bod kyi rgyal khams 'di/ /rgya nag btsong kha rgyal po'i mi sde yin/ /ma sangs bon po 'dre rgod ces bya ba'i/ /ma 'ongs dbus su 'di ltar mi brgyud 'byung / /pha yi ming ni rin chen skyabs zhes pa/ /ra spu skud 'khal sgye char nor du gsog /ma yi ming ni yon bdag 'bum skyid /ma/ /byang chub mtshan can lcags stag lo pa 'byung / /phyogs tshod kun gyes ma tshor bya ba byed/ /rgyal khams 'khrugs nas bde ba mi 'byung ngo / /su yid ma 'ches bstan pa'i tha la ltos/ /long 'theng me tog dku 'dra'i bu mo la/ /byang ming 'dul skyod gnam she'i bdag po 'khrungs/ /bar gcod bdud kyi bstan pa 'dul bar byed/ khrims dang dam pa chos kyi nyi ma shar/ /lcags rta drug cu rtsa lnga lo skor bzhi/ /lcags kyi sgam chung kha brgyad ro langs bdun/ /zhe sdang las gyur dmag 'khrug 'byung ba'i dus/ /'dod chags las gyur mu ge 'byung ba'i dus/ /gti mug las gyur yams nad 'byung ba'i dus1 /spun chapadun skye ba bdun 'byung bstan pa 'dzin/ /nga rgyal las gyur dmag 'khrug 'byung ba'i dus/ /mi rnams skyo shas che bas chos kyis 'dul/ /u rgyan sku chagasung thugs kyi sprul pa zhig /dbus phyogs nyi ma gra stod yar chen du/ /gtadwa pa'i las can me khams chu mo phag /bstan pa'i bdag po u rgyan gling pa 'byung / /yar chen chob bcu sa yul lung du bstan/ /yul mang lha 'dres rten 'brel bsgrigs pa las/— /mi yis rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ma yin sgo/ /yug mo tsho bar mang po ngo ma shes/ /yar chen 'o dad tsam las mi 'dug kyang / /byin rlabs gzhan las che ba yin ma shes/ /ri mo bzo kun ri mo g.yag stangs can//chos kha cig gis gcig bzung phrag dog 'thab/ /skur pa 'debs shing gcig gis gcig la smod/ 1'di dus u rgyan pad 'byung bstan pa dar/ /rten ༷bzhengs lugs su blug dang 'bur du btod/ /ris su bris pa pad 'byung sku 79

'dra la/ 'khor gsum yongs dag phul rnams sgrib kun sbyong / /ji ltar ku ru'i sku gzugs shing las byas/ /rdza 'am ba so sa 'am rin cen las/ /bgyis pa ci 'dra rung yang mchod pa'i gnas/ /de bas che 'byor chung 'byor bsod nams bsag tshes bcu mchod khrims bya rgyu gzhan med pa1 /phan pa'i dbang byas sra mkhregs 'jam rdo rags/ /med pa'i dbang byas chu phor gang tsam mam/ /yod pa'i dbang byas shing gi lo ma tsam1 /chung ba'i dbang byas yos rdog sran ma tsam/ khrab dang ral gri go mtshon sna tshogs pa/ /ka ra bu ram shing tog nas 'bras gro /'bru rigs rardo ka to ra dang zangs/ /ga bur la sogs bzang po'i sman rigs dang / /sa gzhi sngo thog gnag lug ba glang dang /shesngo gsar dkar thog 'dod yon lnga la sogs/ /zhal zas gtor ma mar me me tog chang / /gos gsar dang ni sgod spyad gsar pa dang / /de la sogs pa zhag re phul lam spyod/ /rkun jag smad pa'i khyim bdun bshan lings mi khyad par sprel zla'i tshes bcu lo zlar mchod/ /sgog dang rgyal srid phyir du'ang mchod mi bcag /tshe 'dir je bde je bde je skyid 'byung / /phye ma mtho ris lha mi'i༄longs spyod 'thob/ /shar nas 'ongs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' mjal/ /sto nas 'ongs pa'i rin cen 'byung ldan mjal/ /nub nas 'ongs pa'i snang ba mtha' yas mjal/ /byang nas 'ongs pa'i don yod grub pa mjal/ /dbus nas 'ongs pa'i rnam par snang mdzad mjal/ /rgya la skyed gsum srus lung dkar po'i ljongs/ /lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams las la 'khol/ /lha mi'i mchod gnas bsam yas tsam re bzhengs/ /de yi rab gnas legs pas rgya dmathug/bzlog /sku gzugs gyang logs bris pa'i ri mo kun/ /lha khang bag tsam nyams pa 'ong srid pas/ /chos kyi sku la 'o brgyal mi mnga' yang / /de dus zhig gsos la ni brtson par bya/ /'di med lha khang gzhan rnams thamag 80

cad kun/ /sbang ro rul pa bzhin du song dogs yod/ /nag po'i rigs kyi lha 'dre rgyal gyur pas/ /yid brtan byed pa sto khang so ma bzhengs/ /'phan yul dar yul gtsang ri'i brag in+d+ra bhū ti rang byon mya ngan sku/ /pad 'byung ba khal sprug po rang byon sku/ /gter du sngas pa'i rdo sku khyad 'i'igs gnyis/ /rngong sman skyes chung phan mo dang / /ti lo sman dang stag sman gdong / /gtad gnyer byas pa'i yab sras rang byon 'di/ /rdo sku gser sku nang rdzong gzhug pa'i dus/ /yab kyis gzhug dang sras kyis rgyab gnyis brdar/ /dza gad dpa' byed a ba ta btab pa/ /rab gnas ston mo ltad mo byas te byin1 khu ba 'di nyid sto ru song tshad kun/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga byas pa/ /sdig /sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur/ /gnas ngan ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo gcod/ /mtho ris thar pa'i lus ni thob par 'gyur/ /de bas mchod pa zhabs tog 'bad la gyis1 /bstan pa'i spyi chis yin pas rgya dmag bzlog lha sa bsam yas khra 'brug lung gsum ljongs/ /rgyal blon bzhengs pa'i sa steng lha khang du/ /sde brgyad khengs log dmag sgyur g.yul zlog bshom/ /lha 'dre mkhengs log lha 'dre g.yul zlog bshom/ /dpe don grub bam gzhag sgor lta bur bskor/ /dbus su glang chen rab tu brtan pa la/ /rin cen tshogs tshad 'bru sna tshogs tshad dang / /rtsi shing sna tshogs dar sna tshogs tshad dang / /stag ras ༷gzig ras glang chen rdzongs la 'debs/ /klu rigs gyur pa thams cad rje/ /klu ni mal gro gzi can yin/ /mi yi lus la sbrul mgo bdun/ /sku mdog nag po/smad sbrul 'khyil/ /glang po che yi steng na 'dug /mal gro gzi can g.yas g.yon gnyis/ /bud med sngon mo g.yu yi thor cog can/ /de gnyis mal gro'i btsun mo yin/ /de 'og tshong dpon nag po mi yi lus/ /dkar po sbrul mgo lnga pas g.yas ru 'dren/ /de 'og khams kyi bya thul ni/ /mi lus ser po sbrul — 81

mgo gnyis/ /gzi can g.yon gye ru 'dren no/ /gangs kyi gcung po gro gro skyer chu'i lha/ kha rgyal zha mo 'od ni ser po glang mgo can/ /gzi can sngon gye bshul sel yin/ /de yi 'khor na gdug pa can ni bzhi/ /mthong bangi dug can mi lus sbrul mgo can/ /mnam pa'i dug can mi lus rta mgo can/ /bsam pa'i dug can mi lus khye mgo can/ /reg pa'i dug can mi lus rgya mgo can/ /glu gnyan sa bdag mang po klad rjes spul/ /tshal nag klu ni sbrul nag cig /rkyang bu tshal klu khye'u chung zur phud can/ /nag po klong brdol glu nag sku me 'bar/ /lu ma nag po'i klu ni rta spyon mi marga can/ /zangs gri mtsho dmar klu ni ling dmar po/ /sbrul dang sbal pa la sogs pa/ /sa bdag gzugs ni sna tshogs bya/ /phyogs dang kha dog bstun la gzug /dus ni rtsi thog ma bo ba yi dus/ dkar gtor chu gtor dkar gsum mngar gsum bskor/ /de nas klu chog byed pa brgya rtsa brgyad1 /de phyi bon chog byed pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /de phyi gdon tshog byed pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /de phyi sngags chog byed pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /de nas tsha tsha brgya rtsa gtor ma brgya/ /de nas sdong po brgyan pa chu 'jam brgya/ /de nas sprin sreg mnan pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /de nas sman bla gdugs dkar sgol mchod pa/ /zhub can go mtshon spyon pas bskor/ /yugs mo brgya dang byu brgyad g.yob jul bya/ /zhag bdun byas nas gtsang po'i gezhung la bskyal1 /ro langs bdun zlog cham 'bebs rdzong 'debs bskyal/ /rten 'brel 'di byas phan yon mthu stobs kyis/ /mtha' dmag thams cad 'jigs brgyad rang 'ur 'gro /bzlog thabs bstan pa'i rim gro ro langs bdun/ /mi rnams bsam pa phyogs gcig bsgril nas su/ /gser 'bum brgyad nas grub thob sku sha brgyad/ byang ming dung kha phyed nas dgra phyogs pastan/ /sgrub chen brgyad bsgrupas ngo lapas gzungs sgrub zlog /klog 'don yang nas yang du byas na blog/ཿ2

mdos rigs gyur tshad yang dang yang du gtang / /nag sgo'i phyogs pham dkar phyogs spobs pa bskyed/ /sngags bon dge spyopa dpung ni bskyed nas khrog /bablog thabs mi byed sbas pa'i yul la bros/ /byi 'brug sprel gsum lo la rgya dmag 'ong / /chu pho sprel bya yar klungs gartam ngan 'tshog /btsan po'i rdzong 'bebag spyogs kyi 'phrul 'khor bca'/ /yo la btsan rdzong phul ma ma lus pa//thams cad rgya nag dmag gis 'joms par 'gyur/ /sham po'i yul du rgya nag sgar mang 'debs/ /za 'thung dbyung gi sdigs rngams 'di lta bu/ /rnam sminas yin kyang chos pa snying rje skye/ /hor rgyal 'og gi sde dgon bsod nams zad/ 1/bod khams mi skyid pa yi nyi nag shar/ /gling tsha dgon 'jo khrom tog me nyag ma'abyung / /rkun jag ar sprang dge ba spel thebs med/ /dbus gtsang khams gsum thams cad 'o re brgyal/ /dus ngan skyes pa'i sems can snying re rje/ /kye ma kyi hud mi dge byas pas lan/ /bdud dang srin po ma mo gnod sbyin dang / /gong du smos pa'i lha 'dre ma rungs rnams/ /nang zhig sa jing khengs log rnams la rgyal po 'byung / /rgya bod drin chen gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa'i le'u ste nyer bzhi ba'o// ///ska/byeb/ (1rub// de nas u rgyan pad+ma'i zhal nas su/ /bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ thun mong mngon par shes pa lnga/ /khyad par mngon par zhes pa lnga/ /za med mngon par shes pa lnga/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par shis pa lnga/ /zag bcas mngon par shes pa lnga/ /zag med mngon par sheg pa spu/ 1'das pa'i mngon par4shes pa lnga/ /ma 'ongs mngon par shes pa lnga/ /da lta'i mngon par shes pa lnga18

maca/ nges mngon par shes pa lnga/ /'jig rten mngon par shes pa lnga/ /mngon shes lnga bcu rtsa lnga mnga' ba yis/ /lha 'dre dam la btags nas gter re gtad/ /lha lcam mardo ra bas yi ger btab/ /bsam yas bu tshal rus sbal 'og tu sbas/ /skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog /sa mā ya/ /rgya rgya rgya/ /garter rgya/ /sbas rgya/ /gsang rgya/ /zab rgya/ /gtad rgya/ /rgya rgya rgya/ /me mo phag gi lo stag gi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nub mo bu tshal gser khang gling gi sgo g.yas/ rus sbal 'og nas/ gra stod yar chan pa mu rgyan gling pa ngas/ kun dga' tshul khrims khrid nas bton/ gog ser ni shog dril gcig 'dug go /134

'go brjod/dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba sus dang ba5sa/ /yi dam zhi khro rig 'dzin tshogs noms la/ /gdung zhing gus pa'i yid kyis btud byas nas/ /rgyal po bka' yi thang yig bstan pa ni/ /phyogs bcu'i 'ijig rten rgyal ba'i zhing khams dang / /stong gsum ri rab bye ba prag brgya dang / /slong bzhi gling phran lcags ri mu khyud dang / /sgod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar chags pa dang / 1bcud kyi sems can ji ltar grub pa dang / /'khor los sgyur rgyal ji ltar byon pa dang / /sangs rgyas bde gshegs ji ltar byon pa dang / /phyi nang theg pa ji ltar gsungs pa dang 1 /chos zhus sdud pa ji ltar byon pa dang / /bod kyi chos rgyal ji ltar byon pa dang / /lo paṇa skyes bu ji ltar byon pa dang / /bod du dam chos ji ltar dar ba dang / /sngags 'chang grub thob ji ltar byon pa dang / /rgyal po'i thugs dam ji ltar bzhengs pa dang / /rgyal brgyud gtsug lag khang chen brtsigs pa dang / /sgong gi bang so ji ltar mchod pa dang / /bzhengs kyi lha khang ji ltar bzhengs pa dang / /bzhugs kyi sku mkhar dzi ltar brtsigs pa dang / /rtsis kyi rdo ring ji ltar bslangs pa dang / /ma 'ongs rgyal brgyud nor skam sbas pa dang / /bka' yi nan thag ji ltar gdams pa dang / /phyi ra/bas sngags 'chang man ngag rgyas btab dang / /phyi ma'i dus su ji ltar 'byung la sogs/ /rgyal po bka' yi dkar chag chen po 'di/ /phyi nang rnam gzhag zhib lo zhes bya ste/ /rgyal po bka' yi lo rgyus chen mo yin/ /dpal gyi bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi/ /steng khang lha yi gzhal yas chen mo ru/ /chos kyi rgyal po mu tig btson po yis/ /slob dpon lo paṇa grub phob spyan drangs nas/ /87

'jig rten spyan gzigs mang po'i tshogs 'khor bshams/ /bka' yi blon chen khru 'khor nang 'khor bcas/ /jo mo che sgong rgyal mos bka' zhus pa/ /mu rgyan mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /rgyal po mjing yon mu teg btsan po yis/ /bka' thabs thang yig dkar chag zhal nas gsungs/ /sgob dpon gsung dang rgyal pos bka' bstsal pa/ /dkar chag yi ge ldan ma rtse mang gis//de ring bco lnga rgyal gyi nyi ma la/ /slob dpon rgyal po rje 'bangs drung du bsdad/1che bgres blon po rnams kyang 'dus nas ni/ /blon chen dmag dpon lha bzang klu dpal dang / /blon chen bgres po khri bzang yab lha dang / /blon chen bgres po mdo bzher gre chung dang / /blon chen bgres po khri 'bring lha lod dang / /blon chen bgres po shud bu dpal seng dang / /sgon chen bgres po sna nam lha snang dang / /blon chen bgres po rta ra klu gong dang / /blon po rnams kyis phyag byas zug la nem/ /mgrin gcig gnyis med dri rmed byas rjes la/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i slob dpon chen po dang / /che zhing gnyan pa rgyal po bka' yi lung / /yum rje btsun mos zhus pa shin tu legs/ /thang yig dkar chag rgyas pa bstan du gsol/ /zhes zhus so/ /de nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /lha gras rgyal po mu tig potsan po yis/ /zhal nas gsungs dus blon po rnams kyis kyang / 1rmed tshig gong 'og ba gas nas mdzad tshul bajod//mchan bu rtse mang zin bris yi ger bris/ /rgyal po bka' yi rtags chen bcu gsum la/ /dang po rdo rje slob dpon sku yi rtags/ /gnyis pa rgyal po mi 'gyur sde rje'i rtags/ /gsum pa blon po bka' nan ral gri'i rtags/ /bzhi pa btsun mo'i mchid gsal gsung girdortags/ /lnga pa rgyal por mnga' gso'/ khrims kyi rtags/ /drug pa nor chen longs spyod dkor mdzod rtags/ /bdun pa phyogs rnams gdul ba dmag gi rtags/ /brgyad pa lo paṇa gdan 'dren rkang 88

—mgyogs rtags/ /dgu pa dam chos gsungs pa khri stong rtags/ 1bcu pa lha khang ༷brtsigs bzhengs brtan pa'i rtagab/ /bcu gcig gsol zas longs spyod che pa'i rtags/ /ban+ya gnyis bde skyid longs spyod 'itsho mu'i rtags/ /brtsu gsum tshe dbang rigs brgyud rgyas pa'i rtags/ /rgyal po bka' yi rtags chen brtsu gsum la1 /ma 'ongs rgyal brgyud kun rnams gau+od par shoke /dus gsum rgyal ba bla ma dkon cog gsum/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo rig 'dzin grub thob dang / /mkhas pa'i mchog gyur paṇa chen lo tsā rnams/ /che ba'i gdan du seng ge glang chen dang / /dar zab pho long gab rtse'i gdan la bzhugs/ /sku mchog pad ltar nyes pa'i skyon ma gos/ /yid bzhin nor ltar che ba'i yon tan dzogs/ /khri gdugs brdal ltar thugs rjes spyi khyab bzhugs/ /che btsan gnyan pa sa /bdag rgyal po ni/ /sku mdzes dpal brjid ri rgyal lhun po 'dra/ /gsal dag gsung snyan g.yu 'brug sgra ltar ldir/ /mkhyen rig thugs dgongs nam mkha' chadwangs ltar bzhugs/ /'phrul bag ldan pa thabs kyi zhang blon ni/ /rje yi chabaka' blon chab/srid gnyazha gnon/mdzad/ /drang sron/yog pa jig shing gcod / 'i gri/ /legs la darke byin nyeshe la 'gal khrims gcod/ /spuches kyi zhang blon ༷ bgres gargon gral rim bzhugs1 /mdzadas 'phrule ldan pa'i yum rje btsun mo ni/ /zhi ba'i ngang tshul dgu ldan mdzes ma la/ /mnyen snyug 'khril sdem lhun lhug gzi ba rjed 'bar/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan smra brjod sgu ni snyan/ /me long g.ya' dag nor bu'i 'od ldan bzhugs/ /bla mchod rgyal blon rnams kyi spun lam du/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i gu rus gsungs pa dang / /bka' chabatsan gnyan pa rgyag po bka' yi gsung / /thabs kyi blon chen gsung gi mchid rnams la/ /ldan ma rtse mang mchan bus zung tshig gsos/ /rgyal po bka' yi dkar chag bshad pa ni/ /ma rig mun sel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /snang 33

srid chags tshul phyi nang bar gsum gyi/ /bka2 yi babs tshul rgya mtsho chin po las/ /nor bu kun tu snang ba'i phra rnams bsdu shog bu'i logs la yigage'i ris su bris/ /ma 'ongs rgyal brgyud rnams kyi btsas su bzhag /phyi rabs rgyal po skal ldan las 'phro can/ /thang yig dkar chag chen mo 'di nyid la/ rdodam par gces spras mig gi 'bras bu ltar/ /thugs la goms pa sems kyi gter du chongs/ /lha khang bzhengs dang khrims kyi 'cha' ga gas dang / /rnying pa zhig gsos dkon cog mchod pa dang / /legs nyes dka' ba thog tu bab pa'i dus/ /rgyal brgyud nor skal dkor nor srus pa dang / /sa dmigs 'dom dang mdang yis gzhal tshod rnams/ /nang nor sems la gaster srung mnod de thon/ /blo thub nang blon thugs gces khrid nas ni/ /nus pa ldan pa'i skyes bus sa la brus/ /gsang thub blo chen rgyal brgyud phyi rabs rgems/ /noragachen gang 'dod longs la spyod rdong mchod/ /snod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar chags rgo'/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten zhing khams grub pa ni/ /thog skar srid pa 'byung ba'i chags tshul bstan/ /srid pa dag dang ma dag rnam gnyis las/ /dag pa'i 'jig rten khams zhes bshad pa yang / /bde gshegs ye shes thugs rjes 'dul ba la/ /sku gsum so so'i smon lam khyad par gyis/ 1rgyal ba'i zhing khams gsum du grub par 'gyur/ /chos sku'i zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /brjod med bsam 'das khyab gdal chen po las/ /ston pa kun bzang chen po'i ngang lu gnas/ /dam chos sgogs chen nam mkha' lta bur gsungs/ /chos nyan 'khor ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byung / /longs sbyod 30

rdzogs sku'i zhing khams gnas tshul ni/ /stong gsum3mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya las/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan ces gsungs/ /ston pa kun rig rnam par snang mdzad byung / /dam chos zab mo kri yog sde gsum gsungs1 /chos nyan 'khor ni dus gsum sangs rgyas byung / /sprul sku'i zhing khams khor yug rgya khyon ni/ /gling bzhi ri rab bye ba phrag brgya la/ /lcags ri nag pos yongs su bskor ba'i nang / /mi mjed 'jig rten khams zhes zhing khams su/ /ston pa shākya thub pa zhes bya byung / /dam tshos zab mo gang la gang 'dul gsungs/ /chos nyan 'khor ni nyan thos sems can byung / /chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang po yis/ /spros med sku dang nang rgyud thugs kyis 'byel/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang phyi rgyud sku yis 'dul/ /sprul sku'i ston pa shākya thub pa yis/ /nyan thos sku dang mtshan nyid gsung gis 'dul//me tog brgyan pa'i zhing khams bstan pa ni/ /kun bzang zhing khams thog mar gzhi las byung / /chos sku kun du bzang bo'i zhing khams ni/ 1nam mkha' mtha' yas khyab gdal chen po la/ /brjod med bsame 'das mkha' dbyings rnam par dag /ma bcos spros med shes rab dbyings su grol/ /dbyer sked lhun sgogs snying po ka nas dag /kun bzang dgongs pa thig le bde ba che/ /longs sku rnam par snang mdzad zhing khams ni/ /gzhi dang snyinge po me tog brgyan pa la1 /nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa'i klong yangs na/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdul phran snyed kyi bskor/ /rlungasag/dkyil 'khor chen bo'i 'og ma ni/ /gzhi nyid kun la khyab pa zhes bya ste/ /rin chen 'od 'phro 'bar bas khyab gdal zhing / /rlung gi dkyilam̐ 'khor kun gyi gong ma ni/ /gzi brjid dpal gyi snying pos khyab cing gdal/ /de yi steng na rgya mtsho gnas pa ni/ /ming ni nor bu snang yas rgya mtsho zhes/ /rgya mtsho de las pad+ma'i sdong po skyes/ /91

/ming ni sgos kyi rgyal po shod zer la/ /ze ba rin chen sna tshogs zhes bya byung 1 rdode las me tog pad+ma sna tshogs skyes/ /me tog re la rgya mtsho steng du chags/ /de yi steng du 'jig rten rdul snyed grub/ /yar bltas mar bltas rgya theb brtseṭa pa 'dra/ /phar chur bltas na za 'og gur khyim 'dra/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams bsam las 'das pa yang / /'jig rten 'di nyid dbus su gyur pa yi/ /spos chu'i rgya la po ze ba kun 'byung ba/ /'od zer mtha' yas zhes pya'i steng nā ni/ /nor bu'i rgyale po byang chub shing chen skyes/ /gzhi nyid spos dang nor bu'i rgyal po las1 /rgyal ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i pad+mo byung / /de la 'jig rtedi 'di nyid bhun gyis grub/ /phyogs bcu brjod du med pa'i zhing gis bskor/ /rnam par snang mdzad mnyam gzhag phyag gi mthil/ /lhung bzed rgya khyon dpag tu med pa'i nang / /sgos chu'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil na/ /ske tog brgyan pa pad+ma'i :yangag po skyes/ /rgyu ni rin cen sna tshogs kun las grub/ /de la yal 'dab me tog dpag med skyes/ /de'i steng snod kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs grub/ 1dper na me tog ha lo'i ldum bu 'dra/ /sdum bu la ni me tog 'khrungs pa yi/ /me tog gcig gi nang gi dkyil na yar/ kha dog ser mo'i phrum phrum zethu 'bru yod/ /'bru gu gcig gi rgya khyon tshad la ni/ /ri bo mchog rab bye ba phrag brgya la/ /gling bzhi gling phran 'khor gyis bskor ba yod1 /dperartan/me tog 'dab ma re re'i steng / /phrum phrum spungs pa'i dkyil gyi phyed na yar/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs pa'i 'jig rten yod/ /me tog dbus ma'i bcu gsum bar skabs ni/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'di yin zhes grags/ /bcud kyi sems can mtha' yas grangs las 'das/ /sangs rgyas sprul skushe sems can 'gro don mdzad/ /de ni me tog brgyan pa'i 'jig rten yin/ /phyogs bcu'i cha rgyal ba kun gyis de skad gsungs/ /'di yang khal bu/gamig 1ga/tshod yin te/ /92

phyogs bcu stong gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /nom par snang mdzad de yi sku las ni/ /'od gir phyogs bcur nyi ma'i zer ltar 'gros/ /'od zer re re'i rtse la zhing khoms chags/ /zhing khams re la rnam par snang mdzad bzhuṭa/ /me tog sdong po gong du bston pa ltar/ /yal 'dab rgyas shing me tog steng rnams na/ /zhing khams dbag med/gong du bshad dang mtshungs/ rgyal ba shāka thub zhing khams gi mjed 'di/ /me tog brgyan pa pad+ma'i sdong po yi/ /me tog 'dab ma lnga brgya phrag bzhi'i 'og /me tog brdal ba chen po gcig gi steng / / dper na ste tog ha lo'i me tog dkyil/ /ser mo 'athru gu phrum phrum spungs pa'i dkyil/ /phrum phrum nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs pa yod/ /phrum phrum re la sprul sku'i zhing khamagu ni/ /gling bzhi ri rapasabye ba phrag brgya yod/ /sprul sku'i ston pa re re'i 'dum zhing yin/ /de ltar brtsegs pa nyi shu rtsa lnga yi1 /dbus ma bcu gsum bar skabs gnam pa ni/ /ston pa shāku thub pa'i 'dul zhing yin/ /stong gsum snying po mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /gling gi mtshog gyur radzam gling be+e zur+ya/ /yu' gyi snying bo rgya gar ma ga dha/ /grong khyer snying po ser skya'i rgyal po'i khab/ /bzhugs gnas snyeng po mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan /'dzig rten zhing khams ma lus kun gyi mchog /rgyal ba'i1thugs rjes smon lam khol du phyung / /dag pa'i 'jig rten khams su gsungs pa yin/ /ma dag spyi mthun las la grub pa ni/ /phyi nang stod bcud 'jig rten rnam gnyis las/ /phyi nyid 'jig chags stongs gnas nyi shu 'byung / /'thab brabasaman chod stongs gnas nyi shu la/ /gzhi/ni nam mkha' mtha' dgis med pa yi/ /'degs byed rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi/rje che/ 1rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po rngams su ni/ /sa ya dang ni 'bum snag drug cu gnas/ /rgudi khyon dpag tshad gzhal mi nus pa yod/ /chu chen khor yug rgya mtsho gting du zab/ /chu yi jams su 'jam phrag bcu phyi3

rdogasnyeg dang / /dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shur gnas pa yod/ /rgya khyon napag tshad grangs dang gzhal mi nus/ /gser gyi sa gzhi khod stoms legs par /chags/ /rgya mtsho'i spu ba srid pa'i sa ru gyur/ /chu rdul phu tho rin cen brag tu gyur/ /ri rgyal lhun po phra rags rdul las grub/ /gser gyi ri bdun phyed snyedapag rim par chags1 /rol pa'i mtsho bdun kha rdag po sor gsal/ /gling mchen bzhi ni bkod legs gzugs mi 'dra/ /gling phran brgya da ni gling 'dra ༷bkod pa legs/ /nyi gza' skar mun sel mkha' la 'khor/ /mtha' ma lcags ri gcig gis bskor ba'i nang / /gling las khyad 'apags lho yi 'dzam bu gling / /chos rgyal bde gshegs zhing khams khyad par can/ /rdo rje gdan drung sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /nam mkha'i mdog kyang be+e ḍūr+ya sngon por gsal/ /rin cen sa gzhi sog kha'i dbyibs su gnas/ 1sangs rgyas stong gi ༷bsnyan pa 'byung ba mang / /rdo rje gdan du thams cad rgyas par 'gyud/ /sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i bstan pa tshar nas ni/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bstan pa jogs gyur nas/ /bskal chen 'jig rten stongs par gyur nas ni/ /sgod kyi 'jig rten chen po 'di nyid kyang / /kun gyur me yi bskal pas bsregs gyur nas/ /thal ba rlung gi bskal pas 'thor bar 'gyur/ /chu yi bskal pas ༷yongs su byang zhing nga ga /gnas ba'i bar gyi yun de stongs par 'gyur/ //stongs pa'i bar yun chags shing brtan par byed/ 1thog mar 'jig rten 'di snyed stongs gyur nas/ /de nas yang cig 'jig rten chags pa ni/ /'jig rten thub tshul 'di ltar grub pa yin/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor ze'u 'bru'i steng dag tu/ /chu yi phung po rgya mtsho 'bum phrag chags/ /de yi steng du sa chen chags tshul ni/ /srid pa rgya mtsho rlung gis bskyod na yang / /chu rlung brdol bas dba' 'tshub rab tu 'khrugase/ /dper na mar 'dod 'o ma bsrubs pa bzhigo/ /rgya

dab3 klong chu tshan sgang gshongs mtho dman byed/ /'ing log 'ur 'ur ding ding kun tu g.yos/ /dper na 2ོ/som chu dang phrad/pa bzhin/ /chu tshan 'khol ba'i sgra ni 'brug ltar sgog bar bskal phyed du chu yi 'byung ba g.yorga/ /rku mcho/chen po 'khrugs pa'i spu ba las/ /spu ba brdol bas rgya mtsho'i steng rnaca sa chod/ 1'byung ba zer sbungs lhu ba 'khyems pa 'a sa/ /srid pa'i sa rdo ri brag kun rnams grub/ /de nyid rang bzhin 'od du 'bar pa las/ /bar bskal bye1di du me drod rlung gis g.yos/ /de steng rdo ni rin cen grub pa'i rgyu/ /chu chen dba' 'tshub 'khrugardo/ pa'i lbu bas g.yogs/ /de nyid 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa yi/ /rlung gis bus nas sa do0me ru 'bang/ /bar bskal phyed du 'byung ba'i dwangs snyigs phyed/ /lcags thab mgar bas zhun chen bzhu pa ltar/ /rin cen rdo la gser spyo sa gzhi chags/ /sa chu me rlung rgyal pham so so'i dus/ /rin cen rdo dang sa ru dwangs snyigs byed/ /ri rab rin cen rnam pa lnga las grub/ /gser gyi re bdun gleng bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /lcags ri 'a sogs stong gasrum 'jig rten khams/ /'byung ba zer spungs lbu ba brtsegs las grub/ /gling bzhi ri rab bye ba phrag brgya la/ /nyi ma zla ba bye ba phrag brgyas bskor/ /mnyam du chags shing mnyam du gnas pa'i dus/ /ya thog ring/mor yar 'phel dus ged kyang / /sngon thog bskal pa bzang po'i dus tshod ces/ /snod kyi 'jika rten ji ltar chags pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// // bcud kyi sems can ji ltar grub tshu'/bcud kyi sems can ji ltar grub pa ni/ khams gsum sems can 'gro ba rigs drug rnams/ /las dang nyon mongs gnyis kyi rgyu las byung / /srid 9mi

pa/sde sgo nga phyogs rnams kun du brdol/ /srid pa mi dang byol song sna tshogs ༷byung / /'dam dang drod gsher skyes pa'i mi yang byung / /dbyar gyi brlan drod 'dzom pa'i sems can bzhin/ /seng phrom shing tog mi ru grub pa ltar/ /rang bzhin 'od las grub pa'i mi yang byung / /nam mkha'i lha las babs pa'i mi yang — byung / /'jig rten yon tan yar 'phel gong/du 'phel/ /sa zhag sā lu ma ༷zos lo tog rgyas/ /spyi mthun sems can bde skyid yar la 'phel/ /bskal bzang tshe lo dpag med grangs las 'das/ /mi yi skye gzugs bongs ni dpag /tshad re/ /de dang mthun pa'i longs dze+e+od bsam mi khyab/ /de mthun byol song rkang 'gros bsam mi khyab/ /longs spyod rgyas shing sems can gzugs dar bzang / /bde skyid phun tshogs bskal bzang dus tshod der/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i rgyal ba mi 'byon yang / /yang sprul byang sems 'phags pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de dus rgya mtsho chen po g.yas su 'khor/ /dbang chen gser bgyi sa gzhi de la reg mtsho yi rlangs kyis sa rdo kun rnams dros/ /'byung ༷ba'i drod rgyas spri mthun bsod nams 'phel/ /sems can bsod nams dga' ldan lha dang 'dra/ /longs spyod sa la skye rgu zas su 'gro /'jag khyim go khyim ༷spu khyim dar pa byung / /rang bzhin bzang po'i sems can bde skyid stoms/ /sgor rdzas la sogs chags 'dzin bsam pa med/ /dogs 'che gnod 'joms ༷gsod pa'i bsam pa med/ /zhe sdang nga rgyal phrag dog bsam pa med/ /rang bzhin shugs kyis sems can rnam rtog nyung / /dmag dang 'khrug rtsod tshong chadang khe khrum med/ /dgra dang srid kyi/sde ris 'don pa med/ /rang sems bzang po dga' bro rtsed glu byed/ /longs spyod bza' btung gang 'dod ci dgar spyod1 /rang mdangs 'od du shar bas nyin nub med/ /rang bzhin bzang po bde 'gro/stoms pa'i dus/ /tshe lo dpag med bskal pa bzang 9gi

po'i gong / 1ma thog ring mo zhes tsu bshad pa yin/ )/ /de nas no lo dpag med 'das pa sgo/ /ma sgog khug ba zhes bya 'byung/bar 'argyur1 /desgonas rgya mtsho chen po g.yon du 'khor/ /srid pa rgya mtsho dba' 'tshung/'khrugs pa las// chu klung spu bas gser gyi sa gzhi bteg chu chen khor yug sbya ba srid du chaṭa//brgya phrag re nas sa gzhi gyerna du 'phagaso/ /gser gyi sa gzhi rgya mtsho'i brlan dang bral/ /spyi mthun longs spyod sos ka'i chab rom 'dra/ /rgya mtsho'i rlangs kyis sa rdo dros tsho nus/ /'byung ba'i drod ya sa zhage lo tog bskams/ /sems can gye gzugs 'tsho ba ngan du 'gro /rang mdangs 'od yal mun pa'i gling du 'khums/ /de dus/spyi mthun sems dun bsode nams la1 //san ga sel pa'i nyi zla grub pa ni/ /rin cen sprigo las 'al 'ol chad chod 'khyel/ /ma shel snyingag po nyi ma'i dkyil 'okhor grub/ /ri rab dpag tshad porgyad khri'i phyed la 'khor1 /sems carna rang mdangs 'od 'bar nyamase pa bsabs/ /nyi ma'i zla bo mun pa sel ba la/ /rin cen sprin snyenas tshu shel zla ba grub/ /dpag tsha da bcu gsum bar du gnas la 'khor/ /nyi ma'i rgya khyod dparga chodi lnga bcu gcig /mu khyud khor yug dpangs su dpag tshad gathum/ /nang ne snye yi grong khyer dpag tu sded/ /zla ba'i rgya khyon dpag tshad lnga bcu la/ khor thug thu khyud dpog tshad phyed ma longs/ /nang na lha yi grong khyer dpag tu med/ /zla ba che chung skye 'bri mi srid kyeja / /zla po stod smad skye 'bri 'byub ba 'dra/ /gnam stong dus su chu shel zla ba'i steng / /nyi mas nozhe pas gsal ba'i nus pa med/ /tshes ga sum dus su sheg rdom bral ba yis/ /mu chu'i dro ma nang du khyab tshad gsal/ /tshes brgyad dus su griste mas phyed la khyab/ /bco lnga kun la khyad pas gsal ba yine/ /dargyar dargen nyi ma ring thung khyad par ni/ /dazur ni ri rab nyi ma nye bas bul/ /rlung gis ma bskyod ri rab sdebs la dal/ /cang shes rta gsum zhu7

paphyod ba'i shugs dang mtshungs/ /dgun ni ri rab nyi ma rgyang thag ring / /re gas ma bskyabs rlung gis baspyod pas maspyogs/ /'khor lugs shugs che dpaṭa ༷chen mda' dang 'dra/ /gza' skar rin cen lnga las grub pa yang / kha dosha gsal bas gser zangs 'khar ba gsum/ /che ba rgya khyon rgyang grags bco ༷brgyad yod/ /chung ba rgyang grags gamum du gnas pa la/ /che chung gang yang balha yi gzhal ba sa khang / /nyi mas non tshe skar ma bag la zha/ /spu gri'i stobs can rlung gis 'degs pa'i gong / /'degs dang gnon dang 'phrul dang brten pa'i rlung / /bzhi sgom rlung gis nyi zla gza' skar dateg /mtsho yi rlangs las mkha' la sprin du chags/ /'byung ba tsha grang phrad pas glog tu 'khyug /de nyid 'thabs pas mkha' la 'byug sgra sgogs/ /drag cing ngar na bar nas thog tu 'bab/ /dper na me lcags rdo la brdabs ba bzhin/ /bar nas me dang rin cen 'od zer 'apro/ /ri rab yar 'das srid pa'i lha/rabs kyang / /mche ma'i lha dang 'phrul dga' gagin 'phrul dang / /lha gnas rim pa 'khor rgya brtsegs mar che/ /ri rab lha yi 'khor rgya rim par yang / /dga' ldan sum byu rtsa pa sum lha la sogs/ /'khor rgya rim pa'i sa las rgya khyon dpags/ /mkha' dang ri rab lha gnas rnam gnyis kyang / /dper na cha lang spyi bo sprad pa 'dra/ /ri rab rin cen bzhi las grub pa yang / /shar phyogs shel dang sto phyogs be+e ḍūr+ya/ /rdub phyogs rā ga byang phyogs gser las grub/ /gling bzhi'i byang la ri rab gnas tshul ni/ /nyi zla 'khor ba kun gyi lho ngos la/ /lus 'phags nub la 'dzam ming shar phyorges yin/ /'dzam gling nub phyogs ba glang spyod kyi shar//ba glang spyod nub sgra mi snyan gye shar/ /sgra mi snyan nub lus zhagags shar gyi phyogs /lus 'phags ba be+eng spyod gnyis ston dbyed mtshungs/ /'dzam gling sgra mi snyan gnyis dbyar dgun mtshungs / /dbyar dgun nyi ma ring thung dus 'u8

tshod gcig gling bzhi gling phran sems can spyi mthun gyi/ /bskal bzang rdzogs nas tshe lo grangs yod dus/ 'dzam gling sog kha rdo rje'i gdan drung du/ /bde gshegs sangs rgyas ston pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dam ches theg pa rim par gsum bzhi dar/ /dam chos rgyas shing sems can bde skyid ldan/ /brgyad khri bdun khri bzhi khri la sogs par/ /sangs rgyas rim 'byung 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'byung 1 /rgyal ba rnams kyi bstan pa'i mjug ma la/ /yang cig tshe lo bcu pa 'byung bar 'igyur/ /de gong tshe lo lnga bcu'i gong rol nas/ /sa tshan rgyas pas rlangs kyis sa ma 'khugs/ /sa dang nyi ma bar thag rte ba yis/ /bsil brlan bskams shing nyi ma bdun 'gyur tsha/ /'byung ba'i drod yal rtsi shing nas mtshal zad/ /bsnyan pa'i drod yal mkha' 'gro mkha' la gyes/ /gsang sngags sgra1ni brag ca 'dra bar song / /ston pa'i ming med bstan pa'i mur thug pas/ /nad yams mu ge'i bskal pa byung nas ni/ /li yi yul du bston pa'i mjug ma sdud/ /btsun ba glang dmar shākya'i tshul 'chos shing / /mtshon gyi bskal pas yitha' ru stongs par byed/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i bstan pa bheng ba'i tshe/ /sems can bsod nams shin tu dman pa'i dus/ /gi yi bongs ni brgyad cu'i mtho gang la/ /dug lnga rags shing mu ge'i rtsib thur pa/ /rtsig brag thur mas bsngogs nga ri/'byu re la/ /gtsegs su bzung nas gces spras byed pa'i dus/ /rus gong dkar po gab tse mu ge pa/ /skra las byas pa'i shā ba dum re las/ /gos med mu ge nub 'khyags nyin mo 'tshig /ri brag gseb tu bser bu rlung la bsgug /nyi ma mthong che gshed ma'i 'du shes skye/ /'jig rten stongs pashi sems can lhag byul ni/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i ming du grags ba rnams/ /zhag grangs drug cus smin pa'i kha zas ni/ /zas kyi snying bo bra bo sa 'jam za/ /dur khrod rus pa rnying pa lag tu blangs/ /sngon tshe rtsam zan rus pa yin no gye3

zhes/ /sna la sgom zheng kha ru/mur bar byed/ / de dus/ji rnams shin tu nyung bar zan/ /ri dang brag sogs grong gi mija yang med/ 1shin tu yi mug snying mi dga' bzhi dus/ /gnyis gnyis gsum gsum 'grogs shas grong gseb sprul/ yul khamag/shen gye mi rnanas zad pa'i dus/ /re re gnyis gnyis phrad pa'i dus tshod der/ /grong yul khab gog re hul rdib stongs dang / /lcam shing rnying pa khang stong dib ba'i rjes/ /gog rul zhig 'phro sgo med re cha zhig /phyag dar khrod dang grong stong bzhi mdo ru/ /gastug gi lag mgul gcig gis bcangs nas kyang / /kye ma 'jig rte na stongs so kyi hud ces/ /sems sdug lus ngal mya ngago spre sngags 'don/ /brten pa'i 'jig rten 'di ni nyam zhing thag /padag sogs sems can sdug bsngal sna tshogs gzir/ /skal zad skal ngan tshe lo ba cu pa'i dus/ /gos med gcer thu nub 'khyags nyin mo/ 'tshig /gos stan mi rnyed tsha grang sdug bsngal che/ /pos skom mi sted sa snyag bra bo za/ /gtsang po'i chu ni rong khung gting du rbas/ /ri bran chu ni tshad pa'i dugs kyis bskams/ / zla grogs mi rnyed grong yul mi rnams zad/ /brten pa'i 'jig rten yongs spyo stongs shing brlag /nyam thag sdug bsngal skyo zhing snying mi dga'/ /lus srog myur/du/dor na rung ngo zer/ /gcig la gcig reg skyo ngal smre sngags 'don/ /de 'dra'i dus ni tshe lo bcu ba'i dus/ khams gsum so /sa can 'gro ba rigs drug rnams/ /las dang nyon mongs gnyis kyi rgyu las grub/ /mi rnams 'od ga la lha las 'chad pa yang / /dge ba spyad pas mtho ris rnam pa gsum/ /sdig pa spyad pas ngan song rnam pa gsum/ /gnas lugs bongs dang tshe tshad bsam yas kyang / /'dzam gling sog kha bod du skyes pa rnams/ /mi lus gtsang ma chos rnams kun gyis spyod/ /chos skyong rgyal po'i bka' lung rtaṭa bzung nas/ /mi dge bor nas dge ba dang/du blangs1 /longs spyod rgyas shing 1yi0
