sa ni/ yi/skye gzugs bzang / /sems can grub tshul bsam las 'das na yang / /thog/nar 'od gsal lha las 'dzad pa yin/ /spyi dang sgos tshan so so'i ming yig dang / /so so'i che brgyud yon tan bsdod mi lang / /dus chen re la gtam re 'byung bar shes/ /mtho ris rnam gsum lha dang lha min mi/ /byol song yi dwags dmyal ba ngan song gsum/ /thams cad bsdus pas 'gro ba riṭa drug yin/ /dzas tre sha'i yal 'dab don mtshon nas/ /lto yi 'dzag gling yul chen bco brgyad dang / /mtha' 'khob dgu bcu rgyal khams stong dgu las/ /mi rigs mi mthun drug stong bzhi brgya yod/ /skad rigs mi mthun sum brgya drug cu yod/ /lus rigs mi mthun brgya dang bdun cu yod/ /bsam pa mi mthun 'bum tsho sa ya yod/ /mi rigs mi mthun drug stong bzhi brgya la/ /de yang bsdu na bco lnga'i khongs su 'dus/ /bzang po thu sangs she tshar dge tshar gsum/ /ngan pa spangs te pir la yu lu gsum/ /bzang 'og 'thoms pa 'gags pa 'gongs pa gsum/ /'bring po thugs pa ger pa thom ham gsum/ /de 'og dem pa 'gar ba phrag pa gsum/ /che zhing bzang la 'khor zhing 'thoms pa'i skyon/ /mnyen lhug 'khril la 'jam zhi nga 'i ba'i skyon/ /dag ci gsal la tsha zhing rtsub pa'i skyon/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i dus las 'das 'og tu/ /sems can bye rgu tshe lo su ma cu'i dus/ /byams pa'i sprul pa khru gang pa zhig 'byung / /gzugs mdzes gsung snyan sems can thams cad mos/ /de yi drung du mi rnams kun 'dus nas/ /skyes bu gzugs byad bzang ba 'di lta bu/ /rgyu dang rkyen ni gang las byung bar gyur/ /kun gyis bkur zhing ya mtshan 'dzin ba/la/ /skyes bus smras pa/bdag gi gzugs byad 'di/ /pha rol phyin lnga spyad pas byung ngo ster/ /de nas kun gyis pha rol phyin la bslab/ /de nas 'go bzung bston pa mar la 'phel/ /tshe lo dpag med bskal bzang thug gi bar/ /'jig rten 101

mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'byon zheng / /yar 'phel 'jig rten yon rtan rgyas par 'gyur/ /de yi dus la ya thog ring mor btags/ /de nas bzung ste tshe me grangs yod dus/ /margan po thums pa 'jig rten khams su 'byon/ /rdo rje gdan du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal re la sras mchog re//bstan pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas stong rtsa 'byon/ /bar khug bco bgyed ma thog ring mo 'byung // bcud kyi sems can ji ltar grub pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ / /1/'khor los sgyur rgyal ji ltar byon tshu'/ 'a/ ra los sgyur rgyal ji ltar byon pa ni/ /gdung brgyud rgyal po'i lo rgyus mtshon pa la/ /sngon thog bskal pa bzang po snga dus na/ /zas su sa zhag sā lu za ba yi/ /skye rgus tshe lo grangs yod thub pa'i dus/ /mi yi ming du sems can zhes pa las/ /sems can gzugs bzang che ba'i mchog cig la/ /kun gyis bkur nas rgyal por mngang yang gsol/ /rgyal po mang pos bkur ba zhes byar grags/ /sku mchog mdzes pa lta bas chog mi shes/ /ka la ping ka yan lab/ brgyad ldan gsung / /thugs dgongs sgam po glu bzang 'phrul bag ldan/ /legs la dge sbyin nyes la 'gal khrims gcod/ /ba /'a lung rtags chen rgyal po'i sa mnan nas/ zhing dang sems can kun la dbang bsgyur cing / /gling khams sems can kun la dbang mdzad skad/ /gdung brgyud rim pa gser gyi 'khor lo ba/mas/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de nas byung / /'khor los sbyar ba'i rgyal po 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /ren cen sna bdun sa/gi gter du 'byungado/ /tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i nor gyi dbang skal la/ /thog mar nor bugarin cen 'byur bar 'gyur/ /thugs dgongs bsam 'phel longs spyod sna zlos—1nya2

'byung / /de nas btsun mo rin cen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lta ba'i gzugs mdzes sems 'phrul kun dang ldan/ /de nas blon po rin cen 'byung bar 'ashār/ smra ba mi dgos spyan gyig don rnams go /de nas rta mchog rigo cen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bgrod pa'i gnas su skad cig tsam la phyin/ /de nas dmag dpon rin cen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /pha rol rgol ba'i dpung rnams rab tā 'joms/ /de nas glang po rin cen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /stobs chen rgyal po'i dpung tshoṭa rab tu 'degs/ /de nas khyim bdag rin cen 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dod yon rgyas pa'i phun tshogs sgo mo 'byed/ /skye rgus tshe lo drug khri thub pa'i dus/'khor los sgyur rgyal mtshog sbyin zhes bya byon/ /gling dang sems can kun la dbang yang byed/ /mi rnams tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa'i dus/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal tsadhenazhes bya byon/ /gling dang sems can kun la dbang yang bye1// /mi rnams tshe lo nyi khri thub pa'i dus/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal kṛ kri zhes bya byon1 1gling dang sems can kun la dbang yang byed/ /mi rnams tshe lo brgya par gyur pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po zas gtsang bre bo bdud rtsi zas/ /zhing khams sems can kun la dbang yang byed/ /rgyal bu sgra gcan rab byung rgyal srid spangs/ /gdung pargyud dgu/khri dgu stong dgu brgya yi/ /rgyal brgyud sgra gcan yan chad yin zhes gsungs/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal ji/ltar byon pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //bde gshegs rgyapha ba ji ltar byon tshul/bde gshegs rgyal ba ji ltar byon pa ni/ /'das pa'i dus kyi bskal pa sngon byung la/ /mdzes par snang ba zhes bya'i 'jig rten du/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams rnam par brgyan pa der/ /bde gshegs mtshan ni yon tan mtha' yas 10

chadapal/ /rin chen sna tshogs brkad pa'i rgyal ba yi/ /bstan pa de la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal/ /rgyal po yul 'khor srung zhes bya ba yis/ /btsun mo stong dang rtsa gnyis khab tu bzhes/ /lo bzang tshes grangs gza' skar zhub gcig la/ /btsun mo stong la rgyal sras stong du 'khrungs/ /btsun mo gnyis la lang du khyenyu re/ /mngal nas ma 'khrungs 'od dang bcas nas byon/ /de rnams che chung gong 'og sras brtag phyir/ /rgyal pos gser bum g.yu yi kha pad can//rin chen sna tshogs phra yis brgyan pa'i nang / /gser shog sor bzhi stong dang rtsa gnyis la/ /beḍūru zhun mas rgyal bu rnams kyi mtshan/ /tshigs su bcad pas smon lam bga' nan bris/ /bum por bstsal nas dkon cog mchod pa phul1 /rdo rje pha lam skya bas lam bdun dkrugs/ /smon lam dbad gis zhag bdun gsol ba btab/ /zhag bdun nang par kha phye mtshan byang bltas/ /thog mar /mtshan gyi yig 'byu 'di skad smra/ /ma 'ongs bskal ba 'di 'das 'og rol du/ /༷gnas bzang bskal pa nyi shu'i dang po la/ /skye rgus che lo drug khri thub pa'i dus/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal mchog sbyin bya ba'i sras/ /bde par gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig ces 'byon/ /dam chos lo grangs brgyad khri'i bar du gnas/ //skye rgus tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa'i dus/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal tsadzha zhes bya'i sras/ /bde bar gshegs pa gser thub ces bya 'byung / /dam chos lo grangs stong gi bar du gnas/ /skye rgus tshe lo nyi khri thub pa'i dus/ /'khor los sgyur ༷rgyal kṛ kro zhes bya'i sras/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'od srungs zhes bya 'byon/ 1 dam chos lo grangs bdun khri'i bar du gnas/ /skye rgu'i tshi lo brgya par gyur pa'i dus/ /zag gtsang zhes bya rgyal po chen po'i sras/ /bde bar gshegs pa shāka thub ces bya 'byon/ /dam chos lo grangs lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas/ /spyol bu stong rnams sang sa rgyas gyur pa'i rjes/ /ma smad ma dang dpe med ma yi 104

bu/ /pang skyes chos kyi sems dang blo rgas gnyis1 / tsharas/ba dang ni girtabashan rdo rjer 'gyur/ /tshangs pas bde gshegs chos la bskul ba dang / nyag na rdo rjes chos kyi sdud pa mdzad /gage gsheḥgs zhing khums bstan/pa dar zhing rgyas/ khams gasrum sems can byang chub snying po 'thob/ /bde gshegs rgyaladab ji ltar byon pa'i le'u ste/bsdo /'o// //༷ sdi nang jeg pa ji ltar gespyodase tshuke// phyi nang theg pa ji ltar gsuXs pa ni/ /sangs rgyas ste shes thugab/rje thabs mkhas pas/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba shākya thub ba des/ /spyon sneng bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i gong / /shākya thuXb pa chen po'i spyan snga ru1 ba 1mchil lham rdza bum 'gron bu gdugs phul nas /lhag bsam rnam dag byang chub sems bskyed/zhus1 ༷ /de nas grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs la sogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bdun khri snge stong mtshod cing bkur/ /tshogs gnyis sems can don du bsngose shing bsags/ /darkano cog bla/med spyon sngar bzod pa thob/ di /mar me mdzad kyi spyazhe sngar lung yang bstan/ /srid pa tha maranadaga' ldan lha gagos su/ /dam pa tog dkar zhes pyo'i lha lus blangs// /lha dang nye dbang dobag med chos la bkod1 /chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen natha' ya sa bskor/ /snye dang lha min 'gro ba dpag med drangs/ /lha dang nye dbang brgya byin phyag tu gtad/ /rgyal tshab gnyer du mgon po byams pa bskos/ /lta yi yulajanas mi yi yul du gshegs/ /'dzam bu gling du gzigs stangs gsum gyis byon/ /grong khyer la gzigs gnas mchog ser spyo la/ /yab la gzigs pa rgyal po zas gtsang la/ /yum la gzigs pa spyu ma lha 10co

sadzes la/ /glang chen thal kar mche ba drug par sprul/ /mkha' la rgyan na4 /yum kyi lhams su zhugs/ /zla ba bcu nas sangs gyes sku bltams tshe/ /sgru ma ༷ lta mdzes lusa'i tshal du gshegs/ /sku rten pāk+ṣa'i shing la mdzad pa'i che/ sa g.yog mo skye rgu'i bdag mos phug gis bzung / /rtsib ma'i bar nas rgyal bu sdu ༷bltams dus/ /lha chen tshapas pas dar dkar lcibs mas blangs/ /dbang po brgya byin bdud rtsis sku khrus gsol/ /phyogs bzhir gom pa bor bas pad+ma 'khrungs/ /pad+ma brtsegs pa'i mchod rten la sogs byung / /khrus byed rgyan /'dogs nu zho bstun pa sogs/ /ma ma sum cu rtsa gnyis phyag gis bdar/ / gzhon nu rol rtsed btsun mo'i 'khor la rol/ /bram zes mtshan gsol rgyal bu mdon grub ces/ /shākya'i bu mo sa 'tsho khab tu bzhes/ /rgyal srid bzung nas grong khyer ser skyar bzhugs/ /sgra gcan 'khrungs nas mchod rten rnam dag la/ /kus pas btud nas rang gis dbu skra bcad/ /ni rasdi nar dka' thub mdzad la dang / /'o thug bzhes nas sku mdog gser ltar gyur1 /byang chub shingarwang ༷rdo rje gdan gyi rtser/ /grod la bdud btul nam byed mnyam par bzhag /tho rangs sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i dpal du shar/ /'jig rten pa yi mdzad pa lnga dang gi/ /'jig rten las 'das mdzad pa rnam pa lnga/ /thun mong ma yin mdzad pa 1gnyis la sogs/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis mthar phyin mngon sangs rgyas/ /wā ༷rāṇa sīr lnga sde bzang po dang / /'gro mchog rnams la dam chos char ltar phab/ /bden pa bzhi yi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor1 /bya rgod phung por theg chen gang zag la/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /yangs pa can du sna tshogs gang zag la/ /jas pa don gyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /bde gshegs thugs rje che la thabs mkhas pas/ /gang la gang 'dul de la de 'dul ba/ /sku gsum ston pa thub pa drug tu sprul /sku gsum so so'i chos 06

gzhung dmeng srol gyi/ /theg pa rim dgu la sogs so sor gsungs/ /chos sku'i ston pas snang stong gnyis men/gsungs/ /longs sku'i ston pas bskyed sgogs zung 'jug gsungs/ /sprul sku'i ston pas 'dul ba'i sde snod gsungs/ / bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs pa chen po gsum/ /nges tshig thos pas sangs /rgyas lag gis bladās/ /kri ya u pa yo ga rnam pa gsum/ /mi tshe gsum gyis sangs rgyas sa la sbyor/ /'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa rnam pa gsum/ /grangs/ samed gsum gyi sabs rgyas sa la sbyor/ /sprul sku'i ston pa shākya sed ge yi/ / dam tshos lo grangs spu brgya phrag bcur gnas/ /dam chos le'u bzhi ru phye ba las/ /rtogs dang sgrub dang lung dang rtags tsam 'dzin/ /lung gi durga su sde sgod rnam pa gsum/ /thupa pa'i dam chos ji ltar dar ba ni/ /lnga stong lnga brgya / ga ba cur phye ba las/ /rgyal ba'i sras po 'byon lugs rim pa yang / /lnga /brgya dang por dgra bcom sha stag 'byung / /lnga brgya gnyis par phyir mi thong ba /'byung / /lnga brgya gsum par byer 'ong rgyun zhugs 'byung / /lnga brgya bzhi par lhag mthong shes rab 'byung / /lnga brgya lnga par tshul khrims sdom pa 'byung / /lnga brgya drug par zhi gnas ting 'dzin 'byung /lnga brgya bdun par ༷mdo sde'i sde sdod 'byung / /lnga brgya brgyad par 'dul ba'i sde sgod 'byung / lnga brgya dgu par mngon pa'i sde sgod 'byung / /lnga brgya bcu par rtags tsam /'dzin pa 'byung / /lnga brgya phrag bcur 'das pa'i sems can rnams/ /snyigs ma'i mthar thug skal ngan skal ba zad/ /gos kyi snyigs ma lwa ba gyon pa'i dus//zas kyi snyigs ma lci ba za ba'i )dus/ /nor gyi snyigs ma gri mtshon dar ba'i dum/ /'bru yi snyigs ma bra bo skye ba'i dus/ /gtam gyi snyigs ma khengs smra sa 'gran pa'i dus/ /mu ge bskal pa'i nad yams mod pa'i dus/ /mtshon gyi chubaskal pas mtha'/ru stongs par byed/ /ston pa'i dam chos nub par gyur nasan 10na

ti1 1chos kyi bston pa li yi lul du tshugs/ /mtha' mar bsten me li yi yul du sdud1 /de yi dus su rtags tsam 'dzin pa 'byung / /li yi yul du chos snyang rgyal po ni/ /spe ba cago zhes rgyal depo'i gzhug sdud 'byung / /rgyal po de yi zla mchod lnga brgya po/ /dro dus chos kyi rgol rtsod the tshom gyis/ /gcig la gcig rgol bzod pa'i go cha shor/ /dug lnga rags pas zhe sdang dba' rlabs 'khrugs/ /mtho dma'i tshig la kun slong kha lag shor/ /kun gyis ske rags ༷gseb kyi gri gu bton/ /gcig la gcig thebs bla mchod lnga brgya po/ /mtshon khru+os bkums te khrug gi 'dam du tshud/ /rgyal po thu ngan khang par zhugs pa'i dus/ /phyi nang blon po rig pa can rnams kyis/ /ba dmar glang dmar pags tha lus la gyon/ /grod pas mgo gtums gseg shang lag tu thogs/ /rgyal po'i spyan gyes non pa'i sa rga 'gyu/ /nang blon phyag tshang rgyal mo la sogs kyis//rje cig begyed dang bla mchod gral ma stongs/ /ri brag sul gye dge 'dun them spangs rnams/ /ri khrod dben gnas bsten pa'i skrub pa po/ /de nyid rgyal pos gzigs pas mya ngan zhi/ /btsun pa glang dmar shākya'i tshul 'chos rnams/ /rgyal pos gzigs phyir chas gnyis 'dzin pa 'byung / /de nyid rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus tshod ces/༷ /gos mdog bsgyur ba'i chos la nus pa med/ /tshwa yi ro nyams zho la mar mi 'byung / /rab tu 'byung pa'i mkhan slob yul gzhi stongs//rgyal po'i bka' khrims nyi ma lta bu rgas/ /'apangs kyi mi chos sog ma'i phon thag chad/ /bla mchod chos khrims dar mdud lta bu grol/ /chos kyi nyan bshad na bun lta bur yal/ /sgom dang sgrub pa nam langs skar ma bzhin/ /gsal ba med cing gasdig kyang mngon pa med/ /rgan rabs gong ma lo tog brngas pa stor/ /sngon/ma skyes pa phyi ma gcig ma lus/ /skyes bu grub thob yon tan mnga' ba kun/ /dus kyi+o/shugs las shing tog yal ba bzhin/ /thub pa'i bstan pa 103

snyedagong ka'i grib so bzhin/ /mar 'grib dus ngan bskol pa ngan pa'i dus 1sems can spyi mthun bsod nams dman dus der/ /bzang lan don gagom legs lan nyes kyis 'jal/ /las gu srog gcod zong la rdzun du 'argong / gdod med rku 'phrog mdzangs med ser sna byed/ /de 'og che lo bcu pa'i dus ngan 'byung / /de nyid jogs nas yar 'phel bskal pa bzang / /ya thog ring po zhis bye rgabyung bar 'gyur/ /sems can bde skyid phun sum tshogarga pa 'byung de nyid rdzogs nas tshe lo grangs yod dus/ /ston pa'i bstan pa rim gyis babyud bar 'gyur/ /gong ma rgyal bas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar/ /ga 'ongs rgyal /ba rnams kyang de nyid gsung / /phyi nang theg pa ji ltar gsungs pa'i le'u ste lnga sgyu pa'o// // zhu dang sdud po ji ltar byon tshupa/zhu dang sdud po ji ltar byon pa ni/ /kun tu bzang po rang byuja/ste ru —kas/ /chos dbyings klong yangs 'og min gnas mchog tu/ /rang bzhin rnam snyedag dus gsum bde gshegs la/ /nang rgyud sde gsum thugs kyi klong nas /bshad/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'og gin pho brang du/ /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'khor rnams la/ /phyi rgyud sde gsugi sku yi mdangs kyis bshad/ /sprul sku shāka thub lto yi 'dzam gling du/ /nyan thos dgra brtsom sna tshogs gang zag la/ /mtshan nyid theg pa gsu ma gyi dam chos gsung / /gsang sngags 'bras /bu theg pa'i byung tshul ni/ /kun bzang che mchog khro rgyal te ru ka /drag tho 'jigs byed 'bar ba 'i skur bzhengs nas/ /rang dang mtshungs par dur khrod chen por sprul/ khro bo mngon 'byung dkyil/'khor gyis bsdus dang / /rgyud sde /109

na'aphren las tshogs rnams ma lus gsungs/ /zhi khro phyi rgyud bye brag rgyud gnyis ༷las/ /spri yi rgyud la byud sde lnga ru gsungs/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /phyi ma nges par 'byung ba'i rgyud dang ni/ /phyi ma'i phyi ma sngags / kyi rgyud sde dang / /ma tshang kha skong kun dargas rgyud chen dang / /'byed par byed pa sde sdig rgyud rnams gsungs/ /bye brag rgyud kyang rtsa rgyud yan lag gnyis/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud la dgos pa bcu ru gsungs/ /zhi ba rtsa rgyud che mchog rtsa rgyud dang / khrug 'thung rtsa rgyud gshin rje'i rtsa rgyud dang / 1'grin las rtsa rgyud ma mo'i rtsa rgyud dang / dregs pa rtsa rgyud drag po 'dus pa'i rgyud1 /ngog 'edzin rtsa rgyud pad+ma tso rgyud dang / /yan lag rgyud sde sgrub ba bka' brgyad byung / /thugs nas phyung nas mgul gyi bum par gril/ /ljags la bkram nas tshems kyi bar la bton/ /chos kyi rang sgra le'ur gsungs pa'i dus/ /bka' yi sdud pa rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyes thog mar ngag tu ༷ btus/ /de nas po ti glegs bam bkod pa las/ /gser spyi glegs bam me+e ḍūdu zhun mas bris/ /spri dang bye brag rgyud sde phyogs phyogs bsdebs/ /mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che la gtad/ /rnal 'byor skel /rdon cig la sbyin zhes pa'i/ /dngos grub bka' lung bstsal nas gter du gtad/ /theg pa'i rim pa dam chos so so la/ 1rgyal ba'i bka' lung 'khor lo rnam pa gadzum/ /sprulo skus gsungs pa bka' yi sdud pa po/ /phyag na rdo rjes 'bras bu'i theg pa gsungs//nyan thos kun dgas rgyu yi theg pa gsungs/ /yig ming chig tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis so/ /bzo rig 'bur du khyab 'jug lha yis btod/ /rgyal ba shāka thub mya ngan 'da'i gyur nas/ /me tog bkod pa zhes bya'i zhing khams su/ / rgyal ba ma grags pa zhes bya ba 'byung / /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'od zed spungs pa'i gnas/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i tshom bus yongs su bskor/ /kun bzang 110

shabyer med chen po'i ngab la bzhugs/ /sprul sku'i bka' lung 'khor lo rnam ༷ gsum la/ /bstan bcos rnam pa gsum du byung tshul ni/ /bden pa gzhi yi /chos kyi bka' lung la/ /lta ba so so rang gi rig pa yi/ /bye brashe bshad lodzod chen mo la sogs pa/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i bka' ni klu sgrub kyis/ /bdabu ma rig pa'i tshogs drug bya ba brtsams/ /nges pa don gyi bka' dang don rnams la/ /byams pas mdo sde rgyan sogs sde lnga brtsams/ /bstan bcos sartsom po rjes su 'byung ba'i lung / /nyi khri rnam 'byed bam po'i nang du lagasungs/ /nga ni mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /nga dang 'dra ba'i skyes bu ༷mchog gis ni/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mchog rnams 'grel par byed/ /kun dga' bos ni dgra bcom thob pa'i dus/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa kure rnams sdud par byed/ /bde bar gshegs pa skal ldan rin po che/ /ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /rde'u dang ni shing bu dang / /rnga bo che dang pad+mo las/ /de dag sgra byung bka' yin te/ /rgyal bas byen gyis brlabs pa'i phyir/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa'i dus/ /dgra bcom lnga brgya bzhugs na yang /kun dgas dgra bcom ma thob par/ /sdud po gzhan la gtad pa min/ /rgyal ba bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i dus su ni/ /lnga brgyas dgra bcom thob nas bzhugs na bab nga / /gcig ma gtogs ni kun dga' bo zhes gsungs/ /kun dga' bos ni mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /rjes la dgra bcom 'bras bu thob nas su/ /bde gshegs bka' yi sdud pa mdzad pa ni /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rnams rjes su dran pa yis/ /lus kyi ba spu rnams ni g.yo byed cing / /sangs rgyas gsung rnams rjes su dran don yod/ /zhus dang sdud pa ji ltar byon pa'i lezhu ste drug pa'o// /rdo111

bod khams chos rgyam ji ltar byon tshul/pod khaskas chos rgyal ji ltar byon pa ni/ /glo bur rgyal po'i lo rgyus mtshon pa las/ /gdung brgyud glo bur gnyis kyi bar snyabs sru/ /phyogs bsger bskos pa'i rgyal po/sde bzhi byung / /shar phyogs rgya nag gtsug lag rgyal po0ni//mar gzhong gab tses bskos shing legs nyes gcod/ /lho phyogs rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po ni/ /bdud rtsi'i bum pa glang po'i sna la btags/ /de yis dbang bskur ma rig mun pa sel/ /nub phyogs ta zig nor gyi rgyal po ni/ /gzings bcas rgya mtshor phyin nas rin cen lon/ /gser gzhong gser gyis bkang nas dpul ba seg/ /byang phyogs ge sar dmag gi rgyal po ni/ /phyogs bzhir 'ben btsugs dpags chen mdang 'phangs nas/ /dus gcig gang byun de ni rgyal por bskos/ /dgags chen mda' yis pha rol dgra rnams 'joms/ /gtsug lag rgyal bo/gdug pa sbrul ltar 'khril/ /chos kyi rgyal po khye la spyang ltar 'jab/ /nor gyi rgyal po bye'u la khra ltare 'jum/ /hor gye rgyal po shing la star ltar 'tshab/ /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po phyogs nas dar ba'i tshe/ /de dushe bod khams mi la rje rmad pas/ /ri bran brag mkhar kun la jong yang bcas/ /gos dang kha zas btsan mkhar nor bu bcug /rgol du mi thub dmag grangs nyung ba'i dus /rang la dbang med tshogs rgyab srab pa'i dus/ /bod yul gangs ri rtse dgu'i ljongs 'di ru/ 1spur rgyal gong du mnga' mdzad drug tu byung / /dang po gnod sbyin nag pos dbang byas ste/ /yul ming bdud yul kha rag mgo dgur btags/ /snga rtags gnyen po btsan pa de nas byung / 1de nas bdud dang srin mos dbang byas te/ /ming yang lha srin gnyis kyi yul du btags/ /snga 113

rtags sha za gdong pa dmar ba byung / /de nas glu dang btsan gyis dbang byas late/ /yul gyi ming la bod khams gling dgu ra btags/ /snga rtags dkar bu chu snyel spyod pa byung / /de nas ma sangs spun dgus dbang byas te/ /yul ming bod khams g.ya' drug bya bar btags/ /snga rtags mda' mdung mtshon cha de nas —byung / /de nas za rams skyes drug dbang byas te/ /yul ming stong sde bco brgyad bya bar btags/ /snga rtags rta zhon rna cha 'dogs pa byung / /de nas rgyal gron bcu gnyis dbang byas te/ 1yul gyi ming ni swa kha brgyad du btags/ snga rtags phyag dang zhe sa de nas byung / /gzhug tu spur rgyal btsan pos dbang byas te/ /ming yang bod khams ru bzhi bya bar btags/ /bod kyi btsan po ༷'o de spur rgyal de/ /gnam gyi lha las mi yi rje ru gshegs/ /tshangs pa phyag nas gnam lha than dgur brgyud/ /gname than sprin than char than than dgur byon/ /rtags chags wal wal sras po mched bzhi la/ /rje gcig mab la cibardal drug bya ba byon/ /de la sras mtshog spun bdun 'khrungs pa las/ bar ༷lha tshigs bdun yab yum mched la gnod/ /yab yum skor bon shang po'i mub du sprugs/ /dmu bza' lde me btsun dang bshos pa'i sras/ /gnya' khri yan 'khrungs srid pa'i lha/rabs yin/ /rje gcig gnya' khri btsan/po bya ba di/ /)mgo nag mi dang srog chags rkyen du byon/ /dogs la bzhugs nas rgyal brgyud sras bltams pa/ /gnam la khri bdun sa la legs drug dang 1 /sil ma bdun dang tshigs la btsan lnga'o/ 1bod kyi chos spyong rgyal po rim pa bdun/ /gnam sal khri bdun ji ltar yin pa ni/ /gnya' khri'i sras ni mu khri gtsan po yin/ sa de yi sras ni ding khre btsan po yin/ /de yi sras ni so khri btsarge po yin1 /de ༷yi phras ni mer khri btsan po yin/ /de yi sras ni gdags khri btsan po yin/ / /de yi sras ni spyi khri btsan po yin/ /de ltar gnam la khri bdun mtshan du 113

gsol/ /sa la legs drug rgyal po'i rgyal brgyud la/ /rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i sras gsum ni/ /bya khri sha khri nya khri rnam pa gsum/ /rgyal po bya khri kong po'i yul du gshegs/ /rgyal po nya khri nyang po'i yul du gshegs/ /rgyal po sha khri sgo bo'i yul du gshegs/ /yab gcig gshegs nas rgyal sras spyan drangs pa/snye spo bo'i yul nas spu de gung rgyal byon/ /spu de gung rgyal sras ni ye sho legs yin/ /de yi sras ni le sho legs zhes bya/ /de yi spas be+e 'brong bzhi legaca zhes bya/ /de yi sras ni thi sho legs zhes bya/ /de yi sras ni gu rum legs zhes bya/ /de yi sras ni za nam legs zhes bya/ /de rnams sa yi legs drug bya ba yin/ /rgyal po za nam legs kyi sras la ni/ /rgyal po sde ru gnam gzhung btsan du grags/ /de yi sras ni sde sgod sbas zhes bya/ /de yi sras ni sde sgod ya zhes grags/ /de yi sras ni sor no nam zhes grags/ /de yi sras ni rgyal po so ste lags/ /de yi sras ni sprin rgyal btsan zhes bya/ /de yi sras ni stong ri stong btsan yin/ /de dag rnams ni rgyal rabs sil ma bdun/ /stong ri stong btsan sras ni khri nam btsan/ /de yi sras ni khri sgra dpung btsan yin/ /de gi sras ni khri thog rje btsan yin/ /de yi sras ni tho tho gnyan btsan yin/ /de yi sras ni khri gnyan gzungs btson yin/ /de rnams mtshan gsol tshigs la btsan lnga yin/ /de yi gras ni 'brong gnyan sde ru yin/ /de yi sras ni stag ri gnyan gzigs yin/ /de yi sras ni gnam ri srong btsan yin/ /gnam ri srong btsan sras ni spong btsan sgam/ /de yi sras ni mang srong mang btsan yin/ /de yi sras ni gung srong gung btsan yin/ /de'i sras rlung nam 'byel gyi rgyal po la/ /de'i sras khri sde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom/ /de'i sras chos skyong rgyal por mnga' gsol ba/ khri spong sdenyu btsan lha yi me tog yin/ /de gi rgyal brgyud sras gsum sku 'khrungs pa/ /mu ni btsan po mu rum btsan po dang / 1114

chos rgyal masngeng yon sad na legs dang gsum/ /mu rum btsan po mdo khams byang du gshegs/ /mu ni btsan po zas kyi rgeng du gshegs/ /tha chung mjing yon mu tig btsan po la/ /rgyas par bshad na legs pa lnga dang ldan/ /thugs sgam bka' btsan khong pa yangs pa dang / /zungs thub dpyad pas thugs stobs rab tu che/ /rgyal sras mjing yon legs pa'i blo gros kyi/ /che ba'i wan rtan lo rgyus 'og tu ston/ /dam pa'i chos dang g.yung drung bon byung dus/ /rje gcig gnya' khri btsan po'i sku ring la/ /lha yi tshos lugs sgrung dang sde'u byung //rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i sku ring la/ /ta zig 'a zha'i bon po gdan drangs nas/ /rdo nag thom do lhu dang sdum du sbrel/ /shi lngags skya mo'i bla gzhi 'breng du 'dra/ /gson gyi lha mchod gshin gyi 'dre 'dul byung 1 /btsan po spu de gung rgyal sku ring la/ /yab sras gong mdzad lha bu smon gsum du/ /thabs kyi zhang blon dag kyang de nas byung / /rgyal po stong ri stong btsan sku ring la/ /rme gza' klu gza' gnyis kyang de nas blangs/ /'bangs dang sku yang de nas gnyen du gyur/ /dmu thag chad nas bang so sa la btab/ /yar 'khums dmu thag lha zam gshegs bzhud mdzad/ /tho ri snyan shal rgyal po'i kyi ring la1 /dam pa chos kyi dbu tsam brnyes gyur te/ /gser gyi spang skong rgya gar yi ge gcig / mkha' la byon nas rang gi thog tu babs/ /dar gyis dril nas che zhing gnyan par bzung / /mtshan ni gnyan po gsang bar gsol nas kyang / /mos shing gus pas gser skyems g.yu sngon mchod1 /sku tshe reme zhing ma nga' thang de nasagaskyes/ /stag ri gnyan gzigs dmus long skyes po pa nga / /gnyan po gsang ba mchod cing bkur ba yis/ /spyan bye mnga' thang longs spyod de nas 'phel/ /laganam ri srong btsan rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /dmag dang 'khrug pa g.yo ba'i 'dun ma byas/ /bar du bskal pa 'khon byung sde ris la/ /mtha' rgya bcad 1/5

/nas rgya dang gru gu btul/ /phung g.yag btul nas lan tshwa rnyed pa yigo/ /chos rgyal grong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/ /dam pa chos kyi bka' sgol phye nas ni/ /sgu mi bkod pa sprul pa lnga stong sprul/ /zas rigs mi gcig sum brgya'i spyan ༷gzigs rol/ /nor rigs mi gcig rin cen sna tshogs spungs/ /rgya gar yul kyi gtsug lag khang chen ni/ /ku ma la yi gtsug lag dper blangs nas/ /lha sa 'phrul snang ra mo che la sogs/ /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag bzhi bcu bzhengs/ /lo tsā spu mi sasto ṭa yis ni/ /rgya gar lo paṇa yig mkhan gdan drangs nas/ /nā ga ra yig rdzad la bzapas mar bsgyur/ /wa rtul yig bod la ༷shur mar bsgyur/ /cid+dhā ma ṇi dam pa tog dkar mdo/ /ngan song spyong ba rdo je nom 'joms dang / /dge ba bcu dang pad+ma dkar po dang / /dkon rtsog sgon dang 'dus pa tog la sogs/ /dam chos mtha' rgyas lha tshos mod du ༷baspyur/ /dge ba bcu dang sbyar te thang khrims bcas/ /bod khams btsan zhing sems can bde la bkod/ /rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /lodagrin ༷mngar bsdus gyad / mi bdun byung /lag rjes lag rtags phyogs kyi dmag gis phul/ /mchod rten bzhengs dang tsha tsha gdab pa dang / /bka' la smog 'ardon khrims kyi spyi tshogs byas/ /nang gi sa tshigs bde ba'i mu rnams bskyangs//sayachod gnas rgang du sri zhus bsten dab mchod/ /mi dge'i las spangs dge ༷ba'i 'phro shems mdzad/ /rgyal po ag tshom me yi sku ring la/ /bsam yas ka mchu paṇa chen gtsug mag khang / /mchims phu nam ra'i gtsug lag bsil khang dang / /brag dmar 'gram bzang lha shug gtsug lag khang / /brag dmar 'ol bu'i tshal chen gtsug lag bzhengs/ /pho brang bzhengs skor gtsug lag longs spyod khang / /ri thang mtshams su mchod rten bcu gsum bzhengs/ /da ma pa'i tshos la 7ོsa shing 'dun mar mdzad/ /mnga' bdwag khri ldong sde'u btsan lda ring 116

la/ /dam pa'i chos rnams dar zhing gyes par mdzad1 /nā ledri yi gtsug lame/ dper blangs nas/ /rgyal po'i thugs dmu dpal gyi bsam gas bzhengs/ rgya gar mkhas pa mang po spyan drangs nas/ /mtshan nyid bka' dang gsang sngags bye nang bsgyur/ /sad mi ske bdun rab tu phyung nas ni/ /zhabs 'og rde'u bton dbu yi mtshod gnas mdzad/ /ma nga pon mu tig btsan po'i sku ripa la 1dmal gye bsam yas shar sgo'i mtshams su ni/ /dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu pazhengs su gathol/ /skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ /mab mes gtsug lag lha khang kun rnams lamatshod/ bka' khrims thang khrims sngar bas babrang bar bskyangs/ chos skyong rgyal po'i rnam thar rtags bzung na / /gsang sngags 'bra3 bu'i tshos rnams nyams byu blangapa/ /spri bor slob dpon rapa lus yi dam lha/ /ngag tu gsapa sngags rdo rje'i bzlas pa mdzad/ /dam tshos bstan pa khri gdugs brdal ba 'dra/ /bshad grwa sgom grwa'i bstan ba btsugs nas ni/ /rdo rje slob dpogo pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /lo tsā be ro tsa na la sogs kyis/ /gsang sngags theg chen 'bras bu dar bar mdzad/ /slob dpon mtshan gsol mya tig btsan po zhes/ /yab kyis mtshan gsol khri lde srong btsan zhes/ /nang blon mtshan gsol mjing yon sad na legs/ /rgya yis mtshan gsol mu ri btsan po zhes/ /'dzam gling thum gnyis dbang du bsdus nas ni/ khu yi gdong can 'dzam gling shar phyogs kyi/ /shud bu'i yul khams mngar bsdus bran du bkol/ /sto phyogs bod rkang grul bum che spo nga yul/ /kun kyang mngar bsdus bran dang g.yog tu bkol/ /nub phyogs gtsang mi byi la'i mjug ma can/ /sngal gnon yul khams mngar bsdus bran du bkol/ /rgyang phyogs sna nam ri bong rna ba cadi/ /bran du byas te mngar bsdus las la bkol/ rgyal po'i mapa' thang dag ni dgung bas mtho/ /'bangs kyi chaba'isrid chu bo'i gzhung 111

sdubs ring / /dang po chab srid bzhes ma khad du ni/ /mtha' bzhi phyogs brgyad —bka' btsan chab srid la/ /phyogs bzhir rgyal po sdi bzhi gnas pa yang / /bar du bka' 'khon byung nas dgra ru bdo/ /srin po gdong dmar bod kyi ༷namag dpung g.yos/ /chab srid bod dmag khri tsho brgya chas te/ /dmag dpon ༷rgyal po 'dul ba'i dus su ni/ /sngon gyi bshul sel gyad mi rta zhon brgya/ /g.yas kyi ru 'dren dpa' bo stag chas brgya/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren sngags mkhan sa ra thogs brgya/ /slad kyi rjes spul zhub chen ca/dung thogs brgya/ /rgya yul ༷gshog pa'i phyogs su dmag gis phul/ /gyad kyi dpa' bo dmag gi sna la bskos/ /pha rol dpung 'joms mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor/ /chab srid mnga' thang do zla mid par byas/ /sto phyogs rgya gar rgyal po bzhugs pa yang / /rā dza rterma dpal dang dras dpung gnyis/ /dmag sgo gcod par bka' yis sa bskugs nas/ /rgya gar rgyal srid bod kyi bran du byas/ /rgya gar yul gyi nor sardzas rin po che/ kha zas bzang dgu dus las ma 'das phul/ /rgya gar stod smad rgyal po chen po gnyis/ /rang la mnyan zhing bka' la gces spras byed1 /nub phyogs ta zig rgyal po bzhugs pa yang / /rgyal po la mer mu dang hab bgadal gyis/ /pod kyi bka' la gces par bzung nas ni/ /rin cen nor dang /sman gyi lnga dos dang / kha zas gces pa dus las ma yol phul /bod kyi mnga' 'og chab srid dam par mdzad/ /rang gi bka' bstsal gang yin gus pas nyan//bung phyogs ge sar gru gu bzhugs pa yang / /bar du bka' 'khon byung nas bdo ba la/ /srin po gdong dmar bod kyi dmag g.yos nas/ /gru ku yul gye yong du man chod du/ /bod kyi dmag daphung sbra nag phab nas ni/ /yul brlag mi rnams mon gyi sa la bskyal khyim grokhar mon gyi sa la btod nas kyang / / yul du mi ran bsten pa sun phyung ste/ /sru bkong ded dpon yul/mkhar 'tsho 1/8

bar bzhag /gru gu ge sar bod kyi bran du byas/ /bod kyi dmag dbung li yi yul du phab/ /li yul ñcang ra spyag po bran du spyad1 /bod dmag shar cugs rgya nag yul du phab/ /rgya nag be chu'i rgyal po chen po yis/ /rang gi chab srid ༷mnga' thang bod la phul/ /dar zab lnga dos rin cen mang po dang / kha gis gces pa dus las ma 'das phul/ /'dzam gling sum gnyis chab srid mnga' ru bsdus/ /bsam yas mthil du bstan pa'i gzhi ma btsugs/ /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lngas grub ga thob/ /che la mnga' brtes rig 'dzin sa la gnas/ /bla mchod b.rab byung zhabs 'og rde'u bton/ /mchims phu yer par sgom grwa'i bstan pa btsugs/ /bsam yas lha sar bshad grwa'i bstan pa btsugs/ /bla na rje sgom 'og na 'bangs 'phrul te/ /spri mthun bsod nams sumashecu rtsa rgesum gyi/ /dbange po brgya byin lha yi longs spyod 'dra/ /rgyal po'i mnga' thang khri gdugs shar bo 'dra/ /'bangs kyi chab srid lo tog rgyas pa 'dra/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad bde legs chos la btsud/ /thang khrims rnam lnga nang gi bca' khrims bcas/ /zhal lce rnam lngas legs nyes 'dun stangs dbye/ /dbus kyi mnga' ris gsum nas bsings khu 'dren/ / mtha' yi mi sde bzhi yis dkor nor 'bul/ /mtshams kyi swa kha dag nas dpya yang sdud/ /dpa' rgod rdem lngas mtha2 yi su kha bsrung / /dpa' 'dus stag sdes mde' rgya dmag gis 'dul/ /lha chos mi chos gnyis ka dar zhing rgyas/ /bod khams ma lus bde skyid longs spyod ldan/ /bod du chos rgyal ji ltar byon pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// // lo parte byes /bu ji ltar byon tshum/ ༷༷lo pashe skyes bu ji ltar byon pa ni/ /'phags pa'i rgyal po spyan ras 11gyi

gzigs dbang gi /sku yi sprul pa rgyal po'i rtags 'dzin pa/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/ /lo tsā thu mi sasto ṭa zhes byon/ /chos bsgyur pir thogs yi ge de nas byung / /dam chos spyod pa'i mnga' srol dkyus la phab/ /chos rgyal 'jam dbyangs rgyal po'i sku'i sprul pa1 /chos rgyal khri srong sde'u btsan sku ring la/ /lo tsā pa gor be+e ro tsa na byon/ /gye gar theg chen dam chos bod du bsgyur/ /za hor yul na mkhas par grags pa yi/ /bo dhi satā bod du gdan drangs nas/ /lo tsā mkhas pa ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis/ /mkhan po bo dhi sa tā'i gsung bgros bsgyur/ /rgya nag yul na mkhas par grags pa yi/ /hā shang ma hā ya na gdan drangs nas/ /gye nag sman dang 'byung ba'i rtsis la sogs/ /lo tsā sna nam sa la btsun gyis bsgyur/ /u rgyan yul du mkhas par grags pa yi/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du gdan drangs nas/ /gsang sngags zab mo bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos/ /man ngag zab mo dpag med gsungs pa rnams/ /lo tsā chen po be+e ro tsa na dang / /po tsā chen po ldan ma rtse mang gis/ /sgru sgyure rgya gar gling du bsgyur ming bkod/ /rgya gar yul na che zhing mkhas pa yi/ /paṇa rjen bi shā mi tra gdan drangs nas/ /lo tsā cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan dang / /skad sna bdun la mkhas par sbyangs pa ni/ /gnubs kyi lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ /rgya gar mkhas pa'i dam chos bod du bsgyur/ /gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma'i zhal snga nas/ /lo tsā gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po dang / /lo tsā ye shes spro na ku mā ra/ /lo tsā rin cen mchog la sogs pa yis/ /gsang sngags don dam 'bras bu'i dam chos bsgyur/ /lo paṇa skyes bu ji ltar byon pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //120

bod du dam tshos ji ltar dar tshulo/bod du dam chos ji ltar dar ba ni/ /chos rgyal khri srong sde'u btsan sku —ring la/ /bsam yas brtsig pa'i sa gzhi 'dul ba la/ /za hor yul na mkhas par grags pa yi/ /slob dgon/bo dhi sa/1gdan drangs nas/ /sa gzhi btul /bas 'thul bar ma rgyur nas/ /padru 'byung gnas gdan 'dren lung yad chabastan/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du byon nas ni/ /lha srin sde brgyad mngar bsdus bran du bkol/ /brag dmar bsam yas rgyal po'i thugs dam bzhengs/ /dam ba'i chos rnams dar bar mdzad pa la/ /thog mar mkhan po bo dhi satwa yis/ /zhabs 'og rde'u bton nas dbu skra bcad/ /mtshan nyid sde dang kro yog sde gsum gsungs/ /dam chos bshad grwa'i sde tshan btsugs nas ni1 /theg pa spyi yi bstan pa dar bar byas/ /de nas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas sakyis/ /bsam yas dbu rtse'i rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus/ /theg chen nang gi dam chos bshad pa la/ /gsang sngags snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /thugs kyi sras dang rje 'bangs rgya mtsho la/ /sgrub ba bka' brgyad dkyi' 'khor zhal phye nas/ /gsang sngags spyi blugs chen po'i dbang skur tshe/ /thugs kyi sras brgyad tho rengs lung bston mdzad/ /lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer bdun lha phran dbacas/ /mi long gzugs garnyan bzhin du zhal bstan nas/ 1me tog gang babs lha rgyud sgrub thabs gsubs/ bod kyi gnubs ben nam mkha'i snying po la/ /yang dge thugs kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs gsungs/ /gnubs kyi ban+de /sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /'jam dpal sku yi rgyud dang sgrub thabs gsungs/ //pan mam btsun pa rgyal ba mchog/dbyungs la 1pad+ma gsung gi rgyud dang sgrub 121

thabam gsungs/ /lā se'i sprul pa jo mo 'tsho rtal la/ /phur ba 'phrin las rgyun dang skrub/thabs gsungs/ /ban+de 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes la/ /ma mo thod gtong rgyud dang sgrub thabs gsungs/ /glang chen dpal gyi seng ge phyi ma la/ /'jeg rten mchod bstod rgyud dang sgrub thabs gsungs/ /lo tsā pa gor be+e ro tsa na la/ /dmod pa drag sngags rgyud dang skrub thabs gsungs/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong sde'u bcon la/ /che mchog yon tan rgyud dang sgrub thabs gsungs/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus rgyud sde lnga dang ni/ /bye brag rgyud sde chen po bcur gathungs shing / /chos tshan brgya dang sum cu rtsa brgyad gsungs/ /gsang sngags chos sgo dbang la thug pa la/ /dbang gi chu bo rgyun chad med pa dgos/ /dbang gi chu bo chen po babs tshul ni/ /de la dang po 'og min chos dbyings su/ /steng tsogs dag pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas khang / /gsang ba mtshag gi dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /bcom ldan dpal chen kun tu bzang po dang / /dus gsum yum chen kun tu bzang mo yis/ /rigs lnga rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /spyi blugs rgyal thabs chen mo'i dbang bskur ste/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru byin gyes brlabs/ /rigs lnga'i gartsa bo rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas chen po yi/ /dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du /dam pa tog dkar lha la dbang bskur nas/ /thub pa chen po drug tu byin gyitsā brlabs/ /'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal smin par byas/ /dam chos theg pa phyi nang bka' bstsal to/ /mkhyen rab bdag po 'jam dpal non po dang / /sgrub pabi rig 'dzin rdo rje chos kyis bsdus/ /bka' bstsal dbang bskur gnyer du gtad pa'i dus/ rdogasang sngags thams cad gser gyi glegs bam la/ /be+e ḍūr zhun mas yi ge'i ris su bris/ /dar zab rin cen gser gyis gril nas panyugs/ /de yang dbang gi chu bo bzhi ru babs/ /de/la rgya gar dbang gi 122

chu bo ni/ /yi dam lha yi dbang bskur thob pa dang / /bka' rtags po ti'i dbang bskur the padapa dang / /rang rig rtsal chen dbang bskur thob pa dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbang bskur thob dang bzhi/ /rgya gar yul gye dbang gi chu bo yin/ /bka' brgyud po ti'i dbang bskur thob pa ni/ /rgyal po dza zhes en+d+ra bye ti yin/ /ma la ya na dgongs pa mdzad pa'i dus/ /'jam dpal non po rdo rje chos dang ni/ /grub thob rig 'dzin chen po rnams kyis su/ /rgyal po chos la las 'phro sad par gzigs1 /glegs bam rgyud sde rgyal po'i khang thog tu/ /mkha' las rang babs tshul du gdan yang drangs/ /nub mo rgyal po mnal ba'i rmi lam du/ /glegs bam be ḍūr zhun ma'i po ti ni/ /pho brang thog tu char ltar babs pa rmis/ /nang par gzigs pas de bzhin kho nar gda'/ /zhal bye gzigs pas shes par ma gyur nas/ /ku ku rā dza zhes bya'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /mkhyen pa can gyi spyan sngar bstan gyur kyang / /brda yang ma 'phrod shes par ma gyur te/ /ku ku rā dzas slar yang tshur brdzangs nas/ /bdag gis bltas kyang shis par ma gyur pas/ /rgyal po nyid rang las dang skal par ldan/ /dgongs pa dpag par zhu zhes spyan sngar brdzangs/ /de nas rgyal po e n+d+ra bhū ti yis/ /kaser gyi glegs bam spyi bor bzhugs nas ni/ /gdung ba babyed nas zhag bdun ba spu zengs/ /mchi ma blags te mnyam gzhag dgongs pa mdzad/ /zhag bdun nang par glegs bam zhal bye bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong le'u mkhyen/ /slar yang nyi ma nyer gcig mnyam gzhag pas/ /rgyud sde bco brgyad don rnams khong du chud/ /gsang sngags don la mkhas par grur pa yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i don gyi dbang rnams thob/ /rgyal po tshom bu lnga yi 'khor dang bcas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i lus su gyur nas ni/ kun gyis mthong bar mngon sum sangase rgyas po/ /idri bhū tis u pa rā dza la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang 123

sa rnams rdzogs par bskur/ /u pa rā dzas u rgyan ko sha ru/ /u rgyan thor cog can la dbang yang bskur/ /de yis sing ga'i yul gyi rgya mtshozhi 'gram/ /sing ga'i rgyal po sing ga rā dza la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams sgogs par bskur/ /za hor rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams mardzogs par bskur/ kha che'i mkhas pa ma hā rā dza la/ /phyo nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur/ /rgya gar yul gyi gser brag bya khyung du/ /slob dpon chen/po kakakakakakakakakaka/ /phyikakakakakakakakakakakakakakakakakakakardzokakakapar bskur/ /de rnams thams cad tshom bu lnga brgyar bcas/ /mngon sum rdo rje'i lus su sangs rgyas so/ kha che'i mkhas pa ma hā rā dza yis/ /rgya gar yul gyi shrī nā len+d+rar/ /paṇa chen mkhas pa be+e mā mi tra la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur/ /yi dam lha yi dbang bskur thob pa ni/ /slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje yin/ /de yi 'khrungs tshul mdo tsam bstan pa ni/ /rgya gar rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti la/ /sras mo lha lcam g.yung drung skyid ces yod/ /de la mig sngar mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ /gser gyi rma byas skad snyan lan gsum bsgugs/ kha nas shel gyi khu 'phang rdog po gamum/ /'gril nas bu mo'i thugs kar thim pa las/ /zla dgu ngo dang bcu na sras shig bltams/ /ba spu'i khung nas nang par nyi zer la/ /bde gshegs mang po phyi ru gshegs pa dang / /dgongs mo ba spu'i khung du bzhud pa mthong / /lha srin mang pos phyag dang bskor ba byed/ /mdun gyi mkha' las bde gshegs gsung rnams byon/nga/sems can don la kun gyis lung yang bstan/ /lha lcam nyid la dge ba'i bsam pa byung / /sras la dga' rab rdo rjer mtshan yang btags/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ /gsang sngags bdag nyid rdo — rje sems dpa' byon/ /khrong chen bam po nyi khri phyag tu gtad/ /dzogs chen 12

sems mdo bco brgyad gtad nas ne+e/ /sems nyid ma pacos ye sangs rgyas par bshad/ /skye 'chi med pa'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur/ /paṇ+ḍita yi dbang bskur thob pa ni/ /slob dpon chen po bi mā mi tu yin/ /de yi 'khrungs tshul mdo tsam bstan pa ni/ /rgya gar rgyal po dharma rā dza yi/ /sras mo lha lcam rin cen gsal zhes la/ /rmi lam bya khru g.yu yi gshog pa can/ /lus las 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba yis/ /dngul bum bdud rtsis bkang ba spyi bor bzhag bdud rtsi blud pas bde bas gang ba rmis/ /zla ba bcu nas khyethu btsas pa na/ /bdag nyid skyes pa spangs pa'i bud med la/ /pha med bu ni shin tu gnong bar 'dug g.yog mo bu 'di bas mthar bor la shog /g.yog mos bye ma'i khung du bor ba las/ /mig 'bur bkra ba hrig hrig 'dug nas ni/ /rmi lam ltar byas sprul skur srid snyam nas/ /slar blangs gsos pas sprul pa'i sku ru byon/ /lnga brgya'i nang nas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ /bod kyi rgyal po khri sgopa sde'u btsan gyis/ /rgya gar chos skyong rterma rā dza'i drung/ /yar glungs gnyags ban dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ /lo tsā cog ro glu yi rgyal mtshan dang / /atsar+yā rin cen mchog ste mi gsum la/ /gser phye gla ba'i rled bu gang brdzangs nas/ /dngul la gser gyis bris pa'i sde ge la/ /chos skyong rgyal po chen po khyod la ni/ /sku yi bla mchod mkhas pa pani ta/ /rig gnas mthar phyin sgrub par mnga' brnyes pa/ /mchog tu gyur pa lnga brgya bzhugs skad pas/ /bdag la skyes lan mkhas pa pani ta/ /lnga brgya'i nang nas kun gyis bkur ba cig /bdag gi drung du bod du rdzong par zhu/ /lo tsā gsum gyi rge gar yul du phyin/ /rgyal po'i spyan sngar dngul gye bka' shog gtad/ /gser phye phul nas sngar gyi zhu ba byas/ /de nas nang mo tsha ba'i gral du ni/ /rgyal pos byon na—sa bla mchod lnga brgya la/ /dbus su gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas ni/ /bdag la bod kyi rgyal po 12du

sachen po yis/ /gser bye bla ba'i rlid bu gang phul nas/ /gser gyi skyes lan mkhas pa parnyi ta/ /bod du rgyal po'i spyon spur sgongs shig gsungs/ khye+od rnams nang nas che zhing mkhas pa cig /pod kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar gshegs par zhu/ /de snyad rgol pos bka' gsal gsungs pa dang / 1dbus na pi mā mi tra bzhugs pa la/ /yar gyi gral rim mar gyi gral rim rnams/ /dbus kyi paṇa chen bi mā mi tra la/ /zhal nas mi gsung spyan ni rub kyis gzegs/ /don la song zhig brda yis bskul ba las/ /zi mā mi dus brda thim lan gsum gsungs/ /gdan 'dren gsum gyes brda yi skad cig la/ /go lugs ma gcig brda skad gsum du go /gru bo dag la brten pa'i mi/ /skyes bus skya bas rtsol phod na/ /grus kyang pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ /gcig gis de ltar go ba'i dus/ /gcig gis go lugs 'di lta ste/ /gzhu mo dag la brten pa'i mda'/ /skyes bus mtheb mdzub rtsol phod na/ /mnas kyang 'ben ngor phyin par 'gyur/ /gcig gis 'di ltar go ba la/ /rig pa dag la brten pa'i mi /skyes bus 'du shes bskyod phod na/ /lus kyi bum pa gang 'gril ba/ /sems kyi chu bo de ru 'bo/ /bod du 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ /gdan 'dren gsum gyes gdan drongs te/ /bsam yas mthil du phyag phebs nas/ /rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /'dod yon lnga yis mnyes par mdzad/ /dge ba'i bshes gaston pan+ḍi ta/ /lnga brgyas dbang bskur thob pa'o/ /rang rig rtsal gyi dbang bskur thob pa ni/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas rte/ /sto rdub u rgyan rgya mtsho gser gyi gling / /rin cen chu gling pad+ma'i sdong po la/ /mngal gyis ma gos pad+ma'i skyes bu 'khrungs/ /thog mar bskal pa bzang po'i rgyal srid bzung //bar du thos bsam slob dpon mang po bsten/ /mtha' mar yo ga tshe yi rig /'dzin brnyes/ 1skye 'chi'i rgyun chad rdo rje'i sku ru gyur/ /phyi nang snang srid 126

rang byung rig par shar/ /sgod bcud 'khori 'das rang rig byang chub sems/ ṣesems kyi rtsal chen rang dbang rang gis thob/ khams gsum yongs bsgul dug gasrum rtsad nas bcad/ /rigs gsum gtan dkrugs rang rig rtsal chenake jogs/ /mthu rtsal nus pa nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra/ /bsam yas mthil du rgyal pos gdan drangs nas/ /lha srin gdug pa rdul du brlags nas ni/ /lhol po'i thugs dam dbal gyi bsam yas bzhengs/ /thugar kyi sras brgyad rje 'bangs rgya mtsho la/ /rang rig gsal ba'i me long bstan nas ni/ /rig pa rang shar dgongs pa gtan la phab/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i dam chos car ltar phab/ /bod la bka' drin che bar mdzad pa yin/ /pod du dbang gi chu bo pyon tshul ni/ /dga' rab rdo rjes lha yi dbang thob nas/ /des ni shrī sing ha la dbang bskur1 /de yis mkhas pa bo ro tsa na la/ /shrī nā ledri yi gtsug lag tu/ /dbang bskur byang sems rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ /rang bzhin rnam dag ltun gyes grub pa yi/ /gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen podi dbang bskur ro/ /be+e ro tsardonas khri srong sde'u btsan la/ /rang sems skye med chos skur ngo sprad nas/ /sems la jogs pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro/ /bod kyi blon po gdug pa 6na rnams kyis/ /shi ro tsa na tsha ba ngong du sprugs/ /be+e ro tsā nas g.yu sgra snyeng po la/ /dbang bskur dam chos rdzogs chen ma lus gagungs/ /rgyal po'i spyan sngar g.yu sgra snying pos byon/ /rgyal bo/chen po khri srong ldeju btsan dang / /lo tsā dz+nyā na ku wā ra gnyis la/ ) /brag dmar g.yang ma lung ge naben gnas su/ /dzogs chen nam mkha' thugs kyi nyi ma dang / /sangs rgyas thugs dgongs dga' ba'i ye shes su/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag ba'i dbang bskur nas/ /mi nub r+yol mtshan chen por mnga' gsol ste/ /dam pa'i tshos rnams dar zhing rgyas mar mdzad1 /dbang gi chu bo chen po gcig yin no/ /po ti glegs bam dpang412

bskur thob pa ni/ /rgyal po dza zhes in+d+ra bhū ti yin/ /u rgyan yul gyi pho brang mā la yar/ /u pa rā dza nyid la dbang yang bskur/ /de yis thor cog can la dbang bskur nas/ /de yis sing ga'i bharmā rā dza la/ /de yis za hor in+d+ra bhū ti la/ de yis kha che'i ma hā rā dza la/ /de yis slob dpon shā chen kā ra la/ /de la gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po yis/ /yang dag sgrub pa'i dbang /bskur nod pa'i che/ /dpal chen badz+ra he ru'i zhal mthong nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnyis ka thob/ /sgrags kyi yang sgong chen po'i dpen gnas su/ /chos kyi rgyal po khri srong ldethu btsan dang / /gnyags kyi ban+de dri med zla ༷shar la/ /ye shes pa dang 'jig rten pa la sogs/ /srog gi snying po 'phrog pa'i dbang bskur tshe/ /yi dam zhal mthong lha srin bran du 'khol/ /yang dag chadam chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ /bod du dbang gi chu bo gnyis pa'o/ /༷paṇ+ḍi ta yi dbang bskur thob pa ni/ /slob dpon chen po be mā mi tu yis/ /yar glungs shel rdzong pad+ma brtsegs pa ru/ /bdud rtsi mchog gi dkyil 'khor zhal ༷bye nas/ /rgyal po chen po khri srong lde'u btsan dang / /brdo dz+nyā na ku mu ra gnyis ༷la/ /bye nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rdzogs par bskur/ /gsang mtshan tshangs pa lha yi me tog dang / /sto na dri med zla shar rtsal du btags/ /bod du ༷dbang gi chu bo gsum pa'o/ /rang rig rtsal gyi dbang bskur thob pa ni/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /spa gro stag tshang seng ge'i bsam ༷grub tu/ /phur pa e khrum dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /rgyal po chen po khri srong sde'u btsan dang / /ku mā ra dang mkhar chen mtsho rgyal la/ /dregs pa tshar gcod phur ba'i dbang bskur nas/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dam tshos dar bar mdzad/ /bod du dbang gi chu bo bzhi pa'o/ /slar yang dbang gi chu bo 'dus dpa ni/ /rgyal bo mjing yon mu tig btsan po la/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 128

'byung gnas kyis/ /bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar dben gnas su/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /gsang ba mchog gi dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nus zhal bstan nas/ /bar gcod dam sri bdud tshogs rdul du brlags/ /bar chad lam 'joms gnad kyi 'phrang sel gnang / /dpang gi chu bo babs pa'i bka' gcig yin/ /zung mkhar rdo yi mchod rten dben nas su/ /slob dpon chen po bi mā mi tra yis/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rjogs par bkyir/ /rdzogs chen snying thig man shel ngo sprod gnang / /dbang gi chu bo gnyis pa thob pa yin/ /grub thob chen po nam mkha'i snying po yis/ /sto brag mkhar chu brag gi dben gnas su/ /yang dag sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /rje btsan rgyal po mu tig btsan po dang / /gnubs kyi brdo sangs rgyas ye shes la/ /bla na med pa'i dbang bskur gnang ba'i tshe/ khrug 'thung lha tshogs me long gzugs brnyan bstan/ /sems nyid dpal chen dgongs pa ngo sgod mdzad/ /dbang gi chu bo gsum pa babs pa yin/ /lo tsā chen po be+e ro tsa na yis/ 1bsam yas brag dmar chu rgyun ne'u gsing du/ /lha sras mu tig btsan po rje 'bangs la/ /khrong chen rab 'byams sgogs chen gsungs pa'i tshe/ /dri med ka dag chos dbang sems la bskur/ /sems kyi gnas lugs dgongs pa ngo sprod mdzad/ /dbang gi chu bo bzhi ru 'dus pa ni/ /rgyal po chen po mu tig btsan po yis/ /rgyal pos chos rnam gaster du sbas la'i dus/ /phyi rabs skasta ldan lung/gi dbang bskur ba/ /skal ldan las 'gro can dang 'phrad par shog dam chos bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog lung bstan dmod bor bka' yi gnang ba byin/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang gi chu bo ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bye ba bcu gcig gis/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams chen po ru/ /129

/rjerta dpag med kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ro/ /snang ba mtha' yas tshe dpag med pa yis/ /rigs drug sems can rnams kyi don nyid du/ /'phags 'i rgyal po spun ras gzigs su sprul1 /rigs drug smin par mdzad pa'i dbang bskur ro/ bde gshegamu rgyal ba snang ba mtha' yas kyis/ /'gro ba mi dang lha min 'dul ba la/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas skur sprul nas/ /pho brang ri bo ta la'i brag phug tu/ /sku dngos bstan nas bdud rtsi zhal du blud/ /skye 'chi/med pa'i dbang bskur rig 'dzin me+ob/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dngos su byon nas kyang / /bod yul kha ba can gyi sems can rnams/ /bde ba mchog la 'god pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bsam ༷yas mchims phu'i yang dben chen po ru/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po rje 'bangs kun rnams la/ /thugs rje chen 0po'i dbang bskur chen po mdzad/ khyad lar mnga' bdag mu tig btsan po dang / /zo mo/mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rnam gnyis la/ /thugs rje rig1pa rtsal gyi dbatsho/ bskur te/ /rang lus ri bo dben pa'i dgon pa ru/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dkyil 'khor du/ /rang rig byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'di/ /rgyu yis ma skyed rkyen gyes mi 'jig pa/ /rgyun chad med par rang la gnas pa 'di/ / rang byung rang gsal thog mtha' med par gsal/ /gzugs brnyan de la phal pa'i do ma yin/ sems nyid thugs rje chen por mthong ba 'di/ /dab da/bskur gdong g.yogs bgrol ba'i do ma yin/ /rig pa rang byung rang ngo shes pa 'de/ /rdo rje spyan 'byed byas pa'i do ma yin/ /sems nyid gsal dag nyams su myong ba 'di/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i do ma yin/ /rang sems mngon rdzoṭa lha ru shes pa 'di/ /rnam rtog lha gzugs mthong ba'i do ma yin/ /dug lnga /spang med ye shes bsgrub tu med/ /spong len bzang ngan blang dor med pa/'di/ /130

sarngosnang srid klong dag skye 'gag med pa ste/ / /do nyid shes na mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /rang rig gsal ba'i rtsal du ngo shes na/ /rang dbang rang thob rang ngo rang gis shes/ /sangs rgyas mi re'i rig pa rang nas sa rgyas/ /'khor bar mi/ dogs rnam rtog rang sar deg /de ltar rtogs shing khong du chud pas na/ /rig pa rtsal/gyi rang dbang rang gis thob/ /de skad gsungs pas lha sras jo mo gnyise/ /rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur thob gyur te1 /snang srid thams cad nam mkhar ngo shese nas/ /nam mkhe'i ngo bo rang rig ngo shes te/ /rang rig rtsal chene sematsā la dbang /sgyur ro/ /de ltar dbang gi chu bo chen po rnams/ /bod du dam chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ /dam chos ji ltar dar ba 'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// // /ཿ ༷ sngags 'chang/)skye ba thob ji ltar byon tshul/ sngages 'chang grub thob ji ltar byon pa ni/ /chos rgyal khri srob sde'u btsan sku ring la/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gdan drangs nas/ /bod kyi sa gzhi thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ /lha srin gdug pa'i srog snying sbogs nas ni/ thugs kyi sras brgyad rje 'bangs bcas pa la/ /dbang bskur lha tshogs dngos ༷sru zhal bstan nas/ 1lha khyed sgrub thabs man ngag so/sor gnang / /mchims phu la sogs dben gnas mang po ru/ /bo gsum bar du so sor sgrub pa sadzad/ /range rang grub rtags so sor thon pa'i dus/ /nam mkha 'i snying loganyi ༷ma'i zere la chibs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes brag le phur pa 'debs/ /rgyal ba /mchog dbyangs rta skad phyogs bcur khyab/ /mkhar che da mtsho rgyal bsad pa'i mi ro slong / /dpal gyi ye shes ma mo mngon/du/'khol/ /dpal gyi seng ge lha srin /3/

bran du 'khol/ /be+e ro tsa na ye shes spyan dang ldan/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po mi g.yo ting 'dzin grub/ /g.yu sgra snying po rtog pa mchog dang ldan/ 1dz+nyā na ku mār rdzu 'phrul mchog dang ldan/ /rdo rje bdud 'joms rlung ltar thogs pa med/ /ye shes dbyangs ni mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs/ /sog po lha dpal gcan gzan gnya' nas 'dzin/ /sna nam ye shes bya ltar mkha' la rdzing / / dpal gyi dbang phyug phur pa gdengs tshad 'gum/ /ldan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzungs rnams thob/ /ska ba dpal brtsegs gzhan gye sems kun shes/ /shud phu dpal seng chu bo gyen du zlog /rgyal ba'i blo gros ro langs gser du bsgyur/ khye'u chung lo yis nam mkha'i bya rnams zin/ /dran pa nam mkhas1byang nas g.yag rgod 'khugs/ /'o bran dbang phyug chu la nya ltar 'dzul/ /rma thog rin cen pha bong zas su za/ /dpal gyi rdo rje ri brag thogs pa med/ /lang 'gro dkon cog thog chen mda' ltar 'phen/ /rgyal ba bung chub mkha' la skyil krung bca' /de ster rje 'bangs grub thob de rnams ni/ /lte ba slong chen mangs pa kun gyis rtogs/ /sgom pa nyi ma sprin bral ngang nas ni/ /spyod pa grub rtags kun gyis so sor bstan/ /sngags 'chang grub thob ji ltar byon pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// /// rgyal po'i zugs dam ji ltar bzhengs tshul/rgyal po'i thugs dam ji ltar pazhengs pa ni/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan sku ring la/ /dpal gyi bsam mas bzhengs su gsol ba ni/ /mi 'gyur lhun grub legs pa'i gtsug lag khang / /gzhi che dpangs mtho rgyu bzang bkod pa legs/ /bku shis byin che gzhan na dpe zla med/ /dbu rtse rigs gsum /3shā

yang thog lcog bzhi dang / /gling bzhi gling phran yak+ka ltag 'og dang / /tshang ༷mang ke ru dag byed khrus khang dang / /mthu rtsal slong dang sgo bzhi mgon khang brgyad/ /mchod rten bzhi dang mchod rten 'od 'bar dang// /grangs su btab na sum cu bzhugs so skad/ /de la lcags ri chen po gcig gis bskor/ /gser gyi pa trar g.yu yi phra bkod 'dra/ /mi yis brtsig las lha 'dris brtsigs pa legs/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra rang bzhin skyes pa 'dra/ /gsang ༷sngags ltar na dkyil 'khor gcig gi tshul/ /sde sgod gsum las mngon pa mdzod kyi tshul/ /'dul ba dang bstun thog la rim pa gsum/ /mdo sde dang bstun rgyud ris mdo nas bris/ /sngags dang bstun nas dkyil 'khor thig tu btab/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi gzhal yas khang du bzhengs/ /'og khang bod ༷lugs bar khang rgya nag phibs/ /steng khang rgya gar phebs la stog dang ldan/ /dbu rtse rigs gsum sku gsung thugs kyi brda/ /'og khang sgo gsum rnam par mthar ba'i brda/ /steng khang sgo bzhi tshad med bzhi yi brda/ /bar khang sgo gcig thig le nyag gcig brda/ /'khor ba'i sgo gnyis thabs dang shes rab chabarda/ /dkor mdzod dgu ni theg pa rim dgu'i brda/ /gru skas drug ni pha rol /phyin drug la/ /steng du 'dzegs pas shes rab pha rol phyin1 /'og khang gtso bo rdo sku rang byon ni/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pas byen gyis brlabs// bsam yas has po ri nas gdan drangs nas/ /byang chub chen po gser gyi gyim bag g.yogs/ (bskal pa bzang po'i sems dpa' bcu yis bskor/ /mi g.yo ba dang rdo rje gtum po gnyis/ /lha yi grangs ni bcu gsum bzhugs tho skad/ /nang gi ste ba rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing / /zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i ris su bris/ /spyang ma mgon po khri ral can la gtad/ /lha khang dkon cog sprin ༷kyi rgyud ris bris/ /skor khang phyi bstar pad+ma dkar po dang / /skor khang nang /33

bsnar rin cen tog tu bris/ /bar khang gtso bo dus gsum sangs rgya sa la/ dbung chub sems dpa' chen po bcu yis bskor/ /king kang gnyi sa te lha tshogs bco lnga bzhugs/ /lte ba'i nang na 'bum gyi gleng gzhi bris/ /skor khang nang bstar mdo sde sprin/chen bris/ /sgobo khang phyi bstar mngon par 'byung ba bris/ / sgo bgram gnyis la rgyal po chen po bzhi/ /srung ma rgyal po shing bya can la ga tad/ /steng khang gtso bo rnam snang kun du zhal/ /nye ba'i 'khor le spyan gyis gzigs pa bzhengs/ phyogs bcu nas lhags sems dpa 'a bzhi bcu dang / sgo spung bcas pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad bzhugs/ /ri mor rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs bris/ /tshos skyong gnod sbyin 'be log can la gtad/ /spyog na gnod dh+rin rdo rje mched bzhi ste/ /ri mor sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal du bris1 /tshos sko+ong gnod sbyin bzhi la gtad do skad/ /'khor sa bar mar rgya cher rol / bris/ /skas dbrag rnams dang 'og khang skas 'og rnams/ /sangs rgyas stong gi ri mo bris so skad/ /sto phyogs mdzod gsum dri khang sgos kyi mdzod/ /srung ma gshin rje dbyug pa thogs pa gsum/ /dub kyi mdzod gsum gsung rab rgyud kyi mdzod/ /ā tsar nag po spu gri thogs pa gsum/ /byang phyogs mtshod gsumadzarin cen ga ra gyi mdzod/ /gnod sbyin rin cen be con thogs pa gsum/ /'khor sa chen mo phal chen rgyud ris bris/ /sgo 'gram gnyis su rab gnas zhal sgo'i dus/ /glu gar rol mo rnga shon bro la sogs/ /rta rgyug pyag rtsed sgyu ma mkhan po dang / /bod kyi bde skyid ya mtshan sna tshogs bres/ /midor na lha be+e+ogs bdun cu kha yangs dang / /sgo mo so drug bye+obartse bzhi bcu gnyis/ /phru skas drug dang 'ibs zur bco brgyad yod/ /ka ba stong dang rtsa brgyad yod pa la/ /seng phrug brgya dang rtsa brgyad dag gis brgyan/ /'khor sa kham bu can bye klu la gtad/ /longs spyod yon bdag 'brog gnas mched lnga yin/ /yashi ltag 13

thog gnyes na lha tshogs ni/ /shākya mu ni gco 'khor lnga lnga dang /sgo thung gnyis dang lha tshogs/bdun bdun ba zhugs/ /ri mor bskal pa bzang po'i sapas rgyas stong / /chos skyong nor bzang gang bzang gnyis la gtad/ /nyi zla gnyis kyi tshul du bzhengs pa yin/ /shar gyi gling gsum rnam dag khrus kyi gling //lha tshogs rgyang chub chen po gartsa 'khor lnga/ /ri mor mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud ris bris1 /chos skyong dung gi thor cog can la gtad/ 1 ོ1khyen rab 'ja ma dgal gling gi lha tshogs ni/ /'jam da pal la sogs gas 'khor dgu bzhugs so/ /ri mor ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud ris breg1 chol skyo nga gshin rje me gi 'khor lo can/ /brda sbyor tshang mang gling gi lha tshogs ni/ /byang chub/ chen po gtso 'khor lnga ru bzhugs/ /ri mor/ mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyud ris bris/ /chos skyong 'brug gi slog pa na la gtad/ /sto yi gling gsum bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling / /gtso bo khyang chub chen po lugs ma la/ /sems dpa' bzhi dang sgo srung chen po/gnyis/ /ri mor nam mkha' snying po'i rgyud rig bris/ /chos skyong dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad la gtad/ /thugs rje'i rgyun 1 byung āme pā lo'i gling 1/lha tshogs khad+ma pā khi gtso 'khor lnga/ /steng na a mi de wa gtso 'khor/lnga/ glo 'bur g.yas na rgyal po'i sku tshab dang / /bas yi lha mo phra men mchod rten dang / /stong phrag brgya pa bse yi sgol ma bzhugs/ /glo 'bur g.yon na don zhags lha tshogs bzhugs/ /slo 'bur gcig na rigs gsum mgon po bzhugs/ /lte ba'i rgyud ris ma do sde za ma tog /khyams la mdo sde sa bcu'i rgyud ris bris/ /chos skyong dpang chen pho nya rnams la gtad/ 1sgu sgyur rgya gar gling gi lha tshogs rna/ /gtso bo3byang chupha chen po lugs ma la/ /sems dpa' bsgo dang sgo srung chen po gnyis/ /lte bar nyi ma'i snying po'i rgyud ris bris/ 1khyams la da/ོngas pa nges par 'grel pa bris/ /chos stong gnod sbyin ra yi 135

godong can yin/ nub kyi gling gsum be+e ro tsa na'i gling / /zangs kyi rnam par / snang mdzad gtso 'khor lnga/ /rnam snang mngon par byang chub rgyud ris bris/ / chos skyong gnod sbyin glang mgo can la gtad/ /dga' ldan byams pa gleng gi lha tshogs ni/ /lha tshogs mgon po byams pa gartsa 'khor dgu /lcog na a mi de lo gtso 'khor lnga/ /ri mo gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang / ༄/bsam yas bzhengs lugs ri mor bkode pa dang / /'jig rten bstan pa'i ri mo rgyud ris dang / /rgya tsha lha snang skyes rabs lag rjes bris/ /chos skyong ma ling ka dang u ling ka /mi g.yo bsam gtan gleng gi lha tshogs ni/ /gtso bo byang chub chen po gas 'khor lnga/ /sims dpa' bcu drug rtag tu ngu dang ni/ /yum gyi snying bo tshe dpag med pa dang / /gtsug tor dang ni phal chen rgyud ris bris/ /chos skyong rgyal po dngul mgo can la gtad/ /byang gi gling gsum rin cen sna tshogs gling / /bcom ldan byang chub chen po gartsa 'khor lnga/ /ri mor tshong dpon khye'u chu 'a bas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' phan sems rgyud ris bres/ /chos skyong gnod sbyin bse gdong can la gtad/ /sems bskyed byang chub gling gi lha tshogs ni/ /gtso bo sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma can/ /sgrib pa rnam sel bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / /zhi ba'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas bzhi bcu gnyis/ /bdud 'joms rgyal po badz+ra gī la ya/ khyams la rtag tu ngu yi skyes rabs bris/ /glo 'bur shes rab pha rol phyin rgyud bris/ /chos skyong seng ge'i gdong pa can la gtad/ /dkor mdzod pe dkar gling gi lha tshogs ni/ /lha yi gtso bo sangs rgyas dga' ba'i dpal/ /'khor du byang chub sems dpa' chen po brgyad/ /rgyud ris yab sras mjal ba'i bkod pa bris/ /dkor mdzod re la srung ma re re ste/ /snga gdong gnyis la rgyal chen bzhi po bres/ /gzhan yang nyi khri'i gleng gzhi rgyas par bris/ /grung ma rgyal po pe dkar nyid la gtad/ /36

lcags ri phyogs bzhi mgon khang nang brgyad na/ /lha mgon lcam dral gami 'khor gsum gsum ste/ /mdor bsdu lder bzo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bathugs/ /ri mor sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis bris/ /bcu gnyis gling la ma gtogs lcags ri'i nang / /dag byed khrus khang klu 2brug mthu rtsal gling / /tshang mang ge ru'i gling dang gsum du bzhengs/ mchod rten nag po'i rgyab la khrus khang gling / /so phag khad pa nyis thog bzhengs pa la/ /chu ni steng nas zangs kyi wa la 'bab/ /'og khang khrus byed kha gdob rkang lag 'khru/ /steng khang mi rtag ston byed dur khrod dang / /lus bor skye 'phos mi rtag sdug bsngal gyis/ /'khor ba'i 'khor tshul srid pa'i 'khor lo bris/ /spung ma gnod sbyin chu bum phogs la gtad/ /dbu rtse chen mo'i 'khor sa'i nub phyogs na/ /tshang mang ke ru'i gling zhes bya ba/ni/ /so phag khang pa nyis thog 'og khang du/ /pani ta yi g.yos khang byed sa dang / /steng na chos bshad lugs ma'i lha khang yod/ /srung ma gnod sbyin rma sgron can la gtad pi ro tsa na'i gling gi rgyab phyogs na/ /mthu rtsal glu 'brug chu gling zhes bya yod/ /so phag khang pa chig thog bzhengs pa la// thang la chu yi mtsho mo mer bar bskyil/ /pad sdong dbus na phyag rdor 'gyib kyibag bzhugs/ /'dab ma brgyad la klu chen thorgyad rnams 'khod/ /rgyud ris klu 'bum dkar po'i glu gzugs dang / /chu glang sdig sbrul nya sngal spyong mo bris/ / rtesrung ma zur phud mal gro'i glu la gtad/ /klu dang rgyal po grogs po byas pa'i rten/ /glu khang bzhengs par zhal bzhes mdzad pa bzhengs/ du/bsam yas gzhi ma rus sru'/gzugs su yod/ /rus sbal mgo la āyi pā lo'o gling / /dkyil du dbu rtse yan lag bzhi po la/ /mchod rten bzhis mnan sta zur nyi zlas mnan/ /bka' rtags phyag rgya mchod rten bzhi la ni/ /mchod rten dkar po seng ge brgyad kyig brgyan/ /srung ma gnod sbyin skar mda'i gdong pa can/ 131

bzhings pa'i lag len blon chen shud pu yin/ /mchod rten dmar po bad+ma stong /gis brgyan/ /skyong ba'i spung me gza'i bdud mig dmar yin/ 1bzhengs pa'i 1/ga len rgya tsha lha snang yin/ /mchod rten na ge po mchod rten stong gis bar+ghad//skyong ba'i srung ma mkha' 'gro lcags mchu can/ 1bzhengs pa'i lag len rta ra klu gong yin/ /mchod rten sngon po lha khang thacu drug brgyan/ /skyong ba'i spung ma rdo rje bdud 'dul yin/ /bzhengs pa'i lag len rdo rje spre chung yin/ /sa dang rdo yi lhag ma kun bsdus na sa/ /byams pa gling du mchod rterna bzhengs su gsol/ /rab gnos mdzado tshe bsam yas 'od du 'bar/ /mchod rten 'od 'bar zhes su grags pa yin/ /lcargas ri mu khyud srung mar bskos pa ni/ /rgyal po chen po bshi la gtado do skad/ /de rdoms lcages ri nang khongs dkar chag lags/ /rngo mo gsum gyi thugs dam bzhengs pa la/ /jo mo tshe spong rgyal mo'i thugs dam ni/ khams gsum me tog sgol gyi bkod pa ying / /dbu rtse chen mo'i bkod pa 'dra ba la/ /'og kheng gartsa bo byang chub chenadipo nyid/ /nye pa'i pras brgyad 'khor gyes bskore nas ni/ /sgo spung khro bo khems gsum rnam rgyal dang / /mi g.yo ba dang lha tshogs bcu gcige bzhugs/ /ste ba'i logs la sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ /'khor sa phyi bstar sgrib pa rnam sel rgyud/ /'khor sa nang bstar lang gshegs rgyud ris bris/ 'khor sa bar ma'i byang dang shar gyi gyed/ /rgyal ba shāka thub rgyal po'i khab nase ni/ /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas su byon pa bris/ /shar gyi byed dang sto yi ngoshes/la ni/ /yab dang gras po mjal pa'i rgyud ris bris/ /chos 'khor dgu yi bkod pas phyogs gsum brgyan/ /nub dang lho yi phyed la ri mo ni/ /zhing khams rgyal ba'i tshos gsung bris pa lags/ /bar khang gtso bo sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad sgo srung keng kang gnyis/ /snye ba'i rgyud ris 'bum gyi gleng gzhi dang / /138

—rigs lnga'i zhing khams sems dba' sems ga bres/ /skor khang ri mo nang du gzigs pa la/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po dang / /rgya nag lul dang pal po'i yul dang ni/ /li yul zangs gling gser gling be ta'i gling / /mu rgyan ge sar bod kyi yul dang ni/ /rgyal khams bde skyid phun tshogs mtha' /dogardobris/ /sgor khang phyi ru gzigs pa'i ri mo ni/ /sangs rgyas gtsug na'an cen rgyud ris bris/ /steng khang gartsa bo rnam snang kun du zhal/ /3khor du sems sadapa' nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / /sgo srung brgyad de lha tshogs sum cu gnyis/ /be+e ba'i logs sa mchod pa'i lha mo bris/ /gser gyi la dus lcam gdung legs bar brgyan/ /gser gyi gdugs dang gser gyi drel thu dang / /lha phrug nam mkha' lding gi mchod 'bul/yod/ /'og khang chos skyong lha mo re ma ti/ /bar khanganasteca khang gnyis kyi srung ma ni/ /gnodanosbyin rgyal po chen po mched gsum yin/ / spyo+og la ri mo/dang ni srung mardomed1 /'khor sa bar ma klu la gtad pa yin/ /sgo dang khu ma'i nang na lha tshogs ni/ /mkha' 'gro byang chub gems dpa'i tshogs rnams pazhugs/ /srung ma bstan ma bcu gnyis bris nas gtad/ /nor bu'i rgyal po la yang gnyer du gtad/ /'khor sa chen mor phal chen rgyud ris bris/ /glo 'bur mazhi na nigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /'khor sa chen mo'i sgo ༷'alum rnams la ni/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po gung na bzhugs pa la/ /glu gar rol so byag byed sgyu ma mkhan/ /gyad mi stobs 'gran stag gzig mi dang rtse/ /sbrug dang seng ge 'thab mo byed pa dang / /bod du ya mtshan gang che thams cad bris/ 1ming smad mtsho mo mgul gyi rga dkyil du/ /padru'i sdong po chen bo skyes pa'i drung / /rgyal pos za 'og gur chen phubasanas su/ /bod khams stong sde'i gzhon byes/thams cad tshogs/ /bro brdung glu len gar stabs gsung snyan ba'agran/ /lta chen khri steng bzhugs nas sgra skad bsgyur/ /mdzes pa'i khye'us lag 136

chan rnga ma thogs/ /gar stabs bro brdung shon rtsed byed pa dang / /rgyal po'i 4ོsa sangs 'bag dang seng ge dang / /sngags bon rnga thogs 'chams po byed pa dang / /rgyal po mnyes pa btsun mo mdzes ma kun/ /rgyal po'i spyan sngarwa sprin ltar gtibs nas bzhugs/ /bu mo mdzes mas g.yung drung shon gra bcas/ /gsung snyan zor khugs 'then cing rkang bro brdung / /rdzu 'phrul rta zhon brgya dang 'chams po dang / /dom 'dra sprel 'dra skyus mo lang ma ling / /zangs dung cha lang 'khar rnga gling bu dang / /rdza rnga mi wang pheg rdob rol mo'i tshogs/ /rgyal mtshan ba dan phur ma zur 'phan dang / /dar khu bsil g.yab rlung bskyod pu ru ru/ /g.yag rgod sha rlon btsos dang bsregs yibs dang / /mar brkal phrum dang zho mar thud dang ni/ /spyan gzigs longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / /sgos dkar sman gyi dud pas lung pa khengs/ /bu ram sprang rtsi btsos dang rjen pa dang / /'bras chang dwangs ma rta chang rgun chang dang / /nas chang go la rgya nag zhal bsil dang / /btung ba'i tshogs dang zhal zas gang dgyes rol/ /lo paṇa rnams dang rje 'bangs grub thob rnams/ /bstan pa'i gad bdar chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad/ /rab gnas tshar nas lo ni bcu gsum par/ /nyin re bzhin du mtsho mo mgul du tshogs1 /dpal gyi nyi ma shar bas dro ba'i dus/ /skyid pa'i 'dom 'jal kun gyes bskyangs pa la/ /long ba mngon shes can gyis gral gshoms mdzad/ /mi dga' lha dgyes 'du 'dzi ci dga' byung / /dgung lo bcu gsum bde skyid gzigs mo byas/ /skyid pa'i glu shon gar bro byag rtsed rnams/ /gnas dus bzang po lha yi mdun sa 'dra/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas bka' bstsal grur blangs pa/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha la dpe blangs nas/ /g.yu khang gser khri bya ba'i zor snyan blangs/ /lha sras mu ni btsan po yis/ /'jig rten sgrol ma bya ba blangs/ /lha sras mu rum btsan po4140

/yis/ /seng ge 'byung chen bya ba blangs/ /lha sras mu ri btsan po yis/ /dga' glu bcu gsum bya ba blangs/ /jo mos g.yu mtsho 'khyil pa blangs/ /lha lcam g.yu yi lcug phran blangs/ /bla mchod rnams kyis mgur bzhes pa/ /slob chadapon bo dhi sa ta yis/ /sgom phreng dkar po bya ba blangs/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /lha 'dre zil gnon bya ba blangs/ /pa gor be+e ro tsa na yis/ /dbyangs ring khugs pa bya ba blangs/ /lo tsā ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis/ /skyid pa'i glu ring bya ba blangs/ /cog ro glu yi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /kakachen bco brgyad bya ba blangs/ /gnubs ban nam mkha'i snying po yis/ /mkha' la khyung sding bya ba blangs/ /ngan lam btsun pa rgyal mchog gis/ /rta mgrin mgur dbyangs bya ba blangs/ /wa se'i sprul pa mtsho rgyal gyis/ /phur pa /'jol chen 'jol chung blangs/ /blon po rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /'gos kyis drang shing dkar po blangs/ /gtong gis zer chen zer chung blangs/ /shud bus dung chen dung chung blangs/ /myang gis gser gyi dril chen blangs/ /sbas kyis re brgya bya ba blangs/ /mgar gyis bya rgod lding ba blangs/ /sna nam lha shug gong ma blangs/ khu yis mdo spyod bya ba blangs/ /gnyags kyis zla 'od bya ba blangs/ /li yis lcags ri gdong drug blangs/ /dmag dpon lu ma rgyud gsum blangs/ /shar pos stag ri dgu brtsegs blangs/ /shar mos grong zer ring mo blangs/ /gzhan yang brjod kyis mi lang ste/ mi tsho re yis glu re blangs/ /mi res rta re brgyugs ga rnams/ /'khor sa khams gsum zangs khang gi /sgo 'gram chen mo'i logs la bris/ /'jam dpal sprul pa khri srong sde'u btsan gyi/de/btsun mo 'bring ba pho gyong rgyal mo btsun/ /yum las skye 'phos rgyal po'i khab tu bzhes/ /thugs dam gser khang dga' ldan byang chub sgon/ / gtsug lag lha khang bzhengs pa'i brkad pa ni/ /zas g.yos dgu drangs bzo /141

khyad dgu yise 'phags/ /lha sras mi mnga' lha khang nyis thog bzhings/ /rgya phebs phyi nang rtsig pa ka ba med/ /gzhan na ma mchis de nyid bzo yi khyad/ /gathad jargyad rgyu skar phye yi gdung chab brten/ /rgya phibs nang bstar bo ḍūru yi gdung / /gser gyi panatra seng ge rta mchog dang / /pa du'i ngazo ris khyad /'phags dgu yiso bsteg spar khab dgu la gser gyi bye'u chung druka snyan ba'i sku skad yid 'ong sgrogs pa dang / /bar khyams nang bstar g.yu thog seng ge'i mgrin/ /spyi bo rta rgyab rta babs khyad du 'phags/ /thang dang bad ni so phag pi ḍūrme/ /rgya phibs g.yu thog gzhan las khyad du 'phogs/ /chu srin kha nas dri chab spos kyi chu/ /rdo yi rus sbal steng du 'bab pa lags/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis gtso bo 'bur du dod/ /gtso bo dang ni sems dpa' thams cad la/ /spyi gdugs dang ni sgos gdugs gnyis su phub/ /'og khang gtso bo rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas la/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad 'khor gyis bskor ba dang / rdomi g.yo ba dang rdo rje gtum po bzhugs/ /dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i rgyud ris khrus/ /lte ba'i snga gdong rgyal chen 'khor bcas bris/ /skor khang phyi bstar 'bum gyi gleng gzhi bris/ /skor khang nang bstar li tsā byi dang ni/ /samakhyen rab 'jam dpal bgro gleng mdzad pa bris/ /steng khang gtso bo rnam snang kun du zhal/ /yo ga'i lha tshogs dag gis bskor ba bzhugs/ /steng khang rgya phibs dag la ri mo ni/ /bu mo bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang / / 'phags pa dge 'dun skyong gi rtogs brjod bris/ /steng khang bar khyams nang gi ri mo ni/ /mdo sde pad+ma dkar po'i rgyud ris bris/ /steng khang logs la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bris/ /'khor sa chen mor phal chen rgyud ris bris/ /tsong khapa nang na bris pa'i ri mo ni/ /gang ba bzang po nor bu bzang po dang / /srid pa'i 'khor lo 'jig rten bstan pa bris/ /dkor mdzod drug dang jo mo'i 142

khange pa dang / /glo 'bur bdun sde nor dang rjas kyis bkang / phyi yi grung ma mgon po lcam bral dang / /nang gi spung ma rus sbal klu la getad/ /byang gi pyogs kyi dkor mdzod srung ma ni/ /rgyal po chen po rta mgo can la gtad/ /sto phyogag dkor mdzod dag gi srung ma ni/ /gnod sbyin kuṇ+ḍa li la gnyer du gtad/ /longs spyod nor gyi srung ma chen po ni/ /gnod sbyin nor bu bzang la gnyer du gtad/ /de dag bu tshal gser khang dkar chag go /rgyal po'i jo mo 'gro bza' byang chub kyis/ 1thugs dam dge rgyas gtsug lag bzhengs pa ni/ 1lta sras mi mnga' lha khang chig thog bzhengs/ /so phag rdo sprin gnyis kyis rtsig pa byas/ /rgya phibs bzo ni khyung ma kha ru phub/ /rnam snang gtso mdzad lha tshogs lugs ma bdun/ /gtso bo'i mdzod spur me shel 'od 'bar bcug /mdun gyi gdung la nor bu 'od legs btags/ /mar rma mi dgos nyin mo pazhin du gsal/ khyad 'phagase de gathum bod khams gzhan na med/ /lte ba'i ri mor bzang po spyod pa bres/ /skor khang ri mo nang du gzigs pa la/ /'jam dpal li tsā byi gnyis gleng ba dang / /spyan ras gzigs dang byams pa gleng ba bris/ /nor bzang le'u nyung shos tshang bar bris/ 1rnam snang bzeng spyod jo mo'i smon lam bris/ /skor khang phyi ru gzigs pa'i ri mo ni/ /phyag rdor dkyil 'khor zhang phrom ming gring dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang ming sring phyag shor dang / /kune tu bzang po'i zhing khams rgyas par bris/ khyams la ri mor sangs rgyas stong rtsa bris/ /ya thog ring mo ma thog ring mo dang / /bar gyi khug pa bco porgyad rdzogs par bris/ /chos skyong srung ma mgon po lcam dral dang /'bri mgo cade dang u ling ka/la gtad/ /mchod rten gong ma mig dmar gza' la gtad/ /mchod rten 'og ma pa ba sangs le gtad/ /yon chab (1na ska klu la gnyer gtad byas/ /de ltar thugs dam dbal gyi bsam yas la/ /143

bkod pas khyad 'phags bsam gyis mi khyab pezhugs/ /dkar chag che skesang chung gsumakobakod pa min/ /rgyal po'i thugs dam ji star bzhengs pa'i lezhu ste bcu gcig pa'o / //rgyapha brgyud gtsug 'ag khar chen brtsigs tshul/rgyapha brgyudwa gtsug lag khang chen brtsigs pa ni/ /rgyal po mu tig btsan po'i sku ring la/ /jo mo dpal gyi dang btsun khab tu bzhes/ /bsam yas lcags ri nag bo'i shar lto mnames1 /dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu bzhengs pa ni/ /rgya khyon dpangs ni dbu rtse sum ldab la/ /'og khang gzhi ma bod kyi luṭa bu phub/ /li yi shing mkhan bod du gdan drangs nas/ /gong gi thog gnyis li yi lugs su phub/ /rgya nag be chu'i shing mkhan gdan drangs nas/ /de steng thog gsum rgya nag lugs su phub/ /rgya gar shing mkhan mkhas pa gdananadrangs nas/ /de gong thog gshām rgya gar lugs su phub/ /lha yi bkod pa dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi/ /'og khung bar dang steng gi bkod pa rnams/ /lan gsum 'dabs te dgu thog nang du bkod/ /snga khang khyams dang 'khor sa rim pa dang / /dkor mdzod ba co brgyad rdo ring bzo yi khyad/ /gzha' tshe gru skas phib zur lcog chung dang / /dbu rtse bya 'dab steng gi spyog bzhi yi/ /bkod pa'i rim pa khyad med 'dra ba la1 /lan gsum 'dabs te dgu thog bzhengs su gsol/ /rjes la dbu ru klungs shod gtsug lag khang / /skar ma gcig gi rgya khyon dpe ru blangs/ /skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ /dbus kyi ste ba rgyal khang bzo thon la/ 1phyogs mtshams brgyad du bka' rtags mchod rten bzhengs1 /rtsis kyi rdo ring la sogs gtsug wag 14

/bang / /stong sde'i mi bran sa rdo shing gshog dang / /phyogs re dag na bzo bo brgya brgya yis/ /rdo yi rmang bting shing dang 'dam pas brtsigs/ /gzhan yang yar klungs btsan thang gtsug lag khang / /dpal gyi ngang btsun rgyal rmas bzhengs su gsol/ /g.yu phibasaṃ sngon po lta bar mdzes pa la/ /g.yu yi dmago can chu srin bum sna can/ /tsong khang rta babs g.yu thog za ḍūyi/ /zhal 'dam sder bzo rgyud ris mkhan po ni/ /bzo go bdun cu don brgyad phyagages bdar/ /rgyal brgyud gtsug lag khang chen brtsigs pa'i le'u ste bcu ba/nyis pa'o// //srong gi bang so ji ltar mtshod tshul/sreng gi bang so dzi ltar mchod pa ni/ /chos rgyal sgong btsan sgam po skad pa de/ /thugashe rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /ri po ta la'i rtse nas gdan bskyod de/ /bod khams yongs kyi mgon du gshegs so skad/ /snang ba rnam gsum byung nas sku bltams ste/ /sku gcig phyag gnyis zhal ni bcu gcig pa/ /yab yum gnyis la gnyis med dri ma mdzad/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dbang bskur nas/ /rgyal sar bton pas dge ba'i khrirmes bcas te/ /thog mar sprul pa lnga stong sprul nas ni/ /byams pa mi 'gyur gtsug lag khang chen bzhengase/ /rgya nag bal po gnyis nas thugs dme ni/ /shākya mu ge mi baspyod rdo rje byon/ khri btsun kong jo gnyis ka khab tu bzhes/ /'phrul snang ra mo che la sogs pa yi/ /thugs rten bzhugs gnas gtsug lag brgya rtsa bzhengs/ /bod la sku drin che bar mdzad pa'i rjes/ /sprul pa bsdus lugs snang ba gsum du byung / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sprul pa bsdus bar gzigs/ /145

nang blon rnams kyis lha la thim par gzigs/ /rgyal brgyud rnams kyis yar klungs sprug ri ru/ /bang so brtsigs nas yab yum gsum gyi pur1 /gser gyis byugs nas dngul gyi ga'ur bcug bang so'i re'u mig dbus mar khri la bzhugs/ /gser dngu' g.yu sogs ba yi khul re dang / /rgyal po'i dkor nor gang yin spyan sngar spung /dar zab blo bar gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bres/ /mi glags tshags kyis legs par bsdams pa la/ /mi shigs rgya ni rim pa bdun gyes btab/ /blon por bskosha pa'i nang blon rnams la gnyer/ /nang blon gang yin rgya' po'i bang lo bsrung / /gshin po'i tshul bzung phur gyi 'ab sa su bsngos/ /gson gshin bye byas mi yi khyu nas bud/ /rgyal brgyud gapon po rnams dang mi 'phrad cingarka /mchod pa'i dus min bang so'i tho phyi ru/ /gson po'i mi dang rta phyugs 'khyams dbang med1 /mi nor byung na dur srung gshin pos 'dzin/ /dur srung gis reg gson khyur mi tshud cing / /gshin so'i rtags bzung dur srung bran g.yog byed/ /gzhan gyi bya ba gang yang mi 'bab cing / /sa khul bang so'i pur kha nor rdzas srung / /mtha' 'khob rgyal pos bod la sto nag gtong / /rgya' po'i pho nya bang so'i pur la 'jab/ /rgyas btab rjes la nang blon de phyir srung / /mchod pa'i dus ni gung la gshegs pa yi/ /rgyal gyi nyi mar srong gi bang tho mchod/ /phyi rabs rgyal po 'das dus gang yin la/ /rgyal brgyud rje 'bang sa 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /mchod pa'i longs spyod spyan gzigs sna tshogs bteg /bzhengs kyi lha khang nang du byon nas ni1 /dud 'bud dbang po'i drung du btang nas su/ /sang gi nyi mar srong gi bang so mchod/ /gshin po thams cad byes kyi lung1par song / /de skad smras nas mchod pa rgyas par byed/ /phud dang nor dang gos la sogs pa dang / /rta phyugs rkang 'gros mchod pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /mchod pa tshar nas lhag ma 1 6

shul du spungs/ /gshin po shog la de las zo zhig bsngo/ /phyi mig mi lta rab gi gnas su 'byon/ /byes kyi lung pa'i dur srung byed pa 'ongs/ /phud dang lhag ma kha zas bcas la rol/ /gos dar rkang 'gros la sogs phyi la spyod/ /sa khul rgya khyon 'tsho ba'i lo tog 'debs/ /phud dang lhag ma bza' patung mang po 'byung / /nor gyis ma phongs dogs 'tshe gang yaje sked/ /dmag dang las ka gang yang mi 'bab cing / /rang sar bde ba'i nang blon khyu yi tshogs/ /srong gi bang so ji ltar masdod pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// // bzhengs pa'i snye khang ji ltar bzhengs pa/bzhengs kyi lha khang ji ltar bzhengs pe ni/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/ /thog mar mi 'gyur byams pa'i gtsug lag khang / /g.yu ru khru 'brug dbu ru bka' stsal bzhengs/ /g.yas ru gtsāng 'gram ru lag gros pa bzhengs/ /sto brag mkho mthing mon yul bum nga bzhengs/ /spa gror skyar chu mdo khems klong thang sgol/ /nyang ror rtsis dang rgyang ror dpal tshashe bzhengs/ /kong por chu dang lha khang bzhengs su gsol/ /mang yul byams sprin tshangs pa rlung gnon bzhengs/ /spra dun rtse dang skyo yi lha khang bzhengs/ /༷klo yul kha ra nyang khams gru gu bzhings/ /'phan yul bye ri/lha sa 'phrul snaje dang / /ra mo che yi gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs/ /chos rgyal zong btsasha sgam po man chad name/ /lha sras mu tishe btsan po yar 'khums su1 /bzhengs kyi lha khang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /bzhe ngas kyi lha khang ji ltar bzhengs pa'i zhe'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //147
