bzhugs kyi sku mkhar ji ltar brtsigs tshupa/bzhugs kyi sku mkhar ji ltar brtsigs pa ni/ 1rje gcig gnya' khri btsan po'i sku ring la/ /yul la snga ba yar klungs sog kha ru/ /mkhar pha snga ma sham po dgu brtsegs brtsigs/ /rgyal bo gri gum btsan po'i sku ring la/ /yar mo sna bzhir snang ba'i shar phyogs su/ /pho brang sku mkhar tho dang bya/ra brtsigs/ 1rgyal po spu de gung rgyal sku ring pha/ /yar mo sna bzhir snang ba'i nub phyogs su/ pho brang sku mkhar khri brtsegs 'bum gdugs brtsigs/ /rgyal po stong ri stong btsan sku ring la/ /pho brang sku mkhar 'phyi ba stag rtse ni/ /ba dmar 'o mas sa rnams sbangs te brtsigs/ /(75dpo tho ri snyan shal sku ring la/ /yar mo sna bzhir snang ba'i sto phyogs su/ /pho brang sku mkhar yum bu bla mkhar brtsigs/ chos rgyal grong btsan sgam bo'i skya ring la/ /kye mkhar lha sa dmar po ri yi steng// /dgu brgya go dgu rtse dang stong du brtsigs/ /rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyalapo'i sku ring la1 yar mo sna bzhi mda' yi byang phyogs su/ /pho brang sku mkhar zo thange ri ma brtsigs/ /rgyal po khri sde mge tshom sku ring la/ /pho brang sku mkhar bsam yas mchims phur brtsigs1 /chos rgya' khri sgong sdethu btsan sku ring la/ /bzhugs kyi sku mkhar gsum du brtsigs pa ni/ /rta mangs khud kyi btsan mkhar yang rtse par gas/ /gnam phyin chad pa'i zla ba'i bsil khang ni/ /zung mkhar smag ma brag gi zur la brtsigs/ /lo paṇa rnams kyis dam chos gsungs pa'i dus 1 1bsam yas lho ngos na rgyud ne'u gsing du/ /sgyug ma'i gzer khang sku mkhar gsum thog brtsigs/ /mjing yon mu tig btsan por+sha sku ring ma1 /pa ma mas thog mkhar steng du sku mkhar brtsigs/ /sku mi skyo 1 8

bsangs dar khang mig dgu'i nang / /mchod gagog mdzes pa gzhon nu dgu yis ni/ /zas sna g.yos sna mi 'dra du ma yis/ /nang nub dro dang gung gi dus la mchod/ /bzhugs kyi sku mkhar ji ltar brtsigs pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pashes// //bka' yi nan thag ji ltar gdams tshul/bka' yi nan thag ji ltar gdams pa ni/ /btsan pos bka' lung bstsal ba'i dus su yang / /legs nyes che chung gong 'og legs par brtags/ /sems zhib bsam mno zhib rgyas legs par btang / /tshig 'dril don bsdus 'gag sbungs brda skod sbyor/ /rgyal po smra ba lan gcig gsung ba ste/ /de las brgal na nyes la chad pa gcod/ /legs nyes che chung legs par ma brtags na//ser gzhig long med btsan po'i bka' lung la/ /nyes med mi la chad pa phog pa mang / /byams pa med pa'i rgyal po srin po 'dra/ /ser gzhig med pa'i rgyal po rbab dang 'dra/ /legs nyes che chung lta long med pa ni/ /tha mal byol song yus kyis brnangs pa 'dra/ /ma brtags ma gzhigs btsan po'i bka' lung ni/ /gzhan gyis khrel zhing rang re spyod kyis thin/ /don med sems can sdug bsngal mtsho ru bskyur/ /rang nyid 'aspyod kyang thal zin bcos mi btub/ /blon po ngan pas mi rnams spyod la skyel/ khrims kyi srang mda' legs par brtag pa'i dus/ /rang 'dod bshad pas bden pa'i chig mi thos/ /rgyal po gos ngan chag su zhugs nas ni/ /rang gi mnga' ris yul khams myul bar byas/ /legs nyes khrims kyi bya ra lo rgyus gsan/ /gen gon kha 'chal dag la 'dri bar bya/ /byis pa kha 'chal dag la'ang 'dri bar bya/ /rgyal srid gal la bab 49

la'i dus spu ni/ /dkor la mi 'phongs sdig la mi 'dzem spyod/ /rgyal srid nyams na rgyal po gya ba yin/ /phyi rabs khrims kyi bsgo ba srung ba rnams/ btsan po'i bkazha lung bstsal pa'i dus su ni/ khrims chad phyi nang bya ba thams cad la/ /long med mi bya long yod legs par brtags/ /smra ba lan gcig ngag nas 'don pa'i byes/ /sems gzhig med pa'i mi la smra ba min/ /so ma chud pa'i mi la smra ba min/ /thugs ches nang blon gzhigs pa can la sgos/ /nang blon rnying pas bka' gros 'dri ba la/ /che 'gying ma byed gting phugs dag par sbyin/ /thugs tshod lhug par snying gtam rjen par sgros/ /phyi rabs rgyal brgyud rgyal sa 'dzin pa rnams/ ma rabs sgon po'i ngag la mi nyan zhing / /bskyur bar mi sla snyan khung mthug pa dang / /tshod med ngo dga'i gtam la bden mi gzung / /zhe gcod thugs tshod nanganagating mi bstan zhing / /grad srab sna thag gzhan la shor mi bya/ /mkhar sgo ri rtse 'bangs la kyal mi bya/ /thugs sgam khong yangs zhi dal gsong por spros/ /col chung gtam la yang yang lab mi bya/ smra ba mi mang gong rnams chod par spros/ /shes rig med pa tho phyir mi bsten zhing / /ma rabs rigs ngan gces par gzung mi bya/ 1ma rabs che sar gong du bton pa la/ /'go ba rnams kyis gartsa bzhin sems na yang / /rgyal po mi chen rnams la mnyam du blta/ /rigs bzang rnams ni gong du bton gyur na/ /rig shes 'byol bag thugs la 2khrungs gyur nas/ /rgyal po'i che ba 'don cing zhabs tog dang / /nye ba'i 'khor rnams brtse bas skyong bar 'gyur//phyi rabs rgyal brgyud nang blon byed pa rnams/ 4phra ma mi bya drang po/tshugs thub bya/ khro gtum/mi bya rgyal po'i gsung mi bcag rgyal po'i zhabs stog gang che gang 'gro bya/ /rgyal srid 'a—11salas gang 'phel 'dun ma bskyed/ /chab srid phyi nang bde ba'i gros sna bsrings/ /zhi des 'bangs 'khor rnams la bde ba shā+on//150

ngag snyan 'jam po'i chig sgo gsal ba yis/ /ma rig 'khor 'bangs dud 'gro'i lam sna bya/ 1mnyam gnyis gzhan gye bar pa byed 4'i dus/ /zas kyi ngo ngu nye ring byed pa min/ /rgyal po mnga' thang che zhing dar ba'i dus/ /skyin thang chu la rba lus 'gag mi bya/ /bran g.yog la sogs bka' 'khor mi rnams la1 /gdong du tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal smra mi bya/ /sgog tu gtam 'phya ngan spra mi gtang jo / /blo gtad zhapha lce bar pa bcol ba'i tshe/ /nye ring phyogs cha rgya ༷pham byed pa min/ kha nyan bongs chung byis pa gzhon pa la/ /dpang yod thub tshod brnyas pa byed pa men/ /bran g.yog la sogs kha dog ngan pa dang / mi phran dmang ba kun rnams shugs kyis skyongs/ /phyi nang gnyis kyi thu ba thams cad pha/ /legs par brtegs pa gong du soms la spros/ /spyir ni phyi nang ngar gsum thams cad la/ /tshangs pa'i thig ltar drang bar gyespo la bgrong / /rnguṭa ris mi chen drung du byon pa'i dus/ /phyag dang zhe sa dri ba mdongs gsol gyes//blo gtad mi yis stos pa'i dus su ni/ /rang srog bcad kyang de / phan 'doṭa gyis/ /rgyal po'i drung du sdod pa'i dus su yang / /mnyen lhug zhe saḥdzod tshugs legs par gyis/ /dkon cog slob dpon rgyal po rnam gsum la1 /gdung ba bskyed de spri bo'i gtsug tu khur/ /bla ma la sogs sri zhu'i yul rnams la/ /rang ngos bsnyen bkur zhabs tog 'bad la gyis/ /rgan rim dang ni pha ma nye du la/ /gos gsar dri ma med pa bskon pa dang / /snyi la ro mtshog thon pa'i kha zas ni/ dron lan mtshod pa 'tsho yi bar du gyis/ /long sprang la soṭa ma nus gang zag la/ /bza' btung gos kyi sbyin pa grub tshad gtang / /sgos dang 'dun ma rgan dang rje la dris/ / bka'i nan thag ji ltar gnams pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //151

rtsis kyi rdo ring ji lter bslangs tshul/rtsis kyi rdo ring ji ltar bslangs pa yang / /gtsug lag lha khang tshar ba'i dus su ni/ /stong sde phyogs kyi mi rnams kun tshogs nas/ /rin cen rdo la 'aspul gyis 'khyags lung btags/ /rgyal po'i drung du bde blag drangs nas ni/ 1rig pa can gyi rdo bzo mkhan rnams kyis/ /lcags zhun rdo je pha lam btab nas ni/ /'phrul thu bzo bos gzong thogs lag gis bdar/ ji ltar rdo ring bzo legs btsugs pa ni/ /yab mes rgyal pos ji ltar mdzad tshul dang / /thang yig rgyal po'i bka' thung bstsal ba bris/ /rgyal po dge sgod sgo mo rnam bzhi la/ /sgong gi bang so che ba'i yon tan dang / /bzhugs kyi sku mkhar bzhengs kyi lta khang dang / /rtsis kyi rdo ring rnam pa bzhi la ni/ /rab gnas mdzad dus stong sde'i mi rnams tshogs/ /ko paṇa gru ba thob bla mchod rnams la ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston byas nas su/ /bod kyi bde skyid gzigs mo sna tshogs byas/ /stong sde'i rta rgyug skye gar bro shon dang / /gzhon pas rdo ba rtsed mchong byed pa dang / /mi dga' lha dga' skyid rtags bcu gsum byas/ / bde skyid phun tshogs sum cu rtsa gsum gyi/ /dpag bsam shing sogs chos bzang lha yul 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon rtan lnga la gang dgyes rol/ /longs spyod sprin phung dgos dgu char ltar 'bab/ /bde ba'i ngang la bde chen rol pa mdzad/ /thugs la ci bsams rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /bod khams bde skyid bka' nan rgya cher mdzad/ /rtsis kyi rdo ring ji ltar bslangs pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun ba'o// //152

ma 'ongs rgyal brgyud nor skal ji ltar sbas tshu'/sa ma 'ongs rgyal brgyud nor skal sbas pa dang / /rgyal brgyud bla mchod man ngag rgyas panyab ni /tho re snyan shal rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /yum bu bla mkhar ja rgyud gong ma'i steng / /brag/ri dmar po mtha' chen nang khongs na/ /nor gyi bang so grwa mig lnga pa yod/ /de yi steng gi brag logs dmar po la/ /rdo rje rgya gram mtshal gyis bris pa'i 'og bka' rtags phyag rgya rdo la mchod rten brkos/ /de nas gzhu 'dom thur la bcal ba na/ /bang so'i thad du gzhu 'dom gang brkos la/ /g.yam pa sngon po 'dom geng gru bzhi yod/ /de nyid bsal ba'i zhog na bang so'i sgo/ /dbus 'byed lcags lung lcags kyus sbrel pa sad/ /de yi nang gi seng ge'i khri steng na/ /zangs chen kha sbyar rin cen mil mas bkang / /mi yi khur po bdun gyi bongs tshod la/ /bre la bcal ba'i khal bdun bre lnga yod/ /dngul gyi ga'u pang theg gcig gi nang / /gnam zhal chen mo phra man rin cen skyogs/ /lha yi na bza' pañca li kas gril/ /lta yi yul gyi dpag bsam sbyon shing 'bru/ /rin cen nor bu ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam/ /rgyal po'i darkar cha rin cen bcu gsum yod/ /ces gsungs pas/ /'di na mar la kha byang yang byang gnas byang sde mig dang bcas pa ston te/ /yul yar klungs sog kha'i lung pa shar gyi phyogs/ /brag dmar po ri sna zur dang bcas pa/ /ri dwas ye na ya lta bu'i steng / /rgyal po'i sku mkhar yum bu bla mkhar zhes bya ba yod do/ /de'i gong ya tshad brag mtha'i skyib na bang so dmar po zhig yod/ /de'i steng brag dmar po zhig gi sdebs la/ /mtshal gyis bris pa'i rdo rje rgya gram yod//de'i 'og na rdo la brkos ba'i mchod rten bang rim gsum pa zhig yod do/ /de 153

nas gzhu 'dom lnga dang mda' gang bcal ba'i sa ru bshos pas 'dom gang khru gang na/ /g.yam pa 'dom gang gru bzhi ba zhig gis sgo'i kha bcad nas yod do/ /de mar la bsal ba'i 'og na 'dzad sgo dbus nas 'byed pa zhig yod do/ /de4la lcags skor lcags kyus sna lung sbrel nas yod/ /lcags kyu bkrol nas sgo phye ba'i dus su/ /ral gri gnyis deng nga yod do/ /rma them gyi nang du 'phreng ba gnyis breng nge yod do/ /de dgra zob gyis bcad yabe+e dus su/ /ral gri gnyis sa la log nas 'gro yi/ /nang du phyin la thog mar ral gri mdo+or 'don par bya'o/ /de nas mar me che ba zhig bsteg la nang du phyin pas/ rdo skas rim1pa bdun babs pa'i sa na/ /seng ldeng dang gla gor gyi gdung gshibs pa'i steng /zangs mo che kha sbyar ba'i nang na/ gser sbram dang mtshal bsres pa mi khur bdun yod/ de'i dkyil na dngul gyi ga'u zhig na/ rin po che nor bu bsam 'phel bya ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam zhig lha'i gos partsi li kas gril nas/ rgyal pogastong ri stornga btsan gye bsnams zhal rin po che phra men gyi skyogs su bcug ste/partsi li ka la sogs pa lha'i na bza' bdun gyis gril nas yod do/ /de'i zangs 3ོ/mtha' na/ dkor cha rin po che dngul gyi bum pa rta'i mgo can gsum rgyal po sde ru gnom gzhung btsan gyi gnam sder rin po che sna tshogs las rang 'khru sa gru grub pa dang / /rgyal po khri thog rje btsan gyi dbu thod gser gyi ga'ur bcug nas rin po che sna bdun gyis rgyas btab nas yod/ /gzhan yang gzi'i phor pa rin po/che sna tshogs kyis phra btab pa bdun/ /dngul gyi gsol sder bdun cu don bdun/ /zangs kyi sgod drug cu rin po che mching bus bkang ba yod do/ /srung ma sham po'i gangs btsan la gtad nas yod pas/ mar gyi g.yag dang bshos bu dang gser skyems kyis mchod la thon/ khyi 'brug glang lug bzhis longs spyod par shog cig smon lam btab ste/ rgyal brgyud rim pa nab 15

rim par kha thub phyag tu brgyud nas rgetad de/ mu tig btsan po'i ring la phug lag sor 'dra ba la gter du sbas so/ re'u mig gzhan dag kun na yang / /gser bye zangs kyi rdza ma re re yod do/ kha bung smos kha'i sgo ni dang po nas med do/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las yum bu bla mkhar gyi le'u ste dang po'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rgyal po 'brong gnyan lde ru yi/ /sku la snyun nad byung ba'i dus/ /zhang phu'i mda' ru bang so brtsigs/ /re'u mig dgu pa'i dbus ma ru/ /tsan+dan gdung gi sding khri byas/ /rgyal po'i sku tshab gser las bzhengs/ /zangs chen kha sbyar naja du bzhugs/ /gser bre dgu dang da dzul bre bgyede/ /rgyal po'i dkor nor bcas pa kun/ /sa rdo shing gsum rgya yis btab/ /bye rabs rgyame brgyud nor bu srus/ /gter spung gnyer du gtad pa med/ /lo dus zla dus tsheshe grangs med/ /ces gsungs pas / zhang phu'i mda' ru bang so re'u mig dgu pa yod do/ /de'i dkyil rge g.yam pa nag po mgo dkar the can zhig btsugs te nyug ge yod do/ /de'i mtha' skor te 'dom gang gru bzhi ru/ 'dom phyed dang gsum thur du bkaus pa na/ tsarnan gyi sgo mo'i steng du/ rdo pang theg gshibs pa yod/ de'i steng nang g.yam leb gshibs pa yod do/ /de rnams bsal skas gdang nyi shu rtsa gcig btsugs te/mar me gtams pa'i dus su/ tsardon gyi gdung nyis gshibs yod pa'i khri'i steng / zangs mo che mtshal gyis bkang ba'i nang na/ rgyal po 'brong gnyan lde ru'i sku gzugs rkul po dang mnyam pa/ gser la gar bur bzhengs pa/ rgyal pori na bza' gsol ba bzhugs so/ /de'i mtha' ma phyogs mtshams brgyad du/zangs sgod bzhi dang dngul snod bzhi na/ /gser bre dgu dngul bre das gnam zhal che ba dngul gyi nyi shu/ /chu / ba dngul la gzhi byas pa rin po che snab155

tshogs pa'i phra btab pa bcu/ dngul gyi bum pa gser gyis bkang ba bsnye yod mdo/ /re'u mig brgyad po'i nang re re'ang / zangs re re'i nang du gser sil sam mi rgyab bzhi bzhi yod do1 /de rnams bton ba'i shul du sa mi stongs par bya ba'i phyir/ nang thams cad du gser sa gtor te/ steng/gi sgo legs par bcad la bzhag go /gter byang mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las yar klungs zhang mda'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring sal/ /ra sa 'phrul snang dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'og /rdo rje 'dam pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng / /gser sbal spug pos steng nas kha la dgab/ /rgyal po'i dkor cha rdogs kyis mtha' ma bskor1 /phyi rabs gtsug lag khang gi chagasos su bsngos/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gnas ra sa 'phrul snang gi lha'i gtso ༷bo la gdan gru bzhi mtho gang ba cig yod do/ /g.yon gyi 'og na gdan khri'i 0ldebs la phur gtun gyi rtsig pa rlung seng rtsel cha ba zhig yod do/ /de la gdong gtad pa'i dus su rlung si ri ri yod do/ /rdo skas gyi rtsig pa de bshig nas/༷rdo'i khri rim pa/dgu pa ste/ gom pa bdun gyi sa na rdo'i skas brtsigs yod do/ /snang gsal che ba gnyis gshibs/ /rtsig pa de bshig la mar me gcig de ru bzhag gcig khyer nas nub phyogs su srang kha'i nang lta bur yod pas der zhugs la 'gro bar bya'o/ khyams kyi dkyil 'khor thad ka'i 'og na 'dom phyed chadang do'i khung lte ba na/ thog mar mtsho bsubs pa'i mthongs kyi seng zhig nas 0bltas pas rlung 'u ru ru 'ong ga zhig gi tsa na/ rdo rje'i 'dam pa brlan gyis mi rul ba'i rjas kyis byugs pa'i chu shing gi dkyil 'khor yod do1 /de'i steng1na zangs sgod che ba'i nang na/ gu lang gi gser bre la bcal ba khal gsum dang 1lha gcig khri btsun gyi rdzongs bal po'i yul nas 'ongs pa'i gaster dpa dnguli 3 6

dang / rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs pa mdzo khal lnga brgya dang bcas pa'i steng na bse'i sbal pa chen po zhig gis kha g.yogs nas yod do/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi nang na/ bal po'i g.yu zangs sa le sbram mdzo rgyab dgu dang / gzi dang / byu ru dang / mtshong dang / me shel dang / dung dang / nya lcibs la sogs pas 'khar ba'i rkyen chen mo bkang ba kha zangs kyi pa dras bcad pa phyogs re na bcu bcu yod do/ /gzhan yang rgyal po'i bsnams zhal dngul la din po che sna bdun gyis phra btab pa bdun dang dngul sder chen mo bdun/ /'bras chang dang rgun chang dang go la'i snod/ /dngul rkyen/rnga mong gi mgo can gsum dang / /ngang pa'i mgo can bdun ste bcu rgad do/ /dus phyi rabs 'phrul snang 'jeg pa'i dus 'byung bas/ de'i dus su rgyal brgyud byang chub sems dpa' mthu stobs dang ldan pa cig gis/ glu khang du glu la mchod pa rgyas par phul nas nor gang dgos blangs la spyad par bya'o/ /dus ni dgun zla ra ba'am dbyed zla ra ba'i gza' skar bzang po la 'don par shis so/ /gter byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las dkyil 'khor 'og gi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /'phrul snang sgo yi them pa'i 'og sgo kha'i dbus kyi thad so na/ /rdo sgom zha nye'i kha gtums byas/ /nang du gsal gye rdza ma bcug sol phye chig bye bsres pa'i dkyil/ /in+d+ra dī la'i lhung bzed nang / /lha yi yul gyi rin chen bdun/ /glu yi yul gyi rin cen bdun/ /gser sogs rin chen lnga yis gril/ /rdo sprin dmar pos kha gcod byas/ /them pa'i 'og na rgya yis btab/ /ces gsungs pas/ /'phrul snang gi them pa nang ma'i sgo 'byed pa'i dbrag gi kha lta ba'i nang ngos rdog pa 'ong ba'i thad ka nas mda' gang brus pa'i sa na g.yam pa cig yod/ /de bsal ba'i 'og na rdo gsal gyi rdza ma yod/ /de'i nang na be+e ḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed kyi nang na lha'i yul gyi rin po 157

༷che 'od kyi lte ba/ ke ke ru/ rat+na de pa/ in+d+ra dī la/ su tsa murte/ stag sha dhe ba/ ma ni pa tra/ klu'i yul bye rin po che/ ljon pa tsi tu/ mo yongs tsi tra/gu na tse tra/ tseng ka ling tsi tra/ len tso tra/ bha huta tsi tu/ bha su ra tsi tra bdun gyis bkang ste/ thog mar mi'i yul gyi rin po che gser gyis gril/ de'i steng du pad+ma rā gas gril/ de'i steng du dngul gyis gril/ de'i steng du lcags kyis gril/ de'i sdeng dwa zangs kyis gril nas rdo'i rdza mar bcug / bar mtshams gong 'og tu sol ba dang nas chig gi phye mas gtams ste kha zha nyes bcad nas/steng la rdo sprin gyis zhal ba byas pa yod pas/ de'i dbang gis mtha'i nor thams cad dbus su 'du ba dang / mtha'i mukhas btsun thams cad kyang lha sa'i nang du ༷'byon pa dang / rig pa'i yon tan thams cad kyang bod du dar zhing rgyas par —'gyur ro/ /gter 'di ni bod khams kyi rten 'brel che ba'i gter zhis ngu ste/gnyer du gtad pa'i srung ma yang med/ bton nas spyad par yang ma gsungs so/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /zur chen ka ba bzhi po la/ /nor bu dbang gi rgyal po dang / /nor sgrub srog ser gtad gsum bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar ka ba bum pa can la nor gyi gter sbas pa ni/ /bum /pa can gyi ka zhu'i g.yas zur gyi seng ge'i lcam gzhug gtad pa'i ste ba la/ lcam gzhug nas rtsig pa la khru gsum thur la bcal ba'i sa na/ rtsig pa la gla ba'i shing gru bzhi pa cig yod/ de'i steng gi zhal ba bkog ma'i 'og na/ shing de la gla gor gyi chol mdzub gang ba cig yod/ de gzong gis bkog pa'i 'og na gser gyi spu gu zhig tu lha'i lhal gye rin po che nor bu bsam 'phel rat+na de ba zhes bya ba mthe bong gi tshad tsam cig sbrul gyi pags pas gril nas yod/ de'i 'og na klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas dkar po nor du sgrub ba dang / gnod spyin ku be ra'i nor kyeze gnyis/ gser gye shog bu ma tho ḍūr+yās bres pa bzhugs so/ /gser 63

hre sbu gu'i kha rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad pa yod/ klu'i rgyal po'i gzugs dang steganod sgyen gyi sku gser las sprul pa'i bzo bos bzhengs pa sor lnga pa gnyis banyugs so/ /gter srung ni ku be ra la gtad do/ /'dodo pa'i dus su gter bdag mchod par bya ba dang / skyebo thabs dpe bshugo nas rnying po shul du bzhag pa dang / sku gnyis las klu gzugs shul du bzhag nas/ sngar be+er dachegs pas rgyas btab pa gces so/ /tshes grangs dang lo ni lug go /dus ni —2gun zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la'o/ /gter byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyun/las them nga'i 'og dang ka ba bum pa can gyi le'u ste pazhe pa'o// //ga pa seng ge can la mthu'i gter yod ces pa di/ ka zhu'i g.yas zur steng gi lcam sna'i 'og nas khru gsum thur du bcal ba'i sa na/ rtsig pa'i sdebs la rdo sgom kha so thag gis pacad nas wad/ so phag de gzong gis dum phung bcag pa'i 'og /zangs kyi sgrom bu chu srin gye mtshul pa ca na gye nang na/ lha'i yul gyi rin po che stag sha bhe ba/ nor bu bsam 'phel mthe bong gi tshad tsam zhig gser shog gis gril nas bzhugs so/ /srin po lang ka mgrigo bcu'i grog sgrub cig dang / gzhan yang ya bdud rgyal po dang ma bdud rgyal mo'i mthu zhag gcig ma dang / ging srog zan dmar po'e sgrub thabs dang / srog gi bshan pa'i mthu zhag gsum ma sogs rin po che gaber gye rgyang bu la sa ḍūr+yā zhun mas bris pa bzhugs te/ rgya rim pa gsum gyes btapa nas yod do/ /'don pa'i dus su srin por mchod pa dang / dpe bshus te phyi rma shul du bzhug pa dang / /rin po che gser dngul gyis zangs kyi sgrom bu bkang la bzhag ste/ mi dmi gas pa'i rgyas btab pa gal che'o/ /garter byang mjod kyi sde mig rgyud las ra ba seng ge can gyi lethu ste lnga pa'o// //ga ba shing lo can la ser ba dbab bcad kyi gter sbas zhes pa ni/ ka 153

ba shing lo can gyi g.yon zur gye lcam sna'i 'og nas khru do thur du bcal ba'i sa/rtsig pa'i gseb na shing gru bzhi che ba zhig la/ 'dzer pa gsum sna gcig la 'dzom pa yod/ 'dzer pa'i thad ka'i 'og na so phag gi sgrom zheng du lag pa shong ba dkyus su khru gang ba cig na chu shing gi sgrom bu mtho gang pa yod/ de'i nang na lha'i yul gyi rin po che ke ke ru zhes bya ba1 nor bu bsam 'phel bya ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam dngul gyi ga'ur bcug nas dar zab kyis gril pa yod do/ /ser ba'i sgrub thabs gza' dang gdong mo gnam sa me rlung 'khrug pa'i rgyud dang / sgrub thabs zhag dgu ma dang / ser ba srung ba'i thabs snang srid me khang rlung du 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs zhag gnyis ma rnams gser gye byang thu la be+eḍūr+ya zhun mas bris pa/ rgya rim pa gsum gyes btab nas bzhugs so/ /'don pa'i dus su so phag gzong gis bcag ste gza' bdud mchod la/ dpe bzhus rnying pa shul du gzhag pa gces so/ /gong ltar rgyas brtab pa ni gal che'o/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las ka ba shing lo can gyi le'u ste drug / shes// //ga ba sbrul mgo can la gtad kyi gter yod ces pa ni/ ka ba sbrul mgo can gyi g.yon zur gyi lcam sna'i mjug thur du tshangs thig drangs pa'i thad ka khru phyed gnyis na/ gla ba'i shing chen po zhig gi 'og so phag gi sgom sol bas bkang ba'i nang na/ rus sbal gyi khog pa che bar klu'i yul gyi nor bu bsam 'phel tseng ka ling zhes bya ba dang / bha su ra tsi tra bya ba gnyis/ chu dar kyis gril nas bzhugs so/ /gtad khrum dug mtsho khol ma'i rgyud/ tsi tso dzā la phol nag 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs dang / klu'i rang gshed gnyen po rang gnad kyi skor rnams chu dar mching kha la rin cen gser gyis yi ge bris nas bzhugs rte/maboms snya rdo bse dmar po'i rus sbal gye king lag mgo dang stod de rgyam 160

btab pa yod do/ /'don pa'i dus su klu gnyan la mchod pa rgyas par bya ste/so phag gzong gis bkan la 'don/ /dpe bshus la phyi mo rnams rus sbal gyi khoka par sngar bzhin rgyas btab bo/ /so phag gi kha legs par bcad de/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab pa gces so/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las ka ba sbrul mgo can gyi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //sgo'i nang khang gnod sbyin ku ba ra dang srin bo'i gzugs kyi mdun nas rkang 'dom gang tshur la bcal ba'i sa na/ mda' gang byas pa'i sar g.yam leb sa da' gang sgor mo zhig yod/ de bkog pa'i 'og na rdo sgrom sol bas bkang ba yod/ de'i dkyil du 'khar ba'i bum pa sbrul mgo can gyi nang na/ gser dngul mtshal gsum 'drese pa bre la bcal me'i khal gcig yod/ 'don dus ni dbyar stod dam rtsi thog rgyas pa'i dus su/ srung ma gnod sbyin dang srin po klu gagum mchod la bton te lo gsum du gsang la spyad do/ /gzhan yang gtsang khang byang ngos ma'i thugs rje chen po dang / rta mgrin dang / sgol ma dang / khro gnyer can ma bzhi'i zhabs 'og na klu rgyal dang / mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal 'og dang gsum na/nor dang lha sa'i lo rgyus kyi yig ris dang / rgyal po'i zhal gdams kyi skor mang du yod pa 'dir ma smos pas shog dril gzhan du shes/ gzhan yang par gags dang ke'u tshang che chung gnyis na/ chos dang nor dang lha mo gzugs kyi snye ma'i sgrung la sogs pa thog ma'i sgrung 'bum dang le'u dang / chos skyong rgyal po'i zhal gdams la sogs pa yod de shog dril gzhan du shes so/ /gter byang 'di dag thu mis yi ger btab nas rgyal po'i phyag tu gtad/ rgyal pos mang sgong mang btsan la/ des gung srong gung btsan la/ des rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po la/des khri sde gtsug btsan la/ des khri srong lde'u btsan la/ des mjing yon legs pa'i blo gros la gtad do/ /de'i dus su smob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi 161

zhal nas/ rje nyid la sras bdud kyi sprul pa cig da ste lo dgu bcu na 'khrungs par gda'/ de'i ring la khrims bshig nas chos rdub 'gro bas/ /rje nyid kyi chos rnams dang yab mes kyi dkor nor gyi kha byang rnams/ phyi rabs kyi don du mi brlag pa'i rdzas kyis bsdams la/ mi shigs pa'i rgyas btab/ste sbas nas bzhag na phyi ma'i dus su las 'phro can zhig gis thon nas dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur gsungs te/ gter du sba bar dgongs nas gong 'og bsdebs nas yi ger btab/ /phras daja rgyal brgyud la ma gtad do/ kha byang mdzod kyi lde mig /rgyud las 'phrul snang gi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya pa/ /chos rgyal sgong bcan sgam po yi/ /sku /ring thog mar legs bzhengs pa'i/ khra 'brug dbu rtse'i ste ba na/ /ched du byas pa'i sku rgyab der/ /lha khang 'og ma'i seng sgo yod/ /lha khang nang na gtso bo ni/ /dngul las bzhengs pa'i rnam snang bzhugs/ rdogaper gyes rigs lnga'i ༷ sangs rgyas rnams/ /lugs ma gar du brkyangs khru re/ /gser gyi maṇ+ḍal gser (gyis spungs/ /rgyal po'i dkor cha ma lus yod/ /ces gsungs pas/ khra 'brug gi lha'i sku rgyab ste ba la/ skor khang nang na seng sgo chen po zhig yod/de'i sgo lcags phye ba'i nang na ke'u tshang chen po zhig yo da/ de'i nang na yab mes ༷kyi chos gnyan po gsang ba rin po che rgya rim pa bdun gyes btab nas bzhugs so/ /thu mi sasto ṭas rgya gar nas drangs pa'i rgya dpe mang po dang / bod du chu dar la bris pa'i bka' pota mang po dang / rgyal po nyid kyis gasrungs pa'i sprub thabs kyi skor dang / zhal gdams kyi skor mang po/dang / dkorje cha rin po che'i snod mang po yod do/ /ke'u ①ོnga chung ba'i nang na dar khru dang / gdung 'gebs dang / seng ge'i mgo dang bla bre dang / dar gyi lda lde dang / kho ra khor yug dang / bye ma phur ma dang / bsil byed dang rlung g.yob la sogs pa 163

yod do/ /gzhan yang 'bag dang / gtor snod dang / g.yag seng dang / rgya 'bag dang / dung dang / rnga dang / 'khar rnga dang / cha lang dang / zangs dung dang / pi wang dang 1 rgyal mtshan la sogs pa yod do/ /g.yon phyogs kyi sa la gnam sgo'i steng na/sgo lcags gcig la/ gze mig gsum du sde mig gsum gyis 'byed pa yod do/ /de'i sde mig ni senge sgo'i steng / sgo klad kyi kha na mtshal gyi g.yung drung ris sor bzhi pa yod/ de brkos pa'i 'og na yod no/ sgo phye nas/snang gsal che ba cig gtams la/ de'i nang na rdo skas gdang bu dgu pa zhig yod/ de la phyin pas nang gi/lha ni riges lnga bzhugs te/ dbus su zangs snod gser gyis bkang ba'i steng na dngul gyi rnam par snang mdzad mda' gang pa cig bzhugs so/ /de'i mdun du gser gyi byams pa khru gab pa cig bzhugs/ phyogs bzhir gser zangs kong re la gser bre bdun bdun gyi steng na/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rin cen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don mad grub pa bzhi gser la gar bur bzhengs pa brkyangs khru re re bzhugs so/ garkan yang rigs gsum mgon po dang / seng ge sgra dang / sgrol ma rnams dngul la gar bur bzhengs pa dang / byams pa dang sgrib pa rnam par sel ba gnyis dngul la gar bur bzhengs pa dang / khar sa pā ṇi dang don yod zhags /pa rnams dngul la gar bur bzhengs pa'i sku mda' re'i tshad du bzhugs so/ /dkor cha rin po che'i sgod rgyal bu stag ri gnyan gzigs dang gnam ri sgong btsan gyi bsnams zhal dang / bsnam sder chen mo dngul las byas pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ dngul rgyan nyi shu/ 'khar ba'i rkyan rin po che'i phra btab pa bzhi bcu/ gzhan yang zangs snod dang / ljon dmar gye snod dang / bse'i sgod 'a sogs ga brgya dang bcu gnyis yod do/ /de rnams la gnyer du gtad pa med de gtsug lag khang gi rkyen du bzhugs pa'o/ /gnod sbyin khang par nā ga ku be 163

rakhru zhapas g.yon pa'i 'og na/ nor sgrub dang ngan sngags mang po dang / gtad dang sir ba la sogs pa mang po chu dar la bris pa zangs kyi sbu gur bcug nas kha la chas gril ba mtho gang brus pa'i sa na yod do/ /gnod sbyin gyi khang pa'i dbus/ /dzasto la nag po'i thugs ka nas 'dom gang bcal ba'i sa ru mda' gang brus pa na/ g.yam pa mdang gang ba cig yod/ de bsal ba'i 'og na rdo sgrom khron pa lta bu'i 'dom do pa cig yod/ de'i gting na rdo bse nag po'i rus sbal gyi sto ba na/ nor bu bsam 'phel ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam zhig rin po che sna bdun gyis gril nas wad/ de'i steng mda' gang gi sar lding thog yod/ /de'i steng du dngul gyi ga'u kha sbyar ba cig gi nang na rin po che dkar po dung g.yas su 'khyil pa rta'i mgo bo tsam cig yod/ de'i mtha' nas tshig gis bskor nas yod do/ /de'i steng mda' gang gi sa na zangs sla nga 'dra ba gnyis kha kha sbyar ba'i nang du rgya mtsho gling gi bye ma las bzhengs pa'i klu chen po brgyad kyi rten dang gzungs bcas pa bzhugs so/ /'di ni khru 'brug bzhengs pa'i dus su nor gyi gta' bsdams pa'i gter zhes bya ste phyis 'don pa'i dus su kha gcod dang thog rim pa bzhin du bsal la/ klu chen po brgyad la mchod pa rgyas par phul/ glu'i spang skong bklags te glu'i pho brang dang dngul gye ga'u dang / bse'i sbal pa rnams steng du bton la/ bse sbal gyi sgal pa'i steng na zethu kha gcod 'dra ba zhig yod/ de me la bsgos kha bye nas rgya rim pa bdun bshus te nor bu bton la/ gsir mthe bong tsam zhig la rgya rim pa bdun pos gril nas sbal ba'i nang du bcug ste/ sngar gyi shul du phyogs ma nor bar gzhag par bya'o/ /steng du lding thog phub la dngul gye ga'u kha sbyor gye nang nas dung bton la/ de'i shul4du rin po che sna tshogs pa dang / 'bru sna tshogs pa dar zab sna tshogs kyis bkang nas sngar gyi shul du bzhag de'i steng du sngar gyi thog phub la zangs 164

sam/ rin po che'i sgod che ba cig tu shar du blta ba'i chu mig nas blangs pa'i chus bkang bar rin po che brdar la phyi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la bzhagade'i steng du glu'i pho brang gzhug ste/ de'i nang du'ang rin po che sna tshogs ngardar ba dang / dar zab sna tshogs bcug gzugs rnams so so'i sar bkod la phyogs ma nor bar byas la gzhug go /de'i steng du glu sman sna tshogs btang la/g.yam pas bkab ste sngar ltar rgyas btab bo/ /skor khang gi mdo/ gnod sbyin tshong pa'i mdun gyi snga gdong gi steng lcam gcig la shing gi tshol yod/ de ldags kyis bkog zangs kyis gzer btab ste/ de bkog pa'i nang na man ngag sna mang po dpa / gter thung gi shog dril bdun yod/ srung ma gnod sbyin la gtad yod pas/ phud snas rgyas par mchod la bton na mnga' brnyes par 'gyur ro/ /gter byang mngod kyi lde mig rgyud las khru 'brug gi le'u ste dgu/paro// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rgyal po khri sde/ag tshom gyis/ /mchims phu nam ra'i gtsug lag khang / /gtso po'i gdan gyi maṇ+ḍal 'og /zangs bum rdo sgrom nang du bcug /rin cen sa le sbram gyis bkang / /phyi ༷rabs gtsug lag rkyen du bzhag /ces pas/ mchims phu nam ra'i gtsug lag khang gi— lha'i gartsa bo'i thugs ka nas maṇ+ḍal steng du 'dom gsum khru gang bcal ba'i sa ru/ mda' gang bkos pa na/ zangs kyi bum pa cig gi nang du gser sgom bu dang khrol bu bye ma bre la bcal ba'i khal phyed yod/ bum pa'i kha zangs kyis/gtums te mtha' sol bas bkang nas yod steng nas rdo sgom gye kha g.yam pas bcad de yod do/ /srung ma mchims phu'i btsan shin pas/ bzhos bu sha khrag gis brgyan pas nyin lan gasrum mtshan lan gsum mchod do/ 1rjes la zangs sgod nas byes bkang ba'i dkyil du gser phud bre gang blug la kha bcad de/ snga ma bzhin du rgyas btab bo/ kha byang mdzod kye lde mig rgyud las 165

mchims phu nam ra'i le'u ste bcu pa'o/1 //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /ag tshom me yi sku ring la /'gral bzang gtsug lag khang gi nang / /lha yi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du 'dom bzhi bcal/ /g.yam sgrom zha nyes sbyar ba'i nang / /zangs sgod rin cen sil mas bkang / /bre la bcal ba'i khal phyed yod/ /phyi rabs rnams kyi rkyen du bzhag /ces pas/ mgrin bzang gtsug lag khang gi lha gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ maṇ+ḍal steng du 'dom gsum mda' gang bcal ba'i sa ru mdang gang brus pa rna/ g.yam pas rdo sgrom kha bcad pa'i nang gi zangs bum kha kacus pa'i nang na gaper bre la bcal ba'i kham phyed yod pa/ phyi rabs gtsug lag gso ba'i rkyen du bzhag go /brag dmar mgrin bzang gi 'og na/ brag nag po g.yag nyis ga bas 'dra ba'i dbus/ g.yam sgrom gyi nang sol bas bkang ba'i dkyil na/ li yul gyi rgyal po'i thod pa gser gyis bkang nas dngul gyi snod gsum sbrag tu bcug de zangs kyi gnyur bzhugs yod do/ /de'i steng na mchod rten mi tshad tsam zhig yod/ 'don pa'i dus su btsan byedamados lan gsum byas la 'don no/ /gter byang mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las mgrin bzang gi le'u ste bcu gcib nga'o// // de nas yang dag pashad bya ba/ khri srong sde'u btsan sku ring la/ /rgyal po'i bla gter sbas pa ni/ /dbu rtse'i 'og khang sku rgyab kyi/ /ke'u tshang nang na tshos kyi gter/ /bod du bsgyur ba'i phyi mo sbas/ /bka' srung dkor bdag pe dkar dang / /mgon po lcam dral glu la gtad/ /ces gathungs pas/ dbu rtse'i 'og khang gi byang chub chen po'i sku rgyab na/ ke'u tshang thog gsum sgo dgu nga yod/ mig gong ma'i nang na/ bka' rdzogs pa chen po bod du 'gyure dgu cog gi phyi mo dang / rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rnams kyi phyag dpe tā la'i lo 166

ma ma bris pa rnams dang / paṇ+ḍi rta bi mā la mi du'i ka pa li sor bzhi pa dang gotshob dpon pad+mas rdzu 'phrul gyis rgya gar nas blangs pa'i rgya dpe mang po dang /khyad par du klong chen rab 'byams dang 1 sems rgyud rnam pa ka dag dang /dzogs pa chen po sems mdo/bco brgyad la rgya dpe dang bod dpe gnyis su wad do/ /slob dpon la rgyal pos zhus pa'i zhu lan dang nyams myong gi gdams pa dang / jo mo mkhar chen bza'i zhus lan dang / mkhas pa mi bzhis medzad pa'i chos rnams bzhugs so/ /ke'u tshang mig bar pa'i nang na/ bde gshegs sgrub pa paka' brgyad kyi chos dang rgyal po'i phyag dpe rnams bzhugs pa ni/ zhi khro'i spyo rgyud dang bye brag gi rgyud gnyis su bzhugs pa las/ spri rgyud la rgyude tre chen po lnga babyugs pa ni/ thade bar gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyad dang / phyi ma nges par 'byub ba'i rgyud dang / phyi sa'i phyi ma sngags kyi rgyud dang / ma long ba ba skong ba'i rgyud dang / 'byed par byed pa sde mig gi rgyud dang lnga'o/ /bye brag gi rgyud la'ange / rtsa bo'i rgyud dang yan lag gi rgyud gnyis mu bzhugs pa las/ rtsa ba'i rgyud la dgojas rgyud btsu1ru bzhugs te/ zhi ba 'dus tha rtsa ba'i rgyud che mchog 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ khrag 'thung 'dus pa rtsa ba'i byed/ gshin rje 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rta mgrin 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud 'phrin las 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud1 ma mo 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dregs pa 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ drag sngargas 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ zhi khro 'dus pa rig 'dzin rtsa ba'i rgyud rnams bzhugs so/ /yan lag gi rgyud sde la ni/ 'jam dpal gshigo rje gshed la sku'i rgyud 'jam dpal gsang rgyud le'u nyer pa/nyis pa/'jam dpal gsang bar sgrub pa le'u bcu drug pa/ me lce'i phreng ba le'u bdun cu pa/ gzhon nu gedong drug pa'i rgyud/ khro bo sme brtsegs kyi rgyud/ dpa' bo drug pa'i rgyud/ mtshan brjod nges pa glur blangs kyi rgyud/ zla gsang nag po'i 167

rgyud/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud/ man ngag rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje thog 'apebs kyi rgyud/ rtog pa bdun pa'i rgyud/ bsad pa las bcu'i rgyud/ dgra nag 'khor lo'i rgyud/ sku la gsang ba'i rgyud/ gshin rje las kyi rgyud/ nyi ma bzhi pa'i rgyud/ gshin rje dmar nag gi rgyud/ gshin/rje khros/ba'i rgyud/ gtsug na me 'bar gyi rgyud/ 'jam dpal non po'i rgyud/ bsad pa 'khor po'i rgyud/bshan pa dmar nag gsod byed kyi rgyud/ 'khor lo nag po 'ching byed kyi rgyud/rak+ta glang mgo rngub byed kyi rgyud1 zangs khang dmar po sreg byed kyi rgyud/ mnan ༷pa'i rgyud 'phrin las rnam bzhi'o/ /las kha tshar kyi rgyud bsad pa'i las bcu dang / bsrung ba'i rgyud bla mtsho nag po/ myur du gsod pa bsad pa drag po'i sod/ bskang ba'i rgyud sku mchog rol pa/ pra dbab pa'i rgyud pra mo ka bam sgrub khro bo puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i rgyud/ sku dgra bsgral ba gshin rje gsal shing gi rgyud//de rnams ni gshin rje sku'i rgyud yin no/ /pad+ma gsung gi rgyud la/ rta mtshog rol pa'i rgyud/ rngog ma le brgan gye rgyud/ dbang rgyal bcud kyi rgyud/ dbadzi chen 'dus pa'i rgyud/ rta mgrin khros pa'i rgyud/ dregs pa kun 'ardul gyi rgyud/dregs pa tshar gcod kyi rgyud/ dregs pa dbang sdud kyi rgyud/ rta mgrin rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dbang chen rngam brjid kyi rgyud/ dbang chen kun 'dul gyi rgyud/ de rnams ༷rta mgrin gsung gi rgyud yin no/ /badz+ra te ru ka thugs kyi rgyud la/ nye ru ka gal po che chung gnyis la rgyud phran dang bcas pa/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i rgyud snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis/ kun 'dus rig pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rngam pa klog gi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud/ zla gsang thig le'inargyud/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud/ lha mo sgyu 'aspul gyi rgyud1 sgru 'phrul brgyad pa'i rgyud/ bzhi bcu pa'i rgyud/ bla ma'i rgyud/ le lag gi rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud sde bzhi/ gzhan yang te ru ka sku'i rgyud/ gsung gi rgyud/ thugs kyi 168

rgyud/ de rnams badz+ra he ru ka thugs kyi rgyud yin no/ /che mchog yon tan kyi rgyud la/ lung bdud rtsi bam po brgyad pa'i rgyud/ ye shes gsang ba 'khor lo'i rgyud/ dngos grub nye ba snying po'i rgyud/ badzud rtsi bum pa'i rgyud/ rnam dag dri med kyi rgyud/ dngos grub ster ba'i rgyud/ las rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ bde ba bdud rtsi thigs pa'i rgyud/ de rnams ni che mchog yon tan gyi rgyud yin no/ /rdo rje gasgon nu 'phrin las kyi rgyud la/ byi to ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud/ phur pa pha'i rgyud1 dam pa gsang chen phur pa ma'i rgyud/ rku be+e ya bcu gnyis gnyis ka'i rgyud/ rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud1 sangs rgyas rtse mo'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rtse mo'i rgyud do1 /yan lag gi rgyud sde la/ zlog phur bcu gnyis kyi rgyud/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rgyud1 grung ma bcu gnyis kyi rgyud do/ /byi to ta ma la'i rgyud la rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga/ snying po'i rgyud gsum/ yan lag gi rgyud bcu/ lo ma'i rgyud bzhi/me tog gi rgyud bcu/ 'bras bu'i rgyud bzhi/ ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i rgyud do/ / rtsa ba'i rgyud lnga la/ dang po ye shes 'khor lo sku'i rgyud/ pad+ma gsang ba gsung gi rgyud/ rnam dge rdo rje thugs kyi rgyud/ rin po che 'bar ba yon ten gyi rgyud /ral gri 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi rgyud do/ /snying po'i rgyud gsum la/ mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rgyud/ rin cen phung po'i rgyud do/ /yan lag gi rgyud bcu la/ shā kā ra ser ba dbab pa'i rgyud/ rnam par rgyal ba dbang bskuraXba'i rgyud/ dbyug pa sngon po sbyin sreg gi rgyud/ gshin rje gshed po las la gnid pa'i rgyud/ mi g.yo mgon po zlog pa'i rgyab rten gyi rgyud/ rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul ba'i rgyud/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po pho mo dgug pa'i rgyud/bdud me+e 'khyil pa bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i rgyud/ khams gsum rnam rgyal 'tshong drug las la gdags pa'i rgyud/ stobs po che ser ba gcod pa'i rgyud do/ /lo ma'i rgyud bzhi ni/ rnal 'byor bla ma'i rgyud/ bla na sked pa'i rgyud/ bla ma'i bla ma'i 6mi

/rgyud/ 'jig rten snang byed kyi rgyud do/ /me tog gi rgyud bcu ni/ 'khor lo gasnyar pa'i rgyud/ 'jig rten rab snang gi rgyud/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud/ gsang ba srog len gyi rgyud/ ye shes rtse mo'i rgyud/ mya ngan 'das pa phyi ma'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud/dur khrod khu byug rol pa'i rgyud do/ /'bras bu'i rgyud bzhi ni/ srus pa ma mo drug brtsegs kyi rgyud/ bse rgyud dmar mo'i rgyud/ shā na dmar nag gi rgyud/rtsa ba 'bum pa'i rgyud do/ /ma tshang ba kha skong ba'i/rgyud lnga ni/ gsang ba gter phyi rgyud/ gab pa gter gyi rgyud/ lta ba gter gyi rgyud/ 'phrin las gter gye rgyud/ man ngag gter gyi rgyud rnams so/ /gī lnga ya bcu gnyis kyi rgyud larto tī mā ya dgongs pa'i rgyud/ phyi ma sgogs pa'i rgyud/ phyi ma'i phyi ma 'phrin lam kye rgyud do/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i rgyud la yan/lag gi rgyud sde rnams kyis bskor ba ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu 'phrin las kyi rgyud do/ /ma mo bod gtong gi rgyud la/ ma mo gsang ba gtan chigs kyi rgyud/ srid pa'i bems chen le'u stong phrag gi rgyud/du ba'i rgyud le'u brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ rgyud phyi ma le'u pacu gcig pa rnams spri rgyud chen mo'o/ /bye brag ge rgyud la/ sku'i rgyud 'bum tig gsung gi rgyud ma lo rgyud lung / thugs kyi rgyud lha mo gsang ba'i rgyud mdzod do/ /yan lag gi rgyud sde ni/ sku 'dus pa dkar po spyi'i rgyud sde la/ shel mtsho dwangs pa'i rgyud/nyi ma brtsegs pa'i rgyud/ zla ba 'od chags kyi rgyud/ dri med dag pa'i rgyud/dam tshig rtsal sprugs kyi rgyud/ snang gsal sgon me'i rgyud do/ /las rgya mtsho'i rgyud gsum la/ spyi rlung las rgya mtsho'i rgyud/ phra men las spyo mtsho'i sted/dbang phyug las rgya mtsho'i rgyud do/ gsung 'dus pa spug mo bye'i rgyud la1spug mo tsirte stong zlog ma'i rgyud/ tsirte dgu brtsegs ma'i rgyud/ le brgan gur 'bum ma'i rgyud/ spe brtsegs dmar gog ma'i rgyud/ ma shan nag mo'i rgyud do/ /1da 0

thugs 'dus pa nag mo spri'i rgyud la/ skyeg nag 'khyil ba'i rgyud/ rgya mtsho gsang ba'i rgyud/ nag mo gzer nag gi rgyud/ gog mo mtsho skems kyi rgyud/nag mo mche gtsigs ma'i rgyud/ kun tu bzang mo bha ga skor bye rgyud do/ /yon nyan 'dus pa ser mo spyi'i rgyud la/ seng nag 'khyil ba'i rgyud do/ / /'phrin las 'dus pa dzong mo spyi'i rgyud la/ ljang nag 'khyil pa'i rgyud do/ /bye prag gi rgyud dang bcas pa ma mosathod gtong gi rgyud do/ /dregs pa kun 'dul gye rgyud la/rdosku'i rgyud dregs pa 'dus pa/ gsung gi rgyud ngan sngags nag po/ thugs kyi rgyud srog thig nag po/ yon tan gyi rgad dregs pa gter tsūn/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud /dregs pa las rim mo/ /sgos/rgyud ni ded dpon suzlo cu la/ so so'i rgyud bsam gyis mi khyabe pa zhig pazhuges so/ /de dag ni dregs pa kyen 'dul gyi rgyud ༷do/ /stobs ldan nag po'i rgyud la/ sku'i rgyud dregs pa shel phreng / gsung gi rgyud drag sngags 'dus pa/ thugs kyi rgyud tsit+ta dmar 'byide/ yon rtan gyi rgyud —drag sngags gter rgyud/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud las sna tshogs pa rnams so/ /sgos sprud ni dregs pa bco bgyed re re la sgrub thabs las phran dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /de'ang rgyud kyi skor/ lung gi skor/ ma na ngag gi skor rnamase su phye nas chabazhugs te/ de'ang rgyud kyi she+or la/ bde gshegs 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ phyo ma nges par 'byung ba'i rgyud/ bye ma'i phyi ma sngags kyi rgyud/ ma tshange ba kha skong ba'i rgyud/ 'byed par byed pa sde mig gi rgyud rnams ni spyi rgyud lnga yin/ de'i steng du sgos rgyud bcu ste bco lnga bzhugs so/ /lung gi skor la lnga ste/ nges pa don gyi lung / mdzad pa cho 'phrul lha'i lung / 'phrin las mthar byen sgrub pa'i /phung / thugs rje dpyang thag gnas kyi lung / gsal bar byed pa sgron me'i lung / shede ltar rgyud lung nyi shu'o/ /man ngag gi skor la gsum ste/ bye bshad thabs gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag nang sgrub thabs gsal bar byed pa'i man /71

ngag gsang ba de nyid gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag rnams su phye'o/ /de la byi bshad thabs gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag la lngar phye ste/ spri'i sdom lnga/ rgyud kyi chings lnga/ lung gi sdebs lnga/ sgrub thabs kyi sbyor so lnga ste nyi shu'o/ spyi'i sdom lnga ni/ lung gi bang mdzod/ bka'i tha ram/ lung gi sde mig lung gi bka' 'og sgrub pa lung gi bka' 'og dang lngar phye'o/ /rgyud kyi chings snga ni / ོga dbub stong thun gyi chings/ sa dpyad rnam 'byed kyi chings/ 'grel pa 'bru 'grel gyi chings/ ti ke bsdus don gyi chings/ lag len man ngag gi chings sdong lnga'o/ /lung gi sdepas lnga ni/ rgyud khyang dang sdebs/ lung sgrub thabs dang sdebs/ sgrub thabs 'phrin las dang sdebs/ 'phrin las lag len dang sdebs/ lag len nyams myong dang bsdebs pa nang lnga'o/ /sgrub thabs kyi sbyor so lnga ni/ rtsa ba sgrub thabs dang sbyor/ sgrub thabs 'phrin las dang sbyor/'aprin las sgom khog dang sbyor/ sgom khog teng nge 'dzin dang sbyor/ ting nge 'dzin man ngag dab sbyor ba lnga'o/ /de rnams phyi ltar bshad pa nyi shu'o/ /nang sgrub thabs gsal bar byed pa'i man ngag la'ang / zhi ba'i sgrub thabs dang /sgo bo'i sgrub thabs gnyis su mdzad/ dang po la lnga/ dam pa rigs brgya'i sgrub pa/ bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi sgrub pa/ de kho na nyid rigs lnga'i sgrub pa/ gsang chen rigs gcig gi sgrub pa/ zhi ba phyag rgya rkyang par sgrub pa dang lnga'o/ /dang bo dam pa rigs brgya la las chen lnga/ las chung lnga ste chos tshan bcu'i las chen lnga ni/ gzung ba dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rim pa dbang gi skyo ga byin rlabs rab gnas kyi cho ka tshe 'das ro sreg gi cho ga sto sgo sbyongs kyi cho ga dang lnga'o/ 4 /latsā chung lnga ni/ mnyes byed mchod pa'i cho ga mgron mchod gtor ma'i cho ga mchod sbyin chu gtor gyi cho ga sku gzugs sāts+tsha'i cho gabakra shis tshe'i cho ga dang lnga'o/ /zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyig la'ang sgrub thabs 172

lnga ste/ phyi bskyed rim du bsgrub pa/ nang rdzogs rim du bsgrub pa/ gsang me de kho na nyid du bsgrub pa/ 'phrin las dngos grub tu bsgrub pa/ las kha tshar du bsgrub pa dang lngango/ stede kho na nyid rigs dzir bsgrub pa la lnga ste/ phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bsgrub pa/ nang phung po'i dkyil 'khor du bsgrub pa/chagasang ba dug lnga'i dkyil 'khor du bsgrub pa/ de kho na nyid ye shes lngar bsgrub pa/ yongs surwadzogs pa sku lngar bsgrub pa dang lnga'o/ /zhi ba phyag rgya rgyang pa dwang / gsang chen rigs gcig la'ang sgrub lugs lnga lnga ste/ gnad lnga pacu skya lnga la brten nas 'khore 'das kyi chos thams cad gtan la phab ste sgrub pa dang / chos thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du 'du ba la rterten nas rgyun gyi yi dam nar mar bsgrub pa dang / 'phrin las kha tshar la brten nasaḥchos stod lam rim du bsgrub pa dang / rnam shes rtsal sbyong ma brten nas gsange sdegashe /gzhung tshul du bsgrub pa dang bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel la brten nas rgyun gyi yi chadam nar mar bsgrube pa'o/ /de ltar zhi ba la chos tshan sum cu'o/ khro bo la rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs dang / yan lag gi sgrub thabs gnyis las/ rtsa ba'i sgrub ༅bas la lnga/ bskyed rdzogs chen po rnam par spros pa dang / bsdus pa ga dga' /bar bskyed rdzogs 'bring po dang / shin nyu bsdus pa la dga' bar bskyed rdzogs pūng ngu dang / gang zag rgyun du sgrub par 'dod pa la sngags sgrub nar ma dang 1༷sko chung ba rnams la phyag rgya rkyang par bsgrub pa dang lnga'o/ /de dag kun la'ang sgrub lugs lnga lngar bkod do/ /phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bskyed pa ma hā yo gar bsgrub pa dang / nang phung po lha'i dkyil 'khor la badzhanacanas sgogs pa a nu yo gar bsgrub pa dang / gsang ba rig pa sems kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo gar bsgrub pa dang / de rngo go nyid lam gyi riyo pa la brten nas bskyed rdzogs zung 'grel du bsgrub pa dang /173

phren las yongs su rjogs pa la brten nas sgyu lus lha ru ngo sprod pa'o/ /yargo lag gi sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ byin rlabs kyi skrub chen lnga1 man gdags kyi las chen lnga/ 'phrin las kyi gzer chen lnga/ nyams chags kyi skong lnga/ rteXbastod bskul gyi bye brag lnga'o/ /dang po byin rlabs kyi sgrupa chen lnga ni/ dus kyi ngasnyen pa'i sgrub pa/ mchod rdzas bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa/ rim pa dbang gi sgrub pa/makra shis tshe'i sgrub pa/ byin rlabs phur pa'i sgrub pa dang lnga'o/ /phan gdags kyi las chen lnga la/ dam rdzas bam gyi las/ sreg sbyong ro'i las/ tshe 'das gshin gyi las/ 'dul ba gri'i las/ sgrol ba rgyu'i las so/ /'phrin las kyi gzer chen lnga ni/ 'khor lo la brten nas bsrung pa/ gtor ma la brten nas bzlog pa/ thun la brten nas bsad pa/ hom la brten nas sreg pa/ thod pa la brten nas mnan pa dang lnga'o/ /nyams chags kyi skong lnga la/ mchod pa phud kyi skong / dam jis mdangs kyi skong / sgog chags rgyu'i skong / 'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i skong / ming bzhi mdos kyi skong ngo / /bstod bskul gyi rgyas 'bring lnga la/ gzhi bstod chen mo chos nyid don gyi thu nas la bstod pa/ gzhi bstod bsdus pa lha'i tshom bu la bstod pa/ spyi bskul chen mo sku mdog phyag mtshan nas bskul ba/ 'bring po lha'i grangs nas bskul ba/ chung ngu dkyil 'khor gyi pho brang nas bskul ba'o/ /de ltar khro bo la chos tshan sum cu so lnga ste/sbrub thabs kyi chos tshan drug cu rtsa lnga'o/ /gsang ba nyams len gsal bar byed4pa'i man ngag la chos tshan nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ bskyed rdzogs kyi sgrub lugs lnga/rwogs kyi yan lag lnga/ thun mong gi rnal 'byor lnga/ khyad par gyi sgogs rim lnga/snyu gsum gyi gzer lnga'o/ /de la bskyed rdzogs kyi sgrub lugs lnga ni/ bskyed pa ma hā yo gar bsgrub pa/ rdzogs pa a nu yo gar bsgrub pa/ rdzogs pa chen po a shi yo gar bsgrub pa/ 'dod chags can zhi ba la brten nas bsgrub pa/ zhe snang 17

can khro bo la brten nas bsgrub pa'o/ 1sngags kyi yan lag lnga ni/ sngags kyi skrub thabs rin cen phreng ba/ sngags kyi bzlas pa bye brag dang bcas pa/ sngags kyi spu'i skyon yon dang pacas pa/ gsang sngags spyi'i sngags kyi don bstan pa/paskyed rim sngags kyi gegs sel ba dang lnga'o/ /thun mong gi rnal 'byor lnga ni/nang nub chos spyod kyi rnal 'byor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'phyor btung ba skom gyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam rgyun gye rnal 'byor dang lnga'o/ /khyad par gye sgogs rim lnga ni/ paskyed rim la brten nas lha'i jogs rim/ sems nyid la brten nas byang chub sems kyi jogs rim/ lus la —brten nas rtsa'i rdzogs rim/ dbugs la brtede nas rlung gi rdzogs rim/ bcud la brten nas thig le'i rdzogs rim dang lnga'o/ /sku gsum gyi gzer lnga la/ yi dam gyi lha la sku gsum gyi gzer gdab pa/ bar chod kyi bdud la sku gsum bye da zer gdab pa/ sdang pa'i dgra la sku gsum gyi gzer gdab pa/ 'gro drug gi /g.yang la sku gsum gyi gzer gdab pa/ 'byung bani nad la sku gsum gyi gzer cha nadab pa'o/ /de ltar gsang sngags kyi rgyal po bde gshegs 'dus pa 'di la spri rgyud lnga/ sgos rgyud bcu/ lung lnga ste nyi shu/ bshad thabs kyi chos tshan nyi shu ༷ste bzhi bcu'o/ /zhi ba'i sgrub thabs chos tshan sum cu/ khro bo la chos tshan ༷sum cu tso lnga/ nyams len la chos tshan nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bsgrub bya zhi khro gnyis/byud lung man ngag gi skor gsum ste/ chos tshan brgya sum cu rtsa lngas bskor nas bzhugadzo/ so/ gzhan yang slob dpon gyi ngan sngags mtha' dag ste/ drag po mthu'i 2sa nga shā+od brgya nang rtsa brgyad/ sbrub thabs brgya rtsa bathud/ drag sngaṭa brgya rtsa brgyad/ gdug pa gtad kyi las la rgyud brgya rtsa brgyad/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad/ drag sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ bsnyen pa bsrung bzlog gi las la rgyud babyu rtsa brgyad/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad/ drag sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/175

ngan thelas ser ba dang ltas ngan tsho 'phrul la rgyud brgya tso brgyad1 sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad/ las phran dang bcas pa/ srog ser gtad gsum la/ lag len chobagegs dang / 'phreng sel tshe'i zhus lan/ kun la dgos pa'i gter khyem/ srog khyim/ gtad khyim/ gnad khyim/ thug mtha'/ mthar thug dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /rkyen dang bar chad sel ba la skong zlog mdos kyi rgyud lag len stong phrag gcig bzhugs so/ /phyi nang gi 'byung ba'i gtsug lag kyang mang po bzhugs so/ /lus kyi nad gso ba'i sman dpyad kyang mang po bzhugs so/ /rig byed bzo'i yan lag bzo rig mang po'ang bzhugs so/ /bka' zab mo mkha' 'gro gnad kyi skor/ lung gi skor/ sgrub thabs kyi skor mang po'ang bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang slob dpon pad+ma 'a byung gnas/ mi mā la mi tra1 ha shang ma hā yā na rnams kyi thugs 'dzod brtol ba'i rgyud sgrub thabs/ zhal gye gdams pa/ the tshom sel ba'i zhus lan/ man ngag phra mo mang po dang bcas pa ke'u tshang bar ma na bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang khyad par du slob dpon pad+mas rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs su bzhugs nas rgyal po la gsungs pa'i bde gshegs 'dus pa/ dril zhing bsdus pa rgyal po'i thugs dam spri rgyud lnga/ sgos rgyud bcu/lung chen lnga/ bshad thabs la rgyud chings/lnga/ lung sdebs lnga/ sgrub thabs kyi spyor so lnga/ spri sdom lnga/ khro bo'i skrub thabs bskyed rdzogs che 'bring gsum/de rnams chu dar la gril nas 'dril shing gser las byas/ dngul gyi sbu gur bcug ste/ ke'u tshang bar ma'i dbus ka ba la khol du phyung nas shing chol la lcags kyi gzer btab nas bzhugs so/ /ke'u tshang 'og ma na slob dpon bo dhi sa rta'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa/ lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur pa/ kṛ ya dang / u pa/ yo ga 'dul ba/ mdo sde/mngon pa/ pha rol phyin pa la sogs pa bod du bsgyur tshad kyi phyi mo rnams4116

bzhugs so/ /de rnams ni rgyal po'i bla gter chen mo zhes bya'o/ /gter byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las chos gter dang rgyal po'i bla gter gyi le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ gzhan yang nor gyi gter sbas pa ni/ kha /byang nas/ dbu rtse rigs gsum 'og khang gi /byang chub hūṃn po'i maṇ+ḍal 'oke / 'khar rkyen sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ /rin cen sishe mas bkang ba ༷ni/ /g.yam sgrom khro chus sbyar par bcug /rin cen sa yis rgyas btab nas/ //nanod sbyin 'brog gnas mched lnga dang / /darkar bdag glu yi phyag tu gtad/ //ces gsungs pas/ dbu rtse chen mo 'i dkyil/ byang chub chen po'i skyil krung bcas pa'i mdun 'dom gang bcal ba'i sa la mda' gang khru gang brus pa'i 3sar/ rdo sgrom g.yam pas kha bcad pa'i nang na/ 'khar ba'i rkyen che ba cig la ༷sbrul gyi gzungs ka gsum dang bcas pa yod/ de'i nang na gser bre la bcal /ba'i khal gsum yod/ de klu la gtad pas klu sgrub zhag gsum bya zhing / gnod desbyin la'ang gnyer gtad pas gnod sbyin gyi mdos bya ba dang / dkor bdag pe shakar la gnyer gtad pas bya pho dkar po dar snas brgyan pa phul rme gsol ka rgyas par gtong ba gces so/ /gter 'di ni rgyal po yab sras bka' bgros te/ dbu rtse'i gsos dang / rgyal brgyud rnams kyi dor skal du bsngos nas sbas so/ /phyi rabs rgyal brgyud byang chub sems dang ldan pa gtsug lag khang dang bla mchod la mos pa/ rten bzhengs pa'i bya ba la brtson pa/ dkon cog la dad pa/ngang ring pa/ rgyud dal ba/ sems drang ba/ gzugs bzang ba/ rgyal po'i rtags chen po bdun dang ldan pa/ thugs sgam pa/ bka' btsan pa/ khong yangs pa/ zungs thub pa/ zhe bcad rab tu che ba/ thugs stobs dang ldan pa / sems can la brtse ba chen po dang ldan pa/ khyi 'brug glang lug bzhi'i lo 177

pa dang 'phrad par shog rtes smon lam btab bo/ /sgo srung phug na rdo rje'i lte khung nas mdun dzu 'dom gang bcal ba dang mda' gang 'og gi rdo sgom gyi nang /phrin po'i thod pa cig na gser dang mtshal bsres pa bre la bcal ba'i khal phyed yod/ de thog mar bse'i ga'ur bcug de nas zangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas yod/phyag rdor gyi bsnyen pa zhag bdugo byas la gus pas 'don/ gtsug lag khang gi gsos su spyad par bya'o/ /khro bo mi g.yo ba'i zhabs g.yas kyi mthe bong nas mdun du 'dom gang bcal ba'i sa ru khru gang byas pa na rdo sgom cig na/ byad mig gcig pa'i thod pa'i nang du/ gser dang dngul 'dres pa bre bdun yod/de 'don pa'i dus su mi g.yo ba'i bsnyen pa/zhag gsum dang mchod pa rgyas par bya/ thod pa gnyis lcags rdos bkang la/ gser phul re blug ste sngar bshin rgyas gdab bo/ /dbu rtse'i nang gi zur bzhi'i rtsig pa nas sa'i mtshams su khru re brul pa na/ dngul sgrom re na dngul gyi bum pa bzhi'i nang du/ dung g.yas su 'khyil ba re dang / lha glu mi gsum gyi nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang 13 dang/dar zab kyi rim pa sna tshogs yod/ de thog mar dbu rtse rmang 'ding ba'i dus su sa'i gta' bsdams pa zhes bya ste 'don par ma bshad do/ /byang chub chen po'i 'og na shing gi sgo khrigs yod/ de'i nang na 'bru sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i nang du/ dar zab kyi sgrom bu dgu dar zab kyis bkang nas yod do/ /de'i 'og sa la brus pa na zangs kha sbyar gyi nab du/ bskos pa'i rgyal po sde bzhi'i thod pa'i nang / lha glu mi gsum gyi rin po che sna tshogs pas bkang ba/ de dar zab sna tshogs pas gril nas ga'u rigs bzhir bcug pa ni/ lho phyogs rgya gar rgyal po'i thod/pa gser gyi ga'ur bcug byang ge sar rgyal po'i thod pa gci'i ga'ur bcug nub ta zig gi rgyal po'i thod pa mchong gi gnyur bcugashar rgya nag rgyal po'i thod pa dngul gyi ga'ur bcug rgya rim pa gsum gyes 178

btab pa byang chub chen po'i zhabs 'og tu bcug nas yod do/ /de'i dbang gis mtha'i rgyal po rgyal phran dang bcas pa bod kyi rgyal po'i mnga' 'og tu non pa dang / mtha'i nor thams cad dbus su 'du ba dang / khro bo gnyis kyes ma rungs pa'i thod pa gnyis zhabs 'og tu mnan bas/ srin po dang bdud la sob/sa pas bran dang khol po byed par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni bod kyi rgyal po che ba'i rten 'brel gyi gter zhes bya ste 'don par ma bshad do/ /gzhan yang dbu rtse'i bar khang gi zha rtse'i 'og dbus drang po nas khru de bcal ba'i sa na mtho gang brus pa'i 'og rtsig pa'i dkyil na so phag gi sgom re yod/ de bzhi'i nang du gwaser gyi sgom bu re na nor bu bsam 'phel rin po che mar gad re re chu1dar gyes gril nas yod/ bum pa gaper gyis bkang ba'i dkyil na rin po che mtho/re /tsam pa re/ bum pa'i nang na mtho re lhag pa re bzhugs so/ /'di ni rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / mgon po trag shad dang / pe dkar shing byu can la gtad do/ /nor bu ni rgyal brgyud kyi nor du bsngos/ gser ni darkar khang gi gsos su bsngos so/ /bar khang gtso bo'i gdan khri'i 'og dbus drang po'i sa mtshams mtho gang brus pa na/ chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' rtags bcu gsum bya ba dang / da lta nyid du sims nyid gtan la 'bebatsā pa'i/rdzogs pa chen po rang grol sde mig ces bya ba dang / rdzogs pa chen po dngas ma mig gi 'bras bu nyi zla'i ngo sprod ces bya ba dang / rdzogs pa chen po 'od khyim kha sbyor gyi ngo sprod ces bya ba dang / rdzogs pa chen po dwangs ma man shel dri med la ngo sgod pa zhes bya ba dang / man shel snying gi me long be+e ma lha ru ngo sprod pa zhes bya ba de rnams shog ser la bris te dngul gyi ga'ur bcug nas/ seng ldeng gi sgrom bur rgya rem pa bdun gyis btab nas bzhugs tho/ /gnyer gtad pa'i gter bdag ni ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gtad pas/ 'don pa'i dus su rig 'dzin rnams la gsol 17mi

ba gdab/ tshogs 'khor phul le 'don par bya'o/ /steng khang gi gtso bo rnam /snang kun tu zhal gyi gdan khri'i 'og shā ri'i bu'i lhung bzed kyi nang na/ lha klu mi gsum gyi rin po che sna tshogs pas bkang ba dang / mo dgal gyi bu'i chos gos dar chen sna tshogs kyis gril nas zangs kyi sgrom du bzhugs pa dang / 'od srungs kyi lhung bzed sman sna tshogs kyis bkang nas bse'i ga'u kha spyar du rgyas btab nas bzhugs so/ /'di ni gtsug lag khang che ba'i gter zhes bya ste//de'i dbang gis mtha'i mkhas btsun bod du 'byon pa dang / sde snod thams cad dar ba dang / dge slong dang / dge tshul dang / dge 'dun gyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag rgyas par 'gyur ba'i gter ro/ /steng khang gi gdung g.yung drung ris kyi sna lho nub zur la/ gser gyi pa turi dkyil na/ g.yu'i phra btsugs pe wad/ de'i rtsa na shis chol sor bzhi pa cig yod/ de gzong gis bkog pa na lcags kyi sbu gu mtho gang pa cig yod/de na gnod sbyin rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs dang / nor bu bzang bo dang /gang ba bzang po dang / be dkar dang / a ling ka dang / u ling ka 'dasogs pa gter srung yongs kyi sgrub thathamasaXrnams bzhugs so/ 1zab rgya dbu ce 'og khang gi snga gdong nas/ them pa'i nang pos g.yas kyi re bzhi'i zur nab/khru do sor brgyad bcal ba na/ khru do thur du bkos pa'i sar/ rdo sgrom khro chus sbyar ba yod/ de 'i nang du gsal gyi rdza ma cig yod/ de'i nang na dngul gyi bya pho pang therge gi nang gser dngul gyi sbram ste gang yod/ de'i nang na shel gyi ga'u cig na gzi mig med bre gang yod/ de'i nang na ga zi'i ga'u yod/ de'i nang na srog bdag gsang ba snying gi sgrub thabs dang / pe dkar las kyi rlung dmar gyi sgrub thabs yod/ de pe dkar la gtad pas 'don pa'i dus su bye la chadang bya dkar pos mchod/ gser skyems rgyas par btang la 'don no/ /zab/130

rdo ring gi rdobapad+ma cig ge 'og na/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi ngos su blta ba'i phyogs kyi rdo'i pad+ma'i rtse mo thur la blta ba'i 'og mda' gang brus pa'i sa na/ rdo sgom rdo leb rang 'thag 'dra ba zhig gis kha bcad pa'i 'og nang sol phyes bkang ba'i dbus su zangs kyi bum pa cig gi nang na gser phye bre bdun yod do/ /rnapa/ thar sgo gsum nyams pa'i dus su gso ba'i rkyen du bzhag pa'o/ gnod sbyin sibha mu kha la gtad pas/ 'don pa'i dus su sgos mdos dang gsol ka rgyas par bya'o/ /de'i shul du zangs bum de nyid lcags rdo zangs rdo zha nye'i rdos bkang la gzhag par bya'o/ /gter byang mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las bsam yas dbu rtse chen mo'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// /// de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dkor mdzod dgu ni rgyud kyi mdzod/ re re'i nang na kethu tshang re/ /dkor mdzod dbus ma'i ke'u tshang nang / /tā la'i po ma'i bka' po ti/ /glegs bam bdun cu rtsa drug ni/ /rgya pod lo paṇa rgya dpe bzhugs/ /rgya nag shog bu gril ma la/ /hā shang ma hā lnga na yis/ rgya nag 'gyur gyi chos sde ni/ /seng ldeng sgom bu bcu gnyis bzhugs1 /bod shog glegs bam bzhi brgya la/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 1g.yas kyi kenyu tshang sgo nang na/ /rgyud 'bum glegs bam bzhi bcu dang / /mdo mang gzungs kyi sde tshan la/ /glegs bam brgya dang bdun cu bzhugs/ /g.yon gyi ke'u tshang sgo nang na/ /'bum dang nyi khri pha rol phyin/ 1shes rab phyogs kyi glegs bam ni/ /bdun cu rtsa brgyad dong na bzhugs1 /bka' pota spung khri'i 'og na yang / /gling gso gang dgos spyod pa yi/ /mañji ting tshar nyi shu dang // zangs gzhong nyi shu dril bu bdun/ /rdo rje bdun dang khrus bum bdun /riṭa lnga'i sangs rgyas khru re dang / /gser sku dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs/ rdo'aphags pa'i rgyal po spyan ras gzigs/ /sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / /tshe 31

'das spreng pa sbyong ba yi/ /gapher sku bcu dang mchod cha bzhugaso/ /gsung rab rgyud kyi glegs bam dang / /gaper sku mchod pa'i dkor cha ni/ /bod ༷khams sto+ong sde spyi la spyo // /dri khang sgos kyi mdzod gsum ni/ /g.yas pa'i mdzod na sgos dkar dang / /a ka ru dang tu ru ka /dri bzab sman gye tshogs shoms la/ /zangs dang lcags kyi sgros phor ni/ /bzhe shācu rtsa lnga bdug spos kyes/ /nang nub mchod pa'i dri/bsung 'bul/ /sgos marjad dbus ma'i nang shed na/ /tsardon phur ma'i 'dam pa dang / /shing spos sna tshogs dri yis bkang / 1g.yon pa'i mdzod na sman sgos kyis/ /nyin mtshan rgyun chad med parngo mchod/ /ca/tha' yi spos gnyer rim pa yis/ /rgya bod mtshams da nga mon bod mtshams/ /bal bod mtshams kyi sman spos rnams/ /mi khur nyi shu nyi shu yis/ /zla ba re ma darkar mdzod khenges/ /zhun mar phag rir she ma btsugs/ /nad khongs lung par she ma btsugs/ /rtsi bcud mar gyi mi khur ni/ /lo re bzhin du lnga brgya sayis/ /ma khang lcags ri'i nang du phebs/ /rgyal po yab sras blon chen rnams/ /shal bsil btung ba'i gsol skyems la/ /mon yul 'bras chang ding ma dang / /tsha ba yul gye rgun chang dang / /gnya' nam mang yul go le'i skyems/ /mdo ༷khams stod kyi zhal bsil rnams/ /kang mgyogs khe+or yug lag brgyud bskos/ /༷bse lag brgya brgyas snga dro res/ /rgyal po yab sras spyan sngar ni/ /rlang ma /yol ba brtol ba 'byung / /shā ltar bab skor bskos pa ni/ /brgya brgyas bye dro satshams la brtol /brgya brgyas nyin phyed gung la brtol/ /brgya brgyas nyi ma sprur na brtol/ /de bzhin mnga' ris skor gsum gyes/ /rgyal po'i gsang bu 'dren byed pa/ / dro dus nyi ma'i gong du ni/ khor yug rkang maspru+ogs pargya brgya yis/ /bshos gtsang zhal zago spyanapagazigs tshogs/ /dngul gzhong dngul ༷sder bsnams zhal rnams/ /bkang nas pus btsugs thal so sbyar/ /sangs 137

nas zug nem snyun med 'dri/ /skyogs ka lan gsum phyi ma la/ /bsnams zhal la sogs bteg nas ni/ /rgyal po'i phyag tu gus pas phul/ kha byang mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las zhal skyems gsol zas mi zad gter la mnga' brnyes pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi ba'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rin cen gter gyi mdzod gsum la/ /gsum ka'i nang na ke'u tshang re/ /ke'u tshang dbus ma'i sgo nang na/ /mi'u sde bzhi skad pa yis/ /phyogs nas phul ba'i sgor chen ni/ /rgya gar rgyal po'i nor chen rdzas/ /gser dngul pa tra nor gyis bkang / /ke'u tshange g.yon pa'i sgo nang na/ /rgya nag rgyal pos phul ba'i nor/ /gser gyi dong tse la sogs pa/ /dar zab rin cen tshogs kyis bkang / /ke'u tshang g.yas pa'i sgo nang na/ /ta zig rgyal pos phul ba yi/ /gsed dang rin cen sman gyis bkang / /gru gu rgyal pos phul ba yi/ /g.yu dang rin cen sman gyis bkang / /rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pa ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan gang dgos sbyor/ kha byang mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las dbu rtse dkor mdzod kyi lenyu ste bco lnga pa'o1/ // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ (dpe rnying lcags sprug gis bres pa zhig la lelu 'di dang bcu bdun pa gnyis 'dug pa ltar bris) mtshams kyi so kha dag nas dpya bsdus kyi/ /rin cen dar zab dngos po rnams/ /zangs sgod 'khar nga lcags kyi sgod/ /phyogs nas bsdus pa'i nor sna rnams/ khams gsum zangs khang dga' ldan gser khad dang / /bye ma gling dang jo mo rnam gsum gyi/ /phyag tu gtad nas dgor mdzod kun rnams zhagengs/ /yum sras blon 'bangs spyi la spyod pa'i nor/ kha byang mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las jo mo gling gsum gyi dkor mdzod kyi lenyu ste bcu drug pa'o// // 183

de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /pe dkar gling gi darkar mdzod rnams kyi nang / /dpa' gtum stag rjes dmag gas btul ba yi/ /mtha' nas phrogs blangs nor dang rngos kyi rigs/ /rin cen nor dang zab chen rnams kyis bkang / /sbrang dang bu ram mngar ba'i dos rnams dang / /stag nga/zig pags pa zha nye'i pha bong dang / /zangs kyi pha bong lcags kyi zhun 'ing dang / /rin cego mching bu skong dang mche'u ma/ /dbyig gi ltang tse dong tse'i rgun 'brum dang / /zangs chen mar bkang lcags kyi sgod rnams dang / /gos dang bal 'jam phyug dang/nas kyis mdzes/ /sha mar thum bag sna tshogs zas kyis mdzes /snga gos 'bri bal sha ba'i bal lngags dang / /thug chil ra tshil rta mar g.yag tshil mdzes/ /g.yag rgod rta lug sha gsum gsar rnying mdzes/ /'bras chang nas chang go la zho dkar mdzes/ /gang la gang dgyeg longs spyod bsam yas spyod/ /gang la spri dgos bsam yas kun la spyod/ /longs spyod bsam yas 7ོnga sde spri yi nor/ /rgyal blon bod mi spri mthun yongs kyi nor/ /bka' yi blon 'bangs phyag tshang nang blon dang / /sku yi gsol ka rgyal po'i gnyer gtad dang / /jo mo sku gnyer 'bangs kyi so tshis la/ /bka' yi pho blon 'khor pho 'khor mo dang / /rta gnyer phyugs sdud chab bzhugs me 'don dang / /dur srungs la sogs yongs kyis spyod pa'i nor/ /bod khams stong sde spri yi dkor mdzod yin/ /rgyal po'i 'phrin las sku 'khor stong sde gsum/ /stong sde gnyis la g.yon ru'i bka' btags dang / /chab 'og bka' btags dbu ru'i stong sde lnga/ /g.yes ru g.yon ru bka' btags stong sde bdun/ /stong sde bco brgyad bod khams gzhi ma'i sa/ /de yi bye rim stong sde'i sde tshan la/ /mon bod mtshams kyi stong sde bzhi rnams ni/ /mdo khams smad kyi stong sde ru pa rnams/ /bka' la btags nas la stod lung par bgig /rgya bod mtshams kyi 84

/stong sde'i so srungs rnams/ /sum pa'i mi sde bka' la btags nas ni/ /yi gnyag yul du so mtshams gnyer la bskos/ /stong sde dang po bod khams ru bzhi btul/ /bod khams ru bzhi phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi btul/ /rgyal po'i ring du chab srid mnga' ru bsdus1 /bod khams rgyal po stong sde'i sa khul ni/ /yul gyi mi la mi sde'i grangs btab pa/ /stod kyi zhang zhung stong sde bcu gsum yod/ /smad na sum pa stong sde bcu gsum yod/ /phyogs su dmag gis rgya yi mtha' la phul/ /bod khams ru bzhi yul gyi grangs btab pa/ /dbu ru g.yas ru g.yon ru ru lag bzhi/ /g.yas ru'i glungs la yul sde bcu drug yod/ /byang phugs tre shod zang zang stag sde dang / /stag ris mus sdog 'jad dang rta nag dang / /zhan thag shangs dang mon mkhar ge re dang / /lang 'gro spa gor tshur zho snye mo bcas/ /de rnams g.yas ru'i yul sde bcu drug yin/ /nang blon rnams kyis grangs su btab pa'i dus/ /g.yon ru ru lag yul gru bcu drug la/ /dpal ma chad lung ding ri sri yul dang / /mnga' ris pa drug 'bri mtshams sras kyi yul/ /kram lung shab lung nyang ro nyang stod dang / /gtsang bzhi ri bo yul gru bcu drug yin/ /dbu ru'i yul gru bcu drug 'di lta ste/ /stod lung phar kyang klung shod mal gro 'dam dang ba lam deng / /ngan lam rag nas 'breng dang g.yu khung dbu sa skor/ /gzhol skungs 'phan yul rong shod bra rnams bcu drug yin/ /g.yon ru'i yul gru bcu drug 'di ltar ro/ /dwags po nga rab gung po sar klungs dang / /'grangs te gnyal lo ro dang 'khag pa dang //rtam shul gra lung dol gzhung dang / /yab 'brog la sogs bcu drug ming du btags/ /bod khams stong sde rgyal po'i bka' khrims pa/ /rje yi bka' blon chab srid gnya' gnon yin/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las dkor mdzod gling dang skor 'bangs kyi le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// // 185

di nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /brag dmar 'dzam bu gling stod na/ rteslob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /tshe chu phra men bum pa gang / /dngul byi ga'ur rgya nan byas/ /g.yam sgrom nang du rgyas btab bzhag /ces gsungs pas/ brag dmar 'dzam bu gling stod na/ brag bya khyung gi gshog pa brkyangs pa 'dra ba yod/ de'i ngos la mtshal gyi rdo rje rgya gram yod/ de nas tshangs thig drangs pa'i 'og tu/ mda' gang brus par g.yam sgrom sol phyes bkang ba'i dkyil na/ zangs kha sbyar nas tshig gis bkang ba'i dbus/ dngul gyi ga'u'i nang na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan mi yul/du dgung lo stong phrag gsum bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes bka' gnang mdzad pa'i rjes la che chu bsgrubs pa yod/ de'ang brag dmar g.ya' ma lung du nam mkha' che rdzogs chen dri med ka dag gi dbang chen mo mdzad/ rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang bskud ba'i dus su/ rgyal po'i zhal nas slob dpon chen po lags rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba rnams/ bskal thog dang po nas 'jig rten ma stongs bar du bzhugs pa/ slob dpon nyid lta bu rnams thabs zab mo ji lta bu'i sgo nas brnyes pa lagag zhes zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas legs so rgyal po chen po/ rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba rnams ni/ steng nge 'dzin rtse gcig tu 'khor 'das su shan bye nas bsgoms pas/ lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur nas sa non pa'ang yod do/ /lus rdo rje pha lam lta bur gyur nas bgres rgud mi mnga' ba'ang yod do/ 1dbang po yang rab kyis lus gnad gzir nas bsgoms pas sems rtags lus la shar nas/ bsam pa'i yul du/skad cig la zhing khams myul ba dang / rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa'ang yod do/ /yi dam lha'i rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub brnyes pas dngos su dbang bskur te/ de nyid dang khyad med du gyur nas tshe la mnga'e brnyes pa'ang yod do/ /bcud len 186

dang sman gyi dka' thub la brten nas sha rus bdud rtsi lta bur gyur te sman gyi sla lta bur gyur nas che nyi 'i dang mnyam pa'ang yod do/ /mgogo po che dpag tu rmed pa lta bur gyur pa'ang yod do/ /rig 'dzin tshe la dbang ba'i sgrub pas dngos grub tshe la dbang bskur nas tshe lo stong phrag tu bzhugs pa'ang yod do/ / yang de nyid la gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis tshe lo lnga brgyar bsrings pa'ang yod do/ /zhes gsungs pas rgyal pos zhus pa/ slob dpon chen po bdag la'ang rig 'dzin gyi gral du tshe la dbang ba'i dbang bskur bar zhu zhes zhus pas/sgob dpon gyi zhal nas rje gcig lags jo mo 'khor 'bangs dang bcas pa dkor mdzod mnga' ris dang bcas pa bdag la phul zhig rje nyid mi yul du lo stong phrag gsum bzhugs pa bdag gis bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /de nas brag dmar g.yang ma lub gi dben gnas thu/ tshe dasheg med rkye dkyil 'khor zhal bye phra men gyi bum pa rtsi bcud kyis bkang nas/ zla ba gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i dus gu mgon po che dpag tu med pa 'ja' tshon gyi sku lta bu zhig bum pa'i steng du byon nas/ mi dang mi phrad pa lta bur gsung sgogs te/ skyes bu skal pa ldan pa gang na yod/ /'jig rten 'di na tshe yi snod dkon pas/ /des na tshe la dpang ba nyi blo tsam/ /che yi sgod yod skyes bu su la bya/ /tshe 'dod skyes thu me tog u dum 'dra/ 〉/las sgrib med na tshe chu 'di la 'thung / 1'di 'thungs tshe lo stong phrag bdun tshe gcig /sems can lus la skal ba bzang por byas/ /rnam smin sgyu lus rdo rje lta bur gyur/ /'byu nga ba'i phung po 'jigs pa kun dang bral/ /zhes chos nyid kyi rang sku mkha' la sgogs so/ /de'i dus su bsam yas kyi lung pa sman dris khengs/ tho rengs rgyal po'i ma la lam du/ dbu rtse'i steng du mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa byon te/ bsam yas mgims phu'i g.ya' ma lung du phyag brkyangs ba/ tshe chu'i byum pa la reg gi/nadug pa rmis so/ /de nas ma la sad /37

pa'i dus su/ stan las bzhengs dus la bab par shes te/ dbu rtse nas g.ya' sam lung du slob dpon gyi spyan sngar gshegs par sgo drung du slebs pa'i dus su/blon chen glu dpal gyis blon po rnams sbran ste/ blon po chen po rta ra glu gong —dang / blon po chen po rdo rje spre chung dang / blon po chen po khri 'bring lha lod chadang / blon po chen po shud pu dpal seng dang / blon po chen po rgya tsha lha snang chadang / blon po chen po khri bzang yab lha rnams kyis gros byas pa la/ klu dpal dang klu gong gnyis gsung mthun par/ mtha'i mon bu 'dod/pa can 'dis/༷rgyal po blun rmongs phag gdong 'dra ba 'di la rtsi gtong bar 'dug pas shol thob/ bedag blon po seng ge 'dra ba rnams la'ang 'ong nyen yod pas/ so so'i gnyen po bsten zhes smra'o/ /rdo rje spre chung dang shud pu dpal seng gnyis gsung 'cham ste/ de nyid legs par soms shig mi srid do/ /slob dpon 'jig rten spangs pa'i skyes mchog la/ /rgyal po'i rgyal sas slob dpon ci zhig bya/ /zhes zer ro/ /glu dpal na re/ slob dpon rgyal po'i rgyal sar rngams pa 'dug /chagaya'am lung du zla ba snga ma la/ /rje 'bangs tshogs pa'i dbang gi dus su yang / /rgyal po'i sku tshe ring bar 'dod pa na/ /dkor mdzod jo mo ma 'a ris phul zhig gsungs/ /nang rtags phyir shar shing gi yal ga 'dra/ /zhes zer ro/ /rgya tsha lha nang na re/ rgyal po tshe ring bod khams yongs la gces/ /slob dpon 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa la/ /dkor mdzod jo mos slob dpon ci zhig bya/ /zhes zer do/ /shud bu dpal seng na re/ kun la gces pa rgyal bo tshe ring na/ /rang nyid kun gyi bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub/ /ces ༷zer ro/ /glu dpal na re/ tshe ring 'dod bas rang srog rtsa ba skyel/ /nang na /sked na phyi ru ci la brtol/ khyed rnams kun la de 'dra'i tshod yod min/ /rgyal lapo med pa'i blon pos ci zhig bya/ /rgyal po'i spyan sngar da lta la 'ur 'dengs/ /188

khyed rnams smra ba'i gros chod gang lags kyang / /gting phugs nga yi thog tu ma tso+ong na/ /tha mar khyi yi blon po rlung gis khyer/ /zhes zer te/ klu dpal gyis blon po gzhan rnams sba dbyug gipa brdungs so/ /de rnams rgyal bo'i spyan sngar —phyin te/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyi sgo khang du/ rgyal po phyir gshegs pa'i chibs kha nas bzung ste/ blon po rnams kyis phyag byas zug nem pa'i dus su/klu dpal gyis zhus pa/ kye rgyal po chen po lags tshe'i dbang la bzhud dgongs ba lags na sku srog 'dor ba'i nyen gda'o/ /mtha'i mon bu 'dod pa can 'di rje'i gdan sa la rings par 'dug skad do/ /che chu sgrub kyigo yod skad pa de la gshegs pa na blun rmongs pa'o/ kha sang zla ba snga mar rgya gar ba rtsi dug khur ba'i mi gnyis mchims phur song ba las/ bla mchod paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis kyis gser bcal nas khud du sbas pa mthong ba 'dug go /rtsi dug pa gnyis kyis pazod pa ri gdong gi brag la yi ge bris/ gru pa la 'phrin brdzangs nas/ /dogs yod zon gyis shig skad do/ /zhes smras te chibs kha nang du bzlog pas/ /rgyal po'i dgongs pa la mi srid thang de ci yin mi shes snyam ste/ chibs pa'i steng nas bshol te nang du bzhud do/ /de nyid slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas/ g.ya' ma lung gi brag phug nas tshe chu bsnams te/ 'dzam bu gling stod du byon pa'i dus su/ tshe chu rlajupa phyur phyur/ khol lhog stog skad tsir tser byung ngo / /de nas brag bya khyung ge gshog pa 'dra ba'i ngos la mtshan ma btab ste/ de'i 'og tu rdo sgrom sum sbrags byas/ phra men gyi bum pa gzi'i ga'ur bcug snye/ de zag sa kyis gril nas gter du sbas so/ /slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten 'di na che yi sdod dkon pas/ /rig 'dzin gral du 'gro ba'i thabs bgyis kyang / /snyigs ma'i sems can bsags pa chung srid dam/ /rgyal po'i las la skal par ma gong ngam/ /skal ldan tshe reng las 'phro med sdid dam/ /rgyal po ma yis 83

mngal ga stong kogs sam/ /skye 'chi 'byung 'jug las la sgo srid dam/ 1/rlung 'khor shing rta zo chun 'khyud mo bzhin/ /'khor ba'i skyes bu las ngan dogs srid dam/ /brtse ba'i gros dang zhal ta nyan pa med/ /the tshom can gyi rgyal po yi re mug /nam zhig rgyal po skal ldan las 'phro can/ /rdo rje spre chung skye ba bcu bdun tha/ khri rgyal zhes bya rgyal po'i mtshan rtags can/ /thugs sgam bka' btsan ṇang yangs zungs thub pa/ /thugs stobs che zhing gsang rjo+ogs chos la spyod/ 1kun gyi bkur gnas mchod gnas rim gro'i gnas/ /skal ldago las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog /ces smon lam btab nas sbas so//kha byang mdzod kyi sde 'i ga rgyud las 'dzam bu gling stod kyi che chu'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ (lethu 'di zam bu lung na rten gyi bu zhig la 'dug pa ltar bris)dbu ru skyid smad snye mda' na/ /brag dmar zangs g.yag ces pya ba/ /lag sor 'dra ba'i tshigs pa la/ /sgrub gnas zla gam dmar po'i nang / /slob dpon pad+ma'i dpe cha dang / /rten dang sgub rdzas khyad 'phags bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /brag zangs g.yag mo'i shar logs kyi mtha' dang / g.ya' mtshams na/ brag gi steng kha zhig na sgos brdung ba'i gtun dang /rdo gzhong sbrel ma zhig yod/ rdo gzhong gi dbus na nub byang mtshams su rkang 'dom nyi shu rtsa gcig 'jal ba na1 brag la 'bur zhes bya ba/ brag spe'u'i pus mo 'dra ba'i rtsa na/ rtsig pa'i skor ra zhig gi nang na shug pa phung po gcig btsugs nas yod/ rtsig pa de bshig la pha tshad du bsdus so/ /shug pa de'i rtsa bar spungs pa'i sa rdo sa ngas kyis bsal lo/ /de'i shul na g.yam pa me long 'dra —ba zhig yod/ de'i 'og tu ga ru btsugs nas bkan la g.yon du phul la gtang ༷ngo / /di'i 'og na gnam sgo gcig g.yam pas sgo bcad nas yod/ g.yam 190

pa de la rkan gnyeb 'dra ba yod/ de yang ga rus bkan la g.yas su phul nang du phyin nas gnam sgo'i thad ka na sgar khung zhig yod/ de nang nas rdos brdungs pas zhig nas dkar lam gyis 'ong / de'i nang na dkyil labor zhig gi steng na gser gyi rdo rje gzhon nu khru gang pa zhig gi mdun na mañji bdun gyi steng ting bdun gyi nang na gser shing sbang bdun yod/ rdo gsal gyi rdza ma che ba cig gi nang na/ zhi khro'i spyi rgyud dang / bye brag gi rgyud sde/ yongs su sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi chos tshan brgya dang sum cu rtsa lnga/ bde gshegs 'dus 'i chos tshan ma lus pa yod/ dkyil 'khor gye 'og skar khung na rgyal po skye ba bdun pa'i thod pa dang / brachu/ ze skye ba bdun pa'i thod pa gnyis yod/ dug sgog mar/la 'gro ba'i rkan sgra can zhes bya ste/ 'dzam gling smra shes dang 'phur shwes gnyes yod/ dkyil 'khor o khrum nyi shu rtsa gcig gi steng na/ lcags phur nyi shu rtsa gcig yod/ gathims mal gyi skar khung na/ ngan sngags kyi skor zab dgu rnams yod do/ /rgya'i chu chu yod/ nang na chu mig yod/ brag phug gi gnam sgo'i logs la rgyal po'i bla g.yu pha bong tsam yod/ gter sruja thang lha gangs btsan la mar dang lug gis mchode / dam can rdo rje legatha/ pa la ra'i sha khrag gis mchod/ lha sman la 'brang rgyas kyis mchod/ gzhan yang gser skyems rgyas par gtang// gdan khri'i 'og nas khru gang brkos pa na/ dam sri mnan pa dang / lpu+ol po 'dul ba'i mgo ngag me chu rlung 'khrugs pa'i 'khor lo gzir ba la sogs tsha bses gril ba rdo gsal gyi ga 'ur bcug pa yod do/ /sa mā ya/rgya rgya rgya1 /daphen rtsa'i skye sgozhi rtsa na pus mo 'dra ba zhig yod do/ /de nas 'dom gang natho do bcal ba'i sa na brag me long gang tsam pa g.ya' ma'i mdog 'dra ba zhig god do/ /de ga ma brkos ma cig yod do/ /de'i thad ka nas phar sha nye'i rdo yod/ gzong gis/khru gang brkos pa'i 'og na/ shel lag bzhengs 19/

gser mig /sgob dpon pad+ma/ /blon po/sprel thod/ 1rnam gsum gyis sbas pa yin/ /gser skyems dang g.yu sngon gyis brag btsan mchod la spre'u lo pas thon cig sa mā ga/ rgya rgya rgya/ /gyid smad ljang gi gong gnam gyi cesag na/ rgyug pa 'phrang bya ba'i 'phrang zhig yod/ de'i steng na rdo la seng ge'i gzugs byas pa cig thod/ de'i 'og na gser srin po'i thod pa gang yod1 kha byang mardzad kyi sde mig rgyud las dbu ru skyid smad kyi li'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bu ba/ /lha sras mu tig btsan po la/ /rgyal khrims phog pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /man ngag rin cen nor rdzas rnams/ /'phan yul gong ma'i brag la srus/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhang rgya tsha lha snang yab gras kyis dbu rtse'i steng rgyal po'i spyan lam du/ 'dzam bu gling gi sum cha gcig dbang du bsdus/ sum gnyis la dbang bya ba'i paka' gros zhus pa'i tshe/ bu 'u rings kyis sgo srung byed pa'i dus der rgyal sras phyi nas nang du rings pa la/ sgo bsdams pas thugs khros nas/ bka' gros tshar ba'i rjes la sgo/phye ba dang /lha sras kyis 'u rings bkrongs/ de'i khrims chad la byang khams su lo gsum sprugs so/ /dus der bdag 'di nas thar pa'i dus byung na spyod par shog ces smon lam btab ste nor du ma zhig sbas so/ kha byang dang yang thung dang gnad byang sde mig gnyu bcas pa bton te/ lha sa sgo phu'i byang ri'i logasage'i/ gong ma nang zhes bya'i lung pa na/ srin yul dge mo'i nang zhes bya ba yod/ lung pa de'i brag ri thams cad la mtshal gyi g.yung drung ris bris pa yod/ g.yung drung ris kun la mtho re'i tshad du byas/ brag mtha'i ri logs kyi zur/cig ga/ g.yung drung ris khru gang bris pa cig yod/ de la rdo chol rang 'thag tsam khro dang rdo sprin gyis bsdams pa yod/ rdo chol gyi/mdun du rdo g.yam gyi khri brtsigs pa/sbud pas bzhu zhing bsreg rdo sbyin bzhu nas rdo skad 'tsheg pa'i dus su/ rdo /nya3

chos lcags kyi tho bas brduras/ de'i 'og na phug pa 'dom gang pa yod/ de'i phug na bse'i sgrome bu yod/ mdo na sbal pa yod/ spre'u dmar po dang stag sbrul gyi gzugs yod/ me zhig ma ral ma chag pare mdo ru legs par 'don/ bse sprom mig gsum dbus ma'i nang bar brdzangs sol phye'i dkyil/ zangs tsha gser snyi ga'u'i nang du rje'i mgul cha g.yu dmar bre gshog bkra ris dang / rgyal mo shes ra༅ shetsum shar gyis sna drangs pa'i/ gagye gre na gyad kyi sbar changs bdun tsho bdun/ rin cen be+e—ḍūr+ya sngon po smrar changang dgu gu lang gi gser shing srang drug bakhye+o/nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu rin po che a ru ra tsam pa rin thang med pa nore bu'i rgya la po yod do/ /bse sgom mig g.yas pa'i nange na b.re bajings sol byes bkang ba'i dkyil du/ zangs tshe snyegasere byas pa'i ga'u'i nange na mchong sgong spug po dngul gyis gtums pa yod/ /de'i nang na slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag phreng mu tig brgya rtsa brgyad dang / rgyal po'i thugs dam gser gyi dzam+bha la/ gser gyi phyag gdub mgul rgyan/snyene cha/ slob dpon pad+ma'i ring bsrel 'phel gdung dang / rgyub thob name mkha'i snying po la logs pa grub thob brgyad kyi phyag sen dang / zhabs sen dang / in+d+ra ni la/chu shel/ me shel/ be ḍūyi pad+ma rā ga nor bu mchinge bu che chung rim pa 'ga' yod do/ /bse sgrom mig g.yon pa'i nang na bar brdzangs sol byes bkang ba'i dkyil du/ zangs kyi gzhu tsha gser can gyi nang / mtshan ldan bkra shis ka pā la kha sbyar gser shog gis gril nas dngul dzong gis rgya gram du bcings/ dug sbrul gyi pags pas gtums pa/ de'i nang du dung g.yas su 'khyil pa dang / ke ke ru/ stag sha bhe ba/ me shel mthe bong tsam/ rig 'dzin gyi sgrub thabatho phyi nang gsang gsum/ rjegs chen gyi gdams ngag mang po/btags pas don grub pa bstan pa bu gcig pa/ srog ser gtad gsum gyi man /64
