ngag mang du yod do/ /bse sgrom steng na'ang bse sgom kha sbyar ba zhig na reg pa rdo chod ral gri bcu gsum yod/ de dag til la dar btags te gser dngul bgyis gtums nas yod do/ /de rnams kyi steng gi brag lung cig la sha ba'i chad bu btags nas yod/ de'i nang na lha sras kyi bya thul la sogs pa na bze' bzhi — bcu zhe gcige yod/ ba mes zhal cig rin po che'i bum pa'i nang na rtsi bcud ༷sbrang rtsi sa bkang ste/ tshe dbang brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin pad+ma yis/ /lichi mede lcags kyi srog rtse bsgrubs pa yod/ /gnyer du gtad pa rgyal po pe deker darnga / / badzud mo nag mor bya dang ra yis mchod/ /sna tshogs/phud kyis martsed pa rgyas parje byas/ /sbal gzugs spril gzugs sngar gyi shul du gzhag /rdo chol sgo la 'dam pa'i zhal ba byug ཿ mchel gyis geyung drung ris ni sngar/bzhirna briso/ / rgyas btabe/rje rmi lo gsum gsang la spyad/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las 'arten khyele rgong me'i le'u ste nyi shu po'o// //༷ de nas yang dag bshad bya me/ / rome bu'i brag la sman gter sbas/ /༷zhes pa ni/ yar 'brog rom bu'i rtse mo la/ pha bong seng ge khyi tshugos byas nga 'dra ba zhig yod/ de'i nub na pha bong spug po 'bri tsam pa cig yod/ de'i sto rdub/ngos na pha bong nakar po g.yag tsam pa cig yod/ de nas gzhu 'dom dgu lho nub hūṃ bcale ba na/ rdza dmar po rtseg gi gseb na/ pha bong sprug/po gzhong pa kha spub pa 'dra ba/yod/ pha bong de'i sto rdub ngos na rgya yig dkar po bdun ༷pod/ de'i 'o ga drang por 'dom gang brus pa na/ rdo sgom gyi nang na bse kha spyar zhig yod/ de'i nang na byang khog gi man ngag mthar thug pa sngar sa steng du ma 'phel pa/ chu dar sngon po la gser gyis bris dngul gyi 'dril shing byas pa yod/ gter medag bdude btsan le gtad yod pas/ bya ze bor dar sgobyu brgyan pa da nge / bshos bu dang phud kyis nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du 136

mtshod/ 'don pa'i dus ni sos dang dgun la'o/ kha bung mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las yar 'brog rom bu brag gi le'u ste nyer gcig pa'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bdag 'dra mu teg btsan po yis/ 1spyi gtsug 'bral ba med pa ru/ /dus gsum1rgyun dunamachod pa'i gnas/ /rin chen lnga las bzhengs pa ni/ /slob dpon sgrub gnas brag dmar gyi/ /zangs g.yag nam mkha' rdzong la sbas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob dbon gyi sku tshabagamatha' mi mgon brtson gyes bzo byas pa ni/ slob dpon u rgyan du bzhud par dgongs pa'i dus su/ rin po che sna lnga las bzhengs pa/ slo ba dpon gyi spyan sngar sku zhal la dpe blangs pa/ zhal dngos dang tha mi dad pa/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi mthe bong tsam du bzhengs/ rgyal po'i spyan snga nas ring du mi bzhugs pa/ sgob dpon nyid kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/ sa steng thams cad 'od zer rnam pa lngas khyab ste/ sa g.yos shing lha srin rnagis/kyis me tog gi char phab pa/ slob dpon gyi sku dngos su mngon pa cig dang / sde sgod thams cad kyi bcud phyungs pa'i man ngag rdzogs ba chen po snying steg yang gsang bla na med pa'i skor/ rtags yig dang chad yig tu byas pa/ seng sdeng gi sgrom bu'i nang du rgyas btab/ tshas rim pa bdun gyis gril nas bzhugs so/ /slob dpon gye sgrub gnas/ /bod kyi ri bo rtse lnga'i rdzong rtse/ /tsarnan nags kyi sto nub mtshams/ lha srin dngos su 'byung po'i sa/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis sngags kyi rang sgu sgrogs pa'i gnas/ brag dmar ze mthon mdung rtse gnam du bslangs ba 'dra ba'i yang thog na/ pha bong bya khyung ri rab kyi rtse la gshog pa bcum pa 'dra ba yod/ de'i mdun 'dom do'i sa na/ brag slang po che'am phag pa nyal ba 'dra ba zhig yod/ de nas sto nub tu 'dom gang gi sar pha bong khye tsag thag thug rong dza ba'i gseb na/ slob dpon gyi bzhugs khri rja 136

g.yam las byas/pa cig yod/ de'i mdun na rdo rgyab tshad cig la/ spopa dpon thog mar gnas chen po de nyid dunasgos /phebs ba'i zhabs rjes yod/ gdan khri de'i rgyab yol gyi tshul du rtsig pa gru bzhi pa nig yod/ de'i 'og na rdo zur can dpal bshos 'dra— ba zhig yod/ de'i 'og tu rdo sgrom sol bas bkang ba'i dkyil du/ rdo sol gyi dzo ma nas chig gis gang ba'i nang na se rnga sdeng gi sgrom bu tsha papes gtums pa/ de'i steng du tsha laso gril/ de'i steng du chu nga ra/spus gril/ de'i steng rdu spu tshil gyis gril/ de'i steng du sbrul lngags kyis gturmas pa/ de'i nang na slob dpon gyi sku dang / sdeman ngag sa'i sternga de dkon pa mang po yod do1 /kha byang/mdzod kyi sde mige rgyude las brarga dmar zengs g.yeg nam ma khe'i dzong gi le'u ste ster rganyis pa'o// /1 de nas yang dag bshad bye be/ ('dir chims phu sher/snye ging rgestarna ād+ma/pā/lo'i le'u ngacas gaspum po zam lung nang rten gyi bu zhig las byung ba ltar bris)/dgam gyi bsam gas mnims phu na/ /bod du ma dad semag/phyogs dang / /phra men sku dang thugs dag dang / /gser gyi mnod cha la jegs yid/ /ces pa ni/bsam yas mchims phu gre gu'i sge'u na/ /brag dkar po sgo 'dra ga cig god/ /de srab gathug me long gang yod/ /de'i sdorge na rdo sgrom sho snyen sdis sbyar ba zhig yod/ /de sgo phye ba'i nang na 2 podi nag rdo zhig yod/ de la zha nye'i rdo rje sde yanam yod/ de'i thad ka nas phur la gzong gis bkos pa'i 'og na1 /zangs kha sasbyar zhig na gzhi dngul las byas pa'i phra men gyi sku gsum yod/ gzhi dngum sang/sa byag pa'i phra men gyi skyogs bzhi yod/ gser gye mañji kha rgyan dang bcas pa ༷yod/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi rgyud sgrub thabs dang bcas pa yod/ phur pa me lce phreng ba'i skor la rgyud nyi shu rtsa gnig yod/ mgon po gsang ba spu gri'i ngan sngaṭa 197

yodo/ mkha' 'gro lung skor bya ba dang / las rgya ma tsho 'i ste/ri zhes bya nga dang /sngar pod du ma phebes pa'i se mas phyogs kyi rgyud sde mang zhig yodo lta sgo gye man ngag mthar thug gi gsad mdzod brdol ba gang/zhig yod/ brag btsan btsan / 'os bya ba la gtad yod pas/ ra kham pa'i sha khrag gis mchod la thon zhigayang mchims phu gre gu sge'u na/ slob dpon gyi bzhugs gnas grwa bzhi pa'i shar phyogs na/ steng 'og pyogs mtshams kun nas bcal ba'i dkyil na/ 'da' kha zhal chems kyi gdams pa dang / gzhan yang gsab sngags kyi chos mang zhig chu dar la gseradigyis bris ges zangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas yod do1 /gnyer du gtad pa med do/ /mchims phu na mtshod rten nag po bram la bcar ba cig yod/de'i nang na khrom thogs bdud mo bcu gsum gyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs yod/ chu dar la gser gyes bris nas lcags kyi ga'ur bcug nas yod do/ /yang brag la parkos pa'i mchod rten cig yod/ nya drug gi dus su de'i greb ma'i steng du sakos pas/ 'dom gang gi 'og na rdo sgom sol phyes gang ba'i nang na/ bse kha sbyar bdun byi nang na rdo rje 'dag pa'i gathu re re/yod/ gnyu bdun gyi nang na pod du bahūṃr ba'i rgasang sngags kyi tshos rnams kyi phyi mo rnams chu dar mchin kha 1ga gser dang dngul gyis bris nas 'dril shing gser las byas/ /tshas rim pa bdun gyes grim nas yod1 dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rig 'dzin rnams la gtad pashe/ /phyo rabs kyi dus na gsang sngags 'chol ba dang / /nub pa rnams dar ba'i ster gsol ba gdab po/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las mchims phu'i le'u ste nyer gsum ma'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya brdo /shar gyi glib gsum gtso bo'i thugs ka nas1 mdun gyi marnal steng du 'dom re khru re bcal ba'i sa ru/ khru re byas pa'i 'og na/ gser dngul mtshal gsum 'dres pa zangs chung re re yod/1/33

spung ma gling so so skyong ba la gtad do/ /rdo dbasharagasamachodo pa rgyas par byas la/ gling rnying pa'i dus su 'don no/ ༷ kha byab mdzod kyi sde lika rgyud sa shar gyi grong gsum gyi le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o/ // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ āyi pā lo'i gling gi rta mgrin gyi zhabs jodo na/ sde brgyad kyi mnan pa yode pas 'don par ma bshad do/ /rta mgrin gyi rgyab dbu rtse'i thad ka na/ tshong dpon gyi bu dor bu len pa'i rdzing bris pa yod/ de'i 'og gi gyang sdebs la sor bzhi brus pa na/ rta mgrin/dmar po drogs pa zil gnon gyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs bzhugs/ lha srin dregs1pa bco brgyad kyi srog sor gtad gsum las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs1 de dag thog mar gser gyipo gtums/ bar du zangs kyis gtums/ mthab mar lcaṭa kyis gtums1 srupa ma long brgya 'dre la gtad stod1 khad+ma pā ṇi zhabs banyungs pa'i 'og na/ /chu'i pa tu rlung gi pa tra 'byel ba yod/ /spung ma sku'abrug rlung 'brug la gtad yod pe dkar gling gi gtso bo'i lha'i gdan khri'i g.yon zur/ /pad+mo ze'u 'bru can gyi 'og tu khru do brus pa na/ /rdo sgom cig gi 'og na zangs bum chen po zhig gi nang na gser khal phyed yod1 /pe dkar gyi7snying ga na gter byang gi shog dril rnams yod do/ /bshos/bu dang bya dkad pos mchod la thon cig kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las gling brgyad kyi le'u ste nyer lnga pa'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bsam yas mtshod rten dkar po ni/ 1seng ge brgyad kyis brgyan pa yi/ /shar lho so phag mchod rten la/ /dam pa chos kyi gter gcig srus/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nachod rten dkar po'i shar lho mtshams kyi ngos na/ so phag ngos gsal ba phyis bsdams pa 'dra ba cig yod do/ /de phyir bton pa'i nang na bka' jogs ngasachen po sems mdo brtso pargyad4139

cu dar la gser gyis bris pa zangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas rgyas btab bo/ de na / yang dag bshad bya ba1 /bsam mas mchod rten sngon bo yi/ /shar sto mtshams kyi lha khang 'og /mtsho byed sman gyi gter zhig sbas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mchode rten sngon po lha khang bcu drug gi nang nas shar sto mtshams kyi lha khang 'og na so phag nag po zhig yod1 de'i 'og na sman dpyad shi sos bdud rtsi 'chi med dang sman dalcad rin cen thigs pa zhes bya pa/ chu nar la bris te thangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas rgyas btab pa yod do/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mchod rten nag po'i bum pa'i nang / /ngan sngags zab dgu mang po dang / /bod khamasacayongs7)/gter byang dang / mang byang sde mig bcas pa sbas/ /zhes ga sungs pas/ mchod rten nag po'i bum pa'i shar ros na/ so phag sum brtsegs shig la blon chen rta ra klu gong gi phyag rjes sor po gsal lam me ba cig yod/ de la so phag gi chol sum brtsegs yod/ 'orga ma la rgyal po dang blon chen nyid kyis sbas pa'i gter yod pa 'dir ma smos so/ /gong ma'i chol la phyis rgyal bug sbas pa'i sa yod/ de nyid gzong gis sor bzhi brus pab gser gyi sbu gu cig na gter byang yongs kyi kha byang yod/ lcags kyi sbu gu cig can sngar sa steng du ma 'phe2 ba'i ngan sbrags bdun yod do/ /gter srung mkha' 'gro ma lcags mchu gdong can ga gtad do/ /de nas yang dag bshad thu ba/ /mchod rten dmar po'i bum pa'i dkyil/ /drag sngags srog ser gtad chagasum sbas/ /zhes pas/ mtshod rten dmar bo'i bum pa'i dkyil na/ pad+ma 'dab ma gcig gi dkyil na so phag gi chol lag mthil tsam zhig yod/ de /gzong gis bcag pa'i 'og na/ zangs sbug mthohogang pa yod/ de na gza' bdud kyi ser ba dang drag sngags sngar sa steng du yo 'phel ba mang po yod rdo/ /chaganyer du gtad pa ni bya rog mgo brtsegs mchod par bya'o/ kha byang marngod 200

kyi sde mig rgyud las mchod rten bzhi'i le'u/ste ter drug pa'o// //de nas gang dag bshad bya ba/ (le'u 'di zam lung nang rten gyi bu zhig 'dug pa ltar bris)lcags ri'i mgon zhang brgyad kyi dril bu'i thad na1 me lce rtse mo'i thad ka nas mtho re byus ga/na/ co na3gyi sgrom re na mgon po dang lha tho dang ging chen po bco brgyad kyi sgru da/thabs bzhugs so/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las mgon khang brgyad kyi le'u ste nyer bdunā pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sto yi skyer chu lha khang na/ /chos dang nor gyi gter zhig spuse/ /zhes gsungs pas/ skyer chu lha khang gi gtso bo'i thugs ka na/ rin po che'i pa tu 'khyil pa cig yod/ de'i 'og sor bzhi brus par zangs sbub cing can/ rgyud sde snod kyi 'bu me zhes rgya ba dang / sde snod kun 'byung zhes pa gnyis/ /shog bu dril ba la bris pa yod do/ /lha'i gtso bo na 'edom do bcal ba'i sar1 mda' gang brus pa na rdo sgrom sol byes bkang bsgo dkyil na/ zangs kha sbyar gyi nang du gser dab mtshal 'dres pa khal phyed yod do/ /lha khang nyams pa gso ba'i3dus kyi na rkyenanadu bzhag go /gang zhig lha khang gso ba'i dus su glu'i spang sgong 'don pa dang / /klu sgrub dang klu'i mtshod pa rgyas par bya'o/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las/skyer chu lha khang gi lenyu ste nyer brgyad pa'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bum thang dge ba'i gtsug 'ag hūṃ/ )/ dzobaltas/chen sems mdo bco brgyad dang / /gser mtshal 'dres/ba bre brgyad sbas/ /gtsug lag khang gi gsos su bzhag /ces bas/ bum thang dge gnas kyi rnam par snang mdzad kyi snyan g.yas pa'i rtse mo'i sdebs la mtho gang brus pa na/ seng ldeng gi sgom bu dngul gyi spar bkab can gyi nang na rdzogs pa chen po snga 301

'gyur lnga/ phyi 'gyur bcu gsum la sogs pa mang zhig shog dril la zin prija/ phye byas nas/ rgya rim pa lngas btab na yod do/ /lha'i mdun maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/zhabs skyil krung dbus nas 'dom gang mda' gang bcal ba'i sar khru gang brus pa na/ /zangs rkyen zha nyes kha gtums pa cig gi nang na/ gseri bre bzhi dang ༷mtshal bre bzhi rgya rim pa bdun dang bcas pa yod do/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las bum thang dge gnas kyi le'u ste nyer dgu pa'o/ / //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ (bum thang rtse lung dang gtsang 'gram gyi le'u cha'adi gnyis zam bu nang rten gyi bu zhig sas byung ba ltar bris) bum thang rtse lung gi g.yas/phyogs rdo'i steng zhig yod/ de'i sked/ pa na rdo'i chol nar mo zhig yod//de bcag pa'i nang na/sngags sruja gis gas byas pa'i ma mobe+e rgyud dang sgrub thabs bzhugag pa la/ /mdo rgyud stong phrag gcig gi snying phyung ba snying gcig tu dril ba'i dril sgrub dang / /dkar/mo nag mo spug mo'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa /mang go yod/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las rtse lung gi le'u ste sug/cu / shes// // / de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gtsang 'gram lha khad gi dbu rtse snga gdong gags pa'i sted la seng gezhi gzugs cig yod/ de'i mjug ma'i rje mo la sor bzhi brus pa'i sa na/ lcags kyi sbug ma cig na yab 'jam dpal nag po/yum ye ka tsa ti/ sgog ging bshan pa'i man ngag dang bcas/pa/ gshin rje wa /thod lag kyi rlung dmar dang// ming srog zan dmar po re sgrub pa'i rgyud dang bcas pa shog dril ma bdun dang / gaster byang shog dril ma gsum yod/ sdel po/srog bdag mchod la 'don par bya'o/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las gtsang 'gram gyi le'u ste so gcig pa'o// // de nas yang dag bshad thu ba/ /rgyang ro dpal tshad lha khang du/ /rin 203

bun chos sman rtsi gapum sbas/ /zhes pa/ rgyang ro da la chad ste gaja ge ka/be yang shar mar/ /yar la 'dom gang gi sa na shing chol nar mo mdzube gang ba /cig yod/ de gzong gis bkog pa'i nang na/ sngar sa steng du ma 'phel pa'i man ngag /glong chen rab 'byams bsdus pa gcig tu gril ba/dang / //den /smo depyade mgo tshal gar spyin dang / /byang khog gser gyi sgom bu zhes pa dnge // /yan lag ka ba dgu sgril zhes pa dang / /gnyan dpyad rin cerna bsdus pa zhes pa dang / /sman sbyor bdud be+e ljon shing rnams bgyegs/ /rtsis la ri reb rdul phran du brdzi ba'i dgu mtha' dus kyi 'kher lo dang /zangs kyams che tshung ma zlo chagand dzu brtsi ba rnams bzhugs so/ kha byang mngod kyi sde mig rgyud las rgyange ro dpal chad lha khang gi lenyu ste so gonyis pa'o// 1/ / de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ (le'u 'di zam bu nang rten gyi bu zhig las byung ba ltar gris) mkho mthing lha khang gi lha gtso bo'i dbu'i gtsug tor gyi thad ga'i gyang ldebs la mtho gang byes pa na shog sere gyi glegs bam tsher nag gi spang leb dang / dashing dmar gyi spang leb kyis gturmas/pa yod/ mig skore la zabase kyis gtumase ba bdun bzhugs so/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las mkho ༷mthing lha khang gi le'u ste so gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /spa gro stag tshang seng phug na/ /mengon par jogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /dam chos zab mo mang po sgas/ /zhes pas/ spa gro stag tshang seng ge'i phug ring na slob dpon bad+ma 'byung gnas dang glang dpal gyi seng ge'i zhal snga nas dngos grub brnyes pa'i dkyil 'khor e khrom nyi shu rtsa gcig yod/ de nas rkang 'edom bdun phugs su bcal ba'i sdebs g.yon/phyoṭa ༷su mtshal gyi rdo rje rgya gram zhig yod/ de nas khru do bcal ba'i sar/ rdo spyisgo ༷ zhal ba la byurges pa yod/ de'i 'og na rdo chol zhig yod/ de bcag pa'i 'og na 2she3

bse sprom chu srin gyi kha can zhig yod/ de na bka' rdzogs pa chen po glong chen rab 'byams/ lta ba phyogs med rang grol/ sgom pa ye dag stong gsal/spyod pa byarwa sked rang dag 'bras bu lhun grub ye dag gzhan yang sems ma do brtso brgyad la/ lta ba la zla ba/ sgom pa gsar+sha dag pa/ spyod pa rgya yan pa 'bras bu yi med lhun grub kyi man ngag chos tshan drug dang bcas pa bzhugs so//kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las spa gro stag tshang gi le'u ste so bzhi pa'o// // di nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /spra dun rtse'i gtsug lag khang gi mdun na rdo'i gtor stegs gru bzhi pa cig yod/ de'i 'og na zangar/ shog la gtad /nga ser ba phung ser gyi rigs brgya rtsa brgyad yod do/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las spu dun rtse'i le'u ste so lnga pa'o// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba1 /skyo dun rtse'i gtsug lag khang na rdo ring gi zhu'i 'og shar sdebs na mar la mtho gang gi sa na/ rdo chol zhig yod/ de brkag pa'i 'og na drag po drag mo thams cad kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad yod do/ /'di gnyis ni shin tu gnyan pas/ gtor tshogs btang la 'don par bya'o/ /cho 'phrul shin tu che ba byung yang ma bred par bya ba gal che'o/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las skyo dun rtse'i le'u ste so drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /nyang ro rtsis kyi lha khang gi gtso bo'i dbu'i nang na/ zangs kyi ga'u zhig gi nang na shog ser dril ma la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsgril ba'i rgyud dang / sems7lung chen mo nam mkha'i klong rum dang 1 lta sgom spyod gsum nyi zla mthongs gsal gyi gdams ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ kha byang mdzod kyi lde mib rgyud las rtsis kyi lha khang/gi le'u ste so bdun pa'o// //204

de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mon kha sna ripa na phug pa chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sdebs la dkyil thig drang po'i sner/ masgo gang phrudo pa dngul sgom cig na sgogs pa chen po spyi ti yongag dang / yang ti yo ga dang 1 ma ti yo ga dang / yang zhun nag po gser khru 'bru gcig srog ser gtarwa 3gsum spu gre reg gcod dang bces pa bzhugase so/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las mon kha sna ring gi le'u ste so bakhrud pa'o// // — rwa de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sgragasnya kyi yang rjong dben gnas bu/ /phar pa dang ni sems phyogs sbas/ /zhes pas/ sgrags kyi yang rdzong gong ma'i chadakyil 'khor gyi sto ldebs skar/khung na/ gshin rje'i rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa ༷cwa dar la bris nas lcags kyi sgrom bur bzhugs so/ /byang shar gye skar khung na (1ra pa'i las tshogs bzhugs so/ /dkyil theg drang po'i 'og na sems phyogs mang zhig bzhugs so/ kha byang mdzod kyi lnga mig rgyud las sgrags kyi yang rdzong bgi le'u ste so dgu pato// // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ (lebu 'di dang pho ma gling gi le'u gnyis zam bu nang rten gyi bu zhig las byung ba ltar bris)spa gro jong ge phug na brag dka ra po /seng ge gnam du/mchongs ba 'dra ba'i sder mo/g.yas pa la brag bya 'ug pa gshog pa brkyangs pa 'dra ba zhig la/ mtshal gye rgya yig dmar po bdun yod//de nas mda' gang 'og tu bcal ba'i sa na/ brag gi khri mar ga dam pa cig gi /'og na/ rdo chol ngo/spyin gyis sbyar ba yod/ de bcag pa'i 'og na srog seng gartad gsum gye man ngag drag sngags bcu gsum yod/ dbang gi lha khro bo cha'adod pa'i rgya la po/ rgyas pa'i lha tshogs bdage glang sna/ spre'u sna jam lha1༷nod rgyun ma/ zhi ba'i lha sgrol ma dkar mo/ don yod zhags pa/ seng ge sgra la sogs pa bzhugs so/ /gter srung ni rdzong btsan la bshos bus mchod/ 205

kha byang mdzod kyi lde mig rgyud las sga gro rdzong gi le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o1/ // de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /pho ma gling gi sgrub gnas kyi rdzug pa'i chadakyil 'khor nas/ phugs su 'dom gang bcal ba'i sa na brag la gzong rjesagagasum yod/ de nas steng gi ngos la khru gang bcal ba'i 'og na rdo chol sor bzhi pa tshe chus sbyar ba yod/ de'i 'og na bse'i sgrom bu zhig na gsang ba phur gcig pu du'i skor dang / bsen mo'i sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang gsum/ yang gsang gter du sgrub pa rnams shog ser la bris nas bzhugs/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las pho ma gling gi le'u ste zhe gcig pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mkhar chu dpal gye phug ring na/ rdodakyil 'khor chen po gru bzhi pa cig dang zla gam pa cig yod/ zla gam pa de'i ༷steng na/ brag la g.yung drung ris bris pa'i nang na mtshal byugs nas yod/ de nas 'dom gang phugs su bcal ba na/ brag la rdo 'bu re ba rigs mi gcig pa yod/ de bcag pa'i 'og na zangs kyi spu gu'i nang / glu bdud nā ga rak+ka'i rang gshed rang la dbab pa dug gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs dang / rgya mtsho dug ri ga bzhugs so1 /sngags srung smug nag snying thun gyi drag sngags kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs dang / smug ma yongs kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa dang / chig rkyang du sgrub pa rnams bzhugs so/ /sngags srung mchod la 'don par bya'o/ khokha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las mkhar chu phug ring gi le'u ste zhe gnyis pa/shes// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gtsang gi phung po ri bo che'i rtse mo na g.yam pa rtsig pas bsdamag te rtse mo nyug ge yod/ de'i shar du mda' gang brus pa na/ rdo sgom sol phyes bkang ba'i dkyil du/ tsardon gyi sgrom btsas kyis gtums pa'i nang na gshin rje che bdag nas po'i rgyud sgrub thabs las phran dang ba206

/bcas pa bzhugs so/ /bdud btsan dmu rgyal po ging gza' bdud kyi drag sngags cog brdungs kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs rnams bzhugs so/ /srung ma ni gza' bdud la rgyas par mchod la 'don par bya'o/ kha byang mdzod kyi sde mig rgyud las gtsang phung po ri bo che'i le'u ste zhe gsum pa'o// //kha byang 'di rnams lha sras kyis rgyal brgyud phyag tu ma gtad par brag lag sor 'dra ba la gter du sbas so/ /sprir yang gter gang 'don kyang lha srin la gnyer du gtad pas/ bcol ring bdag tu bzung nas 'khren du 'ong bas/ bar snang 'brug sgra chems se chems/ /glog dmar me 'od khyugs se khyugs/ /gung la sprin nag nyi li li/ /char drag ser drag sha ra ra/ /dog la sarlung nag khyi li li/ /lha srin ku co di ri ri/ /'dre zhud zil du thibs se thibs//bla 'phyo skyi bun zings se zings/ /de ltar sko 'phrul ci byung yang / /dpa' bo'i gzi byin dpa' bskyed la/ /ya gi bde gshegs dgongs pa nas/ /dma' de dmyal ba'i snang ba yang / /rang sems yin paro blo thag chod/ /dpal chen he ru man chad nas/ /the'u brang grong rgyu yan chod la/ /rang snang yin par blo thag chod/ /srid pa'i 'jig rten 'di dag dang / /rigs drug sems can snang ba yang / /rang snang yin par blo thag chod/ /phyi rol cho 'phrul ci byung yang / /sarang sems stong par blo thag chod/ /dngos su cho 'phrul ci byung yang / /rang gi sems nyid ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan nas ma grub blo thag tshod/ /nyam nga med pa'i brtul zhugs bskyed/ /sems nyid yin par blo thag chod/ 1ming gzugs rnam par rtog pa yin/ /rnam rtog ye shes chen po yin/ /stong pa'i ngang las canayos pa med/ /de ltar sems nyid rtogs pa na/ /lha srin stong srog chod pa ༷yin/ /bsrung ba gzhan gyi do ma yin/ /lha srin sde brgyad khro mi nus/ /slar sa bran dang g.yog tu 'du/ /grog snying 'bul zhing dngos grub ster/ /de ltar 207

༷ kyi rgyal po 'byung / /dam pa'i chos dang bstan pa'i bar chod che/ /rgya0/ bu tha chung rgyal sar bton na legs/ /ston pa'i dam chos khri gdugaso brdal ba 'dra//lhal pori mnga' thang lo tog rgyas pa 'dra/ /'bangs kyi chab srid char gyi rgyun 'bab 'dra/ /bdud kyi sprul pa glang gi ming can dus/ /rgyal po'i rgyal srid gnyis su gyur pa ni/ /'od spungs yum brtan zhes bya'i sku ring la/ /mnga' nis gcig la phyogs ris gnyis su 'chad/ /spyi mthun bsod nags sos ka'i ba rom 'dra/ /rgyal po'i bsod nams longs spyod mnga' thab dbul/ /lha gcig rgyal po khri srong ldenyu btsan ni/ /rgyal bu tha chung ral pa can zhes grags/ /'dzam gling sum gnyis chab sri da ma 'a ru 'dus/ /dkon cog rten btsugs dbu rtse dgu thog bzhengs/ /lo paṇa mtha' rgyas dam chos dar bar 'byung / /de nas mi rabs dgu yi 'og rol du/ /rje gcig rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan des/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku bsam yas sto phyogs su/ /mas mthing gtsug lag khang gi shar phyogs sa/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku dbu skra lcang lor 'khyil/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde rgya mtshor mnga' brnyes pa/ /skyes mchog 'brug lo nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku mnga'/bdag rgya mtshos bskor/ /de phyis me tog pasmo'i zhing khams su/ /'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs rigs lnga'i tshom bus bskor1 /bde ba can du mngon dzogs rgyal por 'gyur/ /rje gcig rgyal bo khri srong sde'u btsan di/ /sprul skus don mdzad bsam yas byang shar mtshams/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'bri zhes grags pa ru/ /skyes/mchog phag mo rin cen dpal zhes pa1 / sprul sku'i sems dpa' 'bum phrag tshogs kyis bskor/ /de phyis mngon par /dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /bde gshegs dri med dkar po zhes bya ba'i/ /mngon dga'i zhing du mngon rdzogs rgyal por 'gyur/ /rgyal sras mjing yon 209

legs pa'i sgo gros ni/ /bdag gis mtshan gsol mu steg btsan bo zhes/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta'i dus la ni/ /bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gong rol du/ /bde gshegs klu rigs sgrol ma'i spyan snga ru/ /nor bu dbang gi rgyal po phul ba'i dus/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por lus blangs pa/ /'dir byon 'dir skyes brjod las 'das na yang / /bskal pa brgyad khri brgyad kyi gong ro' du/ /stong gagyem snying po 'di yi shar phyogs su/ /zhing khams 'od zer mtha' yarna zhes pa ru/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal lag na be con zhes/ / gling bzhir gser gyi 'khor los sgyud bar 'khrungs/ /de dus rgyal sgas 'jig rten ston pa ni/ /bde gshegag rgyal ba nyi ma'i sgol ma zhes/ /skyes bu 'dul dang kha lo skyur ba yi/ /lha mi'i ston pa drug khri 'dus pa skyong / /skye rgu'i sems can tshe tshad dgu khri thub/ /de tshe 'jig rten khams de'i kha lo sgyur/ /de nas bskal chen bar bskal phyed tsam du/ /bdag gis mi shes 'jig rten gzhan dag tu/ /'khor los sgyur dang sems dpar lus blangs nas/ /de nas 'phog te me tog brgyan pa yi/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi lho phyogs su/ /zhing khams rnam dag sprin gyi snying po can/ /rin cen gzhong thogs zhes bya'i zhing khams su/ /sems can tshe lo bye ba bdun thub dus/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal gser chen stong zhes pa/ /zangs kyi 'khor los gling gsum sgyur bar 'khrungs/ /de dus sras kyi thu bo ston pa ni/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba mun pa sangs pa zhes/ /skyes bu 'dul dang kha lo sgyur ba yi/ /bla sked ston pa stong khri 'dus pa skyong / rdoskye rgu'i tshe tshad bye ba thub pa'i dus/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi nub phyogs na/ /zhing khams rnam dag rang byung spyos ldan zhes/ /rnam grol sgos ngad ldan pa'i zhing mchog der/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal byang chub snying po can/ /stobs ldan dpa' bo 'byung gnas zhes su 'khrungs/ /de dus lca gas kyi 'khor los 210

sgyur ba yi/ /chos mchog rgyal po chos la mnga' brnyes pa/ /de dus sras mchog sangs rgyas 'khrungs pa ni/ /rgyal ba sman gye bde ba mchog ces pa/ /skyes bu 'dul dang kha lo sgyur ba yi/ /lta mi'i ston pa bye ba 'dus pa skyong 1 /skye rgu'i tshe tshad bye ba gsum thub dus/ /stong gsum snying po 'di yi byang phyogs su/ /zhing khams rnam dag rab mchog/dga' ba yi/ /rnam rgyal zhing khams kun yangs bde ba ru/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'khrungs pa ni/ /kun khyab rgyal po byu ngan rmad ces byon/ /gser gyi 'khor lo la sogs rin cen bdun/ dpung tshogs bsam 'das 'dzig rten khengs pa byung / /de yi dus kyi rgyal sras sangs rgyas ni/ /bde gshegs ston pa tshos mchog skyob pa byon/ /skyes bu 'dul ba'i 'dus/pa sum stong la1 /skye rgus tshe lo bye ba gsum thub dus1 1 de ltar sngon 'das dus kyi skyes lus rnams/ /grangs las 'das shing brjod kyis rdzogs pa min1 /'khor los sgyur rgyal lus blangs mngon mtshon tsam1 /'dod khams rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i lus/ /brjod kyis mi rdzogs grangs kyes mi lang yang / /'dzam gling 'di ru lus blangs zur tsam brjod/ /mi mjed 'jig rten sto yi 'dzam gling 'dir/ /bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan shāka thub kyis/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rnam gsum gsungs pa'i dus/ /nyan thos chen po ma 'gags pa zhes byon/ /ston pa'i gtso bo mya ngan 'das pa'i rjes/ /bka' yi dgongs pa 'grel pa thogs med ces/ /'dzam ming 'di yi nyi ma byang phyogs su/ /zhing khams chos kyis mdzes pa zhes bya/bar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal bzang byon pa'i dus/ /'phags pa kun mdzes mu tig 'od 'bar zhes/ /bod khams kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di ru/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag nyid byon pa'i tshe1 /gad na mjing yon mu tig btsan po zhes/ /bod khams kha ba can gyi lto phyogs su/ 1rgya gar grong khyer shid thags can zhes par/1211

rgul po chen po parnyi shes rab ces1 /de phyis bod khams ri bo rtse lnga ru/ /༷dngos grub brnyes pa shākya pra bha zhes/ /bod khams 'di yi nyi ma lho phyogs su//11/gar grong khyer ma ga rte zhes par/ /khyim bdag rgyal po nor sbyin dpal zhes 'byung / /'dzam gling dbus kyi rdo rje gdan drung du/ /dge slong dpal mo zhes bya 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi sto phyogs su/ /rdzus skyes sprul —sku'i sems dpa' 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgya gar dpal gyi ri/bo zhes pa la/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog dge slong zhes bya 'byung / /bod khams gangs ri rtse dgu'i ༷byang phyogs su/ /mu tig dgongs pa gsal de zhes bya 'byung / /bod khams chagangs ri rtse dgu'i nub byang du/ /chos skyong rgyal po ha lu ka zhes 'byungaka /༷bod khams gangs can ljongs kyi dbus 'di ru/ /ston pa bsnyen sgogs gsang ba zhes bya 'byung / /gangs ri rtse dgu'i nub byang mtshams sunayang / /'dod ltams rgyal po 'ja' 'od ces bya 'byung / /bod yul kha ba can gyi sngongs 'di ru/ /tshul khrims sgom pa zhes pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bod khams 'di yi nyi ma share phyogs kyi/ /rgya nag khri zhes bya ba'i yul khams su/ /'dod khams rgyal po zin khri zhes bya 'byung / /bod khams gangs ri rtse dgu'i 'dab rol du/ /'dod khams rgyal po rin cen rtsal zhes 'byung / dpal kyi bsam yas bung shar mtshams su yang / /chos mchog/rgyal po rin cen zhes bya 'byon1 /'dzam gling 'di yi stonge gsum shar phyogs su/ /zhing khams rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ru/ /de bzhin gshigs pa/skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa bye ba'i 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs/dri ma med pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes/ /yon ༷tan mtha' yas sgogs pa'i rgyal ba 'byung / /gzhan yang mazhe' ma'i dus su ༷ 'byung ba shi/ /rgyal po mjing yon mu tig btsan po 'di/ /ma 'ongs skye ba ༷bcu gnyishe mtha' ma le/ /gsang sngags zab dgu cig dang 'phrad par 'gyur/ /212

gsang sngags zab mo dgongs pa'i gting phyungs pa/ /kun tu bzang pos thugapha kyi glong nas gsungs/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis nyan/ /gsang sngags bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /dga' rapa rdo je'i thugs su brlabs nas bshad/ /dga' rab rdo rjes shrī sidha la/ /dig 'jin rig pa brda yis brgyud cing bshad/ /shrī sirtes pad+ma bdag nyid la/ /snyan gyi gathung byin gyes brlangs shing bshad/ /pad+ma thod breng rdo rje gshog god kyis/ /mnga' bdag rgyal po mu tig btsan po la/ /bka' yi rgya nan yi ger bkod nas gtad/ /chos skyong rgyal po mu tig btsan po bdag /'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i dmag tshogs dpon la yengs/ /las kyi/shugs dbang smon lam mthu btsan la/1gsang sngags zab mo'i snying po nyams len rnams/ /shog bu'i 'ogs la zin bris yi ger btab/ /mi brlag btsas ni rgya rim bdun gyis gril/ /slob dpon sgrub gnas brag dmar zangs g.yag la/ /spa bar bka' bgros tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i dus/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i slob dpon zhal snga nas/ /nam zhig snyigs ma'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ /rgyal sras skye lus bcu gnyis kha 'thong mtha'/ /bod yul gangs ri rtse dgu'i ljongs 'di ru/ /rje rigs rgyal po gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul/ /rgyal po'i mtshan ltas legs pa lnga dang ldan/ /thugs sgam bka' btsan khong rgyud yangs pa dang / /zungs thub dpyad pas thuṭa stobs rab tu che/ /rgyal po'i dpung tshogs longs spyod du/ma ldan/ kha ba can du dus kyi mtha' la 'byung / /de yi dus su gdams pa 'di dang 'phrad/ /sgyu ma'i skyes bu rje'u rigs rnal 'byor pa/ /tha mal mon bu lha srin ded dpon gcig /tha brag ri bo'i khrod nas 'ongs zhes pa/ /nyi ma'i zer la dmar thag dus su 'byung / /sngags kyi dngos grub 'dod pa yod dam zhes/ /sngon dus rgyal po da lta yod dam zhes/ /sngon dus rgyal po man ngag long zhes zer/ 213

gabang sngags rgya mtsho'i nang gi snying po rnams/ /rig pa'i brda yis char gyi tshul du 'bebs/ /rgyal po'i phyag dpe man ngag snying po ni/ /rdzogs chen sems /do bco brgyad snying phyungs pa/ /bstan pa bu gcig snying thig man ngag bcas//lta sgom spyon ba byem zhus lan sgom khrid dang / /rgyu 'bras rnam 'byed dge spyod 'gro pa 'gu / /thugs rje chen po brtags grol mthong grol dang / /ngag tu ma bton man ngag mthar thug gsum/ /'khor lo bzhi sprub 'khor lo gsum sgrub da nga / mang galang gter sgrub man ngag yang steg rnams/ /bka' yis rgya nan rim pa dgu ru brtsegs/ /rgyal po'i thugs dam 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / /de nyid sngagaca/ kyi thems yig man ngag bcas/ /cig skor yid bzhin nor bu kha tshar bcas/ /gtum po sku gsung thugag kyi sgrub pa dang / /yang bcud dregs pa srorga gi 'khor lo dang / /klu yi ded dpon nag po ti pa tsa/ /nā ga rak+ka nor bu sgrub par bcas/ /dbang phyug chen po bhe sha 'joms pa dang / /rlung gi mngon shes rgyun khyer man ngag dang / /pra mo no mthong srid ༷gsum gsal byed dang / /gces phreng lnga bcu'i man ngag sde tshan bcas/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po nam mkhe' mdzod kyi rgyud/ /sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyal po man ngag bcas/ /nor gyi bdag po gnod sbyin dzam+bha la/ /tshogs bdag spre'u sna yi sgrub thabs bcas/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul tshogs bdag glang po'i sna/ /gnod sbyin nag po gter skyong dung 'dzin dang / /gnyan chen thang lha sham po ma sangs shang / /sngags bdag dregs pa brtso brgyad sgrub thabs bcas/ /gzhan gyis mi thub 'jig rten skyong byed dang / /lha mo nor rgyun dbang sdud ka kha sgrigs/ /mu stegs dbang sdud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /ske ba brtsegs pa yul khams chadabang sdud bcas/ /mkha' 'gro'i lung skor khros ma nag mo dang / /dbang sdud las la phyi sgrub sgos sgrub gnyis/ /thems kyi rgyud dang kha tshar brgya rtsa brgyad/ /2 4

dregs pa bcu gsum gza' gdong nying khu dang / /don dam zab mo man ngag gnad kyi chos/ /man ngag kun gyi sto tshil bsdus pa'i don/ /rgyud sde kun gyi khong snying bton pa yin/ /gzhan gyi don du spyod pa'i chos sde la/ /skyabs 'aspo sems bskyed gtor ma bsnyen gnas dang / /drang don dge bskul chos spyod nyi shu gcig /bka' bstsal rkyang pa na rag dong sprugs dang / /dam tshig basprang mtshams skyon mtshang 'don pa dang / /'gro ba 'dul ba'i rgyud dang bsten sgrub dang / /sman skrub mchod sbyong kha tshar sprod pa'i chos/ 3 /slob dpon rgyal po'i rnam thar chen mo dang / /snang srid gtan 'bebs thang yig 'di nyid dang / /rgyal po'i thugs dam bsam yas dkar chag dang / /me tog brgyan pa bsdus pa'i lung bstan skor/ /slob dpon rnams dang lo paṇa skyes rabs rnams/ /rgyal po'i bla mchod lung bstan gter du bcas/ /khad+ma pa ṇi sgrupa pa sgrom ḍashājug dang / /gsung sgrub dmar po nyams len mthil gyi chos/ /srog ser gtad gsum phreng sel zhu lan skor/ /spyi la dgos pa'i srog khyem gter khyim dang 1 /mthar thug snang srid lha srin sgrub thabs dang / /bskal pa dum bu'i le 'ag kun la dgos/ /gnyer du gtad pa mgon po traka shad dang / /nag po nag mo drag sngags sde tshan la/ /drag sngags gcig chod gshor du sgrub pa dang / bshan pa ra mgo tshe/ ra snying zan dang / /srin po'i dmod pa da ra di ra dang / /spu gri gog po srog gi bshan pa dang / /rdo rje legs pa yam shud dmar po dwang / /nag po spyan gcig bdud kyi drag sngags dwang / /spu gri reg gcod ngab/ 'grol zlog bsad dang / /srid pa'i rgyal mo sngags kyi srung ma dang / /dug sbrul nag po nā ga gur ling dang 1 /tri wang 'byung ba bzhi yi mnan pa dang / /phra men 'gom chog/skyes bu phung sel dang / /rin ceno bzo yig rig pa bzo yi gnas/ /bdud rtsi rta/na dpyad rin ces /bsdus pa dang / (rgya/yi sman dathud 31da

dor bu don bsdus dang / /snying rlung bco / dang skran dang dmya chu dang / /dug gi 'khren 'dren sman gye bya ra dang / /sman kyi skyor ba bdud rtsi ljon shing dang / /rig ma'i sman ma lus kyi gapos gru pacas/ /gdug byed rdzu 'phrul ag ni bya ba dang / /rdzi dug rlung zhon byug pa reg phung dang / / gdug pa'i rdzas la rig pa'i 'phrul dang bcas/ /sa yi steng du dkon pa'i man ngag yod/ /slob dpon bkaki yi rgya nan bcas pa la/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku yi sgrub pa dang / /gsang sngags zab mo lta ba'i rdzong breng dang / /rgyal sras zhus lan lta ba rdzong phreng dang / /bar chad bdud dbung 'joms pa'i 'phrod sel dang / /dzogs/chen sgom yod sgom med rnam pa gnyis/ /rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i zhus lan4dang / /zab mo nyams len go byed brda yi skor/ /bka' yi rgya nan bcas pa'i gdams pa kun/ khong snying don dam mig gi 'bras bu ltar/ /gces pa'i gdams pa gsang ba sems kyi gter/ /rdzogs chen nyal chog man ngag zab mo dang / /rmi lam gnyid dang 'pho ba grong 'jug dang / /bar do'i gnad dang gseb lam gdams ngag dang / /lta sgom spyod gsum dri med ka dag bdun/ /gcepa pa'i gdams ngag gsang ba sems kyi gter/ /rtsa rlung zab mo gnad kyi gdams ngag dang / /gtum mo'i drod dang rdzas kyi me gos dang 1 /chu dang rdo yi dka' thub ting 'dzin dang / /tshan dang cong zhi bcud len rnam pa bdun/ /bka' yi rgya nan gsang ba sems kyi gter/ /sems nyid ngo sprod me long rnam gnyis la1 /rgan po mkhar thogs rgan mo mdzub tshugs dang / she byud 'phags bud med bdun byis zhus lan dang / /snying gtam bka' rgya'i gal chen gtad rgya dang / /zhus yon btab dang rgya nan bka' yi gsung / /gces par gdams pa gsang ba sems kyi gter/ /sgom khrid ren cen sems kyi phreng ba dang / /nyams len dri med shel phreng nor bu dang / /gnad 'dus dri med 316

nor bu'i phreng ba dang / /zla ba gcig gis mchog grub man ngag dang / /mtshan brjod 'don dang yi ge brgya pa dang / /nyams len zab mo yi ge shā gi chos/ /rgyud las bkol ba'i rab 'bring rnam pa gsum/ /pho tshogs po tshogs zhal sbyor sgrub pa dang / /rdo rje slob dpon 'khor lo bzhi sgrub dang / /slob dpon tshe sgrub na ngag zab mo dang / /sde sgod snying po 'khor lo gsum sgrub dang / /yang gsang mkha' 'gro gter du sgrub pa dang / /'jig rten 'di ru 'apyong bar darkan pa yi/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro bka' rgya'i mdud pa bkrol/ /gsang ba'i snying thig tshig tu bton pa rnams/ /lha sras rgyal po'i thugs kyi dkyil du chongs/ /dus gsum bde gsheb/sa rgyal ba ma lus kyis/ /thugs dgongs gting dpag dka' ba'i chos/gsungs kyang / /mdo don 'gag 'dril gdams pa 'di 'dra dkon/ /dus gsum rig 'dzin ma lus thams cad kyis/ /brda dang ngag tu rim pas bstan gyur kyang / /nyams len gnad kyi man ngag 'di 'dra dkon/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos ma lus thams cad kyi/ /zab don snying po kun gyi bcud phyungs kyang / /nyams su len bde'i zab don 'di 'dra dkon/ /sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong chos shes kyang / ༷ /gcig shes kun grol gdams pa 'di 'dra dkon/ /dus gsum bde gshegase dgongs pa lon gyur kyang / /kun shes gcig tu gril ba'i gnad sprungs pa/ /nyams spyong srang tshad gdams pa 'di 'dra dkon/ /nam zhig lnga brgya'i snyigs mar babs pa'i tshe/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dam chos nyams dus/su/ /de tshe bdag gi bstan pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /snyigs ma'i dus ngan bar gyi tshigs pa la/ /rgyal brgyud rang gi bshul lam mi thub dus/ /gnas brtan dmag dpon 'dun shom byed pa'i dus1 /dge 'dun bzod pa'i go cha shor ba'i dus/ /sde 'khrug gnas bsa'athab ra 'cha' ba'i dus/ /dge slong gri mtshon rgyan du 'dogs pa'i dus/ /211

lha tshos bshad pa mi nag mkhas pa'i dus/ /lta ba zab mo nya mas gleng ba'i dus/ /dge sbyong bdud mo bud med bsten pa'i dus/ /chos byed khrel med glu kro byed pa'i dus/ /bde gshegs bka' la rin thang gcod pa'i dus/ /'argang po rgyab ser rgyang glu len pa'i dus/ /so so skye bo ngan sngags slob pa'i dus/ /gsang sngags slob dpon khye ltar 'khyams pa'i dus/ /slob ma dam med seng ltang 'gying ba'i dus/ dam nyams bka' log bshags pa mi byed dus/ /sa yi bcud nyams gter mdzod rdol ba'i duse/ /gsang sngags dus nyams dam tshig mi thub dus/ /skye bo nor nyams rku 'phrog byed pa'i dus/ /bud med khrel med rang lus mi thupa dus/ /sems can zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i/dus/ /de dus nga yi bstan pa 'byung ba ni1 /'dod khams rgyal po gangs kyi 'dabs su 'byung / / bod khams gling dgu sems can bde ba ldan/ /gsang sngags zapa mo sa yi steng du 'byung / /yang cig mtha' ma'i dus su 'byung ba ni/ /mi lo dgu brgya/bdun cu 'das pa'i dus/ /bod khams rgyal po legs pa'i blo gros ni/ /mi lus skye ba bcu bdun 'khor ba'i dus/ /srid pa mtha' ma khong khro'i zhing khams su/ /bye ma shing lo'i tshal zhes bya ba ru/ /rgyal po'i chos kyis sems can don mdzad pa/ /rgyal po rang tu snying po brnyes zhes pa/ /bde gshegs snying po mtshog la mnga' brnyes 'byung / /di dus nga yi bstan pa 'byung ba ni/ /grong khyer rdo mchog ces pa'i zhing khams su/ /gsang sngags sdong po skra yi wa ba can/ /'dam skyes pad+ma mon bu ā tsār+ya/ /nga yi sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya la/ /mgo brnyan khyung dang seng ge stag dang ni/ /dom dred la pogs sde tshan lnga ru sprul/ /bod yul bstan srung dred kyi gdong pa can/ /gdug rtsub ngan sngags rgyal po'i bstan pa srung / /sngags kyi bdag po sum cu rtsa gsum sgor//thugs kyi sras mchog sngags bdag chen po brgyad/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la dang 318

por 'byung bar 'gyur1 /bye ma 'dus pa nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /kun kyang lngags las dngos grub brnyes pa 'byung / /yang phyi 'dus pa stong dang bdun cu la/ /gsang sngags 'gro sad ting 'dzin mnga' brnyes 'byung / /thog mar dang po sngags bdag 'byung ba ni/ /shar phyogs g.yu ru gling gi zhing khams su/ /rdzucapaskyes byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya 'byung / de nas 'phos ste spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten kun grags dbyangs zhes su/ 1de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa sum stong 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs thung chub bde chen zhes byar 'gyur1 /shar phyogs g.yu ru bzang po'i zhing khams su/ /gsang sngags don dam theg chen rnal 'byor pa/ /sprul sku'i sems dpa' seng ge zhes bya 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi nyi ma sto phyogs kyi/ /dbang ldan ye dag ces bya'i zhing khams su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa 'dus pa bdun khri skyong / /bde gshegs zla 'od mya ngan med ces 'byung / /shar phyogs dbu ru 'phan zhes zhing khams su/ /theg chen don dam sems nyid rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po mgon po zhes bya 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi nyi ma nub kyi phyogs/ /zhing khams bde ba can zhes bya ba ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa bdun stong 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs sman mchog mgon skyabs zhes byar 'gyur/ /nub byang dbu ru rgya zhes bya ba nas/ /zhing khams rnam dag rin cen 'dus pa ru/ /gsang sngags don dam theg/chen rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags bdag bla ma rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /gus pa'i mchog gyur rtse gcig rnang 'byor 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jeg rten 'di yi nub kyi phyogs/ /zhing khams rnam dag pad+ma can zhes par/ 21zhu

de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa sum khri 'dus pa spyong / /bde gshegs nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes byar 'gyur/ /shar sto g.yu pru gzhung zhes bya ba ru/ /gsang sngags don dam rtse gcig rnal 'byor pa/ /byang chupa sems dpa' grags pa zhes bya 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi nub kyi phyogs/ /pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing khams rnam dag tu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa bdun khri 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs sā la'i mgon po zhes byar 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams dbu ru lam zhes par1 /gsang sngags rnal 'byor bde ba zhes bya 'byung / /theg chen glong yangs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rterwa 'di yi nub kyi phyogs/ /zhing khams dag pa pad+ma can zhes su/ /de bzhen gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa sum stong 'dus pa stong / /bde gshegs kun bzang rgyal ba'i mchog ces 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams lam zhes bya ba ru/ /mchog gi skyes bu bla ma'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nges don spyod 'gros bde 'bum zhes bya 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'dzam gling 'di yi nyi ma sto nub tu/ /u rgyan chu gling zhing khams dag pa ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgrur/ /bla med ston pa nyi khri 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs dri med gtsug tor can zhes 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khames dkar zashā zhes pa nas/ 1gsang sngags don dam 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags bdag nag mo bya 'bum zhes pa 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsu 'jig rten 'di yi nub phyogs sru/ /zhing khams rnam dag bde ba'i snying po ru/ /bde gshegs rngam brjed khro ba'i /rgyal po zhes/ /log lta tshar gcod dbang gi rgyal por 'gyur/ /wa dang khyi 320

spyang rgya 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /shākya'i zhing khams bsam yas phu gdong nas/ /byang sems gsang sngags theg chen rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po nam mkha' zhes pa 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi shar phyogs su/ /zhing khams rnam dag mngon par dga' ba ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bye ba 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs bla med nam mkha'i klong yangs zhes/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i rgyal ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams yar klungs spungs zhes su/ /gsang sngags theg chen spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po skel ldan zhes bya 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi shar lho mtshams/ /'brug sgra dbyangs/ldan zhing khams dag pa ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa lha mi'i 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba gzi brjid 'od naphro zhes par 'gyur/ /de byes 'dus pa nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /shākya'i zhing khams 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang / /smon lam dag pas byang sems gzhan don mdzad/ /'dusotsho1'i mchog gyur 'phags pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi byang shar mtshams su ni/ /kun mdzad bde chen yangs pa'i 'jig rten du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur//bla med ston pa bdun khri 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba 'od zer dbyangs zhes bya bar 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhib khams yar 'phreng zhes pa nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen dgongs ma'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po lha dar zhes bya 'byung / nade nas 'phos te spyod pa r+yabs chen mdzad/ /shā+ong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi sto phyogs su/ 1zhing khams rnam dag bya ba grub pa ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgyes bu kha lo sgrur/ /lta mi'i ston pa lnga khri 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba yon tan 231

bkod pa'i 'od zer 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams lugs mda' zhes bya ru/ /gsang sngags theg chen spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ sngags kyi bdag po 'dzin po zhes pa 'abheng / /de nas 'ashos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi shar phyogs su/ /shing khams rnam dag 'gyur thang zhes pa ru//de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bde gshegs pad+ma'i rgyal po zhes par 'gyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa khri yi 'dus pa skyong / /shākya'i zhing khams dbu ru ljang zhes nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po ri rab lhun zhes 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten zhing khams 'di yi shar phyogs kyi/ /zhing khams rnam dag mngon par dga' ba ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bdun khri 'dus pa skyong / /de bzhin gshegs pa bzang mchog ces par 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams stod lung mtsho zhes nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen ting 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kye bdag po rin cen zhes bya 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi bla med gong gi ngos/ /steng phyogs dag pa sngags kyi gzhal yas su/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo khro bo'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa khru spyang sprul pas bskor/ /shākya'i zhing khams g.yu ru gangs zhes nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po ye shes zhes pa 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi sto nub mtshams su yang / /u rgyan zhing khams thor cog can gyi gling / /rig 'dzin che la mnga' brnyepa mgon po zhes/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin stong phrag gsum gyis bskor/ /shākya'i zhing khams bsam yas phu zhes su/ /gsang sngags chos spyod ting 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po shes rab ces bya 'byung / /de nas 'dzos te 222

spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'dzam ming 'di ye shar sdi phyogardo su ni/ /zhing khams rang byung bde legs zhes pa ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo/—sbrur/ /bla med ston pa sum stong 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba dpa' bo mun sangs zhes par 'gyur1 /shākya'i zhing khams long stod ces pa na/ /byang sems smonangalam gzhan gyi don la brdon/ /ma 'ongs mkhas pa grags zhes 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /zhing khams rnam dag nor bu snang 'od du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bzhi khri 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba longs spyod mtha' yas zhes byapas 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams/bzang po yul zhes nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen sgong pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po dar po zhes pa 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gagum 'jig rten 'di yi lho phyogs su/ /zhing khams rnam dag yon tan dpal zhes su /de bzhin gshegs pa skyesagebu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bdun khre 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba rma tog dpal lce snying por 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams ngan lam dgon zhes nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen spyod panyi rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po dar ma zhes bya 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mngod/ /stong gsum mi mjed rdo je gdan zhes su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa seng ge sgra zhes 'byung / /'dus pa'i tshogs la dang ze bdun khri skyong / /shākya'i zhing khams snye mo zhes pa nas/ /gas3 sngags theg chen spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sdang sa/ste bdag po nyi ma zhes pa 'byung / /de nas 'phos ste spyod pa rlabs chen rgojed/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi byang phyogs kyi/ 1dpal dpyangs snying po zhes pa'i zhing khams su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyesamathu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bzhi khri 'dus pa spyong / /de bzhin gshegus pa 223

'jig rten mgon zhes 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams grwa phyi mkhar zhes nas/ /gsang sngags/theg chenanaspyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdarga po rnam mkha' zhes pa 'byung / /de nam/'phos ste spyod pa rlabaso chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi byang gi phyogs sa//yang / /rnam dag zhing khams byang chub klong mngase su/ /de bzhin gshogs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bzhi stong 'dus pa skyong / /de bzhin gshegs pa skyabs sprin rdo rjer 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams bsam yas zhes pa nas/ /theg chen skyes mchog gsang sngags rnapha 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po khri zhes bya ba 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'dzig rten 'di yi lho nub mtshams su yang / /zhing khams rnam dag rin cen chu gling du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur//bla med ston pa bzhi khri 'dus pa skyong / /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal bzang zhes par 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams dbu ru rgyal zhis nas/ /gsang sngags don dam theg chen rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po bde 'bum zhes pa 'byung / /de3sa 'phos ste spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi shar lho mtshams su ni/ /zhing khams rnam dag 'brug sgra dbyangs zhes su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bdun stong 'dus pa skyong / rgyal ba dpal gyi blo gros mgon zhes 'gyur/ /shākya'i zhing khams dbu ru zhes pa nas/ /zhing khams rnam dag chos byed ces pa ru/ /theg chen don dam gsang sngags rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po dpal zhes bya ba 'byung //༷de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi byang shar mtshams su ni/ /tshos mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya'i zhing khams su/ /de bzhigo gshegs pa skyes/bye kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bzhi stong 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs blo gros rin cen zhes pa 'byung / /shākya'i zhing khams dbu ru stod 224

ces nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen don dam rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po rim pa zhes pa 'byung / /di nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ / lo gsam 2di yi nub kyi phyogs sa yang / 1zhing bam zhi ba'i snying po dpal ///)sa ri gi sgo / /rdo/ga / sa sde zhe she phu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo/sgyur/ /bla med ston pa khri yi 'dus pa skyong / /bde gshegs rgyal ba nyi 'od dpal mgon zhes/ /'dzig rten mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhing khams/tre+em dag chos mchog 'bri zhes nas/ /sngags kyi ting 'dzin brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor/pa/ /don dam ye zhe / dgongs pa mnga' brnyes pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po rin cen zhes pa 'byung /nade nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi —shar gyi phyogs/ /zhing khams rnam dag mngon bar dga' ba ru1 /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa lha dang mi yi lha/ /rgyal ba klong yangs rgyal mtshan zhes par 'gyur/ /snga phyi 'dus pa 'bum phrag gsum du 'byung / shākya'i zhing khams kong po chu dar nas1 /gsang sngags theg chen spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdeg po rdo rje mgon zhes 'byung / /desanas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi byang 4phyogs thu/ /zhing khams rnam dag lha yi gzhal yas khang / de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu/kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa khri yi 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba g.yung snying gtsug phud ces pa 'byung / /shākya'i zhing khams g.yu ru grwa zhes nas/ /gsang sngags theg chen spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas dpon kun dga' zhes pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi sto yi phyogs su yang / /zhing khams rnam dag skar ma'i 'od ces sba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa rab rdzogs zhes bya 'byung / /shākya'i zhing khams 'gur mo zhes pa nas/ rdogasang sngagaXg

chen dgo ngas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po dpal zhes bya ba 'byung / /de nas 'phos te sprod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi steng gi phyogs su yang / /zhing khams rnam dag dga' ldan zhes pa ru/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skye/ga/bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa lha dang mi yi lha/ /rgyal ba rgyal mdzad mgon sho zhes pa 'byung / /shākya'i zhing khams byang phyogs khams zhes nas/ gsang sngags theg chen spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po rgyal bu zhes pa 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad//'jig rten 'di yi byang gi phyogs su ni/ /zhing khams nyi zla bkram pa zhes pa ru/ /de bzhin gesherges pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa 'dus pa stong phrag skyong / /rgyal ba rin cen rab mchog stes pa 'byung / /shākya'i zhing khams mdo khams zhes pa nas/ /gsang sngags don dam spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags kyi bdag po rdo rje grags zhes 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs lachen mdzad/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di yi byang phyogs su/ /zhing khams rnam dag tsardon nags zhes su/ /de bzhin gshegag pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa sum stong 'dus pa skyong / /rgyal ba ye shes kun bzang zhes pa 'byung / /shākya'i zhing khams mdo smad ces pa nas/ /gsang sngags nges don spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags bdag sgom pa zhi 'od ces pa 'byung / /de nas 'phos te spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi shar lho'i mtshams mu ni/ /rnam grol ye dag ces bya'i zhing khams su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skyes bu kha lo sgyur/ /bla med ston pa bdun stong 'dus pa skyong 1 /rgyal ba byang chub ye shes blo gros 'gyur/ /gsang sngags bstan pa byang gi phyogs su dar/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus pa'i phyi ma yis/ /byang phyogs gsang sngags 'di nyid dar zhing ༷rgyas/ /gsang sngags chen po'i sgrub pa mang bo/'byung / /tshos 'di spyod pa'i 236

gang zag mang po 'byung / /mtha' ma bstan pa byang gi phyogs su dar/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang cig mtha' ma'i dus su 'byung ba ni/ /lha min shing lo'i tshal zhes pya ba ru/ /rgyal po'i chas kyis sems can don mdzad pa/ /dge sgong rin chen btsan po zhes bya ni/ /lnga ldan dus kyi snyigs ma'i mtha' la 'byung / /nang blon phyi blon gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /bka' rtags 'dzin pa'i dge slong chen po dgu /chos kyi rgyal srid legs pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs/ /re re la yang bye ba phrag gis bskor/ /dur sprig 'dzin pa'i rgyal srid dar zhing rgyas/ /sku yi gsol ka phyag tshang sku gnyer lnga/ /gus pas pus btsugs mdun nas bsnyen cing bkur/ /bka' yi nang blon 'phrin las byed pa bcu/ /re re la yang stong phrag gsum gsum bskor/ /phyi nang bya byed 'phrin las kun rnams sgrub1 1bka' yi phyi blon 'phrin las sgrub pa brgya/ /re re la yang stong phrag re res bsgor/ /bstan pa'i 'phrin las dka' ba du ma spyod/ /bka' yi bstan tsung mon bu gshin rje'i gzugs/ /lha srin mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /bstan ba'i ru dra gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul/ /sku yi skyo bsangs sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs/ /gus shing dung pas gdams pa'i snying po len/ /mtha' ma'i dus su dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes phye ma'i dus thu bstan pa ji ltar 'byung ba'i lenyu ste bcu dgu pa'o// //slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /mnga' bdag mu tig btsan po dang / /yum chen btsun mos zhus pa yi/ /rgyal po'i dkar chag thang yig chen mo 'di/ /ldan ma rtse mang bdag gis dkar shog logs la btab/ /snang srid gtan la 'bebs pa'i thang yig chen mo zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ /gu ru u rgyan gleng pas dge ba mthar rgyas gling nas spyan drangs pa'o// //

bsam yas 'byordas ba/'edas dang ma byon da lta dus gsum du/ /btsun mo rin cen grangs medagabyon gyur kyang / /de tsam 4 ges 'jigs pas brir ma lang / /sa 'tsho grags 'dzin la sogs btsun mo'i 'khor/ /tshig don smra ba'i gsang rtags thugs la shar/ /gsal byed chos kyi me long ston pa'i bstan/ /srid pa rab zad sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems/ /lta bar mdzes pa'i sangs rgyas gtso la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel mdzad skyob pa'i chos/ /gang zag blo rnams gcig tu ma nges pas/ /gsung rab bcu gnyis 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /don dam4spros med ni ba mya ngan 'das/ /yon tan mchog bskyed chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ 1thub dbang slob ma nyan thos sdi gnyim dang / /srin rtsa'i nyes bcom rang rgyal rnam pa gnyis/ /thams cad 'dren pa rgyal ba sras kyi tshogs1 /rin cen lta bu'i dgos 'dod lta ba yis/ /mi ngoms chos spyod dge 'dun rnams la mos/ 'khor bar gnas shing sdug bsngal spyod pa rnams/ /so thar lag tu ma thon snying re rje/ /sha za gdong dmar 'dul mdzad mes dbon gsum/ /btsun mo bka' yi thar yig bstan par bya/ /gnya' khri btsan po man chad nas/ /smad kyi sde gsum yan chad la/ /btsun mo bdun cu don lnga yod/ /gdung rabs bzhi bcu tham pa thal lo gsungashā/ /sems can bde byed sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /bod na bon dar chos ni ma/dad pas/ /bod khams mun ba'i smag rum 'dra ba 'dir/ /u rgyan chen po gser g.yu'i khri la bzhugs/ /rgyal pos phyag rten bsnyen bkur 'bul ba byas/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas da ci 'dra zhig bzhengs zhus pas/ /u gyen pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal nas su/ /'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa 231

gathum dang mthun par bzhengs1 bstan pa mi nub chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bzhengs/ dge 'dugo kun dgan/ra ba phyi1zhadug ba ltad bzhengs/ nang mdo sde dang bstun nas dbus kyi ri bo mchorge rab/la gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlas bskor da'i tshude/ du bzhings/ rgya phrag mngon pa dang bstun nas sku gsung thugs kyi bzhugs gnas su bzhengs/ 'bras bu gsad sngags dang bstun nas dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs par bzhengs gsungs so/ /'o na de ltar byed pa'i dpe gang na yod zhus bas/ rgya dkar nag gi mtshams/ sngon dus bzhengs pa spo tanyi pū ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas bzhengs/ sa pho stag lo ston bla 'bring bo'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ chu pho 'brug gi nyi ma skar/ma lag sor/ gza' phur bu la u rgyan pad+ma nyid kyis sa 'dul mdzad/ 'og khang rgya gar dang bstun nas sprul sku'i zhing khams/ bar khang rgya nag dang bstun nas longs sku'i zhing khams/ steng khang bod yul dang bstun nas chos sku'i zhing khams su bzhengs/shib lji bas na mas nas bteg ste 'og sbyar pa dang shug pa/ bar lcang ma/ ster gso ma/ dbu rtse rigs gsum sku gsum zhing khams/ dpe kha gsum yod pas dbu rtse rigs gsum zhes bya'o/ /za dmar rgyan gyis khams gsum zangs khang chabazhengs/ 'bro bza' byang chub sgron mas dge rgyas bzhengs/ pho gyong rgyal mo btsun gyis bu tshal gser khang bzhengs/ mchod rten bzhi1 gter kha bzhi/rdo ring bzhi/ zangs kyi khyi mo bzhi/ lcags thag la sogs pa rgyal po'i dbu rtse chen mo 'dra ba kun la yod/ phyi la lcags ri nag po/cig gis bskor ba'i bsam yas 'di chu pho rta lo ston zla 'bring po la lha rjedres bar du ma chod par lo lngas tshar ro/ /dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga la me tog 'thor ba'i sngon du bsnyen pa zhag nyer gcig mdzad/ /de nas rab gnas mdzad do/ /ye ma sems can nyes skyob legs 'a/byed btsun mo lnga / mchims bza' ma ni lha mo btsun/ /232

mkhar chen bza' ste mtsho rgyal gnyis/ /'bro bza' byang chub ma dang gsum/ btsun mo tshe bza' me tog sgon/ /btsun mo pho spyong rgyal mo btsun/ /'jig rten khams na 'gran zla ma po/chis pa'i/ /ya rabs tshogs pas dpal gyi bsacas yas grud/ /rgyu bzang bkod legs rgya che srog gra mchan/ /rgya bod 'dus ngas rdor gdan gnyis pa 'byongs1 /lo paṇa bzhugs gnas bong la drin cher tshar/ /nyi 'og rgyal khams bzang mkhas bsam yas khugs/ /bka' dang bstan bcos rgya gar grags tshad bsgyur/ /dam pa chos kyi nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /zed khams thams cad kun ma thang mar brdal/ /rgyal po'i mnga' thang steng 'og dbus mthar rgyas/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po zil gnon mog mog gyur/ /snyan pa'i ba dan gyis ni nyi 'og khyab/ /rje 'bangs bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'di/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha dang mnyam par grags/ /mtho ris thar pa'i them skas ldan par gyur/ /skyes bu thams cad chos la sems pa ste/ /ma 'ongs phan pa'i 'phrin las rgya cher mdzad/ /bsam yas 'byongs pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //11gas pa/sde /sngab/ba /glu /sde/ba/ga/sngags pas sngags glu sdi bzhi gsungs/ /gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /sna nam zo rje bdud 'jomag dang / /mchims kyi shākya bra bha dang / /shud bu dpal gyi seng ge ste/ khong shazhis mi res glu re blangs/ /u rgyan chen pos 'di skad do/sungs/ /kakakakakakakakakakakakakakaskukakacokakakakakag kakakakakadakar po bsgul kyang lha yi bag /chu mig gnyan chen 'de ma dkrug cog ge gog chu mig gnyan chen 'di dkrugs na glu yi bag /dug sprul khru bo 333

'di ma gzung cog ge zhog dug sbrul khra po 'di bzung na dug gi bag /brde sngags pa 'di ma sgul cog ge zhog /bsde sngags pa 'di bskul na mthu yi bag /dpas gyi bsam yas 'di ma skul cog ge zhog /dpal gye bsam yas 'di bsgul na bstan nub/bag /ces gsungs so/ /sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis gsungs pa/ kakakaka'akakakakakakakakakakakakakakakaka/ kakakakakaka byaka'akakakakakakakakan/ /bya 'dab shog/rgyas pa don re chung / /nya 'phyo rba la 'phyo ba nyam mi nga //nya 'phyo rba la 'phyo ba nyam nga na/ /nya chu nang du skyes pa don re chung / /lcags kyi ga ru rdos mi chog lcags kyi ga ru rdos chog na/ /lcags la zhun thar byas pa don re chung / /ban+de sngags pa dgras mi 'jig /brde sngags pa dgras 'jig na/ /mi tsher sgom sgrub byas pa don re chung / /zhes gathungs so/ /mchims shakya pra t+ta'i zhag nas/ /kakakakakakakakakakakakagyekaljokakakakakakakaka kakakakakakakakaso klu la zug /rtse mo dga' ldan lha yul slebs/ /yal gas bar lam ma snyeb kyang / /lo 'dab/bod yul dbus su slebs/ /gcan gzan seng ge'i phru gu de/ /rtsal gsum tshad du ma rdzogs kyang / /sder chags thams cad glad nas 'joms/ /'dab chags khyung gi phru gu de/ /gshog rtsal tshad du ma rdzogs kung / /'dab chags thams cad klad nas 'joms/ /brje sngags pa'i phru gu de/ /sgom sgrub tshad du ma 'khyol kyang / /dgra bo thams cad klad nas ༷'joms/ /zhes gsungs so/ /shud bu dpal gyi seng ge dgra shi ba la dga' nas/ phyag sprel nas dbyangs su blangs pa/ sangs rgyas chos dang dege 'dun gsum/ /chos nyid ngang du tshogs 'tshogs nas/ /dgraXdug lnga'i mgo la cam cam 'khrigs/ /gri dang mda' dang mdung gsum gyis/ /skyes dar ma'i mgo la cam cam 'khregs/ /sngags dang ting 'dzin zor dang gsum/ /ban+de sngags pa'i phyag tu brengs se breng / /dam nyams dgra bgegs mgo la chem chem shā3/

('khrigs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sngags sdi/sde bsdo'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //rje yi dga' glu/bcu gsum/ rje yis dga' glu bcu gsum blangs/ /rin cen sna lnga tshang pa bod kyi /yul/ /'bru sna lnga la longs spyod mgo nag rje/ /tsha grang khod stoms nyi1ma dbus kyi sa/ /bod kyi rgyal por skyes pa nga re dga'/ /zhib mor bsags pa las ni rjas 'byung zhing / /nyin mtshan bsams pa las ni blo 'byung ste/ /ya rabs mdzad pa las ni phyag ris 'byung / /rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan nga re dga'/ /mes po tho tho snyan shal chos dbu brnyes/ /sgong btsan sgame pos tshos kyi srol yang btod/ khri srong sde'u btsan chos kyi gzhi zhig things/ /bzang po'i yar 'then yod pas nga re dga'/ /sems can mtho ris thar pa'i 'am 'gro ba/ /bod 'bangs rnams ni dge ba bcu la 'tshud/ /za hor mkhan po bo /dhidis tā byon/ /ngan pa'i mar 'then med pas nga re dga'/ /chos kyi gzhi ma mi chadage bcu po spong / /ston pa'i/rtags 'dzin byas pa yid la mdzes1 /'jig rtego 'khor bshi spyod spangs chos spyod bcu1 /sangs rgyas spyod lam shes pa nga re dga'/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob dpon pad+ma 'byung / /ya mtshan rmad byung sku la skye 'chi med/ /mthu rtsal ldan pas ri rab bteg par nus/ /sangs rgyag gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang byon dga'/ 1bod kyi lha 'dre mi baspun dam la btags/ /bsam yas mi bas lha 'dres brtsigs pa mtho/ /nga yi bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum 'de/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes parta'adra ste dga'/ /pha ma'i ngor g.yang sdig pa'i las mi byed/ /srog gi phyir yang dam pa'i chos mi sgong / /tshe 'di'i don du rgyal srid chos kyis spyod/ /phyi ma'i don du lha tshos byed pas 236

dag3/ /phyi yi rgyal srid phyugs lug bzhin du skyong / /nang gi rgyal srid bu tsha bzhin du skyong / /bar gyi rgyal srid bran khol bzhin du skyong / /rgyal mo'i mnga' thang chos la spyod pas dga'/ 'di las lhag pa gang na med do bsam/ /nor gye zhen pa sdog pa'i gnya' gcog yin/ /lus ngag yid gagum dge bar 'khod pa'i thabs/ /bdag ni sems can mtho ris 'dren par dga'/ /ngan cing blun pa'i bod rnams chos la nyon/ /sems can 'gro don byas par rang don 'grub/ /ngan song skye ba'i srid bcom phyir mi sdog sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing tshugs pas dga'/ /zhing ngan pa la sbyin btang tshogs mi rdzogs/ /zhing mchog bzang po dge 'dun dbu sde gnyis/ /'di la bkra shis bsod nams dbang chen 'thob/ /phyi mar mtho ris thob pas nga re dga'/ /dge sdig ngo shes ya rabs ngo tsha thub/ /sems nyid gyong po 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ mdo mang rgyud mang bstan bcos mang po bsgyur/ /'bri klog sgom 'dzin byed pas nga re dga'/ /rje'i dga' glu'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //mi res glu re blangs pa'i khog phub/rgyal sras mu tig btsan pos stong glu blangs/ /mkhan pos sgom phrepa dkar po bya ba blangs/ /nam mkha'i snying pos byams pa'i glu lnga blangs/ /pa tshapaṃ nyi mas snying rje'i glu lnga blangs/ /g.yu sgra snying pos dga' bzhi'i glu lnga blangs/ /chos kyi bzang pos btang stoms glu lnga blangs/ /legs sbyin nyi mas sbyin pa'i glu lnga blangs/ /yon tan mchog gis ngag snyan gru lnga blangs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes don mthun glu lnga blangs/ /'phags pa shes rab don spyod glu lnga blangs/ /rgyal ba mchog dbyangs 'dod pa zag med blangs1 /klu yi rgyal 236

—sadutshogo ma rig zag med blangs/ 1dgongs pa gas la gyes sred pa zag med sazlangs/ /bkra shis mkhyen 'dren lta ba zag rjad blangs/ /dri med tho shar chos lūn stong nyid blangago/ /glu yi dbang pos mtshan ma med pa blangs/ 1gnyan chen dpal dbyangs k+ṣe+on pa med nga blangs/ /ska /ོgdapal brtsegs mngon par 'du mi byed/ /dpapa byes seng ges lus/drago nyer gzhag blangs/ /be+e ro tsa nas chos dran nyer gzhag blangs/ /ye shes 'tsho rgyal tshor yun nyer gzhag blangs/ /dpal kyi ye shes sertsa sa dran nyer gzhag blangs/ /glu yi ngo bo thabs kyi glu/ /nges chig snying po/don gyi glu/ /dbye ra stong lnga brgya/ bsdu na gnam yol g.yung ༷drung / sa yol g.yung drung / glu 'khor ba spro bskyed blangs pa ni/ steng tshangs ༷ba lha'i glu dgu blangs/ sa lol mad+ma/ bar yol lan 'debs/ sma the bcu/ te sru 'du/ khyams khar la/ zur med/ blum po/ gleng re tri/ 'jig rten nyi'i blu dgu'o/ /bar mi'i glu la lnga ste/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa gyos po'i glu/ yid bzhin nor bu bdun phog sgyug mo'i glu/bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad bag ma'i glu/ gtsang chab me tog gi bcud gsal khu bzhang gi glu/ 'og glu la glu ris bcu gsum mo/ /gsan pa dung gi glu chu srin gyi bgon pa/ gnas pa rgya mtsho'i glu chu bo bzhi'i 'bab phyogs/ gzigs pa nyi zla'i blu gzang skar dpag tshad rgyang grags/ za ra tshags kyi glu 'phral sbyar skyon yon/ ba dan mdzes pa'i glu skyems 5 chog nyams dga'/ 'phan gdugs gzings grog gi blu sha tsha skog nyal/ malhar ba'i glu ya rabs skyems gsol/ na chung tsam po kha'i glu pho krog dang mo krog go /rar na ya'i glu mi lkog glu/ u mo ta'i glu gzhan sun 'don/ me ga pad+ma'i glu mdza' mthun yid 'phrog byung rabs rin po che'i rkang 'gros kyi glu 'di phyi'i bya ra/ chu rta gser sga'i glu cang shes kyi rta rabs/ glu ris 'di rnams rje 'bangs ku na gyis blangs/ gsang 237

sngags rdo rje'i theg pa 'di nyid longs spyod khyad par che/ bsam yas rab gnas tshar nas lo bcu gsum bar/ nyin re bzhin du mtsho mo mgul du tshogs/ mi res glu re blangs so/ /khog phub le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //(1/ba pa//ba/snye/ba/chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyes/ /u rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sku/ /dbu rtse chen mo'i bar khang spyan drangs nas/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs rin cen khri la bzhugs/ /sku yi 'od zer las byung slob ma'i tshogs/ /'bum phrag mang po 'dus nas skor ba byed/ /lha phyog 'tshal zhing mchod pa rgya cher 'bul/ /nam mkha' 'od gsal 'ja' tshon mang po shar/ /sa gzhi co dzes pa'i me tog mang po skyes/ /phyogs bcu yongs su sgra snyan mang po bsgrags/ /u rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /sku gsung thugs las gsang sngags chos bstan pas/ /yon mchod lus ngag yid gsum skreb pa byang / /phyogs bcu 'jig rten dag gi khams kun tu/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul sku grangs med pas/ /'gro don nus par shog cig lan lnga gsungs/ /sprul sku rnams kyang de don thugs chud gyur/ /chos gsung gang gi sgo nas ma 'gags par/ /srod la bsam yas dbu rtse chen mo ru/ /u rgyan pad+ma'i sku la mtshod pa phul1 /gung la bsam yas mchims phu'i brag phug tu/ /bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams btul/ /tho rangs yar klungs shel sne brag /lhag/byon/ /de tshe de dus u rgyan pad+ma la/ /bo ro tsa na dri med zla shar dang / /yar rje brtsegs se yon tan mchog rnams kyis/ /pad+ma shel phug lha khang mchod pa phul/ /de yi byin rlabs pad+ma'i sku las/su/ /'od zer mang po phyogs bzhizimatshams brgyad 'phros/ /336

shar phyogs 'jibakarten khams su dkar po 'phros/ /zhe sdang dmyal ba'i sgo bcad don ched du/ /kong po rong nag lha ri gyang rdor song / /rgya nag chu mi rgya mtsho dag la thim/ /byang phyogasgo 'jig rten khams su ljang gu 'phros/ 'dod chags mi rwags sgo bcad don ched du/ /dbu ri rlung di 'tshub po yal nas song / /ge sar mtshon gyi rgyal khams sa la thim/ /nub phyogs 'jig rten 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ /gti mug byol song rnams kyi sgo bcad phyir1 /gtsang g.yargaru yi ri tser yal nas/song / /mnga' ris skor gasnyam don por 'od du zhu/ /lho phyogs 'jig rten 'od zer spyon po 'phros/ /phrag dog mi rnams sgo bcad don byed phyir/ /rgya mon mtshams su 'ja' ltar yal nas song / /ru 'ag ri bo sul mang rtse la phog /sdubs skatsho gling dgu'i dkyil du thim nas yal/ /dbus phyogs/'jig rten 'od zer ser po 'phros/ /nga rgyal lha min rnams kyi sgo bcad phyir/ /yar klungs zo thang gong po ri le them/ 1gnam mtsho phyug mo'i dkyil du 'od du zhu/ /bod kyi khre shor/rgyal mo'i mtsho la them1 /ma pham g.yu mcho'i dkyil du yal nas song / /phyogs bzhi dbus lngar zhal ni lhag ge byung / 1u rgyan pad+ma rab tu thugs dgyes te/ 1'gro ba'i don byed bsam yago'adra ba re/ /ri dnge mtsho dang phyogam dbus rang byung la/ /mchod pa sna lnga sman rag gtor gsum phul/ /mched po lnga yis pad 'byung shal mthong bas/ /spyan sngar 'dus nas bskor ba lha phyag 'tshal/ /mchod pa phul nas 'dod don 'di skad zhus/ /bdag cag mched lnga 'a khor ba'i sgo bcad la/ /chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong nang nas kyang / kha tshang/don 'dril zhal zhesal bka' rnams 'dus/ /nges tshig bden pa'i bskyed jogs bstan du gsol/ /mu rgyan chen pos 'di skad bka' bsnal to/ rigs chen lnga yis 'di ltar gsol ba legs/ /sems can thams cad dug lnga'i dbang gis 23nya

'khor/ /gnas lngar skyes pa de rgyun bcad pa'i phyir/ /bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho bshad par bya/ /ro langs bdun gzugs seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ /shel gyi phyags shing gser gyi pa tra bsnams1 /slob bu rnams ni pus btsugs thalu mo sbyar/ /shel gyi brag phug bkod pa lhun grub nang / /bka' 'dus mdo lnga rgyud bdun bshad cing bzhugs/ /de tshe de dus shar phyogs 'jig rten gyi/ /lha dang lha mo mang po sprin gseb nas/ /dar khru 'phyar zhing sgra snya na bsgrags shing 'dus/ /de nas mi mang po zhog 'ong zhing 'dug /de nas pad+ma brtsegs pa'i thang la phebs so/ /sprul pa bkye ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //mi rnams dang dre ba dris len mdzad pa/de nas mi de rnams kyis phyag btsal lo/ /ri 'di'i ming la ji skad zer ba lags/ /brag 2di'i ming la ji skad zer ba lags/ khyed rnams mtshan la ji skad zer ba lags/ /mu rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas ga na bzhugs/ /de la u rgyan pad+mas bka' stsal pa1 ri 'di'i ming ni pad+ma brtsegs pa yi na/ /brag 'di'i ming ni thad+ma shel phug yin/ /bdag ni 'dren pa'i skyes bu pad 'byung yin/ /'khor pa 'di rnams rdo rje'i spun lnga yin/ /bka' 'dus chos kye rgya mtsho nyan pa lag sa/ rigs kyi thu nyid nam mkha' dar gyis bkang / /sa gzhi phrobyo/sa cad rol mo'i sgra yis bkang / /gser gyi 'khor lo shing rta bzhon pa dang / /'khor ba mang pos mtha' ma legs par bskor/ /shin tu ngo mtshar che ba zhig snang ngo / /yul ni ji skad bya nas 'ong / /ming ni ji skad bya ba yin/ /da ni gang du 'gro ba yin/ /de skad u rgyan pad+mas bka' stsal pas/ / mi rnams zhwabs la phyag 'tshal spyi bos gtugs/ /bgrod sar phyin na re dga' 24'o

re sgyid na/ /bsam pa 'grub po re dga' re skyid na/ /sprul sku'i zhal ma rdong re dga' re skyid na/ /ma hā gu ru chen po lags/ /bdag cag mchis pa'i yul ni rgya nag lags/ /ming ni du har nag po bya ba lags/ /yul na gson po'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab/ /sems can skye 'chi 'du 'bral larmeganas na/ /maspo ris 'dren pa'i thar lam ston mkhan yed/ /gu ru chen po da lta spyan 'dren mchis/ /bstan pa'i sgon me skye 'chi gnyis spangs sku/ /btsong kha rgyam po'i mchod gnas gshegs par zhu/ /de skad ces gsole pa dpa / /u rgyan chen poja/ thugs dgongs bka' bsnyal pa/ /sprul sku du tar nag mo khyed/ /ngag 'jam khong dal snying rje che/ /zhi dul sems ldan cig snang ste/ /bdag ni phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga'i/ /mched po lnga la bka' 'dus chos ston pas/ /bstan pa 'di yi 'phro gcod mi rung ngo / /be+e ro tsa na kun 'chang sprul pa yin1 /rgyal po'i mchod gnas bstan pa'i sgon mer btang / /rgya bod mkhas pa be ro tsa na khyod/ /dbang po gsal zhing shes rab rig pa dwangs/ /rig pa no zhing brtul zhugs shin tu che/ /'du shes myur cing tshor ba skyen blo bstan/ /thugs rje che zhing byin rlabs dregs pa 'dul/ /ngas kyang bstan ni mi dgos blo cig yin/ /pad 'byung bka' 'di dang du long zhig bu/ /lta ba yas 'bubs mas 'jog brtsegs/ /gzhi ma snying rje che la longs kyang spyod/ /lam ni pha rol phyin pa bcu la song / /de skad bka' bstsal be+e ros lan gsol pa/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad 'byung bka' byung na/ /dmyal ba'i yul du sprugs kyang 'gro bar bgyid/ /pad 'byung bka' ni lha 'dres ma chogs nas/ /rāk+ṣa srin ngos kyang ni skrub par byed/ /rje yi bka' bstsal bzhin du bdag mchis pas/ /'gro zhes de skad gsol nas rta gtad de/ /u rgyan chen po pad+mar phyi phyag btsal/ /grwa rogs kun la smon lam btab nas chas/ /slob dpon du har 2 1

dan rnang 'grogs te gshegs/ /brtsegs se gamu sgra gnyis kyang gdung ba skyes/ /phyi bzhin 'brangs nas lam la chas pa'i dus/ /nya mang lcags gseb phyen tsa na/ 1be+e ro tsa nas 'di skad gsungs/ /lha dang slob dpon gcig pa'i grogs po rganyis/ /gu ru'i bka' ma bcag par nga yis 'ongs/ khyed gnyis nga mi khrid pas 'di nas log /gu ru'i thugs 'gal ngan song gnas su skye/ /brtsegs se g.yu sgras lan btab pa/ /lha dang slob dpon grogs po gsum/ 1dam pa yin pas mnyam par gnyan/ /rgya nag brtsang khar bskyal nas ldog /de gong de skad ma gsungs shig /de nas dol thang thang la phebs tsa na/ /rgyal po khri grong sde'u btsan gsan nas su/ /da rung nga yi dgos pa bsgrub dgos yod/ /bo ro tsa na ma 'dren bzhugs su chug /slob dpon du har nag pos 'di skad smras/ /bstan pa'i sgron me brtsegs se g.yu sgra gnyis/ /dbus kyi rnam snang skyol chung 'di nas log /rgya nag yul du bskyal nas slar ldog na/ 1rgyal 'bangs ya ga bdag la 'ong du mgis/ /slob dpon bskyal nas gshegs pa da mi zer/ /rgyal po'i mchod gnas gsum tsam spyan drangs pas/ /rgyal po'i tshul la ma mgu gnyis ni bros/ /de skad rgyal 'bangs gleng du 'ong bar nges/ /'di las bgrod bshul lam thag ring pa na/ /u rgyan pad+ma bdag la mi dgyes nges/ /brtsegs se g.yu sgra 'di nas phar la gshegs/ /yang cig be+e ro tsa nas 'di skad gsungs/ /gu ru'i bka' sked khyed gnyis nga mi khrid/ /khams gsum sems can dus gcig bsad pa bas/ /bla ma'i bka' bcag shin tu gnyan/ /dmyal bar nges rgyu 'di 'dra sogs/ /gdod nas ma thos shin tu nyes med dge bdag gi ngo dang 'dra ba'i rta nag 'di/ khyed gnyis zhon la ku ru'i spyan sngar song / /de skad gsungs nas rta nag steng nas babs/ /srab mda' grogs po gnyi la gtad pa dang / /rta ni ma dga' skad ngan lhang lhang 242

'tshen/ /g.yas g.yon mig nas mchi ma byi'u sgong tsam/ /de la bo ro tsa nas mgur gsungs pa/ /bstan pa'i sgon me sgob dpon pad+ma la/ khams gsum sems can ma lus kun re bas/ /bdag ni sku tshab rgya nag yul du phyin/ /yid 'thad dargan pa'i gnas shig 'dzin pa las/ /rta nag khyod zhon gar yang 'gro sa med/ /padag dang 'dra ba brtsegs se g.yu sgra gnyis/ /rta nag ma sdug skyid par gyes shig gsungs/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i bang chen phyogs bcur byas/ /rta nag lus po bor nas thar pa 'thob/ /chos dar rig 'grub 'phan yul don yod skye/ /de skad gsungs pas rta nag mchi ma chad/ brtsegs se g.yu sgra gnyis kyis 'di skad smras/ /bstan pa'i sgron me slob dpon pad+ma/la/ /'jig rten khams na slob ma grangs mang yang / /slob ma'i dwangs ma thugs dang 'dra ba ra/ /bdag cag spun gnyis yin pas su/ /yul du bskyal na rgyal po nyid mi dgyes/ /la / la 'grogs na be+e ro tsa na skrag /gu ru nyid kyang gal te mi dgyes srid/ /da ni bdag cag 'di nas sdog par bya/ /de skad smras nas mched gnyis kyis/ /ral ka sbar ta phud nas phul lo/ /le'u drug pa'o// //btsun mo tshe spong bza' dmar rgyan be+e ro tsa nar chags sems skyes pa/de nas phyi phyag byas na sa tho sor gyes/ /brtsegs se g.yu sgra rta nag gsum/ /pad+ma brtsegs pa'i brag la gshegs/ /du har nag po 'khor 'bangs bcas pa rnams/ /bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum gling bran dang / /jo mo kling gzum mchims phu ka chu la/ /mchod pa lha phyag skor ba byed du gshegs/ /rtabe+e ro rgya nag yul du bzhud pa la/ /rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan ma dgyes nas shā4lo

chos bsgrur bod na lo tsā mkhas pa med/ /slob dpon bzhud pa'i bshol 'debs byed dgos bsam/ /dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar du/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas btsun mo sras ming sring / /gtso mdzad bod kyi ltong sde tshogs nas su/ /be+e ro tsa na'i mdun nas gsu ba byas/ /dar 'phyar dung 'bud 'khar rnga cha lang rdeb/ /bskor she lha phyag mchod pa phul nas bshas/ /de nas bsam yas dbu rtse chen mor byon/ /gsol zas bda' dgu sku la mdzes pa dpa / /thugs su 'byon pa'i ka ca khyad 'phags phul/ 1rgyal po btsun mo ming sring blon po rnams/ /be+e ro lo gsum bzhugs pa'i zhu ba phul/ /du har nag po 'khor bcas rgya nag brdzangs/ /lo gsum song nas gtong ba'i 'phrin yig bskur/ /mkhas pa chen po be+e ro tsa na nyid/ /brag dmar g.yang ma lung du dgongs par gshegs/ /nang par slob dpon dro la byon tsa na/ /bsam yas yul gyi bya gag rnams kyis bsus/ /de nas ri dwags spu sdug rnams kyis ༷bsus/ /de nas gcan gzan ri bkra rnams kyis bsus/ /de nas rta mchogacang shes rnams kyi bsus/ /de nas glang po khyu mchog rnams kyi bsus/ /de nas khyi rig pa can gyis bsus/ /de nas sras ni lcam dral gnyis gyis bsus//de nas rgyal po yab yum blon 'bangs bsus/ /de nas bsam yas dbu rtse'i ༷nang du byon/ /gsol zas ro mchog bda' dgu drangs nas gsol/ /de nas mdo dang smon lam btab nas gshegs/ khyad par can du nam gyi srod dus la/ /bdud dang gshin rje srin po gnod sbyin rnams/ /slob dpon zhal mthong mchod pa 'bul du 'ong / /nam gung lo skor rgyu skar gza' glu gnyan/ /slob dpon zhal blta mchod pa 'bul du 'ong / /nam gyi tho rengs srid bskos phra dang lha/ /slob dpon zhal blta mchod pa 'bul du 'ong / /de nas nam langs ye shes lha tshogs rnams/ /'dod don lnga yi mchod pa 'bul du 'ong / /nyi ma rtse 244

shar ru+o/langs bdun der rag /de ltar mkhas pa be+e ro tsa na nyid/ /lo gsum g.ya' ma lung gi brag phug tu/ /rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan bteg nas bzhuṭa//dgongs pa mdzad cing sangs rgyas bstan pa spel/ /yul khams gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kung / /sdig pa bcu sgong dge ba bcu spyod do/ /de tsho de dus sprir yang bod khams kyi/ /sems can thams cad 'dod pas rgyal lags so/ /de na bud med rigs byed thams cad kun/ /chags pa che zhing 'dod pa drags nga lags/ /de yi nang nas mnga' bdag rgyal po yi/ /btsun mo che spongagabaza' ni dmar rgyan las/ /'dod chags che ba 'jig rten khams na med/ /de nyid mkhas pa be+e ro tsa na la/ /bstan pa'i chos dang bden pa'i tshig mi nyan/ 1slob dpon la ni 'dod chags sems skyes nas/ /btsun mo bsam pa ngan pa sems la 'gyus/ 1slob dpon grogs la lan cig 'grogs par mno/ /yid kyis smon lam btab cing sems la gab/ /blob dpon nang par dro la byon pa la/ /rgyal po grong khyer sku 'chag btang nas su/ /bu tsha ming sring gnyis kyang rtsed mong btang / /'khor ba rnams kyang phar la bskrad nas su/ /sems can phyi mas bas ba'i rteng la ni/ /mo rang gcig pus slob dpon bsus nas su/ /mkhar 'bar mal gong sgang sngon rtse dgu yi/ /rgyal sa yang thog blob dpon spyan drangs nas/ /zhal zas ro mchog ldan pa sna tshogs drangs/ /slob dpon zhal zas drangs rnams gsol nas su/ /bzhengs nas g.yang ma lung du gshegs pa la1 /btsun mo ba ni dmar rgyan gyis gsog pa/ /slob dpon sgang sngon rtse dgur gdan 'dren pa/ /ba ga ni chags pa skyes so slob dpon dgongs/ /slob dpon khyed ni ci bltas ci ru mdzes/ /ci gsung ci ru bden pas chags pa skyes/ /'di la mi brten gang yang ma mchis so/ /'di la ma brten khyed kyang sku mi 'khrungs/ /de skad zer nas slob dpon sku la 'jus/ /slob dpon shin tu/ 245
