charab tu dngangs par gyur/ /thugs kung byes pas sgo nga bskyur ba bzhin/ /yar 'phar mar rdeb sku lus 'dar 'dar ro/ /bsam blo 'bad nas btang nas gnos gzhibs pas/ /blo zhig rnyed nas btsun mor bka' bstsal pa/ /'khor ba rnams kyis mthong ngam rig pa na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nub ste 'gro brtsa su/ /padag ges bya ra pyas la phyi sgo bcad/ /de nas log nas 'ong gi zer nas gshegs/ /btsun mo snyam na slob dpon bden snyam btang / /slob dayon sgo ru cur gyis byung nas bros/ /le'u bdun pa'o/ / / // btsun mos sto long btab pa/ btsun mos 'ong du re nas bsdad ngang thung / /ma byung sgo phyir phyin na bltas pa na/ /slob dpon bu tshal steng du slebs nas song / /btsun mos bsams pa shin tu snying na nas/ /slob dpon khyod kyang 'jig rten mi yul 'dir/ /nga yis bstan pa stub kyi zer nas su/ /chig ngan smras te khyim du log nas song / /lha babs skad zer 'dre babs nas zer smyo/ /sgrog bu bcad de sham thu phral nas su/ /'dzings pa'i tshul du lus po sen rjes byas/ /'phrig cing ngus pas 'khor rnams drung du byung / /btsun mo ci nongs ci nyes ci la bzhums/ /'khor pa rnams kyis de skade gsol ba dang / /btsun mos 'khor pa kun la lan smras pa1 /da lta shi la ma byung nga la byung / khyed rnams sprur song rgyal po spran drongs shog /'khor pa rnams kyis rgyal po'i spyan sngar phyin/ /chos rgul chen po 'khor pa'i ngag la gson/ bshān mo'i zhal nas rgyal po spyan drongs gsung / /da lta mi la ma byung nga la byung / /rgyal po myur bar spyan drongs shog cig gapungs/ /rgyal po myur bar yaranal gshegs par zhu/ /rgyal po shin 246

tu ma dgyes khab tu byon/ /btsun mo de ni kha bub ngu zhing 'dug /rgyal pos btsun mo la ni 'di skad gsungs/ /ngu zhing rab tu ngu ba ci nongs pa/ /mi la sa byung ci byung mgo theg dang / /rgyal po'i phyag gis btsun pho'i mgo bteg pas/ /btsun mo yar la ljog byas 'phrig cing ngus/ /gtam yang mi 'byen pa bzhin byed byed nas/ /nyid kyis zhabs nas 'degs rin chog pas gda'/ /da nang mi med sa ru gsol drangs pas/ /slob dpon bdag la mchongs nas 'dzin du byung / /sgrog bu bcad daja sham bu phral la gzigs/ /lus bo/'jings pas sen rjes 'di ltar bkang / /de skad ces pa btsun mos smras pa dang / /rgyal po'i blon po 'khor ba thams cad kun/ /gros ma byas par blo ni phyogs gcig mthun/ /'di ni gsad pa'i 'os yin bsad pa 'thad/ /mi gsod na yang rngon bya'i rigs yin no/ /rngon mi byed na'ang brag phug nas phyung la/ /brdungs shing /btogs la tho les thob las thong / /de skad blon po 'khor pas gsol pa dang / /rgyal po chen pos 'di skad bka' bstsal to/ /mi yi mchog gyur skyes bu de la yang / /'khor ba'i 'dod chags sems kyi ma spangs nas/ /yon bdag mo la 'dzen du 'ong ba 'di/ /sems can phyi ma thams cad blta bas yus/ /dge 'dun bstan pa nub tu tho pa yigo/ /'o cag bsod nams tshogs ni dum yang med/ / /re ma dga' 'o ji lta bu yad srid/ /de skad gsungs nas dbu gtums nas bzhugs so/ /btsun mos 'khor la ngag bcug rbad pas kung / /slob dpon sku la bdo thabs re ba yang / /grib ma 'gom pa gcig kyang ma byung ste/ khong rnams thams cad myog myog por song ngo / /de nas sang nyin dbu rtser byon pa la/ /dro dus dro la byon kyang bsu ba med/ /bya skad gcan gzan ri dwags bsu ba med/ 1rta dang glang po khyi'i ris bas ba med/ /sras ñcam rgyal po yab yum bsu ba med/ /de nas rgyal po'i pho brang byon pa 24shā

dirnga / /sgor phyin 2khor pa rnams kyang myos nas snang / /slob dpon dargongs bas btsun mos sto long rig /slar loge brag dmar g.ya' ma lung du gshegs//gnas su ma tshugs slar mang sgor byud nas/ /byol song rig pa yod pas bgur 'ong ba/ pha rir ngu zhing 'gre zhing 'dug pa gzigs/ / na tu ma dga' ba yis pems 'thugarga so bsam yas yul 'dir mi 'dug 'gro sems skyes/ /yig chas dang ni/dope cha khur nas phyin/ /lung pa'i phu la zhugs phyin dgod shor bas/ la kha de la dgod dkar ma khar logam/ /la khar zhal ni phyir shezigs dmod btsugs pa/ /ngas kyang dge la dad skyes chos bshad na'ange / /bod rnam /nyon mongs sgob pa ma 'byongs pas /mang zhig sems can la gnas pa 'dra/ /bstan pa spel bas bstan pa nub ste song / /rgyal po'i btsun mo dug sde me 'bar ma/ /mi ro tsa na rgod po dkar po yin/ /btsun por las kyi rnam smin tshe bdir gog /nga la mtshang me sa med pas bston pa dar/ / po ro tsa/na/tshad mar 'dzin par shog /le'u brgyad pa'o// //be+e ro tsa na daja mgar ba 'phrad pa/de/nas la brgal lung la babs nas byon/ /mam kha zhig na ba cig shi nas 'duge khang pa zhig na mgar ba bzo byed snang 1 /shin tu bkres nas mgar ba'i sgor phyin te/ /rdo la rin chen mkhyen pa'i mgar ba gas/ bzo rig kun mkhyen yo mnyes dpon bzang lags/ /nang dro ma myong gdug kyi phyed la thug gsus ltogs nga la nang gi tho zhig drongs/ /mgar bas thos nas/chung ma la smra sa pa/ /sgo phub 'di na shin tu ngag 'jam zhig /bro slong ba ni su yin stos la shog /chung mas bltas nas mgar ba la smras pa/ /gsung ngag 2 phyi

'ja bas kyang zhag ras legs/ /ban+de spyi blum chos khur ba zhig gda'/ sade skad glengs pas bzo 'phro bcad nas bltas/ /zhe sa lugs bzhin phul nas nang spyon drangs/ /mgar mo skra 'khru rgyan cha rang 'thag bzhag /gsol zas drangs nas slob dpon blo btab bo/ /mdo bsngo smon lam btab nas 'di skad —gcungs/ /lam kha ya na ba zhig shi nas 'dug 1yon bdag khyed kyi min nam gagungs nas gsheges/ /lung pa de la ba lam zhes su btags/ /slob dpon chagashegs rting mgar ba ba bshar song// /mgar mo'i rgyan chas stor nas ma rnyed do/ /mgar mo na re gzhan ni su yang med/ /da nang brdo de yis brkus pa ༷yin/ /do nub mi sleb la 'ur rgyug cig zer/ /bzo byed mgar ba shin tu snying na nas/ /mda' gzhu khyer nas phyi la rgyugs song ste/ /lung pa'i skada' la 1rjes zin khril gyis glebs/ /mgar bas slob dpon nyid la 'de skad smras/ /da ༷nang phugs su bcug nas zhim dgu byin/ /de yis lan du chung ma'i lus rgyan brkus/ khre' med po khyod lings kyis gastong ngo zer/ /mda' stong bcug nas mer gyis bkang nas byung / /slob dpon gshegs pa'i long ni med pas te/ /slob dpon zings kyis btang nas 'dzings pe yis/ /mdang ni dpe cha —bzed pa'i steng du phog /slob dpon ma rmas mda' stong 'jug long med/ /༷mgar ba'i lag pa g.yas g.yon bzung nas su/ /de nas slob dpon bden chig ༷mgar bar gsungs/ /nga ni rgyal po khri srong sde'u bcan gyi/ /thugs ches ༷mchod gnas dam pa byed tsa na/ /btsun mo tshe sprosang/ba lu ba dmar rgyan la1 /sdom gsum rtsa ba dam tshig ma nyams par1 /nga yis mi tshangs par gang ma spyad la/ /nga yis khyod kyi khyim du phyin pa'i dus/ /nang dro spur ba rnams ni zos pa las/ khyod kyi chung ma'i lus kyi rgyan cha la/ /sdom gsum rtsa ba dem tshig na nyams shing / /ngas ni ma byin par yang ma blangs so/ /sems can khyod kyi 243

'dod pa bskang ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi srog la tshad pa'i mda' dang gzhu/ gzhu nyid gser mda' nyid g.yu ru gyur/ /de shad gsungs nas rtse mo gtug byas pa sa1 /mgar ba'i mda' gzhu gser g.yur lings kyis song / /mgar ba skyengs nas bzhin log tug ger snang / khyod kyi chung ma'i lus rgyan byis pas khyer/ /thog kha'i nyal nyil gseb nas chung mas rnyed/ /nga ni ma byin mi len brde yin/ khyod kyi chung ma'i rgyan cha rku srid dam/ /de skad gsungs nas slob dpon phar la gshegs/ /yul de la ni ba glang brlag mdar btags/ /de nas mgar ba yang ni phyir log go/ le'u dgu pa'o// //rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis be+e ro tsa na 'tsho' du gshegs pa/de dus rgyal po khri sgong sde'u btsan ni/ /shin tu thugs mug dbu gtums gzims pa las/ /nyi ma tsug snying phyung bzhin ma dga' nas/ /sku bzhengs be+e ro tsa na spyan 'dren du/ /brag dmar g.yanya ma lung du byon pa'i tshe//gnas na ma bzhugs shul ni ha re bzhud/ /gcan gzan ri dwagam 'dab chags mi rnams kun/ /byang gi phyogs su kha bltas ngu bar byed/ /chos kyi rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan ya nga / /sha rus bye ba tsam du ma dga'o1 ༷ /rgyal pos btsun mo'i rtsar 'ongs spyod btab pa/ /slob dpon dgongs na ci gsung nyan pas tshog /bdag gis rgya la slob dpon rnyed 'khugs na/ khyod nyid bzhed na gtan du 'bul lo gsungs/ /shugs ldan la bzhon slob dpon 'tshol du gshegs/ /dgod dkar la rtsar mi nag mgar ba cig /dgod cing 'dzum zhing byung ba cig dang 'phrad/ /rgyal pos mi khyod re dga' zhig 'dug pa/ /cig rnyed pa zhig 250

yin nam ci la dga'/ /'di na phar la mi zhig song mthong nga / de skad ces ni rgyal pos gsungs pa dang / /mi nag mgar ba des ni 'di skad smras/ /mi khyod rta rngul chu bzhin byung byung nas/ /gar rgyug sus bdas 'di ru ci byed pa/ /'di phar mi zhig shin tu rings par song / /nga dga' ba ni mda' gzhu 'di byen pas/ /de la dga' zhing dgod pa yin no zer/ /rgyal pos mgyogs par gcum nas bdas pa yis/ /skye chu'i rtsa ru lhan du phyin tsa na/ /slob dpon chu la gom gsum pa zhig byas/ /pha ri phyogs la yud tsam thal nas song / /nyi ma rtser gyis rgas nas ma zin te/ /rgyal pos khus btab g.yabs pa'i pha gi nas/ /slob dpon spyon gyis gzigs kyang chu ches pas/ /brgal du ma thar gru ko mnyan pa med/ /mun rub grong khyer btsal ba'i long med do/ /rta las babs nas lha phyag btsal nas zhus/ /nga yi bla mchod be+e ro tsa na lags/ /'khor ba'i sems can mtho ris drang ba dang / /sangs (1sa chos kyi bstan pa spel ba dang / /bdag gi mchod gnas dam par rgyan drangs na/ /ngan bu bor nar gang du gshegs pa lags/ /btsun mo bzhed na gtan gyi groṭa su 'bu / /bdagam sa tshod gnas dam par gshegs par zhu/ /de skad ces pa rgyal pos gsol pa mis/ /sgob dpon skyi chu'i byang nas bka' bsdul pa/ /dad pa can gyi rgyal bo rje gcig lags/ /bud med bya ba btsan dug ha la yin/ / mas can gang gis zos kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bud med)bya ba las kyi srin mo yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor yang la 'ur 'chi/ /bud med bya ba dmyal pa'i 'dam dzab stede/ /sems can gang gis 'khor ba'i 'dam la 'dzin/ /bud med bya ba 'khor ba'i btson ra yin/ /gang gis 'bags kyang thar pa 'thob mi srid/ /bud med bya ba bdud kyi mya ngan yin/ /gang gis 'brel kyang sdug bsngal chad med rmyang / bdag gi sems la 'dod chags sa 351

debon med/ /sems la med pas lus la ci la skye/ /bo skol 'apyogs su btsun mos sto lob btab/ /ma nyes su ni nam zhig mtha' dag 'ong / /rlang log rgul po'i yul du nga mi mchi/ /mchod gnas gzhan nas 'tshol la lugs pazhen spyod/ /ces gsungs slob dpon gar song cha med gshegs/ /rgyal po mi chad to ngal ga mug tsha/ /mun sros khrul de tsha ba gru ru grags/ / /rgyal po der lus mgar ba slar log ste/ /nyi ma dmar thag chod nas khyim du glebs/ /chung ma mdun du byung nas 'di skad zer/ khyod kyi ban+de de nyid ma bsad dam/ /nga yi lus rgyan bu tshas thog khar khyer/ /nyal nyil gseb nas rnyed nas yod do zer/ /mgar pa khros nas chung mar lan btab pa/ /ci gu thams cad brtags nas mi zer bar/ /ban+des brkus so rgyug cig zer zer nas/ /lung pa'i —mda' ru brdo khril gyis zin/ /mdang gzhu bkang nas lings btang bzhag snyam sapas/ /chos dper phog nas kho bo gsod par zin/ /nga rang gsod pa'i 'a/sa shig da byung bsam/ /shin tu 'jigs shing rab tu bred pa la/ /gsod pa'i tshul du de nyid mi 'dug par/ /tshig bshad 'di skad bgrangs nas gsungs pa than/ /bdag ni rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gye/ /thugs 'ches mchod gnas /dam pa byed co na/ /btsun mo tshe spong bza' ba dmar rgyan la/ /sdom gsum rtsa ba dam chig ma nyams shing / /ngas ni ma byin par yang ma blangs so/ /sems can khyod kyi 'dod pa bskang ba'i phyir/ /bdag gi srog la tshad pa'i lamada' dang gzhu/ /gzhu nyid gser la mda' ni g.yur gyur gsungs/ /nga yi ༷mda' gzhu gsechedagayur lings kyis song / /shin tu ngo tsha mig kyang lta mi saphod/ /de rteng bdag la 'di skad gsung du byung / khyod kyi chung ma'i lus brgyan byis pas khyer/ /thog kha'i nyal nyil gseb nas chung mas rnyed/ /nga ni ma /byen mi len ban+de yin/ /mgar mo'i rgyan cha rku ba'i lugs yod dam/ /de skad —252

gsungs nas yar la bzhud de song / /des ni tshur 'ongs mda' gzhu bstan pa yis/ /mgar mo dga'/ngu shin tu sems gcod do/ /le'u bcu pa'o// //be+e ro tsa nas klu bsgrubs nas btsun mo la tsi tsi dzā 'a'i nad btang ba/de nas nang par nam langs gung sangs nas/ /rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan tsha ba grur/ /chab kyi pha kar slob dpon bzhugs sam bltas/ /ma bzhugs chab kye kha 'grim gru phab ste/ /mi rta'i dro blangs chab bsgral mnyan pa bslog 1chab kyi pha kar byon nas dris mthong med/ /rjes bcad pas kyang rjes ma chod par brgyal/ /phyir 'ongs mgar ba'i sgor babs de la dris/ kha sang khyod phrad ban+de gar 'gro zer/ khyod la gser g.yu'i mda' gzhu byin zer ba/ khyod kyis bsde de la ci byas pa/ /mgar bas rgyal po nyid la gsol pa ni/ /ban+de 'dir 'gro bya ba ye mi gsung /gar 'gro cha med bdag gis ma dris so/ /parkus btsugs mda' brgyab shin tu ngo tsha nas/ /rgyal po la gsangs gser gzhu g.yu mda' ni/ /gsol zas bda' dgu skyel ma zhabs tog byas/ /de yi drin lan gser gzhu g.yu mda' byin/ /de ni mi min mchog tu gyur par gda'/ /rigs ni gar gtogs ming ni ri skad bya/ /nyid 'ded pa ni ci khrur 'ded pa lags/ /rgyal pos btsun mo'i tha snyad gsang nas su/ /mi las mchoge tu gyur pa'i skyes bu de/ 1rigs ni dbus kyi rnam par snang mdzad lags/ /ming ni be+e ro tsa na zer ba yin/ /bdag phyo bsnyegs ba mchod gnas spyan 'dren yin/ /'byon du ma bzhed rgya nag gshegs/yin nam/ 1da lta yi mug khyim du 'ongs pa yin/ /de nas dgod dkar lar byon pasam 2 ོ3

—ba sa phebs /btsun mo/'khor pas rgyal por dris kyin smras/ 1rgyal pos bdag gis rjesanabo nar bcug bsnyegs/ /nyi ma gos khar skye chu'i 'gram du skebs/ /skyes bu de nyid rdzu 'phrul ldan cig gda'/ khu yis btab cing g.yob kyin bos tsa na/ /spyan zur tsam gzigs bdag gis lha phyag btsal/ /'byon par zhus pas gshegs su ma bzhed par/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams bdag la gsungs/ /chos dad can gyi rgyal po khri sgong lags/ /bud med bya ba btsan dug ha la yin/ /sems can gang gis zos kyang 'chi ba yin/ /bud med bya ba las kyi srin tho yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor yang la 'ur 'chi/ /bud med bya ba dmyal ba'i 'dam ba yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor ba 'dam la 'dzin/ /bud med bya ba 'khor ba'i btson ra yin/ /gang gis 'bags kyang thar ba thob mi srid/ /bud med bya ba bdud kyi mya ngan yin/ /gang gis 'brel kyang sdug bsngal tshad med myong / 1bdag gi sems la 'dod chags sa bon med/ /sems la med par lus la ci la skye/ /'o sgol 'grogs spu btsun mos lto long btab/ /ma nyes su ni nam zhig mtha' dag 'ong / /slar log rgyal po'i yul du nga mi mchi/ /mchod gnas gzhan nas 'tshol la lugs/bzhin spyod/ /ces gsungs slob dpon gar song cha med gshegs/ /de skad ces pa rgyal pos bka' bstsal pa/ /btsun mo 'khor pa blon po de rnams kyang / /mi dge'i sems ni shin tu kun skyes so/ /de dus de tshe be+e ro tsa na yis/ /yer pa gtsug ri spungs pa'i nags la gake+ogs/ /thugs dam mdzad pas glu btsan lha mo 'dus/ /spre'us shing thog smon sna 'thus nas 'dren/ /lha mo klu mo btsan rnams sgor mchod 'bul/ /be+e+ob dpon mnyam gzhag mngon par shes pas gzigs/ /bsam yas mi rnams nyid la shin tu 'phya/ /sdig las byed cing sbyin pa gtong 'phro bcad/ /tshul khrims 'chal ཿ54

cing sdom pa nod pa shor/ /slob dpon de tsug byed na chos rdzun min/ /slob bu sdig pe sna tshorges sgod cing snang / /sgob dpon shin tu /mi dga'i so sa skyes nas/ /'di ni ji sta bu mi bzlog na dgongs/ /klu chen dga' bo bsgruthas sa dmar rgyan gyi/ /mus la nad du tsi tsi dzā la gtong / /nad des btsun mo shin tu gdurngas tsa na/ /rdzu 'phrul mo ma rnen po cig gtong la/ /lha rma yer mngabatsan rgod babs nas 'jug /de la btsun mos mo 'debs 'ong bar gzigs/ /sgob dbo ne dgongaso paso thu na ga/snying nas drangs/ /'gugs bye da/pyag rgya khu tshur nyid kyis bcings/ /de na klu nag gnas pa'i grong khyer 'gul/ de yi nang nas glu nag 'dam 'a dzin zhes1 /sdom nag rkang lag sum brgya rtag cu pa/ /dpral bar mig gcig kha chu dug tu 'dzage /dbang/du babyes nas rngob dpon spyan skor byung / khyod kyis bdag ni gnas tsu 'dug mi stede/ /snying na drangs shing 'gugs pa khyod ci nyes/ /ci byed zer nas shin/tu ske sdag blta /sgob dbon klu nag po la bka' bstsal me/ khyode ni ri bdi'i rtsa rte na gnas rte/ /nga yang ri 'de'i sked pa la gnas pas/ /bdag gnyis banas kyis bsdu pa'i spun zla yin/ /nga la dgra byung ra mda' khyod bzlogagayin/ khyod las mthu rtsam che ba gang yang med/ /dam long dam long nag po sdu yi bu/ /de skad gsungs nas snying po stong rtsa bzlos/ /sha sna sna tshogs lator blud klu 'grub nas/ /klu yang shin tu dga' ste 'di skad gsungs/ /banas kyis bsdus pa'i tshang zla skyes bu khyod/ /bstan ba bshig pa'i dwagra bo gang na yod/ /nga yis rtsi rtsi dzā sa'i nadwa bzung gtang / /slob dpon shin tu dges nas klu la gsungs/ /mazu dang stobs gyu ldan pa'i nag po klu/ /nga yi bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bo ni/ /bsam yas (14 ༷po khri zong lde'u btsan gyi/ /btsun mo tshe sgong bza' ba dmar rgyan yen/ /nga yi bka' ma byung bar spu 255

sakhyod kyis/ /tsi tso dz+wa las zungs ga sdoms shig gsungs1 /༷ ma/byed phyag rgya bshig nas spu btang pas/ /bsam yas mal gong sgang sngon rtse dgur snyin/ /btsun mo dmar rgyan nyal ba'i sngas su mchongs/ /byin mnan kha yi nang na mar la 'dzul/ 1snying gi dkar nag mtshams su zhugs nas bzung / /man lag mang pos rtsa ni thams cad brgyangs/ /btsun mo klu yis dbang du bsdus te brdoms/ /gnyid sad lus za snying mi dga' la sbrid/ /mo ma lha skan dgung bsher rgya ba la/ /mo btapa mthu btab bus kyang ma phan no/ /lo gcig lo gnyis/rgyal 'bangs kun gyis gleng / /nad mdze yin par kun gyis ngo shes so 1rgyal po sras lcam mchi ma la sngas byas/ /de tshe de dus be+e ro tsa na yis/ /yer pa'i brag phug dpal/ldan lha mo bsgrubs/ /'phrul gyi mo ma kun shes thengs po la/ /lha mo babs byas bsam yas yul du btang / /bsam yas phu mda' ༷med pas mo btab pas/ /snang srid thams cad 'char bas rno bar grags/ /—rgyal pos bka' bstsal mo ma 'khor pas bkug mal gong sgang sngon rtse dgur mo ma byon/ /rgyal po yab yum sras lcam gnyis dang bzhi/ /'khor pa mas sacad sgor byung mo btab ba/ /bdag gi btsun mo nad ngan 'di ltas zin/ skyon dang le lan ci lta bu ni lags/ /lha 'dre ji lta bus ni gnod pa lags/ /rim gro ji lta bus ni phan pa lags/ /bdag gi btsun mo 'di ni sos pa sa/na/ /nyid la yul zhing sne grangs bcad sbyin no/ /le'u bcu gcig pa'o// / mo ma'i lung 'bras ltar btsun mos sto long skur btab drang zagang/smra khas zlangs pa/de nas mo mas mo bcas sna dgu bshams nas mo btab pa'i tha ma la/༷253

rgyal po yab yum la mo shar ba spros pa/ bci+on mos ci bsams thams cad log par song / /byas pa'i las la 'bras bu med pa'i mo/ /mi kha gleng zhing tsi tsi dz+wa las zin/ /rnam thar ngo lkog med par kun gyes khur/ /bla ma bzang po gdams ngag phyug pa yod/ /ngo mtshar gcig las gcig che dpon slob gnyis//gcig la gcig skyon mi 'gel mthong na dga'/ /gcig sems gcig la chags te 'bral mi phod/ /bla ma'i tshab tu slob ma btang ba bskyil/ /btsun mo snying med byol song blo byas te/ /'dod pas mi 'dod pa yi gnas su lhung / /sto long skur pa chen po btab pas lan/ /de yi chadwa pas nad 'di byung ba yin/ /'di la gzhan gyis ci byas mi phan te/ /slob dpon gdan drangs mthol bshags phyos na phan/ /rgyal po sems la shin tu 'phrig par shar/ 1btsun mo shin tu snying nas khas ma blangs/ /rgyal pos 'khor ba rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ /rgyal srapha mu ga btsan po/khrom pa rgyan/ /'khor pa mang bo byang gi phyogs su btang / /slob dpon 'tshol las gden drongs shog cig gsungs/ /rgyal pos rta bzang 'khor lo bzhi pa chibs/ /rol mo 'khor mang yar klungs shel brag nas/ /u rgyan pad+ma babyung gnas spyan 'dren gshegs/ /dge steng spang khar byon nas bsgor ba byas/ /lha phyag btsal nas mchod phul zhus pa ni/ /ye ma ho /mu rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas lags/ /bdag gi btsun mo tsi tsi dz+wa las zin/ /phan pa gzhan byas ci byas cis ma phan/ /mo ma kun shes thengs pos mo btab pas/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma spyan drangs nas/ /mchod 'bul bskang bshags byas na phan zhes zer/ /brag dmar dpal gyis bsam yas gshegs par zhu/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' bstsal pa/ /rigs chen lnga la bka' 'dus 'chad thun rdzogs/ /'khor pa'i lam lnga sgo gcod 'tshal bas gshegs/ /bdag ni ngabe+e+o0ba'i don byed gal che pas/ /rgyal po spyan 257

'dren 'grogs nas bsam yas mchi/ /lha 'dre'i slob ma 'bum phrag mang po rnams/ /bdag gis brag dmar bsam yas ma 'khor bar/ /mchod rgyun ma bcad bstan pa gzhung bzhin srungs/ /de skad lha 'dre rnams la bka' bstsal nas/ /rta bzang 'khor lo brgyad pa chibs nas su/ /rgyal po 'khor ba mang pos sku bskor gshegs/ /rol mo sna tshogs mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon 'khrigs//chu bo lo nyi ta brgal bsam yas phebs/ /u rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /lha 'dre mi gsum tshogs nas lha phyag 'tshal/ /'dab chags sder chags mig blum thams cad dang / /rmig pa kha brag 'greng bu thashas cad kyis/ /lha phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa sna tshogs phul/ /btsun mos kyang ni lha phyag mchod pa phul1 /de nas mal gong sgang sngon rtse dgur gshegs/ /ro mchog ldan pa'i gsol zas sna tshogs drangs/ /u rgyan pad+ma ye shes spyan mnga' bas/ /dus gsum thugs 'a sa ler mkhyen na yang / /'gro ba da lta'i don dang ma 'ongs don/ /bdag gi slob ma shi ro tsa na nyid/ /sgrub pa gang na byed kyin yod ces gsungs/ /skad ma thengs sam da dung ci byed pa/ /bdag gi spyan sngar khrid las shog ces gsungs/ /rgyal po shin tu ngo tsha gnong nas su/ /lo rgyus gtam ni smra ma phod pa ru/ /lcam dral 'tshol du btang ba la re nas/ /u rgyan ༷pad+ma nyid la 'di skad gsol/ /za ro tsa na bu tsha ming sring gnyis/ /shin tu don gal che ba gnyer du thal/ /zhag gsum tshun la spyan sngar 'khor te mchi/ /de nas nang par/gdugs kyi rtse la ni/ 1sras lcam 'khor ba mang po slebs nas byung / /rgyal pos sras la dris pa sras kyes gsol/ /bdag cag byang phyogs kun dang kun phyin te/ /btsal zhing pho mo smra shes kun la dris/ /mi gcig ༷gis kyang mthong ba ma byung bas1 /shin tu yi mug ga chad da lta spebs/ /yab /rje rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di skadwa gsungs/ /rgyal khams de tsam zhig nas ma 258

/rnyed pa/ grongs na pur yang bya yis zos par shes/ /de skad gsungs shing rkul po bshums par 'gyur/ /mchi ma nas tsam sran tsam rgyun du byung / /de nas bshums pa'i mchi ma phyag gis phyis/ /rgyal po lcam dral gnyis kyi sna mtshon te/ 1u rgyan chen po nyid la bskor ba byas/ 1lha phug btsal zhing mchod pa sna tshogs phul/ /rgyal sras chen po pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ khyed cag lcam dral gnyis kyis 'dir phebs na/ /bdag gi slob ma be+e ro ga ru song / /de la yab rje rgyal pos 'di skad gsol/ /bstan pa'i sgon me rgyal sras chen po lags/ /be+e ro tsa na gar song lo rgyus ni/ /bdag gi btsun mo ba dmar rgyan ma la/ /cha mchis pas na snyan zhur 'tshal gyi gsungs/ /yab sras gsum po langs nas bzhud do skad/ /btsun mo'i sar byon rgyal pos 'di skad gsungs/ /btsun mo nad ngan 'di yi 'ong lugs dang / kha sang mo ma de yis zer lugs dang / /slob dpon be+e ro tsa na'i zhal nas kyang / nga yi sems la 'dod chags sa bon med/ /sems la med par lus la ga la skye/ /yon mchod 'grogs su btsun mos lto long btab/ /bla mchod gzhan nas 'tsho'abagasungs bzhud pa yin/ /skyes bu de la 'dod chags med par nges/ /de ni sdom pas rdzun spangs bya ba yin/ /skyes bu chen po rdzun mi gsung bar nges/ /btsun mo khyed kyis slob dpon 'degs par dga'/ /skur pa chen po btab pa ma yin nam/ /da yang u rgyago chen po'i spyan snga ru/ /lha phyag btsal nas drang po'i tshig smras te/ rwa /mthol bshags byas na nad 'di sos par 'gyur/ /lcam sring gnyis kyang rgyal po'i gsung dang mthun/ /yum la shin tu nan tan bskyed nas smras/ /yum gyi legs par bsams shing dgongs pa las/ /nad ngan tsi tse dzā la 'di sos na/ /bdag ni ci ni 'dra na 'ang 'dra snyam sems/ /da ni drang por smra bar khas blangs so/ /le'u bcu gnyis pa'o// // 259

u rgyatsu:chen po'i sbyan sngar btsun pyo/sa drang por zhus zhing / yo rgyan gyis lung bstan mdzad nas be+e ro tsa na phyir thog tu gdan drangs pa/de nas rgyal po/khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /u rgyan chen po rgyal sar spyan drangs nas/ /mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa ni bshams nas su/ /nang blon bye blon 'khor pa thams cad dang / /sems can dam pa 'bangs rnamapa bsdus nas su/ /btsun mo khrid nas gu rur zhu 'bul bcug /btsun mos lha phyag btsal nas zhus pa ni/ /bstan pa'i sgron me u rgyan rin po/che/ /bdag ni sems can gang la'ang chags pa ni/ /mi skye ba zhig yin pa lags na yang / /blob dpon dge slong be+e ro tsa na de1 /ci bltas pas na ci ru mdzes pa'i sku/ /ci gsungs pa ni ci ru bden/pa'i gsung/ /de la bdag ni chags pa shin tu skyes// yid kyis smon lam kho na yar yang btab/ /bdag gis nang cig dus na skabs btsal nas/ /rgyal po rje nyid grong khyer sku 'chag btang / /bu tsha mi sring gnyis kyang rtsed mor btang / /'khor pa rnams kyang g.yengs kyi bskrad nas su/ /bdag rang gcig pus slob dpon bsu byas nas/ rgyal sa yang thog spyan drangs bda' dgu drangs/ /las spyod 'di la sems can kun brten no/ /'di la ma brten slob dpon ga nas 'khrungs/ /bdag gis bgyes nas slob dpon sku la 'jus1 /slob dpon yer gyes dngangs nas 'dar 'dang gyur/ /dge slong be+e ro tsa nas 'di skad gsungs/ /'khor pas tshor na bstan pa nub ste 'gro/ /nga yis phyi sgo dacad la 'ong gi gsungs/ /bden snyam sku la 'jus pa btang bas gshegs/ /bsdad pas 'gor nas blta ru phyin tsa na1 /bzhud nas ma4260

debazhed bu tshal phebs nas thal/ /de la bdag ni shin tu snying na nas/ /rdzun gyi sdeb sbyor lenyu bsdebs nas su/ /skur pa btab pas slob dpon 'khor ma ༷ btub/ /nyi ma byang du 'khyams te song ba lags/ /rgyal pos bdas nas slar la spyan bungs pas/ /'ebyon du ma bzhed bdag gi ngan mtshang sgogs/ /bsnyan masha'i sgon me sprul sku chen po lags/ /nongs pa thams cad kho mo dngos kyig bgyes/ /tsi tsi dz+wa la'i nad kyis jin pa yang / /'di yi chad pa yin nam ༷sems 'a/ 'phrig /bstan pa'i sgron me u rgyan rin po che/ /slob dpon stor ba rgyal khams thu tshas btsal/ /btsal bas ma rnyed gang du thal ba lags/ /—bdag gi nad 'di ji ltar zegyis nas sos/ /de skad ces pa btsun mos zhus pa sadang / /lho long btab pa mthol bshags byed pa la/ /u rgyan pad+ma shin tu thugs dgyes so/ /rgyal po lcam sring rab tu thugs dgyes so/ /de ru tshogs la'i mi rnams thams cad kyang / slob dpon skyes bu de la de mi srid/ /de tsam 'tshengs zer kun gyis kha skyo byed/ /de nas u rgyan pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ /༷btsun mo khyod ni mir khyer pa la yang / /nyon mongs pa ni shas che ba zhig 'dug khyod ni 'dod chags chu ltar 'khol ba yis/ /sdom gsum srung ba'i /slob dpon 'ju phod yin/ khyod ni zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba yis/ /skur pa bde lta bu ni 'debs nus yin/ khyod ni ga mug mun ltar 'thibs pa yis/ /sasmyo nas las 'bras ngo ma shes pa yin/ /slob dpon spyan drangs bskong mthol ma bshags na/ /mi tsi dzā la'i nad kyang sos mi 'gyur/ /phyi ma ngan pong gsum 'khor mnar med skye/ /rdo rje'i dmyal ba dmyal pa shom pa la/ /thugs dam rtsa bar/bskong bshags spyan sngar bgyi/ /be+e ro tsa na gar song gar yod ni/ /bdag gis mnyam gzhag lha bsgom byas nas su/ /mngon par shes pas gar 'dug blta bar rgya/ /de skad bka' bstsal gu ru thugs dam bzhugs/ /261

mngon shes gziges nas gu rus bka' bstsal pa/ /slob dpon dge slong be+e ro co na de/ /btsun mos ma nyis lto long chen pos 'gams/ /shin tu yi mug rab tu ga chad nas/ /bsam yas dag gi nub byang mtshams shed na/ /ra sa rgyang bran dor sde dwags srib kyi/ /yer pa gtsug rum 'bar pa'i sked pa na/ /nags tshal mang po 'thibs pa'i dgon pa ru/ /lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i brag phug na/ /ri rtse 'dus pa'i lha khang phyogs bzhi na/ /'greng gi mi phrad thugs chadam bzhugs 'dug go /lha dang glu dang btsan gyes stong grogs byed/ /lha mo klu mos khrus byed mchod pa 'bul/ /spre'u byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /sman dang shing tog barmas cad de la 'dren/ /shin tu sgo gsod skyid par /snang ngo lags1 /gser g.yu mu tig len phran btsan po khyod/ /chibs pa rgeg po bzhon la khug las shog /de skad u rgyan chen pos gsungs pa las/ /slob dpon yodanapas shin tu 'tshengs shing dgod/ /de nas tshu tig btsan po 'gus su byon/ /yer pa gtsug rum 'bar ba'i nags tshal phyin/ /slob dpon be+e ro tsa na nyid dang mjal/ /chibs pa nag pos slob dpon ngo shes nas/ /bskore zhing spyos bsngag mchi ma sran tsam byung / /rgyal sras mu tig btsan pos gsol pa ni/ /slob dpon nyid la skur pa 'debes pa'i mi/ /a ma btsun mo mdze nad dam pos zin/ /nyid la skur pa btab pas lan par ni/ /mo ma kun shes thengs pos ngos1kyang bzung / /mo bdag 'phrigs nas gu ru'i spyan sngar mchis/ /drang por tshig smus mthol bshags byas pas ni/ /gu ru rin po che yi zhal nas su/ /da yang thugs dam rtsa bar bskong mthol dgos/ /slob dpon dge slong be+e ro tsa na ni/ /yer pa gtsug rum 'bar pa'i dgon par 'dug spyan drongs shog cig gsungs nas bdag gis 'ongs/ /da lta gshegs par zhu ba 'bul ba lags/ /de skad gsol bas slob dpon shin tu dgyes 262

dga' ba'i mi rta gnyis dang phrad do dga'/ /snyan pa'i gtam yang mang du thos so dga'/ /btsun mo de la de phan de ran 'jebs/ /gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs yod na/ /ngan bu cis te mi 'gro gsungs nas gshegs/ /yul de'i lha phran brgya dang klu phran brgya/ /lha mo brgya dang klu sko brgya rnams dang / / spre'u byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang / /slob dpon nyid la skyeshe ma byas nas su/ /slob dpon rta nag gzhon nas bsam yas phebs/ /skad snyan bya dang gcan gzan ris bkra dang / /ri dwags spu sdug glang po khyu mchog dang / /cang sheshe rta dang khyi rig rnams kyis ni/ /slob dpon mdun nas bsus te bskor ba byed/ /lha gyeg/btsag nas mchod pa sna tshogs phul/ /rgyal po yab sras 'khor dang shob bu she nga / /yul khamarke mi rnams mdun bsus bskor ba byas/ /de nas be+e ro go na 'khod bcas kyis/ /u rgyan 'in po padrur bskor ba byas/ /lha phyag btsal zhing marnal lan gsum phul/ /yer pa gtsug rum 'bar ba'i/nags tshal gyi/ /lha klu sprezhu rnams ni slar log thob / /de la mnga' bdag rgyal po ngo mtshad skyes/ /chigs su bcad pa'i snyan ngag 'di skud gsungs/ /da chig ma nyams mi mchog skyes bu ni/ /mi med yul du song yang lha klus mchod/ /spre'u dad skyes smon dang shing tog 'bul/ /dam med skyon can dbyings nas btsubamo ni/ 1grong khyer dbus gnas 'dug kyang nad mdze bzung / /dam las nyamasgo pa btsun mo bgyid bgyid nas/ /skyes bu dam nga mjale long ga la yod1 /de gad ces gsungs zhabs la spyi bos gtugs/ /gus pas lha phyag lan bdun btsal nas su/ /de nas gye rgyan pad+ma'i 'og tu bzhugs/ /lekyi bcu gsum pa'o// //ཿ6mi

btsun thos bshags pa phul bas be+e ro tsa na zugs degyeca/ te btsun mo nad gas grol bar mdzad pa/ bod 'bangs kun kyang slob dpon stor rnyed pas/ /shin tu dga' nas sprin bzhin 'dus nas 'dug /de dus rgyal po khri sgong sde'u btsan gyes/ 1btsun mo slob dpon nathol bshags 'bul du bcug /btsun mo dmar rgyan lus kyi bkod pa nyams/ /tse ber ras ka cig ni sge rags bcings/ /re ba'i tshal bu zhig la g.yang lugs byas/ /skra byi phyi rnams shu bas khengs pa byas/ //kha yon mig sle rkang lag 'theng ba byas/ /me tog sna tshogs pa yis bkang ba )/ /bse yi gzhong pa gang ni lag tu thogs/ /lcam dral gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon gnyis nas brten/ /bskor ba byas te slob dpon me tog gtor/ /mig ༷ni lta ma phod de zhabs spris gtugs/ /ngo gdong sa la sbyar nas 'di skad ༷ sgros/ /sngon dus las ngan bgyis pas lus ngan thob/ /bsam pa ngan pas nyid la chags pa skyes/ /sgod me ngan pas slob dpon sku la lejus/ /shin tu gnong tsho gyod slob dpon sku la mthol/ /nad ngan mdze yis gzugs phung khengs pa yang / /slob dpon lha yi sku la 'jus pas nongs/ /shin hūṃ gnong ngo slob dpon nyid la bshags/ /bsam pa ngan pas skyengs la snying na nam/ /slob dpon smad cing bstan pa stub pa yi/ /rdzun brgyud sbyar nas sto long chen po patab/ /de yi skyon kyis gzugs phung mje yis 'gengs/ /shin tu gnong ngo sgob dpon lha la mthol/ /yus so khrims ldan rdo rje slob dgon lha/ /zhes smras thal mo gnyis po spyi por sbyar/ /ngo gdong sa la spub nas ngus pa yis/ /lha sras ming sring gnyis kyang zla la ngus/ /rgyal po khri srong/ཿsdethu btsan nyid kyang 264

bshums/ /de ru 'tshogs pa'i mi rnams kun kyang ngus/ /u rgyan pasmo nyid kyang spyan chab byung / /slob dpon dge slong be+e ro tsa na yang / /btsun mo dmar rgyan ma la snying rje skyes/ /de nas zang zing mang po mtshams bcad nas/ gser dngul gzhong par slon sna sna tshogs dang / /'bru sna sna tshogs ba dmar bo mar sbyar/ /dkar gaspum mngar gasrum btsun mo'i sngas su bzhag /klu sgrub snying po rgyun mi chad par bzlas1 /'gugs byed lag pa'i phyag rgyas bkug nas drangs/ /klu 'gul bas ni btsun so/skad ngan cor/ /de la be+e ro tsa nas 'di skad gsungs/ /las ngan lus ngan nad ngan btsun mo 'di/ /skad ngan ma 'byin yar la mgo theg dang / /lta phyag nus tshad bdag la 'tshol zhig gsungs/ /btsun mo glo snying ma bzod 'don tsa na/ /'bad nas yar langs slob dpon lta ma phod/ /sna gong mig pab mgo bkug lha phyag btsal/ /btsun mo hrangs kyis 'gyel te brgyal nas snang / /dge slong bo jo tsa nas 'di skad gsungs/ /'dzin pa lag mang nag po glu yi bu/ /nga ni khyod kyi spun zla dge slong yin/ /de na ci byed btsun mo bzung ba thong / /nga dang phrad du sgo ru mi 'ong ngam/ /de skad gsungs nas 'gugs byed phyag rgyas/drangs/ /btsun mo'i kha nas khrag ni mang po skyugs/ /de nas chu ser mang po skrugs te byung / /de nas rnag ni mang po skyugs te byung / /de nas sdom nag lham tsam skyugs te byung / /rgyal po yab sras shin tu 'jigs skrag nas/ /'bros par gzas par slob dpon 'di skad gsungs/ 1yab sras ma 'bros ma 'jigs sman 'dis mtshod/ /gaster gyi gzhong pa'i sman dpul gzar bus gtor/ /ldom nag de yi lus po phyir phyungs kyang / /yan lag nyi ma'i zer tsam nang lus gda'/ /rgyal pos rtsi sman gtor ba'i phan yon gyes/ /sdom de je cher khyi gu tsam du song / /btsun mo/brgyal ba sangs nas ta na zer/ /sdom nag de nyid gal 26mi

dgul byed tsa na/ /skad ngan 'phro rnams tser tser ha na zer/ /slob dpon phyag gi sdom byed phyag rgyas bcings/ /sdom de 'gul ma nus par lhan ner bsngad//de nas u rgyan pad+ma bzhengs nas su/ /btsun mo de la ljags kyi mchil ma btab/ /las kyis mnar ba'i sems can sdig can 'di/ /klu /ba/yan lag mang po phyir 'byin shog /klu la lngags kyi mchil ma thengs gsum btab/ /'dzin shes gtong mi shes kyi gdug pa glu/ /zha grum med par yan lag lus 'dus shog da ni phyin chad sems kyang zhi bar bgyi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gu ru'i mchil ma bdud rtsi dang 'dra bas/ /btsun mo'i lus rtsa thams cad nang nas ni/ /klu yi yan lag brkyang rnams rang byung ngo / /de nas btsun mo lus stobs shed kyang med/ /klu yang tshon gyi dru bu brtul bzhin song / glu de gu ru'i bka' thos mchil phog pas/ /shin tu sems zhi dga' ba'i yid dang ldan/ /gru yis gu ru nyid la 'di skad gsol/ /bdag ni phyin chad sems can gnod mi bgyid/ /phan par bgyid do bstan pa bsrung bar bya/ /gu rus klu la dga' bo ming bye btags/ /de nas sdom byed phyag rgya bkrol ba yis/ /glu de lul du sbran de mchongs nas song / /de tshe de dus btsun mo khyim du bteg /gu ru 'khor pa khams gsum zangs khang gzhags/ /le'u bcu bzhi pa'o/ / //btsun mo'i sgrib pa 'byongs sam ma 'byongs brtag pa mdzad pa/de nas nang par snga dro gdugs rtser la/ /rat+na rgyas pa khengs pa'i sems can 'dus/ /lha phyag bskor ba byed cing mchod pa 'bul/ /sdom pa shor dang tshul khrims 'chal pa bskyar/ /mu rgyan gu ru bad+ma'i zhal nas su/ /266

ca nga' bdag rgyal po khyod kyi btsun mo 'di/ /sprib pa 'byongs sam ma 'byongs lta dgos gsungs/ /nad ni rung ngam mi rung lta dgos gasnyangs/ khams gsum na ga'i sa gzhi/thams cad la/ /'o ma sman sna'i chag chag btab nas su/ /'gro 'dul chen po'i dkyil 'khor zhal bye nas/ /u rgyan pad+ma de yi steng khar byon//zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon me tog pad+ma ni/ /lam lam re re brgya dang rtsa brgyad song / /de rjes phar la be+e ro tsa na yis/ /phyag btsal phyin pas pad+ma/bzhi bcu gnyis/ /de rjes phar la brtsegs se g.yu sgra gnyis/ /phyag btsal phyin pas pad+ma nyi shu lnga/ /de rjes phar la rgyal pos phyag btsal byung / /pad+ma /brgyad pa re re lam lam song 1 /de rjes phar la btsun mos phyag btsal byung // me tog bye/ma ma skyes snga ma chig /de rjes phar la lcam sring phyag btsal byung / me tog lnga pa re re lam lam song / /de la u rgyan pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ ཿbtsun mo 'di las sgrib pa che ba ni/ /mir gyur pa la med pa cig yin snang / ming yang khams gsum me tog sgol du btags/ /btsun mo 'di'i ring chos kyi ༷bstan pa nub/ /bon gyi bstan pa dar tsam cis kyang 'ong / /'gyod pa/rga nas ma skyes khyod ci nyes /de la btsun mos rab tu bsams pa ni/ /nga yi ding la tshos kyi bstan pa rdub/ /nad ngan pa 'di lta bu yang byung na/ /bu tsha sko sring rjes la me tog skyes/ /bdag la me tog ma skyes ma chog par/ /rgang pa phog ༷pas me tog chig 'asgo 'di/ /ngas ni chos gsar pa bas bon rnyija dga'/ /gsar 'grogs byas pas rgya la sa shor gyis dogs/ /bdag nyid kho na sdig che las re ngan/ /de bzhin nongs pas 'grod pa drag po skyes/ /gzugs phung/'dzig pa tsam du ma dga' nas/ /gu ru'i zhabs la spyi pos gtugs te ngus/ //lha phyag lan gsum btsal nas zhus pa ni/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa 'i gu ru chen po lagag/ /nga ni sdig che'i las ngashe/mo zhedi yis/ /ji lhar bgyis na sdig 267

prib 'byang ste mchi/ /ji ltar bgyes na nad ngan sos te mchi/ /ji ltar bgyis na slob dpon mnyes te mchi/ /u rgyan gu ru chen pos bka' bstsal pa/ /spon kya da za ma mo lus thob pa la/ /'gyod pa drag skyes nges pa'i don bsgrubs pas//bud med lus bor lta mo'i skur sangs rgyas/ /sprul pas 'jig rten khams na —'gro don byed/ /bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang bzhugs/ /de rjes mthun par bya phyer 'akyod pa skyed/ /bdag gis nges pa'i don ni bsgrubs lags mod/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa sbyang ba'i byer/ /'das dang ma byon da lta bzhugs pa yi/ /bla ma 'gro 'dul lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i mtshan/ /bstan gnyis skor gsum brgya dang rtsa brgyad mtshan/ /brjod cing phyag btsal sgrib pa des dbyang 'ong / /slob dpon mnyes nas nad ngan de yang sos/ /me tog yang skyes chags nyams ma lus dag /de skad ces pa gu rus bka' bstsal pas/ /de nas btsun mos slar yang zhu ba phul/ /bdag ni dud 'gro gti mug dbang du mchis/ /brgya rtsa pargyad pas gcig kyang mi thon no/ /bston pa'i sgon me pad+ma 'byub gnas lags/ /nyid kyis mtshan brjod bdag gis mtshan phyag 'tshal/ 1bdagra gis mtshan ni shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /le'u bco lnga pa'o// // btsun mos sgrib sbyor phyag 'tsha' byas ba/de nas gu ru pad+mas bka' stsal pa/ /btsun mos smras pa de ni shin tu / bden/ /btsun mo'i lus po sman sna dri bzang khrus/ /mchod pa lnga shoms mar me brgya rtsa sgor/ /u rgyan pad+mas gu ru'i mtshan brjod nas/ /btsun mos mtshan re la ni phyag re btsal/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo bla ma la/ 1blo ngan g.yag 'grogs byas pa mthol lo bshags so/ /bla ma'i sku'i dam tshig 268

/nyams pa gims)cad skong gyur cig 'jigs pa'i sdug bsngal sgro2 ba'i dam cho sa 0 la/ snyin log rteb kyis/phyogs pa thams cad mtho' go bshags so/ /bla ma'i sa gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa skong gyur cig dkon cog gsum pas/bla malhag pa la/ dad pa ya zung du skyes pa mthol lo bshags so/ /bla ma'i thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa skong gyur cig bla ma med par sangs rgyas med pa la/ khrel meng ngo tsha gzhal du byas pa ca/thol lo bshags so/ /bla mji yon tan gyi dam chig nyams pa shā+ong gyur cig gdul dka'i sems can rgyud rtsub 'dul ba la/ dam nyams 'khon btsugs 'gro don sgrib pa mthol lo bshags so/ /bla ma'i 'phrin las kyi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad skong gyur cig gu ru a la la ho/ glong dbyings chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /rgya mtshor/sku 'khrungs u rgyan yul du byon/ /rgyal po'i sras mdzad rdzu 'phrul sna1tshogs ston/ /gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shāka thub dri ma med pa'i sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dkon cog sprin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ge sgra dang mdzes pa'i tog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya thub pa gzi brjid rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tsarnan dri mchog dpal la phyag cha'atshal lo/ /shākya snying rje'i rgyal po zer la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shākya thub pa snying rje'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dga' ba'i spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rte1g.yongs su dgongs pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi 'od yi phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thub pa zhi pa'i dbang po la phyag tshal lo/ /bde gshegs cho 'phrul sprin gyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal salo/ /sangs rgyas me long 'od snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzu po —dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i snying po la phyag 'bol lo/ /263

sangam rgyas sgom kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon par smra ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rin cen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ༷'od zer dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dka' thub rgyag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gtsug ོra snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nges par 'ongs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs gyes sgos ngad bsung ba la phyage 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas me hog dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas grags pa'i dpal ces bya ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sgra dpyangs mi zad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sman pa'i gyel po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer 'phro ba la phug 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gser gyi gzu ba la thug /'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas depal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal go/ /sangs rgyas snang ba brtsegs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dga' ba mchog gi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gzi brjed dpal zhes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas mang po 'du zhes bya ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad sbyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten dge ba 'bum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs /rgyas rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rma tog bkod pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'acal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad snang ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas tsarnan dri zhes bya ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas seng ge 'bum gzu gas la phyag 'etshal lo/ /gu ru ma la la ho/ bla ma sprul sku bdag la dgongs/ 1dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas/ /byin rlabs sgyu lus 'di la zhu/ /spyi gtsug gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /oṃ ā shā gu ru nirma ṇa ku 310

4/ /sarba shākya mu na yi sidhi snya tra shā/ /de ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la/ /btsun mos mtshan brngod lha phug re re btsal/ /lus kyang zhi nas nad kyi sdug bsngal sos/ /ngag kyang zhi nas rtsub tshig ye mi smra/ /sems kyang zhi nas kun la bu bzhin byams/ /yang ni u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis1 /da lta bzhugs pa'i lnga bcu rtsa bzhi brjod a la la ho/ /sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas rdo rje gsor/ /g.yon pas ske yi sdig pa dmar po bsnams/ /sku yi cha lugs khro bo'i rngams bzhi ldan/ /gu ru rnam par gnon sal phyag 'tshal lo/ 1'phel 'grib rdo rje yi ni tshig gaster phyung / /ma la la ho//de nas u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /ma 'ongs pa yi mtshan brjod rgyu bskang gsungs/ /'khor 'das gnyis su med pa'i ban bye ru/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i rgyu dngos bdud rtsis bkang / /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /rnam smin sgyu lus ༷ skye 'chi'i ban dha ru/ /tha mal sgo gsum sdom gsum bdud rtsis bkang / /rig 'dzin kujir yi thugs dam bskang / /mkha' 'gro las dbang chos mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku 0lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /sems nyid ma bcos ting 'dzin ban cha ru/ /snang ba rang grol kha yan bdud rtsis bkang / /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /paṇa chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang / /lo tsā brgya dang rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang / /nying 'khrul bag chags rmi lam ban rte ru/ /rdzun snang ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsis bkang / /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskab / /thim gsum snang mched 'chi kha'i ban sto ru/ /zhen chags khams 'khris med pa'i bdud rtsis bkang / /271

bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /lugs 'byung lugs ldog srid pa'i ban rte ru/ /'khor 'das 'od bcu rnam byang bdud rtsis bkang / /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /skyon bral chos nyid mngon sum ban rte ru/ /nam mkha' gsum sprugs dbyengs rig bdud rtsis bkang / /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /ma zad mi zad rgyan 'khor ban bha ru/ /snang ba rang so zin pa'i bdud rtsis bkang / /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /zhe sdang khong khro'i gtor gzhong du/ /sdig sgrib can gyi dpal bshos btsugs/ /byams pa lnga yi mtheb skyus sbran/ /'khor gsum yongs dag dza gad gsal/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad rak+tas brgyan/ /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam bskang 1 /skru lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang 1 /sdug bsngal tsit+ta'i gtor gzhong du/ /ser sna 'jur gegs dpal bshos btsugs/ /snying rje lnga yi mtheb skyus sbran/ /mtho ris bdun ldan dza gad gsal/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rak+tas brgyan/ /bla ma bstan gnyis sgor gsum thugs dam bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /spro dga' pags pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /'tshe ba zhum pa'i dpal bshos btsugs/ /dga' ba lnga yi mkhyeb skyus sbran/ /sbyor sgrol gnyis kyi dza gad gsal/ /dkar dmar chu tsur rak+tas brgyan/ /bla ma bstan gnyis sgor gsum thugs dam bskang / sku lnga bde ba chen po'i thugs dam bskong / /rang gar khog pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /mi gtsang so gnyis dpal bshos btsugs/ /btang stoms lnga yi mtheb skyus sbran/ /phung po lnga yi dza gad gsal/ /sems spyod ting 'dzin rartas brgyan/ /bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum thugs dam 273

bskang / /sku lnga bde ba chen pa'i thugs dargya bskang / /a la la ho/ 'dir dan song gsum gye dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi gu ru la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes lta mo shā se ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi ba'i lha mo mi 'byed ma la phyabasaba'atshal lo/ /sprul pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byen rlabs lha sko rda pa ma la phyag 'tshal yo/ rdordo rje ḍā gi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin cen /shā ka ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma ḍā ke ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /karma ḍā ki ma la phug 'tshal po/ /bud+dhā ḍā ke ma la phug 'tshal lo/ /sprug nag ḍā ke ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag spug ḍā ki ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmar smug ḍā ki ma la phyag /'tsha / lo/ /spug dmar ḍā ki ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ljang smug ḍā ke ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spug ljang ḍā ki ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthing sprug ḍā ki ma la phyag 'tshal bo/ /smug mthing ḍā gi ma la phyag/'tshal lo/ /dkar sprug ḍā ke ma la /phyag 'tshal lo/ /spug dkar ḍā ke ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser spug ḍā ke ma ༷la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smug ser ḍā ke ma la 'phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar ma 'ongs lha rma nye shu brjod/ /btsun mos lha mo re la phyag btsal bas/ /lus kyang zhi shas mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /'od dang zer kyang phyogs bcu kun du 'phros/ ༷ngag kyang dul nas snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ldan/ /phyogs bcu'i 'bangs rnams thams cad ngag la 'du/ /sems kyang zhi nas mnyam pa'i cha la 'jog /bdag ༷dang gzhan rnams phyogs dang ris mi gcod/ /gu ru'i sku la bskor nas phyag pyas pas/ pa /rjes la me tog sna tshags lam lam snang / btsun mo shin tu dga' ba'i sems skyes nas/ /bstan pa'i sgon me u rgyan chen po lags/ /drin lan lan gyis ma lon kho mos dngos len no/ /le'u bcu byeg pa'o// //273

btsun mo sa lho long btab pa sangs pa/u rgyan rgyal po'i gdung brgyud mi chad phyir/ /bdag gi bu mo lha lcam khrom pa rgyan/ba/drin cen nyid la gtan gyi grogs su 'bul/ /de la mo ma kun shes things pos smras/ /btsun mos zhus pa de ni shin tu legs/ /bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal sras gu ru lags/ /gu ru'i gdung chad sems can 'chol bar 'gro/ /'tshal bar song na dud 'gro phyugs dang 'dra1 /rgyal rigs dra ma chen po pad 'byung lags/ /dngos kyis mo bzhin bgyis na chab srid zin/ /'di ni khab tu bzhes pa'i rigs lags so/ /rgyal po khri song lde'u btsan gyis gsol pa/ /u rgyan rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas lags/ /btsun mos drin lan bu mo phul ba 'di/ /dad pa mi ldog khab tu bzhes par zhu/ /bu mo 'di la 'jig rten gzhan dag nas/ /'dod nas tshig smod 'ga' dang 'ga' ni gda'/ /las 'phro can nam bu mo bdag mchis kyang / 1rgyal po dra ma zhig gi grogs byed na1 /phyi ma gzhan la bdag ni mi mchis skad/ /bu mo'i ming yang 'phrul dgu sgyur mar btags/ /de nas u rgyan chen pos bka' bstsal pa/ /bod khams 'di yi sems can thams cad kyis/ /pad 'byung bdag zhal mngon sum mthong gin du/ /chos bshad bka' rgyun mi chad thos pa dang / /be+e ro tsa na'i dgongs pa'i byin rlabs dang / /mnga' bdag rgyal po'i 'apad rtsol nad pa yis/ /sems can kun gyi bye rabs a cang che/ /'dod chags che zhing chags pa drag po mo/ /patsun mo 'di yi sgrib pa byang nas 'dug /tshogs rdzogs 'gyod bshags de yi yon tan gyis/ /sang nyin nyi ma'i rtse la mangs rgyas 'gro/ /rgyal po'i mnga' 'og me toku sna tshogs 'thus/ /sang nyin rtse la thams cad rgyal sar 274

'dus/ /de skad thu rgyan pad+mas gsungs pa dang / /rgyal po yab yum rje 'bangs shin tu dga'/ /u rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /lha lcam khrom pa rgyan la dgongs pa mdzad/ /phyi lhal bzang la nang sems dge bar /snang / /'gro ba'i don mdzad sems can mthun par bya/ /rabs chad ma ning bya ba'i ngag gcad phyir/ /gu rus khab tu bzhes par zhal gyis bzhes/ /de la 'khor pa rnams kyang dngos spro'o/ /rgyal po yab yum shin tu dgyes par gyur/ /bod 'bangs rnams kyis nags tshal me tog btus/ /lo nyi ta la sku khrus byas nas su/ /sang nyi rtse shar bsam yas kun tshogs nas/ /rgyal sras pad 'byung sku la bskor ba byed/ /lha phyag mchod 'bul me tog sna tshogs gtor/ /la las rnga brdung la las cha lang rdeb/ /la las dung 'bud la las sgos rigs gtong / /la las dar 'phyar la las gdugs ni bskor/ /la las rgyal mtshan la las rnga 'chams gar/ /phyogs bcu kun tu lha phyag btsal ba yis/ /sa gzhi kun la me tog sna tshogs skyes/ /nam mkha' kun la me tog mang po shar/ /sprin pa'i gseb nas bar snang sgra snyan sgogs/ /'das pa'i mkha' 'gro mang po dbyings na bzhugs/ /ma 'ong mkha' 'gro mang po sgrub byin blob/ /da lta bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro mngon sum mthong 1 /rgyal 'bangs khams gsum gling dgu'i sems can rnams/ /snga phyi da lta gsum gyi sgrib pa byang / /u rgyan pad+mas phyir mi ldog lung bstan/ /de nas u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /bod kyi dge slong be+e ro tsa na dang / /rgyal sras mu tig btsan po khrom pa rgyan/ /nom mo gsum bcas chibs rta nag po rnams/ /rgyal bo khri srong lde'u btsan thugs dgongs bsgrubs1 /'gro don mthar phyin mdzad nas shel phug gshegs/ /sto long btab pa sangs ba'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //275

bkod gzhi bstan pa/de nas bkod gzhi bstan pa ni/ /dus gsug sems can rang bzhin gyis/ /gson che ring la rtag par rtogs/ /shi nas sems can chad par rtogs/ /rtag chad 'phreng la mu byas nas/ /spyod pa cang cub rgyun du gnas/ /gsog 'jog 'du byed bde sdug g.yengs/ /ma rig las sprib rgyu rkyen bskyed/ /de bzhin nyid zab don ma rtogs/ /nyes pa lnga yis sa gting 'phul/ /'jig /rten drug gi 'khor bar brgyud/ /srid gsum skye ba bzhi ru 'khor/ khud/par sems can las kyi mnar/ /'khrig chags g.yems pa'i las ngan gyis/ /nyon mongs dug lngas bde mi ster/ 1sems ni 'phyar yengs rta rgod 'dra/ /'khrig pas 'khor ba'i sa bon btab/ /chags pas thar pa'i lam dang bral/ /'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na/ /gnas dang 'byung ba'i sems can rnams/ /ldig pa'i las la spyod rnams kyis/ /sku gsum sgrub pa'i lam 'gags nas/ /mthar thug lta ba de nyid la/ /yang dge spyod pa 'ga' yang med/ /la la sprib ba bcu ༷la spyod/ /la la g.yeng ba'i las la spyod/ /la la rtog 'dzin las la spyod/ /la ༷la don med las la spyod/ /la la g.yo sgyu'i las la spyod/ /la la mi dge'i las sal spyod/ la la rtogs 'dod las la spyod/ /la la khram zog las la spyod/ /la la 'gyur sdog las la spyod/ /la la bcas bcos las la spyod/ /la la gnas 0bde'i las la spyod/ /la la yul srid las la spyod/ /la la khram 'tshog las la spyod/ /la la ltogs 'gong las la spyod/ /la la 'du byed las la spyod/ /la ༷la rtsod dang shags 'gyed spyod/ /la la mi gcig snyan grags spyod/ /la la ther zug las la spyod/ la la 'jigs pa bcu drug spyod/ /de ltar log/spyod sna tshoṭa —276

kyis1 /'jig rten drug tu spyod pa rnams/ /sdug bsngal bcu drug mtha' rgyasagapas/ /pad 'byung khab bzhes don ma gsal/ /rgyal sras pad+ma 'byung gnas nga / /'gro ba sems can don mdzad pas/ 1sems can rnams dang mthun par bsnyun/ /rabs bcad ma ning ngag gcad phyir1 /yul mi mtho ris ngan song gsum/ /lhung dang rtsod dang gol ba dang / /glen skugs bkres spyod sbyong zhing 'khor/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi/ /btsal dang rtsol dang dgra dang gnyen//lha rnams gnas su ltung ba dang / /ga yo 'khrug sdug bsngal bshad mi lang / /lha min rtsod de gzhan smod dang / /mi bde sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /mi rnams 'khor dang 'gyur ba dang / /chags pa'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /byol song glen dang lkugs pa dang / /rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /yi dwags bkres dang skom pa dang / log rtog sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /dmyal ba rtsod dang sbyong ba dang / /tsha grang sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ /bar dor gnas ngan len dang 'tshol/ /'jug ldog sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ 1'khor ba mi rtag 'gyur zhing sdog 'jig rten sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ kun la brgyad kyis khyab par gnas/ khams gsum 'khor pa'i sems can ni/ ma rig klong na gnas pa yin/ /mi dge'i las la che 'khril 'gro /'khor bar skye ba rtsi thog 'dra/ /de las thar cing bde ba'i lam 'gro phyir/ /'dzam gling rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan gyi1 /lha lcam 'phrul dgu sgrur ma khab tu bzhes/ /bod dang zhang zhung gnyis kyi mtshams su byon/ /ma pham g.yu mtsho nag mo'i 'gram du bzhugs/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i lha khang mchod pa phul/ /u rgyan chen pos 'khor la bka' bstsal pa/ /ma pham g.yu mtsho rta lam nyin gcig 'khor/ /rte na ko sha'i mtsho ni 'di dang 'dra/ /bdag bskyed yum ni don gyis rtogs par bgyi/ sa du ba zhungs 'di/la bskor ba 'khor gsum bskor/ /sangs rgyas 277

༅/zhan nabasabatsal du med de thob/ /u rgyan thor tsog dgu ldan dpe byas nas//lad+ma rgyas pa'i lha khang me ma ho/ /sgod min log lta can la gsang bar 'os/ /pho mo dad pa can la 'chad par 'os /nyam mi nga bar bskor ba 'di la skor/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs phul/ /las 'a11 dag pas ngan song yul mi 'gro/ /lha khang 'di don lta shes skyon rnams sol/ /de bas rnar nyan gom pas bgrod par rigs/ /'di bskor mtshams med lnga byas byang bar 'gyur//g.yu mtshor bkrus 'thungs bde chen mkha' spyod 'gro1 /byang sems gdung brgyud mi rje lha yi sras1 /de phyir sgogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dus/ /'jig rten nad med tshe ring phun sum tshogs/ /ngo tsha shes dang sbyin dang tshul khrims spyod1 /phun sum tshogs pas khong du chud pa yin/ /de ltar rtsod ldan dus te 'jig rten na/ /'che dang nad mang phun sum tshogs pas dman/ /g.yo dang sgyu dang dregs pa phrag dog ldan/ shes rab zhan cing log par lta ba dang / /las ngan la sogs kun la dga' ba yin/ /thugs rje'i 'od ldan nyi ma shar ba la/ /'tshig par byed rnams nges par mi dga' bas/ /bud med shin tu brtag par dka' ba yin/ /bud med brtag pa bud med mkhas pa yin/ /bya ba thams cad legs par ba gas nas bya/ /bud med ma brtags bsten pa bdud kyi las/ 1phyi rabs rjes su 'jug pa rnams kyi don/ /'phel 'grib med pa ma pham g.yu mtsho star/༄ /'phrul dgu sgyur ba'i lha lcam brtag par bya/ /sa yi lha mor brtag tu 'jug pa yin/ /gnyen po bzang ba'i be+e ro tsa na khyod/ /gnas mchog dam pa zla ba sgo ba'i yul/ /bal po'i yul de ya bu ya 'gal nas/ /bal mo shākya de ba spyan drangs shog /mtshan nyid tshang ba'i mtshan rtags mi bslu jas/ /chibs pa rta nag chibs nas spyan 'dren btang / /tshad pa/mchi ba bal chapo'i yul du slebs/ /nags tshal go rims yid du hob ba nas/ she /bal yul 278

yang le shod kyi brag phug phyin/ /lha lcam bal mo ོ༷kya de ba la/ /dngos ngan sa ro tsa na bgyi ba des/ /chigs su bcad pa 'di skad ces smras pa/ /'di na mchis pa'i be+e ro tsa na yis/ /thog ma'i dus nas da lta yan chad du/ /sdig pa mi dge'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /dus gsum bde gshegs rnams la ma bshaṭa pas1 /rgyal po'i btsun mos bdag la sto long btab/ /bdag gis ma nyes nam lang sa stos pa sangs/ /btsun mor nad mdze byung nges slob dpon bsten/ /mdzad spyod 'di yi don rnams bshad 'tshal dgongs/ /bstan pa'i sgron me pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /btsun mos drin lan lha lcam khrom rgyan phul/ khab kyi dam pa 'phrul dgu sgrur ma bzhes/ /yum gyis bkra shis mtshan rtags yod dam med//sa yi lha mo brtan mas bzang ngan shes/ /shin tu blo gsal khyod dang gnyis kyis rtogs/ 1gsang ba'i gnyir thub srog lus chags med 'ong / /le'u bco brgyad pa'o// //rgyal po'i sras mo lha lcam khrom pa rgyan brtag pa/de la bal mo shākya de bas smras/ /rgyal po'i spas mo lha gcig brtag pa la/ /nga bas yul khams de yi mi rnams mkhas/ /rig pa blo gsal che ba ma lags te/ rdom dris 'chad pa zla mo g.yog mo mkhas/ /rgyal sras gsungs na bka' bstsal bzhin du mchi/ /nyid dang 'grogs nas bod du 'gro bar bgyid/ /chibs rta nag por chibs nas gas mtshor slebs/ /be+e ro tsa na dang 'gronas bsam yas phyin/ khams gsum me tog sgol gyi na gar bsdad/ /be+e ro tsa nas bsam yas pa rnams la/ /pad rgyas lha khang ma pham g.yu mtsho ru/ 1rgul po'i sras mo 'gugs par sgra bsgrags so/ /yul khams mi rnams shin tu 273

sgo ba skyes/ /rje 'bangs thams cad bsu ba la gshegs so/ /blon po'i bu mo gcong ma thams cad dang / /dmangs kyi bu mo gtsang ma thams cad dang / /khye'u gtsang ma khams gsum na gar 'dus/ /bal mo shākya de bas mtshan brtaṭa pas/ /mgo mjug legs pa'i yon tan mtshan legs bzang / /'dra ba'i dpe ni ut+pal lo ma 'dra/ /mig ni zar ma'i me tog 'bras bu 'dra/ /dpral ba'i gdengs che zla ba nya ba 'dra/ /smin ma'i dkyus ring yi ge na ro 'dra/ /mkhur tshos bkra gsal dung phor mtshal 'dres 'dra/ /shangs kyi dbyebs legs rin cen sna tshar 'dra/ /mchu legs mu khyud cha ga btab pa 'dra/ /bzhad pa'i tshems legs lha tshe ba gam 'dra/ /gsung dbyangs snyan te ni tso'i cong skad 'dra/ /skog ma'i dbyibs legs lha yi them skas 'dra/ /mgrin pa'i gsang dod dngul gyi bum pa 'dra/ /thugs kyi phugs stoms gser gyi sngang po 'dra/ /gsol legs dngul dkar gshang chung kha sbub 'dra/ /rked pa'i skabs phyed gzhu mo'i 'chang pa 'dra/ /mdoms kyi mtshan ma pad 'dab bcu drug 'dra/ /byen pa'i gdub 'dril ri dwags ye na 'dra/ /lus kyi bkod/sha rin cen phung po 'dra/ / gzugs kyang ran pa'i tshad dang ldan par gda'/ /mi rije mi byeng mi stem mi/lnga ldan/ /dri zhim ga pur tsardon dri ma mnam/ /rgyal po'i sras mo lha lcam khrom pa rgyan/ /rgyal sras pad+mas khab tu bzhes pa 'di/ /mi gzhi legs la rab tu mdzes par gda'/ /'dra ba bcu bdun phyi yi/yul la tshang / /de la sa yi lha mo brtan ma la/ ༷༷/naja gi sgrib pa che chung khyod kyis rtog /de skad be ro tsa nas smras pa dang / /sa yi lha mo brtan mas bka' brtsal pa/ /rgyal po'i sras mo lha lcam khrog rgyan 'di/ /'byung pazhis bskyed pas bye yul rab stu mdzes/ /rnam shes sgomes kyis bskyed pa lung ma bstan/ /nang gi tshogs brgyad gin tu dge mi dge /nyon mongs sa bon zad pas dad pa che/ /sbyin pa rgya chen gtong 230

rkus brtson 'grus che/ /tshul khrims gcob ma bsrung nus shes rab che/ /sgrub pa chadang du len nus sgobs pa mtho/ /byams pa'i sems ldan chos phyir dkar spyod nus/ /nges par rdon rtogs bden pa'i tshig ston nus/ /sems nyid sra bon skyenasked don rtogs pas/ /che de'i snang ba yid la mi 'dug go /bsten pa'i sa ru /mthun pa'i yum du bzang / /de skad brtan mas mtshan ni bzang por gsol/ /srid pas bkod pa'i gtsug lag gzhung bzhin du/ /gnam sman bdud gcod sri samanan byur phud do/ /'dre dkar lha gsol dpal skyabs g.yang slon no/ /de nas 'a yu mtsho'i 'gram gyi pho brang du/ /g.yu khri sngon po la ni lha lcam bzhag /gser khri ser po la ni rgyal bas bzhugs/ khye'u dang ni bu mo'i tshul du tshogs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro mang pos bkra shis brjod/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gro mang bapos gsol ba 'debs/ /'gyur med ri rab btsugs bzhin tshe srog bsrings/ /shang po u rgyan padru 'byung gnas nyid/ /'jig rten mi yul bla mar gshegs tsa na/ 1u rgyan yul gyi nyi na ko shar byon/ /dri med mdangs ldan pad sdong 'khrungs dus su/ /mthu stobs byin rlabs dregs pa'i lha 'dre rnamag/ /dam la btags pas pad+ma rgyas par tshogs/ /u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid la gsol///bdag cag rnams ni u rgyan pad+ma yis/ /dam la btags shing lung ni phog laṭa pas/ /bod kyi rgyal po'i sras lo khrom rgyan 'di/ /bya ba 'dod 'jug spros pa med la spyod/ /rgyal po'i srid 'dzin sems can 'dren don du/ /btsun mor /bzhes pa rgyal gras shin tu legs/ /rab tu legs pas smon las re re /'debs/ /de bzhin sngags spyod dam pa'i rigs can lnga/ /theg pa chen po'i rigs can lha tshangs pas/ /lha lcam khrom pa rgyan la 'di skad gsol/ /shin tu mdzes ma 'phrul dgu sgyur ma 'di/ /de la 'di ni sku gsung thugs yon 'phren/ /dbu lo ut+pal lo ma 'dra ba 'di/ /bde bar gshegs pa dbu la bkur pa'i 381

rtags/ /ye shes lha dang gnyis med smon lam 'debs/ /mig gnyis zar sgang me tog 'dra ba 'di/ /bde stong longs spyod bde ba rgyas pa'i rtags/ /snang grid sa ler gsal bar smon lam 'debs/ /dpral pa'i gdengs che zla gsal nya 'dra 'di/ni /mtshog thun dngos grub mtha' ru rgyas pa'i rtags/ /'dod pa'i thig le zla gsang smon lam 'debs/ /smin ma yi ge na ro 'dra ba ni/ /gsang sngags bstan pa dbus su 'byung ba'i rtags/ /bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong bar smon lam 'debs/ /mkhur tshos bkrag gsal dung phor mtshal 'dra ni/ /ma nor nges pa'i sa la gter sed rtags/ /skabs su sprul sku 'byung bar smon lam 'debs/ /shangs dbyibs rin cen sna tshar 'dra ba ni/ /'jig rten mi yul las can 'byung ba'i rtags1 /kun la ma ltar byams pa'i smon lam 'debs//mchu legs mu khyud cha ga 'dra ba ni/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong bsrung gsum dar ba'i rtags/ /lha mi'i lo tsār 'gyur bar smon lam 'debs/ /bzhad tshems lta tshe ba gam 'dra ba ni/ /thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa chags pa'i rtags/ /snying po ma ṇi 'dren par smon lam 'debs/ /tshems rnyil ste tog dmar po 'dra ba ni/ /rigs drug sems can chos la bkod pa'i rtags/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa sel bar smon lam 'debs/ /smra ba'i ljags bde bar snang glog 'dra ni/ /nyan 'chad sgom pas 'gro pa 'dul ba'i rtags/ /gter chos bstan pa dar ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /gsung dbyangs ne rtsa'i gcong skad 'dra ba ni/ /sims can mgu byed bde gshegs mnyes pa'i rtags/ /rnga gling dbyangs/kyis 'thul bar smon lam 'debs/ /yog dbyibs lha yi them skas 'dra ba ni/ /'khor ba'i sems can theg dgus 'dren pa'i rtags/ /skye ba rnam gzhi kun sgol smon lam 'debs/ /mgur gyi gsang dod dngul bum 'dra ba ni/ /skyon med yon tan tshang ba'i bka' dang lung / /bdud rtsi'i gaster chos ston par smon lam 282

'debs/ /thugs kyi phugs stoms gser srung 'dra ba ni/ /chos la phyogs ris med pa spri stoms rtags/ /gang shar thug phrad grol bar smon lam 'debs/ /gsol legs dngul dkar spub ba 'dra ba ni/ /sems can 'dza don skyo dub med pa'i rtags/ 1'khor ba'i gcong nad thon par smon lam 'depa'i / / rked pa'i skabs byed gzhu 'chang 'dra ba ni/ 1skyon yon rtsa ba dge sdig 'byed pa'i rtags/ /skyon bor yon tan rdzogs par smon lam 'debs/ /byen pa ri dwags e na ya 'dra ni/ /theg 'og gong ma'i lam stegs yin pa'i rtags/ /sa bcu rim gyis bgrod par smon lam 'debs/ /sku lus rin po che ltar bkra gsal/ni/ /gsang sngags bla med tshe gcig sangs rgyas rtags/ /sbyor sgol tshad byen gnas stobs smon lam 'debs/ /sku lus ran pa'i tshad dang ldan pa ni/ /sgo gsum zhi dul bzod pa sgom pa'i rtags/ /sems can yid 'jug mgon skyabs smon lam 'debs/ /bal mo shākya de bas mtshan brtags pas/ /'gro ba sems can rnams kyi don slad du/ /klu yi rgyal po gtsug na rin cen dang / / tshangs pa gtsug phud 'dzin pa 'khor dnge bcas/ /gnod sbyin skar mdang gdong ni 'khor dang bcas/ /mi ni dri med grags pa 'khor dang bcas/ / gsang sngags rtsa ba gzung ma mtshan ldan yin/ /skye/ba 'di la sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rtags/ /'khor bsde gnas sgo gcod par smon lam 'debs/ /de yang don du 'di ltar ro/ /sems can rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /gnas la chags shing khyim la dga'/ /de dag de las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /lan cig khrom pa rgyan zhes pa'i1 ra /de nas khyim pa khyim du 'byin/ /de gyir khyim thab ces pa'o/ le'u bcu dgu pa'o// //283

lha lcam khrom ga rgyan la bu bdud sprul skyes pa/de tshe de dus lha lcam khrom pa rgyan/ /phyi yul bzang la nang sems dge ba mo/ /lha lcam khrom rgyan bag dang ldan pa la/ /dgun zla tha chung nya yi rmi lam na/ /'od nag 'dom gang khong du song ba rmis/ /gnyid sad tsa na lus lci khong pa 'dar/ /yid 'khrugs snying gcu gzugs phung kun ma bde/ /'phrig pa skyes nas kun la ma bshad gsang / /dmar rgyan ma la ji ltar byung ba bshad/ /ba dmar rgyan mas bu mor 'di skad brjod/ /u rgyan pad+ma'i thugs rje'i sprul pa dang / /sems can rnams kyi spyi mthun bsod nams kyis/ /bod ni mi nub bstan pa dar ba'i rtags/ /de skad byas nas lha lcam lha bsangs byathob /phyi de'i lo dus sku las sras gcig 'khrungs1 /'khrungs pa'i dus der kun kyang spro ba skyes/ /de la 'dus nas kun kong ltad mo lta/ /a cang mtshan chadang ma ldan gti thug nas/ /mi rnams kun gyis kha dmar ngan pa btags/ //sa/rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen gyis gsal bar gzigs/ /bdud kyis baspus pa yin par ngo mkhyen cing / /'dul ba'i dus la ma bab bdud ma gsungs/ /bdud kyang gu ru'i bu ru sprul pa ston/ /slob dpon pad 'byung bu ru ming btags nas/ /zhi bas bsrings la da gzod 'dul bar dgongs/ /ma bu sar sar gnyis ka thab la rgyug /rkang mthil lag mthil pad+ma'i ri mo yod/ /bu do sems can gzhan pas skye ba drag /pha ni zhe sdang bdud kyi bu yin pas/ /legs su bcos kyang rang gi rgyu nyid gtso/ /sems can sha dang khrag la dad kyang che/ /rus pa khrul khrowa mig mthong thams cad kyang / /keng rus go bo bzhin du mid kyin gtong / /de nyid mthong bas 284

thams cad 'phrig pa skyes/ /ming yang pad+ma 'byung gnas chung bar btags/ skoskyes nas yab la chos slob mi nyan par/ /yab la gsol pa pad 'byung chen po lags/ /gzhan la phan pa mi slob dka' las che/ /bdag rang nyid la phan pa slob pa yin/ kha ru za ba'i zas su sha zhim pas/ /sems can gsod na gsod kyin za ze yin/ /lus la/gyon pa'i gos su pags pa/dro/ /sems can bsad nas bshu yin gyon pa yin/ /jag sprang rkun ma brku ba'i chos shig slob//pad 'byung go bo bdag la thugs rjes zungs/ /de skad ces pa yab la gsol pa dang / /u rgyan pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ /sems can nyon mongs snying re rje/1sgyu ma'i phung po nyon re mongs/ /'bras bu sems 'di nyam re thag bden tshig brgya smras gcig mi go /gal ba'i sems can sdig can cig bdag1gi gnas 'dir skyes par dpyad/ /gzhan la snying rje chung lugs dang / /rang la bsod nams drag tshul dang / /sha dang khrug la dad tshul dang / /sdig pa'i log chig spu lugs dang / /zhe sdang bdud kyi rigs shig yin/ /se 'phang nag po'i bu yin 'dug /chos la bar chad byed par nges/ /zhakhor gyis sems can slad ma kun/ /'di yi tshig ni ma nyan cig /do skad ces pa bka' bstsal to/ /pad/'byung go po ngo nag song / /mtshang phog par der mno bsam btang 1 shin tu zhi byas slu ba dran/ /nyin bzhon pha mar bskor ba byas/ /lha phyag gan brgya rtsa brgyad btsal/ khrus byas me tog brgya rtsa phul/ /de ltar bya ba byas nas su/ /yab kyi gser gyi kha shā la/ /rtsa btsugs thu na las/mosku tsugs1 /rgyug 'asbor phub pa'i tshul byas brgyab/ /gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gser gyi kha shā ma zug par/ /dngul gyi rtse mo brgyab pa'i sar/ /zangs kyi rdo rjer wal gyes song / /gser gyi kha ṭī brgyab pa'i sar/ /me tog pad+mar lam gyis song / /pad chung skyengs nas ngu tshul bstan/ /de la yab kyis bka' bstsal 285

༷pa/ /bu khyod ma la skyes tsa na/ /mtshan dang ma ldan 'jigs pa cig /rang gi chagazugs kyi phung po la/ /tsher ma gcig rkyeng mi bzod par/ /gargan dag sems can mang po yi/ /srog bcad pags pa gos gyon zer/ /ga la'i sems can bdud rigs cig /bdag nyams gzhan la blang ngo cog /ma nor bden pa'i don bstan na/ /mi bden phyin ci log tu byed/ /pad+ma'i bstan pa bstub snyam nas/ 1gser gyi kha ṭī nga la brdeg /gser gyi kha shā nga mi gsod/ /shadangul gye kha shā nga gsod du/ /nga la srog gi lan chags med/ /dngul shā brdog pa dngos grub mchog /don dam bstan kyang mi nyan pas/ /bden pa'i sa bon /khyod la med/ /dper na sems can blo log gis/ /lcags rdo gser du bzhu ba 'dra/ /de 'dra'i sems can sdig can khyod/ /dmyal bar 'gro ba'i skye shing cig /ngan song gsum gyi rmang rdo cig /bden pa'i sa bon khyod la med/ /sdug bsnga / na/pa'i sa bon thod/ /sems can nyon mongs nyon re mongs/ /zhes /gsungs yab kyi bstan pa ma nub nas/ /pad chung go bo mya ngan khong du shi/ /༷shi nas yab yum 'khor kun mya ngan byed/ /gnyer pa se 'phang nag po'i thu yin 'dug /lha lcam khrom rgyan ma ni ro la 'jus/ /bu 'bod mya ngan smre sngags du ma 'don/ /u rgyan pad+mas mya ngan ga la byed/ /ma ngu ma ngu khrom pa rgyan/ /'u bu cag gyi bu ma yin/ /la la lha yi thugs rje'i bu/ /la la bgegs kyi bar gcod bu/ /la la bdud kyis dmod pa'i bu/ /la la dmyal ba'i lan chags bu/ /la sa srin gyis baspus pa'i bu/ /drin la lan gyis slon pa'i bu/4/brgya dang stong la 'ga' re tsam/ /cir yang bu zhes bya ba'i rgyu/ /sngon tshe skye ba gong ma la/ /salas ngan byas ga'i lan chags ni/ /shin tu mi bzad dos drag pas/ /bu ru skyes nathegasing la snyeg /de la chags par ma gyur na/ /don gyi 'bras bu de yis rnyed/ /ces gsungs pas/ /lha lcam khrom pa rgyan 'khor mya ngan byed pa kun gye 286

mya ngan thams cad dge ba'i las la spyod pa mthong / /gnyer pa se 'phang nag po mya ngan gyis zin song ngo / /le'u nyi shu pa'o// //bud med kyi skyon sogs dge sdig skor 'ga' bstan pa/khrom rgyan don med skyid lug skye ba zhus/ /se 'phang nag po pad chung go gdong gnyis/ /snga ma gar skyes phyi ma gang du skye/ /byang chub skabs ni yod med gsung bar zhu/ /de la u rgyan bad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ /col med pha dang bu sring 'thab rtsod byed/ /snga ma 'thab la rab tu rtsub pa dang / /phyi ma khro la rab tu tshig pa can/ 'di nas mi gnas bdud kyi chu bo bzhi/ /sems can thams cad de la 'jigs shing skrag /byin log dad pas 'khor ba stongs kyis dogs/ /smre sngags mya ngan ngus pas log yor re/ /las 'phro med pa'i sems can sdig can mang / /shin tu grangs mdza bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /skyon gyi gong po khyim thab ngo ma shes/ 1'jig rten laso ni byas kyin yang byed dgos//byang chub med pas shi nas zin pa yin/ /'khor ba'i lus 'di blangs kyin yang len dgos/ /'khor ba'i brtsan nas thar pa'i dus mi 'ong / /nyon mongs log par 'khrul pa'i bu mo rnams/ /rang dbang yod dus mkhung che sbom ring dran/ /rikhor ba rgyun mi chad ni bud med yin/ /srin mo dngos su byung ba'i mgo nag mo/ /gzugs phung dkyil du dmyal ba'i zangs cig skyes/ /btso bsreg sdug bsngal thams cad de las 'byung / /mtho ris thar she'i 'brub khung zangs de yin/ rdobade ba mi bde btso sbyang zangs des byed/ /bud med bya ba dmyal ba'i zangs ka yin/ khyod dang 'grogs na dmyal ba'i zangs su 'tshod/ /daphyol ba'i zangs su btso gal bdag la med/ /bud med bya ba bdud kyi btson ra 237

yin/ khyod dang 'brel na bdud kyi btson ra ste/ /bdud kyi brtsan rar sdod gal bdag la med/ /bud med bya ba gshin rje'i gdos thag yin/ khyod la dad na gshin dzhas gdos kyis 'dogs/ /gshin rje'i gdos gal pad 'byung bdag la med/ /bud med byaXb dug gi 'dam rdzab yin/ khyod la dad na dug 'dam 'tshod pa yin/ /gsod pa'i dug 'dam brgal gal bdag la med/ kha mdog rgyas pa'i bud med ni/ /sdom pa 'phrog pa'i jag pa yin/ /so thar 'dul khrims med pa yi/ /so so skye bo ngan skyog gol/ /pad 'byung nga la dgos pa med/ /rjes 'jug 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal zhi bya'i byir/ /tshad med bzhi dang ༷ldan pa'i khrom pa rgyan/ /ma pham g.yu mtsho bha na ko sha'i mtsho/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i /lha khang gzhal yas su/ /shin tu mos gus che ba'i khrom rgyan bzhugs/ khyod cani sdig skyon ma gos rmi lam na/ /nam mkha'i mthongs nas 'ja' tshon skas ka btsugs/ /skas gzhug khyod kyi dpung pa gnyis myu bzhag /gdang bu'i steng la rdo rje sems dpa' byon/ /mtshago dang dpe byad ldan pa spyi gtsug thim/ /kyo b.las 'od 'gros stong gsum gsal ba rmis / /gnyid sad lus bde shin tu yid kyang spro/ /dngos grub mtshog dgongs shin tu mi la gsang /lha lcam sku la sras bltams mtshan dpe ldasha/ /sras de thabs shes sprul pa'i sku yin pas / /dgos 'dod re skong ni 'dod yid la sprod/ /dgung lo gcig lon shes rab tshad du phyin/ /dgung lo/gnyis na snying rje'i sems dang ldan/ /dgung lo gsum na yab la chos 'dri spobs/ /yab kyis bstan pa tsam byes sras kyis rtogs/ /skyon spangs yon tan snyan pa'i sgra grags so/ /ming yang snyan chen dpal dbyangs zhes su btags/ /'gro sdeng yi ge spri tshugs yi ge sogs/ /yig rigs mi gcig bdun cu rtsa lnga shes/ /'jig rten dag na mi dge'i chags sdang stog /'di don ma rtogs thos pa mi gagog na/ /ma rig rnam rtog dra ba'i rgyun mi grol/ /chos 283

la myod darkan de bas theg chen dkon/ /ma nor ston dkon de bas mos pado dkon/ /de phyir nga yi bu yin skal pa bzang / /blo chung 'phyar 'jag tshos la phyogs cha che / /log lta'i tshig gis 'gro ba'i don mi 'grub/ /de bzhin dgongs sam lha lcam khrom pa rgyan/ /bu/'di nor shod bu med cig la ster/ /lus ngag yid gsum ngal med nor bsags nas/ /lus sems bral 'gro dran pa 'dzin mi dgos/ /nor bas lus bzhag lta myul bya mi dgos/ /rig pa sna tshogs 'thas 'chim dran pa rgas/ /de la bu byin phan thogs cher 'ong gsungs/ /rgyal po'i gras mo lha lcam khrom pa rgyan/ /smre sngags ngu bshum shin tu ngu bshum byas//ba dmar rgyan ma kha ru sa 'gams ngus/ /tshos rgyal khri sgong sde'u btsan 'di skad gsungs/ /dmar rgyan khyod kyis legs pa ci zhig byas/ /mkhas pa bo ro tsa nar lto long btab/ /nad du mdze byung ba de ma dran nam/ /mo bsdur dpyad lto byas pa ma dran nam/ khyod khams bde ba slob dpon drin las byung / 1phas bu 'bogs la ma smad ci la ngu/ /slob dpon1mnyes na gang dgar sbyin pas chog chos rgyal chen pos de skad gsungs pa dang / /ba dmar rgyan mo ma mgal so btab bzhengs/ /kye ma kye hud/ drin lan gzhal du btsun mo dmar rgyan ngas/ rgyal khams mnga' mdzad mtha' yi 'dod mi la/ /khrom rgyan ma byen bla ma khyed la phul/ /bud med lus la sa rdo min pa skyes/ /pad chung go bo nga yi bu min te/ /gnyer pa se 'phang nag po'i bu yin gsungs/ /bu 'dis chos la bar chad byed nges pas/ /'khor ba sems can slad ma kun gyis kyang / /'di yi tshig la khyod rnams ma nyan gasrungs/ /bye brag ma 'dres shugs mchod 'dod do —gsungs/ ༄/bod du slob dpon gdung brgyud byung na bsams/ /zhem brjod cing ngus/so/ /lha lcam khrom pa rgyan gyis 'di skad zhus/ /bar chad rkyen mang za ma mo yi lus/ /skye rgyal med na bud med lus 'di rul/ /dper na skyes bu428ste

ཿyon tan sna dgu ldan/ /dpa' rtsal che ba'i mtshan du btags pa yin/ /'dun t+pas ngos nas gtso bor mtshan du btags/ /rig byed ngos nas bzo yor /mtshan du btags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /u rgyan pad+ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /yul ni ngan lam ral gsum bya ba na/ /spa bza' re ma bya ba'i bu shi nas1 /nor rdzas yod de bu med zer nas ju /pha ma gnyis la bu de sbyin pa na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di la phan thogs 'ong / /bshad rgyud sgrub rgyud nyi sam shar ba 'dra1 /ye shes mkha' 'gro mang pos bkra shis brjod/ /'jig rten mkha' 'gro mang pos gsol ba 'debag/ /'gyur med ri rab btsugs1bzhin /tshe sgog bsring / /rgyal po'i sras mo lha lcam 'di la ni/ /lha srin sde brgyad sarnams la bka' btsan zheng / /skye 'gro sems can don byed pa zhig 'khrungs/ /nges par sngags dang mtshan nyid gsal bar smra/ /pad 'byung bsten pa spel nushe ༷pa cig 'khrungs/ /mus sems dpal shar bod kyi rgyan du byon/ /pha ma gnyis la bu byin yid 'ches pas/ /chos sgor btsud pas 'di ltar shes par byed/ /rtsed mor chos nyan pa dang 'chad pa dang / /'bri klog min pa mi byed pa cig byung / /cher song las 'bras khyad mi gsod pa 'byung / /ska ba dpal brtsegs cog ro glu'i rgyal mtshan/ /rma rin mchog dang zhang ban ye shes sde/ /lo tsā 0bzhi byon dus su mtshan nyid gsan/ /mtshan nyid ma lus dpe don gzhi la mkhas/ /de dus be+e mā mi tra rgya gar nas/ /pasam yas spyan drangs byon pa la/ོོ/'phrul zhi khro dzogs gor gsan//bi mā'i lo tsā mchims pa yon 'dar dang / /rgenyags ban rto na ku mār bya ba bzhugs/ /gsang sngags tshur gsan mtshan )di par la bshad/ /phar slob tshur slob mdzad nas sgos pa bcad/ /sems phyogs ma lus nan tur mkhas par mkhyen/ /de nas yul ni ngan lam ral yul byon/ /nam mkha' che ni bshad kyin yod tsa na/ /lu rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas 290

thugs dgongs la/ /bzang po ngan pas chud gson med dam ci/ /chos 'chad slob mar slob dpon ngan pa yin/ /bla ma'i keng 'dren pa la slob ma mkhas/ /dus la ma bab 'gro don bar gcod yin/ /mgo la rang yu btsugs nas phyir log bskor/ /de 'dra'i dpon slob gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu/ /nan ltar dge ba'i chos cig byed 'dod na/ /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing bzhad gad rgyur/ /ma song byed dgos 'jig rten spangs byas nas/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs rab tu byung ba byas/ /brgyags sris 'bun gtonge nor gyi sgyur log byed/ /lus ngag sa da gsum g.yeng bar gnas ba ni/ /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing bzhad gad 0rgyu/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba sngon du ma song bar/ /shes bya shes byed rtogs par tshos shad zer/ /go yul chig la sangs rgyas 'dod pa yang / /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing bzhad gad rgyu/ /so so thar pa'i bslab bya tsam yang med/ /sdom pa gsum ldan yod par khas len kyang / /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing bzhad gad rgyu/ /tshe 'di rang 'phung sgrub las mi shes par/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum 0'dzom par/khas len kyang / /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing bzhad ba da/rgyu/ /phan sems cung zad tsam yang med par ni/ /mi sdud sems can 'gro don byed pa /yang / /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing bzhad gad rgyu/ /sems can don du rtog pa'i gdengs med par/ /dam tshig sdom pa mi bsrung mi mgo bskor/ /dam pa rnams kyis smod cing bzhad gad rgyu/ /chos 'di byed blo tsam gyis go mi skyod/ /bla ma mtshan nyid ldan dang 'phrad dgos gsung / /gang byung byung dang phrad pas mi 'ong gsung / /bla ma bzang po 'tshol 'tshol 'dod 'dod nas/ /bdud dang 'phrad pa'i nyen yod brtag pa gces/ /bdud ni chos par cis kyang baspyo ba yin/ /sdig pa mi dge'i las sbyor bdud yin no/ /mi la gzhan skyon mang 0po bgrangs bgrangs nas/ /rang skyon sel bar mi byed bdud yin no/ /rigs 2gyi

ngan 'phral dbul ngo tsha khrel gdong med/ /gdams ngag ci tsam bshad kung gzung 'dzin che/ /gdams ngag chos thob brtsis nas bshad par rings/ /mu ge'i dus kyi zong bzhin 'phrog btsong byed/ /bdud ni slob mar brdzus pa brtag par dka'/ /gang zhe na/ dam tshig med pa/ rdzun che ba/ khrel med pa/gdong chung ba/ rang 'dod che ba/ phyogs cha che ba/ bsam pa ngan pa/ dpe brku pa/ gzhogs ngom byed pa/ bka' slu ba/ dad pa chung ba/ 'jab mkhas pa/ byi la ltar phyir 'byams don chung ba/ nor khyung ba la sogs kyi spyon rdzogs pa/ de 'dra'i slob ma bstan pa la bkod kyang / phan thogs par mi thong gnod pa skyel ba la dgongs nas/ u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis sprang rgan cig tu sprul/ dpal dbyangs chos 'chad pa'i chos grwar phyin/ nyin cig tshos grwar sprang po rgad po byung / phyag mi 'etshal zhing zhwa mi 'bud par chos nyan gyen 'dug /res yin yin zer res min min zer ro/ /de nas chos ston gyes tsa na/ /snyan ā tsaru dpal dbyangs zer nas sgra che tsam na/ /nam mkha' che lta sgom shan ma phyed pa cig 'chad kyin geda' zer song / /snyan chen dathal dbyangs snyam na da rung sems thag ma tshod byung snyam/ /sprang po de btsal bas rnyed nas gdams ngag zhu byas/pas/ khyed dge bshes nga la gdams ngag ma zhu zhig zer1'o na da gi de gsungs phyir zhu dgos byas pas snyan brgyud le'u nyis brgya zhe gnyis pa gnang nas sprang po gar song cha med song / snyan gyi thugs la ming yang ma dris pas/ gsol ba ji skad byas nas gdab snyam nas shin tu ma dgyes par yod tsa na/ nam byed la sprang po nyi ma'i snying po yin gsungs/ de nas u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis snyan chen lha'i yul du lung bstan to/ 1sgron ma rnam pa drug ni/tshu lta ba yang dag sgon ma ma'i don du mdzad do/ /thu lan sgon ma sna nam sdong khri'i don du mdzad do/ /bzhi pa sems can spyi'i don du mdzad par 292

chagada'o/ /man ngag sprul pa'i 'khor ོ/'di nyid nyi rongs zangs kyi dben rtsar —mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje bzang mos nam gyi gung la gsungs par gda'o/ /gu ru'i shagongs pa la da bsgom dgos snyam nas/ dgon pa mtha' dag 'grims nas dgon pa der/brtags te bzhag rga /de nas chu shul gyis rdza lhud mor yang bzhugs so/ /de nardo ngan lam gyi dgon pa cig na bzhugs tsa na/ dkyil 'khor zhal bye nas lo mtshams bcad nas bzhugs pas/ gtor ma lud pa mar ye rgyun mi chad ba/ sgos rgyun shi chad pa/ mtha' ma khro zhal bzhad pa/ phur bu rtsed bro byed pa la sogs pa rtags bzang po yod pa ga1 zhang pos pha'i mi shar byang bra/byas nas mi mang po bsad la/ mas slob dpon la dpen pa'i phug nas/ zhang 14/kun gyi sdig bshags bya dgos byas pas/ slob dpon byes de'i sdig bshaṭa ngas mi 'ong / ma'i ngag yin gyi mi gcog par zhu byas pas/ phyis mno bsam btang nas ma'i ngag bcad na mi rung snyam/ ma rgan zhang po kun la yar shog shus pas/ shang po kun khal khur mang po bkal nas byung tsa na/ gu ru la dam tshig gi sel byung nas/ dkyil 'khor kun kyang mog mog por gyur rte gtor ma sal ham pa chags zhun mar shi la khad/ sgos dud rgyun chad/ khro zhal kun kyang /ngu la khad/ der slob daslon bka' nas/zhaja po kun la phan mi thogs par 'dug gi/ khyod rang log las song zhig byas pas/ 'o na nged rnams dmyal ༷bar lhung / tsha bo'i bstan pa la gnod na nged log pas chog gi ka ca kun kyang tshogs dang gtor ma'i rgyu gyis shig zer nas song ngo / /der gu rus ka ca kun/nang1du 'jug ma 'dod/ /rtsa bar yod tsa na/ sring mo chung shos byung nas/ a ma na bas a po mar bos shog zer bar khyod rang log nga mi yong byas nas ma phyin1 'bring mo byung bas kyang sa phyin/ chen mo byung nas da 'chi bar 'dug go zer bar/ der mi 'chi las che snyam nas gtor ma patang / dngos 293
