grub blangs dkyil 'khor bsdus nas/ mar phyin co na/ a ma khang pa'i rgyab na dru bu 'dzin gyin gda' nas/ bu bar gcod ma byung ngam yar log zer pas/gu rus kyang lan ma blan par yar phyin tsa na/ dgon pa'i nang na mi reng skya bo bzhi byas nas/ gu ru'i thugs la kri ya ki kun gyis zhang po'i ka ca khyer las che snyam nas phyin tsa na/ mi de 'tshub nag chen po zheg tu song / gu ru de'i nang du chud nas zhabs snad spyan mdongs nas rgya mtsho'i sle la bor snyam byed pa cigader skor bshags mang po mdzad pas/ dam chig gi lha po pra mo ha bya ba zhig byung nas/ ming po khyod rang spyo+od pa rtsings pas lan/ bar gcod du de'u song /da bkra shis par 'ong gi /khyod rang gi rtsol sgrub la rdugs pa yin/ /da gnas 'di bku ma shis pas 'dir ma bsdad/ /ru mtshams ya gi na gi ram rja mo thu ba yod kyi der song zer nas/ g.yog ni ldong khris byas nas der lo gsum bzhugs tsa na/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad byung nas/ phyag gyang 'gyel ba bzhin mdzad de/ gu ru da 'dir ma bzhugs par/ yar glungs na ru ra che chung bya ba yod pas/ de ru gshegs zer bar byon nas bzhugs pa la/ che bar bzhugs chub ngur skyo sangs mdzad pa la/ na ma cag sna nam ldong khri chu 'chur phyin tsa na/ gu ru'i rtsa na mi dkar po thod dkar po bcings shing lag na ba dan dkar po thogs pa cig na re/ gnyan a tsadu dpal dbyangs bya ba /khyod kyis 'gro ba mi 'thul gyi/ dga' ldan lha'i gnas su ston pa la gshegs zer nas 'dug skad/ sna nam ldong khris ched du ma gzung tsa na/ zhag gsum gyi nang par nam mkha' nas ma la/ gser gyi skas ka cig byung / sgra dang rol mo dang / mchod pa'i bye brag mang pos bsus nas/ gu rus skas la 'dzegs nas gshegs pa la sna nam ldong khri la ni ma bsam pa mang po bdog nas gu ru thugs rje re chung na zhus pas/ slo bo la sha tsha slob pa'i tshul du/ gu rus sna nam 294

sdong khri'i don zhu lan sgron ma brtsams so/ /gu ru dga' ldan lha'i yul tri ston pa mdzad do1 /lenyu nyere gcig pa'o// //yu rgyan pad+mas mngon shes kyis 'byung 'argyur lung bstan pa/pho gyong bza' rgyal mo btsun la gsungs pa/ mu rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas/ /zag bcas mngon shes nyi shu lnga/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / 1 lha ma yin dang gling bzhi'i mi /rgyal chen bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum dang / / 'thab bral dag dang dga' ldan 'phrul dga' dang / /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bsam gtan bzhi/ /skye mched mu bzhi dang ni nyer lnga'o/ /skye gnas zag pa bcas pa nga yis shes/ khams kyi zag pa bcas pa nga yis shes/ /srid pa'i zag pa bcas pa nga yis shes/ /ma rig zag pa bcas pa nga yis shes/ /lta ba'i zag pa bcas pa nga yis shes/ /stod mnga' ris skor gsum rgyal po gang byung ni/ /nga ni sto rdub srin yul phyin 'og tu/ /lo ni brgyad brgya bdun cu nas/ /sa tor khrims 'jig rtsub 'gyur yang yang 'byung / /rgyal po stag gi lo pa lnga 'byung ste/ 1yar glungs nang nas lcags pho stag lo pa/ /mnga' ris skor gsum lcags pho stag lo pa/ /shar gyi phyogs nas rgya nag ka shi ka me pho stag gi lo pa nam mkha'i ming / /hor rgyal bram ze zla gsal 'joms/ /rgyal brgyud smad gdengs sil chad gnyis su 'gyur/ /smad gdengs dud 'gro'i ming can gnyis gnyis lon/ /me pho rta khri lo la ra sar ni/ /'das pa yan chad gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa gnyis so1 /gnam lde 'od srungs man chad sil bur chad/ /lha 'dre khengs log sems can bsod nams zad/ /gnam lde khri sde can la༄mi 'cham 'khrug /gdung sel zhugs pas mi bde rlung chub ldang / /gnyis ka yab 29thu

dogrongs rteng la skyes bas lan/ /gnam lde mar me'i 'od kyis bsrung ba 'byung //dbu galor gnyis chad 'khrug pa chen po 'byung / /'od srungs gdung brgyud samanga' ris stod du 'bros/ /mgon gsum stod du grags pa'i bku shis/mgon/ /gdung pargyud yab/srasga/gsum po pab tu 'byung / /rgya bod lo paṇa bstan pa gso ba 'byung / /bod khams sa hor khrims sgyil zer la bdag byed 'byung / /sa hor dmag kha nang du ston pa 'byung / /lho yi dom sgo nag po kha bye zhakhrug ༷lo gang la 'ong ba ni/ sto mon zad pa'i rgya gar pho mo lcargas pho stag lo pa/hū la hu yis bstan pa gtor ba 'byung / kong yul cha ga ra se pho mo stag /༷hor gyi rgyal po bod dmag gdung brgyud du/ /rgya gar bram ze sku gsal skye ba /bzhes/ /bstan lo gang brtsi ba ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bdun —rjes/ /lnga brgya phrag gsum lcags mo sbrul nas ni/ /mkha' la gnam lcags sgu chen bsgrags/ /sa hor bstan pa mtshan mor 'gyur/ /mtshan mo ji skod zer ba ni/ /sngon 'das dus na rgya gar du/ /sangs rgyas gaṅgā dag gi 'gram du/ / mnyan pas gru gtong ma 'dod de/ /go'u tam gru btsas gshoms shig zer/ /sang la gru btsas med ces nam mkha' la/ /lho yi phyogs nas byang gi phyogs la ༷gshegs/ /mnyan pas mthong nas 'aspyod pa drag po skyes/ /sbyin gnas de lta bu bdag gis ma bsgrul snyam/ /shin tu rab tu 'gyod de/sa la 'gyelasgo /chung 1mas ming nas bos rte mgo nazagabateg /ngu ste ku ma yar la longs/ /brgyal ༷sangs dran pa rnyed nas su/ /rgyal poXgazugs can snying po'i mdun du byen/ /rab tu byung ba thams cad las/ /gru btsas mi 'dod pa'i dam bcas/ /mnyan pa tshe yi dus byas nas1 /lha dbang brgya byen bu ru skyes/ /'chi ltas/rnam pa lnga byung nas/ /sdug bsngal smre sngags 'don pa la/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byen dres/ /bu khyod smre sngags ci la 'don/ /bdag ni lha yi pade pa dang bral nas/ 1296

phag mo'i mngal du skye bar 'gyur/ /mi dge sprod pas de la smre sngags 'don/ rdolha dbang brgya byin bka' bstsal pa/ /dkon rtsog gsum la skyabs 'gro ba1 de ni ngan song mi 'gro ste/ /lha/yi lus 'di spangs nas kyang / /lha lus nyid ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /de nas lha'i bus skyabs 'gro byas/ 1ngan song/thar nas dga' ldan lha yul skyes/ /lha yi bu'i mngon par shes pa yis/ /rgyali po mes byin mtha' 'khob rgyal por skyes par shes/ /de mi bu ru bdag ni skye bar 'gyur/ / mi bde ba yi smre sngags 'don par 'gyur/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byin lus bzang po/ mig stong dang ldan pas gzigs / mtho ris skye bar 'dod dam che ring yun du gnas par/'dod dam/ nyi zla gnyis ba dbang ba'i bdag por 'dod dam/ 'jig rten pa'i rgyal por 'dod dam/ de la sogs pa ni bdag gis ster bar nus/ khams gsum mchog las 'das pa ni ma yin no/ /smon lam gang btab 'grub par smon lam thob/ ces sgros so/ / lha'i bus rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la brkur sti byed pa1 chos kyi rgyal por smon lam btab/ las gang byed pa ni brtsam ldan 'das la gru ma btang ba'i sngon las 'byung / ma 'ongs bstan zhabs lnga brgya phrag gsum na/ /me mo phag tshong bku mi shis pa 'byung / /rgya pod hor stod hor smad 'phung dus na/ /zhe sdong las gyur dmag 'khrug dang / /'dod chags las gyur mu ge dang / /gti mug las gyur nad yams dang / /sems can mi skyid sdug pa'i dus gcig 'byung / /bod yul lo nyi ta yi 'gram/ /yar klungs nang nas rnam smin bskyed pa 'byung / /lha dbang brgya byin lung bstan nas/ sprul pa'i rgyal po mige gsum lag pa bzhi/ /ste gnyis gzhu 'dom bco brgyad mtho bcu pa/ /zhub can 'bum gyis bskor ba 'byung 1 /mi srid srid pa'i lca gaspe can/ /'khor du ro langs bdun gyis bskor /rgyal po de nyid grongs nas 297

su/ /hor sras bying gi lus su skye1 /de la bu ni dad pa can gcig dang / cadad pa med pa gnyis 'byung ste/ /rgyal srid la ni mi 'cham par/ /zhang blon rnams ni 'khrugs nas su/ /dge 'dun rnams ni gsod par 'gyur/ /bla mchod rnams ni chu la bskur/ /mi lus sems can sna tshogs mgo bo can/ /sha za khrag 'thung rdung rdeg byed pa ni/ /nyes med sems can mang po snying re rje/ /gnam la 'thur rgu sa la 'dzul rgu dang / /bar na 'grim rgu sems can dal du med/ mtho ba'i mkhur rnams 'bebs su 'ong / /btsan pa'i rdzong rnams 'jig tu 'ong / /dma' ba'i yul rnams 'phrog tu 'ong / /mi phyugs gnad du gcod du 'ong / /mi rta mang po gri ru gsod du 'ong / 1de yi bzlog thabs gra nub mar chen du/ /chos bdag skyes pa'i yul du 'di ltar bya/ /ngas lung bstan pa byang ming gnam sa'i bdag sa song sdenyu btsan 'grin las sprul pa de/ /ji bzhin 'dra ba sde gu lha bzhengs nas/ /rnam thar kyang ris dag la bri bar bya'o//shel gyi mched rten dbu gsum cig kyang bzhengs/ /mar me sgos dang me tog rtsi dang sman/ /yon chab zhal zas sna tshogs mchod pas mchod/ /spyin bdag nyid 3 mnga' ris rgyal po dang / /rgya nag rgyal por rig par bya'o/ /'dus pa ci btsam 'byung ba ni/ lha dbang brgya byin gyi bu dge gnas gtsang ma lus rigs ༷bdun brgyud du mi lus blangs pa/ stod mnga' ris gu ge pu rangs su 'byung //mtshan ni ra dzā girti sde btsan zhes bya'o/ /lo ni lcags pho stag gi lo pa 'byung //spyodapung pa gnyis su smi ba lha'i mig 'edra/ /'di yi gdung brgyud 'dzin pa'i btsun mo ni/ /lha mo purna ri ka che 'phos pa/ kha che dge 'dun bathang po nga ra thang du gum/ /sa pho spre'u'i lo la mi lus blangs/ /sgol ma'i sprul pa khri rgyan zhes bya'o/ /de las phun sum tshogs pa sde btsan zhes bya ba/ /'od grags lha khri btsan pa mched gnyis 'byung / /de gnyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems 2gyi8

dpa' ste/ /bstan pa la phan pa'i bya ba byed do/ /mab ni 'jam dpal sprul par rig go /sras che ba me pho stag lo pa/ spyon ras gzigs kyi sprul par rigachung ba ni rta'i lo pa 'ong / phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par rig 'di la btsun mo bzhi 'byung ngo / 1glang lug khyi 'brug gi lo pa 'byung ngo / /bsam yas dbu rtse dang / yar chen lha khang la gser thog dang g.yu thog 'gel —bar 'gyur ro/1pu rangs gser kha'i gser phud zhabs tog byed/ rgyal po'i bya ba rnam bzhi )byed de/ nga yi sku gzugs chen mo bzhengs/ /ngas brtsams chos rnams dar du 'jug /'di yi bla ma lung du bstan pa ni/ /spyon med yon tan tshang ba'i bka' dang thung / /mchog rab pa zhes grags pa 'byung bar rig mnyan pa gru snyegatong ma 'dod chung ma de/ /mdo khams rgyal po ska mtshar zhes byar skye/ / ༷mchod gnas bdun brgya rgyal srid mnga' thang che/ /de bzhag rteng la thar pa'i 'bras bu 'thob/ /rnam gsum blo dang ldan pa rigs kyi bu/ /dgung lo gsum na shes rab tshad du phyin/ /sidha'i ming can spro ba skyes pa 'byung / /mnyen par bus rkyen de las dge sdig 'byed shes pa/ /rnam par spen pa phra mo la 'dzem /la/ /rnam par gnag pa'i las mi byed pa/ rnam par dkar ba'i las byed pa/mi dge bcu spangs dge bcu spyod do/ /zhang blon 'bangs dang bcas pa de'i rjes su zhugs pas/ rgyal po dad pa med pa de rmi lam na nyi zla nag po thang la lhung ba dang / ri glungs 'od kyis khengs pa dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sa g.yo ba chen po 'byung / mo pra rtsis ju thig gtsug lag dpyad la sogs pa byed par/'gyur ro/ nga /kye ma kye hud dgongs pa ngan pa 'byung srid1 phu nas brag ral mda' ru mtsho 'khrug bar du mi bde ba'i 'tshub ma ldang ngo / /stod smrad /dmag gis khrid nas gnyis pham par 'gyur/ mi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa//sku tshe la bar chod byung dogs 'ad pas gzab pa gal che/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 293

yun ring du gonas par bya ba dang / dam pa'i chos me nub par bya ba dang /sems can thams cad ngan song nas drang ba'i phyir/ sngon gyi las mi bden zer ba dang / 'phral gye rkyen mi bden zer ba dang / 'phags pa'i thugs rje mi bden zer ba dang / u rgyan pad+ma'i gter ma mi bden zer ba dang /changa'i tshos babargyud 'dzin pa la yid 'ches par bya ba'i phyir/ lung du bstan pa gsungs /pa'o/ /de nas pe dkar rgyal pos zhus pa/ sims can nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa la/ /'jig rten las la grub pa'i bde sdug gnyis/ /sngon gyi sgon lam stobs kyis byung tshul gsung par zhu/ /shākya thub pa'i zhing khams sgo mjed /'dir/ /gang la gang 'dul de la de 'dul du/ /'gro don zad pa med par /byed pa yi/ /rgyal srid chos srid ci tsam 'byung / /zhes zhus pas/ u rgyan pad+mas bka' bstsal pa/ /nyon cig pe dkar rgyal po khyod/ /ma 'ongs gdug pa can gyi gling rnams 'byung / /shar ni sha za gdug pa can gyi gling / /zas su mi sha za ba 'byung / /skom du gi khrag/'thung ba 'byung / /las su dmag las byed pa 'byung / /sto ni chom rkun gdug pa can gyi gling / /la rtsub 'phrang rtsub yul yang rtsub/ /rkun jag ar sprang skar tshogs tsam/ /snyegs med khyu yis 'tsho ba 'byung / /nub ni dme ham gdug pa can gyi gling / /de bsgrub pa'i gnas ma yin/ sdig pa rnam smin mi 'dzem dang / byang ni bsam pa rnam par ma dag gdug pa can gyi gling / nya pa dang / bsam pa dang / mgo 'tsho ba dang / shing chu skyes kyi 'dab ma bzhin du 'gul lo1 /dbus su mi skyid gdug pa can gyi gling /dmag stong dang bcas/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / nag po chen po/bgegs dang log 'dren bar du gcod pa thams cad 'byung ngo / /sangs rgyas bstan pa ni nyams/ sems can bde skyid ni zad/ char chu dus su mi 'bab/ sa la skyes tshad skam/ mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / dmag 'khrug mu ge ni 300

1'byung / mi dge mi yis byas pas dus ngan 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyas/sri deza chos srid ji tsam 'byuja / ngas lung bstan pa bzhin du/ sgobs pa gi zad par byed pa/rngoge shes1phung/bo rnam par dag pa/ byams pa chen po dang ldan she/ snying rje 'in po dang ldan pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i bu dag/'du ba/ lha'i bu chen po bzhis kyang phyogs bzhi baspung ba/ rgya mtshor mchis pa'i glu'i rgyal po ma droska ༷pa dang / dga'i bo dang / 'jog po dang / mgi' yas la sogs pa'i klu/bye ke+o/khrag khrig du mas yongs gu srung bar byed pa sa bla'i gnod sbyin dag gis blag pa byed pa/ lus ris mi lus blangs pa/ gu ge pu rangs mang yul du/ rā dza karti sde/btsan zhes bya ba/ lcags pho stag gi lo pa cig 'byub / de ska phun sum tshogs pa sde btsan zhes bya ba cig 'byung / de gnyis kyi ring la sangs (1sa dang byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba byed pa/ yab 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa/sras spyan ras gzegs kyi sprul pa/ 'di ni lung du bstan pa mang du bshad migadagos te/ skyes pa dang / bud med/ khyenyu dang bu mo la sogs pa/ ri dwags dang / gcan gzan/ 'dab chags/ ba glapa / bong bu la sogs pa thamag gcad bda'o/ /rnas 'byor pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / bsam gtan pa dpag tu med pa dang / chos kyi mdzod yongs su 'dzin pa/ sems can thar pa la 'jug pa/ chos kyi ro la spyod pa/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis ma ༷gos pa/ 'di lta bu'i mdzad grol ni/ bshad mi 'tshal gyi gsungs1 rta zhal /shes bya ba nyid du/ sngon dus bram ze'i bu mo tsa mi yis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi khri yi rtsar/ bu chung bskyal te de ni skyes par brtsams/ /bram zes 'di ni khyod kyi snyin no bston/ /ngan song rnam smin bshad na skyi sha zhebyung / /de nas bsam yas /sgra bsgyur gling nyid du/ /mu stegs kyis ni kā ma shī la bkrongs/ /ma 'ongs sdug bsngal gcod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /nam mkha'i ming can 301

bu ba gnyis su 'byung / /gcig ni kā ma shī lar rig par bya/ /des ni nga yi bsten pa spel/ /tshes btsu la ni mchod pa byed/ /gcig ni mu stegs skye ba ste/ /des ni nga yi bstan pa stub/ /gter chos log par lta brgyad sgom/ /zang long zing long tsab tsub 'gings/ /phag ri mkha' zhes bu ba nyid du/ dge slong ko ga li zhes bya ba/ rwaskye ba brgya'i mtha' nga'i chos kyis bstan pa/'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa/ bsam gtan pho mo lnga brgyas bskor ba/ 'khrul zhig chen po zhes bya ba 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs so/ /'di 'dra'i dus su skye ba snyam/bsod nams ma bsags zer zhing yi mug 'byung / /pu rangs mi bde 'jigs pa brgyad rnams dang / /gu ge khrims ma zin pas bgegs rnams ldang / /zhang zhung pa rnams log pa'i lam la zhugs/ /g.yo khrum mgo skor yid mi 'ches pa 'byung / /btsun mo bka'i thang yig stod mnga' ri skor gsum rgyal po gang /lo gang gi lo/ lo gang la brtsi1 mtshan ji skad zer/ skye ba gang blangs/potsun mo sras dang bcas ba/ 'dus pa ji tsam 'byung zhus pas/ u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' bstsal pa/ yum chen btsun mos phyi rabs bod la dgongs/ /bu tshal gser gyi lha khang 'dra pa bzhengs/ /u rgyan bdag la zhus pa shin tu legs/ 1le'u nyer gnyis pa'o// //btsun mo bka'i thang yig rjogs so/ /skal ldan las 'phro can dwa 'phrad par shog pha mā ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gter rgya/ sngas rgya/ gsang rgya/ gab /rgya/ gtad rgya/ khams gsum zangs khang gling nas sprul sku u rgyan gling pas spyan 1 drangs pa'o/ / //3 303

'go brjod/ra (nya0gleṣā sha/ u rgyan gyi skad du/ mduk+kasgargaṭarga༈/ bal po'i /skad du/ nyikhruṭaṇaḍarganyacag ṇa/rgya gar skad du/ sha ma na ni kun ni re su khaṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ gargathagarbaju nu/ lo paṇa bka'i thang yig ces bya ba/ston pa gnas dang dus dang 'khor dang chos/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga la phyag )'ashā la lo/ /zhu ba po gsum gyi zhu don nyi shu pa/rta lo stag gi zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin/ /u rgyan chen po/pad+ma 'byupa gnas nyid/ /bsam yas yo 'bog lcang ma'i khri la bzhugs/ /g.yas gral rgya gar paṇa chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ /g.yon gral bod kyi lo tsā brgya rtsa brgyad/ /mdun bal/rgyal blon btsun mo 'khor bcas bzhugs/ /rgya gar rgyal po sna tshogs bha ra te/ /bza' btung mang po g.yos pa cher bshams nas/ /phyi dang sanang dang gsang ba'i 'dod yon lnga/ /so sdo rang rang chos lugs mthun par drangs/ /sa steng dkon pa'i nor sna khyad 'phags phul/ /rardo brgya 'bul stong 'bul mang po byas/ /zhu ba po ni bod kyi lo tsās zhus/ /gus pa'i phyag 'tshal gzugs rnam dma' sar 'dug /snyan ngag sku yi che brjod 'di skad shasol/ma /'dren pa'i skyes bu ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs/ /dri med mdangs /maldan dasheg tshad 'bum phrag gcig /rlum la 'khyil ba sngo la dwangs pa'i mtsho/ /1chu bo yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa la/ /me tog u duspu ra rigs lnga skyes/ /30du

nyi ma'i 'od kyis rgya mtsho'i gting du 'gro /rgya mtsho chen po byin dang ldan par byed/ /mtshan mo rgya mtsho'i gting nas kha ru thon/ /ri klung med pa 'od kyes sdang bar byed/ /pad+ma'i sdong po pang gis mi khyud pa/ /lo skor re na gsar rnying brjes nas skyes/ /me tog tshad ni shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam/ /dpag tshad gcig dang khor yug khya be pa yi/ /me tog dmar po bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs/ / rang bzhin gtsang bas cho ga'i rig byed med/ 1rnam dag dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+mar skyes/ /bla ma chen po gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /thun mong mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje lta bu'i sku/ khyad par mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /gzhon nu btsas 'dra sku la bgres rgud med/ /bla med mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /tshangs pa'i gsung ni tshos kyi sgra ru sgog /zag bcas ma—ོna par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /yang dag don gyi dgongs pa'i gdams pa ston/ /zag med mngon par shes pa lnga nams gsungs/ /sbyor brgyad gnas su stobs pas mkha' 'gro'i dpon/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /sgol bcu tshad du phyin pas lha 'dre 'khol/ /'das pa'i mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun phyug pas dbul phongs skyong / /ma 'ongs mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /mi brjed gzudas thob sangs rgyas gsung gleng sgog da lta'i mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan 'gro kun 'dul/ /ma nges mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga ma rmongs thams cad mkhyen/ /bden gnyis mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /thege pa phyogs med lta spyod zung du 'jug /ma yengatho mngon par shes pa lnga rnams gsungs/ /mngon par shes pa drug cu gsung ba nyid/ /lo paṇa bka' yi thang yig gsung bar zhu/ /zhes zhus so/ /rgya gar rgyal po sna 306

tshogs bha ra has/ /chos kyi rgyal bo khri srong lde'u btsan la/ /gus pa'i phyag 'tshal gzugs dem dma' sar 'dug /bod kyi rgyal po'i che brjod 'di skad lo/ /e ma ho/ chos kyi rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan/ /thugs bskyed dag pa'i mnga' thang bka' drin las/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bod du dar bar mdzad/ /mkhan chen sde lnga spyan drangs mi dge bsdams/ /so so thar pa bdun brgyad lam la bkod/ /sad mi mi bdun bod kyes che ba bskyed/ /lta ba dbu ma spyod pa yod smra'i sde/ /nag chos bzhi spangs bsdu ba rnam bzhi bsdus/ /bstan pa'i gzhi bzhag dge 'dun sde mang btsugs/ /sems can bde byed gsang sngags bla med yin/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob dpon pad+ma 'byung / /sum stong lon nas bod yul dbus su byon/ /brgya dang bcu gcig bod yul dbus su bzhugs/ /lha 'dre btul nas sku rten bsam yas bzhengs/ /lo paṇa chen po brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis/ /mdo sngags bstan bcos mang po bod du bsgyur//thub bstan 'chad gra sgrub brgyud bstan pa btsugs/ /yon tan can gyis sa yi steng rnams bkang / /'phrin las sangs rgyas bstan zhabs garter gyis skyong / /rgyal ba'i dgongs brgyud ma chad pa/ /rigs 'dzin brda brgyud ma chad pa/ /mkha' 'gro gtad brgyud ma chad pa/ /lung bsnyan smon brgyud ma chad pa/ /grub thob snyan brgyud ma chad pa/ /gang zag chig brgyud ma chad pa/ /lo paṇa bka' yi thang yig zhu/ /zhes zhus so1 /chosam /rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan gyis/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gus pa'i phyag btsal gser bye phyag tu phul/ /e ma ho/ /sgod bcud sku gsum zhing khams gsung bar zhu/ /dus gsum thonges rgyas byon tshul gsung bar zhu/ /theg pa rim pa ji ltar gsung bar zhu/ /theg pa'i shan 'byed gsung tshul gsung bar zhu/ /bkol mdo drug gis rang rang nyams su len/ /bka' dang bstan bcos dbye ba bstan pa dang /ṣe307

mdo dang rgyud kyi dbye ba bstan pa dang / /rgyud sde tha dad ngos 'dzin bston pa nang / /rgyud sde phyi nang khyad par gsung bar zhu/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dar nub bstan pa dang / /mdor bsdus gzhi lam 'bras bu gathung bar zhu1 /sems kyi ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dang / /mtshan nyid gzhi lam lta sgom spyod 'bras gang / /'khor 'das rtsa ba gang lags mdo gar sdud/ /'gag ni gar sdom gnad ni gang du bsre/ /phu thag gar gcod 'gro sa gang du gtong / /mtha' ni gar thug thob bya gang yin lags/ /sems dang ye shes khyad par gang gis dbye/ /sangs rgyas thugs rje'i byung tshul ji ltar lagasardo /tshig nyung go bde don 'dril gsal ba zhig /sprul sku pad 'byung khyed kyis gsung bar zhu/ /zhes gus phyag dgu sprugs su btsal nas zhus so/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las zhu ba po gsum gyis zhus pa zhu don nyi shu pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //phye snod 'jig rten chags tshul bstan pa/u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' bstsal pa/ /nyon cig gson cig ༷lo paṇa rje 'bangs rnams/ /bka' 'dus rtsa ba'i rgyud las su/ /nyan pa'i ༷'khor rnams dma' ba'i sa la 'dug /zhwa thod skra lo la sogs mdun du phab//mig gi dbang pos chos spu'i zhal la blta/ /rna ba'i dbang pos ma yengs gsung sal nyan/ /yid kyi dbang pos tshig bzung don la 'chang / /zhes gsungs pas/—bslab bya de ltar ldan par bya 'tshal lo/ 1dang po skos sku'i zhing khams bston ༷pa ni/ /brjod med bsam 'das mkha' dbyings rnam par dag /ma bcos sgos med shes rab dbyings su grol/ /dbyer med lhun rdzogs snying po ka nas dag /kun bzang dgongs pa chos sku'i zhing khams yin/ /dper na nam mkha' mtha' 308

dbus med pa bzhin/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams bstan pa ni/ /nam4mkha' mtha' dbus med pa'i klong yangs su/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdul phran nyid kyis paskor/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'og ma ni/ /gzhi nyid kun la khyab pa zhes bya ste/ /rin cen 'od 'phro 'bar ba khyab gdage cing / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor kun gyi gong ma ni/ /gzi brjid dpal gyi snyiparngoXpos khyab par gdal/ /de yi steng na rgya mtsho gnas pa yin/ /ming ni nor bu snang yas rgya mtsho zhes/ /de las pad+ma'i sdong po chen po 'khrungs/ /ming ni sgos kyi rgyal po 'od zer laṭa/ /yal ga rin chen sna tshogs zhes bya 'byung / /de la me tog pad+ma sna tshogs skyes/ /me tog re re'i steng na rgya mtsho chags/ /rgya mtsho'i steng na 'dzig rten rdul snyed grub/ 1yar bltas mar bltas rgya dar brtsegs pa 'dra//phan tshun blta ga/na za 'og gur khyim/'dra/ /longs sku'i zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab las/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan pa 'di/ /rnam snang gangs dun mtsho yi zhing khams yin/ /de 6)/ba spu'i khung rer sprul sku'i zhing / /'od zer1phyogs bcur nyi ma'i zer ltar 'phro/ /'od zer re re'i rtse la sprul sku'i zhing / /zhing khams 'di nyid mnyam gzhag phyag gi mthil/ /lhung bzed spyo khyon dpag tu med pa'i nang / /sgos chu'i rgya mtsho ze ba kun 'byung ba/ /'od zer/mtha' yas zhes bya'i steng na ni/ /nor bu'i rgyal po byang chub shing chen skyes/ /rgyas ba'i rgyan/zhes bya ba'i pad+mo byung / / /phyogs/bcu brjod du med pa'i zhing khams bkod/ 1dper na me tog hanalo'i sdong bo 'dro/ /me tog gcig gi ze'u 'bru gcig la yang / /zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga chags pa yi/ / bcu gsum pa de mi mjederdo jig rten 'di/ /sprul sku shākya thub pa'i 'dul shing yin1 /zhing khams 'di nyid ji ltar chags rtel ni/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di byung pa yang / /rgyu rkyen dpag tu med pa las grub ste/ /sangs rgyas mthu dang sems 30shu

bcan las dang ni/ /'byung lnga 'dus pa'i rkyen las grub pa yin/ /mkha' la rlugi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi/ /rgyun mi chad par byung bas rgyu byed de/ /yongs su 'dzin pas chu phung 'dzin par byed/ /yongs su gzhol bas gzhal med khang rnams ni/ /rnam par dgod pas stong gsum 'jig rten gyi/ /sems can kun gyi las rnams 'byed par byed/ /gzhan yang rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhi/ /brtan dang gnas dang mi nyams sring por ldan/ /chu yi phung po 'dzin cing rtag par byed/ /sa ni de la gnas shing mi 'jig go /phyogs bcu kun 'dus rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /mkha' la mtho 'khor mtho 'khor bye ba chags/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor de dag re re la/ /rngams su sa ya re dang thad ka ru/ /'bum phrag drug ste mtha' skor grangs med do /de steng chu yi dkyil 'khor byung ba ni/ rdogacig tu byeg cing tha mi dad pa yi/ /sprin las char pa'i rgyun chen 'bab ༷pa ni/ /stong gsum grub pa'i rlung gi dkyil khor las/ /sa gzhan phyogs kyis zin par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sprin chen char pa lnga 'bab ste/ /rab tu zhi ༷bar byed pa'i sprin chen char/ /me yi phung po rab tu zhi bar byed/ /'byung ba byed pa zhes bya'i sprin chen char/ /de las chu yi phung po de dag byung / /yongs bsu spyod pa zhes bya'i sprin chen char/ /chu yi phung po de dag yongs su spyod/ /yongs su grub tha zhes bya'i sprin chen char/ /nor bu rin chen mang po grub par ༷byed/ /rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya'i sprin chen char/ /stong gsum stong chen ༷'jig rten khams rnams 'byed/ /sprin pa gser gyi snying po can las ni/ /chu ni shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam du 'bab/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor bye ba chags pa'i rngams//—'bum phrag bcu gcig stong phrag gcig tu'o/ /zheng du 'angum phrag bcu gnyis stong gsum pa/ /phyed dang lnga brgya mtha' skor grangs sked do/ /bar mtshaca sa rlung gis bcad pas mi 'dre'o/ /de steng gser gyi sa gzhi'i tshul du ni/ /rlung 310

gi dkyil 'khor rab tu gnas pa yi/ 1sa ni chen po kun nas gnas par gyed/ /sprin pa'i rgya mtsho rlung gis bskyod pa yis/ /chu rlung dros pas rba 'tshub rab tu 'khrug dper na mar 'dod 'o ma dkrogs pa bzhin/ /ldeg sdeg 'ur 'ur bar bskal phyed du g.yos/ /sbu ba byung bas rgya mtsho'i steng rnama'i che+od/ /'byung ba ther spungs spu ba 'khyoms pa las/ /srid pa'i sa rdo ri brarge thams cad grub/de nyid rang bzhin drod du 'bar ba las/ /bar bskal phyed du 'byung ba dwangs snyigs 'byed/ /lcags thab mgar ba'i zhun chen bzhu ba ltar/ /rin cen rdo las gser gyi sa gzhi chags/ /rngams su sum 'bum nyi khri zheng du yang / /'bum phrag bcu gnyis stong phrag bcu dang ni/ /byed dang lnga brgya mtha' skor grangs med do/ /sde rab ri bdun khor yug grub tshul ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor khyad par 'phags pa yis/ /ri yi rgyal po ri rab dgod par byed/ /rlung gi rgyal sapo brtan pa zhes bya bas/ /rin po che yi ri rnams dgod par byed/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gcig stug tha mi dad/ khor yug khor yug chen po'i ri rnams 'jog mkha' la sna tshogs snying po can gyi sprin/ /'dus pa'i char rgyun gser gyi sa gzhi khengs/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor bye ba chags pa ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dkrug byed 'khrig byed dang / /'khrug byed 'thug byed rnams kyis dkruṭa la las1 /dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du ni/ ri rab rin cen rnam pa bzhi las grub/ /shar phyogs shel la sto phyogs be+e ḍūle/ nub phyogs pad+ma rā ga byang phyogs gser/ /ri bo khri phrag drug cus rnam par mdzes/ /de phyir gnya' shing 'dzin dang gshol mda' 'dzin/ /seng sdeng can dang lta na sdug ri dang / /rta rna dang ni rnam/'dud mu khyud/'dzin/ /de dag gser gyi ri bdun khor yug lcags/ /gling dang gling bran bcas pa'i sa yin no/ /lhun po ri bdun gling dang khor yug bcas/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong mtshor nub 311

yohem/ /brgyad khre bzhi p+tong ltun po steng du 'phags/ /snyun lo/dang ni ri bdun ngim pa bzhin/ /'phangs dang zheng du gyed phyed dbri ba yin/ /de dag bar bar rol ba'i mtsho bdun te/ /rol mtsho dang por thad ka brgyad khri dang //ngos la sum 'gyur nang gi mtsho chen yin/ /rol mtsho gzhan rnams gyed phyed dbri ba'o/ /de rnams yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu/ /gtsang dang dwangs dang bsil ba 'jam pa dang / /bsung dang zhim dang ngoms dang bde ba'o/ /mu khyud 'dzin dang khor yug bar na gling / /de dag bar na spyi mtsho ba tshwa can//thad kar 'bum phrag gsum dang khri tsho gnyis/ /lus 'phags po ni zla gam ngos gsum pa/ /dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis gnyis yod pas te/ /ngos gcig dpag tshad phyed dang ba zhi brgya'o/ /lus ni shar gnas lus 'phags nub na gnas/ /sgra mi snyan ni gru bzhir gnas pa ste/ /logs re la ni nyis stong nyis stong yod/ /sgra mi snyan ni shar gnas zla ni nub/ /ba glang spyod ni blum po mtha' skor du/ /bdun stong lnga brgya thad kar byed dang gsum/ /g.yo ldan shar gnas lam mchog 'gro ni nub/ /'dzam gling ngos gsum stong phrag gnyis gnyis te/ /sto phyogs phyed dang bzhi brgya shing rta'i dbyibs/ /rnga yab shar gnas rnga yab gzhan ni nub/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag cing 'od gsal bas//gzugs la lta ba spyod pa'i gzhal yas bkod/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag cing 'od gsal bas/ /rgyan bzang 'dod yon lnga la spyod pa yi/ lha bu rnams kyi gzhal med khang rnams dgod/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las bye sdod chags tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //gzugs med rnam bzhi bshad pa/khams gsum sems can grub tshul ni/ /rgyu ni sems nyid thog med la//312

rgya chad phyogs lhung ma mchis kyang / /de nyid ma 'gags ngol pa las/ /ngo bo sto nga pa'i rang pazhin gsal/ /rnam pa 'gag med cir yang 'char/ /de shād rang gis rang ma rig /kun gye sgog rlung dang bcas pas/ khams gsum skye ba spyor bar byed/ /dang po gzugs med rgyu rkyen dang / /ngo bo ngegoshe tshig dbye rgyas tshe/ /rgyu ni dug gsum mngon gyur spangs/ /phra ba bag la nyal du yod/ /rkyen ni 'du byed rnam shes kyis/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas la sogs bzhi/ /yul du byas na der skye ba/ /gzugs med ces bya yid lus so/ /ngo bo rnam shes 'di nyid du/ /nyes dmigs zhi ba'i nga rgyal tsam/ /nges tshig khams rgasum dngos ma grub/ /gzugs med pas na gzugs med khams/ /dbye na skye mched mu bzhi'o/ /bsam gtan baji pa la brten nas/ /gzugs ni rags bcas ma zhi bar/ /mthong bas gzugs kyi 'du shes te/ /dga' phyir mkha' ltar dmigs 3/ gang / /nam mkha' mtha' yas zhes bya ste/ /rnam par shes dang 'du byed kyi/ khyad par la brten de spob bo/ /dang po/gzugs skra reg bya tshos/ /nyer bsdogs yin te gzhan ma gsum/ /chos la dmigs pa kho na skye/ /rnam shes mtha' yas nyid sgom pa/ /gong ma las kyang zhi bar 'dod/ /rnam shes nyid kyang reg mthong nas/ /rtog de bshig pas ci yang med/ /yul la mtshan mar 'dzin pa yi/ /ci yang mi rtog yin mthong nas/ /re zhig yod min med min ste/ /brtan pa'i rnam par shes pa dang / /nyon mongs can yid gnas pa nyid/ /kang gang goms pa la brten nas/ /gang du shi ba der de thob/der ni bskal pa nyi khri dang / /bzhi khri drug khri brgyad khri rnasas/ /tshe gi tshad do 'di dag rnams/ /'dod gzugs 'das pa bzhi yin kyang / /shes rab bral na 'og tu lhung / /de bas mkhas pa bsam gtan pa/ khams gsum la sred tsu+o/zhig byed/ /theg mchog thob pa'i snying rje can/ /'di dag steng 'dzen 3/3

thob nas kyang / /ro myang ma yin der mi skye/ /'dod dang gzugs kyi chags bral yang / /bsams bzhin gzhan la phan par byed/ /gang gi sems kyi dri ma dang / /'du byed las dang nyon mongs rnams/ ma rtogs dge dang mi dge bar/ /thog med dus nas rjes zhugs pas/ /zo chu bzhin du khams gasrum 'khor/ /de mthong khams gsum srid bde la/ /ma zhen zhen par gyur rnams la/ /tshad med rnam bzhi bskyed par bya/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las gzuṭa med rnam bzhi bshad pa'i lenyu ste gsum pa'o// //gzugs khams bshad pa/ba/zugs khams rgyu rkyen ngo/bo dang / /nges tshig dbye ba gzugs dang tshe//rgyu ni dug gsum rags pa dang / /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa kun/ rkyen ni bsam gtan nyer bsdogs dang / /bsam gtan bzhi rten gang skye ba/ /gzugs khams yin te 'dod sred ni/ /rags pa bcom pas rdzus skyes so/ /ngo bo 'dod khams 'dod chags bral/ /yul la 'dzin chung zhi bar gnas/ /nges tshig gzugs kyi 'dod ma bral/ /gzugs khams zhes su btags pa yin/ /dbye na rnam gnyis 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten las bral rnam pa can/ /de yang bsam gtan nyer bsdogs las/ /byung ba gnas gzhan bcu gnyis te/ /tshangs ris tshangs pa mdun na 'don/ /tshangs chen 'od chung tshad med 'od/ /'od gsal dge chung tshad med dge /dge rgyas sprin med bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che ste gzhan ma lnga/ /mi che mi gdung gya nom snang / /shin tu mthong dang 'og min pa/ /de rnams 'phags pa'i lha gnas yin/ /gad gi bsam gtan dang po ni/ sgom byed sbyin dang tshul khrims la/ /sngar ltar dag pa la spyod 31

pas/ /de tshe 'dod pa'i bde ba rnams/ /chags zhen sred pa'i rgyur mthong nas/ /de spong byed dang bsam gtan la/ /sred cing len pas mtshams sbyar te1 1tshangs ris nyid skye de bas kyang / /mi stogs mi sgom gnyis pa ste/ /de dag byas dang 'brel bsgoms pas/ /tshangs chen dag tu de dag skyes/ /gang tshe skye ba de yi tshe/ /kun rdzob goms dang bcas pa nyid/ /gnyid dang nyin mtshan pho mo med/ /bsam gtan zas mchog dag dang ldan/ /rang rang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa ste/ /'dod khams snying rje'i gnas su mthong / /tshul 'di rnams ni bcu drug 'gyur/ /gong ma gong ma 'phags zhes bya/ /de rnams mchog ni mi mjed kyi/ /bdag po tshangs pa zhes grags te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la/ /dam chos bskul 'di 'phags pa yin/ /gzhan dag log lta'i zhing gyur par/ /blo nyams rnams kyis smra bar byed/ /de ltar bsam gtan dang po la/ /grub pa gsum yin de las gzhan/ /gnyis pa rtog sked skom pa la/ /'od chung du skye sngar bas lhag /de nyid ma spyogs 'di pasgoms pas/ /tshad med 'od de de las gzhan/ /phul du byung ba 'od gsal yin/ /shin tu dga' dang bde ba yin/ 1lus sems tshim byed bla na med/ /de nas dga' bde dang bral zhing / /dran rig g.yo ba rlung rgyu+o/ba/ /tsam ldan bsam gtan gsum pa yin/ /bsgoms pas dge chung du skye la1 /brtan byas tshad med dge yin te//shin tu brtan nas dge rgyas zhes/ /dge ba gang bsam 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang bsam gtan bzhi pa ni/ /g.yo med ces bya de bsgoms pas/ /sprin med ces bya der skye ste/ /de goms bsod nams skyes su skye/ /mthar thug gyur pas 'bras bu che/ /de rnams rab tu zhi ba'i lha/ khyad par 'phags pa bshad pa yin/ /der ni zag bcas mthus skyes phyir/ /re zhig nyon mongs zhi gnas mang / /yun ring lon kyang tshul min gyi/ /yid kyi byed las nyon mongs 315

ldang / /de bas don rab 'byed pa yi/ /shes rab kyis bzung bstan pa ni/ /'phags pa'i lam 'brel bsgom par bya/ 1de gnyis khyad par bshad bya ba/ /snga ma chos kun ma brtags kyang / /sems gnas khyad par las byung ngo / /phyi ma chos kun rten 'brel gyi/ /tshul khrims sems dang sems byung gi /rnam pa rgyu dang 'bras mthong nas/ /rtog dpyod gnyen po brtan po yis/ /de la brtson byas rtse gcig pas/ /dga' bde'i 'bras bu rab tu skye/ /de ni bsam gtan dang po yin/ gartog daphyod dang bral rtse gcig pa/ /nang du rab tu dang ba yis/ /dga' bde ldan pa gnyis pa yin/ /rtog dpyod bde sdug dang bral zhing / /dran dang shes bzhin ldan rtse gcig bsam gtan gsum pa zhes byar ༷bshad/ /rtog dpyod bde dang sdug bsngal dang / /yid bde mi bde dwabugs dbyung rngub/ /skyon brgyad bral zhing mi g.yo ba/ /btang stoms dran pa dag pa ni/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa zhes bya'o/ /tshul khrims dang ni 'di 'brel bsno /'phags pa'i bsam gtan zhes brjod do/ /nyon mongs bcas la dga' bde chadang / /rab tu shes bzhin dran pa dang / /btang stoms dran pa bdag med de/ /nyon mongs dben pa min phyir dang / /nyon mongs rtog pa med phyir dang / /nyon mongs can de dran shes med/ /dran bdag med de dri bcas kyis/ /'di dag rtogs pa'i bsam gtan yin/ /'di yis bsam gtan bzhi pa la/ /'du shes bkag nas de tsam gyi/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs byed pa1 /'du shes med ba'i lha zhes bya/ /grong las dgon pa'i tshul du skye/ /de ni phyir zhing log lta yis/ /mtshams sbyar mnar med lhung byed pas/ /mi khom gnas yin tshe ring lha/ 1de phyir tshul ldan bsam gtan pa/ /shes rab rnam par sbyang bar bgye/ /mi che la sogs lha rnams ni/ /bsam gartan shes rab dang 'brel pas/ /nyon mongs che min de mi gdung / /nyon mongs brel ba'i yon rtan ni/ 1316

ma ral skyon med bsrungs pa dang / /dgra brtsom pho mo bsam gtan pa/ mchod byas srog sbyin stong phrag gis/ /mig stong ldan pa skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni lha yi dbang phyug ste/ /bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu yi / /lha mo mdzes ma rnams kyis mchod 1 /de rnams mchog gi bde sogs te/ /de sogs lha yi rin cen //mas/ /bla na med par dbang byed sten/ /lhun po'i rtse la brgyad khri ste/ 1sa/lta na sdug dbus tshos bzang gnas/ /dpag tshad lnga brgya rin cen gye/ gi nga bzhin skyed tshal bzhi dang ldan/ /bud med dga' tshal kun dga'i tshal/ dpe med tharmas cad 'byor pa'i gzhi / /de sogs nye ba'i tshal dang bcas/ /gnas rigs sum cur skye ba'i rgyu/ /grog gcod ma byin len spangs dang / /sprin dang gus pa bskyed pa yin/ /shar phyogs shing rta sna tshogs te/ /lho nub༄rtsub 'gyur 'dres tshal dang / /byang na grong khyer dga' bas bgyen/ /yongs 'du byang shar mtshams na gnas/ /gzhan rnams phyogs kun bskor bar gnas// phyogs mtshams brtsegs ma bzhi la ni/ /lag na rdo rje 'chang ba gnas/ khyad par sum cwa rtsa gsum na/ /bag med myos dang lha min gyi/ /gnod pa bzlog pa'i rnga bo che/ /gzugs med chos sgu 'byin ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las khyad par yin/ /tshe ni mi lo brgya phrag gcig /zhag yin der skye rang lo stong / /mi lo bye ba phrag gsum dang / sa ya drug tu brjod pa yin/ /de ltar ri rab steng gi cha/ /brgya byin dbang byed gnas su gsungs/ /de nas gzhan yang 'thab bral bye/ /gnas dang rgyu 'bras bshad par bya/ /de rnams mnga' bdag rgyal po ni/ /mu su lurnyi zhes bya ste/ /tshul khrims rnam bdun skyon med par/ /lhag pa'i sbyin la brtsen pas 'grub/ /brgya byin las ni brgya phrag dag du mas 'phags pa'i las las byung / /'od dang gzi brjid gzugs brtson 'grus/ /bde dang spro ba lhag pa yin/ /der gnas lha rnams thams cad kyang // 319

sgog gcod ma byen len speng ba1 /snga ma byin te khyad par du/ /'dod los ldong ba'i tshul khrims ni/ /rnam par dag pa'i rgyu las byung / /gnas de khyad bu ra 'phags pas te/ /ri rab las ni 'bum phrag khri/ /brgya stong steng gi nakyi/ mkha' la/ /rlung gis sprirge phung bteg ltar gnas/ /de la gnas ris ti shā bdun/ /rtsa gasrum gnas las bcu drug 'gyur/ khyad par mul du gyur pa yin/ /de na 'gro la phan gzigs pa/ /rnam par gzigs dang gtsug tor can/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub dang / /'od spungs zhes bya rgyal ba yi/ /mchod rten rin cen las byas yod/ /de la lha rnams phan byed pa'i/ /mdo rnams rin cen gyis bris pa/ /lha dbang de yis ston par byed/ /mi lo nyis brgya zhag gcig ste/ /de bgrangs rang lo nyis stong yin/ /bye ba bcu bzhi sa ya bzhi/ /mi rnams lo grangs yino par 'dod/ /de ni mtshe ma zhes ༷bya ba'i/ /lha yi gnas gzhan yin par brjod/ /de las gzhan yang dga' ldan gyi/ /phyogs mtshams rab tu dbye bar byed/ /snga ma'i gnas gzhan ji snyed pa/ /de steng byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /'gro ba kun la phan mdzad pa//sabyams pa bdag nyid chen po bzhugs/ /der gnas lha ni rnam gnyis te/ /'phags pa dang ni phal pa'o/ /phal pa de rnams sngon /)salas/ khrims lnga ldan par dag pa ni/ /bla na med pa bsrung ba dang / /drag po'i lha ldan chags rnams dang / /pha ma nad pa dbul po la/ /snga ma rnams las lhag pa dang / /sbyor dngos rjes gsum dag par sbyin/ 1der skyes tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /lus dang gzi brjed 'od dang ni/ /spro ba snga ma 'thab bral las/ khyad par du mas 'phags par 'gyur/ /mi rnams lo ni bzhi brgya la/ /zhag yin de bgrangs rang lo ni/ /stong phrag bzhi yin mi yi lo/ /bye ba lnga bcu rtsa bdugo dang / /sa ya drug gi tshad duga'adod/ /de nas gzhan yang 'phru'/ dga' ni/ /320

ra'i di 'phrul ba'i bde ba la/ /spyod byed gnas der skye ba yin/ /rgyu ni tshul khrims dag pa ste/ /sbyin sogs dge ba de dka kun/ /snga ma las ni phul byung bas/ /gang gi 'aspyal dka'i bdag po/ni / /de dag kudi phul byung ba yi/ /bsod nams mthu yis thob pa yin/ /mus dang 'od dang stobs rnams kun/ / brgya byin 'bum pas lhag pa yin/ /gnas der longs spyod dpag med kyang / / rang gi yid kyis kang sprul ba/ /de dang de 'drar dbang byed 'gyur/ /lha noms dpag med gyur pa la/ /'phru'/ dga'i bdag pos zlog par byed/ /'dir ni mi lo brgyad brgya la1 /zhag yin de bgrangs rang lo ni/ /stong phug brgyad yin mi lo'i grangs/ /bye ba nyis brgya sum cu dang / /sa ya phrag bzhir nges pa yin/ /de las gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi/ /phyogs tsam mdor bsdus brjod par bya/ /der skye'i rgyu be+e tshule khrims bdun/ /ma ral skyon med baspungs pas na/ /mi lem na yang mi nyamase so/ /de bzhin rnam dag sbyin pa ni / yul lnga mchog tu gyurnga ba la/ /rgug byas sbyor dardos rjes gsum ldan/ /'on kyang de ni rigs gnyis te/ /padud rigs gtogs dang gzhan ma'o/ /de yang phal pa 'phags rigs gnyis/ /dang po sngon gyi log lta dang / /'brel pa'i sgon lam gyis 'byung ste/ /mtshod sbyin gyis bsgrubs 'bras bu yin/ /log ltas mnar med khrid pas na/ /de bas rgyu 'bras so sor 'byung / /gzhan dag yang dag lta dang ldan/ /log lta ring du spangs pa yin/ /gnabo 'de 'dod pa'i lha mo rnams/ 1kun gyi gnas las khyad 'phags te/ /gzhan gye 'phrul las dbang byed phyir1 /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi/ /'dod lnga yul la dbang byed yin/ /gnas 'di'i srid par skye byed na/ 1su zhig mya ngan 'dang bar nus/ de phyir dbang skyur bdud kyi yul/ /'dod khams kun las phul byung yin/ /gang che bag med la brten nas/ /sred dang phyos dang 'thab pa dang / /yid 321

'khrugs gyur pa smos ci dgos/ /der ni bdud kyi pho nya bzhe/ /de rnams dbang sgyur mi dge spyod/ /'bras bu sngon chad ngan 'gror lhung / /de rnams/bdud kyi lha zhes brjod/ /de ltar snang ba'i longs spyod kyang / /ji ltar shes dang bag yod cing / /'dod khams dbang sgyur do rgyal dad / /zlom pas sgrib par mi 'gyur bar/ /bag chags bsam gtan sbyod pa gang / /'dod pa'i las la 'da' bas na/ /bdud dbang ma gyur lha zhes bya/ /de phyir bstan la zhugs pa rnams/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims dag pa la/ /spyad cing ma chags spyod pa dang / /rang gi don tsam mi sems par/ /bzod dang brtson 'grus rab ldan pas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bsam gtan gnas la 'dun /par bya/ /'dir ni mi lo stong drug brgya/ /zhag yin de bgrangs rang lo ni/ /)khri dang drug stong thub par gsungs/ /mi ltar brtsis na bye ba ni/ /dgu brgya/ nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /sa ya drug ste 'di dag/rnams/ /kun la dus min 'chi ba yod/ /de ltar 'dod lha rigs drug gi/ /nyin mtshan1me tog 'byed 'dzum dang / /gnyid dang bya skad 'byin mi 'byin/ 1yin te mun pa yod ma ༷yin/ /lus tshad rgyang grags bzhi cha nas/ /phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du yin/ /samador na 'dod pa'i khams 'di na/ /srog gcod spangs pas tshe ring la/ /pazod byas gzugs mchog phun sum tshogs/ /ma byen len spangs bdag nyid kyi/ /longs spyod bsrung ba'i mchog yin no/ /gzhan gnod 'dod spyod rab spangs pas/ /mtshungs med khyim bdag lha mo ldan/ /rdzun spangs bden pa thob 'gyur te/ /phra ma spangs pas mi brjed thob/ /dag 'khyal spangs pas ngag btsun 'gyur/ /tshig rtsub spangs pas snyan smra la/ /sgog byen gzhan gyes 'tshe ba med/ /nor byin longs spyod du ma 'byung / /sman byen nad med 'thob pa yin/ /bza' btung byin pas bkres skom med/ /bzhon pa rta byin de nyid 322

dang / /dal ba med dang mgyogs par ldan/ /sil snyan byin pas sgra snyan te/ /sgon me byen pas 'od thob 'gyur/ /rgyan dang me tog phreng mdzes byin/ /de nyid dang ni mdzes pa 'thob/ /gru zam byen pas bde legs 'gro/ 1ngal stegs byas pas ngal med 'gyur/ khang pa byin pas rin cen gyis/ /brgyan pa'i khang bzang thob 'gyur zhing / /skyed tshal lam gzhi byin pa las/ /thams cad sa yi bdag por 'gyur/ /bran dang 'khor byen de nyid dang / /gang byen pa yi 'bras bur ldan/ /de phyir bde ba 'dod gang dag 1bsgrims1te rgyu 'bras brtag pang bya/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las snod bcud 'dod lha riṭa drug bstan pa'i zha'u ste lnga pa'o// // / lha /men gyi rgyu 'gis ba gad pa/ lha min skye ba'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo dang / /nges tshig dbye rgyas gzugs tshe'i/ tshad/ /rgyu rkyen smon lam ma dag pas/ /ngo bo phrag dog sems ma zhi/ /nges tshig lha min lha la 'gran/ /dbye na rigs pa nyis yi dwags kyi/ / khongs gtogs bdud rigs rdzu 'phrul can/ /dud 'gro'i 'gro bar gtogs pa yin/ /rgyas par bshad na rnam bzhi ste/ /rgya mtshor nub pa'i ri rab ni/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong la gnas pa/ /snang ldan zla breng gnas bzang po/ /mi g.yo zhes dang rnam pa bzhi/ /kun kyang khri phrag gnyis dang stong / /rim bzhin gnas te darje po'o/ /sgra gcan gnas pa'i grong khyer ni/ /dpag tshad brgyad stong rang bzhin grub/ /rang bzhin longs spyod sna tshogs ldan/ /phyogs bzhir rtsedwa mo can tshal dang / /rgyags pa ngang pa khu byug can/ /thams cad dpag tshad brgya pa'o/ /sna tshogs ljon pa lteng ka dang / /me tog sna tshogs 'bab chus 323

ngargunabhe /bya dang bung ba du mas gang / /de na sgra gcan chung mar bcas/ 1khub/ khrig bcu gnyes bcas pa yod/ /de ni sngon tshe bram zer gyur/ /sbyin la ngartsen shing reg byed mkhas/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten me shor ba/ /mthong nas shing rta stong phrag bzhis/ /chu bskyas mchod rten ma chig byas/ /dad pa med kyang 'di skad smras/ /'di la bsod nams yod grang na/ /'dod khams bdag po mchog tu shog /de brjod lha min dbang por gyur1 /de 'khor skye ba'i lha min rnams/ /grags pa 'dod na rgyal po'i bka'/ /rang rigs baspung phyir ri dāgs nya/ /de sogs sems can srung byed cing / /sbyin byas mi dge gzhan spyod pa/ /las des der skyes sna tshogs lus/ /'dres ma'i bde myong nga rgyal can/ /mi lo lnga brgya zhag gcig ste/ /de bgrangs rang lo lnga stong yin/ /bar ma ngor ni 'chi ba yod/ /de ltar lha min dbang po ste/ /lha gnas lha dang zlaḥpa dang rdo re 'dod g.yul 'gyed de yi tshe/ /rdzu 'phrul lus kyis zla ba sgom/ /de dgra rnam grub cesadakung grags/ /gnyis/par lha min mgul phreng gi /snga ma las ltag grong khyer ni/ /nyi tshe dpag tshad brgya stong yod/ /phyogs bar+shar dga' byed mdangs 'tsher dang / /mi snang yid 'ong gser ri baji/ /skyerwa tshal bdun dang brtsas pa yi/ /sna tshogs sbyon pa 'bab chur ldan/ /grong khyer dbus na kun mthong mtsho/ /las mthun mthong ste me long bzhin/ /de/la rgyal po bsnan pa ni1 /lha min khu me du ma dang / /las mthun de la tsod par byed/ /sngon tshe phyi rol chags bral la/ /sbyin pa brtang ba'i 'bras bus skyes/ 1sdig bcas mchod sbyin gang byed pa/ /'jig rten 'azas 'dod der 'gyur ro/ 1tshe ni mi lo drug brgya la/ /zhag gcig yin te rang lo ni/ /drug stong bar du 'tsho ba yin/ /de nas gsum pa rtser gnas pa'i/ /grong khyer zab pa brgyad stong la/ /g.yer kha'i phreng dwang gser phreng tshal/ me phreng 'dres tshal bzhi 324

yis brgyan/ /gong ma gnyishe las mejos she/yin/ 1de na rgyag po me togo phreng / khang bzang skyed tshal du ma na/ /lha min bu mo rnams kyis mchod/ /ltobs dang longs spyod du ma dag /sngon tshe tshul gtsanganamachod pa'i mthus/ /thob bo zhes ni thub pas gsungs/ /garken yang der ni skye ba'i mthu/ /dus ston gyad dang sil khrol deng / /dga' mgron de bzhi na phul ba yis/ /sbyin ldan gnas der skyes pa yin/ /mi lo bdun brgya zhage gcig ste/ /bgrangs pas mi lo bdun stong yin/ /de las bzhi pa rab spro'i gnas/ /grong khyero me dzese pa zhes bya ba/ /gser gyis gasnye'i steng na gnas/ /dpag tshad brgyadi stong rin cen brgyad/ /rang bzhin bku zhing rab medzes pa/ /ljon pa skyed tshal du ma dang / /bya dang bung ba myos pa sa gang / /grong rdal ltetre ka 'bab chur bcas/ /lha min bye mo rab mdzes rnams/ /rin cen rgyan gyis rnam par klubs/ /de dag bdege po thags bzang ris/ /tsol ba che zhing stobs dang ldan/ /rdzu 'a phrul dang ldan 'ijigs pa med/ /bde ldan gzhan yang rab dgod ces/ /bya ba stobs snyemes lhag pa dang / /nga rgyal ldan pa de yang gnas/ /lha mo/gzhan 'is lhag pa yin/ /do 'khor kune/ spro de rdems kyang / /stobs chen longes spyod sden dpag med/ /range gi las kyi 'ibras bur spyod/ /rgyal po ༷de yi las snyed pas/ / yange dag ste ba mi ldan kyang / /tshul ldan bsod stoms byib pa dang / /'jig rten dge spyod ldan pas grub/ /gzhan dag sred pa tshal du ni/ /sdesngas can gnod med sdud pa dang / /rtse gcig sbyin pa sman pas grub/ /de phyir bde ba'i 'ashes bu thob/ /che ni/mi lo brgyad brgya la/ /zhago lin rang lo stong phrag brgyad/ de ltar dud 'gro rnams las ni/ /'phos ste lha dang mir skyes kyang / /rang rang rgyu mthun 'bras bu 'byung / /de phyir rtag tu mi dge spong / /bag yod dge ba bstan par bgyi/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang skyesag 32rgya

las lha min rgyu 'bras bshad pa'i mezhu rte drug pa'o// //mi rnams kyi rgyu 'bras bshad pa/mir skye'i rgyu rkyen ngo bo dang / /nges tshig dbye rgyas gzugs tshe bstan/1rgyu ni nage ba'i las las byung / /rkyen ni khams drug rags su song / /ngo bo smra shes go don rig 1nges tshig bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ /dbye ba mi lus tsam po dang / /gtsang ma dang ni rin po che/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyi mi/ /de yang rgyas par bshad ba na/ /dang po bskol pa 'jug pa'i che/ /mas zhabs rim gyis 'jig pas te/ /bcud rnams dmyal nas rim pa bzhen/ /gong du 'pho dang 'jig rten gzhan/ /'pho byed mi dang lha rnams ni/ /bsam gtan rang mtshan nyid bsten nas/ /sems can mas nas cung zad de/ /de nas nyi ma rab tsha bas/ /rtsi shing 'bab chu chu bo bzhi/ /ma dros rgya mtsho ba tshwa can/ /lhun po ri rab bdun pa yis/ /'bar byas tshangs gnas bar du sreg 1bsam gtan dang po gnyis pa gsum/ /rtog byed dga' bde rlung rgyu ba'i/ /skyon gyis me chu rlung gis 'jig /me yis bdun la chu yis 'jig /de ltar chu bdun thal nas ni/ mjug tu rlung gis 'jig par 'gyur/ /de ltar bar bskal nyi shur 'jig bar bskal nyi shur stongs par byed/ /chags tshe yas rim chags pas te/ /bsam gtan gsum pa gnyis pa dang / /de nas 'dod lha rigs drug dang / /ri rab gling dang bcas pas brtag /mtha' mar 'dzam bu gling chags so/ /phyi sgod chags pa bar bskal gcig /nad bcud chags par bcu dgu 'gor/ /'di gong bskal pa me yis bsregs/ /de nas rim par chags pa ste/ /bsam gtan dang po man chad ni/ /'od gsal lha las rim 326

par 'chad/ khyad par 'dzam gling dang po'i mi/ /skye ba bzhi las rdzus rte skyes/ phus kyang dpag tshad tsam pa la/ /rang gi 'od dang ldan pa'o/ /'gro che rdzu 'phrul mkha' la 'gro /zas su dga' ba za bzhin du/ /che yang dpag tu med pa thub/ /dgra gnyen rtsod 'thab la sogs med/ /bde skyid dga' ldan lha dang mnyam/ /de ltar yun ring gnas pa la/ /stong phrag re nas lo re bri/ /tshe yang bye ba tsam du song / /'di dus skye bzhi sgong skyes byung / /zas su 'byung ba'i rwangs ma za/ /sa yi dwangs ma sa zhag dang / /chu yi dwangs ma pad+ma'i 'bru/ /me yi dwangs ma shing 'bru dang / /rlung gi dwangs ma ga pur dang / 1gos su shing bal 'dab phyo/ gyon/ /ston mongs bag gi skyes pa yis/ /khrus kyi 'od kyang rim gyis nub/ /zos pa che rnams kha dog ngan/ /bzang gis ngan la khyad gsod cing / /nga rgyal mi dges dwangs ma nub/ /bsod nams rim gyisaskuchung du song / /brgyad brgya lon cing lo re bri/ /mi yi tshe yang 'bug la thug myu gu'i tshal dang ljon shing za/ /mi re skyes che shing re skyes/ /'bra sa bu za zhing pags pa spyon/ /me re shi tshe shing yang skam/ /'di dus 'gro rnams rlung gis bteg 'dom gang sa la ma reg 'gro /zos pa che chung mgyogs bul byung / khyad gathod zhe sngang de yang nub/ /'od ni chag gang mi bdun mthong /1drug brgya re nas lo re bri/ /tshe yang brgyad khri pa la thug /lus kyi 'od yal mun pa byung / /spyi mthun bsod nams sangs rgyas mthus/ /mun pa sel byed nyi zla byung / 1'di dus su lu'i ljang pa za/ /'dod chags rgyu langs gnas 'dod chags/ /bltas tshim 'dod chags lo brgya byung / /dgod chim 'dod chags drug cu'i bar/ /bcangs tshim 'dod chags lnga bcu'i bar/ /'khyud tshim 'dod chags bzhe bcu'i bar/ /de nas pho mo'i dbang po dod/ /gcig la gcig gis chags sems skyes/ /spyad pas kun gyis de la bltas/ /phar skyor 333

tshur 7ོra 'jag ma bkab/ khyim la snga ba 'jag spyol byung / /de dus skye ba mngal nas byung / /gos su jas bal shing pal spyon/ /zas su nam za len pa la/ /rgyud ngan zhag res rdus rer blangs/ /de ltar kun gyis zla lor blangs/ /de ltar gsog 'jog byas pa yis/ /phug ma thun chung mi skye'o/ /nga bdag bzung zhing ma 'cham par/ /nga dang khyod kyi phyo rdo sbrel/ /las ngan sems can ma byen blangs/ /sems can lta sdug bsod nams can/ /nagod mi bcol nas bdag por bsgos/ /mang pos bkur pa'i rgyal por grags/ /tshul khrims shes rab nyams len cing / /skye rgu mgu byed nyams pa spyong / /'di dus sems can zhes su 'bod/ /mang bkur yar ded lha dgu la/ /mang yab lha chen rgyal ba yin/ /de yab lha chen dbaza po yin/ /de yab lha chen gzi ldan yin/ /de yab lha chen dung skyong yin/ /de yab lha chen dri med yin/ /de yab gshed rje che chung yin/ /de yab lha chen bzang po'o/ /mang pos bkur bu 'od mdzes dus/ /sems can ming ni tshur shog largas/ /de sras dge ba spe ba can/ /de sras dge mchog sgon chen po/ /gso sbyong 'phags dus tā la'i rkang / /de yi spyi bo'i sha lnga las/ /rgyal po spyi bo skyes 'khrungs te/ /sum cu rtsa gsum man la dbang / /sems can ming ni yid las skyes/ /de yi brla g.yas sha be+e las/ /mdzes pa gser 'khor/gling bzhi bdeg /de yi brla g.yon sha lba las/ /nye mdzes dngul 'khor gling gsum dbang / /de yi rkang g.yas mdzes ldan te/ /zangs kyi 'khor lo gling gnyis dbang / /de yi rkang g.yon nye mdze/rdoldan/ /lcags kyi 'khor lo gling gcig dbang / /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo dang / /blon po dmag dpon glang po rta/ /rgyal srid bdun te nye ba yang / /ral gri pags pa khyim dang ni/ /tshal dang gos lham mas cha bdun/ /'di rnams 'khor los skyur la byung / /de nas nyi shu rtsa dgu'i 328

mtha'/ /rgyal po lag brgyangs brgyad khri'i dus/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig byon rte/ /de brgyud 'apum dang bdun khri dang / /bzhi stong mtha' ma tshangs spyin te/ /bzhi khri'i dus su gser thub byon/ /de yi brgyud pa bdun 'bum dang / /dgu khri brgya das zhe brgyad na/ /rgyal po kṛ ke nyi khri'i dus/ /bde bar gshegs pa 'od spungs byon/ /de brgyud pargya ni gru 'dzin byon/ /mtha' ma grol po rna ba can/ /sras gnyis bha ra dhā dzas bkrongs/ /go tam/khu/ba sgo bar gyur/ /bu ram shing gseb nyi mas smin/ /bu ram shing grags brgya tham pano /gru 'dzin byung ba 'phags skyes bu/ /skar mda' gdong dang lag rna dang / /glang po che 'dul rkang gdub can/ /rgyal srid ma thob mashā' la dh+rigs/ /ming sring 'dus pas shākya zhos/ /mjug tu gzhan grong rgyal sa padz+wang / /rkang gdub brgyud pa lnga khri dang / /lnga stong bcu gcig ser skyar byung mtha' ma gzhu brtan de nyid sras/ /seng ge 'gram dang seng ge sgra/ seng go 'gram la bu bzhi ste/ /zas gtsang zas dkar gre bo zas/ /bdud rtsi zas lo/zas gtsang sras/ /bcom ldan 'das dang gcung dga' bo/ zas dkar la yang bu gnyis te/ /tshe dang sngen pa rgyal ba dang / /shākya'i rgyal bo bzang ldan no/ /bre zas bu gnyis ming can dang / /tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'o / /bdud rtsi zas la bu gnyis te/ /kun dga' bo dang lhas phyin no/ /sgra gcan 'dzin ni bcom ldan sras/ /grags 'dzin ma la 'khrungs pa'o/ /shākya dril sgra'i bu mo yin / /srid pa'i bgrang brgyud de ru chad/ /gling gsum longs spyod ldan pas te/ /'dzam gling las kyi sa par grags/ khru brgyad bcu drug thum cu gnyis/ /dub byang shar gyi lus tshad yin/ /tshe ni brgya phrag phyed dang gsum/ /shar yin nub thung byed 'phags so/ /'di ni dpag sked tshe lo bcu//lus kyang de bzhin mtshungs gyur 1 /byed dang bzhi dang khru bzhir grags/ 1323

sgong skyes rdzus skyes drod gsher ma la/ /shar thung nub dang lho rim bzhin/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims mthu las grub/ /bde sdug dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /rnam smin las kyi skye dbang 'bras/ /yul snang thun mong thun mong min/ /gang gi stobs kyis skye nus byas/ /de bzhin so sor nyams su myong / /skye rga na dang 'chi ba yis/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal gnod par byed/ /drag po 'od dkar khrung khrung dang / /zla ba lha min mi 'am ci/ /gsungs pa gling rnams du ma rnams//sna tshogs las kyis bskyed pa'o/ /thams cad sems kyis bzos pa yin/ /bar srid ngo bo ma rig pa/ /nges chig rang gis rang ma rig /dbye ba bar do bzhi 'am bdun/ /skye 'chi rmi lam ting 'dzin srid/ /chos nyid 'od gsal kun gzhi'o/ /ma gtogs 'khor bar dam du 'khor/ /so sor mthong zhing ngo ma shes/ /de nyid gzhan nas 'tshol byed pa/ /sbrang ma chang 'tshol lta bur 'khrul/ /rtsol ba bya byed kyis bcings pa/ /glang po 'dam la bying ba bzhin/ /laldab pa re stos kyis bslus pa/ /nad la sman log song pa bzhin/ /de ma yin cal der snang ba/ /mig rgyu chu ru mthong ba bzhin/ /med par yod pa'i blo skyes / / /grogs po thag ring shi ba bzhin/ /min pa yin par thag bcad pa/ /tshong phrug nor ngo ma shes bzhin/ /nus pa mar 'gro'i las song ba/ /gshed mas khrims mun khrid pa bzhin/ /ci bsam log par song ba ni/ /bu chung spu gri rtse ba bzhin/ /'od la gzhal yas khang mthong ba/ /phye ma leb dang me mar bzhin/ /dngos grub re stos kyis bslus pa/ /spre'us khron nang phyin pa bzhin//rtogs na sems nyid chos kyi sku/ /snang ba med la 'dug na ni/ /theg pa gsum bzhag ga la yod/ /sems tsam dang ni snang med dang / /sangs rgyas sa dang gnas rnams ni/ /de dag sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad/ /sa bdun dag ni sems yin te/ /snang ba med na brgyad pa'o/ /sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes 330

mate/ /rang sems nyid ni yid bzhin no/ /gang gi yul rnams 'dzin pa ni/ /de ni rnam par shes zhes bya/ /sems ni rtag du lung ma bstan/ /de yi thabs la 'bad pad bya/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las mi rnams kyi rgyu 'bras bzhadwa pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o/ / //༷ dud 'gro'i rgyu 'bras bshad pa/ byol song rnga bo nges chig dang / /rgyu dang dbye ba gnatho bshad pa/ /ngo bo blun zhing rmugs pa'o/ /nges tshig yang dag lam 'a/sa byel/ /ngan song chaganas su song ba'o/ /rgyu ni semase nyid ma rig pas/ /phal cher mi dge skyes 0pa dang / 1'dres ma'i dge ba gang byas pa/ /gti mug shas cher gyur pa'o/ /sgyudabye na mdor bsdus rgyas pa gnyis/ /dang po mdor bsdus dbye na lnga/ /'dab /chags dang ni sder chagase dang / /rmig khrim rmig pa kha dbrag can/ /'greng bu dang ni snga ru ngashad/ /rgyas dbye bye ba sum cu bzhi/ /gnas kyis bsdu na kha ༷'thor dang / /glu dang lha min na gnas gsum/ kha 'thor 'gro ba bzhir khyab ༷ste/ /dmyal bar gnas pa'i dud 'gro yang / /sems rgyud yod dang sems ོ༷da med/ /sems rgyud ldan pa dmyal ba gang / /de la smon pas skye 'gyur ༷yang / /sdug bsnga' dmyal ba nyid mtshungs spyod/ /sems med rmi lam skyes bu bzhin/ /dmyal ba de dag la snang ngo / /dud 'gro lha yi nang skyes pa/ /bde sapa lha dang mtshungs pa rnams/ /de dang de 'dra'i las su 'brel/ khyad par blang po sa srungs bu/ /'khor los sgyur ba legs mthong gi /bram ze mdun na 'don gyur pa/ /bde la gid cing smon pas grub/ /dud 'gro kun gye mchog ༷sken la/ /gang gis brgya byin grub pa yi/ /dga' ldan glang la smon byego wa1 /331

༷ mug gang gis 'phabs min ci/ /de bzhin yi dwags mi rnams kyi/ /gnango na mtshungs spyod 'dres mar skye / /mkha' sding la sogs bya rnams kun/ /phal cher :shing/skyes mkha' lding zhing / /'bu srin 'a/ sogs drod gsher skyes/ /rta be+eng ra lug /ngal skyes bye/ /rdzu 'athrul lochadang mnyam par gnas / /de rnams las kyi rjes 'brel bas/ /yang yang sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur / /de nas sbyin dang tshul khrims kyi/ /cha shas gti mug ldan bskyed pa/ /de yang gnyis te phyi ma yi/ /rgya mtshor ldan rnams chags las skyes/ /nags ma zhe sdang spyod pa yin / /de rnams gtso bo rgyal po ni / /mgo bdun glang lto/nor rgyas bu 'azog po bzang ldan bskyed pa dang / /mi 'jog sprin phreng 'khyil pa dang / kun spro rab spro chos dang ldan1 /'di rnams mi kun bde bar skyong / /rab 'joms 'gying po nag po dang / /hu lu du+o/lu nag po glu / rdothams cad gnas ni longs spyod sdan1 /dpag tshad phum stong ren cen dang / /se tog sna tshogs bdud rtsi za / /cung zad bde bar gnas pa yin / /nag po'i stobam kyes skyes pa rnams / /bye ma'i sdug bsngal 'bab greg 'gyur/ /bye tshan rnal ma rlung za hrid/ /sdupha bsngal rnams kyimi1 gdungs3pa yin / /mi rnams la yang 'tshe bar byed/ /rgya mtsho chu lag dang bcas par/ /chos dang ldan pa'i klu dag ni / /klu chen bgyed ni dge bsnyen te/ /bye ba lnga bcu rtsa bdun no/ /chos mi ldan pa grangs sru me da/ /ma dros pa la sogs pa yi/ /kling bzhi rol mtsho la gnas pa / /de dag blu ni du ma rnams/ /rigs bzhi sna tsho/ོsa las skyes so / /klu mchog tshe la 'chi ba med/ /gzhan ni nges med du ma'o / /lo paṇa bka'i thang 'ig las dud 'gro'i rgyu 'bras bshad pa'i lesdo ste brgyad pa'o/ / /332

yi dwags kyi rgyu 'bras bshad pa/yi dwags ngo bo nges tshig dang / /dbye ba gnas dade rgyu 'bras bshad/ rdodo/bo bkres phongs sdug bsngal ba/ /nges tshig zas skom yid la ngatags/ /dbye na rigs ni dpag med kyang / /bsdu na sum cu rtsa drug go hrū /gnas na gnas dang kha 'thor gnyis/ /gnas ni 'di nas sa 'og tu/ /dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das nas yod/ /de na gshin rje'i rgyal po ni/ /drag po'i las ni 'dres ma las/ /phyung zhing las ni sprog par byed/ /gzhan rnams rgyu 'bras bcas te bshad/ /srog gcod nor ni 'phrogs pa gang / /sto gug ces byar skye 'gyur te/ /ri gnyis bar btsir me mdag za/ /tsha shing bsregs pa lta bur 'gyur/ /nor phyir gshed ma byed pa dang / /ser snas mi sbyin kha khab 'dra/ /zhes byar /skyes nas mgrin phra la/ /ltobabye me mdag za bar 'gyur/ /bza' ba la chags khyem thab la/ /mi ster de ni skyugs pa za/ /yi dwags su skyes nyon mongs shing //chabakres skom gdungs shing cho nge 'byin/ /sbyin la sred pas phud za ba/ /bshang ba zhes byar skye 'gyur te/ /su zhig mi gtsang cung zad tsam1 /za zhing skye ba nyon mongs/'gyur/ /zas spyod srog la gnod byas pas/ /bsam mtsho zhes bya'i yi dwags 'gyur/ /de ni zas med me debar bas/ /gdung sems rgya mtsho skem par byed/ gzas sred bdag za gzhan dag la/ /dri snom byed pa dri za'i grong / /yi dwaja/sa nyid ni bkres gyur kyang / /zas sgos dri tsam gyes 'tsho ba/ /'dzig rten rgyal ba'i bstan bcos sogs/ /'dod pa'i bsnyan bcos za ba yi/ 1rme dwags skyes nas lus skam zhing / /mtshod sbyin rnyed pas 'tsho bar byed/ /'dod pas chu chang bsres 'tshong ba/ /chu 'thung du skyes bkres shing nyen/ /333

rgal chu thigam chu chu sbyin las/ /mi myong gzhan gyis bsrung bar mthong / / chags pas khyer byed sbyin bral bas/ /kun sto zhes byar nyam thag nas/ /sgra 'byin rid cing kun tu 'khyam/ /mya ngan bya ba'i gnas su 'gyur/ /sred pa dge 'dun la sbyin pa/ /lhag mar byas shing ma byin zhes/ /smra ba sdug bsngal rab gdungs pa/ /phyi sa za ba'i yi dwags skyes/ /phreng ba ser snas len pa ni//gardod sbyin du 'gyur phreng bas dga'/ /gtsug lag khang srung las byed pa/ /yi dwags phreng ba za zhes bya/ /sha khrag la sred ser sna can/ khrag zar bskyed pa gnod byed cing / /yi rwags rdzu 'phrul che ba zhes/ /las kyis so sor 'brel bar 'gyur/ /sha 'tshod khe byed cung zad de/ /sha za zhes bya'i yi dwags 'gyur/ /ngo bsrung phyer ni sgos phul ba/ /ser sna ldan ste bdug pa za/ /dge sbyong ltar 'chos sngags sgrub cing / /nor 'dod drag shul spyod par skyed/ /de ni mthu 1 na/gzhan la 'che/ /sred pas bslus pas las rjes 'brang / /chags pas nor la glags lta ba/ /glags ltar sgyes nas sdug bsngal zhing / /lus 'bar mi gtsang gis 'tsho la/ /lha dang bral rnams 'tshe bar byed/ /brtson rnams sa 'og 'jug byed cing / /bkres byed sa 'og yi dwags skye/ /mun nag sbrul rlung drag po ldang / /nor 'phrog 'jig rten sbyin par byed/ /yi dwags dug sbrul chen por 'gyur/ /bdag nyid gcig pu bde ba dang / /nyam nga'i yi dwags khrod du gnas/ /gnyen 'thab grong khyer 'jig byed cing / /rgyal po la brten mtshan mo ni/ /lus 'bar yi dwags gnas skyes nas/ /'bar bas brdungs nas ngu sgra 'byin/ khro bas byis pa bde sems pa/ /byis pa glags pa'i yi dwags su/ /gang zhig 'dod bsten nor 'dod cing / /sbyin byed yi dwags 'dod gzugs can/ /gyur nas sna tshogs tshul gyes ni/ /bsgyur zhing las kyi tshul du 'gro /nad pa glu dang phrag dog dang / /ser sna can de gling 334

bar gyi/ /yi dwags gyure nas nyi zlas kyang / /brgya 'gyur gdungs shing bil bas 'tsho/ /rgyal po la brten drag shul spyod/ /mi nga gshin rje'i chad par skye1 /rlung za gshed ma du mas 'tsho/ /log pa'i mchod sbyin las kyi mthus/ /byis pa za pa'i yi dwags 'gyur1 /bkyes shing sdug bsngal rnams kyis gnod/ /ngo gnyis byed cing skal ba can/ de ni mdangs zar skyes nas kyang / /mtshon chas lus gsheg bkres skom ldan/ /mchod sbyin ngan byed khe sgogs dang / /ser sna ldan pas tshangs pa yi/ /srin por skyes nas gzhan gnod byed/ /glags lta de ni sdug bsngal ldan/ /slob dpon ltar byas dge 'dun dkor/ /spyod pa me za'i yi dwags 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal sgra 'byin mya ngan byed/ /ser sna la chums ngan byed pa/ /mi gtsang za ba'i yi dwags 'gyur/ /de yang bde ba thob pa min/ /rdzun gyis zas rtog brjod pa gang / /rlung zar 'gyur te zas mthong nas/ /phyogs kun rgyugs kyang myong ba med/ /slar zhing sdug bsngal rnams kyis 'tshe/ khrims gcod gzhan dag bkres skom gyis/ /'tsho byed me mdag za ba yi/ /yi dwags 'gyur zhing me de la/ /zos na cung zad bde bar sems/ /nor phyir dug ni ster ba gang / /yi dwags dug zar skyes nas kyang / /char rnams med gyur dug za zhing / /bya gcan rnams kyis za bar byed/ /'brog dgon ser snas gzhan la 'tshe/ /dgon par gnas pa'i yi dwags 'gyur/ /bkres skom gyis nyams 'o dod 'bod/ /'gyel cing bya dang srid bus 'tshe/ /rgyal po me tog breng ba ni/ /longs spyod phyir brkus dur khrod kyi/ /yi dwags gyur nas de'i mgo la/ /lcags 'bar gyis bcings srin bus gnod/ /skyed tshal shing la brkam pas brkus/ /shing la gnas pa'i yi dwags skyes/ /bkres /shing srirgo bus rab tu za1 /stegs pa tsam gyes srog 'tsho byed/ /rkun pos zas nor nog byed pa/ /bzhi mdwor gnas pa'i yi dwags skye/ /sog les gtub 335

pa'i sdug bsngal myong / /de yang gtor mas srog 'tsho'o/ /gang zhig bltas na gzhan gnod pa/ /bdud rigs yi dwags rnams su skye/ /bsam gtan pa la 'che byed cing / /tho lum 'bar za ngan 'gror 'khor/ de sogs 'bum phrag du ma yis/ /yi dwags dpag med sdug bsngal cing / /rdzus skyes phal cher skye gnas bzhi/ 1phal cher yi dwags mo rnams su/ /skyes nas las dang rjes mthun 'gyur/ /de las thar kyang dud 'gror skye/ /gal te mi yi rigs skyes kyang / /bkres sgom nyon songs rags nyams dang / /dbang po0lhag chad rnams su 'gyur/ /de bas yul gye sred pa rnams/ /sgong byed skyes bu rgyal ba lags/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las yi dwags kyi rgyu 'bras bshad pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o/ / //dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras bshad pa/dmyal ba'i ngo bo nges tshig dang / /dbye ba rgyu 'bras gnas tshe bshad/ /ngo bo zhe sdang sdug bsngal ba/ /nges tshig dmyal zhing dub pa'o/ /dbye na tsha grang brgyad gnyis dang / /nyi tshe nye 'khor bco brgyad do/ /tsha ba brgyad po re re la/ /'khor ni bcu drug bcu drug go /yang thos gtso bor skye ba'i rgyu/ /srog gcod nyid do tshul ldan mi/ /gsod cing 'gyod par mi byed na/ /sdug bsngal ma lus myong bar 'gyur/ /gzhan yang nge 'khor bcu drug go /srog gcod che 'bring chung gsum mo/ /gnas ni lcags kyi ra ba du ma na/ /mtshon cha'i nags tshal ro nye mi gtsang 'bab/ /der skyes phan tshun gsod pa'i sems ldan pas/ /gtubs gshags sdug bsngal phyong nas yang sos 'gyur/ /de ltar de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /rang gi lo ni lnga brgya ste/ /mi lo bye ba phrag 'bum 336

dang / /drug khri nyis stong rnams yin no/ /rgyu ni dzogs dang ma dzogs pa/ /dus min 'chi ba yod pa'o/ /de nas thig nag skye ba'i rgyu/ /srog gcod ma byen len pa gnyis/ /spyad las byung ste gtso bo ni/ /srog gcod las 'bras snga ma bzhin/ khyad par ma byen len pa ni/ /darkan cog bla ma dge 'dun dang / /nad pa sdug phongs rnams kyi rdzas/ /brku zhing garnan yang sbyor byed go/ /sdug bsngal ma lus phyong bar byed/ /de 'khor bcu drug skye ba'i rgyu/ /grog gcod ma byen len pa gnyis/ 1che 'bring chung gsum spyad pas skye/ /gnas lcags sa gzhi me 'bar te/ /las gshed rab 'jigs gnam thig gdab/ /shing mkhan sog le me 'bar gsheg /sta res gzhog cing gsor 'bugs pa//tho bas brdung ba'i sdug bsngal myong / /de thar de 'khor bcu drug 'grim/ /'di dag rang lo stong thub ste/ /mi lo bye ba 'bum phrag ni/ /bcu gnyis dang ni bye ba phrag /dgu khri dgu stong nyid yin no/ /bsdus 'joms nyid du skye ba'i rgyu/ /lus kyi las gsum rdzogs pas te/ khyad par 'dod log las byung ba/ /tshul khrims 'jig spyod gtso bo ste/ /de 'khor bcu drug dag gi rgyu/ /snga ma chung dang 'bring po yin/ /de ni gshin rje'i tshogs kyis rab tu gtse/ /'dus tshe lcags kyi dra bas steng nas g.yogs/ /tho ba mtshon chas dmyal ning rdung bar byed/ khyad par 'dod log shal ma li yi ri/ /las 'brel bud med mthong nas der 'dzegs pas/ /lus kun gtub cing sdug bsngal du ma myong / /de rnams tshe ni rang lo nyis stong ste/ /mi lo bye ba phrag ni bye ba gcig bye ba sum 'bum drug khri brgyad stong thub/ /ngu 'bod gtso bor skye ba'i rgyu/ /lus kyi las gsum de steng du/ /chang gi sbyor ba brtson byed cing / /tsul ldan mtshos pa bsam gtan pa/ /chang gis myos par byed pa na/ /de ni mi dege'i gtso po yin/ /de 'khor bcu drug skye ba'i rgyu/ /snga ma 'bring dang spyo nga ngu'o/ 1337

'dir ni rang lo stong phrag bzhi/ /mi lo bye ba brgya phrag brgyad/ /de bzhin bye ba sa ya gnyis/ / bye ba dgu 'bum bzhi khri dang / /bye ba nyis stong rnams yin no/ /ngu 'bod chen por skye ba'i rgyu/ /lus kyi las gsum de bzhin chang / /tshos kyi tshul dag brjod pa la/ /de bzhin mi bden zhes brjod cing / /rgyu des 'jig rten gagod chen byed/ /de 'khor bcu drug skye ba'i rgyu/ /snga ma 'khrung dang chung ngu'o/ /sngar brjod dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung zhing / khyad par rdzun gyi 'bras bus rab tsha ba/ /lcags kyi sa gzhi rab 'bar de la rtse/ /'bar ba'i phur brgyangs pas ni rgyang grags 'gyur/ /lcags/thong gshol gyis dbral zhing srin bu dang / /wa sbrul za zhing 'bar ba kun nas bsreg /gnigo rjes mtshon cha du mas gnod par byed/ /ngu 'bod chung ngu bcu 'gyur lhag pa 'byung / /de las thar kyang de 'khor bcu drug 'grim/ /rang lo brgyad stong mi lo bye ba lngag /drug cu drug dang sa ya gsum dang ni/ /lnga 'thum lnga khri nyis stong thub pa yin/ /tsha dmyal gtso bor skye pa'i rgyu/ 1sngar bshad pa yi las kun dang / khyad par log par lta ba yin/ /de 'khor bcu drug skye ba'i rgyu/ /snga ma 'bring dang chung ngu'o/ /snga ma'i daphyol ba kun las rab drag pa'i/ /'chi khar 'khrul snang gnad gcod sdug bsngal che/ /me lces bsreg cing nad rnams dus gcig smin/ /ngu 'bod sdug bsngal bcu 'gyur dag tu 'gyur/ /'di yi sdug bsngal dper bya rung ma yin/ /log ltas 'phangs phyir tsha la drag pa yin/ / de nas thar kyang de 'khor bcu drug 'grim/ /rang lo druge stong mi lo bye ba prag lnga brgya phum cu sa ya brgyad dang ni/ /bzhi 'bum khri dang drug stong 'gyur/ /rab tsha chen por skye ba'i rgyu/ /lus ngag las bdun log ltar bcas/ khyad par dge slong ma rnams la/ /log lta mi dge 'jug byed pa/ /de 'khor bcu drug skye ba'i rgyu/ /snga ma 'bring dang chung ngu'o/ /gnas der 338

dpag tshad stong phrag 'khrul ba'i mes/ /bsregs nas bye ma bsregs bzhin zhib par 'gyur/ /skam 'dren lce la thong gshol 'bar bas rmod/ /gshin rjes gnod cing zangs khu ldud par byed/ /shal ma li 'dzegs lus kun zhig par 'gyur/ /sngar bshad dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bcu 'grur yin/ /che ni bskal chung byed de sngar ltar ro/ /rang lo 'bum khri nyis stong mi lo ni/ /bye ba bye ba phrag ni bzhi stong dang / /nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa drug ces pa yang / /sa ya phrag bdun sum 'bum khri dang ni/ /brgyad stong dag gi bar du gnas pa'o/ /mnar med gtso bor skye ba'i rgyu/ /sngar ltar mi dge bcu dag dang / /mtshams med pa ni rab spyod pa/ /de ni nges par mnar med 'gro /las kyi snang ba log mthong bzhin/ /nad rnams kun gyes yongs gdungs nas/ /rlung ni brgyad cu 'khrugs pa yis/ /lus kun srin bus 'bugs par byed/ /me dang mun pa gcan gzan dang / /gshin rje rnams kyi snang ba yis/ /rmongs nas sgra 'byin dbang po 'gyur/ /bshang gci 'byin sogs rtags rnams 'byung / /de yi lus la dmyal ba'i mes/ /'di nas bar dor lhung bar byed/ /de ni 'phos ma thag tu yang / /gshin rjes khrid de rab tu rmongs/ /mnar med par yang lhung bar byed1 /de na gru bzhi sgo bzhi yod/ /dpag med sbrul gyis rnam par phye/ /sems can dmyal ba du mas gang/ /dbang med der ne+e 'tshe bar byed/ /de yi sgra thos dmyal ba gzhan/ /brjod cing bde bar smon pa yin/ /me mtshon dug dang rdo rje 'bar/ /bse khyi bya rgod gang ka dang / /sgrul chego khyi ma ko nya dang / /sdug bsngal dpag mid kyis gzir nas/ /bar mtshams rmad par ngu sgra 'don/ /de lus gzhon sha can la ni/ /dpag tshad bzhi nas lnga yi bar/ grub ste mnar med sdug bsngal ni/ /su zhig gis ni brjod par nus/ /gzhan yang de 'khor bcu drug ni/ /ma la ngan sems skyes pas ni/ /ba tshwa 'bar 333

bas grol sreg byed/ /dgra btom ma la log spyad na/ /lcags 'bar dong du rab bcug ste/ /mtshon non tshogs kyis dum bur byed/ /ma la log par dbyen byed pa/ 1'bar par phur bus lus kun 'joms/ /rang rgyal dgra bcos smod byed gang / /spu gris lce gcod rmon pas rmod/ 1gtsug lag khang ni mes bsregs nas/ /de lus 'bar bar rab mched na/ /rdo me char ltar 'bab par 'gyur/ 'dzem med sangs rgyas dkor spyod gang / rang nyid bkres pas rang sha za/ /sbrul nag rab tu 'bar gyis 'azoms/ /chos nor 'bad rtsom nyams byas pas/ /'bar ba'i shing gnyis kyis 'thag cing / /bya yis phus kun za bar byed/ /dge 'dun dkor 'joms gaske+od byas patha// /lcags gtun 'bar bas rdung bar byed/ /nad pa'i longs spyod 'phrog byed pa/ /nad rnams kyis ni gdung bar byed/ /rang rgyal bsodwa stoms 'phrog byed pa/ /rdo rje'i ri yis thal bar slog 1dgon pa'i chu bcad/'tshe ba ni/ /'bar ba'i tshal du bsreg cing 'bros/ /mdza' bshes byas nas gnod par byed/ /'gog las langs pa'i zas 'phrogs na/ /skar 'breng 'dra ba'i zangs su 'tshod/ /glegs bam khro bas 'jeg byed na/ /mig dang yan lag thams bud kun/ /bsregs bzhu btul bas 'o dod 'bod/ /log ltas dge 'dun gnas bcom na/ /lcags kyi ra ba 'bar bar bcug mtshon gye char 'bab 'us kun 'bugs/ /dge 'dun spu bye+od rdzun smra na/ /me chus sbrag cing log dbri byed/ /bstan la gnod pa byed pa ni/ /de la sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung / /'di rnams tshe ni bar bskal te/ /sdug bsngal dpag med myong bar 'gyur/ /bla mas ci gsungs rgyal ba'i bka'/ /rgyal pa'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /bla ma'i bka' bcan sdig pa ni/ khams gsum sems can bsad las che/ khrele drug rdo rje'i dmyal bar 'gro /de'i mthar dmyal ba sham pa la/ /sdug bsngal bshād 340

kyis mi lang myong / /bla ma'i nor rjas ha la'i dug /khong du song bas 'chi ba yin/ /bla ma'i nor rjas tsha ba'i me/ /lus la reg pos chig pa yin/ /bla ma'i nor rjas 'jigs pa brgyad/ rku 'phrog sgong gsum slob ma 'phung / /dam tshig nyams pa'i gson pa bas/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i shi ba rung / /btsun pa 'dul khrims med pa dang / /sngags pa dam tshig med pa dang / /bud med ngo tsha med pa gsum/ /gang la mi gtogs mi srid do/ /de bas 'bad pa du ma yis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa dang / /mi dge spong bar brtson par bgye/ /yang dag lta la rab tu zhugs/ /de tshe lha rnams kyis bsngags shing / /nges par 'byung ba thob par 'gyur/ /de las gzhan yang grang dmyal brgyad/ chu bur chu bur rdol pa can/ /so 'thams a chu kyi hud zer/ /pad+ma ut+pal ltar gas dang / /pad+ma chen po ltar gas so/ /de rgyu grang bas gzhan gnod che/ /bla ma'i zas nor grang ba'i chu/ khyer bas rngam rngam srog dang bral/ /gnas ni tsha dmyal brgyad po/yi/ /byang du sgo nas rim pa bzhin/ /shil rdzong nang nas lo brgya bzhin/ /til re cung zad chu bur can / /gzhan gyi che ni nyi shur 'gyur/ /sred byas gnod pa'i dbang gis skye/ /nyi tshe zhes bya 'dzam gling gi /khrod dang mu khyud gling bar gye/ /thun pa la sogs kun la gnas/ /las ni sngon ma dag dang mtshungs/ /cung zad dge ba 'dres las byung / /nyin par bde la mtshan mo ni/ /gnod pas gtses dang de pazhin gzhan/ /nyin par gsod dang sdug bsngal dang / /mtshan mo lha mo rnams dang rtse/ /de sogs dpag tu med pa yod/ /mnar med ma gtogs dmya' ba rnams/ /phal cher zhag bdun na skye ste/ /bar do yod de rdzus skyes yin/ /'dzam gling ma dros mtsho yi 'og /dpag tshad stong phrag nyi/shu na/ /mnar med de steng dmyal ba bdun/ 1gnas zhes 'dir bshad gzhan dag nas/ /rlung dang gser gyi bar du bzhed//3 1

rmanar med gnas su sems can gcig /skyes tshe chags pa'i mtha' ma de/ /tshe lo khri yi dus na yin/ /de ltar bar bskal nyi shu chags/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las dmyal ba'i rgyu 'bras bshad pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o/ / //sku gsum gyi zhing khams bstan pa/zhing khams mdor bsdus bstan pa ni/ /mi tshe dpag med dus nas su//tshe lo bcu pa mthar thug pa/ 1ya thog ces pa de nas ni/ /brgyad khri'i bar du 'phel 'grib pa/ / /bar gye bskal pa bco brgyad bar1 /mthar ni 'phel bas ma thog gcig /de ltar 'phel nas gnas pa ste/ /sangs rgyas stong dang sems dpa' gnyis/ /de la rdzogs par 'byung ba'o/ /de rnags sprul pa'i sku min la/ zhing khams brkad pa 'di lta ste/ /gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spri phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum mo/ /mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /ri rab gling bzhi khor yug la/ /gling bzhi bcom pa ldan zhes bya/ /'di na bcom ldan shākya thub/ /rgyal po don grub la sogs pa//mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru/grags/ /shar na gling bzhi shin tu baspung / /de na bde gshegs rdo rje sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /sto na gling bzhi bzod par dka'1 /de na bde gshegs dbang po sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /nub na gling bzhi gnyen dang ldan/ /de na bde gshegs chu lha sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /byang na gling bzhi seng ge yod/ /de na bde gshegs thub chen sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag 342

bcu ru grags/ /byang shar gling bzhi rnam par brtsegs/ /de na bdi gshegs bdud rnams 'joms/ /zhes sogs mtshan ni stong phrag bcu/ /shar sto gli'i bzhi dga' ba zhes/ /de na bde gshegs mi 'jigs sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /sto nub gling bzhi snying po dam/ /de na bde gshegs mi 'jigs sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /nub byang gling bzhi sa bzang po/ /bde gshegs yang dag mtha' yas sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /'og na gling bzhi 'od 'gro ldan/ /bde gshegs shin tu grub lo sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /steng na gling bzhi nor 'dzin ces/ /bde gshegs blo gros ldan la sogs/ /mtshan ni stong phrag bcu ru grags/ /de 'dra gcig nas gnyis bgrangs stong / /stong ni spyi phud 'jig rten khams/ /de yi lcags/ris dga' ldan sleb/ /de nyid gcig nas gnyis bgrangs stong /stong gnyis bar ma'i 'jig rten khams/ /lcags ris gzhan 'phrul dbang byed sleb/ /de gnyis gcig nas gnyis bgrangs stong / /stong chagasum stong gi 'jig rten khams /lcags ris bsam gtan dang por sleb/ 1de ni sprul sku'i zhing khams so/ /gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya yod/ /zhing khams de dang mnyam pa ni/ 1shar na khebs pa dang ldan pa/ /de na de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /mnyam pa zhes bya la sogs pa/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ /sto na /lhag pa'i 'jig rten khams/ /bde gshegs thugs su chud pa'o/ /yobon ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ 1rdub na spyi rtsal 'jig rten khams/ /ba di gshegs dgongs pa dang ldan sogs/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ /byang na rnam par 'byung ba'i zhing / /bde gshegs tsam pa ka'i mdog sogs/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ /byang shar 'phro bar byed pa'i zhing / /bde gshegs sdug bsngal bral la sogs/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ /shar sto phan pa'i 343

'jig rten khams/ /bde gshegs rab 'joms la sogs pa/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ /sto nub kun tu spong ba'i zhing / /bde gshegs thub pa'i dngang po sogs/ /rmatshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ nub byang yongs su dga' ba zhes/ /me tog yang dag tshal la sogs/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/1'og na mi che'i zhing khams na/ /'od 'phro 'gyed pa la sogs pa/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ /steng na dbyangs sgogs 'jig rten khams/ /dpal gye rgyal mtshan la sogs pa/ /mtshan ni bye ba stong phrag bcu/ /de 'dra gcig nas gnyis brtsis stong / /mtshams sbyor 'jig rten khams zhes bya/ /lcags ris bsam gtan gnyis par gleb/ /de stong rgyud bkod dang po ste/ /lcags ris bsam gtan gsum par gleb/ /de stong rgyud bkod bar pa ste/ /lcags ris bsam gtan bzhi par sleb/ /de stong rgyud bkod mtha' ma ste/ /lcags ris gya nom snang bar sleb/ /de stong stong chen rtogs spangs zhes/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog brgyan/ /de yi lcags ris 'og min gleb/ /de nyid longs sku'i zhing khams te/ /chags pa yod la 'jig pa med/ /de la dpag tu med pa la/ /chos sku'i zhing khams zhes bya ste/ /dbyibs dang kha/dog ma grub pa/ /chags 'jig kun dang bral ba'o/ /zhing khams de dag thams cad kyang / / sangs rgyas sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /skra rtse'i khyon las sangs rgyas mang /po byon/ḍagang hā'i klung gi bye ma ji snyed pa/ /rgyal ba de dag zhing yang de snyed do/ /de dag mtshan nyi da mi 'dra bskal mi mnyam/ /de yang sgyu ma sprul po'i rang bzhin te/ /ji snyed phyorgas bcu'i 'jig rten 'di/ /'da'adzipa'i zhing rnams rgya mtsho yang / /gcig gi nang na thams cad snang / /sgyu ma'i rang bzhin sprul pa gin//de ltar spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /nom par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho'i/ /zhing khams de 'dra bye ba ni/ /brtsom ldan spyan ras gziḥgs dbang 344

chagis/ /mchan khung g.yon pa'i ba spu yi/ 1bu ga gcig na bzhugs zhes chagasungs/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las sku gsum zhing khams bstan pa'i lethu ste bcu gcig pa'o/ / // dus gsum sangs rgyaso bro+on tshug bstan pa/dus gsum sangs rgyas ji ltar byon tshul ni/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di ༷yi sngon nyid du/ /chos med mtha' 'khob bskal pa brgya byung ngo / /de sngon —bskal pa bzang rgyan sangs rgyas ni/ /bye ba phrag ni brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byon/ /de gong mun pa'i bskal pa lnga brgya byung / /de sngon bskal pa mthong dga' bya ba ༷la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong phrag drug cu byon/ /de gong mun pa'i bskal /pa bdun brgya byung / /de sngon bskal pa dga' ba bya pa la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong phrag drug cu byon/ /de ltar 'dres pa dpag tu med pa byon/ /bskal pa ba nga po de yi 'orge nyid du/ /mtha' 'khob bskal pa rigs ngan drug cu byung / /de 'og bskal pa grangs ldan bya ba la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sto4 phrag brgyad cu byon/ /de 'og mun pa'i bskal pa sum brgya byung / /de 'og bskal pa mdzes rgyan bya ba la/ /sangs rgyas stong thog brgyad cu rtsa bzhi /skyon1 /de ltar 'dres pas bsam gyis mi khyab byung / /da lta'i bskal pe bzang po 'di nyid la/ /sangs rgyas stong dang sems dpa' gnyis/'byon bshad/ 1de gong bskal pa dbyangs snyan de gong la/ /chos kyi me long jid dang de gong ༷gi /mdzes par snang ba zhes bya'i bskas pa la/ /'jeke rten khams ni rnam par rgyal ba ru/ /sangs rgyas rin cen mtha' yas rin cen bkod/ /de dus rgyal po yul 'khor skyong zhes bya/ /de la btsun mo stong dang sras stong yod1 /3 5
