rgyal po des kyang sangs rgyas 'khor bcas mchod/ /yab sras thams cad mngon par shes dang ldan/ /'gro pa'i don phyir rdzu 'phrul mkha' la 'gro /btsun mo dam pa ma smad dpe med gnyis/ khrus byas seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa'i pang / /rdzus skyes sprul sku khye'u re re byon/ /bar snang lha yis khye'ur mtshan btags pa/ /ma smad bu la chos kyi sems dpa' dang / /dpe med bu ni chos kyi blo gros so/ /de nas rgyal bo de yi dgongs pa la/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas bstong dang sems dpa' gnyis/ /sras rnams yin nam snyam nas sangs rgyas gsol/ /yin par gsungs pas sngon la gang 'byon zhus/ /rin cen dzum/pardo rgyal bu'i ming bcug nas/ /zhag bdun gsol btab de nas dbang bskur bas/ /pho brang bum par bcas pa mkha' la 'phags/ /rdo rje pha lam skya batho lan bdun dkrugs/ /rnam dag blo gros ming byang sngo na la byung / /bskal pa bzang po tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus/ /sangs rgyas 'khor pa 'jig tu lung bstan to/ /de nas rnam par rgyal ba'i sde byung ngo / /bzhi khri'i dus su gser thub 'byon par gsungs/ /de nas gzhon nu dbang po nyi khri'i dus/ /sejas rgyas 'od srungs zhes byar lung bstan to1 /de nas don grub tshe lo brgya pa'i dus/ 1sangs rgyas shākya thu ba par lung bstan to/ /de nas gzhon nu ska rags byams par bstan1 /de ltar rim par 'byung rnams lung bstan mdzad/ /mtha' mar rgyal bu blo gros mtha' yas 'byon/ /sangs rgyas mos par lung bstan 'di nyid la/ /stong gi sku tshe 'khor dang longs spyod 'byung / /chos kyi sems dpa' gsang bdag phyag rdor de/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan spung sdud pa po/ /chos kyi blo gros tshangs pa'i dbang po de/ /sangs rgyas stong la chos 'khor/bskul ba yin/ /de ltar lung bstan mdzad rnams rim pa ru/ /byon dang 'ibyon gyur bskal pa bzang po la/ /dus ni bzhi las bskal pa rdzogs ldan gshams/ /skye 346

rgu'i tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa'i dus/ /rgyal po lag brkyangs grong khyer bzang po ru/ /wārā ṇa si zhes pa'i grong khyer du/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig pa bram ze'i rigs/ /yab ni mchod sbyin yum ni tshangs rgyal ma/ /sras ni bla ma sku tshe brgyadanakhri thub/ /'dod chags bral ba'i chos 'chad rgyud la gnas/ /lung gi chos ni bcu gnyis rgyud la gnas/ /dam pa'i chos ni brgyad khri'i bar du gnas/ /dus ni gsum ldan tshe lo bzhi khri'i dus/ /rgyal po rta ldan grong khyer lnga pa ru/ /yul ni zhing khams gser gyi mchod spras su/ /gser thub byon te rigs ni phreng brgyud do/ /yab ni mes byin yum ni bla ma'o/ /sras ni rnam par rgyal ba sum khri'i tshe/ /gsang sngags ma gtogs sde sdod gsum po 'chad/ /gsang sngags chos ni rgyud la gnas pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos ni stong gi bar du gnas/ /dus ni gnyis ldan tshe lo nyi khri'i dus/ 1rgyal po kṛ ki'i yul ni tsadhi nas/ /sangs rgyas 'od srungs rigs ni bram ze'o/ /yab ni/tshangs sprin yum ni nor bdag mo/ /sras ni ded dpon sku tshe nyi khri thub/ /dam pa'i chos ni 'dul ba mngon pa 'chad/ /lhags chos 'dod chags bral ba rgyud la yod/ /bstan pa lo ni bdun khri'i bar du gnas/ /dus ni rtsorda ldan che lo brgya pa'i dus/ /rgyal po zas gtsang grong khyer ser skye ru1 /sangs rgyas shāka thu ba rigs ni rgyal rigs te/ /yab ni zas gtsang yum ni lha mdzes ma/ /sras ni skra gcan rim gro kun dga' bo/ /'od ni 'dom gang sku tshe ga gnyisanaso/ /chos ni sde sgod gsum dang gsang sngags 'chad/ /bstan pa lo ni lnga stong lnga brgya gnas/ /skye rgu'i bdag mo rab byung lnga brgya nub/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas byon pa'i lo rgyus te/ khyad par shāka thub ji ltar byon pa ni/ /dmyal ba bha shi ta nas tshe 'phos te/ /zla bo ka ma ru pa dmyal dpon brdungs pa la/ /snyiperje skyes pa'i stobs kyis rdza mkhan snang byed skyes/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen po la/ /rtsa 341

—sgron phul te byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshoṭa bsags te/ /grangs sked dang po shāka thub chen po nas/ /rgyal ba yul 'khor skyong gi bar du ni/ /bskal pa bdun khri lnga stong tshogs gnyis bsags/ /tshoṭa spyor gnyis bgrod mthong lam rab dga'i sa/ /mar me mdzad nas dbang po rgul mtshan bar/ /bskal pa bdun khri drug stong tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sa shi bdun pa man chad mngon du gyur/ /sangs rgyas bden nas 'od grungs bar/ /bskal pa bdun khri bdun stong tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sa bcu chos kyi sprin ni mngon du gyur/ /de nas sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' des/ / dga' ldan gnas su dam pa tog dkar 'khrungs/ /lha yi ston pa mdzad zhus sangs rgyas bskul/ /'jig rten mgon po khyod la gsol ba ni/ /mi yul bab nas 'gro ba'i don slad du/ /mgon po chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor la/ /semam can/don kun ma lus 'a 1ba/par mdzod/ /de nas mi yul 'byon par dgongs pa dang / /lha bu gzhon pa rnams kyis phyag la 'jus/ /skyes bu dam la khyed ni mi bzhugs na/ /dga' ldan gnas stongs nged kyi ston pa su/ /de lhar zhus pas dam pa tog dkar gyis/ /rgyal tshab gnyer du mgon po byams pa bskos/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis tshul gyis 'dzam gling byon/ /dang po 'dzam bu ming du lha las babs/ /gnyis pa ser skya'i yul du lhums su zhugs/ /gsum /pa lusba'i tshal du glang lor bltams/ /bzhi 4 kyad kyi yul du rol rtsed snyemadzad/ /lnga shā shākya'i yul du rgyal srid bzhes/ /drug pa rnam dag drung du rab tu byung / /ba dun pa be+e radzi nar dka' thub mdzad/ /brgyad pa rdo rje gdan du mngon sangs rgyas/ /dgu pa rgyal po'i khab tu cho 'phrul bstan/ /bcu pa wā rā ḍa sīr chos 'khor bskor/ /bcu gcig rtswa mchog drung du mya ngan /'das/ /bcu gnyis sā la zung du sku gdung bzhag khyad par sangs rgyas 348

/sprudzad pa ni/ /'og min longs skur sangs rgyas nas/ /'gro ba'i don phyir 'dzam gling du/ /sprul pa'i sku ru sangs rgyas te/ /'og min gnas mchog nyams dga' bar/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po gcig 'dir 'tshang rgya/ /sangs rgyas dus ni don grub nyid/ /ni rañja na'i 'egram logs su/ /dka' thub dka' ba spyod pa'i tshe/ /phyogs bcu'i sprul pas longs spyod sku/ /byang chub lnga stobs dbang bskur nas/ /'og min nyid du don grub nyid/ /sprul pa'i dka' thub khog pa nas/ /ye shes snang mdzad tshul du gshegs/ /ri rab rtse mor chos 'khor bskor1 /de yang rtogs pa'i gzugs/ sku yin/ /'dzam gling sprul skur sangs rgyas tshul/ /dgung lo sum cu so lnga bzhes pa'i dus/ /phag lo da phyid zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad la/ /rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub shing drung du/ /srod la bdud btul gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sabs rgyas tho/ 1yo paṇa bka'i thang yig las dus gsum sangs rgyas byon tshul bstan pa//le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //nyan thos gan thum tshogasi3pa bstan ga/ theg pa'i rim pa ji ltar gsungs tshul ni/ /thun mong dang ni bye brag 'dod pa gnyis/ /thun mong 'dod pa 'khor lo rim pa gsum/ /bden bsgo'i 'khor lo wārwa kho ster bskor/ /rgyal po'i khab tu bar pa mtshad nyid sed/ /yangs pa can du mtha'e ma don dam nges/ /bye brag 'dod pa tshos 'khor la na dgur bskor/ /be+eca sa kyi rang bzhin gcig mod kyangarta/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid mi 'dra bas/ /dbang po rab 'bring gsum du byung / /da bang po rab kyi don du ni/ /nang gi bskyed rdzogs rnam gsum bstan/ /dbang mo 'bring gi don du 3433

shi/ /phyi'i kri yog sde sdod gsum bstan/ /dbang po tha ma'i don du ni/ /sde sdod gsum gyi theg pa bstan/ /de ltar theg pa dgu po yang / /phun sum tshoṭa lnga'i tshul du bshad/ /ston pa 'khor dang chos 'dzom na/ /gnas dang dus ni shugs las 'byung / /ston pa gcig la snang tshul tha dad 'byung / /de tshe rigs drug sems can la/ /sdig pa sgong ba'i gzugs su ston/ /nyan thos rnams la chadagra bcom tshul/ /rang rgyal rnams la bse ru'i tshul/ /'og min bla med gnas mchog tu/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba bsam mi khyab/ /don dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig ston/ /mi mthun 'khor ba'i g.yang sa gcod/ /nyan thos theg ba'i phun sum tshogs lnga ni1 1sprul sku shākya thub pa sangs rgyas nas/ /bdun phrag bdun du chos ni ma gsungs te/ /de nas dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad la/ /shāka thub sprul sku'i sprul sku dgra bcom tshul/ /bā rā ṇa shrīr lnga sde bzang po la/ /dang po bden pa bzhi yi chos 'khor bskor/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam gyi chos/ /dbye ba las su bya dang don gsal phyir/ /lan gsum bzlas pas bcu gnyis tshul du ni/ /lo drug zla ba brgyad kyi bar du gsungs/ /'dul ba'i sde sgod/nyi khri chig stong chagasungs/ /'dul ba lung dang 'dul ba bla ma dang / /yod par ston dang lung bzhi rgyas par ston/ /de ni 'dul ba'i rtsa ba sde bzhi ste/ /lung zhus dang ni /'dul ba gzhi dang ni/ /rnam 'byed dang ni 'dul lung phran chegs so/ /lung zhus la gnyis gzhung ngam gzhung bla ma/ /gzhi la gzhi stod rab tu 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /gzhi smad gso sbyong gzhi sogs bcu drug go /'dul lung rnam par 'byed la gnyis yin te/ /dge slong pha yi las ni rnam 'byed dang / ོ/dge slong ma yi las ni rnam 'byed do/ /'dul lung phran tshegs/la ni rnam pa bzhi/ 1de /yang las/chog kar sha ta ma dang / lag len mdo rtsa bam chung ku ri kā/ /mo 350

gsham 'dul mdo 'dum ba rnam 'byed dang / /dge tshulanabya ba la sogs4gsungs pa rnams/ /gleng gzhi/sdeparagasogs pa bcu gnyis so1 /lusgo dang 'byung dang ldan pa dang 1 /nges par 'byung dang gang zag dang / 1bcas pa dang ni rab/'byed dang 1 1rnam par nges phyir 'dul ba'i chos/ /bka' rnams bsdu ba nye ba 'khor/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yiko las nyan thos phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa'i lenyu ste bcu gsum pa'o/ / / /rang rgya' jeg pa'i ston su ma rdogag pa bstan pa/rang rgyal theg pa'i phun surga tsho/sa lnga/ni// /sprul sku'i longs sku shāka thub rang rgyal tshul/ 11ma ga rte ru thod spungs la sogs pa/ /nyan thos chen po mchog ba de de/ /shes rab can mchog shā di'i bu /rdzu 'phrul can mchog mo dgal bu/ /zab mo chos mchog rab 'byor dang / /lha mig ldan mchog ma 'gags pa/ 1ma la stan bkod mchog gyad gor bu/ khyim bdag dad mtshog 'char ka dang / /mang du thos mchog kun dga' bo/ /bslab la gus mchog sgra gcan 'dzin/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis chos kyi nakhor lo bskor/ /lugs 'byung lugs ldog gnyis zu nge sa pa la/ / /ma rig 'du byed/rnam she ming dang gzugs/ /skye mched drug dang reg pa tshor ba srid/ /len pa sri da pa skye ba rga shi'o/ /de yang rgyu/'bras 'bras bus 'khong bar 'khyacabs/ /de yang lugs ldog tshul du bsgoms pas te/ /ma rig phugs rdob 'du byed rtsa ba chad/ /de yis rnam sheg yul la mi 'jug pa/ /de yis ming dang gzugs kyi der 'dzin zhig de yis reg pa 'dod ba'i dug zhi bas1 /srid pa'i chu skoms len pa'i yul mi 'jug /de yis srid pa'i dra ba zhig pa yis/ /skye ba'i sgo 'gags rga 351

khong khro med pa'i byams pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyi ni thums pa ni/ /phyi dang nang dang gsong pa dang / /'dod sred mid pa'i byams thamasaX/ /rkyen gyis bskul ba'i byams pa ni/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /gti mug med pa'i byams pa'o/ phan 'dogs bsgrub pa'i byams pa ni/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /nga rgyal med pa'i pyams pa'o/ /sems can don byed byams pa ni/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /phrag dog med pa'i byams pa'o/ 1rigs drug sdug bsngal bdag blangs byams pa lnga/ /dpe ni bu gcig ma lta bu1 /sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin can/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba snyeng rje yin/ /gang yin 'dri na snying rje yin gyis/shig /rang bzhin skyes pa'i snying rje dang / /gyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /sems can dmigs pa'i snyib/rje dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsab ba'o / /chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /dmigs pa med pazhi snying rje dad / /bye dang nang dang gsang ba 'o/ /mi skyo ba yi snying rje dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /sdug bsngal can ni snying rje'i yul/ /dpe ni khri snyan sa le 'dra/ /gnod pa skyel lan phan 'dogs so/ /bdag gi bde ba gzhan smin dga'/ /pha ma mkhan slob bla ma ni/ /spro ba dang bcas dga' ba'i yul1 /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dga' ba yin/ /gang yin 'dri na dga' ba yin gyis shig 'phags pa dab tu dga' ba dang //phyo dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /mos gus dang bcas dga' ba dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ 1btsal bka' rnyed pa'i dga' ba dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /zhi bar gnas pa'i dga' ba dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /mi thub pa yi dga' ba dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /dpe ni rgyal po rabs chad bu bzhin du/ /rab tu spro zhing dga' ba'o/ /chos kyi rtsa ba btang stoms yin/ /gang yin 'dri na btang stoms yin gyis shig 1353

rang dgad gnas pa btang stoms skye ba'i yul/ /mtho da na mi rdoms btang bstoms dang / /phyi dang nang dang gas nga ba'o/ /rang gzhan bsrung ba'i btang stoms dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /dus dang dus min btang stoms ༷dang / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /dgag bsgrub med pa'i btang snyoms dang / /gyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /las su jung ba'i btang stoms dang / /༷phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o/ /dpe ni/'ba' la tar na 'dra/ sems can nye ring me da pa'o/ /gdug pa'i sems la byams pa lnga/ /'chi ba rnams la snying rje lnga/ /zhum pa rnams la dga' ba lnga/ /'khor ba'i sems la btang stoms lnga/ /ngo bo sangs rgyas chos rnams kyi/ /rim pa de ltar byung ba yin/ /nges tshig sdig pa can la dgongs/ /dbye ba rnam pa nyi shur brjod/ /rgyas par bshad na brgya ru nges/ /smon pa sems bskyed sdom pas zin/ /'jug pa dam bca' /kun nas blangs/ /dngos gzhi sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin cen ༷'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri smon bshes gnyen dang / /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu/ /gyel po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgu snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis/ /rnam ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /de nas 'jug pa'i /sdom pa bcu blangs nas/ /mkhas pas rtsag pur ras kyi steng du ni/ /thal sbyar ༷gus pa'i glegs bam bzhag nas su/ /snying rje dang ni spro ba rgya chen bskyed/ 1sus thos grol bar bya phyir bklag par bya/ khrus byas gos gtsang gyon te dkar gsum zos/ /myos pa'i btung ba sgog bcong zas lnga spang / /g.yeng dang gtam gyi bar chad spangs nas bsgrim/ /skad gsangs mthon por bzhag ste dbugs lhod bklag /shab shub dang ni skad chen rnam par spang / /myur zhing mi gsal kun tu bul ba dang / /gnyid dang 'jog dal rtab rngam bsdus po dag /spangs te 'jam zhing zur byen bakhyeg par thu/ /thog mar rtab ste ho cang sgra chen 354

/min/ /bar du gnod med nu pa dang sbyar nas/ /dbyangs ni sde dang khams sasu bcas pa ste/ /ma tha' mar dog zhing gsal bar meblag par bya / / ba dan zur sna mtha' mar zhi ba dang / /mtshams le glernga gleng mthashe ma zhi bzhin du/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du ba klags nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar te gril zhing gus pas bzhag de nas smon lam dge bar bsngo rgyas te/ rdul med langs nas dgos pa'i gtam bya zhing / mi dgos sna tshogs gtam gyi g.yeng ba spang / /bdag chagazhan nyon mongs bskyed par mi bya'o/ /glegs bam de ni dus gsum rgyal ba sayis/ /mi yis thog mar mchod byar gsungs pa ste/— /bklags nas sngar bzhin gus bya zhing / yang yang glegs bam bklag par bya/ /da lta sbyor ba tshogs pa yis/ /gang zhig glegs bam glog byes na/ /de la zhal nas gsungs pa yi/ /dgos pa 'grub par the tshom med/ /glegos bam kloge paslo bya ba ni/ /mdo ༷tsam rigs brgyud 'brel ba yin/ /lo pakho kun gyi mdzad pa ni/ /shākyangs rdzoṭa tshos rnams bklag par bya/ /gsung gi dbang phyug thob par 'gyur/ /ngo bo mtshad gnas zhes bya'o/ /nges tshig glog mkhan zhes rgya'o/ /dbye na lus ngag yid gsum po/ /skyon dang ldan na mchod gnas min/ /sgra med snyan pa skru bar byed pa dang 1 /mi gsal ma dag klog mkhan ma yin no/ /khri stan dma' zhing mi gtsang ba dag dang / khrus dang gtsang sprorwa bral zhing le lor gnas/ /mtshan mar reg cing glegs bam dag la 'dzin/ /de dag phyugs ma 'edra ba'i spyod lam gnas/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas glegs bam rin cen la/ /ma gus stongs kyis 'phrog pa ltar byas nas/ /rdob cing lhung ba lta bur bzhag nas ni/ /pho dung lcag gis brabs pa lta bu dang / /zhazha/phye bldad po lta bus klog byas ste/ /dri ngan mchil ma'i1zil pa dang ldan pa'i/ kha yi dbugase kyis rdul g.yab byed pa dang / /mi gtsang mchil mas gos pa'i sor mo yis/ /'dzin cing khrog pas 3dudu

cig par byed pa dang / /klog par skyodibs po ti pang pas bteg /de nas tshod tsam zhig kyang dpags te 'jog /bltas shing dbag sa pas thon la mi phan sgo/ /de ni dam chos spangs pa'i rtem par gsungs/ tha ma khyi'u steb ltar phul ba ste/ /lus kyi stobs rngam byed phyir ma gus pa/ /'di dag lus kyi nyes par brjod pa yin/ /des ni dam chos spangs pa'i nyes pa 'byung / /bdag ni klog par byed ces sgogs pa'i phyir/ /thog mar 'o dodu skad kyis bklags byas te/ /de ni dam chos spangs pa'i stos par gsungs/ /de nas myur zhing mi gagal shab shub dang / /sgo med mgo lus mchu dag bskyod pa ste1 /des ni glegs bam bklag pa ma yin no/ /klog skad shub nas gzhan gyi sgra la nyan/ /gtam na 'don pa'i glog mkhan gsol po'am/ /skog rnams mkhas na don gyi chod kyang che/ /'on kyang rang gi dgos pa shor/bar snang / /sha chang sgog pa chos 'gal zas la sred/ /brtul zhugs chung bas bgegs kyis tshugs par ma/ /'di dag ngag gi nyes par brjod pa'o/ /sred pa re dogs rtag tu dran pa dang / /bud /med la/zhogs yid gtod yid kyi skyon/ /de bas nyes pa 'di dag spangs nas ni/ /mi dang mi min nyan po tshogs kyi rnar// /gsal bar bklags na rnam grol thob 'gyur bas/ /skad gsangs mthon pos zur phyin baglag par rgya/ 1rdzun du smras pa 'i ngag gi nyes pa ni/ /rgya cher gyuranapa'i lce di brgyangs byas te/ 1thong gagol 'bar ba/du mas rmod pa yi/ /sdug bsngal bajed dka' yun ring gnas par gsungs/ /tshul khrims la sogs bdag la yod min kyang / /tshul khrims tshogs dang ldan pa'i chos pa gang / /de ni kun tu slu bar byed pa ste/ /byis pa'i longs spyod dag kyang 'bar bar 'gyur/ /gang la dam tshig sdom pa rim mi /ldan/ /de la 'phags pa mnyes par dka' bas te/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don rnams mi 'grub pas/ /dam chig sdom pa dag shi gnas par bya/ /glog mkhan 356

ngan pa'i skyon gyi rnam grangs rnams/ /spangs rte zhar la gdams pa dang bcas )ོ/ /ā li dbyangs dang/gsal byed brjod parashābu1 /cho rnams rtsa ba myur ba tshul khrims so/ /bslab pa gsum bshags sdom nan bya ba gces/ /ngo bo shes rab phyogs kyi dkar chag la / /rgyas pa/'bum la bam po blo ka /tsheg bar dgu yis bcad pa'i tshig rkang ni/ /shad bar ba zhi bsablo ka gcig zeraṣe /de chabade blo ka 'bum yod pa'i phyer/ /brjod bya gyes ba 'bum zhes bya/ /stong phrag chabargya ni yogo pa phyir/ /stong phrag brgya ga zhes bya'o/ 1643/bdun cu tsa gnyis /yod/ /bam po sum brgya shad ni bzhi 'bu yod/ /tsheg ni bye ba bzhi dang 'a bum yod do4 /de ni chom/kyi nges tshig go ba long / zhus pa'i don ni nyis brgya lnga bcu yod/ /dbye na/ma //grangs bcu gnyis yod/ /zhu ba po ni brgyad yod do/ zo/shes rab can gyi chog gyur pa/ /shā ri'i bu yis gnyi so zhus so/ / 'dri zhing lan 'debasga mchog gyu ra pa/ /rabagasabyor gyis ni bzhi shus so/ /byashag bu gang pos gcig zhus so/ /'phags pa rgyams pag gcig zhu sa so/ / lha dbang brgya byin gnyis zhus so/ /chos 'phags dang ni rtag tu ngu 1gnyis kyis spyi la gcig zhu sa so/ /mabadu thos pa'i mchog gyur3pa/ /'phags pa kun dga' bos ni gcig zhus so /de ltar rkang grangs/bcu gnyis1so/ /snyo ka mi'abum yod pa ni/ /'khor ba myang 'das 'a pes te gnyis 'dus so/ /'khor /ba'i 'dre ni phung po lnga pyo nas/ /rga shi yan/chad bzhi la zeragab/yin/ /mya ngasha 'das pa 'i/'dres bshad/pa/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol byen pa nas/ /rnam pa /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ g.yan chad la ni zer ba yin/ /'bras bu sangs /rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /che ba'i yon tan gyis ldan no/ /nyi khri lnga stong dkar chag la/ /blo ka stong phrag nyi shu lnga/ ༷ /le'u bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod/ /bam po brgyad cur smras kyang ni/ don la bdun cu don brgyad yod/ /de la shad ni 357

'bum yod do/ /cheg no bye ba gcig dang 'bum/ /zhu ba po ni 'bum dang 'dra/ khri brgyad stong pa'i dkar chag le/ /blo ka stong phrag bco brgyad yod/ yeXdī brgyan cu rtsa bdun yod/ /bam po drug cu tham pa yod/ /shad ni bdun khri nyis stong yod/ /tsheg ni bdun 'bum dgu khri yod/ /shes rab khri ba'i dkar chag la/ /blo ka stong phrag bcu gnyis yod/ /le'u bdun cu rtsa bdun yod/ /shad ni bzhi khri tham pa yod/ /tsheg ni bzhi ngabume bzhi khri yod/ brgyad stong pa yi dkar chag ma /blo ka ni stong phrag brgyad1 /le'u sum cu tham pa yod/ /bam po nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod/ /shad ni 'bum dang khri yod do/ /tsheg ni 'bum dang lnga khri yod/ /'o na stong phrag brgya pa ni/ /dang po gang nas byub ba yin/ /bar du gang na gnas pa yin/ /mtha' ma gang du dar ba yin/ /blangs mi su yis byas pa yin/ /phyis su de yi lan ba tab pa/ /dang po ston pa'i thugs la gnas/ /rgya shog la bris klus thob ste/ /klu yi mul na gnas pa yin/ /de nas glu sgrub snyib pos thob/ /rgya gar yul gyi dbus su ni/ /rdo rje gdan du rgyas par bstan/ /de nas sto phyogs siṅga lar/ 1klu sgrub kyis ni rgyas par bstan/ /de nas glegs bam rgya gar yul du phyin/ /dus 'khor be+e ro tsaganas spyan drangs nas/ /rgyal mo tsha ba rong du bzhugs so skad/ /de nas bod kyi yul du spyan 'dren mkhan/ /slob dpon khams pa go cha zhes bya ba/ /mi brjed pa yi gzungs thob ces pa des/ /thugs la bzung nas glegs shing mdun rgyab sbyar/ /byon pas glegs bam med pa cis nyes zer/ /slob dpon zhel nas 'di skad gsungs/ /dharmā kag kag rang legs zhes/ /stong phrag brgya pa zhal nas gsungs/ /thugs la bzung nas bshad par gda'/ slob dpon khams pa go cha ni/ /dharmā'i ngor bzhugs de ltar lags/ /thugaso la 'bum sde mnga' ba lags/ /go cha'i thugs las byung ba 'i / /bhasko stong/phrag brgya pa ni/ /lha 363

sa'i mig mangs tshal na bzhugos/ goslad kyis spyan drangs dharmā ni/ /bsam yarga sadabu rtse na bzhugs sgo/ /lha sras khri sgong sde'u btsan gyis/ /gtsug lag khang ni rgya chen bzhengs/ /dha mi bod yul dar zhing gyos/ /mdo sngags gnyis su gsol/lo skad/ / de ni 'gyur byang dkar chag go /gal te kun la yod na ngo mtshar chung / /kun gyis shes na mkhas pa tsu yis byen/ /'o na 'bum sde lnga la/ rgyas pa 'bume ni/ blo/ka babum yod pa'i phyir na 'bum zhes bya'o/ dkon cog brtsegs pa'i 'bum ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mi mthun pa 'bum yod pas na 'bu zhes bya'o/ /phal po rte ska smo/go sam zhabum yod pas na 'bum zhes bya'o/ /de la mtshan dgu brnye tshang ze ni 'phagardo pa gling mo lam bstane gyi nang rdo me gas so/ 1mya ngan 'das pa'i 'bum ni ston pa sku mya ngan salas 'da' khar zhal chemes bzhag pa'i phyire naba'abum mo/ /'a phag po la' gar gshegs papo'abrem ni/ srin po'i yul lang ka pu ra ngas kyi ma do sdi lang gar gshe gas pa bzhengs su gsol nas srin po 'bum btul ba dang / / rnam grangs 'bum yod pas na 'buyo zhes bya'o/ /lo pakho meka'i thang yig las byang sems theg pa'i thun tshogs bstan pa'i ledu ste ba co lnga pa'o/ /༷ rdo rta ཿ bya rgyud kyi phun tshogs bstan pa/bya ba'i rgyud kyi phun/suska/tshogasnya lnga ni/ /nasangag gyizhi sbrug sku rigs gsum mgon po'i tshul/ /ri bo ma la ya yi ste la sog / /'khor ni lha dang mi yi rig 'dzin1la/ /rgyud sde stong phrag bzhi tsam gsungs pa las/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi kri ya sde drug ni/ 1ribakalngags spun gyi khog dbubs dpung bzang rgyud/ /rig sngags dbang bskur phyag rdor dbang bskur rgyud/ /rig sngags ting 'dzin 359

cha/ chog p+ton rig pa mchog rig sngags 'dul pa legs par grub pa'i rgyud/ 1ngareg sngags 'phrin las khro bo khams gsu ma rgyal/ /rig sngags dgongs pa chabasam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud/ /bya ba bye phrag rgyud/gsum 'jam dpal skor/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi skor dang phyag rdor skor/ /kri/ya'i rgyud sde lnga brgya klu yul /bzhugs/ /de rnams sdud༅ po ni rigs gsum mo/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las bya rgyud kyi phan tshogs bstan pa'i le' ste bca drug pa'o/ / 1/ sa naX ) rdo ri ri ༷ —༷ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phun tshogs bstan ba/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phu/ sum tshogs rte ni / /longs sku'i yobs sku rigs bzhi'i sangs rgyas tshul/ /gnas ni dga' ldan dang ni gzugs khams so/ 'khor ni 'dod khams lha dang gzugs khams lha/ /rgyud/sde stong phrag drug las 'di ru ni/ /u pa ya yi/rgyud sde chen po bzhi/ /rnam par snang mdzad mngon ༷ par bung chub rgyud/ /nyi ma gathi brjed rig 'dzinartasde sgod rgyud/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud sde rnams/ /sdud pa po ni phyag na rdo rje'o/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phun tshogs bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o/ / / /༷ rnal/'byor snyid kyi gno tshogs bsnyen pa/rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phun sum tshog lnga ni/ /longs/sku'i chos sku rnam par ༷snang mdzad kyi/ 1thun mong gnas ni sum cu rtsa gsum dang / khyad par gnage ni thog min la sogs su/ /lha dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la/ /360

rnal 'byor rgyud sde stong phrag bcu gsum gsungs/ /yo ga'i rnyisde tsun bam po gum brgya dang / /yo ga lung sems la ni rgyud sde bzhi/ kho na nyide 'odupa ta shā saṃ gra ha/ /ba sha ha kar rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud/ /dpal mchog dang po/bar ma ba rta'i rgyud go /rtogs pa bstsas pa'i rgyud rnams phyag rdor bsdus/ / lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las rnal 'byor rgyurda kyi phun tshogs bstan pa'i lethu ste btso brgyad pa'o// /1 ma hā yo gzhi/phun tshorgag rbasnyen pa/ma hā yo ga'i phun sum tshogs lnga ni1 /chos sku'i long/ sku rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /thun mong gnas ni ma la ya yi rtser/ khyad par gnas ni yum gyi mkha' klong du/ /'khor ni byang chub sems dpa' sems/ma'i tshogs/ /shu ni phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor rnams la bshad/ /rnal 'byor pho rgyud bye ba drug gsungs las/ /a nu sho ga dang ni thun mong du/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud drug sgrub luṭa rgyud dgu ste/ /sku yi sbyor ba sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / /gsung gi sbyor ba zla gsang thig le dang / /thugs kyi sbyor ba gsang ba 'dusgo pa dang / /dgongs 'grel kun gyi rgyu ni rnam snang rgyud/ /tshogs kyi 'phrin las lha /sgo sgyu 'phrul dang / /rnal 'byor mchog rgyud rdo rje gad na bzhi dang / /budhe'i sgrub luges me ltar 'bar ba'i rgyud/ /rdo rje'i sgrub lugs phuṇ+ḍa rī ka'i rgyud/ /rin cen sgrub lugs rin cen ma gol rgyud/ /pad+ma'i sgrub lugs rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud/ /las kyi sgrub lugs lha mo ma gol rgyud/ 1rigs lnga'i spyi sgrub he ru ka 'dus rgyud/ khro bo'i sgrub lugs ya ma rā dza dang / /ma mo'i sgrub lurgas srid pa'i rgyud lung dang / /bdud rtsi'i sgrub lugs bam po brgyad pa sogs/ /zhu 3snye1

/dang bsdu ba mo ni rdo rje chos/ /shākya thub pa mya ngan 'dago nas su/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad song tsa na/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yis/ /ri bo ma la ya yi rtse mo ru/ /pad+ma gar/dbang rta mgrin rgyud rnams dang / /gsang 'dus lha tshogs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ /nyi badz+ra lha1tshogs bcu gsum pa/ /ma hā mā tsā lha lnga pa/ /'jigs byed lha tshogs bcu gsum ba/ /dgyes/rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang / /bde mchog lha tshogs drug cu rtsa gnyis pa/ /bcu gsum pa dang lha lnga pa/ /sasbu ṭa dang rdo rje gdan bzhi dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dus kyi 'khor lo rnams/ /dam pa'i rigs chen lnga la bshad/ /srin po blo gros thabs ldan dang / /lha ni grags ldan chos skyong dang / /klu ni 'jog po gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / /mi ni li tsa byi zhes dri ma med/ /rgyud la dbye na bcu bzhi yod/ /gser gyi char pa lta bu 'i rgyud/ /dga' byed za nus las kyi rgyud/ /sa bhū ta nyi la bka' yi rgyud/ /gsang ba yid bde ma hā mā yā/ /snying po dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud/ /snying po bsdus rgyud rdo rje gur/ /dgyes rdor glo ka 'bum tsho lnga/ /brtag pa sum cu so gnyis mad/ /brjod bya rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyud/ /le'u stong phrag sug cu shod/ /gu ru pad+ma'i phur pa'i dkar chag la//༷sprir phur pa la rgyud sde mang du bzhugs/ /bod du bzhi bcu tham pa bsgyur/ /0de la phye na co ba'i rgyud gsum/ snying po'i rgyud lnga/ lo ma'i rgyud gesum/ yal gasle rgyud bcu/ bshad pa'i rgyud dgu lta ba'i/rgyud gcig spyod 'i rgyud gcig yon tan gyi rgyud gcig 'dzin las kyi rgyud gcig dgongs pa'i rgyud gnyis ki lnga ya'i rgyud gnyis/ phyi ma'i rgyud gcig mdo rgyud gcig dang bzhi bcu/ de la rgyas par dbye na/ rtsa ba'i rgyud la gsum/ byi blortom la 'bum sde'i rgyud/ sbas pa gsang ba'i rgyud1 mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyud do/ /lo mgo'i rgyud gsum ni/ sha na dkar nag gi rgyud/ sbas pa nag po'i rgyud/ bas 363

casgom dman po'i rgyud dad gsum mo/ /snying po'i rgyud lnga la1 rdo rje 'bar ba'i rgyud/ rin rten/'barartoga'i rgyud pad+ma 'bar ba'i rgyud/ karma gu ru 'byed pa'i rgyud dang lnga'o/ di /yalu ga'i rgyudadobacu ni/ khro/bo bcu la rgyud re re bzhugs/ bshad pa'i rgyud dgu ni/ rdo rje rtse/mo/ ye shes rtse mo/ sang rgyas rtse mo/ rdo/rje snying po'i rgyud/ rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud/ rdo rje phreng brde rgyud/ 'dzig rten phreng ba'i rgyud/ drag po mdung rtse'i rgyud/ gab pho 'khoradego'i rgyud dang dgu'o/ /lta ba'i rgyud sangs rgyam 'dus pa/ spyod pa'i rgyud thig le mchog yon tan gyi (15/mngon par rtogs pa/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud gsang rgyud/ke lnga ya 'asdomatsho/ba'i rgyud dang / ki lnga ya 'byung ba'i trat+ta khungs kyi tasbya chuja ba'o/ /dgongs pa'i rgyud la gnyis te dgongs rgyud che chung gnyis so/ 1rgyud khru mar gyur pa la thebs kyi zhags pa pad+ma phreng ba/ de rnams kyi mdo ru gyurnga pa dur sgod khu byug rol pa'i mdo phyi moranabacas pa ste bzhi bcu tham pa'o/ 1phur pa 'phrin las kyi sgrub par btags pa yang / phyi nang gi chos thams cad phur pa'i ngang du gnas la/ phur pa'i rgyud bzhir 'dus/ rego pa ye shes kyi phur/pa dang / lhag pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa dang / thugs rjes sprul pa'i phur pa dang / 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa da nga bzhi'o/ /de ltar phur ba bsgo po 'di gdab par bya ba la yang dmigs par bya ba'i yul bzhi/ gdab par bya saba'i thabs bzhi/ 'debs par bya ba'i grogs bzhi/ thebs pa'i rtags ba zhi/ btab pa'i dgos byed bzhi/ ma thebs pa'i skyon bzhi/ thebs pa'i 'bras bu bzhi las/ de la dmigs par bya ba'i yul pozhi ni/ skyos kyi dbyings deng / yum gyi mkha' dang / 'bo /ba rigs drug dang / game la dmigs pu/bzhi'o//gdab par bya ba'i thabs bzhi ni/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa chos kyi dbyings su gdab/ lhag pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkhe' la gdab/ thugs 363

rjes spru la ba'i phur pa 'gro ba digs drug la gdab/ 'dus byas rjas kyi phur pa gang la dmigs pa de la gdab pa dang bzhi'o/ 'debs par zu ba'i grogs bzhi ni/ shes rab ting 'dzin snyeng rje tshad med dang bzhi'o/ /cho ga bsnyen sgrub min lag bzhi'o/ /thebs pa'i rtags bzhi ni/ chos kyi dgyings gu thebs pas ye shes 'char/ yum gyi mkha' la thebs pas gnyis med sbyor/ 'gro ba rigs drug la thebs pas thugs rjes zin/ gang la dmigs pa la thebs pas bstan pa tshugs pa dang bzhi'o/ /dgos byed bzhi ni/ porig pa shā shes kyi phur pa chos kyi dbyings su thebs pa'i dgos pa ni byang chub thob pa'i dgos pa yod/byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gye mkha' la thebs pa'i dgos pa ni bdag sras gzhan sras su byin gyis brlab pa'i dgos pa yod/ thugs rjes sprul pa'i phur pa /rigs drug gi sems can la/thebs pa'i dgos pa ni byang chub sems kyi dpyang mthag chad pa la thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i dgos pa yod/ 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa cha gang la dmigs pa la thebs pa'i dgos pa ni bstan pa'i snyeng go/tshugs pa'i / dgos pa yod pa dang bzhi'o/ /ma thebs pa'i skyon bzhi ni/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur pa chos kyi dbyings su ma thebs rga 'khor ba las mi sgrol/ byang chub sems /kyi phur pa yum gyi gakha' la ma thebs na dam mig semasarapagi dkyil 'khor rgyun chad/ thugs rjes sprul pa'i phur pa rigs drug la ma thebs na 'khor bar gtan du 'khyams/ 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa gang la dmigs pa la ma thebs /na bstan pa'i snying po mi tshugs pa dang bzhi'o/ /thebs pa'i 'bras bu bzhi ni/ rig pa ye shes kyi phur/pa chos kyi dbyings su thebs pas 'bras bu chos sku thopa/ byang chub sems kyi phur pa yum gyi mkha' la thebs pas 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob/ thugs rjes sprul pa'i phur pa 'gro ba rigs drug la thebs pas 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob/ 'dus byas rdzas kyi phur pa gnyis te/ 'dus byas 36

/btags pa ming gi phur pa dang / 'dus byas byin rlabs rtags kyi phur pa/gnyis so/ /'dus byas btags pa ming gi pyor pa ni dud 'apo'i phur pa la sogs pa thams cad do/ /byin rlabs rtags kyi phur pa la bzhi ste/ dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams ga masgo/bo rgya shadud rtse go blun por/byas/pa/ni zhi ba'i phur pa'i rgyu'o/ /gser ram ser po'i shing rnams/la mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo gru bzhir byas pa/ni rgyas pa'i phur da'i rgyu'o/ /zangs sam dmar go'i shing rna mas la mgo bo rgya mdud rtse/so/zla gam byas pa ni/dbang gi phu ra pa'i rgyu'o/ /stogs somi drage /po'i shing rna sa la mgo mjug ma nor pe pazhogs la ring thung tshad dang ldan ba camarga bo rgya mdud rtse mo zur gsugargyagashog pa byas pa ni drag po'i phur pa'i 1 rgyu'o/ /de ltar 'azhin lag rnam bzhi'i phur tha ni gdab par bya me laphong bzhi/zhi ba'i phur pa yul 'jigs pa brgyad la gdab/༷ rgyag pa'i phur pa 'byor pa drug la gdab/ dbang gi phur pa nyon mongs me bzhi/la gdab/ drag po'i phur pa/dgra bgegs gnyis la gdab sto/ /da sgo dkyil1'khori gamum la bca'/ /grogs sgo bsnyen sgrubagoyan lag bzhi/ 'bras bu sku lnga ye shes lnge/ phur pa 'phrin shas sbrub1pa'o/ /zhes byung bas1 phur pa la thebs pa gsum yod1 'dod lngas ska gzugs khams ga zugs med khamasagaraXsnyebs pa dang gsum/sgo/ /ti pacange la'adzin rna pa/pa gsum bsgoms pas sgo/gzugs khams la thebs/ dkyele 'khor chogasum bsgoms pasi/nipa'idod khams/sa thebs/ dkyil 'khod rnam pha gsum stong snyed du bsgoms pas ni gzugaso med khams la sdebs pa'o/ /sha la thebs pa dang / rus pa la thebs pa deng khrag la thebs pa dang / dbugs rga thebs /pa dang bzhi lag/ de bzhin nyid kyi ti nga nge 'dzin bsgoms pas ni dbugs thebs pa'o// /ye shes sems/dpa' bsgoms pase ni rus pa la thebs pa'o/ //khro bo bcu bsgoms pas ni khrug la thebs pa'o/ 1dwam tshig sems/dpa'/365

bsgoms pas ni sha la thebs pa'o/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las ma hā yo ga'i phun tshogs bstan pa'i lenyu ste bcu dgu pa'o// //ma nu yo ga'i/phun tshogs bstan pa/ma nu yo ga'i phun sum tshogs lnga ni/ /chos sku'i longs sku rdo rje 'chang / chi na gyis/ khyad par gnas ni 'og min stug po bkod/ /thun mong gnas ni de rgyal po pu ra'i tshal/ khyad par 'khor ni rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas te/ /thun mong //'khor ni lad ka'i bdag po sogs/ /ma rgyud bye ba phrag ni bcu drug la/ 1ma hā yo ga dang ni thun mong du1 /sgyu 'phrul gsang snying sgyu 'phrul le lag dang / /thabs kyi zhagasha pa pad+ma'i breng ba sogs/ 1sgyu 'phrul sde drug lung yig bdun cu gsungs/ /sdud pa po ni rdo rje sems dpas bsdus/ /a nu'i rgyud lung nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /lung gi rgyud lnga lung gi lung dgu dang / /lung gi man ngag nyid dang bcu gcig go /thung gi rgyud lnga la1 te ru ka gal po/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mdo/ he ru ka 'dus pa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gi lu ya bcu gnyis kyi tatre+eto/ lung gi lung dgu ni/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i tatre/dbang chen 'dus pa'i tasbyo/ gtor tshogs rgya mtsho'i tan+t+ra/ lha mo ma gol ma'i tabye/ rig 'dzin drug gi tan+t+ra/ gsang ba stong gis brgyan pa'i tasbyo/ gsang ba gtan tshigs kyi tat+ta/ ya mārta ka'i tastu bam po brgyad pa'o/ /lung gi man ngag bcu gcig ni/ lung gi mas lnga dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po drug go /lung gi mdo lnga ni/ yang dag kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/ phur pa khu byug rol pa'i mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rngam pa glog gi mdo/ sems phyogs sems lung chen mo'i mdo/spyi mdo dgos pa 'dus pa'i mdo'o/ /lung gi rgyud drug ni/ kun tu bzang po'i 366

che ba rang la gnas pa'i rgyud/ dbang bskur rgyal po'i rgyud/ dam chig sa ma ya bkod pa rgyal po'i rgyud/ ting nge 'dzin rig pa mtshog gi rgyud/ 'phrin las kha sbyor bdun pa'i rgyud/ spyod pa don dang ldan pa'i rgyud do/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las a nu yo ga'i phun tshogs bstan pa'i leg ste nyi shu pa'o// //ma ti yo ga'i/phun tshogs bstade pa/ ma ti yo ga'i phun sum tshogs lnga ni/ chos sku'i chos sku kun tu bzang po'i tshul/ /gnas ni chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /'khor ni nyid la nyid kyes bshad pa ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rigs byed/lnga3brgya'o/ /chom di bye ba phrag ni sum cu gnyis/ /de las btus pas rgyud sde khri phrag gnyis/ /mdor bsdus nyi shu rtsa gcig bco brgyad do/ /rdzogs pa rdo na po rgya gar chos lugs bzhi/ /rgyal ba'i chos lugs rgyud sde man ngag dang / /'phags pa'i chos ༷lugs rgyud sde man ngag dang / /rgyal po'i chos lugs rgyud sde man ngag dang / /bram ze'i chos lugs rgyud sde man ngag go /bod du baspyor ba sems klong man ngag sde/ /sems sde la ni rgyud sde stong dgu brgya/ /klong sde la ni klong skor bcu gnyis rgyud/ /man ngag sde la batham gyis mi khyab rgyud/ /sgom pa'i rgyud sde snga 'gyur lnga po ni/ khyung chen sding ba sgom pa don drug pa/ /rig pa'i khu byug rtsal chen sprugs pa dang / /nam mkha' che'o phyi 'gyur bcu gnyis ni/ /rje btsun dam pa yid bzhin nor bu dang / /rin cen ku na 'dus rdzogs pa spyi spyod dang / /byang sems bde 'byams srog gi 'khor lo/dang / /bde ba phra bkod rmad du byung ba dang / rtse mo byung rgyal byang chub sem sa tige dang / /byang sems spyi chings rgyang sems myu gu'o/ /sdud pa po ni ston pa nyid kyis bsdus/ /de 367

ltar chos rnams gsungs pa'i tshad bstan nas/ /theg chen la sogs gzhan yangabamado sde rnams/ /dung phyur phrag gnyis gsungs pa yin/ /de bzhin pha rol phye na pa'i tshul/ /sa ya dang ni dung phyur lnga/ /rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud kyi tshad/ / bye ba/ phrag/ni drug tu/nges/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug go /'di deg thams cad thub dbang po/ /sku gsum bdag nyid can gyes gsungs/ /bya ba'i rgyud la stong phrag gzhi/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la stong phrag brgyad/ /rnal 'byor stong phrag pacu drug ste/ /rgyud sde stong phrag de rnams kyi/ /togs pa phra mo ston pa yi/ /rgyud sde stong phrag bzhi nyid de/ /de ltar sum cu so bzhi'o/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las a ti yo ga'i phun tshogs bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer gcig pa'o/ / //—spyi ti skyes/ga'i phun tshogs bstan pa/ / spyi/ti yo ga'i phun sum tshogs lnga ni/ /sku gsum dbyer med kun tu 'chang gi tshul// /gnas ni bkod pa lhun grub pho brang du/ /'khor ni rigs 'dzin rgyal podakun dzagar/ /dam pa'i rigs chen lnga la sobashis/banas/ /chos nidzi'abras bu las rgyud gcod pa la/ khyad par theg pa rim pa dgu gsungs te/ /sgo dbye brda sgo 'dul byed theg pa dang / /snang byed ston pas 'dul gyed theg pa dang / /tshis byed bde bas 'dul byed theg pa dang / /'di gsum rgyu 'khor rgyun gyi theg pa'o/ 1dka' thub rigs byed jeg pa dang / /kun 'byung bden pa'i sgeg sa dang / /dbang sgyur thabs/kyi theg pa ste/ /'di gsum don dam nges pa'i theg pa'o/ /zhen pa las rgyud gcod pa'i theg pa dang / /dregs ma las rgyud gcod pa'i theg pa dang / /rmongs pa las rgyud gcod pa'i theg pa 368

bsgrib pa thams da rnam par sbyong ba/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ ngo salangs bdun pa/ stong 'khyil pa/ lha mo sgra dbyangs/ dpal gyi lha mo chen —mo / mchod pa'i sprin/ stobs po che/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ tshe dpag med/༷tshe dashag med kyi snying po/ gtsug tor/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba/ kun nas sgor 'jug pa/ sangs rgyas bdun pa/ sgol ma mchog gi gzugs/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa/ nor gyi rgyun/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ sgo bzang po/ dri ma med pa/ khyad par can/ rgyal ba can/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed/ mtshan mo bzang po/ rgyal ba'i bla ma/ 'od dpag med/ snang brgyad/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ rims thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ sman gtong ba'i sngags/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa/ chos thams cad kyi yum/ zhal bcu gcig pa/ bcings pa 'grol ba/ snying rjes mi chod pa/ don yod zhags pa/ nad med par gyur pa/ sangs rgyas bcu/gnyis pa/ blo no ba/ sangs rgyas snying po/ kun tu bzang po/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa/ ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya/ shes rab skyed pa/ dbyig dang ldan pa/ yi ge drug pa/ 'phags pa gzungs chen mo/ bar du gcod pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba/ gtsug gi nor bu/ phyir bzlog rnam par rgyal ba can/ phyir bzlog stobs chen/ me tog brtsegs pa/ ga'i dbang po chen po/ 'gro lding ba/ bu mang po rton pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ lha mo nag mo/lha mo 'od zer can/ dpal chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa/ lha mo nam gru/dpal rgen/mo'i mdo/ bdud rtsi sman/ dpal chen mo/ bar+ṇa sha ba ri/ lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ mig nad zhi bar byed pa/ tshogs kyi dedag po/gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ rin po che'i/phreng ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying 370

po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ mgrin pa snyan pa/ rma bya'i snying po/ rig pa'i rgyal mo/ sgo mtha' yas/ gza'i yum/ gnam lcags mchu ste dgu bcu go gcig go /spyi ti snying tig rgyud nyi shu'i sdud pa po ni mokha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'o/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las spyi ti yo ga'i phun tshogs pastan pa'i le'u ste nyer gasdis/pa'o// // zeg pa'i shan 'byed bstan pa/theg pa'i shan 'byed bstan pa ni/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 'a das//'jig rten pa yi theg par gnyis/ /lha mi'i theg dang mu stegs theg /lha mi'i theg pa la yang bzhi/ /ngo bo nges chig dbye ba khyad/ /ngo bo lha mi'i lta spyod bsdongs/ /nges tshig bsod nams bsag pa'o/ /dbye ba lha dang mi gnyis so//khyad par dge ba bcu dang ni/ /mi yi chos lugs bcu drug dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsam gtan bzhi/ /mu stegs pa yi theg pa ni/ /bstan pa'i tshul yaja rnam genyis te/ /dman pa mu stegs bstan pa dang / /mchog gyur sangs rgyas bstan pa'o/ /tshu stegs theg pa la yaja bzhi/ / ngo bo nges chi gi dbye ba khyad/ /ngo bo log spyodi sna tshogs pa/ /nges tshig lta ngan rtog byas nas/ /spyod ba ngan la thu btsugs so/ /dbye na sum brgya drug cu gnyis/ khyad par grub mtha'i le'u nyi shu tsam/ /'jig rten 'das ba'i theg pa la ni bzhi/ /ngo bo nges chig khyade par dbye ba la/ /ngo bo rang bzhin shes rab snyeng rje ste/ che chung dbang gis theg pa'i rim pa bstan/ /nges tshig sems bskyed che chung ste/ /theg pa che dang chung ba'o/ khyad par bdun gyiso 'phags pa ste/ /lta ba spyobs gnas mchod pa dang / /spyod pa 'bras bu grub pa'i mtha'/ /dam chos 371

sogs pa bdun gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams khyad du 'phags/ /dbye ba theg pa dgu 'am bcu/ /thun mong khyad par gnyis su dbye/ /byang chub sems kyi chos nyid de1 /yod ni gcig mas med pa la/ /byung ni snang srid kun tu byung / khyab ni snang srid kun la khyab/ /bstan ni theg pa bcu ru bstan/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems gsum/ /kro ya u pa yo ga gsum/ /ma hā a nu a ti gsum/ /spyi ti yang ti mtha' chen gsum/ /ji srid rnam rtog ma zad par//theg pa'i mtha' la byeke pa med/ /nyan thos theg pa la yang bzhi/ /ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba khyad/ /ngo bo nyan thos lta spyod bsdongs/ nges chig ston pas gsungs pa'i chos/ /yid kyis nyan pas rna bar thos/ /dbye na sprul pa'i nyan thos dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i nyan thos dang / /grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i nyan thos dang / /mngon pa'i nga rgyal can dang ni/ /zhi ba bgrod dab phyogs chagacig pa/ /de las gyes pa rnam pa bzhi /gnas brtan pa dang phal chen pa/ //thams cad yod smra mang pos bkur/ /de las gyes pa bco brgyad do/ /phal /chen mkhan po 'od srungs kyi/ /rigs ni bram ze lha yi skad/ /snam sbyar dum /dgu nyer lnga'i bar/ /rtags ni ut+pa las mtshan pa/ /de las lngar gyes shar ༷ri'i sde/ /nub ri gangs ri gnas pa'i sde/ /'jig rten 'das smra ga par smra///yod smra'i mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin/ /rgyal rigs saṃ skro ta yi skad/ snam sbyar ༷dum dgu nyer lnga'i bar/ / ut+pal pad+ma rin cen mtshan/ /de las gzhi kun yod smra dang / 'od srungs sa srungs chos spungs te/ /mang thos gos dmar can /gyi sde/ /rnam par phye ste gsal sde bdun/ /gnas brtan mkhan po kā hā ya/ / dmangs rigs skad ni zur chag pa/ /snam spur dum dgu spyod lnga 'i bar/ /rtaṭa ni g.yung drung gis mtshan pa1 /de las rgyal byed tshal gnas dang / /'jigs med ri gnas gtsug lag khang / /mang pos bkur ba'i mkhan po ni/ /nye ba 372

ma byang sems lta spyod bsdongs/ /nges tshig ston mongs ma lus byang / /ye shes khong du chub pa dang / /gzhan don sems shing de la dpa'/ /dbye na dbang po no rtul gnyis/ khyad par 'phags tshul bstan pa ni/ /rang rgyal lta sgom spyod 'bras las/ /byang sems khyad par bzhis 'phags te/ /lta ba bdag med rnam gnyis rtogs/ /sgom pa byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /sun cu rtsa bdun bsgom pa'o/ /spyod pa pha rol phyin pa dang / /bsdu pa bzhi yis gzhan don spyod/ /'bras bu bcu gcig kun tu 'od/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang/yig las byang sems theg pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga paX// //kre ya'i/jeg pa bstan pa/kri ya'i theg pa la yang gasnam/ /ngo bo nges tshig/dbye ba'o/ /ngo bo kro ya'i lta spyod bsdongs/ /ngeshe chig/lus ngag yid kyi ni/ /bya ba gartsa bas bya ba'i rgyud/ /kri ga'i dbye ba rnarga bcu la/ /dang po kri ya'i dam tshig ni/ /dkon rtsag gsum dang slob dpon dang / /rdo rje spun dang ming sring dang / /gnyis pa kri ya'i spyod pa ni/ /ste thog sngags dang spyod pa dang / /'di rnams gtsang ma'i spyod gar gsungag/ /gsum pa gi ya'i lta ba ni/ /ye shes sems dpa' rjer dmigs te/ /dam chig sems dpa' bran du dmigs/ /lha la katsang ma'i mchod pas mchod/ / dbang dang dngos grub thob bar bsam/ bzhi pa kri ya'i ye shes ni/ /nyan thos mdo sde thams cad dang / /de bzhin kri ya'i khyad par gyis/ /gsag bad ma gyur gang/yang sked1 /ye shes kun gyi khyad par grub/ /lnga pa kri ya'i rjegs martsed ni/ /darme chig dngo dang spyod pa dang / /rdo rje semam dpadi ye shes kyis/ /tshogs su ma gyur gang yang med/ 1'di ni 374

tshogs mchod dam pa'o/ /drug pa kri ya'i sangs rgyas ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal thams cad dang / /mdo sde dbu ma'i khyad par las/ /de bzhin kri ya 'phaṭa pas te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa brnyes so/ /bdun pa kri ya'i 'phrin las ni/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang drag rnams/ /gtsang ma spyod pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ /sems can don la rab tu brtson/ /brgyad pa kri ya'i sgrib pa ni/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / /dam tshig sprib pa gang yin pa/ /bdag gis de dag rab bsal nas/ /skad cig gcig gis byang bar 'gyur/ /dgu pa kri ya'i rig 'dzin ni/ /de bzhin dam tshig spyod pa dang / /lta ba ye shes tshogs rnams kyis1 /sangs rgyas 'phrin las kun rdzogs nas/ /'di ni rig 'dzin sa yin no/ /bcu pa kri ya'i chad pa ni/ /dam tshig nyams dang lta ba nyams/ /sgrub dang spyod pa nyams rnams kyis/ / 'bras bu sangs rgyas mi thob ste/ /de ni chags pa'i gnas su ldang / /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las kri ya'i theg pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o// //yo ga'i jeg pa bstan pa/yo ga'i theg pa la yang gsum/ /ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba'o/ /ngo bo yo ga'i lta spyod bsdongs/ /nges chig chos nyid rnal ma la/ /rig pa ye shes 'byor pa'o/ /gsum pa dbye ba la yang bcu/ /dang po yo ga'i dam tshig ni/ /darkan cog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /rdo rje slob dpon lha ltar dmigs/ / rdo rje spun dang ming sring dang / /dbang ma thob par mchod pa dang / /lta ba dman la mi smod cing / /rdo rje dril bu bcang bar bya/ /gnyis pa yo ga'i spyod pa ni1 1ting nge 'dzin gyis gtsor byas te/ /de ltar dam tshig spyod pa rnams/ /375

shin tu gzhung dang mthun par spyad/ /sbyor dang sgrol ba a spo ta/ /'di dag spyod par ma gsungs so/ /gsum pa yo ga'i lta ba ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyes gtsor byas nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' grogs su dmigs/ /yid kyis mngon sum spyan drangs te/ /bdag gi mdun na bzhugs par bsago/ /bzhi pa yo ga'i ye shes ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal u pa dang / /de bzhin kri ya'i gzhung lugs rnams/ /gzhan yang spyod pa thams cad kun/ /gsal bar ma gyur gang yang med/ /lnga pa yo ga'i rnal 'byor ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyis/ /yang dang yang du lce dkyil sngags/ /snying pos badzor ba cho 'phrul bzhi/ /drug pa yo ga'i sangs rgyas ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nga las byung / /bdag dang sangs rgyas sems can rnams/ /dbye ba re bya ba rdul tsam med/ /'di ltar rtogs na sangs rgyas rnams/ bdun pa yo ga'i 'phrin las ni/ /ting nge 'dzin byes gtsor gyur te/ /'od zer 'phro 'du mang po dang / /zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod dang / /sems can mang po'i don bya'o/ /brgyad pa yo ga'i sgrib pa ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis gartsar byas te/ /nyan thos rang rgyal thams cad dang / /u pa kri ya la sogs pa/ /ma rtogs pa ni ci yang med/ /dgu pa yo ga'i rig 'dzin ni/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gyis/ /ji ltar dam tshig spyod pa dang / /lta ba ye shes gsal gyur nas/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa non no/ /bcu pa yo ga'i chad pa ni/ /u pa rnams kyi chad pa dang / /kri ya'i dam tshig lta ba dang / /spyod pa ma rtogs gcig kyang med/ /lo paṇa bka'i5thang yig las yo ga'i theg pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer bdun pa'o/ / / /༷ ma hā yo ga'i theg pa bstan pa/ma hā yo ga'i theg par gsum/ /ngo bo nges chig dbye ba'o/ /ngo bo ma 376

hā'i lta spyod bsdongs/ /nges chig ting 'dzin rnam gsum gyes/ /lha yi sku ru bgyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ma hā'i dbye ba bcu/ /dang po ma hā'i dam tshig ni/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rgesum/ /de bzhin nga rkul phrag dog dang / 1rnal 'byor chen po'i dam tshig ni/ /khyang dang mthun par shin tu gsungs/ /gnyis pa ma hā'i spyod pa ni/ /sbyor ba dang ni sgol ba dang / /ma byin pa ni gang len pa/ /'di ni dam chig spyod pa yin/ /rnal 'byor pas ni dang du blang / /gsum pa ma hā'i lta ba ni/ 1sangs rgyas sems can thams cad dang / /mtshan mar btags pa thams cad kun/ /dbyings su ma dī+or gang yang ped/ /de bas sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /mtshan mar gyur pa thams cad ni/ /mnyam pa'i ngang du rab tu gsal/ /bzhi pa ma hā'i ye shes ni/ /nyan thos mdo rgyud thams cad dang / /kri ya yo ga'i khyad par gyis/ /rang gi blo la shin tu gsal/ /dag pa'i ye shes dam pa'o/ /lnga pa ma hā'i tshogs mchod ni/ /legs pa'i yon tan mi brjod cing / /mtshan ma'i nyes pa mi smod par/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /'di ni tshogs mchod khyad par 'phags/ 1drug pa ma hā'i sangs rgyas ni/ /gzugs su snang pa rnam snang rmayod/ /tshig gi dngos po snang mtha' yas/ /rnam par shes pa 8ོbrje sems/ /yid bzhin rin cen 'byung ldan gtso/ 1'phrin las rnam pa don yod grub/ /bdun pa ma hā'i 'phrin las ni/ /nya na dang ni ga na tshogs/ /bzhi bcu dang ni ldan pa'i tshe/ 1dbang phyug chen po'i spyod pa ni/ /ci la yang ni thogs med spyod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs par mdzad/ /brgyad pa ma hā'i sgrib pa ni/ /ci yang thogs pa med pang spyod/ ci/phyi yi yul dang nang gi sems/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gnas/ /'di la sgrib dang mi sgrib med/ /mnyam pa'i rgyal po yongs la grub/ /dgu pa ma hā'i rig 'dzin sdi/ /sku gsung thugs dang dbang phyug gnas/ /377

phung po lnga don yi shepha lnga/ /thams cad dbyings su gyur pa'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin sa yi rang bzhin no/ /bcu pa ma hā'i chad pa ni/ /nyan thos rang rgyal u pa dang / /de bzhin kri ya yo ga rnams/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad par du/ /ma gtogs pa ni gcig kyang med/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las ma hā yo ga'i theg pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer brgyad pa'o// //ma ṅge yo ga'i jeg pa bstan pa/a nu yo ga'i theg pa la yang gsum/ /ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba'o/ /ngo bo a nu'i lta spyod bsdongs/ /nges tshig rnal 'byor bla na med/ /gsum pa a nu'i che ba bcu/ /dang po a nu'i dam chig ni/ /rang gi lta ba dam tshig ste/ /de ni rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /dam tshig chen po nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa a nu'i spyod pa ni/ /thams cad mnyam pa nyid gnas shing / /teng nge 'dzin gyis byen brlabs so/ /dngos su spyod pa thams cad bya/ /gal te de ltar ma nus na/ /nyes pa rdul tsam med par bshad/ /gsum pa a nu'i lta ba ni/ /yul du snang ba yum gyi dbyings/ /de bzhin gzugs kun yab kyi mkha'/ /de ltar tshud pa'i skyes mchog de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan rnams rdzogs/ / bzhi pa a nu'i ye shes ni/ /srid pa gsum gyi sems can dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal u pa dang / /de bzhin kri yog rnal 'byor kun/ /thams cad ye shes ngang du gsal/ /lnga pa a nu'i tshogs mchod ni/ /dam chig spyod dang ye sheg dang / /gzhan yang mi yi rtog pa kun/ /phyi dang nang gi spyod lul rnams/ /rtogs na ye shes tshoshes su gsungs/ /drug pa a nu'i sangs rgyas ni/ /sku ni ma skyes stong pa nyid/ gsung ni rang bzhin smon pa med/ /thugs ni ma g.yos chos nyid 378

thugs/ /'di las gzhan na sangs rgyas med/ /bdun pa a nu'i 'phrin las ni/ /mnyam pa chen po'i dbang bsgyur nas/ /sems can thams cad dbyings la bkod/ /mtshan mar btags pa thams cad ni/ /ye shes gsal ba dbyings la bkod/ ( /'di ni las rnams rdzogs pa yin/ /gzhan du 'phrin las ci yang med/ /brgyad pa a du'i sgrib pa ni/ /sdug bsngal nyid ni byang chub la/ /'khor ba nyid ni mya ngan 'das/ /de bzhin sgrib pa chos kyi dbyings/ 1sgrib pa nyid ni byang chub 'thob/ /dgu pa a nu'i rig 'dzin ni/ /rig pa rmad pa'i rig 'dzin gyi/ /sa dang sa yi rim pa ni/ /gcig tu chad pa med pas na/ /'di ni rig 'dzin sa yin no/ /bcu pa a nu'i chad pa ni/ /sku ni mi g.yo dbyings su 'gyur/ /gsung ni thams cad kun la spro/ /thugs ni rang bzhin ngang la gnas/ /chad pa'i gnas ni sku gsung/thugs/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las a nu yo ga'i theg pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer dgu pa'o// / /༷ ma tisde rjeg pa bstan pa/a ti'i theg pa la yang gsum/ /ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba'o/ /ngo bo a ti'i lta spyod bsdongs/ /nges chig shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /a ti'i bya ba la yang bcu/ /dang po a ti'i dam tshig ni/ /rmad pa dang ni 'chal pa yin/ /gcig pu dang ni lhun gyis grub/ /rigs su chad pa med pas na/ /'di ni dam chig mchog tu gsungs/ /gnyis pa a ti'i spyod pa ni/ /spyod par ma grub gang yang med/ /mu stegs kri ya'i spyod pa dang / /srid gsum sems can thams cad dang / /'gro ba rigs drug la sogs pa/ /skye ba rnam bzhir gtogs pa rnams/ /sgogs te rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /gsum pa a ti'i 373

lta ba ni/ /ma spangs bzhin du lhun gyis rdzogs/ /dbye ba med pa chos kyi sku/ /lta ba med pa lta ba'i mchog 'di ni lta ba dam pa'o/ /bzhi pa a ti'i ye shes ni/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /de bzhin sgod bcud 'jig rten na//kun gyi rang bzhin ye shes dbyings/ /dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes med/ lnga pa a ti'i tshogs mtshod ni/ /ji ltar nor bu rin po che/ khya/bsam pa'i re ba ༷jogs pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yi/ /sku la ma rdzogs gcig kyang med/ /'di ni tshogs kyi dam pa yin/ /drug pa a ti'i sangs rgyas ni/ /ngan song rgyu sgong sangs rgyas dang / /mtho ris 'phags pa man chad dang / /de bzhin dmyal ba'i 'jig rten yang / /sangs rgyas sa yi rang bzhin no/ /bdun pa a ti'i 'phrin las ni/ /thams cad spyod cing thams cad byed/ /gzugs bskyed thams cad phyag rgya yin/ /smra brjod thams cad sngags tshig ste/ /thugs kyi rang bzhin g.yo ba med/ /brgyad pa a ti'i sgrib pa ni/ /ma skyes pa dang ma byung dang / /mi gnas pa la sgrib pa med/ /'di ltar lta ba rtogs tshud na/ /kun tu bzang po mchog gi sa/ /dgu pa ma 'i rig 'dzin ni/ /dpe byad mtshan rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /bdag nyid chen por yongs rdzogs nas/ /thams cad ma grol gcig kyang med/ /de dag sngags kyi che ba ste/ /dam tshig dang ni spyod pa dang / /lta ba dang ni ye shes dang / /tshogs dang sangs rgyas rnams dang ni/ /'phrin las kun gyi sprib pa dang / /rig 'dzin sa dang chad pa bcu/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las a ti'i theg pa bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// // spyi ti'i theg pa bstan pa/ spyi ti'i theg pa la yang gsum/ / po nges tshig dbye ba'o/ /ngo bo spyi /380

ti'i sta spyod bsdongs/ /nges tshig khyad par theg pa dgu /spyi ti'i dbye ba la yang bcu/ /dab po spri ti'i dam tshig ni/ /snang ba gang shar sku gsum yin/ /gnyis pa spyi ti'i spyod pa ni/ /theg dgu gcig tu dril nas spyod/ /res 'ga' nyan thos pa yi spyod/ /res 'ga' rang rgyal ba yi spyod/ /des 'gre theg pa gong ma rnams/ /gsum pa spyi ti'i lta ba ni/ /snang srid dbyings rig 'du 'bral med/ /'khor ba'i mdo dang myang 'das mdo/ /dwangs snyigs gnyis kyi dbye bas 'phags/ /bzhi pa spri ti'i ye shes ni/ /spyod yul ma gyur gang yang med/ /gol sa'i rtsa ba thams cad 'gyel/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bka' rgya bkrol/ /ye shes rnam thar chad rgyu med/ /theg pa thams cad kugo la 'gro /ye shes snang ba chad rgyu med/ /snang grags dbang sgyur brtsas ma med/ /'du byed grogs 'char lam du slong / /lnga pa spyi ti'i tshogs mchod ni/ /yo byad gnyis la pongs spyad pas/ /phyogs der sdug snyur mi tshugs shing / /ma 'bashas ma zhi nyams 'bar 'di/ /'khor gsum yongs dag tshogs mchod yin/ /drug pa spyi ti'i sangs rgyas ni/ /blo yi bya rgyu kun med pas/ 1ye yin khu yin 'ur rgyangs med/ /myong thog 'khel pa'i gdengs thob pa/ /mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /bdun pa spyi ti'i 'phrin las ni/ /g.yo ba med pa'i skyes bu la/ /lha yi bu dang bu mo rnams/ /mang po mang po rgyan ldan ni/ /la la nam mkha' dag la lding / /la la bar snang dag la 'phyo/ /la la sa gzhi dag la 'khrub/ /lha dang lha mo'i skur ston 'ong / /gsung sgrog cho stogoge rtse ga0thunagister/ /mkha' 'gro mang pos 'dod yon 'bul/ /lha 'dre mang pos ku co —'debs/ /ma mgon chos skyong 'phrin las byed/ /brgyad pa spyi tiṣ+ṭṛ sgrib pa ni/ /skugs byed 'byams 'dus sbas gab dang / bying ba rmugs she rgod pa stongs/ /'thas pa ngo zhen dran 'dzin med/ 1sgrib pa bcu gathum mchog gi 381

༷klong / /dgu pa spyi ti'i rig 'dzin ni/ /las rung mi snang snang bar nus/ /snang ba bsgyur nus 'ja' 'od sgra/ /dge dang mi dge'i ltas rnams shes/ /pade bar gshegs pa skar tshogs tsam/ /dbyibs dang kha dog mi 'dra ba/ /'od kyi gzugs brnyan nyams snang 'khrigs/ /rig 'dzin mang pos byen gyis pa rlabs/ /chad pa la zla bogs su 'don/ /rig 'dzin rigs gsum rigs bzhi lnga1 /yul ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi brda don gnyis/ /dur khrod kyis ni bogs su thon/ /sa gsum sa bzhi sa lnga pa/ /kri ya yo ga u pa bstan/ /sa drug sa bdun bogs 'don dus/ /ma hā yo ga a nu bstan/ /sa brgyad sa dgu bogs 'don dus/ /a ti spyi ti yo ga bstan/ /sa bcu bcu gcig kun tu 'od/ /a ti yo ga mtha' chen bstan/ /de dag spyi ti'i che bas bye/ /nyon mongs spyad kyang skyon med do/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las spyi ti'i theg pa bstan pa'i le'u ste so gcig pa'o// //nyan jos kyi nyams len destan pa/bkol mdo drug gis rang rang gi/ /nyams len bstan la rnam pa bcu/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems dang / /kri ya yo ga u pa dang / /ma hā a nu ma ti dang / /spyi ti yang ti mtha' chen po/ /nyan thos le yang rnam pa drug /'jug sgo tshul khrims lta ba dang / /sgom pa spyod pa 'bras bu'o/ /dang po 'jug sgo bden pa bzhi/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam/ /so so'i ngo bo mtshan nyid dbye/ /sdug bsngal gdungs shing sha thang mtshan nyid can/ /kun 'byung skye zhing 'phel ba'i mtshan nyid can/ / 'gog pa mi rtog zhi ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /lam ni theg pa chen po'i mtshan nyid can/ /dbye na re re la 332

yang bzhi bzhi ste/ /sdug bsngal bden pa la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med do/ /nyer len phung po mi sdod mi rtag pa/ /du:kha brgyad/dam gsum ten sdug bsngal lo/ /phung lnga chos tsam yod kyang kun gartaṭa stong / /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin med bdag med do/ /kun 'byung bden pa la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /kun 'byung bden pa rgyu dang rab tu bskyed/ /las dang nyon mongs 'byung bas kun 'byung la/ /de las sdug bsngal kun bskyed rgyu zhes bya/ /las nyon snga mas phyi ma'i rkyen byed rkyen/ /ma spangs rgyun mi chad bskyed rab tu bskyed/ /'gog pa'i bden pa la yang rnam bzhi ste/ /bdag med zhi ba ga nom nges 'byung ngo / /kun nas nyon mongs 'gog pas 'gog pa la/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin med bdag med yin/ /dug gsum me 'dra zhi bas zhi ba'o/ /dug gsum zhi ba gnod med gya nom pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba las ni nges 'byung ngo / /lam gyi bden pa la ni rnam bzhi ste/ /lam dang rig pa sgrub pa nges 'byin no/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i lam du gyur pas lam/ /'bras bu thob par thar pas rig pa yin/ /mya ngan 'das 'bras bsgrub pas sgrub pa la/ khams gsum gnas nas 'byin pas nges 'byin no/ /ma rtogs phung po lnga ni sdug bsngal la/ /sdug bsngal stong par rtogs pas 'phags bden yin/ /phung lnga rgyu ni sred pas kun 'byung ngo / /sred pas mi len kun 'byung 'phags bden no/ /phung po lnga rnams zad pas 'gog pa la/ ma byung mi 'pho mi gnas 'gog 'phags bden/ /de rnams rtogs shing shes pas lam bden yin/ /'bras thob mod shes lam gyis 'phags bden yin/ di lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i tshul khrims la ni don bcu gcig ngo bo nges tshig mtshan nyid dbye ba dang / /yul dang gang zag thob dus bsrung thabs dang / /ston dus skyon dang gso thabs phan yon ni/ /ngo bo 38//

gnod bzhi bcas pa las log pa/ /nges tshig lus ngag yid gsum nyes spyod sdom/ /mtshan nyid lhung bzhi 'khor bcas gnyen por dge dbye na rigs /brgyad dge bsnyen pho mo dang / /dge tshul pho mo dge slong pho mo dang / /bar /slob ma'o bsnyen gnas/dang ni brgyad/ /yul ni mkhan slob btsun pa'i drung du ste+o/ /gang zag gling gsum mir 'gyur mtshan nyid ldan/ /thob dus cho ga gtsang bzhing ma 'khrugs pa/ khas blangs gsum dang brjod gsum tha la 'thob/ /tsha chag mdo ru bsdus pa 'di/ /las chog karma sha rta las/ /sngon dang dge bsnyen bslab pa dang / /zhu dang mkhan po dang yod dang / /rab byung dge tshul dri ༷tshad dang / /bslab pa brjod pa tha ma yin/ /bsrung thabs rnam pa lngas bsrung ste/ /gang zag gzhan la brten nas bsrung ba ni/ /mkhan po gnas kyi bla ma mtshan nyid ldan/ /grogs bzang rnams la brten nas bsrung ba'o/ /rang gi chabasam pa phun tshogs sgo nas bsrung / /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod ngo tsha dang / khrel yod 'dzem bag sgo nas bsrung ba'o/ /spang bya mi mthun phyogs shes sgo nas bsrung / /spang bya nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum sogs/ /shes par byas nas myang 'das bsam pas bsrung / /bslab pa yongs sbyong sgo nas bsrung 0ba ni/ /gso sbyong dbyar gnas dgag dbye byed pa dang / /thos bsam sgom gsum sgo nas bslab pa sbyong / /bde gshegs rten la parten nas bsrung ba ni/ /gos dang zas dang sdod spyad gnas la sogs/ /mtha' gnyis ma lhung brten nas bsrung ba'o/ /gtong rgyu rang bzhin ma nus dang / /log lta skyes na lhung ba ༷'byung /mtshan mo 'das dang shi 'phos dang / /bslab pa phul dang log lta skyes/ /mtshan gnyis byung dus stongs pas rdzogs/ /nyes skyon tshul khrims nyams pa yi/ /lci ba bstan pa'i mdo las su/ /dge slong dang ni dge slong sam/ /ngo tsha dang ni khrel med pas/ /sangs rgyas bka' ni khyad du bsad/ /384

ngaspapa pa mang po'i sdogo nyams na/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i tshe tshad dpa / 1mnyam par dmyal bar lhung bar bshad/ /so sor ma bshags pas nyams na/ gartsa gsum tshe tshad dmyal bar lhung / /lhung ba las nyams 'thab bral tshe/ /sbo6 po las nyams dga' ldan tshe/ /lhag ma nyams na 'phrul dga'i tshe/ /pham pa las nyams gzhan 'phrul gyi/ /tshe yi tshad du dmyal bar stung / /gso ba'i thabs ni 'dul ba las/ /mthol ba dang ni bshags pa dang / /rdo rje snyen rlabs sgo nas bcos/ /stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa'o/ /mdo ru bsdu na 'dul ba las/ /dang po sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis/ /sdom pa thob par bya ba dang / /bar du bsrung thabs yan lag lngas/ /ma nyams pa ru/bsrung ba dang / /mtha' ru byin rlabs phyir bcom snyi1 /sgo/shar stospyosapa 'a sa pa'o/ /phan yon ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ /ye shes yongs su rdzogs byed cid / /sangs rgyas dang ni rjes su bslab/ /mkhas pa gang gis mi slod pa/ /rtag tu 'jigs pa med par 'gyur/ /kun nas sdong ba med gnas shing / /ting nge 'dzin rnams myur du 'thob/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i phan yon no/ /lta ba bdag med gang zag de/ /bdag ces phung lnga gcig tu 'dod/ /gang zag padag med ces pa ni/ /phung lnga du mar phye ba ste/ /yul sems gnyis po tha dad 'dod/ /nyan thos lta ba gnyis yin te/ /bye brag pa dang mdo sde pa/ /bye brag don dam sdug bsngal bral/ /cha med phyogs dang bcas par 'dod/ 1mdo sde g.yag rnga ninyu gsing tshul/ /kun rdzob tshul du 'dod pa'o/ /sgom / pa'i thabs ni mi zad pa/ /nyan thos tha ma'i dmigs pa ni/ /sems kyi bag chags spang ba'i phyir/ /keng rus la sogs sgom par byed/ /nyan thos 'bring ༷ gi dmigs pa ni/ /dbugs la sogs pa bgrang bar byed/ /nyan thos rab kyi sgom pa ni/ 1rang sems sna rtser gtad byas nas/ /ma yengs rtag tu gnas 335

—par byed/ /nyan thos spyod pa de nyid las/ /mi dge bcu dang dge ba bcu/ /chabade sdug las kyi/rgyur brtags nas/ /mi dge bcu spong dge ba bcu/ /rang gi don du spyod par byed/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis spyod/ /'bras bu sa lam mos par spyod/ /spyad pas tshogs lam gsum mthar phyin/ /drod thob sbyor lam rtse mo skye/ /rnam byang dkar po bar yang la/ /mthong ba'i sa yin tshogs la / 'dzin/ /yid chos dad 'dzin chos mchog la/ /gang zag bdag med bzod pas ni/ /byad chub sbyor lam rig ngos 'dzin/ /dgra bcom 'bras bu thob nas su/ /yas mar bgrangs pas rgyun zhugs pa'i/ /'bras bu la gnas phan chad la/ /gang zag brgyad ni tshangs pas su/ rgyun du zhugs pa brgyad pa'i sa/ /rgyun zhugs 'bras bu la gnas pa'i1 /mthong bas spang byar gyur pa spangs/ /skad cig bcu drug la sogs pa/ /de nyid rtogs pa mthong pa'i sa/1lan cig phyir 'ong 'alnga da/pa yis/ /'dod khams lan cig skye ba blangs/ /phyir 'ong la sbyor 'dod pa can/ /'dod khams 'dod sogs bsam pa'i sa/ /daphyir mi 'ong bar 'dod pa la/ /nyon mongs spangs pas der mi skye/ /rdzun dang gnod sems spangs pas ni/ /'ded pa'i ngo bo chags bral ba/ /dgra bcom ༷sgrub pa'i 'bras bu zhugs/ /bslab gsum ma nyams bsrungs pas skye/ /srid pa'i rtse nas sgom spang brgyad/ /sdom pa mi nyams byas rtogs sa/ /mthar thug 'bras bu la gnas pa/ /dgra bcom pa las goms thar med/ /nyan thos theg pa nyams su len/ /'o//paṇa bka'i thang yig las nyan thos kyi nyams len bstan pa'i le'u ste so gnyis pa'o// //sangs rgyas bstan pa dar nub bstan pa/ rang rgyal theg ma la yang don drug ste/ /dang po 'jug sgo tshul khrims 386

lta ba dang / /sgom pa'i thabs dang spyod pa 'bras bu'o/ /'jug pa'i sgo shi rten 'brel bcu gnyis ste/ 1ma rig pa yi bag chags las byung zhing / /don rnams ji ltar yin pa mi shes pa'i /las 'bras de bzhin nyid la rmongs pa yis/ /'du byed phung po 'phen nus kyi/ /bsod nams ma yin mi g.yo ba/ /rnam shes bag chags dang bcas pa'i/ /sems kyi phung pho dngos su bskyed pa ste/ /dbye na rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam shes so/ /ming dang gzugs ni rnam par smin pa'i lus/ /grub la ma rdzogs pas ni phung po lnga/ /skye mched drug ni dbang po kun rdzogs shing / /yul la longs spyod mi nus mig sogs yin/ /reg pas gsum 'dus yongs su spyod byed pa'i/ /dbye na mig so ges drug yin mtshor ba ni/ /myong bas khyad par srid bsgyur rgyu drug ga /'di na gnad drug yod pas go ba long / /dam tshig sdom pa bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa/ /sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ zag pa 'bring la bshags pa bya/ /gcig gi mdun du lhag ma rnams/ /nyon mongs mi sgong bdag sems zhig /'di rnams yan lag nyams pa ste/ dkon cog gsum la gsum mi mchod/ /'dod pa sems kyi ༷rjes su 'jug /rgan pa rnams la gus mi byed/ /dris pa la ni lan mi 'debs//'gro ngo bdag gis mi byed cingag /gser la gsog 'jog mi byed dang / /tshos 'dod pa la sbyin mi byed/ /tshul khrims mkhar rnams yal bar dor/ /pha rol dang phyir slob mi byed/ /sgoms can don la snying stobs chung / /snying brtser byas na mi dge mode/ /'tsho ba log pa dang du len/ /'gyod dang rab tu rgod la sogs/ /'khor ba gcig tu bgrod par sems/ /grags pa ma yin mi spong ba1 /nyon mongs bcas kyang chos mi byed/ /gshe la lan du gshe la sogs/ khros pa rnams ni yal bar 'dor/ /pha rol shad kyi chags pa spong /khros pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug bsnyen bkur sdud phyir 'khor rnams sdud/ /387

le /go la sogs sel mi byed/ /chags pa bre mo'i gtam me pasten/ /ting nge 'dzin gye don mi 'tshol/ /bsam gtan sgrib pa spong mi byed/ /bsam gtan ro la yon tan lta/ /nyan thos theg pa spong bar byed/ /rang tshul sded bzhin de la spyod /brtson mi phyi rol bstan bcos brtsode/ /brtson par byas kyang de la dga'/ /theg pa chen po spong bar byed/ /bdag la bstod cing gzhan la sgod/ /bka' dang bstan bcos khyad par bstan/ /bka' la don ni dgu yis bstan/ /ngo bo nges chig dbye ba dang / /snga dang phyi dang byed las dang / /sa mtshams yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /ngo bo rnam dag dgos pa tshang / /bslad par mi 'gyur thub 'ama'i/bka'/ /nges chig lang kar gshegs pa las/ /'byung thos rtogs par dka' ba'i byer/ /di phyir bka' rme nges chig yin/ /dbye na gsum ste zhal gsungs dang / /byin gyis brlabs dang rjes su gnang / /zhal nas gsungs pa sde sgod gsum/ /rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /byen gyis brlabs pa sku gsung thugs/ nashes rgyud can dang shes med pa/ /mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ /bde gshegs skal ldan rin po che/ /ston pa de yi byin rlabs kyis/ /ri dang shing dang de'u dang / /pad+ma dang ni dpag bsam shing / / rnga bo che las sgra byung ba/ /de dag thams cad bka' yin te/ /rgyal bas pyin gyis brlabs pa yi/ /rjes su gnang ba'i bka' la gnyis/ /zhal bzhugs dus dang gshegs pa'i rjes/ /nye ba 'khor dang kun dga' bo/ /de ltar dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ /mgon po gcig la gcig lung ston/ /de yang bka' zhes bya bar rigs/ /byed las dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ she /sems can khams rnashesas 'khor ba las/ /nges par 'byin phyir bka' bstsal to/ /sa mtshams sangs rgyas bzhugs ring la/ /byung ba thams cad bka' yin la/ /gshegs nas byung rnams bstan bcos te/ /mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po las/ 388

laspang dang yi shes phun sum tshogs/ /de yi mthu dang der snang dang / /nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /nga min nga 'dra dag gis ni/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'grel byed pa/ /bstan bcos dag tu nga yis bshad/ /bka' la snga bshis par brjod/ /'bye ba mya ngan 'das mdo'o/ /yon tan nyon mongs 'joms shing ngu shes pa 'dren cing don la sbyor/ /'byung rgyu phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ /bka' yi don rnams bstan pa'o/ /bstan ba0ོsa la yang don dgu ste/ /dus dang lo rgyus ngo bo dang / /nges tshig dbye ba rtsom pa'i rgyu/ /ldang tshad dgos pa bshad thabs so/ /bstan bcos byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ /sbrul sku shākya thub pa rdas/ /dgung lo brgyad cu gya gnyis bzhugs/ /re nas rtswa mchog grong khyer gyi/ /sna la'i shing gi drung du ni/ /ches brgyad nam gung ston pa 'das/ /phur sgrom zhag bdun bgegs zhugs nas/ /ma bcug 'bar du ma btub par/ / ki lnga ya yi rgyun pa btsugs/ /'od spungs byogo nas zhabs ni bsten/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i bco lnga la/ /thugs nas ye shes me 'bar nas/ /sku ni mya ngan /'das tshul bstan/ /sems can mos rten sku gdung bzhag /sku gdung cha brgyad bgos nas ni/ /nga yi tshab ni lo brgyad pa/ /lon pa'i tshad 'dis gyis shig chagasungs/ /sku tshad bzheng bar kha ma 'cham/ /lo brgyad sus kyang ma shes nas//ser skyar rgan mo la dris pas/ /ser skya'i sgo skyed dang mnyam zer/ /de tsam —pa cig byas pa'o/ klu dang gter dang rgya nag dab / 1srong btsan sgam po'i ra sa dang / /de yi bstan pa gnas bya'i phyir/ /dgra bcom chos kyi spyan ldan tshogs/ /bka' yi bsdu ba gsum du mdzad/ /bsdu ba dang po phyi de'i dbyar//a su ra yi brag phrag tu/ /nye ba 'khor gyis 'dul ba bsdus/ /kun dga' bo yis mdo sde bsdus/ /'od srungs bgres pos mngon pa bsdus/ /'dus pa dgra bcom lnga brgya yod/ /sbyin bdag rgyal po ma skyes dgra /bsdu ba bar pa 38kyi

yangs pa can/ /su ma pu ri'i gtsug lag khang / /dus ni brgya dang bcu tsam na/ /bsdu ba po ni zla sgur sogs/ /gsol 'debs pa ni grags pa ste/ /'dus pa dgra bcom bdun brgya'o/ /sbyin bdag rgyal po a sho ka /bsdu ba gsum pa kha zhi'i yul/ /dzā ladhi ra'i kun dga' rang/ /byang sems bha su mi tra dang / 1dgra bcom byur+ṇa ka yis bsdus/ /gsol 'debs pa dang sbyin ོdag ni/ /gnyis ka rgyal po ka ni ka /'dus pa dgra bcom lnga brgya dang / /so so skye bo khri drug stong / /bstan bcos byung ba'i dus tshod ni/ /bka' bsdu dang po bar pa'i dus/ /dgra bcom pa ni lnga brgya yis/ /bka' ni dang po gtan dbab phyir/ /bye brag bshad mdzod chen mo zhes/ /bam po sum brgya pa cig mdzad/ /sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo bzhi brgyar/ /sto phyogs be ta'i yul du ni/ /bram ze'i sman pa na te ka'i /chun ma rigs sna ma zhes par/ /slob dpon 'phags pa glu sgrub 'khrungs/ /dgung lo brgyad ni lon tsa na/ /dbang po'i sde la rab tu byung / 1chos ming sidhi pha la zhes/ /bka' ni bar pa gtan dbab phyir/ /dbu ma rigs pa'i tshogs drug mdzad/ /rtsa shes rigs pa drug cu pa/ /stong nyid bdun cu zhib mo 'thag /rin cen phreng ba rtsod zlog mdzad/ /de sras āyi de ba dang / /zla grags shākya bshes gnyen dang / glu yi byang chub la sogs pas/ /sa thob bden mthong lung bstan nas/ /byang sems bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ /sangs rgyas gshegs nas dgu brgya na/ 1mgon po byams pa 'jig rten byon/ /bka' ni mtha' ma gtan dbab phyir/ /byams pa'i chos lnga mdzad pa ni/ /mdo sde rgyan dang mngon rtogs rgyan/ /chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed dang / /dbus dang mtha' gnyis rnam 'byed dang / /theg pa chen po rgyud bla'o/ /de rnams rgyud 'dzin thogs med de/ /sa sde lnga dang sdom gnyis mdzad/ /sa yi dngos gzhi bsdu ba dang / rnam par gtan la 330

dbab par bsdu/ /gzhi bsdu ba dang rnam nges bsdu/ /rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba'o/ /thun mong sdom ni kun las btus/ /theg chen sdom ni theg bsdus so de rnams mngon pa gong mar grags/ /gcung po slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ / prakā ra ṇa sde brgyad dang / /mngon pa 'og ma rnams mdzad do/ kha che dge 'dun bzang po yis/ /btsun ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims la/ /lus bskyed thogs med dbyig gnyen grags1 /dbang la don ni bcu gcig ste/ /dgongs pa ngo bo nges tshig dang / /dbye ba go rim grangs nges dang / /bskur tshul sgrib pa dag tshul dang / /skal pa phan yon 'bras bu'o/ 1dgos pa dkyil 'khor bzhi ldan dgos/ /phyi ru rdul tshon dkyil 'khor dang / /nang du phung khams dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang ba byang sems dkyil 'khor dang / /rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor bzhi/ bdag 'jug blangs nas slob ma 'jug chos skus gzugs sku'i don mdzad pa/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngo bo yin/ / gzugs lha sgra sngags chos kyi dbyings/ 1dkyil 'khor kun gye nges chig yin/ / dbye na phyi nang gsang bas dbye/ /bum pa'i ngo bo sna tshogs bcud/ /chu shi bdun lobum chu min/ khyim chu mtsho dang rdzing bu 'khyil/ khron pa ko mog bang mo'i chu/ /chu mig la sogs chu shi bdun/ /rab ni gtsang po yon tan brgyad// 'bring ni 'bab chu tha bo ma/ /sto nub za byed srin po'i yul1 /bde bar gshegs pas ru dra btul/ /glu rgyal gtsug na rin chen gyis/ /bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho phul/ /'o ma'i dgos pa lnga ru bshad/ /dbang bskur rtsa ba'i rgyud las su/ /'o mas thabs chen snying rje bskyed/ /sems can kun gyi gsos su 'gyur/ /mdangs ldan mtsho sman rgyal mo/yis/ /chu bo yon tan brgyad ldan phul/ /chu yi dgos pa lnga ru bshad/ /chu yis shes rab skyed par byed/ / srid par rgyug cing 'gro ba 'tsho/ /sa yi lha mo bstan ma yis1 /gser dngul 301

zangs lcags byu ru phul/ /rat+na lnga yi dgos pa lnga/ /gser gyis rin cen bkod pa'i zhing / /mu tig bying tshugs sgrib pa 'dag 'thab bral lha ru skye /bar 'gyur/ /dngul gyis stug po bkod pa'i zhing / /bag chags phyin log sgrib pa 'dag /dga' ldan gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /zangs kyis bde ba can gyi shing / /'dzin chags bcings pa'i sgrib pa 'dag /'phrul dga'i gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /lcags kyis mngon par dga' ba'i zhing / rnam smin gdon bgegs sgrib pa 'dag /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lus su skye/ /byu rus las rab bkod pa'i zhing / /rang phyogs can gyi sgrib pa 'dag /tshangs ris lha ༷gnas skye bar zhagyur/ /lha chen bu mos slon lnga phul/ /sman sna lnga yi dgos byed lnga/ /gle tres tshogs lam bcu gcig zhing / /nus mthu sgrib pa sel byed 'dag /tshangs pa mngon sum gnas su skye/ /rgya mtsho spu bas sbyor lam zhing / /dge sdig 'chal pa'i sgrib pa 'dag 1tshangs pa chen po'i tshe bskal drug /kaṇ+ḍaka ris sgom lam zhing / /sdug sems sgrib pa yan lag 'dag /'od chung tshe tshad bskal pa gnyis/ /dbang po lag pas mthong lam zhing / /sgro btags yan lag bdun sgrib 'dag /tshad med 'od du skye bar 'gyur/ /shu dag dkar pos mthar phyin zhing / /'dod pa khungs bcug sgrib pa 'dag /'od gsal bar gyi /bskal brgyad thub/ /dri za'i bu mos dri lnga phul/ /tsarnan cig car gsum gyi zhing / /bcud med bsten pa'i shes sgrib 'dag /dge chung tshe bskal bcu drug thub/ /ga pur sku lnga rig 'dzin zhing / sgod min bsten pa'i shes sgrib 'dag / tshad med dge ga'i gnas su skye/ /gur gum bde stong chen po'i zhing / /rgyud ma dag pa'i shes sgrib 'dag /dge rgyas tshe bskal drug cu thub/ /dzā tis sgrib gnyis med pa'i zhing / /tshig don ma 'dres shes sprib 'dag /sprin med 'od shā lha lus len/ /gla rtsis rtsod pa med pa'i zhing / /chos sems ma 'dres shes 302

sgrib 'dag /bapod nams skye/zheng lha lus len/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'bye lnga phul/ /nas kyis yon tan bdun ldan zhing / /rang med gzhan don shes grib ngadag /'bras bu che ba'i tshe bskang/ lha/ /gro yis 'byor pa drug ldan zhing / /ci shar gdung med shes sgrib 'dag /mi che ba yi lha yi gnas/ / 'bras kyis 'phags pa'i nor bdun zhing / /ya bral kha chos shes sgrib 'dag / mi gdung bskal pa nyis stong thub/ /til gyis yo byad rnam gnyis ldan/ /'chi 'pho shes/pa'i shes sgrib 'dag gya nom snang ba'i bskal bzhi thub/ /gran mas ma nyams bshad pa'i zhing / /stoms 'jug sgrib pa'i shes sgrib 'dag shin tu mthong ba'i bskal brgya thub/ /gnod sbyin bu mos snying po lnga/ /lan tshwas skye shi med pa'i zhing / /sprul ba'i sgrib pha tshas sgri'adzi'ad garwa /'og min bskol pa khri drug stong / /mar gyis/rgyu kyen bral ba'i zhing / /bden pa gnyis kyi sgrib pa 'dag nam mkha' mtha' yas nyi khri thub/ /sprang rtsis yid bzhin nor bu'i zheng / /rje khol 'dod pa'i shes sgrib 'dag /rnam shes mtha' yas bzhi khri'i lus/ /ka ra bu ram mtha' rgyas zhing 1 /cir yang ma nges sgrib pa 'dag ci yang med de drug khri'i lha/ /g.yu yis rgyal srid bdun zhing spyod1 /shes bya'i sgrib pa 'dod zhen 'dag /yod min med min drug khri'i lus1 /bum rjas nyi shu rtsa lnga yis/ /srid pa nyi shu rtsa lngar spong / /nyan rang tshul khrims bdun brgya spong / /de bas bum rjas khyad du 'phags/ /lus kyi sgrib pa ma dag par/ /phyi star bum dbang thob mi 'gyur/ /bum dbang chas bcu ma 'dzom par/ /ye shes sems dpa' phebs mi 'gyur/ /rgyu ni rnam par mi rtog pas/ gosngags sgo cung zad tsam ma mthong / /grub par byed pas tshogs kyi chas/ /bkol nyan dus btub 'khor gyi chas/ /bar chad bsrung ba mtshams kyi chas/ /legs nyes brtag pa sta gon chas/ /dmigs rten bca' ba dkyil 'khor chas/ 333

shu na /ོla ldan pa las kyi chas/ /yon tan 'dzom pa yum gyi chas/ /phyag rgya /bsgyur ba gar gyi chas/ /stang stabs 'gying bag ging gi chas/ /bye brag byed pa /rol mo'i chas/ /thos chung rmongs pas gnad mi shes/ /gsang sngags mkhan po lag len rdugs/ /bum pa sne las gzhal yas khang / /lta bskyed bum pa byin gyis brlabs/ /chu ni yab yum stoms 'jug chu/ /bum ni snying po 'od kyi bum/ /pa ni tshos dbyings ma 'gags pa/ /nges chig lugs bzhin 'khrud pas chu1 /dbye ba dbang bskur rtsa rgyud las/ /sten byed bum pa mtshon byed bum pa dang / /rang bzhin bum pa rnam rgyal bum pa dang / /las kyi bum pa dang ni lnga ru bshad/ /bum pa'i mtshan nyid 'dod bzhed mi 'dra mang / /kun job don dam rgyu rkyen 'dzom pa'o/ /dbang gi ngo bo thabs shes kho na yin/ /nges tshig de las gzhal yas khang /nang du lha tshogs bskyed pa'o/ /ma smin smin par byed pa dang / /smin pa grol bar byed pa dang / /gsang sngags sgo ni dbang la thug /gsang sngags ngo bo blo zhib pa/ /thabs shes sgo yangs chegs chung ba/ /don che thag nye brtag par dka'/ khe nyen che dang bsrung bar shaka'/ 1dngos po brgyad du nges dbye phyir/ /dbang gi sgod dang ldan par byed/ /rnam rtog gzung 'dzin dag pa dang / /rang rig ye shes blug pa'i phyir/ /dbang rnams sgyu ma tsam du yod/ /lus ngag yid las byung pa yi/ /༷dri ma dag phyir dbang du brjod/ /sbyor sgol grub chen brgyad dbang thob/ /dbye ba rgyas bsdus gnyis su dbye/ /rgyas par dbang gi chu bo bzhi/ /bla ma nyid kyis ma thob na/ /long bas long ba'i lam sna 'dren/ /dpon slopa gnyis ga ngan song 'gro /dper na seng ge spre'u bzhin/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'di na ni/ /dge dang sdig pa gnyis ka byed/ /sajes rgyas sems can gnyis ka chabazhugs/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /yongs 'dzen dge ba'i bshes 334

1naten dbang / /chos kyi bka' gtad glegs bam dbang / /rig pa'i rtsal /chadabang yi dam dbang / /wangs rdzogs phyag rgya chen po'i dbang / /'di na rgya mabod gnas yod do/ /lta ba spyi 'byams dbang thob na/ /sgos bcas mang po 'dir ma dgos/ /sgom pa spyi 'byams dbang thob na/ /gnas lugs/don la ci yang med/ /sprod pa spyi 'byams dbang thob na/ /sangs rgyas bya ba de rang yin/ /'bras bu spyi 'byams dbang thob na/ /'gran zla med cing khyad du 'phags/ /thos mesam sgom gsum the tshom bcad/ dbang khrid rab gnas dkyil 'khor bri/ /rtogs pa'i lta ba 'chad rtsod ldan/ /rdo rje slob dpon gdengs tshad yin/ /rdo rje slob dpon chas la ni/ /sa rgyan dang ni gnam rgyan dang / / rdo rje dang ni dril bu dang / /dag byed dang ni gsal byed do/ /bsdus pas dbang ni bzhi ru 'dus/ /bzhi ldan rtsa ba bum pa'i dbang / /bum pa'i dbang /bskur dang po ste/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ro/ /gsum pa shes ༷rab ye shes te/ /bzhi pa de nyid/tshig dbang ngo / /gsang ba'i bas dbang ༷bharnye'o/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad bhan t+ta phul/ /de dag sha za mkha' 'gro ma/ /༷bum rdzas bdud rtsi a spo ta/ /mi gtsang sum cu rtsa drug rol/ /grangs nges pa ni rnam pa bzhi/ /spang bya 'dod chags bzhi spangs nas/ /bsgrub pya phyag rgya chabazhi bsten dang / /'bras bu sku bzhi thob pas bzhi/ /dbang bzhi ji ltaran/bskur tshul ni/ /dkyil 'khor shar du bum dbang bdun/ /ting 'dzin sngags samachog ci ris yin/ /dkyil 'khor lho ru gsang dbang bzhi/ /dngos dang dngos min gang mos yin/ /dkyil 'khor nub tu sher dbang gsum/ /ting 'dzin brda dang rdzas dbang 'dzom/ /dkyil 'khor byang du tshig dbang gnyis/ /brda dbang khyad par cho ga 'o/ /sgrib pa 'dag tshul bache naXpa ni/ /bum pa chu yi dbang bskur bas/ /lus kyi sgrib pa bcu ni 'dag /thun mong rig pa'i 335

nabang lnga nas1 /phyi bum phan pa'i dbang bcu bskur/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad yanga' gsol lo/ /gsang ba rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas/ /ngag gi sprib pa bcu dug 'dag /dge tshul nyid du bcu gsum pa/ /'khor lo tshogs chen yon tan 'thob/ /shes rab phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas/ /yid kyi sgrib pa bcu po 'dag /'dod chags dag pa dge sgong mtshog /dngos spyod sa ni bcu pa non// bcu bzhi bde ba chen po 'thob/ /bzhi pa chig gi dbang bskur bas/ /chos sgrib yul sgrib bag la nyal1 /shes sgrib chags nyams 'dag pa'o/ /bcu gcig kun 'od sa non 'gyur/ /dga' ba bzhi yi dbang thob pas/ /dal 'byor lam lnga sa bcu drug /skal pa grang la bzhag pa ni/ /bum dbang lha sgom skal ba bzhag /gsang dbang gtum mo sgom la dbang / /shes rab bde chen spros bral sgom/ /bzhi pa zung 'jug blo 'das sgom/ /rdzogs chen sgom med lta ba'o/ /phan yod dbang thob rtags bco brgyad/ /phung khams skye mched lha ru smin/ /'byung 'jug gnas gsum sngags su smin/ /thig le bde chen ye shes su/ /sems nyid sangs rgyas chos skur smin/ /ye nas yin pas mngon du byas/rdo'abras bu sku bzhi thob pas te/ bum dbang nus pas sprul sku 'thob/ /gsang dbang nus pas longs sku 'thob/ /shes rab nus pas chos sku 'thob/ /bzhi pas ngo bo nyid sku 'thob/ /rgyud 'gyur nyon mongs je chung 'gro /snying rjegaphan sems dag snang che/ /btsan pas 'jigs brgyad nye mi nus/ /lha srin sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /grags pas rgyal khams yongs su khyab/ /mi yi bu rnams mngon par bstod/ /nus pas rdo rje'i brag kyang 'jig /'jig rten bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /gnod pa gang gis mi tshugs pa/ 'byung po'i tshoṭa rnams rgyang du 'bros/ ma dang mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du/ /'gro don ma byas rang shugs 'byung / /mthun kyen snang srid lha 'dres sbyor/ /'tsho ba'i sdug phyi6
