/bsngal bya mi dgos/ /de la sogs pa mang yod kyi/ /dkyil 'khor med/na skyon bzhi yod/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor med pa'i skyon/ /gsang sngags theg pa'i don la sgrib/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor med pa'i skyon/ 1rkyen gyis log par snang /ba yin/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor med pa'i skyon/ /rang ngo ma shes sgrib dang bgegs/ /stong gzugs dkyil 'khor med pa'i skyon/ /lam la phyogs 'dzin 'greng du tshud/ mthong ba'i phan yon bzhi bcu ste/ /gang zhig rngul tshon mthong bas kyang / /skye zhing skye bar mtho ris 'thob/ /ma rig sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams 'dag /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshogs ni dzogs/ /bum dbang bsod nanas tshogs ni rdzogs/ /ji srid dud 'gro'i lus skyes kyang / /dbang che rtsa chu 'dzom par skye/ /mir skyes kha drag dbang che'o/ /bde bar gnyid sad bde bar nyal/ /nad med gzugs bzang longs spyod che/ /gzi brjid che zhing tshe rdo/yang ring / /rigs mtho shes rab gsum dang ldan/ /phyi ru mi nor thas rdogasum 'phel/ /nang du bu tsha rigs brgyud 'phel/ /gsang ba khams gsum ༷dbang du 'du/ /bla tshe zad kyang bsring bar nus/ /gdon bgegs yi dwags ༷gnod pa srung / /dkyil 'khor dpag bsam sdong po yin/ /mgo bstan gnyid log ci bsam 'grub/ /dbang byed gsang sngags dam pa ste/ /sa steng sdig sgrib ma lus 'phyag /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams kun/ /tho rengs skar ma bzhin du srab/ /mthun pa'i yon tan thams cad kun/ /srod kyi skar ma ༷bzhin du 'du/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib kun/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin /'grib/ /legs pa'i yon tan thams cad kun/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin ༷'phel/ /tshe dang bsod nams rab tu 'phel/ /'khor dang yo byad rab tu 'thob/ /bkrag dang gzi mdangs kun kyang che/ /dpal dang snyan grags sa /steng khebs/ /tshe dang dbang thang stobs rab 'byung / /rkyen dang byung dpa 23

thogegs mi tshugaso / /dkyil 'khor yid bzhi na nor bu yin/ /lus skor ngag 'das dgos 'dod 'byung / /dper na mtshon tsha'i rigs byed la/ /rdzas byuṭa ngar ni btags pa 'dra/ /shes shing nyams len bstan pa la/ /thob pa zhes su bshad pa/yin/ /zhi ba'i lha la tshul dgu ni/ /mnyen mnyen 'dra dad/lhug snyug 'dra/ /'khril 'khril 'dra rnams ldem chags pa/ /gsal la 'tsher ze lhun stug pa/ /gzi brjed 'phro ba 'od zer 'bar/ /'dod chags can gyi 'jug sgo'o//khro tshul drug cu rtsa brgyad de/ khro khro 'dra la rngam rngam 'dra/ /gshe gshe 'dra la gtum gtum 'dra/ /me ri dang ni me dpung 'bar/ /bskal pa'i dus ske lta bu'o/ /'od dang zer ni nyi ma 'bum/ /dus gcig la ni shar ba tsam/ khro bo zhe sdang rdo rje dgod/ /gter ma glog stong dus gcig 'khyug rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir/ /tug chom dang ni 'ur chom sgra/ /ri rab 'bum ni bsnyel ba tsam/ kha sna sbugs pa'i brdas bos na/ /dus mtha'i rlung chen 'thor ༷ba tsam/ /de lta bu ni khro bo'i tshul/ /zhe sdeng can gyi 'jug sgo'o/ /rang gi rgyan bdun 'di yin te/ /dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang / /do shal dpung rgyan se mo do/ /phyag dang zhabs kyi gdu bu'o/ chas ni rnam pa lnga yin te/ /stod g.yogs dang ni smad dkros dang / /ze khab dang ni chos gos dang / gtsang gos na bza' lnga ru bshad/ khro bo rnams la dpal chas brgyad/ khyab mdzad re skong rdo rje gshog pa'i chas/ /gdod rdul zlog byed rgya gram ljags kyi chas/ /ting 'dzin rab brjid dpa' bo stag gi chas/ /dbang gi bse khrab gzi 'bar bgrad pa'i chas/ /dpa' brjid mnyen lhug sbrul nag 'khyil pa'i chas/ /gzi mdangs che ba chu srin sprul pa'i chas/ /rdo rje rtse lnga/rig pa blog pa'i chas/ /bskal pa'i mes bsreg rdo rje ste ri'i chas/ /'khor lo khro bo'i dur khrod chas brgyad de/ /glang chen ko ba zhing lngags stag gi sham/ /rasta'i 3gyi

thig le zhag ris thal chen tshom/ /thod pa'i phreng ba sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan/ /rgyas thebs las chog byed pa yang / /su byung yan pas byed min te/ /mi dge bcu spadi/dge bcu blang / /pha rol phyin bcu'i lam la 'gro /chos spyod bcu la 7ོsangal med/ /dag pa gsum dang mngon byang lnga/ /cho 'phrul bsge dang ting 'dzin gsum/ /'di ni las chog rgyas thebs yin/ /ser snas pacings pa'i ༷yi dwags mi/ /dkyil 'khor mi tshud sgo bas pasrung / /rgyud kun bal srin dar ras mig dkar ram khra bo gdong g.yogs 'dug /las kyi slob dpon rtags 'chang lnga/ /dungs pa'i skad dang gus pa'i phyag dbu la dbu rgyan maḍil 'dzin/ 1'bru sman shing tog rin cen rigs/ /'dod yon lngas mtshod lag yon dbul1 /rgyas thebs dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir khrid/ /shar gyi sgo la 'jug par bya/ /mig dbye yon dbul gsang mtshan gdags/ /lha ngo sprod pa rgyas thebs yin/ /baspur thabs bco brgyad bskur tshul bzhi/ /bya las kri ya'i lung pa brten/ /lus ngag bya ba gartsa bor ston/ /gral la 'grim nas bskur ba dang / /ye shes lha rgyud u par brten/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gtso bor ston/ /rdo rje slob depon khri dkyil bskor/ /mngon byung yo ga'i lung la brten/ /gsang sngags spyod pa gartsa bor ston/ /dal phyogs dbang rten bcas nas bskur//bya byed a ti'i lung la brten/ /'bad rtsol bral ba gtso bor ston/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su man ji btsugs/ /bla ma rgyan ldan der 'dug bskur/ dbang gi bskur thabs bco brgyad ni/ /cig car yas kyis bskur ba dgu /rim gyem mas kyis bskur ba dgu /'di na lag len gnad yod do/ /rgyud sde phyi nang khyad par ni/ /dkyil 'khor dbang dang dam chig dang / /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa dang / /'phrin las dus dang 'bras bu dgu /dkyil 'khor khyad par bstan pa ni/ /bya ba'i rgyud la pho brang pad+ma bri/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la 'bar ba rtsibs su /393

ni/ /rnal 'apyor rgyud la tha brang ling tsor bya/ /tshos 'byung zla gam rnal 'phyor chen po'i rgyud/ /gru chad man chad dbyer med mdzes pa la/ /'jig rten khor yug brgyan pa phyi yi rgyud/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis brgyan pa nang rgyud do/ /dbang gi khyad par bstan pa di/ /bum dbang tsam las mi bskur phyi rgyud yin/ /dbang pazhi rdzogs par bskur na nang rgyud yin/ /thabs shes ya bral phyi ba yin/ /ma bral ba ni nang pa yin/ /byang chub rnam drug kri ya'i lha dgu sgom/ (mchod pa lnga dang rgyal srid bdun/ /phyir bstan rung ba phye pa yin/ / sman rag gtor gsum sbyor sgol gnyis/ /phyir bstan mi rung nang pa yin/ /rgyud gsum gyi ni rim pa yis/ /dbang drug dbye ba bstan pa'o/ /chu dbang bskur dang dbu rgyan dag /bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags/ /rdo rje dril bu de bzhin ming /1spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu gsal/ /phyir mi sdog pa ming gi dbang / /rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar byas/ /de ni drug gi bye brag dbang / /'di ni slob dbon dbang zhes bya/ /rnal 'byor bla ma yi ni mtshan/ /gsang ba yi ni dbang rgyas bshad/ /shes rab ye shes 'di la yang / /dbye ba mang du shes par gyis/ /dam tshig khyad par pastan pa ni/ /'phrin las lung brgyad gar ging med/ /sha chang mi mtshod phyi ba'o/ /mi thob pas na chos sprib sogs/ /bstan pa dar nub bstan pa ni/ /bstan pa la ni gsum yin te/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku'i bstan/ /chos sku'i bstan pa stongs bya med/ /bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi theg pas te/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas kyi bar/ /chos kyi sku yi bstan pa gnas/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bstan pa ni/ /kri ya rnam gsum theg pas ste/ /ji grid sems can gnas kyi bar/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bstan pa gnas/ /sprul pa'i sku yi bstan pa ni/ /sde snod gsum gyi theg pas te/ /mdo sde bskal pa bzang po las/ /lnga brgya phrag bcu'i bar 400

—pa ni/ /bod yig sum cus tshog pa shes/ kha che'i jo bo a nan ta/ /spyan drangs mdo sde pad dkar dang / /tsitī ma ṇi dkon cog sprin/ /gra lnga 'dus ༷pa rin cen tog /rdo rje rnam 'joms sgol ma rnams/ /lo tsā thu mi sastos bsgrur/ /god du dam chos bsgyur pa snga/ /dkon cog gsum gye rten btsugs nas/ /bod rnams dam pa'i chos la bkod/ /dam chos srol/petod bka' drin chi/ /shākya mu ni mi bskyod rdor/ /bod na bzhugs pas bka' drin che/ /de nas gdung rabs lnga nas ni1 /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa byon/ /rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan gyes/ /brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs/ /sang spyo ta yi paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bzang la mang ba spyan drangs pa/ /de dag kun gyi mtshan ca smos na/ /pardo ta bo dhi sa1/ /paṇ+ḍi ta pad+ma se ṭī shā/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi mā la mi tra//laṇ+ḍi ta dharmā khog pardota———/ba ma ti/ pardo ta phyogs kyi glang po pani ta ta 1thā ga ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta ta sgo ga ta so skro ta paṇ+ḍi ta thubye gusta/ paṇ+ḍi ta kun la /'gre'o/ paṇ+ḍi ta shā kā ra/ pani ta shārto ka ra/ pardo ta bal po du ha ra/pardo ta dharmotīr parno ta rgya nag ha shang ma hā yā na/ paṇ+ḍi ta sing bha la glu'i :dbang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta pra brta pani ta shi la pra bo dhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra/paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ba le/ paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na su tra/ paṇ+ḍi ta a nan ta/ baṇ+ḍi ta pradz+nyā bha ra ta pardi ta ka la gal bha paṇ+ḍi ta gu hu bud+ngha paṇ+ḍi ta ār+yā de ba/ parno ta ga mā la shī la/ paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā gī ti/ paṇ+ḍi ta sharta de ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ba la dha ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra ma ṇi paṇ+ḍi ta a brte/ poṇ+ḍi ta trī la mañju/ pani ta bud+dhā rkurte paṇ+ḍi tartermā shī la/ paṇ+ḍi ta rakhri ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi narta paṇ+ḍi ta li gzhon nu paṇ+ḍi ta pradz+nyā gīrte/ paṇ+ḍi ta kha che rab snang / paṇ+ḍi ta ba su dha ra/ paṇ+ḍi gta shrī sing ha paṇ+ḍi ta pra bha ha ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta rong pu gu rgya pardo tashākha che shu /la shrī pardo ta bal po nyu byang chub/ pardo ta sa mārtashrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/403

paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la parno ta bal po shī la mañju/ pardo ta bal po li ka thun tse/ paṇ+ḍi ta bal po tī la ka paṇ+ḍi ta rgya nag du ha ra nag po/ paṇ+ḍi ta rgya nag ma hā snyu du paṇ+ḍi ta rgya nag ma hā rā dza paṇ+ḍi ta rgya nag ma hā de ba/paṇ+ḍi ta rgya gar tsadri gīrte paṇ+ḍi ta tsakra gīrti/ paṇ+ḍi ta gsal ba rā dza/paṇ+ḍi ta me tu dzo gi pardo ta su ren+d+ra bodhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañju shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta bha ra hi ta ha bu paṇ+ḍita shākya pra bhe/ pardo ta badz+ra gīrti/ paṇ+ḍi ta gu ṇa tsan+d+ra/parno ta chos mchog parji ta lha blo gros/ paṇ+ḍi ta la li ta badz+ra paṇ+ḍi ta shārte dz+nya na paṇ+ḍi ta bha len su ster/ paṇ+ḍi ta pra ta gabhe/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrī tsā na gabhe/ paṇ+ḍi ta snya snya tsi ta/ pardo ta sna ku sha tsita/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ mdo sde zab mo'i chig dang don 'jal nas/ mi rnams la phan gdags pa'i slad du/ mdo sde'i don rnams bsdus te/ zhus pa'i le'u brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa/ mdo tshan dergyad cu'i lung /rnal 'byor chen po sgom pa'i lung / le'u brgyad cu rtsa brgyad bam po so bzhi pa rin cen phreng ba zhes bya ba gsungs/ lo tsā'i mchog gyur be+e ro tsa na/ mthu che ba nam mkha'i snying po/ btsun pa'i rab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ sba mi ye shes dbang po/ bod du rab byung ba la snga ba spa khri bzher sang shi rardo/ chos thos che ba rgyal ba byang chub/ sad mi mi bdun bod la drin che'o/ /lo tsā che 'breng chung dang gsum/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang bsgyur pa/ /dar gyi gab tse'i khrir bzhugs pa/ /lo tsā mkha sa/pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ /se skyo ta lha'i skad/ be+e sha 'dre'i skad/ a ba bha ti gnod sbyin gyi skad/ nā ga ra klu'i skad/'ba' du la mi'i skad/ kha sto la srin bo'i skad/ a har u rgyan gyi skad/ bye gar mi ma yin gyi skad/ pra ti sha sha za'i skad/ ka ling ka'i skad/ pa li tri ta'i skad/ na ga si dhi'i skad/ khang bu gling gi skad/ thangs gling gi skad/40tshi

—ka mā la ru pa'i skad/ lnga rā ṇa sī'i skad/ ma ga dha'i skad/ nā lardo'i skad/be ta'i skad/ siṅga la'i skad/ ma ru tse'i skad/ za hor gyi skad/ shaṃ bha la'i skad/ kha che'i skad/ bru sha'i skad/ rgya gar gyi skad/ rgya nag gi skad/ bal po'i skad/ li'i skad/ srin po'i skad/ de la sogs pa skad rigs thams cad bod du bsgyur shes pa/ 'khon glu'i dbang po/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku ma ra/ shud bu khong lede/ zhadze+e se btsan/ yar lha du/ legs sbyin nyi ma/ yon tan snying po/ ldan ma rtse mang / sbas thir len/ kyi lo tsā ba/ kag lo tsā ba gyur mo lo tsā ba/ bshal lo tsā ba/ mo na mo lo tsā ba/ khyung po lo tsā ba/ chos rung gzhu'o/ shes rab 'byung gnas/ shing sum lo tsā ba/ sa nag lo tsā ba/chos kyi shes rab/ sgom nag lo tsā ba/ bzhad pa rdo rje/ mnga' ris rin cen bzang po/ bran ka mun ti myang sha mi go cha/ a ban ta ra/ khams pa go cha/chaganyal lo tsā ba/ 'bre gyel ba blo gros/ ā tsadu ye shes sa le/ glang dwabal gyi seng ge sa yong char tsa/ gru gu o bas/ lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas/ g.yu sgra snying po/ gnyan chen dpal dbyangs/ dran pa nam mkha'/ khu byung /'od mon bu rgyal byang / byi sha mi du/ khyung po dbyeg sod/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ u rgyun glang chen/ so ye shes dbang po/ dan ye shes mchog //tong ār+ya pradz+nyā/ sba gsal snang / sba dpal dbyangs/ sba ye shes dbang po/spa 'jam dbyangs/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 'od rgyal kha spun/ rma shāku/khams pa lo tsā mgar shaka 'od/ sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ ā tsaru ye shes dbyangs/ ā tsadu gsal mchog dbyangs/ 'gos spu 'byin1 ke li —'byung gnas/ zhan lo tsā ba/ 'o bran dbang phyug sha me bkol/ lha lung ༷yul kong / me tog byang 'bar/ zhang to na shes rab/ yar shes brtsegs/sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ sna nam zhang ye shes rdo rje/ ā tsadu dharmā shrī la/ 04

rak+ṣi ta/ de lu saṃ bhā lu/ zhang shākya pra swā+o/lu/ byams pa dpal bzang po/zhang pa tsha ba nyi ma grags/ rmog spyogs/ 'dzim lo tsā ba/ de pa byang snying /gra pa grum gu/ gtsang la ring mo/ mal zho lo tsā ba/ rgya banu+on 'grus seng ge la byi ye shes brtsegs/ skyo chos sku rdo rje1 cog ro glu'i rgyal mtshan/ ska ba dpal brtsegs/ chos kyi lhun po/ kha ltung klong / gtsang legs grub/yon tan mtsho/ bsam gtan mkhan po rim gyis pa/ rtse men/ cig car ba/ston mun/ mkhan po mjug spus/ mkhan po edhan r+ṣor/ mkhan po ma hā yā na/ mkhan po bdud 'dul snying po/ cig car mkhan po kun hun shen/ mkhan po dzi shin sha/ mkhan po sbab shan shis/ mkhan po des 'gre'o/ mkhan po de'u shan shis/ mkhan po zangs thang shan shis/ mkhan po ha ze shan shis/mkhan po ādu rakhri/ mkhan po ka la yan/ mkhan po bu chus/ mkhan po kha shan shis/ mkhan po dza shan shis/ mkhan bo 'dre shan shis/ mkhan po a shan shis/ mkhan po len shan shis/ mkhan po ha shan shis/ mkhan po kan shan shis/mkhan po dzi shan shis/ mkhan po ki shan shis/ mkhan po bye'u gyi'u shan shis mkhan po kyi shan shis/ mkhan po ci shan shis/ mkhan po phog tog shan shis1mkhan po dza shan shis/ mkhan po yan shan shis/ mkhan po nyan shan shis/mkhan po shin shan shis/ mkhan po gye khas shan shis/ mkhan po lang shan shis1mkhan po ma shan shis/ mkhan po a lo gzong chu/ mkhan po ye shes dpal/mkhan po gzhi mchog mkhan po myang bran ye shes rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po a rat+na thang / makon po 'dzin mgo rgyan/ mkhan po sum pa ye shes rgyal po/mkhan po dpal sbas/ mkhan po mi 'dzum/ mkhan po dkar rgyal/ mkhan po seng ge blo gros/ mkhan po bde mo skyid/ byang chub sems dpa'i mkhan po rnams/ /sa gsum bzhi pa yan chod du/ /gsang sngags phyi pa nang pa bstan/405

lo paṇa rtsis sman chos rnams bsgyur/ /bod khams bde skyid chos la bkod/ /rje 'bangs kun gyis dgongs tshul dang / /mkhan slob gdan drangs pyon tshul dang / /mdo sngags bod du bsgyur tshul dang / /sngags dang mtshan nyid dar tshul dang / /rgyal brgyud khrims kyi 'jigs tshul dang / /sems can las ngan spyod tshul dang / /chos spel sprul sku'i byon tshul dang / /bstan pa 'phel 'grib dus tshigs dang / /mtha' dmag g.yul ngo bzlog thabs dang / /bstan pa'i tha skyong gter sbas rnams/ /bstan pa'i lung bstan shes par bya/ /'dzam gling spri yi lung bstan dang / /pad+ma bka' yi thang yig dang / /lha 'dre bka' yi thang yig dang / /rgyal po bka' yi thang yig dang / /blon po bka' yi thang yig dang / /btsun mo bka' yi thang yig rnams/ /'dus gral bzhugs pa'i rje 'bangs dgongs/ /rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan gyis/ sangs rgyas bstan /pa dar bar mdzad/ /rgyal po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa/ /'brug gi lo la zung mkhar chagashegs/ /de sras mu de btsan po yis/ 1chab srid nyi shu rtsa lnga bzung / /rakar chu rdo rje dbyings ni bzhengs/ /bzhi bcu lug gi lo la grongs/ /de sras phyag rdor sprul pa byon khri gtsug sde btsan 'on cang rdo1 /dbe med bkra shis g.yung drung legs/ /phyogs bzhir gtsug lag brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rgya gar ma na po dzi na mi co dang / su ren+d+ra po dhi sogs spyan drangs nas/ lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan sogs/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang du bsgyur/ /sangs rgyas bston pa dar bar mdzad/ /mnga' bdag dgung lo bcu bdun nas/ 1rgyal srid nyi shu rtsa gcig bzung / /chu stag rgya dang mdzal dus byas/ /de tshe sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo/ /nyis stong brgya dang drug lon no/ /sum cu so drug bya lo la/ /gcung po dar mas lan khar bkrongs/ /de ni sdig spyod rgyal po yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams par 406

bus/ /rgyal po 'thung ba'i 'tshung sri ldang / /blon po 'phung ba'i 'phung sri rteldang / /rgyal khams 'phung ba'i 'phung sri ldang / /yul mi 'phung ba'i 'phung sri ldang / /sde pa 'phung ba'i 'phung sri ldang / /dmag sri dgra sri dam sri ldang //lda sri chung sri dur sri ldang / /gud sri byed ma'i gung sri ldang / /'a(1ga/sri mug sri nad yams sri/ /ma 'ongs dus thu mnan zlog sreg /bya thabs so so nas yod kyi/ /de dus gtsang pa rab gsal dang / /g.yog po dge chung shamar shākyas/ /'dul ba gdan drangs khams la byod/ /an chung dan tig brag phug tu/ /ha shang ging/bag dgongs pa gsal/ /gsum kyis bsnyen par jogs par mdzad/ /rgyal srid lo ni bcu gsum bzung / /sum cu so gnyis stag lo la/ /lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bkrongs/ /de sras 'od grungs yum bstan gnyis/ /mnga' ris gcig la so sor bsgoms/ /do dus sangs rgyas 1gshegs nas sho/ /nyis stong dgu ba rgya re dgu song / 1me pho 'brug la yar stod du/ /gnyags ban tsān ku mas brtsis/ /'od srungs pos ni dpal 'khor can/ /sman lung la sogs sde brgyad bzhengs/ /de dus mo ston nyams dbang dang / /tshogs dge shes rab seng ge dang / /klu mas shes rab tshul khrims dang / 1'bri zi ye shes yon tan dang / /thos mi ye shes dbang po dang / /rig shes tshul khrims rgyal bo mis/ /mdo smad dan tig brag phug tu/ /dgongs pa gsal las gdams pa blangs/ /dbus gtsang bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ /shing glang grwa pa mngon shes brtsis/ /sum stong sum brgya so brgyad song / /de sras khri la mgon gyi sras/ /bku shis mgon sras lha bla ma/ / ye shes 'od kyi mas mthing bzhengs/ pra ta kā ra spyan drangs nas/ /lo tsā rin cen bzang po mis/ /gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs bsgyur/ /de yi gcung po khri dpal gyis/ / gtsang khar gtsugs lag khang bzhengs so/ /de sras btsun pa rgyang 'od kyis/ / /4mi1

dī paṃ ka ra spyan drangs nas/ /skyos rnams phyag len phebs par mdzad/ /de dus chu pho 'brug lo la/ rong zom chos kyi bzang pos brtsis/ /sum stong brgya dang rtsa lnga song / /phag lo rngog lo 'das nas ni/ /de dus lcags pho stag lo la/ /rong ban shes rab 'od kyis brtsis/ /sum stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu gsum/ /sa skyar sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /me mo bya la brtsis pa yis/ /sum stong sum brgya bzhi bcu dgu /chu glang ya tse rgyal po yis/ /lha sar gser thog bkal ba'i dus/ /gra stod yar chen sngags pa'i sde/ /dbon po shes rab bzang pos brtsis/ /sum stong bzhi brgya zhe drug song / /chu sprel zung mkhar rdo mchod rten/ /chos rje karmā rang byung gis/ /gdugs dang chos 'khor phab nas bskyon/ 1chos rgyal rin cen gling pas brtsis/ /sum stong bzhi brgya re lnga song / /chu mo lug lo sa skya 'khrug /me mo phag la yar klungs sde/ /dpon chen rgyal bzang gsang dmag bkongs/ sa log gnam log bstan pa log /mi bde ba yi rlung 'tshub langs/ /bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ /me pho stag la sgam por bzhugs/ /u rgyan gling pas shes phug brtsis/ /sum stong dang ni lnga brgya lon/ /de nas sa pho spre'u lo1 /bsam yas bgegs gsos rab gnas byas/ /zla ba dgu pa nyer dgu'i nub/ /hor yul pho brang tal du shol/ /thal skya pe wang me chu pho/ /bod du rgya yi lag rtags byung / /sum stong lnga brgya nyi shu lnga/ /chu mo bya la mu ge che/ /lung gsum dkar po ljongs su brtsis/ /sa yos lnga brgya phrag bdun rjes/ 1sum stong yod de lnga brgya bri/ sne gdong zheng blon 'khrugs nas khengs log byung / /u rgyan gling pas sku rim mdzad/ ro langs bdun ni choms la phab/ /me dwags gnyis la lam rgya btsug / /shing mo phag la yar klungs bde/ /de dus tshe yi tshad bstan pa/ /da lta drug cu rtsa lnga'i dus1 mdo sde'i dus la phebarga pa'o/ /de 408

nas bstan pa dngos la stong / /de nas rtags tsam 'dzin pa la/ /lnga brgya phrag gcig 'byung bas te/ /tshe lo bzhi bcu pa ru sgong / /de/yang mdo sde gdas la las/ /bzhi bcu'i dus rte bstan pa nub/ /de yang she che'i yul dag tu/ /sprul shing yul gyi dge 'dun rnamashe/ /thams cad bode du tshoges par 'gyur/ /de yang dge 'dun kha nyen pa/ /rim gyis shar phyogs ngos la 'igro /dge 'dun shabs tog med/pa gis/ /de nas ko'u sham bije 'gro / tshu chin r+sham bcad ma mthar bas/ /klu rgyal e la'i 'dab ma yis/ /sbrul chede/sprul nas zam pa byas/ /dge 'dun kibum ni chu las bsgrazha/ /rgyal te shezod pare dka' ba yis/ /dge/zhadun rnams kyi zhabs rtog byus/ /dge/'byen rnams kyi shetso bo ni/ /sde sdod 'dzin sda slob ma can/ /slob ma rnams la ma mgu nas/ /gshe sbyong 'don du ma gnad bas/ /de byerga darga bcom des pa byon/ /gso stod 'don par rigs gsubs pas/ 1dpung dmar can gyis dgra bcom gsod/ —/de nas phan tshun 'khrugs pas ni/ /dge 'dun rnams ni bkrongs pad 'gyud/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa de ru nub/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul mya jan byed/ /sku rnams klu yis /gdan 'dren cing 1 /yi ge rnams ni rang byir 'gro /rin cen gos dar rnams kyang nub/ /'bru rnams nus 〈ming/bcud kyang med/ /pra mi pheb cing tshos mi 'go /ba dmar glang dmar ko ba spyon/ /rgyal po lta sgom 'dri sa med/ /thugs mug tshe yi dus byed 'gyur/ /de nas kri yog sgyid ma za/ /re ba la sogs gos su gyon/ /rus pa thur zhing rgyan du 'dogs/ /de 'dra'i dus la ma thug bar/ /dam pa'i chos la 'bung 'tshal lo/ /nyes pa'i rtsa ba lta spyod mi thun pa/ /de dag khyer longs sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las sangaso gyes bstan pa dar nub bstan pa'i le'u ste so gsum pa'o/ / //4 9

mdor bsdus gzhi 'am 'bras bu bstan pa/mdor bsdus gzhi lam 'bras bu yi/1ngo bo nges tshig mtshan nyid dang / godabye ba gzhan sel dang ni lnga/ /gzhi yi ngo bo gnyis su med/ /nges tshig thams cad 'byung phyir gzhi/ /mtshan nyid ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /dbye ba rnam pa gsum yin te/ /de dag don gyi kun gzhi dang / /sna tshogs bsogs pa'i kun gzhi dang / /'byor pa don gyi kun gzhi'o/ 1ma rig log rtog sel ba ni/ /stong par 'dug pas dngos po sel/ /gnyis med yin pas gnyis snang sel/ /rang byung yin pas rgyu rkyen sel/ /lhun grub yin pas re dogs sel/ /dag pa yin pas dri ma sel/ /med dang yod pa'i rtag chad bral/ /gzhal lugs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /ye shes rnam pa gsum yin no/ /'khrul gzhi rnam pa mang bshad kyang / /lhun grub dang ni thugs rje'o/ /gzhi la gnas pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rang bzhide shugs kyi 'char gzhi byed/ /mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i ye shes kyis/ /skyon gyis dag pa smin par byed/ /shes dang shes bya'i ye shes kyis/ /mos guse can la dngos grub ster/ /thog ma'i ngo bo rang bzhin dang //—theg pa rnam pa gsum du gnas/ /de yang ngo bo skur gnas pas/ / chos sku longs sku sprul skur 'char/ /rang bzhin 'char byed lus kyi tshul/ /dkar dmar ser dang ljang mthing ni/ /mtshan ma'i rigs can ma yin par/ /rigs med shes bya'i rtsal las grub/ /thugs rjes 'char ba sna tshogs pa/ 1'di 'dra gcig tu nges med pas/ /sna tshogs snang phyir gzhi zhes bya/ /gzhi nas ye shes gsum yin te/ /ngo bo ka dag ye shes dang / /rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes dwang / /thugs rjes rang snab ye shes so/ /ngo bo ka dag ye shes la/ 410

ma rig pa dag mi srid pas/ /gcig dang gnyis zhes gagrang med do/ /gang du ma phye chos nyid la/ /ye shes tsam du grub pa med/ /rang byung lhun grub ye shes zhes/ /mi skye mi 'gag cir mi dgongs/ /yul dang nges pa med pa'i phyir/ 1rtsal dang yon tan 'gag med pas/ /rol pa tsam du snang ba las/ / sna tshogs rdzogs pa'i gzhi ma'o/ /thugs rjes kun khyab ye shes las/ /mi/ 'dzad sna tshogs 'char ba'i sgo/ /'dzad ltar snang ba'i ngo bor rdzogs/ /tshas sku stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ye shes mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /shugs kyis sems can rnams la 'char/ /'di med 'khor ba 'das te chad/ /mkhyen pas rig cing gsal ba'o/ /ngo bo ka dag ye shes ni/ /bde gshegs chos kyi klong yangs gsal/ /spros bral tshos nyid ka dag ni/ /ngo bo rnam dag chos nyid gzhi/ /de la tshig med yi gi bral/ /brjod pa gtan la dbab tu med/ //sgro 'dogs tha snyad kun bral zhing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog med /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /chos sked chos kyi/'du shes med/ /gang med ci med ci yang med/ /de ltar phed pa'i snying po la/ /re zhig tshig gis gtan phab nas/ /ngo bo nyid ni ka dag la/ rang bzhin nyid du lhun grub bo/ /de ltar lhun gyis grub shes nas/ /ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /byang chub sems kyi chos nyid kyis/ /mi snang ba la dngos su 'byin nus pas// chos nyid snying po yin par yid kyang ches/ /rge las ma byung rkyen gyis mi 'jig pas/ /rang byung ye shes yin par yid kyang ches/ /rang bzhin bcu yis btsal du med pa'i phyir/ /bstago pa'i sgon me yin par yid kyang ches/ 1sde snod kun dang rgyud sde kun rnams kyi/ /'byung gnas gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ /kun gye spyi 'grel yin par yid kyang ches/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa kun las khyad 'phags pas/ /theg pa'i yang rtse yin par yid k+tang ches/ /dus gsum 411

sangs rgyas kun gyi lam yin pas/ rnam dag lam chen yin pang yid kyang ches/ thamasashācad sems gu 'dus pa'i phyor/ /kun gyi rtsa ba yin par yid kyang ches/ /thams cad sems la gnas pa'i phyir/ /kun gyi gzhi ma yin par yid kyang ches/ /thams cad sems las byung ba'i phyir/ /kun gyi 'byung gnas yin par yid kyang /sas/ /thams cad sems kyis byas pa'i phyir/ /kun gyi mkhan po yirna par yid kyang ches/ /thams cad sems las med pa'i phyir/ /kun gyi ngo bo yin par yid kyang ches/ /snang ba med las kun la khyab pa'i phyir/ /gdal ba chen po yin par yid kyang ches/ /gcig dang du mar bgrang du med pa'i snyir/ /theg le nyag gcig yin par yid kyang ches/ /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med par gnas pa'i phyir/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan yin par yid kyang ches/ /chos kyi rang ༷bzhin ma nges pas/ /lta ba ngos gezung med par yid kyang ches/ /rang la yod kyang rtogs par dka' ba'i phyir/ /gargang sngags man ngag yin par yid kyang ches/ /de ltar byang chub semaso nyid du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs 'dus te/ /spyi 'dus dgongs 'a dus thams cad 'dus/ /dpe yis 'dus la don gyis 'dus/ /rtags dang rgatan tshirgas mthun par 'dus/ /spyi yi 'dus par bstan pa ni/ /rabame bdun shākya thub pa dang / /stong rtsa gnyis kyi dgongs pa g.yang / /chos nyid byang chub sems su 'dus/ /dgongs kyi 'dus par bstan /pa yang / /kun du bzang po'i dgongs pa 'dus/ /bzang ngan blang dor med par 'dus/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs pa 'dus/ /skye 'gag 'pho 'gyur samed par 'dus/༷ /rnam par snang mdzad dgongs pa 'dus/ /ye shes kun gyi lus can 'dus/ /rin cen 'byung gnas dgongs pa 'dus/ /zag med gter gyi dgongs par 'dus/ /snang ba mtha' yas dgongs par 'dus/ khyab gdal ཿna po'i dgongs par 'dus1 /don yod grub pa'i dgongs pa 'dus /thoṭa me/2

sed ye shes dgong sa pa 'dus/ 1dpe/ni kun dpe nam mkhar 2dus/ /donagani kun rdzob chos nyid 'dus/ /rtags ni byang chub sems su 'dus/ 1gtan chigs rang byung ye shes 'dus/ /rang nyid lha yi gzugs snang ste/ /rang bzhin stun gruze ye shes ni/ /sems can kun gyi sems gcig pu/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /phung po lnga don sangs rgyas lnga/ /'byung ba lnga don dpyongs phyug yum/ khams dang skye mched mang po kun/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i dkyili 'khor yin/ /de bas snang srid dkyil 'ekhor che/ /bsheso 'as grub pa'i gnas lugs bdun/ /gnas pa bdun gyi tshul du yang / /sna tshogs ngos nas lhun grub pa/ /'gyur tshe cha nas nges med pa/ /mi 'gyur ba la nges pa can/ /snang ba'i tshad ni ci yang bsgyur/ /thams cad 'byung phyir khas lerna byas/ /'jel pa dag phyir rke deg la/ /snyeng tshul tha dad khru bor 'dod/ /de rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /'khrul lugs la sgo rnam pa bdun/ /'khrul gzhi rgyu dus ngo bo dang / /tshul dang 'brase bu dpe bstan pa/ /dang po 'khrul pa'i bshad pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mes chen sdos/ /mtshon cing ngos gzung med parje gcig /dus gsum 'dus/ma byas/pa bye/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma bskyede par/ /chos rnams kun gyi/snying po can/ 1rang bsgen lhun gyis grub nas4bzhugs/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /dag dang/ma dag rnam pa can/ /yod kyang rang gis ma mthong bag/ /skyes1bu'i lus byad 'grogs pa 'dra/ /'khrul ba'i rgyu ni ma rig pa/ /sa rig ga la rnam pa/gsum/ bdag nyid gcig pus 'khrul rtsa bye da/ /lhan cig skyes/pa rtog pa gnyis/ /kun tu brtags pas yul du gyur / —/mede pa yod pad brtags pa'o/ /'khrul pa'i dus ni spyod byed kye/ /shes pa/zhugs pa'i che 'khrul te/ /kun/gzhi chos dbyings mnyam ma nyid/go4/3

cos kyi sku ru gdos pa la / /rig pa rang las gzhan du bcad/ /yul sems gnyis su bzung tshe 'khyul/ /rgyu/dang byed med rtsa bas te/ 1rang ngo yin ༷par ma shes pas/ /'di ni 'khor ba'i thog ma'o/ /snang ba 'khrul pa'i nga bdag ste/ /kun gzhi mnyam nyid chen po la/ /nyon mongs can gyi yid kyis ni/ kha ni nang bltas bdag tu bzung / /yid kyi rnam shes kha phyir bstan/ /sgo lnga'i rnam shes rjes 'brangs nas/ /rtog gzhibs sna tshogs bsags pas te/ /༷dgra gnyen la sogs bzung bas 'khrul/ /mdo sde lang kar gshegs pa las/ /sems ni kun gzhi rnam shes te/ /rang sems nyid ni yid bzhin no/ /gang gis yul rnams 'dzin pa ni/ /de ni rnam par shes par bya/ /sems ni rtag tu lung ma bstan/ /yid ni gnyis kar gyur pas te/ rnam par shes pa 'byung ba yang / /de ni dge dang mi dge'o/ /'khru' tshul sems ngo gang du yang / /ma grub mi rtag med pa la/ /phyi nang sgod bcud gnyis su btags/ /yul 'khor bu nor dgra gnyen 'dzin/ /mi rtag chos la dgrar zhen 'khrul/ /'khrul pa'i 'bras bu rigs drug gi /gnas su sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /de rnams gzhan gyis byas pa min1 /rang sems 'khrul ༷las byung ba'o/ /sprir na 'khrul gzhi zhes bya ste/ /ma rig nyid dang sngags pa'i phyir/ /shes bya nyid kyang rje mar snang / /sems la dran sems 'char pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid ni rtog bas sbags/ /rigs drug 'dzin pa ma zhagags phyir/ /chos sku nyid kyang 'dzin pas bcings/ /cha med yul dang bcas pa'i byer/ //'od gsal nyid kyang bag la chags/ rkyen gzhi'i dmigs pa ma dag phyir/ /snang ba nyid kyang du mar shar/ /snang ba de nyid yul snang phyir/ /de las phyi dang nang nyid chags/ /mkha' la rlung brten de la chu/ /'byem phrag bcu drug rtadag gis ni/ /blum la 'dril ba nyid du chags/ /de steng sa can brten pa'i 414

steng / /ri rab ri yi rgyal po ni/ /bang rim bzhi dang stog chede bzhi/ /rol mtsho dang ni ri nom bdun/ /gling sdems dang ni khor yug chags/ stong gsum la sogs khams rnamese so/ 1dire brten nang bcud sems cano kyang / /'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med kyi/ khamaso gsum/po ni /de la brten/ /yod min ci yang med pa dang / /rnam shes curnga zade med pa deng / /gzugs med rnams ni de lapha skyes1 /gnas gtsang la sogs lus can ni/ /gong nas gong du/thug pa'i tshul/ /'og min la sogs 'dod pa'o/ /lha dang lha snyen /mi rnams—ni/ /mngon mtho de la gnas byed cing / /byol song yi rwags nga97la ba dang / /sems can de dag skye ba bzhi/ /de ltar 'jig rten gsum na ni/ /phung po lnga dang dbang po lnga/ /yan lag sde deng don snying lnga/ /yul lnga dang ni nyon mengasgo lnga/ /semes lnga yid lnga rtog pa lnga/ 1gzung 'dzin 'khor ba nyid du grub/ /phung po lnga dang skye mched lnga/ /gzung 'dzin dag gis bzung nas ni/ /'khor ba nyid la yun ring gnas/ khams ga sum po yi khang ba ru/ /ming ༷dang gzugs kyi btsorna rar tshud/ /ma rig la sogs lcargas kyisapa bsdams/ /'khor ba'i thun nag stug pos g.yogs/ / 'dod chags tsha po 'i ro la chags / //gti mug nages pas ske nas bcings/ 1zhe sda nga me yi tshad pas gdungs/ /nga rgyal dag gis mgo nas gtums/ /phrag dog nyid kyis sgo mo 'khrigs/ / khong khro ma sogs dmag gis bskor/ /gzungarwa'adzin zhags pas ske nas bsdems/rwa /snga phyi bag chegase 'dam du bying / /rnam smin nyid dang lag trewa te 1 /las kyis ma bye mtshams snyer nas/ /gcig nas gcig tu zo chu bzhin/ /༷ba nge ngan rim par lus blangs te1 )/so so'i gzugs tshu skye bar 'gyur/ /ngar 'dzinado'akhore ba'i sdug bsngal 'ikhor/ khyed badza rkus kyi spyob tshul ni/ /yab dayum bar do'i rnam shes 'dzome / /bad+mar chud pa'i sa bode ni/ /'dzin pa sa4416

khazhi sa rang bzhi gte ཿ /chus bskyed me yis smin par byed/she /rlung gis 'azel byed nam mkhu' yis/ /go skazas 'byed par byed pa min/ / de nyidasheskye stor byed pa yang / 1sdo bsas ko la sbyodo bas/ /ngog pa bde ba3chags ma nyidashe sa ni de las skyertabarwa 'gyur 1byang snyems khyu ba'i rab bzhi— ོdelag /chu/ste gams ni 'byub bas te/ /bskyod pasnya lus ni drod giskyed de/ /gago ba rlung du rab tu grags/ /bde/ba nam mkha' nyid/kyi khazla sa/ /lnga pos rnam par shem pa /bsko / /spyo ni bur do'i rnam shes/ste1 /bag gog sa/nyoskopodardoshegin gyi yid/ /phying gi ngo bo ba lhags gzhago mthong / /de ni nges par/mi shes shib / /rlunge tsam gcig pur moskos gidu gyed /kugo gzhizhi/rnam shes brdzugalgasanoni/ / mngal/'jug bag chags rnarga par spyod/ /bag/chags nyid/kyis rgom shes bzung / /de tshe khu sa ga/zhu zhigs bgasan /'dres pa rgyu ru gyur pa dang / /kurna gzhi'i rnam shes rgyur bcas pa / /ji pas pa/chang ros myos pa/ltar/)rte /nyor+sha mongs can bye srog /rlung nyid/ /skad cig gcig 'jimang dag 'gro rdo /nur nur men/mer ltan/ltar po/ /gor gor bo ste bdun phrag bzhi/ /las rlung gis dkrugs sdudanapar byed//mkhrung gyur shag ni dab po nasashā rang sor byed dang bcu gsusha/gyi// /tshad saldan dbu ma sgog phying/ bcas// /bskyed nas snying dang ste ba migo 1zhakhor lo drug cu'i rten chags nago/ /nya yi rnam pha lta bur 'gyur / /ste ban ma yi rtsa 'brel bas/ /sang khrag rgyas pharna khyed par/'gyur/ /1de nag zla ba gnyis pa nas/she /zhag re rtse ni nyis/brgya/chugs/ /srog1zhas thurwa se' 'acan ga/nas ni /) rus1sbalarnam pa lta bu/sted/// zla ba gsum par gyen rgyunayi/༷ ca1༷sangabyugis/stod rnamasa'agrub par snyeg/ /1 bzhi pa khyag byed/ rlu nga/rnams kyim/ ༷15palag nga rnamasasnang bar rtsod / /lnga pa mnyam1gnas/rlung/'phros nag/ / rdo /nang gi༅ /gi gzhana'agrub par byed/ /phag rgod seng ge'i gnag skabs/zhin/ / /mnyarga gnar+sā/khyab4sgo6

byed gnyis stobs rdzogs/ /lu ni 'dar dang 'gil por byed1 /de dus rus chigs dum bu ni/ nyis brgya drug cu chags par 'gyur/ /de ster phung po lnga rdzogs nas/ /zla ba drug par phyin pa na/ /rlung gis rlung gi stobag bskyed nas/ //sa khamag/gas ni mig gnyis bskyed/ /de nas bdun bar rus sbal rlung / /sgos nas chu khams sna bubakadod/ rngozud pa/ba/me yis rna ba bye/ /de tshe tshangs pa'i rlung spro'o/ /dgu par lhas byin rlung byung nas1 /ro can rtse be+e skyed par byed/ /bcu par nor lha rgyal gyi rlung / /skyes nas rlung bcu'i nus pa rdzogs/ shāde lta ra khams dang skye mched rdzogs/ /zla re drug stong rtsa chags pas/ mngal du stod phrag lnga bcu bzhi/ /skyes nas zla ba gnyis pa nas/ /stong phrag bdun4 cu rtsa gnyis rdzogs/ /dgu pa zas ni mi gtsang za/ 1de/nas snyigs ma'i khams 'byung ngo / 1bkres skom rlung gis tshor ba'o/ /sdug bsngal drag po myong bar 'gyur/ /de tshe 'byin pa'i rlung gis ni/ /bsgyur nas skye bar 'dod pa min/ mi mi seng ge'i gnas skabs so/ /de ltar phung khams skye mched rnams/ /rtsa rlung thibakale las grub pas/ dri mar bcas pa'i se sa nyidakalas/ /byung ste dri bcas sprul skur gsungs/ /lo paṇa bka'i thang yig las mdor bsdus gzhi lam 'bras/bu bstan pa'i ledi ste so bsdo pa'o// / / sems kyi gnas lugag bstan pa/sems kyi ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba ni/ /se mas kyi ngo bo dwangs ma'i bdag nyin ldan/ /nges tshig yid phyir mi 'brang the tshom bral/ /dbye na snang ba dkar dmar phyi yi sems/ /rig pa 'gyu byed nang gi sems dang gnyis/ /sgo lnga dbang po bar gyi sems dang gsubo/ /gnyis zhedzin rnam rtog lung ma bstan 17

dang bzhi'o/ /mtshan nyid gzhi lam lta sgom spyod 'bras ni/ /mtshan nyid rnam /shes tshogs brgyad lam̐s/ /sems dang yid dang rnam par shes/ /mtshan nyid don du rab tu brtags/ /brgyad po mtshan nyid tha dad med/ /mtshan gzhi /med cing mtshan nyid med/ /ji ltar rdo yi phye na la/ /bsale sbram ni mi snang /yang / /yongs su sbyangs pas de mthong ltar/ ༷ /de ltar sems can di bzhin /gshegs/ /ngo bo thams cad chedams nyid de/ nagabazhirartagyi dpe bzhin gnyis su samed/ /lam ni theg rim tha dad gsungs/ /gzhi ni nyon mongs chos kyi rgyu/ //rnam par byang pa'i gasgo ma yin/ /rtsa ba'i rnam par shes parababashad/ /gzhi ni kun gyi bcos gled bral/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gsum 'dzom gzhi / /skye ba med la kun gyi gzhi/ /'gag pa med pa kun gyi gzhi/ /1gnas pa med pa kun gyi chagazhi/ /de la gzhi ni 'khor 'das gzhi/ /bdag gzhan kun spusagazhi ma yin/ /g.yod med khas blangs kun gyi gzhi/( /snang stong bde sdug kude gyi gzhi/ /tig chad bem rig kun gyi gzhi/ /'dod pa'i khams na ma rig pa/ /lam sgo lnga ru mizhugs nas ni/ /ba zhi/de rtogs dang ma rtogs les/ /sangs rgyas sems can /gnyis su byung / /rig pas sems ma so nam byas/ /snang ba sems med gtan chal phebs/ /sems gyi rnam rtog rgyu zad pas/ /mkha' spyo da gnas su khrid pa'o/ /ma yengs dad nas lam la 'jug nyams su len la brtson byas nas/ /lam gyi bogs 'don gnad du gzung / /snang srid gzhi bzhengs chen po la/ //sgogs chen lam la bstos na 'khrul/ /dzogs chen gang la mi bsten 'di/ /salam la sbyangs pagrod med pa'i lam/ /sku gsum rang yin gzhan na med/ /lam gyi sgrub pa nyams su blangs/ /kun gzhi rtsa bral don rtogs nges/ /nges /pa'i don la chos bur med/ /sa lam 'dod bas dzogs chen 'khrul/ /rte mtsho mchen pos chu la 'thungam/ gochu sna sna tshogs bro ba 'ong / /gcig grol bas ni 418

thams cad zhig/tshig gcig go bas tho sa pa'i mchog /mdud rgya mang po'i sna bzhin du/ /thams cad khrul ma khrol mar 'gro /lta ba bsam dang sgom rgyu gtor/ /snang tshad rang byung chos kyi sku/ /lta ba'i rgyal po ngo shes pas/dpeb na chu la chu bzhag bzhin/ /de snga phan chad 'khrul rtog gzhi/ /da lta ba lalang med shes su/ /snang yang dri ma sems la med/ /lta ba mnyam pa ris med /rdzogs/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /jogs chen ma rtogs 'tshang mi rgya/ //sgom med joganā chen lta ba yin/ /phyag chen pa lis rtogs mi 'gyur/ /lta ba'i sagol sa gcod rgyu med/ /sgom mi nus pa'i spyod 5par/mi ne/ /sgom pa ci yang 'ad sgom ste/ /bsam mno mang po byed pa min/ /rang sems min pa'i chos ci 'dug /chos kyi sgo lag ma rnyed pas/ /chos pa'i grag sar chos mug byung / / yid la ma bsgos sa de bzhi na grol/ /bsgom du byung na rgyun da yin1 /skyon yod 'dug gam mi 'dug gnigs/ /rang shar rang grol/dzogs pa la/ /yid sbyod 'dzin pas 'tshang mi rgya/ /byings tshugs 'ad ma du tshud nyen yod/ /sgom ༷'chos shes pa rgya bod mang / /sgom 'jig shes pa nga las med/ /'di ltar snang ༷ba thams cad ni/ /chos kyi sku la g.yo ba med/ /yin min kun gyi tha snyad /bral/ /snang ba 'gag med rtsal du shar/ /rtsal shar ba de ngos 'dzin pa/ /dang po byung sha ma rnyed pa/ /bar du gnas sa ma rnyed pa/ /mtha' mar 'gro/sa sa rnyed pa/ /sgom pa'i thag gcod rbad kyis chod/ /ma zhesam yengs bsgom —pa'o/ /spom yor sgom gyis de mi go 1sgom gyi rtsa ba 'khrul pa yin/ /lo mang bsgoms kyang sdug skur yin/ /snying rus sdug sran bskyed nas bsgom/ /rang gi blun bzo'i sgom pa de/ /phugs su mi yi bong bu 'byung / bskal par bsgoms —kyang 'tshang mi rgya/ /sgom zhes bya ba yod ma phyong / /gang shar thug phrad lam khyer rman/ /dbang po rag 'bring tha ma gsum/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad thams 4/9

cad la/ shesnang ba spros 'jig glod pa lan/ /bad 'azub sgom gyi mtshang shor ro1 /rab kyis chos skur rtogs nas 'ong / /'bring gis longs skur rtogs nas 'ong / /tha mas sprul skur rtogs nas 'ong / /sku gsum gcig ste dbyer med de/ /spyod pa dgag sgrub gang yang med/ /rkyen thub dad gyur spyod pa'i mchog /bsgrub byu yigag ged spyod pa yin/ 1spyod pa yul daja yul gzhan med1 /lha spyod zung 'bre la 'edzin chags med/ /spyod lam bcos ma med na bde/1shugs 'byung rnam pa thag pa nges/ /dga' mgu bogs 'don ci yang med/ shegazhi lam 'bras bu gnyis su med/ /'bras bu mngon 'byung rdo rje sems/ 1'bras bu spangs thob med par chod/ /yid la ma bsgoms de bzhin grol/ /lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu gsum/ /dbyer med 'bras bu zad par skyol/ 1re dogs 'bras bu ther la 'don/ /'khor 'das rtsa ba gang legs ni1 /mdor bsdus gasnye lam 'bras bur gsal/ /mdo ni gar bsdu zhes pa ni/ /dug lnga garten sprugs song ba la/ /'khor ba bya ba'i ming yang med/ /'gag ni sku lnga ye shes lnga/ /'khrul pa rang dag sgong bar gda'/ /ma rig chu yis khyer bar gda'/ gnad ni geng du bsre ba ni/ /'khor 'das gnyis ka rang snang yin/ /yin lugs thog tu car gyis babs/ /'khor 'das gnyis su med par bsre/ /las la bzang ngan mad par bsre/ /phu thag gar gcod 'gro sa gar gtong ni/ /rang ngo rjen pa yin thag gcod/ /'phrad chog 'bral med phu thag chod/ /'gro sa ma bcos ma bslad gtong / /mtha' ni gar thug 'thob bya gang yin ni/ /bshig pas mi shigs pa la thug /'phral bas mi phrel pa la thug /'thob bya/gshis kyi yin lugs thob/ 1sems dang ye shes khyad par gang / rgyu las ma byung 'bras dus phye/ /lung las ma byung man ngag phye/ sems las ma byung sangs rgyas gye/ /sems ni mi dran dgu dran/yin/ 1mi rig 420

dgusanig sbo zhi btub/ /mi gnas rgyun mirngod du 'phro /sangs gyos/mi ga yo ngarwagasashe mdangs ldan/ /dbyings rig/bde/chen klong du brdal/ /ma byasgam yi gzhal yas/khang / / mimam las na byud sangs rgyatho min/ /sangs rgya thus sa rje'i byung tshul ni/ /thugs rjeg shebyung ba sprum nga'i rtu/ 1tsot+ta rin cen gzhal mas na/ /sku ni cha/phra til1'bru tsam /'od dngashāthir gyi kha mig can1 /'od lnga'iX/klong na jogs par banyugarga/ /yad sgrul zer/sdi kha/mig/canashe rdozhi ba rigs mab yusnya bcu/ khro bo digs lnga yan/yum/baXcu/ kha dog sna yis gomatshonaXn nisha 1rgyal po nang3na bzhug pa'o/ /tshig nyung go/ de don 'dril nyamasga3su long / /lornapaṇa bka'i thang/yig las memamartakyi gnas lugs bstan pa'i lenyu ste stam cu so lnga pa rdzogasartalo/ /sa mā ya1 /rgya rgya rgya/ /༷ nadzhag byang / /de /nas sgo/paṇa/rgyal blon 'khor bcas kyis/ /sangs rgyas/gnyis pa snyarba 'byung gan la/ /bstod sta'i rgyalapo 'di skad ces bstod sko/ /e ma hoṣe kun bza pa/rdor 'a nga rdor sims chos sku gesum/ /rigs lnga rig baXzhi rig sa gsum long sku gsu / /shākya thub ranganargyal dgra bathosnya sprul kyi gsum/ /sku gsu rdocha na ngasapad 'byung nyid la bstod/ a ti a nu/ma hā chos sku'i gasdomang 1 kri ma murdo tha ldo ga longs sku'i gesung / /'dul ba do sde mngon pa (14/sku'ino gsung /sde gsun dam pa'i chos ni gesung la bstod/ / /rigs lnga la mogs /phyog bcu'i sabs rgyas dang / /rigs bzhi la sogs dag pa'i byang sems dbashi /byangabasgoms la hogs 'khor ni sde bzhi ste/ /tshogs margogo dge 'dun shad 'byung thugs la bstod/ khyed 'bo'i sprul spu 'jig rte na 'khyon pa darkan/ 431

shāka thub bstan pa'i srog shinge rgyan gcige bu/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i skyes mchog mthu rtsal can/ /u rgyan pad+ma'i sku gsung thugs la phug 'tshal bestod/ 1ces mgrirna gcig tu bstod de gus phyag dgu sages su btsal lo/ /gro bye rgya/hra caṭabye/ rgakhathe/ rmethu thu/ :wasga ga tha/ u rgyan skad las pod skad de yo tsā bas bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o/ /sa mā ya/ rgya gye rgya/ garter gyi/sbas rgya/ gsang rgya/ rnab gye/ gtad rgya/ rgya rgya rgya/ e ma to/ be+e ro tsalanas so1skyo ta'i skad dang yi ge mkhyen/ ཿ ska ba dpal brtsegos kyis rgya nag gi skad dang ge ge mkhyen/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis u rgyan kyi skad dang yi gegamakhyen/ rma rin ban mchoge gis rgya gar gyi skad dnge yi ge mkhyen/ la gsum rgyal ba byang chub kyis ma ru rtse'i da dang yi ge mkhyen/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bru sha'i skad dang yi ge mkhyen/ dan yon tan mchog gis byu ka ra ṇa'i skad dang yi ge mkhyen/ be+e ro tsa nas skad rigs mi /nacig pa surma brgya dang yig riṭa mi gcig pa sum brgya mkhyen/ rgya nag gi yi ge gser gyi spad po'i ser ga 'dra/se skro ta'i yi ge ba rtag gzings pa 'dra/ rgya gar gye yi ge gzi blum bstor la brgyus pa 'dra1 u rgyan gye yi ge nya'i sgal pa 'dra/ byā ka ra ṇa'i ye ge ngang pa gzan la snyegs pa 'dra/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yi ge ni bla ma'o/ /lha lcam mnā ra bas za hor gyi skad dang yi ge mkhyen/ bal 'bangs ka la sirnyis mu stegs kyi skad dang yi ge mkhyen/ bal mo shākya de bas bal po'i skad dang yi ge mkhyen/ god mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis nā ga ra'i skad dang yi ge srin po'i skad dang yi ge /mi ma yin gyi skad dang yi ge rnams kyang mkhyen/ ga sa ma/thun mong mngono par shes pa lnga/ /gnas dang rdzas dang gang zag dang / /phan pa dang ni gnod pa dang / khyad par mngon par shes pa dzi/ /stung ba'i rgyu lnga sgo dgu shes/ /tha med mngon par shes pa lnga/ /spyan lnga mngon par shes pa 4ཿ3

drug /gud shing dgu dang khye'u brgyad/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes pa lnga/ /rgya lig sgog bu sdebs gcig 'dug ma las bris so rdzogs so/ /pad+ma bka' yi thang yig dang / /lha 'dre bka' yi thang yig dang / /rgyal po bka' yi thang yig dang / /btsun mo bka' yi thang yig dang 1 /bo paṇa bka' yi thang yig dang / /blon po bka' yi thang yig rnams/ /gu ru u rgyan gling pa la bka' babs byung nas tshogs dang gtor ma mang po phul te gter nas spyan drangs pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/1 //42tshi

sa 'go brjod/dkon cog gosus dang rtsa ba gsum rnams dang / /byang chub sems /zadapa' 'phags pa'i tshog rnams dang / /sems can yongs su smin par mdzad rnams daja / / rgyud spyangs shes rgya'i mthare thug mkhyen rnamasanadang / /rgya /bo da rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsha dang / /phyi nang sgo khro'i tshogag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar mdo sngags lam bzhugs mchod yabarjod nas/ /thugs dgojas mi snyegathun phyogasu rnamasha smrang ba dang / /thugs dgongs mthun ba'i phyogs rnams baspub ba'i gyir / blon go bka' yi thang yig bshad par bya/ /'jig rten chags panarlungapas nom/grangs dang /gi yi 'chad khungs rgyal po'i byon tshus chanang / /blon po'i byungarwangs stong/sde'i dmag rtasnadang / 1tshos khrim rgyal khrims 'badas rnams spyi chis dang / ༷/yul khams/rgya bskyed mtha' dmag dgradornamar btul/ /mnga' 'og lha chos mi chos gnyis su spel/ /chos dang chos min ji ltar phye ba dang / /bstan pazhi gzhi bshag blon pozhi/lag ris dang / /mchod pa'i phan yon ma mchod nyes dmigs dang / /bon rtsis sman chos gtan la phab tshul dang / /dus/gsum mkhyen mes dus gsum gsungs tshul dang / /bstan zhabs gter skyong gter min gaster 'dra dbye/ /mos pa spyod pa'i sa la chos kyi rgyal / /btsan po dad pa/skyezasapa'i sku ring la/ /mkhan chen sde snga paṇa chen chagathum du grags/ za stor matagan/po boshedhi sa rdotā dang / /ā tsar bo bhirtermartor dang / kha/che'i mkhan po rab snangardochen po dang ga /rgya gar mkhan po ga me li ga rtang// /li yi mkhan po li ni gagon nu lnga/ /god kyi rgyal po snga dar dus tsa san/ /rgyal srid zas kyis skyong bas mngab thang che/ /u rgyan cha ban po pad+ma sam+bha —437

dang / /ba na 'i mi du gdan drang na /dbyu su bsam yas ru—bzhir mtha' 'dul sogs/ /gtsug/lagag nga ni brgya daje rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ 1 mkhas pa mang po'i chos grwa btsugs pa'i dus/ /'jig rten ga pa rlung gi rnam pospre+os bstan/ /phyi sgod 'jig rten mas kyis chags pa min/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdo rje gram gzhi/ /gyen mi chad par ldang stan 'arirga rten grub/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par dgod pa zhes/ /stong gsum stong chen 'jig rten kham rnams dbye/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gongs su 'dzin pa zhes/ /yongs su bzu nga ba'i phyir na rlunganaldang ngo / /rlung thabadakyil 'khor yongs su skom pa zhe / /chu yi dkyil 'khor yong sa su skam phyir ldang / /yongs su gnas par byed pa'i rlung4brgyad yod/ 1nang bcud sems can ji ltar chag pa ni/ /sems na rigs byed mi 'dra mang na yang / /rigs ni lnga ru ma 'dus med do gagung / /de ni 'dab gas dang ni sder chagam dang / / ga thum dang ni rmig pa kha dbrag dang 1'greng bu dang ni rig gu gas pa yin/ 1sam ma/ /rgya/rgya rgya/ ta / mi yi 'chad khyangs bstan pa/mi yi 'chad khungs rgyal po'i byon tshul ni/ /'dzam ming snying po rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /rdo rje gdan nas rgyang phyogs bcal ba na/ /ri nag dgu 'ad pha rol gangam ti si/ gangs ri'i byang ngos ri bo spos ngad ldan/ /de gnyis bar na/sta dros mtsho zhes yod/ /gru bzhi chu zheng dpag tshad lnga brgya sdo/ /yanagalag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ /rtag tu bsi gnas dbyibs legs lta na sdug /nang na glu yi rgyal po ma dros gan / tsho de'i nub na dza kyi sha'i shing / /'bras bu dmar po ma drom pa la lhung / /jospu'i chu po gser /28

bzhu bzhunabatul badra / /mtsho de'i skyang na shal/ma/'i/ shi'i shongashā/ /rtse/rma mapo rtab 'bras bu ser po yod/ /de/la/nam mkha'1sdeng gi rnam ngazhi gan / /shar sha tsardon sbrul gyi snyi nga po'i shing / /'bras bu dkarwa/po lo ma shu skonganalhung4/ /lto na shing chen yong sa 'du/ga brtol//yod/ /'bras bu ser dmar sheng tog mtsho nang hūṃng / /kogs pa gzhung pa shing/dang shun pa bzhi/ /che ba lo ma me tog 'bras bu bzhi/ /bgrod par deka'3ba rdzu 'phrul/skosan pas lon/ sto1ru song tshad ngan song mi bsgo yod/ / /mtsho de'i dkyil na ri nardorten do tshad bzhi/ ṣe phyogs bzhi dag na sgems thagan/khagi'adrarwabazhi / /chu bo chen po bzhi ni phyogs mazhid 'bab10 /shar phyogs thang chen kha nas gaṅgā 'bab1 /dngul gyi7bye ma 'dren cing/ma drog bskor — /chu bran lnga ba rgyar bcas nas shar mtshor 'bapas / sto khyung 'dra ba'i kha nas sitsū lapobaX/ /boḍū yiyi bye mnagedren cing bskor / /nub 4ོgas rta yi kha 5sa pas 'bab sher babagyi gye sa 'dren/cing sngar ngas na/ bskor/ /byang phyo gas seng ge'i kha nas mi ta 'bag/ ( /gser gyi bye ma 'dren ceng gong bzhin/gaskor1 / /dzasbu trir+shasha'i /gangaX la rlung 'amab snyas /dzasbu zhes rwabya'i sgra 'byin sha zhagul byung / she /gserwa brag byadas bas can ces thu ba ni/ / der —nidobs du snya ra'i sa/gronarabad/ /sa pon nub phyogs mu rgyan yul/sa/rgyas// / / /gleng der ma las skye ba med par gsu sa/ ) /skye tshud/phaX/cher/ brdzus/nas skye bzho/ /dha na rka sha dri ped mdangashe/༷ldan 'gram/do rdo/ste torke u /du smra ba'i na gas 1tshal ni1 gsang po re re pad gis mi 'khyud ma / /lo skor re mdime tog/brje ba ོ ོsa/ /dgaki/ldan lha yi /dza bsanabasalha bu/gnyis do /me tog/u duslu nar/gardzus zhes skyes )/tsan+d+ra dri ma me da pa zhes bya dang rdoyosruyi dri ma sted pa zhes bya la/ pa /gobom thu gling pa'i mi rnams lam nartangs shā /bskal pe dang po'i mi rnams da zugs bzang legs/ /'gro na nam mkhar 'a(1/zhing nam/mkhar 'dug / 436

zas gos dga' ba dang ni bde bar spyod/ /nyon mongs med pas tshe lo dpag —med thub/ /de lta bu ni yun ring byung ba'i mthar/ /nyon mongs las rlung drag po langs nas su/) /mngal skyes pa dang rdzus skyes rigs 'chol nas/ /de las 'gro ba mnge du 'phel ba yi/ /bsod nams chung dang skye 'chi gnyis byung ngo / / shar kyi phus 'phags gling du rigs gnyis 'chad1 /gling de'i 'gro ba thams cad brdzus nas skyes /lus tshad khru brgyad nyis brgya lnga bcu'i tshe/ /gzugs byad lta na legs sdug chos med do/ /de nas byang gi sku mi snyan du 'chad/ / lus tshad khru ni surma cu rtsa gnyis pa/ /che tshad lo stong thub ste chos med do/ //longs spyod ma banyab 'bras ni sā lu za/ /gos ni dpag bsam shing las byung / ba'i gos/ /longs spyod che bas sbyin pa gtong len smon/ /sgra mi snyan pa lo stong ngese pa can/ /lha mi rnams la bar dor 'chi ba yod/ /thog mar 'dzam bu gling chags 'di nas 'chad/ /gling 'di las kyi sa pa zhes bya'o/ /bod kyi mi rnams 'chad khungs bstan pa ni/ /bon lugs glu la sa 'chado par 'dod pa yod1 /chos lugs spyan ras gzigs las 'chad par 'dod1 /nub phyogs bde ba chen po'i zhing khams na/ /sangam rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa las/ /)rgyal po 'astenar los sgyur ba babong po mchog /bla mchod snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa lnga/ /sku yi sprul pa pad+ma 'byung gan sa sprul/ /thugs kyi sprul pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /lho nub 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho la/ /me tog u du snya rar brdzus nas skyes/ /khri snyan sa le'i pags pa phrag la bkal/ /rngag nas ma nu sarba tsit+ta sgorga /'khor ba dong nas nyin ma can gsum du sprugs/ /'khor ba'i gnas na sems can gcig med snyam/ /shar phyogs/ri po ta la'i rtse nas rgazigs/ /snga ma ji lta ba bzhin 'dug nas su/ /dbu ni tshal pa stong du gas 3 par gyur/ /snang ba mtha' yas phyag gis dbu rnams bsgrigs/ /thugs rje 430

/chen po bcu gcig zhal byin brlabs/ /spri go'i gtsug tu a mi de ba bzhuṭa/ /cha'akhor ba 'dirwal thog mtha' gang yang med/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du don ༷khrus shig /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas lung bstan nas/ /spre'u rgyal wa ha/༷lu maskor sprul/ /sgrol mas brag srin khro gnyer can du sprul/ /'gro ba mang po sangs rgyas zhing khrid phyir/ /'phags pa chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ //spre sgom kha ba can du sgom nus sam/ /rdzu 'phrul spre'us sgom nus/khas blangs te/ /'phags pas gtan khrims yan lag lnga pa phog /spre sgom dge 'dun rab byung khas lan bcug /de nas byung phyogs kha ba can du 'ongs/ /brag rum zhig la sgom zhing bsdan tsa na/ /de yi drung du brag srin mo/cig byung / /'dod pa 'khrig pa'i brda byas nas/ /sa gtor nyi ma/bdun byas kyang / /sprel sgom 2dod pa g.yos ma gyur/ /nyi ma brgyad pa'i nyin par ni/ /brag srin mo de dbud med ni/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i cha byad can/ khyod dang nga gnyis khyim thab /bya'o zer/ 1nu ma dang ni mtshan ma bstan pa yis/ /spre'us sa btab rgyab ni bstan nas bzhugs1 1nga ni a du pā lo'i dge bsnyen yin/ /mi tshangs pa ni spyod pa mi rung gsungs/ /brag srin skyengs nas 'di ru 'chi'o zer/ /spre sgom de yis zhag bdun snying rjes bsams/ /'di ni ji ltar 'phags par zhu dgos snyam/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni ri po ta lar byon/ /'phags par brag srin chig tha 3snyad/ /'phags sa khyim thab gyis shig gsungs/ /sgol mas shin tu le'adis/so gsungs/ /spe'us kha ba can du 'ongs/ /brag srin mo yis 'di skad brngod/ //kye ma spre'u'i rgyal po dgongs shing gson/ /bdag ni las ngan brag grin mo ru skyes/ /'dod chags khyed la zhen cing nags/ /bdag khyod khyim thab mi byed /na/ /mtha' ma srin po nyid dang 'grogs/ 1nyin re bzhin du spog chags khri khri 3gsod/ /nub de bzhin du sog chags stong stong gagod/ /srin po'i phru ku 431

dpag med skyes gyur nas/ /bod yul kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di/ /mi med srin po'i rgyal khams nyid du 'gyur/ /'dzam gling sems rtsen srin pos za/ /de bas bdag la thugs rjes zungs/ /gdungs pa'i nga ros shin tu bshum/ / bdag la mi dgongs thugs rjes mi 'dzin na/ /da lta 'di ru srog gcod 'chi bar 'gyur/ /shi nas dmyalu ba'i gnas su skye/ /de la sogs pa mang du gsolabab yis/ /sprel sgom byang chub sems dpa' snying rje skyes / khyame thab byas nas 'dod pa spyad pa yis/ /zla dgu ngo bcu song ba'i dus tsa na/ /pha ma gnyis ka mi 'dra bu zhig skyes/ /'greng bu ngo dmar leb pa mjug ma med/ /sha dmar za zhing khrag ni dren mo 'thung / /spyod lam ma dag 'dug mi tshugs/ /'dod chags la sogs dug lnga shas che bas/ /dmu rgod sus kyang 'thul bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de nas cher skyes ma ni za bar 'dug /pha yis lho phyogs nags ma bya tshogs bskyal/ /lo gcig song nas lta ru phyin pa na/ /spre mo rnams dang rtses pas lnga brgya tsam du 'phel/ /de rnams gcig la gcig rtses mang du 'phel/ /du mar 'phel bas sa steng thams cad gange / /dbyur tshodus nyi mag tshig cing char pas gdungs/ /dgun dus kha ba dang ni lhags pas gdungs/ /zas dang gos med sdug bsngal yid mi bde/ /pha yis 'gul tshe phru gu lnga brgya bungs/ /nga cag ci za ci gron lag pa gdengs/ /nyam thag de la shin tu snying rje skyes/ /spre sgom 'di 'dra sus lan snyam du bsams/ /'phags pa'i gsung bsgrubs pas ni lan no bsams/ ādu pā lo'i drung phyin zhus pa ni/ /kye ma 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag ni dge bsnyen sdom pa speg bzhin bsrungs/ /'dod chags rgyas pa'i srin mo 'dod sred can/ /bad ga la tho 'chemasi sdom pa 'phrog tu byung / /byams mgon khyed kyis bdag la bka 'i gnang bas/ /'phegs pa'i rgesung bsgrubs bdag snyed 'di ltar gyure/ /lus kyi spu byi mjug 433

ma skya ba 'dra/ /da ni ji ltar byas nas phu/tsha gso/ /'phags pa spun ras gzegag dbang gis/ /gser zu khyor gang bod yul phyogs su gtor/ khyim thab zas su 'bru sna/lnga bskur ro/ /nas/dang gro dang 'bras dang ti / /sran /ma dang ni lnga byin nas / /sa yul lung ma bstan pa bcu bzhi yin/ sa drod mnyam pa'i gnas su thob cig gsungs/ 1'di las yon tan ji ltar 'byung 'gyur ni/ /bod yul skabs re bzhin du dus dus su/ /din yo che yi gter khung kha rnams 'byed/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams dma' dus tsa na/ /grub pa thob pa'i byang chub gimag r+shapazha zhibyung/1 /sprul sku thod gargal ba re byung nas su/ /de yis bstano pa dare zhing rgyaso par byed/ /'gro ba pho mo mang po chos la bkod/ /mi zhes bya ba shes pa mi mthun pa/ khyed kyi rigs ni gnyis su 'gyur/ /pha rigs 'chad pas dad pa snying rje che/ /chos zab stong pa nyid la shin tu mos/ /bsod nam chung bas mi rngams shing / /blo rgya chen po la dga'/'chag 'dug mi tshugs pa/ de'u dang shing bu yang gtub pa/ mig gcig tu mi tshugs pa phar hrig tshur hrig byed/ byang chub sems dpa' blo chen ldan zhes rigs/de'i brgyud bas ston pa'i bstan pa spel/ de'ang gsos shig sa steng mi'i 'jig rten 'ong shā /ma'i rigs nas 'chad pas dad pa dang snying rje chung ba sha dmar za zhing khrug dron 'thung ba ngo leb kha nas gad rgyangs sgog gzhan gyi skyon rtog mdza' bo bdag yid byed/ /zhe sdang gdug sems lus la dpa' rtsal che/ /dge chos mi sems tshong dang khe sgogs sbyor/ /gdol pa sha zan gnas ngan rigs su nagro /de yang gsos shig mtha' yi dgra rnams 'dul/ khyod kyi brgyud pas sangs rgyas bstan pa baspung / /bston pa 'dzin skyong baspung gsum —bod du 'byung / /sku gsung thugs rten gachod las rgyas par 'gyur/ /de nas sprel sgom kha ba can du 'ongs/ /bzhed pa rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa'i yul/ /433

sa phyogs nyams dga' bkra shis zhal dre ba/ /rang bzhi na yon tan 'byung ba'i4sa la btab1 /bra bo so ba yungs kar zhar la skyes/ /'byu sna rnam pa drug tu 1gyur/ /zang zing 'di la zo dang byas pas zo dang zhes su grags/ /zhing la snga ba zo dang yin no gsungs/ /mu ge gnam la yar bas yar klungs zhes gu grags/ /yul la snga ba yar glungs yin no gsungs/ /mi'i 'chad khungs bstan pa'i skabs te dang po'o// // mi'i rgyal po ji ltar spyon bstan ba/ mi yi rgyal po ji ltar byon pa ni/ 1gong ma rje yi gdung rabs yin/ / bskos dang glo bur gdung brgyud gsum/ /gdung brgyud rgyal po rje yi dbang gis na/ /mang pos bkur ba yar ded lha dgu nas/ /mar ded sgra gcan 'dzin pa yan chad du/ /shākya'i rigs kyi gdung brgyud ya mtshan gleng ba las/ /bskos pa'i rgyal po sde bzhi yang / /shar nas skar ma smin drug 'char ba'i 'og /rgya nag gtsug lag rgyal po yod/ /'jam dpal rnam pa lnga byon nas/ /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i shar/ /rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /lho nas skar ma lag sor 'char ba'i 'og /rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po yod/ /sangs rgyas stong dang rabs bdun 'byon/ /rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa yis/ /chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ — /nub phyogs/zla ba tshes pa'i 'og na ni/ /ta zig nor gyi rgyal po yod do skad/ /ston pa ār+ya dzam+bhal yis byed/ /las su dbul phongs sdug bsngal sil ba yin/ /byang na skar ma spe bdun 'char ba'i 'og khrom ni ge sar dmag gi rgyal po yod/ /mdo don sum cu tsam nas gleng ba yin/ /bskos pa'i rgyal po sde bzhi la/ 1434

mangs spyod spyod pa gnas dang gang gis bsko/ /'dod pa lha dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus mang / /glo bur rgyal po can lngapa nga dang khug gnam la khri bdun sa la legs drug dang / /logs la lde brgyad tshigs la btsan lnga dang / khrims med rgyal po nyi shu rtsa lnga byon/ /skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum nas/ /de nas dbu brnyes pa da nga srom btod dang / /dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i rgyal po gsum/ /gnam lha babs kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan/ /gleng lurgas ma mthun gsang bsgrags las gsang zer/ /gsang ba rgyal po 'chad pas chosarta lugs gleng / /bsgrags pa lha las 'chad pas bon lugs gleng / /yang gsang the'u brang 'chad pas dmangs blon gleng / /spu yul mo btsun gung rgyal la/ /the'u brang spun dgu skyes pa las/ 1chud dag u pe ra nas 'chad pa'o/ khur du gnyer lji las su smra dka'o/ khri rgyal ba dang dri dmu gyi btsan sras/ to gnya' khri btsan po zla ba nya la skyes/ /nya khri btsan po zhes kyang bya/ /dus de tsa na bod la rgyal phran byed/ /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi ma thub/ /zhang gsum blon bzhi yab 'bangs rus drug gi /shes pa mkhan mi gnyis rkyes rje btsal bas/ /rje skar ma yol sde'i zhal nas su/ /gnam sa rim pa lnga yi steng bzhugs pa/ /gnya' khri btsan po bya ba lha yi sras/ /dmu yi dbon po yod pas spyan drongs gsungs/ /gnya' khri btsan po dogs drug yod gsung pa/ 1rku yod/ sdang yod/ོdgra yod/ g.yag yod/ durge yod/ byad stems wad/gsungs so/ /rtsibs lha skar ma yol sdes bod 'dir/ rku la lan yod/ sdang la byams yode/ dgra la gnyen yod/ g.yag la mace na yod/ dug la sman yod byad stems 'gros thabs yod smras so/ /dmu chas bcu dang bcas nas byon/ mi'i rgyel po ji ltar ston pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //435

/ blon po'i byung/ khrungs sde shad po/de nas blon po'i byung khungs dpyad/ 1gnya' khri btsan po man chad nas/khre srong sde'u btsan yan chod la/ /che brgyud drug cu rtsa gcig byung / /blon la rigs brgyud rnam lnga ste/ /gung blon spyi blon dbang blon gsum/ nang blon bka' blon gnyis te lnga1 /dang po blo na la snga ba ni/ 1lha yi smon gzugs sham po'i sras/ /de sras lha yi 'od dkar byung / khu mang po rje lha gzugs dab / khu khri thog sha spre dang / khu legs rje btsan pa rnams/ /gros ni blo nyes po la 'dri/ /tshod ni sdug po byung bas 'dzin/ /gnubs la blon po bzhi byung ste/ /bla gokhyen mung btsan pa dang ni/ /btsan po de re mang btsan dang / khri do re mthorge po dang / /skyes to re mang snang ngo / /sbas la blon po lnga byung ste/ khri gzigs zhang gnyan dang / khri gsum rje stag sna dang / zhang bzher bla btsan dang / zhaphags te de bzhi tshab dang / rgyal rta ra stag snang ngo / /'bro la blon po lnga byung ste/ 'bro chung bzang ngo ram dang / khrom gsum rje stig snang dang / gtsug spa lha snang dang / /btsan pa stag tshab dang / khri rje de sham dang ni lnga/ gnyags la blon po bzhi byud ste/ gnyags sakhyem bu bdud kyi rje/ bal gsum sgra ya mdzad/ thang pa ya thang rje/ gnyags rgyal sto re gel/ khyung po la blon po gsum byung ste/ yu yar zur cho dang /yungs rta ring po dang / /mi ring sos dkar dang gsum/ sha gor la blon po lnga byung ste/ mgar srong btsan yul gzung dang / khri 'bring btsan srol dang /btsan snya sdom bu dang / khri thog rje a nu dang / khri sgra zin/lung/dang lnga /lamachims la blon po bzhi byung ste/ mar bzher ngan pa po dang / btsan bzher 436

masags gzigs dang / rgyal gzigs shud thong dang / rdo rje spre chung dang bzhi sna nam 'angablon po bzhi byung ste/ rgya tsha lha snang dang / mang snya bse btsan dang / / zhang khrom pa skyabs dang / btsan pa 'u ring dang bzhi/ 'gos la blon po gsum byung ste/ khri bzang yangaltag dang / yang gong bla ma dang /lha gro gro dang ni gsum1 cog ro la blon po gsum byung ste/ skye bzang rgyal ma 'og legs sgra lha sdong dang / cog ro bo gong gsum/ myang la blon po snyegasum byung ste/ myang smon to re'i bu gu dang 1 myang mchog rab gzhu'o dang /myang mang po nang snang dang gsum/ thu la blon po gsum byung ste/ 'bring to re ma nu da / thu mi rgyal mtshan snang la 'phan/ /thu mi klu mang dred dang gsum/tshe spong la blon po gnyis byung ste/ na gad dang se gnyis/ blon po'i 'phrul che ba/ rje mchog ye shes 'phru' gyi rgyal ma blon/ ngan lam rta ra glu gong dang /sba mang po lha lod dang / 'bro skye bzang sdong btsan dang / sbrang khri glu re len pa dang / lang bu thonal btsan pa dang / co shām thu chung dang / dar rgyal mang po rje srong nam mo/ /sgron po'i byung khungs bshad pa'i skabs te gsum tsho shes/1 /1stor sde'i danag rta dpyad pa'i skabs/de nas stong sde'i dmag3 bshad pa ni/ /gtsang ru lag la stong sde brgyad/ /stong bu chung dang dgu la ni/ /mang gar khri dgongs 'bro yi stong sde yin/ /grogi pa lha rtse 'bro gi stong sde yin/ /rgya bod 'thab dus ru bzhi'i dmag dpon 'a/ 4ru lag dmag dpon 'bro rgyal seng ge yin/ /ru rta ngang pa 'aspul da par yin/ /ru dar seng ge dkar po gnam ba spreng thogs/ /ru/437

sgab pa ni snang stag byu ru mtshal/ /yig tshangs pa ni zangs kyi yi ge gtong / /dmag bzhed shel gyi mo del bkram pa 'dra/ /marga grangs sum 'bum dang ni drug khri yod/ /ru lag smad kyi stong sde bzhi/ /nyang ro 'dre yi stong sde yin/ /khri tha khyung po'i stong sde yin/ /gad bkram 'gos kyi stong sde yin/ /mkhar pa shu gu'i stong sde yin/ /'tshong ma stong bu chung sgo'i stong sde/yin/ /ru lag smad kyi dmag dpon ni/ — /'dre rgyal to ri khri lod yin/ /ru rta ngang pa rdog nag yin/ /ru dar dar dkar thang 'gebs yin/ /ru sgab khyung po spu sna zung / yig tshangs g.yu yi yi ge yin/ /dmabashabazhed thang la ser ba bab pa 'dra/ /de yang sum 'bum drug khri ste/ /stod smad gnyis ka'i ma go grangs ni/ /bdun 'bum nyi khri yod do skad/ /g.yas ru'i stong sde brgyad la ni/ /stod yongs shangs steng khyung po'i stong sde yin/ /lang mi phod dkar pa tshab stong sde yin/ /drang mtshams gnyan dkar langs pa'i stong sde yin/ /yel rab zom steng 'gos kyi stong sde yin/ /shangs kyi stong bu chung ring sle bya'i stong sde yin/ /g.yas ru stod kyi dmag dpon ni/ /rgyal ba ye shes de drug mes po/ /khyung po stag zangs nyang stod byas/ /ru rta ni mche' lu ma stag /ru dar ni nag po mtsho 'dra1 /ru sgab ni pa tshab mtsho bzher/ /yig tshangs ni zangs kyi yi ge /dmag bzhed ni byu ru'i sdong po bkram pa 'dra/ /mgo grangs ni sum 'bum lnga khri/ /g.yas ru smad kyi dmag dpon ni/ /'gos khri bston dpal mo/ /ru rta ni spyon po g.yu gshog /ru dar ni seng ge gong bkra/ /ru sgab ni langs pa mgon bu/ /yig tshangs ni zangs kyi yi ge /dmag bzhed ni spang la me mched pa 'dra/ /mgo grangs sum 'bum lnga khrir bzhed/ /bsdebs pas bdun 'bum kha da cad/ /dbu ru stode spad stong sde la/ /'bring mtshamagaphyug mtshams stong sde yin/ /bcom pa zom steng cog ro'i stong sde yin/ /dor de ste 'jom gnyis 438

po de/ /rma dang ka ba'i stong sde yin/ /skyid stod skyid smad srus kyi stong sde yin//yel zhabs stong bu chung bran ka'i stong sde lin/ /dbu ru stod kyi dmag dpon ni/ 1sna nam rgan mo chung / /ru rta ni ze dkar rlung bskyod/ /ru dar yang dar dmar po la/ /me lce dkar po gsal ba'o/ /ru sgab sgon 'dong dpum 'gron skyes/ /yig tshangs ni zangs kyi yi ge /dmag bzhed ni bzong dar khyu 'bebs 'dra/ /mgo grangs sum 'bum bdun khri'o/ /dbu ru smad kyi dmag dpon ni/ /sbas skyes bzang stag snang yin/ /ru rta ni mtsha'i lu gzig ris/ /ru dar ni seng ge gong nag /ru sgab shud pu khong 'breng tsong btsan/ /dmag bzhed mtsho la mun pa 'thibs pa 'dra/ /mgo grangs sum 'bum bdun khri'o/ /gnyis ka bsdebs pas bdun 'bum bzhi khri yod/ /g.yo ru na stong sde brgyad stong bu chung dang dgu /yar klungs dang phyi lung gnyis/ /gnyags dang tshe spong stong sde yin/ /ljang kyang lung pa gnyis po ni/ /myang dang sna nam stong sde yin/ /gnyal dang sto brag gnyis po ni/ /mchims dang snyi ba'i stong sde yin/ /nyang po dwags po gnyis po de/ /sdong dang mchims kyi bhe+ong sde yin/ /ri bo stod bu chung sprang ston stong sde yin/ /g.yo ru stod kyi dmag dpon ni/ /myang stag bzang g.yu brtan bya ba yin/ /ru rta ni snag gi byu ma zho cig ru dar ni seng ge kha sprod/ /ru sgab ni zhang ma bzhengs stos chung / /yig tshangs ni gangs kyi yi ge /dmag bzhed ni zha nye'i them bu brdol ba 'dra/ /mgo grangs ni sum 'bum lnga khri yod/ /g.yo ru smad kyi dmag dpon ni/ 1mchims rin cen rgyal gzigs yin/ /ru rta ni sa'i sbrang ma g.yu 'phyong yin/ /ru dar ni sna lnga mdzes pa 'dra/ /ru sgab ni lho stag chu khri gzigs/ /yig tshangs ni zangs kyi yi ge dmag bzhed ni phug ron gzan la bab pa 'dra/ /mgo grangs ni sum 'bum lnga khri/ /stod smad bsdebs pas bdun 'bum kha da 439

chad/ /mi rta dmag grangs de ltar bstan/ /stong sde bzhi bcu tse gnyis las/ /stong sde bzhi bcu tham pa la/ /stong bu chung bzhi po gnyis su brtsis pas rtsa gnyis them/ /stong sde'i dmag rta dpyad pa'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// // tshos khrims bcas pa/shā skabs/chos khrims rgyal khrims 'bangs rnams bye tshis ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dad+ku+os su bod du byon/ /srol btod rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /thu mi sam stos gnyan po gsang ba bsgyur/ /mi dge bcu spyad phyi ma ngan song skye/ /gnas ngan len gyi sprib pas baspribs pa rnams/ /mtshams med lnga yi las byas dmyal bar skye/ /ser sna 'jur gegs kyis ni yi dwags skye/ /tshul khrims 'chal na dud 'gro'i lus su skye/ /thabs shes ya bral tshe ring lha ru skye/ /smon lam ma dag yul ngan mtha' 'khob skye/ /tshogs ma bsags na dbang po ma tshang skye/ /shes rab 'phel rgyu lnga spangs kla klor skye/ /dkon cog gsum spangs log lta can du skye/ /'jam dpal sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyes/ /yig ris mthong bas thugs dad gshing nas skyes/ /mos pa'i tshig gis smre sngags cho nges btab/ /blo sna rang dbang med par 'gyur ba yis/ /de spyo dge sdig spang blang ngo ma shes/ /gzhan gyi ched min rang gi don lags par/ /mi dge'i las rnams rab tu shes pa yis/ /nag po'i chos bzhi kun nas spang ba'o/ /dge ba'i las kyang rab tu shes pa yis/ /dkar po'i chos bzhi la ni bslab par bya/ /bla ma dang ni mchod 'os mi bslu ba/ /rgyu lam 'bras bus bsdus pa'i mdo sngags gnyis/ /tshig bzhi'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig nyan nas/ /ku re dang ni kyal ka'i ched du yang / /cung zad cig kyang bla ma'i mgo 440

mi bsgor/ /gsang sngags rtsa ba dam tshig dpang por bzhag /rtsa ltung bcu bzhi bla ma lnga bcu pa/ /gser skas g.yu gdung dam tshig rab tu dbye/ /dam tshig gsal sgra dam chag gsal sgron bzhag rje 'bangs blo snying lo paḍo lhan gyis gtad/ /'aspyod pa'i gnas ma yin la 'aspyod mi skye/ /bod kyi rgyal khams skye bo pho mo rnams/ /gtsug lag khang du dkon cog gsum la mchod/ /bla ma bsten bkur dge 'dun tshos ston tshim/ /sdug phongs skyabs mgon med la phan gdags bskyed/ /pha ma la sogs drin cher drin lan slon/ /gang zhig dge byed 'phya dang mi mos pa/ bkur snyi mi byed dkon cog rigs gcod spyod/ phrag dog dbang gis khyod 'di ma legs dang / /nang rgyags rgas thes shi zon dgos zer nas/ /'gyod pa bskyed rnams nag po'i chos su che/ /nus rmad rjes su yi rang ngag tu brjod/ /de bzhin gzhan la bsod nams bsag la bskul/ /dka' spyad chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed/ /sāts+tsha 'debs pa chu gtor yan chad la/ /'aspyod pa mi skye rjes su yi rang dbul/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i yon bdag bcad/ /rgya bod lo paṇa byang chub sems dpa' la/ /zhe sdang tshigs su bcad pa'ang mi brjod bslab/ /nyon mongs rang yan su mthong dgra ru mthong / /byang chub sems dpa' gang yod cha ma mchis/ /rang skyon ma mthong gzhan spyon smra la dga'/ /sngon las bsod nams bsags pa chung ba mis/ /zhe sdang tshigs bcad skyon med skyon sgog smod/ /bstan pa rim sdud nag po'i chos su che/ 1sa brgyad non pa'i rgyang chub sems dpa' la/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed grags dang ma grags dang / /bstod smad bde sdug thams cad 'ching mi 'gyur/ /nyes skyon mi brjod grags pa snyan pa brjod/ /de la dge pa'i bshes gnyen rigs su brjod/ /sems la g.yo sgyu spyu yi srid pa la / /g.yo dang sgyus ni 'jig rten gsum yang 'phung / /drang po'i chos ni nye bar mi 4rta1

spyod cing / /phrad na lha dang 'grogs na 'dre dang 'dra/ /ngo tsha pha rol bre srang chung la 'jal/ /sdud pa tshur la bre srang che la len/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi sgo nas ci rgyal byed/ /mdza' bshes sun pas zhe khrel nag po'i chos/ /'di la mi che spyi srung sna dkar mi/ /drang po'i chos kyis 'jig rten khams kun bde/ /chos khrims bcas pa'i skabs te lnga pa'o// //rgyal khrims bcas pa'i skabs/di nas rgyal khrims ji ltar bcas pa ni/ /mgo nag mi yi 'khor g.yog bstan pa la/ /gcugs dang phra ma gong du shor dogs byed/ /chig legs zhu 'bul rna bar snyan mi 'khyol/ /'phral spyod legs pa spyan sngar mdzes pa rmad/ /lam sna bla mas 'dren pa go bar dka'/ /chos med blon po rnams kyi mthong lugs bstan/ /rgyal khrims nyes pa phog pa med phyin chad/ /mos na 'bangs bde nges shes 'phral la skye/ /bka' mchid rnam pa lnga la bskor ba'i gros/ /spyir dpe rgyal blon rnams kyi bka' mchid dang / /rang gi rgyud la sbyar ba'i bka' mchid dang / /bzang ngan 'breng gsum skyong shes bka' yi mchid/ /gsang gtam gab cing gru ba bka' yi mchid/ /bud med gos khyur mi gzhug brtsams mthar phyin/ /rgyal khrems rje yis bka' bstsal dbad mdzad khrims/ 1stod gsum smad gsum mdzad gsum mi mdzad gsum/ /mkharno btsun bzang po gral gye stod dang gcig /dgra 'dul dpa' bo stag gi stod dang gnyis/ /byas gzo mdzangs dang yig tshangs stod dang gsum/ /smad gsum rkun ma gsod dang gtam po sprug /byi chal sna mig 'chol ma bcing dang gsum/ /mdzad gsum sku gsung thugs rten dam chos mdzad/ khrims 'og mi bsad stong dang 442

gapos thang mdzad/ /rje la ma byin blangs na brgya 'jal dang / /dkon cog ma byen blangs na brgyad cu 'jal/ /skye bor ma byin blangs na dgu 'jal mdzad/ 1mi mdzad gsum la yo log ya mi srong / /snga phyi dpe srol gdod pa'i dran mi gsal/ khengs rgod mi btang bran mo bka' bzhin bgyi/ /snyeng nye sha tshas gang la gang phan gyes/ /gros gdab byas pas phal cher nges shes skye/ /tshod ni ma zin mthong goms myong la dris/ /legs nyes dpe don spyod yul bstun par byed/ /rgyal khrims bcas pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// //'bangs kyi spyi dris bcas pa'i skabs/'bangs rnams spyi tshis ji ltar byas pa ni/ /rgyun chad med pa'i rjes brjod brgyad ldan te/ /spyod lam gzhan la yongs su brtag dang gcig /ya tsar bgri ba lus kyi bsnyen bkur bzhi/ kha zas dang ni bza' btung gnyid log drug /'khrig spyod de dang ldan pa rtsa ba brgyad/ /'jig rten pa yi spyod pa rnam pa bcu/ /smra ba'i gtam byed so sor mgu bar byed/ /bag ma gtong ba bag ma len pa lnga/ /'bod pa g.yar 'dren lhag par za ba brgyad/ /'dus za rtsed byung gcig grogs gcig gis byed/ /rgyug tshogs gtam ni rnam pa gsum nas gleng / /ya rabs chos dang ldan pa'i gtam nas gleng / /ma rabs nyes tshogs nyi she rtsa gnyis gleng / /lung ma bstan pa btang stoms ku/ nas gleng / /dang po sems kyi sgrib pa sel byed yin/ /gnyis pa nye tshogs 'jal lugs sgyu byed pa/ /bre srang sgyu byed g.yo ham mgo bskor bsnyon/ /log pa'i lam sbyor 'thab pa mtshang 'dru dang / /rtsod dang 'gyod dang gshe ba spyo ba dang / /dam bca' bsdigs dang bdeg dang gsod pa dang / /'ching dang go rar 'jug pa 443

chagartsod pa dang / /lugs ma g.yo byed 'drid pa drag shul dang / /rdzun du smra ba nyes tshogs nyi shu gnyis/ /de deg yul khrims sun dbyung gtan la dbab/ /rgyags pa rnam bdun mthu gtad ser gsum dul/ /'dun 'gros ston ka'i sngar sbur 'dra ba'i gtso/ /za 'dod rgyal po'i btsun mo 'dra ba'i gtso/ /zhal lce dbyed ka'i 'khyags rum 'dra ba'i gtso/ /'di gsum che yang mi la dgos pa med/ /mi phugs blangs nas 'dod mos ched dang sbyar/ /spri dpon phan pems 'dul spyong mkhas kyis byed/ /sha tsha phan sems skyo dub sked gsum 'dzom/ /bod 'bangs mig no rnams kyes mthong legs te/ /'bangs rnams phyug pa gsum las med pa yin/ /rab ni chos kyis phyug pas chen bo yin/ /'bring ni /mi yis phyug pas 'bring po yin/ /tha ma sgor gyis phyug pas tha ma yin/ /de gsum smon lam 'brel pa yod med gda'/ /'bangs rnams spri chis bcas pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o/ / //yu' khams rgya bskyed mtha' dmag rnams btu' ba'i skabs/yul khams rgya bskyed mtha' dmag dgra rnams 'dul/ /zhes pas/yul khams rgya ni ji ltar bskyed pa ni/ /dgos 'dod skong byed gsang ba'i rgyas btab pa/ /mngon sum gsal byed sems kyi gsang brtol mdzod/ khyad par sto phyogs 'dzam bu gling 'di ni/ /shar du li kha ra yi shing 'phel nas/ /lho ru 'dam bu 'dam rgyud kyi tshal nas/ /rdub na dri za ka ba nyadoba'i tshal/ /byang du u shī'i ri /ོ/tshun chad na/ /'dzam bu gleng gi sum gnyis yul rgya bskyed/ /bka' khrims bzangamadzas mtha' yi dgra rnams btul/ /phyogs bzhi'i dgra rnams bod kyi dgra skal yin/ /rgya nag rgyal po bod la spyang ltar 'jab/ 444

dmag dpon lha babrang glu dpal rgya nag brtsam/ /bod du legs stes rtsis gzhi gaṭ+wā+oṃn ma phab/ /mi chos zab mo bka' drin kun cher mdzad/ /paṇa chen pargya dang rtsa brgyad bod du bzhugs/ /'od ma'i dug mda' rgya nag 'og tu 'du/ /rgya gar rgyal po bod la sbrul ltar 'khril/ /bdos pas ma thub skyes kyis dbang du bsdus/ /lcags shing mdung mda' rgya gar 'og tu 'du/ /ta zig rgyal po bod la khra ltar gdug /thapas mi 'dra ba bzhi bcu tham pas btul/ /gzi mchong gser sogs rin po che rnams brdol/ /mtshon 'debs ral gri ta zig 'og tu 'du/ /ge sar rgyal po bod la rta ltar 'tshab/ /rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung gis ge sar patul/ /'phrul thabs sgyogs dang lag cha go mtshon byung rdo /bod depung 'dril bas ge sar 'og tu 'du1 /dus bzang mtshon kha phyi la bstan pa jis/ /phyogs bzhi'i rgyal bran thams cad mnga' 'og 'dus/ rgyal khams kun kyang sa bcad yul yangs bskyed/ /shar phyogs gser zam ser po'i nor sgo phye//lto phyogs dom sgo nag po'i kha ni bsdams/ /nub phyogs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rgyun ma chad/ /byang phyogs sha pags skya bo kha phyir bstan/ /bzang sems can dang legs pa'i yon tan can/ /'bangs kyi dam pa zhabs 'og dar bas 'bol/rje yi bka' lung nyi ma shar ba 'dra/ /rgyal khrims lcags kyi nan thag lta bur bsdams/ /ngan spyod rku 'phrog med pa'i blo gtad thub/ /blon po longs spyod che bas gros phugs mthun/ /phyogs kyi mgron po 'du bas stabs chags med/ /rgya che don 'dril bka' yi mchid nas bton/ /yul khams rgya bskyed mtha' dmag dgra rnams btul ba'i skabs ste brgyad pa'o// //mnga' 'og bod kyi rnam thar brten pa'i skabs/'i/nga' 'og lha chos mi tshos gnyis su sbrel1 /zhes pas/ bod 'bangs 4 kyi

yongs kyi rnam thar bsdus te bstan/ /log pa can gyi 'jig rten mi gtsang yul//khrel med po rnams dran pa med pa 'dra/ /klad po che rnams tis ta sgor gyis 'khor/ /ma byin len rnams sa yi byi ba 'dra/ /g.yem pa rnams ni khyi phag pong bu 'dra/ /srog gcod pa ni rngon pas dgo mthong 'dra/ /ngag 'khyal can ni gtsang ba'i rtsang pa 'dra/ /tshig rtsub smra ba'i lha min g.yul 'gyed/'dra/ /rdzun ma rnams ni lcog mgo ne mchu 'dra/ /phra ma mkhan ni gzod dang khyi khu 'dra/ /ba ba sems can ni gser khar skyes pa 'dra/ /gnod 'tshe ba ni gshed ma phrad pa 'dra/ /log lta can ni bu yug 'tshub ma 'dra/ /dred po rnams ni 'chol ma'i 'phongs dang 'dra/ /la la skyed pa'i 'dod yon lnga la 'byams/ /la la las ngan sdug la skog thugs byed/ /la la 'brel ba'i gnyen la zhen/ 1la la sdang ba'i dgra la mnar/ /sdar ma 'bros dang mdzangs pa bzlum1 /dpang bo 'thab dang mi thub 'bab/ /la la nor phyir lus sems khol/ /la la zas gos 'tsho 'phros g.yengs/ /la la nor rdzas gnyis la bskor/ /la la dbul drags sprang bo byed/ /la la kha drags khengs dregs byed/ la la khas nyen dgra yis gtses/ la la rgod drags mi mgo shor/ /la la rgum drags rang ngan dma'/ /la la zung bzhi so nam byed/ /la la rku dang 'phrog pa gnyis/ /la la rmo dang rko ba gnyis/ /la la she spyang tshong spogs gnyis/ /la la slong ba log 'tsho gnyis/ /skyon las yon tan mi la med/ /rmongs pa mgo zhakhor ma sangs bod rnams la/ /rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing sbram la gi /chos khrims dar gye mdud pa 'jam la dam/ /'bangs khrims sog ma'i phon thag mang yang 'dus/ /rgyal po steng bzhugs thugs sgam 'bangs tshim che/ /'bangs 'og mchis pa bka' nyan yul khrims gnas/ /mnga' 'og bod kyi rnam thar bstan pa'i skabs te dgu pa'o// //446

drang don rim gyis pa god smra'i sde pa'i skabs/de nas lha tshos mi chos gnyis su ji ltar sbrel ba ni/ dang po lha chos lo pakho nyi shu la/ ā tsāyi bodhi sa tu dang / ā 〈be+e pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /ā tsārla be+e ma la/mi du dang / ā tsāyi d+ngharmā chos mchog dang / ā tsayi de ba ma ti dang / ā tsaye phyogs kyi glang po dang / ā tsale ta tsā ga ta shā skyo ta dang / ātsan bud+ngha gusta dang / ā tsayi tu kā ra dang / lda rtsayi shān tiṅka ra dang / bal po ru har nag po dang / mkhan chen bo te rtermo tīr dang /rgya nag ta shang ma hā snga na dang / siṅga la glu'i dbang phyug dang / lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / lo tsā ba rgyal gsum rgyal ba byang chub dang / lo tsā ba rma rin chen mtshog dang / lo tsā ba cog ro glu'i rgyal mtshan dang / lo tsā ba dā na bha la dang / go/tsā ba chen po be+e ro tsa na dang / rgya bod grags pa'i lo paṇa rnams/ /bka' dang gzhung lugs mang me dang / /slob dpon bzhed gzhung mang po rnams/ /rgyu yi theg pa'i lugs la ni/ /dbang po no rtul gnyis su 'dod/ /rim gyis pa dang rig car pa/ /rim sgru+os 'jug pa'i lo rgyus la/ /lha mi'i ston pa shākya thub pa de/ /ni rāṣ+ṭa ra'i mchod rten rnam dag drung / /rang gi dbu skra rang bzhar rab tu byung / /'jig rten 'das pa'i mdzad pa mthar phyen mdzad/ /rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin ni rab tu byung / /thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa byung / /yab ni rgyal po tshangs 'dod ces bya yab/ /yum ni skra yi lā ba can zhis yum/ khyi rgyal dge slong ku ku rā dza yin/ /sgra can 'dzin las rab byung lo stong thub/ /thub pa'i bstan pa theg pa gsum la mkhas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin cen mang sprul grags/ /de la dge slong li 447

tsa byis rab byung / /mkhan chen dri ma med pa zhes byar grags/ /de la bodhi sa tīs rab tu byung / /mkhan chen yab mes za hor rgyal po dza/ /lo brgyas phung po lhag med 'ja' ltar yal/ /nam mkha' bya rgod ljongs kyi khrim sa 'phyo gling / /gsang sngags phyi nang gnyis ka mkhas mkhyen pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa ni/ /slob dpon ma hā rā dza dus gsum mkhyen/ /rgyal po dza yi bla ma yin par bshad/ /dza yi sras ni in+d+ra bye ti yin/ /nyis brgya lor 'das phung po lhag med yal/ /de sras rgyal po go ma di byi yin/ /phyed dang nyis brgya thub nas 'ja' ltar yal/ /de sras mkhan po bo dhi sa two yin/ /pod kyi rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan dang / /skye ba snga ma'i las 'brel thugs dam gcig /rgyal pos dgung lo bcu gsum lon tsa na/ /bo dhi sa tā bod du 'byon pa la/ /rgya gar gtsigs che pas ni ma btang dogs/ /bal yul 'phags pa shing khun gtsug lag dang / /go da ba ra'i gtsug lag khang gnyis la/ /phyag skor mchod pa byed du 'gro gsungs byon/ /bod kyi rgyal pos 'byon /pa ma mkhyen nas/ /blon po rdzas ches bang chen btang nas su/ /yab rgyal grongs nas rgyal srid ma zin cing / /bod na dge ba bcu yi sgra mi grag /da res ma ༷'byon dus phyis 'byon par zhus/ /blon 'bangs dpang zhig bskur nas rgya gar ༷bzhud/ /de nas dus phyis mkhan pos 'byon ran mkhyen/ /tshong dus 'gur mor byon 'dug zer ba dang / /rgyal pos bang chen btang shās lha sar byon/ /rje yi blon 'bangs rnams la bka' bstsal pa/ /lha je paṇ+ḍi ta ceg byon 'dug zer/ nga ni mjal 'gro khyed rnams 'gro 'am gsungs/ /blon po rgan rim rnams kyis gros byas nas/ /mtha' mis mgo skor byung ba'i nyen yod pas/ /rgyal po'i sku tshe'i bar chod 'gro nyen yong / /nged kyis mtshan nyid brtag gis zer nas btang / /mkhan pos de bar mi rnams thams cad la/ /sor mo bcu 448
