ni yar la bstan nas su/ /dge bcu spyad na mtho ris lha mi 'thob/ /thur du bstan nas mi dge bcu spyad na/ /phyi ma ngan song 'gro ba'i brda chos bstan/ papa chen rnams la phan sems chos gsum bskur / /byams pa snying rje byang chub sermas gsum ste/ /don la mkhan po'i blo sbyod lam rim yin/ /blon los rgyal po'i phyag tu phul pas mnyes/ /mgo skor byed par mi 'dug spyon 'dren gsungs/ /bsam yas spyan drangs rgyal pos mjal phrad mdzad/ /mkhan po'i zhal nas rje la 'di skad gsungs/ /rgyal po khyod kyis dkon cog gsum gyi4rten/ /sangs rgyas dkon rtsag rten du gtsug lag khang / /brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs pa'i dam bca' mdzod/ /dam pa'i chos kyi dkon cog rten du ni/ skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i skur bzhugs pa/ /u rgyan mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / /lo paṇa mang po spyan drangs chos bsgyur las/ /'gro ba byang chub lam la dgod cig gsungs/ /'di la smod pa ngan song sdug bsngal gsum/ /chos ni skye ba 'di la ma spyad na/ /skye ba phyi ma mir skye'i nges ba med//'dren pa dge 'dun dkon cog rten du ni/ /chos byed kun gyi mkhan po yin pas na/ /'bangs mi thum brgya rab tu byung zhig gsungs/ /dga' par byedagapa sbyin pa'i mchog zhing yin/ /sgo gsum bsdams pa tshul khrims mchog zhing yin/ khong mi khro ba bzod pa'i mchog zhing yin/ /don du gnyer pa brtson 'grus mtshoka zheng yin/ /sems mi g.yeng ba sems gtan mchog zhing yin/ tortog dang bral ba shes rab mchog zhing yin/ /'gro bas 'di drug rab tu spyad bus go/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su mi rnams 'gyu+or gyi gsungs/ /de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde'u ba0ོna byes/ /bod kyi sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung / /sba gsal snang / sba dpal dbyangs la gsum rgyal ba mchog lha lung dpal gye ngo rje/ rma rin cen mchog sa khri bzher be+e ro tsa na dang bdun ge+o/ /sngom 14gi

pa thub pas god la bka' drin che/ /de nas 'bangs ni sum brgya rab tu byung / rdobadud dang mu stegs bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /ma lus bcom nas bstan pa'i gzhi bzhag tshugs/ /sgra gcan 'dzin ni sangs rgyas rang rgyud 'dod/ /yod par smra ba'i sde pa sde bdun gyes/ /bslab pa'i gos gagong 'di thabs rgya gar grags/ /gzhi la thams cad yod smra'i sde pa dang / /'od srungs sde pa sa spungs sde pa dang / /chos srungs sde pa mang du thos pa'i sde/ /gos dmar can sde rnam par bye smra'i sde/ /rgyas par 'dul ba'i sde sgod shes par gyes/ /de yang bod kyi mkhan por snga ba ni/ /mkhan chen bo dhi sa rta'i zhal nas su/ /dus phyis tsa na rgya nag ha shang zhes/ /chos log rtsom pa bod du 'ong bsrid pas/ /de dus slob dpon bi mā mi tra dang / /rgya gar kā ma shī la spyan ༷drongs gsudas/ khyed bod klu yi rigs nas 'chad pa yin pas/ /che thungarwand mang 'dre gdon bar chad mang / /snying rus chung bas thos bsam mthar ma phyin/ /rgyal po'i rgyal srid chos dang bstun na bzang / /ngas ni gson po rnams ༷kyi tshe bsring dang / /gshin po rnams kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i phyin/ /sman bla sangs rgyas bdun gyi mchod pa bya/ /drang don rim gyis pa yod smra'i sde pa'i —skabs te bcu pa'o// //bstan pa cig car ba'i skabs/gnyis pa cig car pa yi lo rgyus ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nga ni 'das gyur kyang / /bstan pa'i bka' ni tshad ma 'gyur ba med/ /nga ni yongs su mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og /'od srungs la sogs dge sgong gnas brtan 'du/ kun dgas thub pa'i bstan pa gang gsungs pa/ /de skad 'dri na 'di skad lung ston 450

cig /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gceg na/ /ston pa gnas dang dus dang 'khor dang chos/ /rnam grangs gang gasrungs khyod kyis spros shig las/ /mjug tu bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la/ /mngon par bstod do bya ba gyis shig gsungs/ /sangs rgyas mya nga 'das dgra bcom thugs me phyung / /phung po mi snang sol ba mi snang 'das/ /'od srungs bka' bsdu mdzad phyir paka' khrims bcas/ /dge slong gnas brtan grong khyer rtsa mchog 'tshogs/ /dgra bcom lnga brgyar gcig gis ma longs pas/ /lha gnas ba lang bdag 'bod gang po btang / /ba lang bdag gis dri ba lnga dris 'das/ /lhung bzed chos gos dge 'dun rnams la phul/ /de nas kun dga' po la tshab ma byas/ /dga' —bos dgra bcom ma thob ma thar bas/ /'od srungs kyis ni spyo ba brgyad smras pa/ /nyon mongs cung zad ma thongs kun dga' bo/ khyod mchog 'dus pa'i nang 'dir sa 'dug cig /dga' bo bred nas 'od srungs chen po dgongs/ /tshul khrimase nyams pa'i las kyang ngas ma byas/ /sprod lam lta ba 'tsho ba nyams ma byas/ /dge 'dun la yang nyes pa cig ma byas/ /btsun pa 'od srungs bdag la ci phyir gsungs/ /'on kyang stos pa bdag bzod gsung bad zhu/ 1btsun pa 'od shāngs smras pa kun dga' bo/ khyod kyis sangs rgyas thabs su rtag 'dug nas/ /tshul khrims la sogs ma nyams ci ngo mtshar/ /longs la tshul zhing zungs shig khyod nyes bstan/ khyod kyis skye rgu'i bdag mo rab tu byung / /bstan pa lnga brgya nub pas dang por nyes/ /kun dga' bo yis de la lan btab pa/ /'khor ni rnam bzhi ma longs kha skong dang / /nu ma bsnun pas ma drin che ba'i byer/ /'od srungs zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /thub pa'i te gnas kun dga' bo/ /sangs rgyas bston pa gnyen phyir khyod 'tshong ngam/ /de gcig ma 'tshal nongs gyur bzod par gsol/ /yang ni khyod kyis khyam pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /4du1

mdoms kyi sba ba nub pa bstan pas nyes/ /dga' bos de ༅nga bzod par gsol lo gsungs/ khyod kyis shes rab phar phyin ma bsgoms nyes/ /sangs rgyas zhabs 'bring bgyid pas ma khom gsungs/ /zhabs 'bring rab ni sgom pa ṣe+o/na yin/ /de yang nongs par gyur pas bzod par gsol/ khyod kyis bdud kyis bar gcod byed pa la/ /mya ngan mi 'dang gsol ba ma btab nyes/ /padud kyis rna ba bkag nas ma thos gsungs/ /stong pa nyid la dgag tu ce kyi/da ces/ /de yang nongs na bzod par gsol lo gsungs/ /sku gser btso ma'i kha dog bud med bstan/ /mchil mas dri ma can du byas pas nyes/ /'od srungs bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mthong na/ /sems can dad pa skyes nas kha dog ldan/ khyod kyis gzhan sems mi shes ci char yod1 /de yang nongs na bzod par gathol lo gsungs/ /sangs rgyas zhal skyems chu rtogs drangs pas nyes/ 1'od srungs rgyal po gzugs can snying go yi/ /ba lang lnga brgyas chu la brgal bas lan/ 1dga' bo lhung bzed nam mkha' la bzed na/ /lha kun bdud rtsi'i char gyis 'gengs zhes pas/ /de yang nongs na bzod par gsol lo gsungs/ /chos gos rdog pas mnan nas btsems pas nyes/ /'od srungs sna byid 'chem du ma btub gsungs/ /chos gos ོma mkhar bor na lha rnams 'dzin/ /de yang nongs na bzod par gsol lo gsungs/ /so so thar pa'i mdo bton rjes la ni/ /tshul khrims glod thabs bag yod byar yod gsungs/ /de nyid khyod kyis ma zhus pa yis nyes/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas dang ni bral dogs pa'i1 /mya ngan nogo pas dri ba ma byung gsungs/ /sangs rgyas zhabarme 'bring lo ni nyer gcig byas/ kho thag ma chod mya ngan ci la phan/ /de yang nongs na bzod 3ra gsol lo gsungs/ /phan tshun 'gran sems bshos lhag mi za dang / 1na bza' rnying pa mi gyon dam bcas nyes/ /sbyo dang gos kyi ched du ma yin 452

gsungs/ /sto gos med pa'i nyer gnas su 'ong gsungs/ /de yang nongs na bzod par gsol lo gsungs/ /de nas kun dga' bo yi thugs dgongs la//sangs rgyas grongs grongs tho phyir mi 'ong bar/ /sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus na nga dgos la/ /da ni sangs rgyas ma bzhugs thams cad spyos/ /thugs mug bshum zhing phyir log 'ongs pa la/ /ma 'gags pas ni shugs gsos kun dga' bo/ /dgra bcom ma thob 'di ru shog dang gsungs/ /de nas 'bri rje'i grong k+ṣe+or khyim bdag bu/ /tshe dang ldan pa sgong byed gnyis la ni/ /shes rab phar phyin btab pas dgra bcom thob/ /rtag mthar mi gnas chad mtha' yongs su bkag /gnyis min grongs pa yod med mthar me gnas/ /bstan pa cig car ba'i skabs te bcu gcig pa'o// //rtse men rim gyis pa'i skabs/bcom ldan 'das kyis 'od srungs la bka' bstsal pa/ nga ni yongs su mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og bstan pa'i don phyir sde sgod gsum bsdus te/ /kun dga' bo ni nyon mongs thams cad ldan/ /dgra bcom mngon sum thob por ma 5ོsa bar/ /'od srungs mya ngan 'da' bar ma byed cig /kun dga' bo la bstan pa gtad nas su/ /drang sgong nyi gung rab tu ma byung bar/ /kun dga' bo khyod mya ngan ma 'da' zhig /nyi ma'i gung la khyod kyis de skad gyis/ /gru yi rgyal po hu lu ka btul nas/ kha che'i yul du bstan pa gnas byas te/ khyem bdag sro ma can ni rab tu byung / /nyon mongs spangs nas dgra bcom thob pa dang / /de la khyod kyis bstan pa ma gtad par/ khyod nyid mya ngan 'da' bar ma byed cig /sro ma can la'ang khyod kyis de skad gyis/ /sro ma khyod kyim glu 453

rgyal gar mkhan dang / /klu yi rgyal po dpa' bo gnyis btul te/ /gar mkhan dpa' bo dgon pa'i gnas su sprugs/ /rgya gar yul gyi ming ni bcom brlag tu/ /mi yi ming ni spos 'tshong bsrung zhes bya/ /de yi budini nyer bsrung rapa byung nas/ /dedzo/ kyang dgra bcom mngon sum ma thob par/ /bstan pa ma gtad mya ngan ma 'da' zhig /nyer bsrung la yang khyod kyis de skad gyis/ khyod kyi rigs bu blo ldan rab tu byung / /blo ldan dgra bcom mngon sum ma thob par/ dastan pa ma gtad mya ngan ma 'dang zhig de la yang ni khyod kyis de skad gyi+os/1blo ldan khyod kyis yul dmar can gyi bu/ /zas la dug za'i bsam ma byas par/ /yongs su mya ngan nyada' bar ma byed cig dgra decom des pa bdun brgyud nas dor te/ /sanges rgyas byon pa rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /bstan pa chaṭa pa lho phyogs wa rta ni/ /bstan pa byung ba byung phyogs lo nyi ta/ bram ze rab rteming/mkhan po 'od srungs phyos/ /phal chen sde pa byung ste lnga ru gyeso/ /shar ri'i sde dang nub kyi ri bo'i sde/ /g.ya' rid gnas sde 'jig rten las 'das sde/ /rtag par smra ba'i sde dang lnga ru gyes/ /bcom ldan 'das sku mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus/ /chos kyi mtha' ma dri bas the tshom bcad/ /mya ngan 'da' ba'i gzhung 'di bstan pa yin/ /dpe don mang po 'od srungs nyid la gsungs/1de nas dharmoṭ+wāṃr la sogs nas/ /rgya nag sprul bdun brgyud pa brgyud pa'i mtha'/ /hā shang ma hā be+e na nyid la thug /'od srungs cig car 'jug pa phal chen sde/ /mkhan po stormobhā ra lī brgyud ni/ /shar gyi phyogs su rgya mtsho brgal nas khrun/ /rgya yul ṅge kun zhes bya'i yul du slebs/ /rgya rje sa 'u yan dang mkhan po mjal/ /don dam go ba ma yin pa ru shes/ /mkhar lag chu zhes bya bar byon pa dang / /dge slong kha shi dang ni le'u tsi/ /kan rdor la sogs pa yis phrag dog byas/ /le'u tsis mkhan po rtermosdir la/ /dug ni lan drug 454

blud pas ma tshugs ོ/ /mjug tu chos ni gtad sa ma rnyed nas/ /rgya nag yul du sku ni 'da' tshul bstan/ /rjes kyi bya ba dge sdur zin nas su/ /rgya gar yum nas stod kyi phyogs su 'ongs/ /tshong pa bun zhes bya bas phyin pa dang /1ga ra ma ting zhes bya'i la ga ru/ /mkhan po bodhi dharmodī je mjal/ /phyag na lham ni ya gcig thogs nas 'dug /de ru bka' mchid zhib tu ston pa dang //tshong pa bun gyes slar log rgya yul du/ /gtam rna sa zhib hūṃ bsnyad pas dur kha phye/ /bstas pas lham ni ya gcig mi 'dug nas/ /rgya nag mi kun 'phags pa yin no gleng / /zhi ba khros pa stoms 'gog ting nge 'dzin/ /brag ri de bzhi'i nang na dge slong ni/ /'od srungs lus khrug ma zhig pa ru gnas/ / byams pa byon nas 'od srungs lus ston 'gyur/ /shāka thub nyan thos chen po 'od srungs yin/ /bsngags pa brjod nas mgo la nyug par 'gyur/ bobhedharmo ༷ ra'i brgyud 'dzin ni/ /mtha' ma hā shang ma hā yu na'i gzhung / /cig car 'jug pa yongs su rdzogs pa yos/ /dpe don mang po mdo sde'i gzhung la thug /de dag 'dod gzhung yi ge yod pa dang / dharmotī ra'i rgya lung chen mo rnams// ci yang byar med man ngag snyan khung brgyud/ /de yi brgyud pa 'bro byal rin cen nas/ /ma rkang rtsa ba yan chad sa ru bzhugs/ /de'i don ma mnyan yid chags spangs pa dang / /pha ma rgyal blon pho nu dang 'grogs 'khon/ /gnyen 'dun khyo chung mdza' bo mdza' mo rnams/ /'jig rten mgron po gnas gcig 'dug pa 'dra/ /mi bden 'dus byas 'gyes pa'i chos can te/ /dus 'dir 'phul gyi dga' bar chags bsten kyang / /byang chub 'phrog pa'i dgrar 'gyur gshed ma thu/ /de dag dbang khar mi gtang rang gros gdab/ /wa yis mi mthong lta bur 'bros pa bzhin/ /tshe 'dir gcig pa'i las mthun nye gzhi rnams/ /mgron po gnas mthun lta bur so sor 'gro /pha ma la sogashe phyogs 4du5

bshes gnyen 'dun gyis/ /sdug bsngal grogs byed 'khor ba'i gros dkyil nas//'phral ched phugs su 'phung bar byed pa'i ngag /de la nyan nas sems gtod shā+o'am ci/ /de bas rang gi lus sems so sor 'gyes/ /dgon pa'i gnas su gcig pur gshegs pa'i don/ /'dzig rten ya ga'i bcas rnams bsrung ba'i zhing / /gang zhig grong gi dbus su 'dug nas su/ /byang chub sangs rgyas dam pa thob pa ni/ /de 'dra'i sangs rgyas gang yang sngon ma byung / /ma byon pa dang da ltar bzhugs pa'ang/med/ /grong dbus rtsod pa'i rgyu+or 'gyur mi dge 'phel//rgyud ma dul bas nyon mongs thams cad 'phyo/ /dgon pa mi dge sdig pa'i phyoṭa la dbyen/ /rgyud gzhi rtsod pa med pas dgra bcom thob/ /rgya gar slob dpon kā ma shī la yis/ /drang po don gyi mdo sde yongs ma rdzogs/ /rim pa slob la bsogs pa the tsom gcod/ /sāts+tsha gdab dang nye 'don bya ba dang / /sto+ong zam 'dzugs dang lam 'phrang sil ba dang / 1mchod rten brtsig dang gtsug lag khang mang bzhengs/ /rab tu byung ba'i sde pa chen po bca'/ /mdo sde rgya chen blog 'don bya ba dang / /chos 'khor chen po bshad nyan bya ba dang / /sdug bsngal can gyi grogs rnams bya ba dang / /nye ring med pa'i nad pa gso ba dang / /sbyin rgya chen po rlabs chen ci cher 'bad/ /hā shang ma hā spyod thabs bcu gnyis spyod/ /theg pa chen po gsang sngags pa la ni/ /dbang gi rim pa mang po nod pa dang / /sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor mang po zhal dbye dang / /sman rag gtor tshogs sreg mnan bya ba dang / /sgom gra 'dzugs pa sogs la 'bad pa'o/ /rab byung sde pa mchod gnas mi bkur ro/ /tshul 'chos chos lugs rdzong ngam khud cing blta/ /gsang sngags pa yi spyod thabs bcu gnyis so/ /mthun pa'i mchod rten thos bsam sgom gsum bsgom/ /kā ma shī la rim gyis pa yang bstan/ /hā shang ma hā yā na'i bsam gtan dang / /yo/ga nang 456

pa'i zab mo'i chos rnams dang / /lhag pa'i rnal 'byor slong rug bzhi sprugs dang / kho na nyid kyi zab mo'i rgyud drug dang / /sems 'phreng nyi shu sems med bco brgyad bsten/ /'gag med snang ba'i thog nas bsam gtan sgom1 /mdo sde 'byung ba bshad pa nyid las kyang / /snang/srid/thanas cad sems las byung ba ste/ /sems nyid de nyid rtag tu brtan tu med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin pyang chub nyid du gsungs/ /byang chub rang bzhin sems can thams cad de/ /sems can rnams dang byang chub gnyis su med1 /de ltar rtogs na skyes bu mchog tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'khrul snang las snang nyams snang gzigs snang bzhi/ /rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum 'byung ba bzhi las grub/ /de ltar snang ba sems can mtshan nyid yin/ /snang ba skye ba rnam pa bzhi las skyer / /de ltar snang ba sems can mtshan nyid yin/ /snang ba skye rga na 'chi 'chi med rigs/ /'khor 'das gnyis ga'i don byed nus pa ste/ /de ltar snang ba sems can mtshan nyid yin/ /snang ba spangs pa'i sems can gcig sgrubs mdzod/ /ro la snang ba med pas sems can min/ /sems yin can min yul drug med khas blangs/ 1'gro ba rigs drug sems can min khas blangs/ /drang don gyis ni snang ba ngo mi shes/ /gsang sngags nad pa rnal 'byor chen po dang / —/shin tu rnal 'byor la ni 'ardzug pa'i dus/ /man ngag thob pa rigs shig bye nas gsol/ /rtse men thabs ni zhi gnas rgyud rtog pa/ /goms par sla ba'i zhi gnas/dag thob byed/ /ston mun thog ma nyid nas don dam pa/ /ma skyes bya ba med pa goms pa'i thabs/ /thob par bye+od kyang thabs ni yang dag min/ /de la thabs ni chen bo mi bya'o/ /rtse men rim 'jug mi rtog pa la 'jug /rnam par mi rtog yid la mi byed sgoms/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum rim par sgoms/ /stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / /smon pa med pa rnam thar sgo gsum mo/ /ston 451

min cig car 'jug pa re mos med/ /don dam ma skyes pa la cig car bslab /chadang po skye 'gag med pa'i sem sa bskyed nas/ /tha ma skye 'gag med pa'i 'bras /bu thob/ /mkhan chen po dhirtermo dhā ras gsungs/ /yang dag yangs phyogs mi stos yangs/ /lham mer gnas na bdag gzhan gang yang med/ /ma rabs dang ni 'phags pa mnyam zhing gcig /mi 'gyur nyams kyi gtan gnas phan chad du/ /tha ge bstan pazhi rjes su mi 'brang ngo / /'di ni yang dag don gzhi'i gnas matsu bab/ /rnam par rtog med zhi zhing bya ba med/ /de ni don la 'jug pa cig car ro/ /bsam gtan mkhan po 'jug dus bshad pa ni/ /mi sems tshul khrims mi dran ting nge 'dzin/ /sgyu sems mi 'byung ba ni shes rab bo/ /bsam gtan mkhan po bdud 'dul snying po bshad/ /ci yang mi dran pa ni sangs rgyas /dran/ /'di nyid ske bltas ma yengs sems stoms na/ /de bzhin gshegs / ༷yang dag chos su yin/ /bas ma gtan mkhan po arten her gyis bshad/ /sems gnyid mi g.yo ji bzhin mnyam pa ni/ /rnal 'byor nges pa'i sa thob lam yin no/1 bsam gtan mkhan po ma hā yān gyis bshad/ /chos nyid bsam med mi rtog pa ru bzhag /sngar ma sbyangs kyang 'di la 'jug tu btub/ /rtse min rim gyis 'jug pa sngar bshad ltar/ /dmigs pa sha thang 'bad nas mi dmigs skye/ /dngos po gtan tshigs kyis ni gzhal gnas su/ /dbu ma'i don ni dang du len pa'o/ /ston mun bzhed pa bdag gzhan chos so cog /ye nas ma skyes don du gnyer bas bslad/ /des ni nam yang don byed mi mthong ste/ /'on kyang ci bsam stoms par gzhug 'dod na/ 1rgyu rkyen rim par 'jug ces bstan pa yang / /rmongs pa rnams ni thabs kyis 'jug par gsungs/ /dbang po tha ma'i don du rim 'jug bstan/ /sbur ba'i 'gros kyis ri rab khar mi rtol/ /dmigs pa can gyis mi rtog par bshad do/ /de lta'i ston mun bya me bral 458

gsol kyang / /skye 'gag gnyi4 su med par ma shes so/ /gnyis med smra yang na ste+os re zhig 'dod/ /stong pa cir yang snang du/mi nus pa/ /rang gi lta bas baspribs pa'i stod zhen no/ /sangs rgyas mdo sde stong par bsgom pa la/ /ci phyir rim gyis 'jug ces bya ba ste/ /'dir ni ri bo chen pod 'dzeg pa la/ /gom gcig gom gnyis phyin pas brtol 'dra zhing / /bden gnyis zhi lhag ris bcad sa non 'gyur/ /spyod lam dge ba la dngos brtson par bya/ /de lta'i tshogs gnyis 'bad pas kun 'od 'gro /skad cig snga phyi'i phyi mar chos sku thob//smon lam thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad/ /'gog pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni gnyid sad dpe/ /gzugs skur langs rte don mdzad pa ru bzhed/ /rtse men sa rim gyis pa'i skadis te bcu gnyis pa'o// /// ston mun cig car 'jug pa'i skabs/ ston mun cig car 'jug pa'i dpe bstan pa/ /ri rgyal rte mor phyin na /kun mgrong tshul/ /ri bran rtse nas lhun po mi mthong bzhin/ /rim gyis pa ni rka mo'i nya chung 'dra/ /cig car ba ni gtsang chu'i nya dang 'dra/ /gzhal bya chagazhal byed ye nas ma skyes pa/ /ci yang ma btsal nyid kyis go bar 'dod/ /bla ma nges pa'i mdo sde mi brten yin/ /yul la ma bsten par ni sems mi skye//sems la ma bsten par ni yul mi snang / /shes bya shes byed gnyis po phan tshun bstos/ /grub pa'i snang ba mi 'gog pa ni thabs/ /snang ba rang shezhin med pa shes rab bo/ /kanyis med don dam gcig par thag bcad de/ /cig car ba ni seng ge lam zhugs 'dra/ /gad med g.yang med kun la thogs med do/ /rim gyis pa ni wa mo/lam zhugs 'dra/ /gad g.yang mi thar pa la log skor 459

byed /nyes skyon le los dmigs pa brjod pa dang / /bying dang rgod dang mi rtsol rtsol ba'o/ /de nyid slob pa'i gnyen po 'dun byed brgyad/ /dad pasate'adun pa rtsol ba shin tu sbyangs/ /dran pa shes bzhin sems pa btang stoms so/ /'dod sred dang bral dga' bde lam gyur tsam/ /sdug bsngal ma yin bde ba ma yin pa'i/ /btang stoms dran 'dun bsam gtan bzhi pa'o/ /rtse men las 'dir khyad par bcus 'phags te/ /thapas kyi khyad par ston mun 'phags pa dang / /'jug lugs khyad par ston mun 'phags pa dang / /spyod pa'i khyad par ston mun 'phags pa dang / /ting 'dzin khyad par ston mun 'phags pa dang / / rnam rtog bcos lugs ston mun 'phags pa da / /sprib pa sbyong thabs khyad ngar 'phags pa dang / /sgrub pa'i khyad par ston mun 'phags pa dang / /tshoṭa kyi khyad par ston mun 'phags pa dang / /rtog pa'i khyad par ston/mun 'phags pa dang / /'gro don khyad par dang ni bcus 'phags so/ /bsam gtan mkhan po ke hun shan tis bshad/ /sems mnyam pa na chos rnams mnyam pa'o/ sangs rgyas chos ma lin pa gang yang med/ /sred cing chags pa thams thud skye bo yin/ /bsam gtan mkhan po rdzing shin shas bshad pa/ /dran pa'i rtog pa mi 'gyur ting nge 'dzin/ /yongs gru rdzogs pas rtog med shes rapa skye/ /de ni khams gsum pa las 'dapha par gyur/ /bsam gtan mkhan po sbab shan shin bshad pa/ /rnam par mi rtog cig car rig pa ni/ /gcan gzan rgyal po seng ge 'gying pa 'dra/ /sgra grag spyod pa rnam bzhi bag mi tsha/ /bsam gtan mkhan po de'u shan shin bsha༄ོ/ /sems nyid 'khrud la chu mi dgos pa yin/ /sbyin pa gtong la nor mi dgos pa yin/ /yang dag sems kyis dam pa'i don bsgrubs na1 /drang por 'dug pas de bzhin gshegs pa 'thob/ /bsam gtan mkhan po thang bzang shin shis bshad/ /chos gcig shes na chos kun ma bslabs lob//466

/des ni nyon mongs bag chags mi skye'o/ /bsam gtan mkhan po ham ze shin shis bshad/ /lam de bsgom zhing sangs rgyas nyid bltas na/ /sangs rgyas mi phyo thong gol ba sangs rgyas nye/ /bsam gtan mkhan po ār+ya rag shis bshad/ /theg pa chen po'i lta ba chun pa ni/ /'jig rten 'dus byas thams ca da 'dus ma thus/ /thog ma rnam par dag cing mnyam pa'i phyir/ /mkhan poti shaka' la yan pa ma bshad pa/ /'od spungs cig car 'jug pa thabs med do/ /chos sems la sems kun la ma skyes so/ /bsam gtan mkhan po/bu chung bshad pa ni/ sha mtshan ma chos rnams thams cad mtshan ma la/ /sems kyis sems 'tshol sems kyis sems mi rnyed/ /ci yang mi rnyed ci yang bstan rgyu med/ bsam gtan ༷mkhan po ma hā lnga nas bshad/ /yongs blta bas ni phyi nang chos bdag gis/ / nashās sems spri yi mtshan nyid chos bdag che/ /rang gi mtshan nyid mi rtag sdug bsngal ba/ /spyi yi mtshan nyid stong pa bdag med mjal/ /bsam gtan mkhan tshe+ochakha shen shi yis bshad/ /tshos so cog kugo stong par shes pa ni/ /stong par shes pas nus pa'i ye shes stong / /de bas chos rnams stong pa nyid kyang stong 1 /bsam gtan mkhan po dzang shan shi yis bshad/ /chos so cog la thogs pa samed pa ni/ /tshos lam spyod pa yin no tshogs drug 'chang / /mdo sde thob pa sangs rgyas lung ston no/ /bsam gtan mkhan po len shan shis bshad pa/ /layig mthong gnas nyid bden pa'i chos mthong mtha'/ 1tshos so cog kyang bden ba'i mtha' yin no/ /de las gzhan du btsal du ci zhig yod/ /bsam gtan mkhan po o shen shis bshad pa/ /sems drang ba ni tshos lam spyod pa yin/ /stong pa mi spyod thabs mi 'tshol ba'i phyir/ /drang por spyad de phan chad lam med do/ /bsam gtan mkhan po len shan shis bshad pa/ /chos kyi ngo bo rted la the tshom med/ /drang por bsgom la the tshom ma za zhig /bsam gtan 461

mkhan po han shan shis bshad pa/ /g.yo zhing byed do cog kyang de bzhen snyid/ 1yul drug gang byung ba yang de bzhin nyid/ /'gyur ba med cing tha dad med pa'o/ /bsam gtan mkhan po kan shas shis bshad pa/ /sems ni ci la mi rtog par go na/ /de nyid mdo sde chos kyi lam srol yin/ /tshos kyis bcings pas grol bar mi mthong / /bsam gartan mkhan po dzi shan shis bshad pa/ shachos so cog la yin min nges pa med/ /mig gis gzugs mthong tshe na mi mthong med/ /de bzhin rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs kyi rgyu la rnam shes mi skye na/ /'du shes mi shes gzugs mi mthong ba yin/ /bsam gtan mkhan po kam shan shis bshad pa/ /rnam par shes drug mi dge'i 'du shes min/ /de'i ming bdud kyi las su shes bya'o1 /mkhan chen bo dhe dharmorto ras bshad pa/ /'du shes g.yos tshe g.yo ba med pa de/ /sangs rgyas chos yin mi rnams shes drug 'khrul/ /mkhan po hu'u 'gyes shan shis bshad/ /sems dang rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin no/ /gnas so cog rnams sangs rgyas mya ngan 'das/ /sems kyi yul log sangs rgyas chos min med/ /bsam gtan mkhan bo gyi shan shis bshad pa/ /ma rabs phag pa sgo gnyis gnas lugs gcig /rgyu dang 'bras bu gcig la mi ltos pas/ /dge mi dge'i las mi stor 'bral ba med/ khrims lnga bsrungs na nges par mi lus 'thob/ /stong nyid chos lam spyad na dgra bcom 'thob/ /bsam gtan mkhan po ci sharge shis bshad pa/ /chos so cog kun sangs rgyas chos la g.yos/ /g.yos so cog kun byang chub yin pas su/ /mi dngangs mi skrag gnas so cog kun grags/ /bsam gtan mkhan po zog rtog shan shis bshad/ /kun rdzob bden pa yod pas stong pa yin/ 1dgra bcom bden pa med pas yod ma yin/ /'phags pas gzigs na stong pa nas gnyis med/ /bsam gtan mkhan po jo shan shis bshad pa/ /bslab 462

pa'i mis ni sdig med sdig tu mthong / /shes pa'i mis ni sdig nas sdeg med mthong / /bsam gtan mkhan po yan shan shis bshad pa/ /kun kyang sems ni g.yo ba'i chos yin no/ /sems mi g.yo ba bsam gtan sgom ci dgos/ /shes rab shes pa'i mis 'tshol don dam zad/ /bsam gtan mkhan po han shan shis bshad pa/ /sems chos lam gyi ngo bo nyid yin te/ /lus ni tshos lam gye ni snod yin no/ /rgyu de dge ba'i bshes gnyen rkyen gyes 'byung// /bsam gtan mkhan po shi shan shis bshad pa/ /bdag gi yid kyis yang dag sems shes na/ /de don zab dang mi zab dbye ba med/ /lam mi 'gal thob stor ba'i gnas mi mthong / /bsam gtan mkhan po te kha shis bshad pa/ /lnga phung yongs rdzogs mya ngan 'das shes na/ /lus sems 'dir spyod gcig ldan gzhuja ཿna yin/ /sems can thams cad mun pa bsal bar byed/ /bsam gtan mkhan po la shin shis bshad pa/ /chos don rig na bden par mthun pa dang / /tha dad yin min thams cad med pa'o/ /mngon dang mi mngon brtson 'grus che rnams so/ /bsam gtan mkhan po ma shan shis bshad pa/ /shes pa'i tshe na 'jig rten 'das pa yang / /mi rnams stong pa 'ba' zhig yongs su zad/ /yi ge bstan pa'i rjes su mi 'brang ngo / /bsam gtan mkhan po sa mo gzong sdeg/ bshad/ /chos so cog rnams yod pa ma yin sgo/ /bshad pa khyod kyis rmede par ma mthong ngam/ /skyes las ma skyes ma skyes skyes par 'gyur/ /mkhan po chen po dharmo dhā ras bshad/ /mi shes na ni mi chos la 'brang zhes/ /shes na lha chos la ni mi 'brang ngo / /shes na rnam par shes pa gzugs su 'du/ /slad na rnam par shes pa gzugs la 'du/ /gzugs kyi rgyu la rnam shes skyes ma lags/ /de ni gzugs su mi mthong zhes byo'o/ /'phags pa'i sems ni nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ /skye 'gag sked mthong byang chub ces bya'o/ /lots+tsha ska ba dpal brtseṭa 463

kyis bshad pa/ /'jig rten thams cad yongs btang ste/ /rdul tsam 'dzin pazi sems med pa/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /nyes pa rdul tsam mi 'byung bas/ /tshul khrims pha rol byen pa ngo+ogs/ /chos dbyings ngang las pazod pa partan/ /bzod pa'i pha rol byen pa rdzogs/ /de nyid don la mi g.yo bas/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa rjogs/ /mnyam nyid mi g.yo bdag med pas/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /dmigs med don lo/rang rig pas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa rdzogs/ /chos rnams 'byung ba med pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /sdig sems mu stegs can gyis ngag brjod dam/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung gang bka' bstsal pa/ 1de dag tha dad tshul gyur med pa ste/ /de ltar shes na de ni mgon por 'gyur/ /nya shang ma hā lnga nas bshad pa ni/ /lus kyi 'dug thabs sems kyi gzhag thabs gnyis/ /de la lus kyi 'dug thabs bstan pa ni/ /stan bde bar 'dug lus ni drang por bsrang / /mig gnyis sna la bltas nas ste rkan sbyar/ /skyil krung dam po bcas te 'dug par bu/ /sgo gsum yan por mi gtang grol du gzhug lus brel ngag lab sems yengs ga nas khom/ /gegs ni mang yang bying rgod gnyis su 'dus/ /bying ba'i rgyu ni sa dang me chu thugs/ /bcud can zas skom ngal dub rkyen gnyid 'thibs//rgod pa'i rgyu rkyen me rlung shas che yul phyir 'brangs/ /nyams spyong nang nas shar na gegs phyir sol/ /dge slong ye shes dpal gyes bshad pa ni/ /mi g.yo thi pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin1 /rnam par mi rtog pa la nyin mtshan phul/ /don de lta bu yin par rig pa'i mis/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i gnas su mi 'dug sgoms/ /srod dang tho rengs mi nyal bsam gtan 'dug /phye nang drod rtags dbugs kyi 'gyu ba chad/ /rtse gcig lus dgon sems khom mtshams la 'dug /la gsum rgyal ba byang chub kyis bshad pa/ /mi bden rdzun pa'i 'du shes rab 464

g.yos 'tshal/ /mi spong mi len thabs la mkhas lags so/ /slob dpon zhi ba mchog rgyan gyis bshad pa/ /mnyam par gzhag pa kho na'i skabs nyid na/ /yul dang rnam par rtog pa mi snang ba/ /mi 'gog pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i mchog /myang bran dpal gyi ye shes rgyal mtshan bshad/ /'khor 'das chos la re ba spru tsam med/ /dbang po'i sgo gsum nges don mnyam par gzhag rgyal po khri srong ldenyu btsan bka' bstsal pa/ /phyi nang chos kun dkar dmar snang yang snang / /mthong yang mthod ste shes kyang shes/ /de ltar rnam par rtog pa med dang gcig ri borngo rwa dang mo gsham bu lta bu/ /tshos med de ltar mi rtog pa dang gnyis/ /mi rtog pa 'dra dran pa med min gsum/ khong bcud don gzhan rtsol ba med de bzhi/ /'di bzhi dus gcig skad cig ma la sgom/ /mkhan po ar na mthar byen gyis bshad pa/ /sems nyid ji bzhin nyid du mnyam pa de/ /rnal 'byor nges don lam la zhugs pa'o/ /bsam gtan mkhan po 'dze mgo rgyan gyis bshad/ /chos rnams ji bzhin ji ltar ma bcos na/ /bsam gtan gcig car 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya/ /mkhan po li zhu snying po yis bshad pa/ /don la chos nyid gang yang ma yin pas/ /yin par blo ni cir yang ma bzhag na/ /rnam pa mi rtog don sgom zhes su gdags/ /gsum pa ye shes rgyal po yis bshad pa/ /lta bas 'jal ba'i dus na yin pa med/ /rang rig ma skyes tshe na brjod du med/ /sgom dus blo med mnyam gzhag cig car 'jug /lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas kyis bshad pa/ she /pasam gyis mi khyab ma nyams mnyam par gzhag skye ba med par ma grub 'gag pa med/ /'di la sgo phugs dbus mtha' gang yang med/ /li tsā dri mede grags pa'i mdo las ni/ /gang yang ma skyes ma byung 'dzig pa med/ /mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob pa yin/ /de ni gnyis su med par 'jug pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' 46du

dpal sbas kyis smras pa/ /nga dang nga yir zhes pa gnyis snang yang / /sgo ngatags med na nga yi bar mi 'byung / /gnyis su med pa de la 'jug pa'o/ rdobyang chub sems dpa' des 'dzum gyes smras pa/ /mi dmigs pa de rtog pas gsal mi byed/ /mi spyod pa de gnyis su med par 'jug byang chub sems dpa' skar rgyal gyes smras pa/ /dge dang mi dge zhes bya de gnyis ni/ /mtshanagabacas dang ni mtshan med gnyis su 'jug /byang sems seng ge blo gros kyis smras pa/ /gang gi mnyam pa nyid kyi chos thos nas/ /'di ni zag bcas 'di ni zag pa med/ /gang 'jug med pa de ni gnyis med 'jug /byang chub sems dpa' bde mos kyis smras pa/ /'di ni bde la 'di ni mi bde ba/ /gnyis ka ye shes rnam par bya ba'i phyir/ /mi chags de ni gnyis su med par 'jug /bsam gtan mkhan po dpal dbyangs kyis bshad pa/ /lung dang rig pas thag bcad de/ /sems kyi rang bzhin yang dag yid ches bya/ /ha shang ma hā mā na yis bshad pa/ /sdom pa kun brtags yin pas bsrung mi dgos/ /bslab pa4sems bskyed yin pas nyams mi dgos/ /dam chig gtsang ma yin pas nyamarnga/ mi dgos/ /spyod pa la 'jug spyod pa rnam bzhi bstan/ /gcig ni 'khon lan ldon pa'i spyod pa yin/ /gnyis pa rkyen gyi rjes su spyod pa'o/ /gsum pa ci yang 'tshol rjes spyod pa'o/ /bzhi pa chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pa'o/ /dang po 'khon lan ldon pa'i sprod pa'o/ /bdag las sgom pas sdug pasngal cig byung tshe/1bdag gi yid la dran cing 'di snyam sems/ /bdag sngon thog ma med pa'i bskal pa nas/ /yang dag pa yi ngo bo nyid spangs te/ /phyi yul 'brangs nas srid pa sna tshogs 'khyams/ /'khor zhing sdang ba mang du byung bas na/ /zhe 'gras brdung 'tshog gnod pa grangs med pas/ /che 'dir gnod pa nyes pa ma byas kyang / /snga ma'i las ngan sdug bsngal tshe 'dir smin/ /lhas ma byas shing 66

mis ma byas pa yin/ /rang gi las la gyur pas 'khang du med/ /bzod cing ma 'khang duḥkha dang du blang / /brdeg pa la ni brdeg cing mi khro'o/ /sdug bsngal dang phrad phyo ngan mi byed pa/ /rang sems 'di ltar byung ba'i don mi 'gal/ /gnyis pa rkyen gyi rjes su spyod pa ni/ /sems can bdag med kun kyang las rkyen zhagyur/ /sdug bsngal bde ba blangs kun rkyen las skyes/ /mngon mtho 'bras bu longs spyod la sogs kun/ /thob dang stor ba dga' mi dga' ni med/ /chos den mthun te rkyen gyi rjes su spyod/ /gsum pa ci yang 'tshol rjes spyod pa'o/ /'jig rten mi rnams rgyun par bde ba bsgrub/ /sdug bsngalagabasgrub pa ci yang med lags mod/ /bde ba bsgrubs pas sdug bsngal song ba yin/ /lus shig yod na kun la'ang sdug bsngal yod/ /su yang bde ba thob pa ci yang med/ /sems can bde bar gnas na byar med bde/ /yod do cog gi 'du shes zhi ba yin/ /bzhi pa chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pa ni/ /chos la sems can dri ma dang bral ba/ /ye shes spyan gyis don rtogs yid ches na/ /khang bzang nang du longs spyod gnas mi bya/ /gos bzang zas zhim nor ches nyon mongs so/ /dper na sngags sman yongs su zin pa'i dug khong du 'thungs kyang 'chi bar mi nus so/ /de bzhin thabs shes mkhas pas yoras su zin/ /nyon mongs pa la spyad kyang spyo na med do/ /lcags kyi ga ru chung yang chu nang 'bying //sgod du byas na chen po'ang kha ru 'phyo/ /snying rje ldan zhing byams sems brtan pa'i phyir/ /sems dge ba la tes pa med par bshad/ /ston mun cig car pa 'jug pa'i skabs te bcu gsum pa'o// //162

bod kyi sde pa lta ba dbu ma dang spyod pa yod sgra/) /sna 35sa skabs/de nas bod kyi btsad po'i bka' lung la/ /nga yi ban+de thams cad sems blta thabs1she /rnal 'byor dbu ma'i gzhung du blta bar bya/ /lus ngag ༷sdom pa so sor thar/pa ste/ /rigs ni rnam par bdun nam brgyad brten nas/ /thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde gzhung spyod/ /ston mun cig car 'jug pa dbu ma yin/ /sa ni dang po dang ni gnyis pa 'thob1 /sa ni gsum pa banyi pa'i spyod yul du/ /gsang sngags kri ya dang ni u pa bstan/ /sa ni lnga pa'i spyod yul wa ga bstan/ /sa drug spyod yul ma hā yo ga'o/ /sa bdun spyod yul a nu yo ga bstan/ /sa brgyad pa la a ti yo ga bstan/ /sa dgu pa la spri ti yo ga pastan/ /sa bcu pa la yang ti yo ga bstan/ /bcu gcig kun tu 'od la mtha' chen bstan/ /lo tsā'i mtshog gyur be ro tsa na yin/ /nyan thos bye brag pa yi spyo dbang po/ /bstan bcos bshad mdzod bye brag chen mo yin/ /rgya dpe bod chongs pod skad shog bcu bsgyur/ /sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa 'bum lnga la/ /byams zhus rtag sdud bam dgus 'bum ma longs/ /lang dkar gshegs pa bam po bco lnga bsgyur/ /'di la shul lhag tshib1 gcig ma lus so/ /dkon cog brtsegs pa yi ni gzhug ma tshang / /bam po sum cu rtsa lngas ma longs so/ /sangs rgyas phal po che brgya brgyad ma 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das bam po nyis brgya dang / /bcu gnyis mes tshig bod du ma 'gyur ro/ /bod kyi sde pa lta ba dbu ma dang spyod pa yod smra'i lha chos skabs te bcu bzhi pa'o/ /438

mi tshos bstan pa'i skabs/mi chos rtsa ba rnam pa dgu/ /seng ge'i khog pa dper bzhag ste/ /kong g.yas srid pa'i chags lugs gleng / /g.yon pa ste+o/'gro'i byung tshul gleng / 1tshang ra 'dzam gling sa bcad gleng / /lag g.yas rje yi gdung rabs gleng / /g.yon pa 'bangs kyi mi rabs gleng / gung mo bstan pa'i chags lugs gleng / /mjing pa rje nam mi sde gleng / /mgo bo pha ma'i cho rigs gleng / /mjug ma mtshon byed dga' ba'i glu/ /de nas mi tshos ji ltar spel pa ni/ /skye bo'i dgos 'dod 'byung ba mi chos gzhi/ /'jug pa'i sgo ni 'dod pa yon tan lnga/ /srid pa'i rang bzhin ji srid 'grub par 'gyur/ /bya ba thams cad sngon la leṭa par brtag /ma brtags bar du gang yang mi bya'o/ /pho bzo rdzu bag ya rabs pho rtsas yin/ /bkol pa mkhas na 'dzam gling rang gi mdzod/ /grags pa thams cad skyon gyi sgong bu yin/ /tshod ma zin na rang sma rang gis phab/ /'grogs pa'i mi la gzhung bzang bya ba ni/ /phyi yi rgya mtsho chen bo'i dpe dang mtshungs/ /char pas mi 'phel than pas mi bri'o/ /ngan pa'i mi ni chu bran rnams dang 'dra/ /ca co 'don cing skye 'bri byed pa yin1 /zas nor blo ma khengs pas khrims dang 'dzol/ /sngags bon 'gras na 'phral phugs bkra mi shis/ /lha glu gnyan po 'gras na 'phung nas 'gro /gnyan zar mna' zos nad mdzes mi brgyud chad1 /bsrung ba'i tshul khrims ngo tsha kheng grags bsrung / /dpa' la zungs thub dpyad pa che ba la/ /thams cad 'jigs te rang la rdzugo mi gtong / /phan gnod mi nus mi dang 'gro gas mi bya/ /mthun po khengs log rang mgo rang gis brdung / /phan gnod nus pa'i mi ni srang rdo 'dra/ /cung —463

zad tsam gyis mtho dma' nus pa yin/ khe bsgrub nyal bye longs snga zas nor gsol/ /lag ris dgra 'dul gnye d+ku+ong 'khor g.yog sten/ 1ma rabs gshib yun ring na sprod ngan 'go /rigs mi mthun kyang dam chig gcig gis bsdus/ /grogs ngan thabs kyis spangs na gang bsams 'grub/ /gnod 'tshe las skyob mkhar khang yang thog brtsegs/ /lus 'tsho byed par zas gos bod 'brog bsten/ /bde bar byed pa rga cha nad dang mtshon/ /ma rungs 'dul ba gros dang 'dun ma 'ardos/ /'bangs la yongs su bzung ba bcu bdun bkol//bdag gces pha ma bu tsha chung ma gong / /bran pho bran mo las byed zho shas 'tsho//mdza' bshes nye du blon po snag gnyen mtshams/ /zhing 'dzin khyim 'dzin zong dgram dngos po bsag bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po las 'phags sbyor/ /longs spyod yo byad bcu bzhis spyi tshis bya/ /zas byen skom blud gos bskon bzhon pa bsten1 /rgyan dang glu bro bzhad gad rol mo sgog /sgos 'bul me tog phreng chab byug pa byugs/ /sgod spyad snang ba pho mo dga' mgur spyod/ /sgom pa'i gtsug lag thams cad mkhas par slob/ /ci la yang ni ran tshod zin par bya/ /ma brtags mi la rtogs 'dod mi smra'o/ /mthon por mig blta gong ma'i rjes su snyeg /pha ma'i drin lan lan gyes blan pa dang / /pho rdu pha tshan nang du shong yangs che/ /rgan rabs rnams la rim gyis bkur sti bya/ khyim mtshes phan tshun mi 'thab byams par bya/ /sha dag dga' ba shes pas phan gdags slob/ /srid gnyen 'dun la za chu gang byung sbyin/ /stogs pa'i mi ni drin gyes skyabs 'og gzhug /rgyal khams yongs kun grong bzhin bde bar bya/ /las 'bras rnam par smin la 'dzem pa dang / /yangs pa'i don gyis gzhi bzung mi chos yin/ /mi chos byang chub sems dpa' nyi zhur bshad/ /mi chos rtog pa'i lta ba rnam pa bcu/ /lus srog khe nyen mi lta blo phugs chos/ /mdo sngags 'bri 470

klog bla mchod bla ma bsten/ /blo rgya ma chung gdams pa kun las long / /mkhas par bslabs na gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /zhabs tog che na gdams pa zab rgu lon/ /yon tan yid bzhin nor bu 'dzad bya med/ /sgyu sa'i nor la 'dzad 'ong blo ma gtad/ ༷/bslab pa'i yon tan grangs mang bsam yas kyang / /'gri khrog gnyis ni yon tan gzhi ma yin/ /pha ngan bu ngan slob ngan sprang po'i rgyu/ri /mkhas pa thams cad slob pa'i dus na sdug /skyid po byas pa'i lo paṇa rgya bod med/ /'jig rten pa ni slob mi dgos te shes/ /yon tan (5khas pa'i gong na yod pa min/ /phyin log mi dge bcu spyod bu min dgra/ /༷bka' gzhung mthun par mi byed bstan pa'i sel/ /mi tshos zhing dang 'dra ba la ༷brten nas/ /lha tshos 'bras bu 'dra ba 'byung bya'i phyir/ /sngos sgor zhugs nas sdom pa blangs pa yis/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan 'thob par 'gyur//mi tshos grub pa'i tshul dgu ste/ /gsog pa la ni mi 'phya med/ /yod pa la ni si smon med/ /mi khyad nor gyis phye ba yin/ /mi gral zhugs na zas nor bsten/ /mna' ma khungs nas len pa yin/ /sgro 'dogs bcad nas dang du /blang / /bu sring skyid sar gtod pa yin/ /nges shes skyes na blo thag chod/ /bden med sgyu ma'i chos rnams la/ /bden pa bzung bas bslus pa yin/rdzogs gsum phogs gnyis mthong lugs brtag /zang cing nor gyi rdzongs zad 'ong / /lus sems gnyis po zad gyes byed/ /pha ming dpung pa'i rdzongs/che na bar snyan/ /rang ma 'pher na pha ming ngan mtshang blugs/ /sgo sto stan gye jongs che rgyud mi dkrug /lta ba ngan pas ma gos mngon du byed/ /dgyes pa'i /'dzum ldan de ni mi na mchog srog la bab kyang mi 'phangs dka' spyad nas/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis rtsol spyab byed par nus/ /'di phyi gnyis ka yod pas pho rabs yin/ /mi nag god 'brog sdogs na 'khor brwa 'khyams/ /med 471

'tshol nor bsgyur phogs ni shugs las mtha'/ /yo bsrang yid 'ong mang pos mtha' ma bskor/ /mi chos 'bras bu skye 'chi mtha' ru phyin/ /che zhing mkhas kyang kun dang spyod pa bstun/ /dkon cog mchod dang rje la bkur ba dang /dgra rnams 'dul dang srid rnams skyong ba dang / nye rogs sems bzung so nam dus su bya/ /bu 'bogs pa dang bu mo rdzong ba'o/ /mi chos kyi skabs te bco lnga pa'o// //sku gsum gyis gsungs pa chos yin pa'i skabs/skos dang chos min dzi ltar phye ba dang / zhes pas/ bka' yin phun sum tshogs pa lnga nas gleng / /ston pa gnas dang dus dang 'khor dang chos/ /bstan bcos yin na rtsis mgo lnga nas gleng / /chos brjod khungs btsun gar gtogs don du bstan/ /dgos ched su yi don du brtsams pa'o/ /lung chos yin na lung gi mtha' gzhi gleng / /mdo rgyud lo paṇa lung drangs mtha' bzhi'o/ /man ngag yin na dpe don rtags gsum gleng / /chos la mang yang sku gsum ma 'dus med/ /chos skus gsungs pa'i bskyed rdzogs gsum nas gleng / /longs skus gsungs pa'i kri yog gsum nas gleng / /sprul skus gsungs pa'i sde sgod gsum nas gleng / /sku gsum dbyer med gsungs pa'i spyi mtha' gsum/ /dang po dbang po rab kyi bskyed rdzogs gsum/ /gnyis pa dbang po 'bring gi bya spyod gsum/ /gsum pa dbang po tha ma'i nyan rang gsum/ /bzhi pa dbang po yang rab chos su bstan/ /bcom ldan 'das nyid dgung lo du la rab tu byung / /dgung lo du la nges par mngon 'tshang rgya/ /dgung lo du yi bar du chos 'khor bskor/ dgung lo du la mya ngan 'das 472

pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i mdo las su/ /nga ni lo grangs nyi shu dgu lon nas/ /dge ba gang yin 'tshol phyir rab tu byung / /sum cu so lnga la ni mngon 'tshang rgya/ 1brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bar du chos 'khor bskor/ /rtsa mchog drung du nga nyid mya ngan 'da'/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nyan thos theg pa lnga rā ṇa sīr gsungs/ /nyan pa'i 'khor ni lnga sde bzang po'o/ /cang shes ko'u dinu dang / /rta thul rlangs pa ba lang bdag ming can lnga rnams nyan thos 'khor/ /bstan pa'i chos ni dam chos 'dul ba yin/ /so thad rigs ni bdun nam brgyad du bstan/ /dge bsnyen pho mo dge tshul pho mo gnyis/ /dge slong pho mo gnyis dang bar slob ma/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa rtsa ba bzhi/ /srog gcod ma byen len dang mi tshangs/spyod/ /ngag rdzun mi dge smra ba dang bcas pa/ /phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul len pa dang / /rgyan dang byug pa glu gar phreng khri sgong / /bsnyen gnas khyim pa pho lo'i chos su bstan/ /nyan thos sum cu rtsa bdun theg pa bzhi/ /rang rgyud pa dang/sgra gcan 'dzin pa dang / /zhi ba khrod dang 'od srungs dang / sprul pa'i nyan thos rab 'byor shā ri'i bu/ /de bzhin /grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i nyan thos dab / /de bzhin mdo sde pa dang bye brag pa1 /nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad pa ru grags/ /dam chos 'dul ba yod na bstan pa yod/ /dam chos 'dukhya ba med na bstan pa med/ /rang sangs rgyas ni ma ga dha ru gsungs/ /nyan pa'i 'khor ni nyan thos mchog chen brgyad/ /shes rab can gyi mchog ni shā ri'i bu/ /rdzu 'phrul can mtshog mo dgal gyi bu/ zab mo la mos mtshog ni rab 'byor dang / /lha yi mig ldan mchog ni ma 'gags pa/ /༷mal stan bsko ba'i mchog ni gyad nor bu/ khyim bdag dad pa/skyes mchog 'char ka dang / /mang du thos pa'i mchog ni kun dga' bo/ /bslab pa la kus rnamachog ni sgra gcan 'dzin/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog 473

chos/ /byang sems theg pa nā ladī ru gsungs/ /nyan pa'i 'khor ni spyan ras gzigs dang byams/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam grol sde rnams yin/ bstan pa'i tshos ni rgyas 'bring rnam gsum yin/ /shes snyeng yi ge gcig ma yanagachad yin/ /rang don la ni ma bstos tshad med bzhi/ /byams pa lnga dang snying rje lnga dang ni/ 1dga' ba lnga dang btang stoms lnga po la/ /bye nang gsang ba rdo rje lta bu'o/ /bsdus pas brgya dang nyi shu sems bskyed yin/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu ru ma 'dus med/ /sku gsum dbyer med gsungs pa kun tu 'chang / / gang zag dbang po yang rab phul phyin chos/ /sgor bu rin cen 'dra de bshad par phongs/ /skal par mi ldan rnams la 'byams kyis dogs/ /'byams na mkha' 'gro rnams kyis chad pa 'ong / /su dga' la bshad bla ma'i thugs kyang 'khrugs/ /rang gi sgo gsum nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /dbang gi mtshan nyid spri nang gsang ba gsum/ /lus ni smin par byed pa phyi yi dbang / /bskyed pa ma hā yo ga bum pa'i dbang / /rdzas ni lnga lnga nyer lnga sku rdo rjer/ /ma rig rig pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i lam/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga yis bsgrub gzhi gzung / /rdo rje slob dpon chas brgyad dbang chas bcu/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad rnyed dka' 'jig sla bstan/ /sdig bcu byas pa'i stos dmigs ngan song gsum/ /dge bcu byas pa'i phan yon mtho ris gsum/ /sprib pa bcu sbyangs tshogs gnyis bsog la 'bad/ /gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags/ /thun mong skyabs 'gro rtsa ba bzhi sbyin lam/ /theg chen byang chub mchog tu gems bskyed nas/ /bla slob dkyil 'khor 'jug cing mig ras dgab/ /mig phye dkyil 'khor bstan la bsgom/ /gal ni gsang mtshan 'doṭa pa che/ /thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga gsang/ /phyi bum phan pa'i dbang bcu bskur/ /thu/bstan phyag rgya gnyis su med par bskur/ /lha dbang ye shes lha 474

dbang sku gsung thugs/ /phan gnod las kyi phyag rgyas bka' song nas/ /ji4 ltar zhus pa'i dbang bskur dam tshig dbab/ /me tog gar shog lha yin der mnga' gsol/ /dpal gyi chas brgyad dur khrod/chas brgyad dang / /rus ba'i rgyan drug chas kyis mnga' gsol lo/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad mjug bsdu'i mnga' gsol lo/ /yar drangs dbu la gdugs kyis mnga' gsol lo/ /ljags la pad+mas mnga' gsol lo/ /tshems la dung gis mnga' gsol lo/ /mgul la bum pas mnga' gsol lo/ /thugs la dbal be'us mnga' gsol lo/ 1phyag zhabs 'khor los mnga' gsole lo/ /sku la rgyal mtshan mnga' gsol lo/ /sa brgyad non te skal bar sa brgyad ldan/ /dge bsnyen nyid 'gyur bcu gnyis 'bras bu thob/ /gnyis pa dag smin byed pa nang gi dbang / /lung a nu yo ga gsang ba'i dbang / /byang sems gsung dbang rgyal ba'i gsung rdo rje/ /rnam rtog nad sel bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog /'dir ni shes rab ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang / /yo byad rnam pa gnyis kyi bsgrub gzhi gzung / /bka' rgyud lung dang mthun pa'i dbang bskur te/ /gsang ba'i dbang gi chas lnga la brten nas//spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig bshad/ /bdud rtsi dang ni gnyis su med par bskur/ /phan yon tshe 'dir 'byor pa ldan par 'gyur/ /phyi mar ye shes mtshog gi sa bon las/ /sems dbang la ni nga/nge 'dzin zhis bya/ /chos la dpang ba shes rab ye shes ste/ /sems chos 'dres pa shes rab mtshog ces bya/ /gsang ba'i dbang zhes bya ba ni/ /sangs rgyas shā+ogs nas mi 'tshol bas/ /gsang ba'i dbang zhes bya ba'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang gi ngo bo byang chub sems//nges chigo phyi nang gsang ba'i chos rnams la/ /dbang byar yod pas dbang zhes thu ba ste/ /dam chig gtsarnga dang spyod pa sa dgu non/ /dge tshul nyid du bcu gsum pa yi sa/ /yi ge 'khor lo tshogs chen yon tan thob/ /gsum pa 475

/sems smigo shes rab ye shes dbang / /rdzogs pa a ti yo ga phyi nang gsang / /ga'abebs dzog thugs dbang rgyal ba'i thugs/rdo rje/ /gzung 'dzin bag chags dogs pa med/ /bde stong ye shes chos nyid mkha'/ /bad dab rad bzhin bdag nyid chen po gsum/ /shes rab dbang bskur thabs ni chos gsum ston/ 1'dod chags dag pa dge slong mchog /dam tshig dngos/spyod sa ni pacu/pa non/ bcu bzhi bde ba chen po thob/ /bzhi pa rang rig rtsal gyi dbang / /yid ches rnam pa bcu 'byung ste/ /sdom pa bslab pa dam tshig gsum/ /skyon la dngos gzhi med par yid ches so/ /gnyis med rtogs pa'i skad cig la/ /mul sems gnyis su med par yid ches so/ /'khor ba ma spangs rang sad grol/ /sangs rgyas logs na med par yid ches so/ /myang 'das ma bsgrubs lhun gyis grub/ /ye shes rgyun du 'char bad yid ches so/ /'khor 'das rang grol gnyug ma'i ngang / /rang bzhin 'gags pa med par yid ches so/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku/ /'pho 'gyur nyam mi nga bar yid d+mes so/ /gzhi —bde lam bde 'bras bu bde/ /'chi 'pho'i 'jigs pa bral bar yid ches so/ /bde ba las ni bde ba 'byung / /lhung gol g.yang ba med par yid ches so/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas rdo rje 'chang / /rigs drug sdug bsngal rang las byung bar yid ches so/ /snang ba thams cad chos sku'i 'od/ /bag chags gol sa med par yid ches so/ /dbang bskur byas nas ci byed na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par byed/ /'jig rten bde ba mi bsgrub bo/ /'das pa'i bde /ba bsgrub dgos la/ /nyan rang dag gis mi chog na/ /byang chub sems dpas ci mi chog chos sgrib nyon sprib bag la nyal/ /shes sgrib yod pas dbang dgos so/ /bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa non 'gyur/ /bskol pa ma chags / d+ma can dang ldan/ /de dag kun gyi chos kyi gzhi ma ni/ /dam/nig yin par 47kyi

kun tu bzang pos gsungs/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dag la/ /rmi lam ngan pa thams cad rmi/ /mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad 'byung / 1ltas ngan thams cad 'byung ba yin/ /lo kag zla kag zhag gi kag /dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i zhags pa thams cad gdengs/ /gdon bgegs che rgu thams cad gnod1 /bkra mi shis pa thams cad 'byung / /rnam par gzheng ba thams cad 'du/ /rims kyi nad rigs thams cad 'go klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams gnod/ /rgyal po me chu chom rkun dug /'jigs pa bcu drug tshe 'dir 'byung / /gzhan las dam nyams slob mar min/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dag dang / /yul lung gcig tu mi bsdad cing / /chu yang gcig la mi 'thung ngo / /rdzogs pa chen po'i chos lugs bzhi/ /rgyal po'i chos lugs dang ni gcig 1'phags pa'i chos lugs dang ni gnyis/ /rgyal mo'i chos lugs dang ni gsus/ /bram ze'i chos lugs dang ni bzhi/ /dang po'i rgyal po'i chos lugs ni/ / dpal chen phyag na rdo rje yis/ /dga' ba bzhi yi dbang bzhi bskur/ /gol sa glang po sun 'byen rgyud/ /rgyal po dza yis skyos bzhir bshad/ /rgyal po/lta ba la zla'i rgyud/ /dza yis in+d+ra bhū tir bshad/ /dkyil 'khor lam la sa bcu drug /de nas rim par brgyud pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'phags pa'i tshos lugs ni/ /phyag rdor rlung bcu'i man ngag la brten nas/ /glong dgu bam po nyi khri chig stong rnams/ /slob dpon klu sgrub la ni bshad/ /de nas rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gros sbas/ /gsum pa rgyal mo'i chos lugs ni/ /rtsa ba'i man mag la brten nas/ /rgyal mo 'da' so ro 'da' la ni bshad/ /bzhi pa bram ze'i chos khyags ni/ /bram ze theg pa shan 'byed rgyud/ /srog gi dbang po'i man ngag la brten nas/ /bram ze a ba dhu tī pa la bshad/ /de nas rim par brgyud pa'o/ /dpal chen phyag na rdo rje yis/ /u rgyan yul du 477

byon nas su/ /rdo rje phag pho la ni gnang / /des yul kha che na ro pa/ /de salas bzhi ru gyes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bzhi ga babs/ / rtsa rgyud kun byed rgyal po la/ /bshad pa'i rgyud ni mdo 'grel bcu/ /snga 'gyur lnga dang sems smad bcu gsum pa/ /bshad pa'i rgyud la mdo 'grel lnga/ /rgyud pa phyi pa la ni gnyis/ /ma tshang kha skong rgyud bye pa/ /zhus pa lan 'debs rgyud phyi pa/ /ma tshang kha skong phyi pa ni/ /sbas zab rdo rje mdud rtsa'i rgyud/ /zhus pa lan 'debs phyi pa ni/ /nya mo bag la nyal gyi rgyud/ /spyi ti che chung gnyis su yod/ /bskal pa dum bu'i rgyud la ni/ /rgyud kyi yig smad sum cu gsum/ /lung gi yig smad sum cu lnga/ /man ngag yig smad bco brgyad do/ /lta ba phyogs ris med pa dang 1 /spro bsdu med pa'i don dgos pas/ /lta ba khyung chen lding ba ni/ /gdams ngag bdun cu rtsa brgyad ston/ /blang dor med pa la dor dgos/ /rmad byung che chung gsum du bsnan/ /don nyams blang ba bsgom dgos pas/ /byang chub sems bsgom bstan pa yin/ /shes bya'i byung sa gdams dgos pas/ /rtsal chen sprugs pa bstan pa yin/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag bco lnga ston/ /de rnams dus mtshams sbyar dgos pas/ /rig pa'i khu byug bstan pa yin/ /sgom pa'i gdams ngag bcu gnyis ston/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan rtser 'don pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che/ /man ngag gze ru brgya dang brgyad cu gnyis/ /rtse mo byung rgyal man ngag mi 'dra ba/ /dgu bcu rtsa drug dag ni ston pa yin/ /'khor 'das chos kun byang chub sems su 'dus/ /byang sems kun 'dus bstan pa yin/ /don thog man ngag dbab dgos pas/ /byang sems sa gcig pa ni bstan/ /nam mkha' lta bur ston 0dgos pas/ /ye shes nam mkha'i rgyal po bstan/ /gdams ngag bdun cu rtsa 2gcig 'chad/ /ye shes rgyun chad 'pho 'gyur med/ /byang sems srog gi 'khor 478

lo ni/ /byang sems bde 'byams bstan pa yin/ /gdams ngag ti zhu rtsa bdun ston/ /rig phyogs ma 'gags don ston pas/ /byang sems myu gu bstan pa sten/ byang sems don 'dus ston dgos pas/ /gdams ngag bco lngas gtan la dbab/ /rdzogs pa spri gcod bstan pa yin/ /byang sems rin chen lta bu la/ /theg pa rim dgu'i phras brgyan pas/ /bde ba phra bkong bstan pa yin/ /byang chus sems chos kun 'das pas/ /spri chings sngags kyi rgyal po bstan/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag nyi shu rtsa gnyis ston/ /sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin gsal bas/ /yid bzhin sgon ma 'bar pa bstan/ /sgom pa'i man ngag ba cu drug bstan/ /byang sems chos kyi rten gzhir gyur/ /bdag nyid ji ltar gyur pa'i phyir/ /rje btsun sngags kyi rgyal po bstan/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag bcu yis ston/ /rdzogs chen sems smad bco brgyad la/ /sgom khrid bdun brgya bdun cu bdun/ /gsang rgya'i gshags 'byed yin pa'o/ /rdzogs pa chen po 'gyur bzhi ni/ /nam mkha' che dang rigs khu byug khyung chen lding dang rtsal chen sprugs/ /byang chub sems sgom dang ni lnga/ /snga 'gyur lnga ru grags pa yin/ /be+e ro tsa nas mdzad pa'i chos/ /them yig brtsa brgyad mdzad pa yin/ /rtsa ba'i phyi 'gyur rtse mo byung rgyal dang / /nam mkha'i rgyal po bde ba phra bkod dang / /rdzogs pa spri gcod rin chen kun 'dus dang / /srog gi 'khor lo byang chub sems tig dang / /bde 'byams dang ni srid pa spyi chings dang / /rje btsun dam pa yid bzhin nor bu dang / /thig le pong yangs rdo la gser zhun te/ /phyi 'gyur bcu gsum dag tu grags pa yin/ /gcig/ tu gril bas sems smad bco brgyad grags/ /bar bar bco brgyad snying tirga lugs gsum mo/ /yang 'gyur nyi shu bka' gter gnyis su grags/ /spyi btus rdzogs pa chen po skor lnga 479

chabasdus/ /phyi skorardonang skor gsab skor bla med skor/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i skor dang lnga las med/ /de rnams la ni bshad gzhung mang lags kyang / /rgya gar bshad gzhung bdun dang ni/ /bod kyi bshad gzhung gcig ste brgyad/ /dang po lta ba klong sdebs pashad pa ni/ /mtshon dpe nam mkha' la bzhag ༷nas/ /rgya gar mkhan po gsal rgyal gyis/ /rdzogs pa chen po rin po che/ /gser 'dril gser phreng bod du bsgyur/ /bka' babs 'phags pa shes rab sabo/ /gnyis pa dgongs pa klong sdebs bshad/ /mtshon datha nyi mar bzhag nas su/ 1rgya gar mkhan po shrī sidha'i/ /rin cen klong phreng bod du bsgyur/ /༷bka' babs gnyags kyi ku mā ra/ /gsum pa gab pa 'khrugs sdebs bshad/ /shamatshon dpe rat+na spungs la bzhag /rgya gar mkhan po ba shi ta'i/ /rdzogs chen rin chen gsang rgya'i skor/ /bod du bsgyur ba'i bka' babs pa/ /zhang sgom dz+nyā na shes rab bo/ /bzhi pa rgyal thabs spyi blugs bshad/ /mtshon dpe rin cen gsal bkram bzhag /mkhan po budhe gusta yi/ /rdzogs chen yongs rnams rig pa yi/ /nyi ma za 'og ber khyim bsgyur/ /bka' babs ye shes dbang phyug rga /rdzogs chen sgang sgril du ni 'dod/ /lnga pa ma 'dres yongs bshad ༷pa/ /mtshon dpe nam langs lta bu bzhag /shrī sidha'i 'grel chung lcags 'grel gnyis/ /mkhan po drang srong ba shi ta/ /bod bsgyur bka' babs skor thung shes rab ye/ /drug pa bshad gzhung so drug bshad/ /mtshon dpe rgya mtsho'i chu bran gyes/ /dzogs chen 'dod gzhung bzhi ru 'dus/ /la zlo shan 'byed gol sgrib bdar sha bcad/ /bod bsgyur bka' babs sangs rgyas ye shes so/ /bdun pa rgya bzhi kha sgod bshad/ /mtshon dpe yid bzhin nor bu che/ /dzogs chen rgya bzhi kha sprod ni/ /rgya gar mkhan po shrī ba le dha ra tsije ma ṇi/ //de la phyi yi rtsis rgya'i skor/ /lta ba la zlo theg shan zhabyed/ /gol sgrib bdar 480

sha gcod thabs so/ //gzer bu bdun brgya bdun cu bdun/ /ston chen rnams kyi chos gin no/ /nang ltar gsang rgya'i skor la ni/ /sems ni ma zin zin par ༷byed/ 1zin pa'i sems de brtan par byed/ /brtan pa bogs ni 'don par byed/ /bogs ma thon na log non 'don/ /degra che bying rgod gnas gsum 'azoms/ /mjug nyu chos nyid na bu sprod/ /de la sgom khrid mi 'dra ba/ /bdun brgya bdun cu rtsa bdun ston/ /sgom chen rnams kyi chos yin no/ /gsang ba rgya'u chung skor la/ /sgom gyi mkhan po ngos bzung nas/ /sgom bdag po la gtod pa'i chos/ /de la la zlo mi 'dra ba/ /bdun brgya dang ni bdun cu yod1 /gsang rgya la zlo ba la gtad/ /man ngag gtad rgya'i skor la ni/ /bsgoms kyang skyon med rang byung ye shes rol/ /ma bsgoms skyon med mtshan ma ed/ /mdor na bsgoms dang ma bsgoms gnyis/ /gnyis su med pa'i chos bya yin/ /de la dgos pa mi 'dra ba/ /brgya dang drug cu yod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor chos su gtad pa yin/ 1sgo dang sgo lcags sde mig tshul/ /mtshon dpe phyug po'i bang mdzod yin/ /mkhan bo me tog byang 'bar gyis/ /shes rab rtsal gyis sgo nas mdzad/ /rdzogs chen lde mig skor des ni/ /gsang sngags babs bdun 'chad tshul bzhi/ /yongs thu rdzogs pa'i skor dang lnga'o/ /shākya thub pas srin po'i yul/ /pu ri gsum du gsungs pa'i chos/ /zo mo pu ri khrug gi mtsho/ /rgyal mo pu ri'i mtsho dang ni/ /shar na lang ka pu ri'i mtsho'o// bram ze'i rgyud lnga bam po dgu dgu yod/ /rmad du byung ba drug la bcu gcig go /man ngag rgya mtsho khrong la bam po gcig /jogs chen bla na med par khas 'che la/ /ston btsan bsam gtan tsam la rten 'cha' ba/ /rgya' po'i sras dmangs babs pa'i lung dang 'gal/ /dmangs kyis rgyal po'i bya las mi 'pher ro/ /rang gi lta ba 'khrul pas dzogs chen snang / /dper na gang zhig 'gro4481

ba'i mig la sha/ /ad ra tsha ga'i rim gyis bskyod/ /gzugs brnyan mab po tha dad snang ba 'dra/ /mi bdes rmongs pa3la ni kun rdzob baspu/ /de dag blo 'khrul chos nyid rjese su 'brang / khong rtsol thams cad gaspyon po rdzogos chen yin/ /lnga par mis mthong mngon sum tshad ma ru/ /be go mi du bod du 'da' tshul bstan/ /rgyanagar yul na ma 'das bzhugs pa dang / /pad+ma 'byung gnas srin po 'dul du bzhud/ /de sogs rgya gar mkhas pa/grangs med na1 /mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams su yang ni /grangs med pa gcig rig pa 'dzin du gshegs/ /jo bo zhang drung thub/sa dam lha skal yol/ shelo tsā rin chen mchog ni bar snang gshegs/ /ngan lam rgyal mchog rte skad dngos grub brnyes//nam mkha'i snye nga po mkha' 'gro mas bsus gshegs/ /mkhan po snyan chego dpal dbyangs mkha' 'gros bsus/ /dga' ldan lha yi ston par gshegs pa yin/ /de la sogs pa bod na grangs med do/ /phyis kyang 'byon par bka' lung man ngag gsungs/ /gdud 'tshob skyes bu 'ga' ni byung srid na/ /shin tu the tshom za bar mi bya'o/ /des na tshe gcig 'khor ba zad par byed/ /slob chadapon be+e ro tsa na'i zhal nas su/ /yang dag nges pa'i zhal ston bla ma bye bor khur/ /de yis bstan pa'i man ngag snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /rnal 'byor lta ༷kham ma chung spyod pa kham ma che/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs kyang mdzad spyod mi dang bstun/ /dge sbyor tshogs lam mi 'gegs kun dang mthun par sgod/ /rtogs pa shugs las 'char gyi snyeng rje gtong phod bskyed/ /theg dgu rang sar bden gyi theg pa'i kha ma 'dzin/ /don dam lta phugs gcig gi chos la phyogs ris bskyangs / /rang rgyud thos pas grol gyes chos la ngoms ma skyen/ /ma bden don dang 'gal na rgyal ba'i bka' yang zhog bden cing 'thad na legs dpyad byis pa'i tshig kyang nyon/ /yid ches gdeng chen rang la yod kyang 482

kun la dris1 1rang nyams zab mo mu cor mi smra kun la gsang / /bdag gis gzhan skyon ma brtag/rang gi skyorna/tha girtagu ༷ /sergos can shogardopa tha dad gang la maskur mi gdab/ /mkhas pa phul du gyur kyang nga rgyal khengs grags bskyungs/ /chose rtod gozherna gos ma 'a tsho la rnam par rtog la stos/ /rnam rtog mthong rgyu med sha skyos nyid dongayitha mthong / /bde bo dang du ma leno sdug batshul skung du me da//sduge pesngal range sar pe la/na de nyid bde ba yin/ rngo /tshig gi rtsa ba/ ma gcod ༷don gyi rtsa ba chod/ /chirga gi tso ba bcad na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /don gyi rtsa ba tshod na tshig mtha' de yis chod/ /tshos kyi rtsa ba ma gcod sems kyi rte po chod/ /sems kyi rte ba chod na chos kyi bdag po yin/ /sangs rgyas /med kyija ske 'tshol sems kyi mtshan nyid rtogs/ /zhes gathungs so/ /mu steṭa bod na gzhung btsugs sa med de/ /bston pa'i dgrar gyu ra pa la mu stegs zer/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar dong rdub tha ni/ /dge 'dun sngags pa kun la brtsis pa yin/ /sngags pa rdal che gsang sngages dar ba yin/ /dge 'dun rdal che sde snyedad gsum po dar/ /gnyis ka rdal che mdo sngags gnyis ka dar1 /dge 'dun khrims kyi spyod yim shin tu dog nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems gathum du 'du/ /lta ba dbu ma spyod pa yode smra'i sde/ /gsang sngags pa rdi phyo+ob rgyud spyod lam yangs/ /lta ba rdzogs chen spyod pa ma hā yin1 /phun thum tshoṭa pa lnga yis bsgrub gzhi bzung / 1sgrub khang sgrub rjas kha yi lta phyogs rnams/ /'di 'dre 'di bzhir 'di ltar dgos bya darnga / /nyi na nyin gci ga thun chag na/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi bka' chad 'ong / khe nyen shin tu che ba yin/ kha bshade rkyang pas mi 'ong ngo / /mi tshe sgrub pa la bskyal nas/ /bya rgyu gzhan yid pa zhig dgos/ /sku gsum gyis gsungs pa chos yin pa'i skabs te bcu jug ba'o// //4 83

chosi dang chos min phye ba'i skabs/—chos ltar bcos pa chos ma yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bdud kyis 'jig /bdud kyi las ni gang zhe na/ / 'dod lha sdig can ces bya ba/ /chung ma pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / /'khor ni 'jig rten skyong ba dab / /bstan gnyis chos la dgrar gyur pa/ /byang chub gegs byed 'dre yi chos/ /rgyal ba'i bka' yis ma gnang ba'o/ /'phags pa'i lung gis ma grub pa'o/ /rigs pa 'dzini mi 'thad pa'o/ /gtan tshigs kyis rgyas ma thebs pa'o/ /rtsom pa tshad ldan ma brtsams chos/ /smon lam ma dag tshogs ma bsags/ /shes rab ma 'phel dkon cog srungs/ /las dang rgyu 'bras yid ma ches/ /nor dang rdzas dang zas la chags/ /'dod pa la 'dun gnod sems dang / /gnyid rmugs rgod stong the tshom za/ /bdud 'di chos par cis kyang brdzu/ /bdud do ma shes lcags kyus bzung / khyim gyi btson ra zab mor bcug 'khor ni 'jig rten skyong ba brgya/ /'thab par byed dang rtsod par byed/ /g.yeng bar byed dang chags par byed/ /'du shes log par byed pa dang / /grims par baspung dang sred pa 'ching / /dam por bsdams pas bya thabs med/ /de dag la ni 'dod pa'i lha/ /chung ma dang bcas spyi bo na/ /me tog mda' lnga yod pa ni/ /dregs par byed pa 'dod chags mda'/ /rmongs par byed pa zhe sdang mda'/ 1kun tu rmongs byed gti mug mda'/ /brgyal ra byed pa nga rgyal mda'/ /sems med byed pa phrag dog mda'/ /de yi me tog bsdur pa dang / /de 'a phog pas nyon mongs lnga/ /gang shas che ba de kho na/ /rab tu 'bar bar 'khrul nas su/ /ma zhi ba de'i dbang song bas/ /'dzam bu gling 'di nyams par 434

'atsur1 /'jig rten skyong brgyad las mtha' dang / /dang po 'thab byed bdud ༷po mo/ la wa mngon sum la la brgyud/ /la la 'jam po la la rtsub/ /ci nas ༷kyang ni sems bsgyur ro/ /glu rigs ma rungs pa rnams bskul/ /lha ma yin rnarmes skul bar byed/ /mi chos ldan pa'i srog 'phrog go /gnyis pa rtsod par byed pa ni/ /gnas brtan phal cher bdud dbang gyur/ /dgi sbyong gnas dgon rnams dang ni/ /tshul spangs khyim pa rnams dang ni/ /rgyal po dang ni /rgyal phran dang / /blon po dang ni blon phran rnams/ /rtsol ba mi bzod phu/phyor rtsol/ /nyon mongs 'bar cing des rkyen byas/ /gsum pa g.yeng bar byed pa sani/ /log pa'i sems 'bar g.yeng rkyen mang / /bsdu na 'grel pa rnams pa /bdun/ /yongs su grags dang bstod pa dang / /rnyed pā/dang ni bkur sti dang / /bsod nams dang ni mnga' thang 'dul/ /tshong dngakeso nam bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa chags par byed pa ni/ /ngan len nyon mongs lnga po de/ /gcig zhi tsa na gcig rgyas nas/ /bde gshegs sku gzugs rnams kyang 'jig /drang srong ngur sprig rnams kyang babreg /lag na gsod pa'i mtshon cha thogs/ /resi 'ga' chos la yon tan brjod/ /res 'ga' chos la smod par byed/ /bdud kyi rig byed mi 'dra ba/ /rtag tu khro ba che bar bshad1 /lnga pa 'du shes log byed ni/ /bdud rigs yi dwags dang bcas yin1 /klu rigs gyur ༷pa rnams kyi rje/ /klu ni mal gro gzi can yin/ /se 'phang nag po zhes kyang bya/ /srog dkar rgyal po zhes kyang bya/ mi yi lus la sbrubashamago bdun/ /sku ༷mdog nag po smad sbrul 'khyil/ /srog snying dus skyong ci tig ci ti 'ong 1 /de —yi 'og ma tshong dpon nag po yin/ /dkar bo sbrul mgo lnga pa g.yas ru 'dren/ /de 'og khams kyi bya thul yin/ 1mi lus ser po sbul mgo gnyis/ /༷g.yon gyi ru ni 'dren pa'o/ /gang gi gcung po spa gro skyer chu'i lha/ ṣa rgyal 485

zhwa 'od ser po glang mgo can/ /sdun gyi bshul ni sel ba yin/ /de yi 'khor na gdug pa can bzhi gnas/ /mthong ba'i dug can mi lus sbyol mgo can/ /bsam pa'i dug can mi lus rta mgo can/ kha rlang dug can mi lus khyi mgo can/ /reg pa'i dug can mi lus rgya mgo can/ /klu gnyan sa bdag mang po slod rjes myul/ /mal gro gzi can g.yas g.yon gnyis/ /bud med sngon mo g.yu yi thor rtsog gnyis/ /de gnyis mal gro'i btsun mo yin/lha /tshal nag spyo ni sbrul nag gcigego /rgyang bu tshal klu khye'u chung zur phud can/ /nag po klong brdol klu nag skur me 'bar/ /lu ma nag po'i glu rtags sngon mo mi mgo can/ /zangs gri mtsho dmar klu ni glang dmar po/ /sprul dang sbal pa la sogs pa/ /sa bdag gzugs rnams thams cad bya/ kham sa'i glang po shin tu che par bya/ /dbu su mal gro pa nas rim par bzung / gzhan tsho phyogs dang kha dog bstun la gzugs/ /gser dngul la sogs rin po che/ /rdzas dang rtsi shing sna tshogs dang / /dkar gtor chu gtor dkar gsum mngar gsum blugs/ /zhar la mal gro 'khor dang bcas pa mchod/ /klu kha bsgyur dang gyer gzhan shes par bya/ /lus la nad rigs sna tshogs gtong ba dang / /lha 'dre'i khengs log 'jigs pa bcu/drug g.yo/ /dus ni rtsi thog mang po'i dus byas bzlog /drug pa grims par/bsrung ba ni/ /bdud rigs yi dwags sum cu rtsa drug la/ /'di dag rnams ni rigs gcig bgrangs pa yin/ nag po'i rtsa lag/rgyas par lta ci smos/ /gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi rnams/ 1bye byel nang na/mchod pa med/ /sdig pa'i gnas bcur 'gyur bas te/ /chang 'tshong gnas dang bshan pa'i gnas/ /smad 'tshong gnas dang rngon pa'i gnas//nya ba'i gnas dang khu mkhan gnas/ /dug mi gnas dang smyug ma mkhan/ kha tshang gnas dang chom rkun gnas/ /sangs rgyas dus chen bzhi yi dus/ /chang 86

btsos tshag/po bshas gnas su1 1btsas mi yul mi thams cad bsags/ / chos min dge log spang bya'o/ /bdun pa sred pa 'ching ba ni/ /rab tu byung ba'i phyogs sun 'byin/ /'khrig pa bza' ba btung ba dang / /'drid pa sdig par gzung bar bya/ /sangag rgyas sku ni mtshan dpes spus pa yang / /'jigs pa bskyed pa bdud yin spang bar bya/ /brgyad pa dam por bsdams pa ni/ /'khor ba'i 'dam tshogs bying ba rnams/ /bstan pa nyid la spyi khyab che ba chos//bstan pa 'dzin skyong dusrung dang gsum du 'dus/ /dkris snang yongs grags/ltar du ma yin pas/ /grags pa ngan pas phog na dga'/ /mi 'dod thams cad byung na dga'/ /mdze sgog tu phol byung na dga'/ /na na dga' la shi na dga'/ /cis kyang dgos med gar 'gror song / /bsod nams la sgo ma 'khang nges 'byung skyed/ 1brtan pa ma thob bar du brtson par shā/ /'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dmag dpon yin/ /sgrub pa rtse gcig brtson pa de/ 1chos dang chos min nges par phye/ /chos dang chos min phye ba'i skabs te bcu bdun pa'o// //bstan pa'i ga/ga bzhag pa'i skabs1bstan pa'i gzhi gnas zlan po'i lag ris dang / /zhes pas/ /bstan gzhi byang chub sems dpa' man chad nigs/ /sems n+d+ran kun gyi spyod/par gnas pa'o/ /dang po byon dang bar du bzhugs pa dang / /mtha' ma mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul ston sgo/ / /dad go bstan pa'i 'go btsugs dar zhing rgya ba1 /bar du bstan pa yun du gnas pa dang / 1mtha' mar bstan ba nyams te nub pa'o/ /'dzam gling mi 'gyur lnga ni mi gid de1 /rgyal/podi khrims ni mi 'gyur 467

brtan pa dang / /dam pa'i chos ni mi 'gyur brtan pa dang / /'gro ba sems can mi 'gyur brtan pa dang / /rgyal srid gdung brgyud mi 'gyur brtan pa dang / /snang srid stod bcud mi 'gyur brtan pa rnams/ /rtag pa'i chos ni mi 'dod 'jig par 'dod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mi nub bya ba'i phyir/ ( rjes ngan ma song dkon cog gsum rten btsugs/ /sangs rgyas dkon rdog rten du ni/ /sangs rgyas byon pa rgya gar yul/ /lha khang shā rā ṇa shrī ma ga dhe/ /nā ledī dang rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /bi kā ma shī la'i gasto la/ /mchod rten pad+ma 'khor lo can dang ni/ /dpal du ba med pa'i mchod rten dang / /dpal ni rig pa med pa'i mchod rten dang / /ri bo ta la o darta pū ri/ /u rgyan ste ru ka yi gtsug lag dang / /mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa dge gnas brgyad/ /mchod rten rnam dag lha las babs pa dang / /de dag kun la tshul ldan dpe blangs nas/ khru 'brug lha sa bsam yas gtsug lag khang / /rgyu bzang bkod legs byin rlabs che ba dang / /'dul ba mdo sde gsang sngags kun dang mthun/ /dbu brnyes srol gtod chos rgyal rim par phyon/ /bod yul sa gzhi thams cad mchod rten bkang / /gtsug lag khang mang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ /dam pa tshos kyi dkon cog rten du ni/ /paṇa chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad gdan drangs nas/ /lo tsā brgya dang rtsa brgyad chos bsgyur bcug /theg pa phyogs med rgya gar ma lus rtsom/ /mdo sngags bstan bcos chos kyi nyi ma shar/ /dge 'dun dkon cog rten du ni/ /sad mi mi bdun nyams sad bus/ /'bangs ni sum brgya rab tu byung / /'gyur ba med pa yod smra'i sde/ /skra gcan 'dzin pa'i rjes su 'bradas/ /dped na gnir dadul lugs su byug /thengs gcig blug pa'i rgyun sdod bzhin/ /dri med shel gong rnam dag thub pa'i bkazha/ /mdo rgyud bsnyan pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bu gcig slob ma 438

gdem bzher btsan/ ༷/tshe 'ani'i snang ga shen pa che/ /sdig rigs mi gcig zas g.yos mkhas/ /rgyal po rnams kyang mnga' 'og bsdus/ /dge sdig rgyu 'bras 'byed shes pa/ /blon 'gos khri bzang yab lhag gi /las skol lha mi'i srid baspung mdzad/ /bon 'ubangs/gobs/sha rgyal khrims bsngams 1 ) /phyi nang nyer len prod bsgyed pa/ /blon po mchi sa rgyal gzigs glu mthonge / /bzang sem sa legs pa'i yon tan spel/ /'bangs bskyangs skyid pa'i re mos song / /'jig rten na ni grags dang ldan/ /ma go ba rnams go bar bskul/ /blon po ngan lam rta ra glu gong gis/ /rnam pa dag pa bon gye kha ba zub nas/ 2 /bon 'byung bstan sha gser gyi sdong po lnga/ /rang gis phyong ba gzhan la spel ba'i blon / /mchims pa mdo bzher rdo rje spre chung gis/ /bon snubs rje la dbu g.yogs 'ong zhes gleng / /bon chos dbang khyad coms/pas/lan/ /bon ni mtha' la sgyugs pas mtha' la dar/ /'phrul rbe thabs g.yo mang ldan pa/ /blon chen lha bzang1glu dpal dmag la mkhas/ /rgya nag yul 'phung thugs nag byas nas btul/ /de ltar bka' mchid gsung la mi nyan sgo/ /shes rab gsum gyi skyon spangs blo zhib pa/ /blon po khri 'bring lha lod de nyid kyis/ /bka' mchid 'dun ma gang mtshams mtha' ru bston/ /thams cad sems 'phags bskyed pa'i tshig bzang smra/ /lce mkhas thabs/'phrug zol can blon1 /sna nam zhang dang rgya tsha lha snang gis/ /lha 'dre dpang btsugs mna' rgatho'i 'dun ma byas/ /tshe 'di'i ched du byed pa dam tshig yin/ /phyi ma mtho ris lha gnas bde skyid bzhed/ /blon po shud pu dpal gyi seng ge yis/ /gtam la gleng lugs mang yang bzhi nas gleng / /bka' dang lung dang mchid dang tshika dang bzhi/ /sems can bde byed rgyal khrims 'tsho/ /zhang gi nya bzang lo+on po dang / /mdzangs/zhaphrul/blon po 'gos kyis kyang / /'gyod pa/drug gzung mi 490

chos pogage'o chos bye da nagrar 'dzine 'du shes spangs1 nasgon chen lo ti rgugan yis/ khrisnyas bstan las ka brgyadagadu bsdug/ /blang dor dmigs pa shes pa'idi blo/ /me 'arga lha lung gzigs kyis ni/ /sing ge 'gying 'dra'i blon po la/ dad pa rgasum dab brtson ngagrus gsum / rdo ༷ /ban sngags rje 'bangs kun la bstul/ /bstan pa'i spri srol gzhi tshugs pe1 /blon po bha sang shi ta yis/ /dpyad pa'i yul la rnam pa drug/ /thos pa mthong ba shes pa gsum1 dran pa/ sems pa smra ba gsum/ /bod khams yongs kyi spyi tshigs byas/ /gnyer stob mtshene gdong rgazirga sgogo gyis/ /sku la bdo bar dmag drangs btul/ /spro snye gye la po dag rkung/spra / / phyi blon lag ris 'di las sked/ /nang shon lag/ris ca/khar dpa rdzong / /gnas skabs bde ba thob ste mnin /mthatha thug 'bras bu 'a/byin par 'gyur1 /phyi rabs slad nas 'byon pa rnams/ /bka'/bzhin/nyon/ la gagyeng bzhin sgrubs/ /blon po'i lag ris ji ltar/byas pa'i skabs/rte bcu dgu pa'o/ / / / ) ༷sa chod ga'i phan sdon ba stan pa'i skabs/ ༷ mchod pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ /sangs rgyas mtshod pa sems can bzung / /mos pa'i tshig gis smre sngags brjod/ /lus po rngul ba'i bskor ba bgye/ /gus pas pyag btsal maṇ+ḍal dbupha/ khyim pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /ches bcu la ni mtshod par bya/ /mkha' 'gro skos bzang sprin bzhin 'du/ /bdun bdun bsdebs nas gar yang byed/ /lha yi bu mo mdzes ma rnams// /mi che mi chung lang tsho ldan/ rin cen rgyan chas brgyan pa rnams/ /snyan pa'i sgra sgog bar snang khengs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ster/ /431

spus kyi metshod pa phya ga/rgya gar/ /ngag gi mchod pa dbyangs snyan sngags dang ldan/ /bstod tshig yan lag bdun pa la sogs dbyangs/ /rnga dung dril bu /cang ti'i sgra/ /'gro ba'i don du chos 'khor bskor/ /yid kyi mchod pa yid bzhin nor bu bsame1 /zur drug sngon po cung zad snye/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /gling bzhi khyab par mdun du bsam/ /mchod tshoṭa phreng ba brtsegs pa'i tshwal/ /ut+pal la sogs me tog dang / /a ka ru sogs bdug spos dang / rdorin cen la sogs snang ba dang / /ga bur la sogs dri bzang dang / /lha bshos la sogs bza' ba dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan na bza' dang / /ba dan pi wang rdza rnga sogs/ /rol mo sna tshogs pa nyid 'bul/ /rgyal srid sna bdun mchod pa nyi shu brgyad/ /so sor ma lus dbul por bya/ /rdzas rnams phun sum tshogs pa dang / gtsang mar bshams dang dad pas zin/ /rim pa ma nor genas shes dang / /chud ma gzan pes mchod la brtson/ /rgyal srid chos dang mthun pa yin/ /gson po tshe ring longs spyod che/ /gshin po rnams kyi sgrib pa 'dag /lha dang mi yi skye gnas len/ /dka par byed pa cho ga'i mchog /bdag gzhan bag chags dag par 'gyur/ /mchod pa yod na dge ba yod/ /mchod pa med na dge ba med/ /rtsa gsum rmanyes pa mchod mes mnyes/ /pha ma'i drin len mched pas 'khor/ /ci 'dra'i spus blangs longs spyod che/ /mchod pa'i phan yon gyi skabs te nyi shu pa'o// // ma mchod pa'i nyes darjegs bstan pa'i skabs/ ma mchod nyes dmigs bstan pa ni/ /lha mi 'gro kun skye bzhis bsdus//longs spyod med pas yi dwags sred/ /dper na mkha' la bya 'phur ba'i/ /4kyi2

0grib ma rjes su 'brarnga ba bzhin/ /gang zhig mchod pa 'di nyid med1 /shin tu rmongs shar gyur pa'i mi /thar pa'i lam la dgrar zhugs pas/ /mgon/dab skyabs med dgra yis khyer/ /bde 'gro/mi ca skye ba dka'/ /pan 'gror skye ba ༷nges pa'i phyir/ /mchod med ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'gyod/ /ma mchod nyes pa bsam mi khyab/ /stobs nyams 'dzud lam thur la bde/ /mi yi gnas skabs 'di min par/ /dper na yi ga bcings pa rnams/ kha zas la ni smod byedabyubazhin/ /de ni sdug bsngal de dud 'gro/ /de ni dmyal ba de yi dwags/ /bdud dang thu stegs log 'dren bgegs/ /rgyu de la ni yi rang ngam/ /til dang ri rab khyad par yin/ /mchod rnams mi ldan tha mal pa/ /'byor pa che yang dbul po yin/ /chos rnams bden med ma stogs shing / rdzu 'phrul du mar mnga' ma brnyes/ /sa gzhi la ni rag khyas bas/ /skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa chen po yod/ /rnam shes rlung la dbang ma thob/ /lam la gang phan/grogs mi 'gro/ /rten 'brel du mar dbang mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas bstan med sems can bde skyid zad/ /rgyal bo rnams ni sgyur kha yang 1 /blon po rnams ni 0gdug rtsub che/ /btsun mo rnams ni phra ma mkhan/ /dmangs mi kun gyis chos mi go /dkon cog rten btsugs 'o ri brgyal/ /kun rdzob bden pa ma bstan na/ /don dam la ni yid mi ches/ /ma mchod pa'i nyes dmigs kyi skabs te nyer gcig pa'o// //don gtan ba/phab pa'i skabs/bon rtsis sman chos gtan la phab tshul dang / /zhes pas/ /bon rnams ji ltar gtan la phab pa ni/ /sems can ngo bo sgrib pa bcu sgrib can/ /nges 493

tshig blo yi dri ma spang blang can/ /dbye ba sems can rigs byed lnga'am drug gogasdugs med yid bcas sgor zug sems can dang / /'khor bar rgyun du zhugs pa'i sems can dang / /skye ba rnam pa bzhi ldan sems can dang / /yang yang bar srid ma yi sems can dang / /bem sems ma mtshungs rtag pa'i sems can no/ /mi sogs sims can skye 'gul rtogag/mi langs/ /srid pa'i khri rgyal khuṭa kyi thugs/ /sgod pa'i phyi mo mirnga dgu sring dgu gnyis/ / dus tshod de tsam tshe lo khri pa'i dus/ /de nas ma srid dgu srid ma byung dgu byung jo / /ston pa gshen rabs mi po ni/ /de nas 'og min pho brang gnas nas ni/ /'gro ba sems cago don la byon tshul te/ /'od zer kha dog sna lnga cir yang snang bar sprul/ /'od zer rab tu sgos pas 'jig rten khams rnams khyab/ /de nas shing shol sdong gi kha la byon/ /'dab chags rgyal po g.yu bya khu byug ni/ /sku mdog be+eḍūr+ya mthing ga'i mdog chags pas/ /thams cad zil gyis non pa bya'i rkyal po/ /gsung snyan khams gsum sems can spro ba bskyed/ /rigs gsal 'gor 'das bye brag mi sgrib/pa/ /shes rab byams ma gnam gyi gung rgyal gyi/ /spyi bo'i gtsug tu babs nas gshog pa brdabs/ lan gsum sprugs pas bya de'i gsang ba nas/ /'od dkar 'tsher dang dmar la dwangs pa gnyis/ /yum gyi spyi/bo'i gtsug nas mar la thim/ /yum gyi lhums nas 'thon te gsung snyan bsgrags/ /bdi ni gzigs stangs bdun gzigs nas gshegs/ /gzigs stangs rnam pa bzhi la gzigs nas byon/ /sa gnas gang la gzigs nas byon pa dang / /yab yum gang la gzigs nas byon pa dang / /bstan pa gang la gzigs nas byon pa dang / /zhing sa gang la gzigs nas byon pa'o/ /dang po khams gagum sa dgur gzigs nas byon/ /gnyis pa tshal chen po g.yu chel du byon / /gsum pā las dag rigs btsun pa la dgongs/ /bzhi pa rigs drug 434

pa'adzam gling mi la dgongs/ /bon rgya mtsho'i mching rnam bas kyang gting ring / /༷bon gyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / /bon gyi mdzodwa mig sum brgya drug cur bsdu/ de la rgyu'i bon bzhi/ 'bras bu'i bon bzhi1 chu bo bzhi dang chu bran bzhi ste brgyad/ /dgongs pa la 'jug las ka rnam pa gsum/ /theg dgu gang gi sgo nas jejug kyang rung / /lus kyi las su phug rgya dka' ba bslab/ /ngag gi las su snying po dka' ba bslab/ /yid kyi las su ting 'dzin dka' ba bslab/ /ting nge 'dzin la yan lag 'bum du bshad/ /de las bsdus pas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis so/ /de las bsdus pas bcu drug bshad/ /de las bsdus pas lnga'o/ /de la bon gyi theg pa rim pa dgu'am bcu/ /phya gshen theg pa/snang gshen theg pa/ 'phrul gshen theg pa/ srid gshen theg pa/ dge gshen theg pa/ gshen kyi drang spong theg pa/ gshen gyi a dkar theg pa/ ye gshen theg pa/ khyan par chen po'o/ /ma khu pa'o/ /phywa gshen 'jug sgo sto rigs sul brgya brug cu dang / dpyad rigs brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jug pa'i sgo/ snang gshen gyer sgo bzhi nas 'jug skad kyi lcong dgu gar babs btsan po gsol//'phrul gshen rdzu 'phrul chen po bcu gsum dang / /thabs chen drug gis sbas gsas rngam sgom pa/ /srid gshen shi thabs sum bani drug cu dang / /'dur sgo chen po bzhi ni rma bo lha/ /dge gshen dga' ba bzhi dang dag pa gnyis/ /gnyen po gsum ste kun shes 'phrul rgyal po1 /drang srong sbad pas bcu dang samatshon pa gnyis/ /sbrangs pa gnyis deng sgrub gsum g.yung drung tshe/ /a dkar sgrub pa'i yan lag brtso brgyad dang / /gnyan po'i sgo dgu 'gi nga/las kyi lha/ /ye gshen 'jug pa rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /ting 'dzin ldan lag drug cu rtags bcu drug khyad par chen po lha gsum don dam gcig /rtsi thog ma khu ba yi ༷gdul dgu zhajug /theg bdun god gor sre gshen theg par/zhugs/ /rgyal 435

ldong gi skad du i yang zhes/ /zhang zhung dmar skad sru ya ag tham zhes/ / spur rgyal bod skad gsang ngo kha tham zhes/ /bon gnam bab rgyu 'bras mi bslu zhes/ /ston pa 'chi med gtsug phud kyis/ khu byug dgu lam nyi shu bdun du dbye1 /gshen lha 'od dkar dran pa'i rgya ru che/ /de nas bon gyi bstan pa btsugs tshul ni 1phywa gshen mo lha'i rgyal po skyes bu rir/ /ta bu sbyid ming ske yi bstan pa btsugs/ 1snang gshen sner sgrog gar gsas btsan po'i lha/ /mi bon lha bon rgyal khrims snang bas btsugs/ /'phrul gshen bstan pa sbas gsas ngom pas btsugs/ /srid gshen bstan pa 'dur gsas sba pos btsugs/ /dge gshen ye mkhyen 'phrul rgyam btsugs/ /drang srong 'dul khrims sgrog pa'i bstan pa ni/ /theg drug g.yung drung tshe yi rgyal pos btsugs/ /a dkar bstan pa gsang ba 'dus pas btsugs/ /ye gshen bstan pa g.yung drung ye dbang rgyal pos btsugs/ /theg dgu khyad par chen po sems kyi bon/ 1gshen po tshad med 'od ldan bstago pa btsugs/ /mgu gshen po tshad med 'od ldan gyis/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su dka' ba spyod cing sgom/ /yab yum 'khor bcas phung po lhag med song / /de nas bon po 'phrul gshen snang ldan gyis/ /ri rab zom la dka' ba spyod cing sgom/ /yab yum 'khor bcas phung po lhag med song / /rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i ring la nub/ /rgyal po'i chab srid de nas nyams pa lags/ /rgya bod gnyis kyi so mtshams na/ /sto ri la spang bya ba'i ri/ /mon gra he da bya ba yod/ /shing mu le grub shing sdong po ni/ /'dom pa bcu drug pa cig yod/ /de la khu byug ston 'bring gi /tshes gsum nim langs skad 'don no/ /bon gyi blon po yi stag ma hā/ /bon blon ma hā khru mi/ /bya rgyal rig pa'i khu byug de/ /lha lnga spo mthon shel gyi rdo ring khar/ /dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes pacu drug la babs /pon gtan la phab pa'i skabs bye nyer gnyis 4gyi6

mas 'o/ / / /༷rtsig gtan la phab pa'i skageg/rtsis rnams gtan la ji ltar phab pa ni/ / srid pa'i gtsug lag dngul rtadakar me long 'de/ 1mdo sngags phyogs ni gang du gtogs pa dang / /mdzad pa'i slob dpon gang gis mdzad pa dang / dgos pa'i mtshan ni sdo la btags pa dang / /dbu nas skabs kyi don bsdus bsgan pa dang / /don byed gang gi don du mdzad pa'o/ 1dang po phyogs ni gang du gtogs pa ni/ /sangag rgyas thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis las/ /lo 'gros bcu gnyis rten 'brel bcu gnyis gtogs1 /rgya cher rol ba'i rtsis gzhung phyogs su gtogs/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa dga' bo mngal 'jug rtsis/ /'dus pa rin po che ni tog rigi rtsis/ /mdo sde stag no ltas dang mtshan gyi rtsis/ /'phags pa rtag tu ngu ni rgyun dpyad rtsis/ /de bzhin mdo sde mig ni bcu gnyis la/ /mdo sde gsang /ba chen po gartan 'bebs rtsis/ /mdo sde khams gsum snang byed rtsis dang ni/ mdo sde gzer mig legs nyes bstan pa'i rtsis/ /mya/ngan 'das pa shi ba ro 'gros rtsis/ /shis par brjod pa tshong dang bag ma'i rtsis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo snyi zla gza' skar rtsis/ /rdo rje gdan bzhi srid pa 'dre 'dzin rtsis/ /bka' 'dus rtsis gzhung thams cad 'dus pa'i rtsis/ /mngon pa'i rtsis dang gakha' 'gro'i rtsis su gtogs/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gang gis mdzad pa ni/ /'phaṭa snyepa 'jam dpal rigs ni lnga yod pa'i/ /rgya nag ri bo de shan bya ba la/ /rgya gnag ri go rtse lnga yod pa yin/ /dashas kyi ri bo sdo ta rtse zheg bya/ /de la 'jam snyedapal gzhon nur gyur pa bzhugs/ /skyes pa'i yab med bltams pas lum yab 437
