mid/ shing ni 'dzam bu tri sha'i lnga ba la/ mi 'gyur gser ltar brdzus nas sku 'khrungs pa/ /rus sbal rnam pa lnga dang ni/ /rtsa bzhi 'dus pa'i rgyud bdun gsungs/ /de nas gson/rtsis nyi khri chig stong bshad/ /gshin po'i rtsis la nyi khri chig stong bshad/ /bag ma'i rtsis la nyi khri cheg stong dang / 1sa dpyad rtsis la nyi khri chig stong ste/ /rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /gsum pa mtshan ni srid pa'i gtsug lag btags/ /na ba gso zhing shi ba sdur bar byed/ /mdo sde nas bsdus gtsug lag gtan la phab/ /bod la phan pa'i gtsug phag sde dgur btags/ 1gnam sa bar gsum gsum gsum gab rtse/dgu /lo dang zla ba zhag dang gsum/ /za ma skar ma dus tshod gsum/ /spar kha sme ba lo khyim gsum/ /'di rnams dgu gsum 'dus pas dgu 'dus btags/ /zla ba bcu gnyis rim pa bzhin/ /gza' dang skar ma tshes grangs nyi ma ni/ /mi 'gyur ba yi gzer ni bzhi bzhi yod/ /rgya bod skor 'go bco lngar gtan la phab/ /'di rnams gab rtse'i mtshan du btags/ /bzhi pa dbu rgebs don bsdus bstan pa ni/ phyi yi skor 'go drug dang nang gi drug gsang ba'i drug ste bco brgyad bsdu/ /gson rtsis gshin rtsis sa dpyad gsum du 'dus/ /lnga pa don byed gang gi don du mdzad pa ni/ /'di ni don dam bden pa ma yin te/ /kun rdzob bden pa rnams kyi don du mdzad/ /rgya nag mi ni blo lci bsam pa ngan/ /las rnams ngan pa sna tshogs kun la dga'/ /sgo gsum rnam par mi dbyen bya ba mang / /don dam bden pa'i tshos la mi mos par/ /kun rdzob bden pa dpyad la mos pa'i don du mdzad/ /tshe thung nad mang sgor dbul dgra 'dres gartsar/ /'jigs pa bcu drug rkyen mi theg phyir mdzad/ /'jig rten chos brgyad pa yi don du mdzad/ /rtsis gtan la phab pa'i skabs tedonyer gsum rngo 'o// //498

sman gtan 'a phab pa'i skabs/nad kyis zin pa sman gyis gso ba la/ /sangs rgyas sman bla 'tsho byed gzhon nu yis/ /rgya gar pad+ma can gyi yul khams nas/ /bdud rtsi snyeng po'i rgyud dang man ngag rgyud/ /bka' ni yan lag brgyad pa'i rgyud bstan rgyud/ /drang srong rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sman rgyud 'bum/ /klu sgrub mdzad pa'i so ma rā dza dang// /bdud rtsi thigs pa bdud rtsi bum pa dang / /pha gol ma gol yan lag brgyad pa dang / /u rgyan bad+mas mdzad pa'i be bum skor/ /gsal byed me long snying po 'dug pa dang / /rgya nag me chu go log gnyen bshad dang / /ā tsar lag rdum sde skor brgya dang sham cu brgyad/ /tsa rgyud chen po tsa ka dang / /'dus pa chen po rin chen mdzod/ /za hor gagang mdzod brna gsun dang// 1srin po'i shi gsos byer brgyad dang / /lha ma yin gyi gso rgyud chen/ kha che'i gapho dpyad rin cen spungs/ /mu stegs bdud snye gsang mdzod brgya/ /u rgyan khyags dang mkha' 'gro'i lugs/ /mi lus 'di la rgyu rkyen nyon mongs pas/ /bskyed pa'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yod/ /gnyen po gso dpyad p+tong dang rtsa gnyis ༷da/ /gso thabs yan lag sum brgya drug cu yod /dang po nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la/ /rlung gi nad rigs rnams la brgyad dang drug mkhris pa'i nad rigs rnams la brgya dang drug /bad kan nad rigs rnams la brgya dang drug ldang dang 'dus pa gnyis la brgya dang drug gzhi la lus dang grib ma bzhin du yod/ /gnyis pa gso sman stong dang rtsa gnyis la/ /sa steng sman du ma gyur med pa'o/ /'di dag sman sbyor rnams kyi ming du bshad//gsum pa yan lag sug brgya drug cu la/ /rlud/la gso thabs brgya dang nyi shu 433

tham/ /mkhris pa gso thabs brgya dang nyi shu tham/ /bad kan gso thabs brgya dang nyi shu tham/ /bzhi pa zhal gdams drug cu rtsa gnyis la/ /skye ba'i sgo gsum 'jug pa'i sgo drug dang / /rten pa'i gnas gsum rgyu lam bco lnga dang // thul dang dus rang sa sne rnam pa dgu /ldog rgyu bcu gnyis gnyan pa rnam pa gsum/ /srog gcod nad dgu bsdus pas mdo don gnyis/ /lnga pa lag len bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad la/ /brtag thabs rnam pa brgyad dang smin rgyu lnga/ /gso thabs bcu bdun phan/mad nyes dmigs gnyis/ gtar mi rung bzhi sreg tu mi rung gcig bzang khrug dbyung gnyis ngan khrug bzhag nad gnyis/ grang ba gtar gnyis tsha ba sreg nad gnyis/ /mi 'dra'i bcos thabs gsum gyes nyams su blangs/ /sman gyi mdo don nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/ /ro drug rjes gathum dang ni gnas pa brgyad/ /sbyor sde lnga dang yan lag drug tu bstan/ /sman gartan la phab pa'i skabs te nyer bzhi pa'o// //chos gtan 'a phab pa'i/skabs/pad 'byung chos rnams ji ltar bab tshul ni/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi nub kyi phyogs/ /dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa na/ /u gyen yul la 'dzam gling sum gnyis yod/ /yul gru tshen po lnga dang ni/ /yul gling chen po nyer gcig yod/ /yul phran chen po dgu yod do/ /dbus na dha/na ko shashi gling / /shar na dzasbra ma le la/ /grong khyer chen po bye ba batho brgyad yod/ gaḥlho na por pa ta gleng la/ /grong khyer chen bo bye ba bcu drug yod/ /nub na na ga si ju la/ //grong khyer chen po bye ba bcu bzhi yod/ /byang na ka ka sham bha la/ /grong khyer chen po bye ba nyi shu rtsa drug yod/ /byang shar mtshams na bgegs kyi yul/ /500

grong khyer chen po bye ba 'bum khri dgu stong dang / /'bum tsho bco brgyad yod do skad1 /shar phyo drang thong me lha'i yul/ /sto nub mtshams na srin po'i yul/1yul gling chen po dgu dang bcu drug yod/ /dbus na gnam lcags ma la ya/ 1shar na lang ka pu ri'i yul/ /sto na dga' ba can gyi yul/ nub na ko ga thang dmar yul/ /byang na byan lag sgongs kyi mul/ /sto nub dzol mus bam ril thod pa mkhar/ /nub byang dza ra dza ta'i yul/ /byang shar nal byi dur khrod yul/ /shar sto bya khru spungs pa yod/ /yul du ba tsha'i mtsho mo yod/ /zo ma pu ri khrug gi mtsho/ /rgyal mo pu ri'i mcho/ gru gsum srin po khe/ gdug pa gtun khung dun/ sbal ri zur gsum brtsegs/ me ri spungs pa'o/ /srin po'i grong khyer lnga brgyas bskor ba yod/ /nub byang mtshams na rlung lha'i yul rnams yod/ /spyir na u rgyan yul la ni/ yul chen po khri tsho dgu grong khyer chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug gan bha la/ dza lan dha ra/ na ka ra rka/ dza la mu/ dhu ma tha la yan chad do/ /'gro lam 'jug pa'i sgo bzhi yod/ ni pa la/ bu sho re/ ka 'o ka ra ca hur ro/ dza larnyi ra nas/ ra ca hur du ba phyed dang gnyis na sleb/ shākya thub pa 'das nas su/ lo ni nyer brgyad song tsa na/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yis/ /ri ni ma la ya'i rtse mo ru/ /pad+ma gar dbang rta mgrin rgyud rnams dang / /gsang 'dus lha ni sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ he badz+ra lha ni sum cu pa/ ma hā mā ya lha lnga pa/ 'jigs byed lha ni bcu gsum pa/ dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu dang / bde mchog lha ni drug cu rtsa gnyis pa/ bcu gsum pa dang lha lnga pa/ sasbu ṭa dang rdo rje gdan gzhi dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dus kyi 'khor po rnams/ /dam pa'i rigs can lnga la bshad/ /srin po blo gros thabs ldan/ lha grags ldan mchog skyong / klu 'jog po/ /gnod spyin skar mda' gdong / mi li tsa byi dri ma sted/ /de la — 501

rgyud ni dbye na bcu bzhi yod/ gser gyi char pa ste zu'i rgyud/ rdo rje gdan bzhi gtsug lag rgyud/ dga' byed za nus las kyi rgyud/ sasbu ṭa ti la ka lin/ gsang ba yid bde ma hā mā ya/ snying po dgyes pa rdo rjede rgyud/ snying po bsdus rgyud rdo rje gur/ dgyes rdor blo ka 'bum tsho lnga/ brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ brjod bya rgya mtsho lta bu'i rgyud/ le'u stong phrag sum cu'o/ /de'ab thabs kyi rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ gshin rje nag po/ gshin rje gdags pa'i tan tra/ rnam grangs tan du/ 'khor lo bum pa'i tan tra/ pra don khong nan nyan tra/ bzhi po 'di lha min drang srong ma thos par/ mdun gyi bar snang khams nyid na/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang mi ma yin/ /rgya yis btab ste mi yul ma grags so/ /ro langs drug cu'i tan tra/ rashi srin po'i tan tra/ klu'i yul du brkus te bros so/ /rasga se srog bya ba'i rgyud/ /lcags sde khrum gyi tan du/ /phyi nang gnyis su bshad pas te/ /lha ma yin gyi yul du khyer/ /mi yi yul du ma grags so/ /mi'i yul du grags pa'i rgyud la/ 'jam dbal gsang pa'i rgyud/ he la ma la gter sgrub tu bshad/ nag po 'dus pa'i tan tra/ 'jam dpal spyi mthun bshad/ dgra 'khor nag po'i tan tra/ yi ge bsdus pa'i rgyud du bshad1 las bzhi 'khor lo'i tan tra/ zhi rgyas dbang drag rgyud du bshad/'jam dpal spyi'i las su bzhag /me lce 'bar ba'i tan tra/ /gshin rje dmar po'i rgyud du bzhag 'khrul 'khor rgyal mtshan bya ba de/ /'jam dpal spyi'i don du bstan/ /lhur yang 'khor rgya chen po'i rgyud/ /'phrul gyi me long bya ba de/1'jam dpal spri'i sham bur bstan/ /lcags kyi me long bya ba de/ /sra bas lcags su bzhag pa yin/ /don rnams gsal ba'i me long de/ /don la ming du btags pa yin/ /gsang ba nyi shu bya ba de/ /dgra star ral gri sor gdub dang / /dngul gyi dong rtse la sogs pa/ /go mtshon dmag dang me tog/sgrub/ /gab/nga 602

grub nyi shu la/ gsang ba nyi shu gtad pa shin/ /gsang ba bzhi bcu bya ba de/ /de yi ma tshang kha skong la/ /bzhi bcu ston pas baje baṭu+o'o/ /zla bzang nag po bya ba de/ /sgrub pa man ngag rgyud du gsungs/ /bya rog mgo brtsegs bya ba de/ /rog ti mdo/rgyud gsungs pa yin/ /mdo ru mdo rgyud gsang rgyud gnyis/ /gza' gdong rgyud du btags pa yin/ 1shes rab rgyud la bde mchog 'khor lo dang / /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sasbu ṭa/ do /rdo rje gdan bzhi rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ /gnyis su med pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ /thun mong gnas kun 'og tu ston/ /khyad par gnas su rnal 'byor mchog gi rgyud/ /rnal 'byor bla med thabs kyi jeg pa'o/ /de yang ma hā yo ga ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin rdo rje chos kyis zhu ba phul/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po yis/ /rnam par snang mdzad sku sprul nas/ /ma hā yo ga'i chos kun bka' bstsal to/ /de yang bsdu na rnam pa gnyis su 'du/ /thabs kyi rgyud dang shes rab rgyud/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud dang gnyis/ /rdzogs tshul a nu'i theg pa dang / /rdzogs chen a ti'i theg pa'o/ /de la a nu'i theg pa ni/ /lang ka'i bdag pos zhu phul nas/ /bcom ldan kun tu bzang po yis/ /rdo rje sems dpar sku sprul nas/ /rgyal mo pu ri'i tshal nyid du/ /mdo bzhi dems dang lnga bka' bstsal nas/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/ sems lung chen po'i mdo/ ye shes rngams pa glog gi 'khor lo'i mdo/ dur khrod khu byug rol pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo/ de la yo ga'i theg pa ni/ /bcon ldan kun tu bzang po yis/ /kun byed rgyal por sku sprul nas/ /rdo rje sems dpas zhu ba phul/ /rgyal mo pu ri'i tshane dang ni/ /zo ma spu ri'i tshal nyid/du/ /kun tu bzang po che ba rang nas rgyud/ /byang seca sa kugo byed rgyal po'i rgyud1 /gom mkha' yongs su rgyas pa'i rgyud/ /ma mā ya nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud/ /nya du03

po ༅sha nyi / che blung la sogs pa/ /rdzogs pa chen po/sems phyogs kyi/ /chos sdo go'i phyorte cad bkang bstsal to/ /de bzhin 'dzig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa/ /༅ /'a tshos bsam kyis mi khyab pa cig gsungs/ /thun mong gnas ni bha na ko sha'i gling / /dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa dang / /rgyal po'i gnas dar ri me ri 'bar ba dang / /ma la ya ri gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse/ /byang chub gyi+o0ni shing drung dang / /rdo rje gdan gyi pho brang rnams su babs so1 khyad par genas ni 'og min dang / yum gyi mkha' dbyings dang / chog dbyings bde rten dang / stug po bkod pa dang / bkod pa lhun grub dang / lha yi drung gi gnas rnams so/ khyad par thun mong ston 'khor bka' bstsal to/ /gnas der chos 'khor bskor ba'i mchod rten byung / /thun mong mchod rten lha lam babs pa ni/ /gru bzhi ri rab la dpe blangs pa'o/ khyad par blum po mya ngan 'das pa'o/ /sku gsum dbyer med ston pa kun tu 'chang / /bkod pa stun kyis grub pa'i pho brang du/ /gsang sngags spyi ti'i theg pa rigs dbye yang / /yum thod pa can lnga la sogs pa gsungs/ /bka' 'dus zug pa rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u stong phrag nyi shu la/ 'dril pa sdong po'i rgyud le'u brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ gyes pa yal ga'i rgyud le'u bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa/ rgyas pa lo 'dapa kyi rgyud le'u drug cu rtsa gcig pa/ lung gi rgyud le'u so bdun pa/ man ngag gi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud le'u nyi shu pa/ spyi spungs 'dus pa'i rgyud lenyu lnga bcu pa/ smin grol gyi rgyud bcu gsungs so/ /sku yongs su rdzoṭa pa mi brjod pa'i mdo le'u bcu bdun pa/ gsung yongs mu dzogs pa ca/ 'dres /'i mdo le'u bco lnga pa/ /thugs yongs su rdzogs pa ye shes sgo lnga'i mdo she) ༷ 7shebyu gsum pa/ yogo tan yongs su rdzogs pa gol sa bcad pa'i mdo le'u lortsu gcig pa/ 'phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa rtsa ba brtan pa'i mdo le'u 504

bdun pa/ las kyi 'khor chen po/rgyun du bkod pa'i mdo le'u lnga pa/ gzhi gzhag gi mdo bdun gsungs so/ /bka' spyod dam pa'i rgyud lnga/ bka' srungs 'dus pa'i rgyud le'u dgu pa/ dgongs pa thams cad pasgrub pa'i tan ta'o/ spyi ti'i theg pa snying thig la/ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i skor bzhi dang / mā ma gī'i skor bzhi dang / gos dkar mo'i skor bzhi dang / dam tshig sgrol ma'i skor bzhi dang / dbyings phyug mo'i skor bzhi'o/ /dang po spyan ma'i skor bzhi la/ bstan pa bu gcig rgyud/ snang dbye thug phrad rgyud/ dam chig khrung ba theg chen rgyud/ sgom med ye grol rgyud do/ /gnyis pa mu ma gī'i skor bzhi la/'khor 'das gzhi tso gcod pa'i rgyud/ spyi rdzogs 'dod 'byung rgyud/ dbyings brjod glong brdol rgyud/ mi 'gyur gtan 'bebs rgyud do/ /gsum pa gos dkar skor bzhi la/ sgra 'od zer gsum rgyud/ thig le 'od skor rgyud/dbyings rig bkod pa'i rgyud glong khru zla zer rgyud do/ /bzhi pa sgrol ma skor bzhi la/ mtshan ma rang grol rgyud/ 'od gsal rgya yan bar do'i rgyud/ btaṭa grol mthong grol rgyud/ theg pa mtha' gcod rgyud do/ /dbyings phyug mo skor bzhi la/ gnas lugs dzogs pa chen po gsang skor rgyud/ dgongs pa gnad gzung rgyud/ sgos pa tshig gcod rgyud/ gnas rgyu+od nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i rgyud do/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'dus pa'i sras/ /u rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas te/ /dus gsum 'jig rten khams 'dir mtshungs med mdzad/ /thu she ba'i bka' las rtsod med sprul skur grags/ /de phyir rnam thar yongs rdzogs brjod dka' yang / /thos pas byang chub rnam thar mdor bshad na/ /rgyal sras mdzad pa bcu gcig 'di lta ste/ /'gro 'dul dgongs mdzad pad+ma lhums zhugs mdzad/ /rang byung bltams mdzad rgyal sras rol rtsed mdzad/ /rab tu byung mdzad dka' du0du

spum sna tshogam mdzad /bdud dpung 'jomam mdzad sangs rgyas byang chub mdzad/ /tshos 'khong bskor mdzad brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad/ /bstan pa mthar rgyam me nāb gter khyed mdzad/ /u rgyan rnam thar mdor bsdus mdzad pa 'di/ /pum bris pa dang mthong thos gzhan la ston/ /de dag 'jig rten bde ba can du skye/ /'di la dad mos rnam thar don spyod tshad/ /bla med byang chub sangs rgyas the chom med/ /de phyir mdzad pa bcu gcig 'di bkod do/ /khu/sa 'phro can gyi re ba kun skong 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal/ /bod kyi rgyal ོོ/khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /mi rdub rgyal mtshan gtsug gi rgyan du khur/ /chos gtan la phab pa'i skabs te nyer lnga pa'o// //dus gsum mkhyen pardoshe snga che/ ci yin de ltar shes pa'i skabs/dus gsum mkhyen pas dus gsum gsungs tshul dang / /zhes pas/ lha 'dre ma rungs gdug pa can gyi yul/ /lha yi tshogs ni lug khyu bkongs pa 'dra/ /rta dkar mi dkar skar tshogs me re re/ /btsan gye tshogs ni se 'brum sge mo 'dra/ /mi dmar rta dmar tshogs rnams grigs se krig /bdud kyi tshogs ni 'brong g.yag bkongs pa 'dra/ /mgar nag mi rta mang po rug ge rug /gza' yi che nas ni dmag g.yul bshams pa 'dra/ /sngags bon mi 'dra dgu 'dra chi li li/ /gnod spyin tshogs ni mtshan mo'i skar tshogs 'dra/ /rgyal blon mang po spungs se spungs/ /rgyal po'i tshogs ni mtsho gling ngang pa 'dra/ 1dge btsun mang po khyu ru shigs se shigs/ /ma mo'i tshogs ni ltad mor 'dus pa 'dra/ /yo chags bud med mang sdo sgo ro ro/ /the'u brang tshogs 'di yungs 5she6

gar skye mo 'dra/ /dkar skya byis pa mang po phungs se phungs/ 1glu yi tshogs ni dbyar ga'i sa gzhi 'dra/ /sbrul sdig sa bdag mang po me re re/ /lha srin sde brgyad yid kyi gzugs can rnams/ /rdzus skyes ma yin mngal skyes ga la mthong / /bden pa ma mthong grub pa ma thob par/ /sha gi mig gis lha 'dre ga la mthong / /nyon mongs ma zhi sems ngo ma mthong bar/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta ga la shes/ /'dri srin mang po nam mkha' rgyu ba dang / /chu dang shing dang dma' sa la rgyu'i tshoges/ /yi dwags mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /lus ni 'jigs 'dzigs ltar 'dug sgu mi snyan/ /cho 'phrul sna tshogs skad ni sna tshogs sgogs/ /chung ma bu dang bu mo bran dang g.yog /g.yas g.yon ru 'dren mdun rgyab kung spul pa/ /mal gro gzi can 'go byas klu rnams tshogs/ /pe dkar rgyal pos 'go byas rgyal po tshogs/ /yar lha sham pos 'go byas lta rnams tshogs/ /rdzong btsan rkurtis 'go byas btsan rnams tshogs/ khyab 'jug rā hus 'go byas gza' rnams tshogs/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul 'go byas gnod sbyin tshogs/ /rdo rje legs pas 'go byas the'u brang tshogs/ /nag po bkrag med 'go byas bdud rnams tshogs/ /lag na gsod pa'i go mtshon sna rgogs bsnams/ /mi la gros nyes byed pa'i 'dun ma gshom/ /rgyal po rgyal tshod mi 'dzin khengs log byed/ /lha 'dre'i tshogs rnams bsam yas dbu rtser 'dus1 /lo paṇa rgyal blon thams cad 'dzom pa'i dus/ /'jig rten bya ba rab tu 'jug pa kun/ 1phyir mi ldog par pad 'byung lung 'dir ston/ /btsan po skye ba 'di yi snga ma nyid/ /rgya gar yul gyi bram ze dpal ldan bu/ /dge slong a ba rab tu bya bar skyes/ /tshe 'phos bod yul skyes kyang rgya gar mos/ /blon po dbu mog btsan po khyod/ /snye ga la yi sgo srung pa/ /tshe 'phos rgyal po'i blon por skyes/ /thon po khri ni thog rjes thang la 'bar/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan ni mu dukyi7

stegs bzung / /byi la stag ris zhig tu skyes/ /da lta rgyal po'i blon po thang na 'bar/ /cog ro skyes bzang rgyal 'gong khyod/ /rgya gar glang po skang gi khyi ru skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta skyes bzang rgyal 'gong yin/ /zhang te ma zhang gsum ste khrom pa skyabs/ /ko ta la yi bong bu tshe 'phos pa/ /da lta rgyal po'i blon po khrom pa skyabs/ /sku tshe stod kyi blon po snga gsal snang / /'bras ldan karka'i tshong 'dus nas/ /rā dza zangs kyi grags pa tshe 'phos pa/ /da lta blon po sba gsal snang / /da lta'i blon po stag sna ldong gzigs 'di/ /rgya gar ke'u ta yi yul phyogs nas/ /mdzo mo cig ni tshe 'phos pa/ /da lta rgyal po'i blon por skyes/ /sbas gnam bzher zla btsan blon po khyod1 /rgya gar rgya mtsho ne nye'i nya ru skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ khri bzang yab lhag blon po khyod/ /rgya gar ku sha bra ma ni la che 'phos te/ /bal yul rigs ngan khyi mo zhig tu skyes/ /da lta mnga' bdag rgyal po'i blon po yin1 /mchims kyi rgyal gzigs klu mthong blon po khyod/ /bal yul rigs ngan khyi ru skyes/ /che 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /blon po ngan lam rta ra glu gong khyod/ /bal yul go da be ri'i gtsug lag khang / /bherma mi tra'i rmon glang zhig tu skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /mchims kyi rdo rje spre chung blon po khyod/ /bal yul muchod rten bya rung kha shor na/ /rigs ngan bya rji'i bya ru skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /lha bzang glu dpal dmag dpon khyod/ /bal bod mtshams kyi spyang ker skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /khri 'bring lha long blon po khyod/ /bal yul rigs ngan phag rdzi'i phag par skyes//tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /snam zhang rgya tsha lha snang skon po khyod/ /ni rardzi ra dbus 'gyur gyi/ /phag mo mig zhar zhig tu skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /shud phu dpal gye seng ge blon po khyod/ /bal yul 508

mtshid rten bya rung kha shor du/ /bya ni phug ron zhig tu skyes/ /tshe 'apos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /zhang be+e nyi bzang blon po khyod/ /bal yul e yi gtsug lag khang / /dkor zan gnas brtan bran du skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyol po'i blon po yin/ /'di na mchis pa'i lo ni ti gu snang / 1gtsug lag dbus 'gyur de yi yul gyi gzhir/ /ri rwags rngon pa zhig tu skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /mi 'go lha lung gzigs zhes blon po khyod/ /bal yul nag gseb rngon pa gcig tu skyes/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /bha sang shi ta'i ming can khyod/ /bal yul shing khun gtsug lag khang / /ge tso cig gi skye ba blangs/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /gnyer pa stag mtshan gdong gzig blon po khyod/ /rgyal po klu yi khyab 'jug skye ba blangs/ /tshe 'phos da lta rgyal po'i blon po yin/ /blon po de rnams tshe 'phos mtha' 'khob tu/ /'du 'dzom smon lam btab pas 'dus/ /bstan pa'i sgon me dge 'dun rin po che/ /lo paṇa bzhi bcu kha yangs 'dus pa 'di/ /lha 'dre mang pos bdag la mngon shes zhus/ /sngar 'das rgyal blon skye ba de ltar lags/ /lo tsā la gsum rgyal ba byang chub khyod/ /gser gling mya stegs grong khyer dbus/ /nyi ma'i shugs can tshe 'phos bod du skyes/ /sa bzhi non pas tshe lo brgya thub mod/ /rma rin cen mchog ces lo tsā khyod1 /thub pa 'das nas lo ni bzhi brgya na/ /bram ze chen po sā ra ha zhes byung / hūṃ cha de was cung zhig phyin/ /shar phyogs kā ma ru yi yul du ni/ /ke pa la ṅges bya ba der/ /ro ras kyis ni smad dkros can/ /wa wa pa zhes bya ba byung / /a shā ba cig gi skye ba blangs/ /sā ra ha yis mda' brgyab sha zos pa/ /tshe 'phos rin cen mchog tu skyes/ /sa lnga non pas tshe lo brgyad cu thub/ /ga'u gnyis gzhong ti ta'i bu/ /smad 'tshong bu mo na ra ya/ /rgya gar yul nas tshe 'phos pa/ /lu wa 509

shā/ zhis bye ba 'dir/ /sga ba dpal brtsegs thu bar skyes/ /sa ni bdun pa lo di brgya dang gcig /lo tsā tsog ro glu yi rgyal mtshan khyod/ /slob dpon glu skrub 'das pa'i 'og rol tu/ /rgya gar sa kun la ni snga ba'i yul/ /rgyal po rnam rje)ra sgon zhes bya ba byung 1 /tshe 'phos cog ro glu yi rgyal mtshan yin/ /lo tsā dā na ste na bya ba khyod/ /rgya gar grong khyer yangs pa can/ /shing 'tshong se ye du tse bya bar skyes/ /che 'phos dā na sto na yin/ /lo tsā chen po be+e ro tsa na khyod/ 1skye ba bzhi nas lnga brgyar khrims bsrungs pas/ khrims nyams rte le pūr+ṇa sna chang ni/ /rgya gar bram ze smad 'tshong ma yi bu/ /rgya gar yul nas tshe 'phos bod du skyes/ /sa brgyad non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /gtsang ni the len dra bu nyid/ /rgya mo g.yu sgra snying po khyod/ /sto brag gtsang sngon legs drug che 'phos te/ /tshe lo brgya dang lnga ni thub par 'gyur/ /sa drug non pa'i thung chub sems dpa' yin/ /gnyags ban dz+nyā na ku ma rā dza khyod/ /rgya gar di+o/rje gdan gyi rdul 'phyag pa/ /ha lu ba de tshe 'phos pa1 /lo ni brgyad cu rtsa gnyis thub par 'gyur/ /sa bdun non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /'di na mchis pa'i lha dpal ye shes khyod/ /rgya gar bram ze smad 'tshong tshe 'phos te/ /lo ni brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thub par 'gyur/ /sa lnga non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /rte sha pu ri'i gsal rig tshe 'phos pa/ /lha ma yin gyi dngos grub thob pa yi/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che/ /che lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig thub par 'gyur/ /sa bzhi non pa'i dri za 'dzin pa yin1 /bi kā ma la shi la'i gtsug lag khang / /sprang po nyi ma dngos grub tshe 'phos pa/ /'khon pa klu yi dbang po khyod/ /lo ni brgyad cu gya gnyis thub par 'gyur/ /sa brgyad non pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /spur na spur me sgu sgyur tshal/ /dza ma ri yi pardo ta/ /bu tsha ming sring bzhi dang chung mas lnga//du10

khyo rang dang ni drug yod pazhi/ /tshe 'phos che ba dge slong dpal dbyangs yin1/de 'og rgyal ba mchog dbyangs yin/ /di 'og yon tan snying po yin/ /de 'og legs sbyin nyi ma yin/ /sring mo ldan ma rtse yang yin/ /chung ma lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas yin/ /bsnyen gnas bsrungs pas tshe 'phel lo/ /gnubs ban nam mkha' snying po khyod/ /rgya gar lnga thub can gyi yul/ /thags mkhan bza' mi gnyis yode pa'i/ /dge slong dze ta tshe 'phos pa/ /da lta nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /rgya gar dri za 'phung byed che 'phos pa/ /da lta ye shes 'tsho rgyal yin/ /rgyal po'i sras mo lha lcam khrom pa rgyan/ 1bram ze skye bdun dung rna'i skye ba yin/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las 'phyul lnga babher/ /dus gsum mkhyen pas snga ma ci yin de ltar shes pa'i skabs te nyer drug pashes// //dus gsum mkhyen pas da lta ci yin gsungs pa'i skabs/da lta bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /bdag don sgrub pa longs sku'i pastan/ /gzhan don mdzad pa sprul sku'i bstan/ /bstan pa gnyis ldan bod du chags/ /bsod nams stobs kyang rab tu che/ /'dun ma dge ba'i phyogs su byed/ /dad pa che bas lha chos dran/ /snying rus che bas mtha' ru thon/ /dam tshig gtsad bas lha srung dgyes/ /sbyin shugs btang bas longs spyod che/ /khrims la gnas pas 'dun stangs gcig bsam pa dag pas ci byas 'grub/ 1smon lam mthu btsan dam chos dar/ /lus ngag yid gsum dkon cog sgrub/ /rig pa yod pas sdig pa 'dzem/ /bsags pa yod pas bde skyid 'byung / /ma rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul mang / /sangs rgyas sprul pa bod du byon/ /dam 511

pa'i lha chos bod na dar/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong baspung dang gsum/ /rgya bod hor gsum dbang du 'du/ /bon rtsis sman sogs 'jig rten sgrub/ /sde snod yo ga sngags bye nang / /theg pa rim dgu bcu 'am gnyis/ /zab rgya'i dam chos ma lus bsgyur/ /sdom gsum mkhan pos bstan pa 'dzin/ /bstan skyong rgyal po chen po/nyid/ /smon lam dbang gis rgyal por 'khrungs/ /bod 'bangs 'dun ma gcig tu bsdus/ /rgyal blon 'bangs gsum khrims la btsud/ /dge ba'i phyogs su brtson pa bskyed/ /mtha' yi rgyal po dbang du 'dus/ /gtsug lag khang chen brgya rtsa grub/ /sa bzhi byin phab sdo ru chugs/ /dkar nag mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi/ /lo paṇa mang po gdan drangs nas/ /chos bshad 'dri blog kha ton sgom/ /chos spyod bcu la sogs pa yi/ /dam pa chos kyi nyi ma shar/ /zas nor longs spyod kun la spel/ /yul bde sa 'jam byams pa'i jeng / /bod khams bde skyid lha dang mnyam/ /bstan pa 'phel 'grib med par bskyangs/ /tshos pa rnams kyang rdzu 'phrul ldan/ /ngo mtshad 'phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /sku tshe ring po byung ba yin/ /bod grorges chos gyel menge/byon kyang / /mnga' thang khyod tsam byon pa med/ /ma 'ongs mi rnams ji snyam sems/ /dbu rtse rigs gsum khyad 'phags 'di/ /sangs rgyas dkon gog rten du mtshar/ /rgya gar skos skad bod du bsgyur/ /chos ni dkon cog bod na bzhugs/ /bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing dam pa/ /dege 'dun dkon cog bod na bzhugs/1bdag kon sbrub pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /grub pa thob pa mang po byung / /dus gsum mkhyen pas da lta ci yin gsungs pa'i skabs te nyer bdun pa'o// //phyi ma ci 'gyur bstan pa'i skab sa/phyi ma ci 'argyur 'di/ltar shes/ /rgyal po'i gtsug lag khang ladi yang / /512

'dus byas yin pas lan cig 'jig /mi log pha la bus mi nyan/ /bzang spyod mi byed rgyal khrims 'jig /'od srungs yum bstan gnyis su gyes/ /bod kyi bstan pa nyams par 'gyur/ 1de dus skyid med sdug bsngal yin/ /bod kyi 'gro ba snying re rje/ /lha 'bod klu 'bod a re sdug dus log dge log bya log byed/ /rgyal po ljang tsha lha dbon gyi/ /gnyan tsho'i dpon po gnyags kyis byed/ /gnyags ni khri bzang yang gdon skyong / /'od srungs sras po mnga' bdag dpal 'khor gyis/ /gnyags byed gtsang du sprug par 'gyur/ /'bro phyed yar glungs gnon par 'gyur/ /mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan po la/ /glu ni mal gro gzi can khengs log 'byung / /zangs dri mtsho dmar klu ni glang dmar po/ /gnyags ni rtse ba la zhugs dpal 'khor bkrongs/ /'jig rten 'phel 'grib thams cad lha 'dres byed/ /ma 'ongs dus ngan sde brgyad bstan pa 'ong / /glang dmar blon po 'bro yis bsad bas lan/ /sbas rgyal to re sdig rtsa bskyed pa yirge/ /de yi mi sha lo po lo chung blon/ /'gro grangs med pa bsam yas nang 'dir gsod/ /chu ni khrug gis dmar por 'apo ba 'byung / /tshur log tsa na ro la mi thar 'byung / /rnam par smin pa tsha ba'i nad kyis gdungs/ /gangs thog stel kyang gangs rnams zhu bar 'gyur/ /lo po lo chung spa bza' ngan ma yis/ /slob dpon dpal dbyangs zhabs tog byed pa 'byung //ma des slob dpon nyams skong bshags pa zhu/ /dgos cha ci dang ci lod zhu bar 'gyur/ /dam chig nyams pa bshags pa la/ /yas rtags shin tu bka' ba yod do zer/ /lug ni dkar po brgya dang nag po brgya/ /nas khal dkar mo brgya dang nag po brgya/ /bya mo dkar mo brgya dang nag po brgya/ khyi rigs dkar po brgya dang nag po brgya/ /gang nas dka' ba thams cad dgos zer 'gyur/ /de tsam ga nas rnyed zer mo log 'gro /dpal dbyangs ngag brjod bu du13

'grus che/ /a yi ming can hor du brtsi/ /bod kyi bde skyid chu la 'bor/ 1stong gi ming can seng ltar 'phyo/ /lus sems sreg pa'i dpon po bsko/ /sa li ming can dbus gtsang 'khyams/ /mtha' yi mi ngan dbus su rdib/ /sa skya dpon chen byang rin btsan/ /bsam yas g.yu yi lha mo 'khyer 2 /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung ba 'byung / kha skad ngan pa sna tshogs pa/ /lo yi rigs la 'gyur zhing 'ong / /bod yangs/sa cha 'dzin mkhan med/ /gcig tshogs gnyis tshogs khrul la lab/ /'gong po lus bsgyur tor sna 'dren/ /rgyal brgyud mi la 'bangs chen 'byung / /rang dbang rang gi ma thob sdug sangs rgyas thugs rjes skyob ma nus/ /bod mi bsod nams nyams nas 'gro/ /chos kyi byen rlabs yal ba'i dus/ /sto phyir rab byung bsnyen par jogs/ /dge 'dun mgo la rgya zhwa gyon/ /hor chas byas nas mi dge gsog nus pa ci 'dug rdul yang sprugaya rabs gong ma'i steng du brnyas/ /las ngan hor la bkur sti 'byung / /mdze dang dmu ro nad yams 'byung / /'brum nag me dbal rims nad 'byung / /gag stog gzer gsum gnyan nad 'byung / /lo shi mu ge bstud mar 'byung / /sad ser rtsa dang skya mug 'byung / /char chu mi 'bab than chen 'byung / /nam zla dus tshod 'khrugs nas 'gro pad 'byung thugs rjes skyob bam lta/ /rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan nyid/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las lnga/ /'phrul lnga bsgyur ba'i stobs su 'gyur/ /'dra min gcig dang ma nor na/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don mdzad/ /byang ma 'dul skyong gnam sa'i bdag /sa hor chab las 'bebs pa 'byung / /blon po dbu rmog btsen pa 'di/ /rgya drug btul ba'i rnam smin brdol/ /ma sangs rgyal zhes bya ba 'byung / /blon khri thog rje thang la 'bar/ /lho gnyos 'bum gyi ming can 'byung / /phal cher mtshon dang dug grir 'chi/ /cog ro skyes bzang blon po 515

'di/ /sa mdud yar 'brog sna dkar du/ /kun gyi ming can ngan byed 'dul/ /༷rtag par 'thab rtsod byed pa 'byung / /blon po ma zhang khrom pa skyabs/ /'bri zhes bya ba'i sde dgon du/ /ye shes ming can hor sngo 'byung / /da lta'i sru mi gsal snang 'di/ /tshal thang bye ma thang zhes par/ /dga' yi ming can dkon chaganyer 'phyung / /3 stan pa'i dge 'dun zas gos skyong / /stag sna ldong gzigs blon po 'di/ /rgya ma zhes pa'i sde dgon du/ /shākya'i ming can gnas partan 'byung / kha skad gsad shi gnyis phu gtong / /sbas pa gnam bzher zla btsan /khyod/ /bya yul glang chung bka' gdams bstan pa 'dzin1 /lha btsun ming can /byang tshub sems dpa' 'byung / /dmag dpon khri bzang yab lhag 'di/ /yang skyes yang shi 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams/ /dus lan cig na stag lung na/ /gnogo spyin ming can dad pa che/ /sgom gyi bstan pa rgyas byed 'byung / /mchims brgya la gzigs klu mthong 'di/ /sprul skus don mdzad byang ni rwa bsgreng du/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'brom ston 'byung / /dge dang yig tshang chos rigs rnam gsum bsten/ /ngan lam rta ra klu gong 'di/ /'bri gung skyu ra'i phyogs su 'byung / /kun dga'i ming can dad pa can/ /di dus bstan pa'i kha 'dzin byed/ /mchims pa rdo rje spre chung 'di/ khams pa me 'bar go tshab skye/ /rdzu 0'phrul ya zung sdig dpon 'joms/ /lha bzang klu dpal dmag dpon 'di/ /lul la snga ba yar glungs gong / /gzhon nu'i ming can gyad hor skye/ /'phral la mi rtag log cing 'gyur/ /blon po khri 'bring lha lod 'di/ /shangs pa'i gnas brtan rgyal ming skye/ /hor khrims gdung 'tshopa yi glang 'byung / /rgya tsha lha snang sna nam zhang / /rgya nag bum zhim zhes bya bar/ /ha yi ming can rgyal brgyud 'dzin pa 'byung / /klu khengs log pas g.yen byed g.yo/ /shud phu dmal gyi seng ge 'di/ /rgya nag shing dhi hu sha spring / /rgya bod hor gyi ba dag 516

po 'byung / /zhang ni nya bzang blon po 'di/ /byang chub ming can rgya kar 'grim/ /rgya nag rgyal gor than 'dogs 'ong / /blon chen lo ni ti gu snang / 1bzad gzhu snye yi sa cha ru/ /zhang tshul rin blos stobs po che/ /gzhung lugs bzang po bskyed sha 'byung / /blon po mi 'go lha lung gzigs/ /sgrol ma'i zheng khams yar klungs 'chos/ /rdo rje'i ming can gdug rtsub 'byung / /'dun ma spyi sgos gnyis su 'gro /bha sang shi ta blon po 'di/ /ka ba yul gyi sdum ra zhes/ /rnod kyi ming can 'bad 'bungs 'byung / /ma thub dgra la dga' tshul ston/ /blon gnyer stag mtshan gdong gzigs 'di/ /la stod byang stod 'am zhes su/ /nam mkha'i ming can la stod kha lo sgyur/ /rgyal khams dbyen dang 'khrug pas 'gengs/ /dus kyi snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus/ /'khrug pa mang zhi nga mu ge mode/ /rgod rigs mang zhing than pa che/ /lo nyes bstud ma phyugs nyes mang / /tshe yi snyigs ma drug cu ral/ /de yang blo bur skye 'chi mang 1 /zas blu+o/snyigs ma rgyu bkol za/ /sngon gyi ma rmos lo tog zad/ /sa zhag la sogs za ba med/ /so nam zung bzhi ya brgyad spyad/ /bra zan za zhing sna yang za/ /nyon mongs snyigs ma bzod pa'i go tshe shore/ /gnyen po ye shes bsten par dka'/1dkon cog gsum gyis ma thul khengs/ /lta log yin lugs don ma rtogs/kha ta bzang po tshig la zhen/ /kun tu brtags pa'i bdag lta log /de log pas na spyod pa log /de nas 'bras bu log pa'i dus/ /ma rabs ngan pa'i lad mo gshom /las ngan 'khrug pa/na nga nas ba/sgo// /dus ngan 'ashi 'dra 'ong ba zer/ /phyi nang lha 'dre sde 'khyeg dang / /lha 'dre mi gsu༄ khengs log 'byung //lha yi khengs log byung tsa na / /rdzuge lung mkhan la yid ches gtod/ /nag/po phyogs rgyas mun par 'gyur/ /pha tshan nang du dug gshom 'ong / /btsan gyi khengs log byung tsa na/ /g.yog po mi nyan dpon la bdo/ /bu yis pha brdung 611

pho nu gsod/ /ngan pa'i rjes su 'jug tu 'ong / /bdud kyi khengs log byung tsa na/ /mi skya thams cad ngur sprig gyon/ /skye bo'i khyim thab btsun mas byed/ /bud med zhwa log lham log spyon/ /pho skad 'don cing phyogs med 'phyo/ /mi chos bstan pa nub pa'i rtags/ /gza' yi khengs log byung tsa na/ /nam mkha' khug gi mdeg tu 'gro /nyi zla gnyis po dus gcig mchi/ /char chu mi stoms mu ge 'byung / /mi spyod glo bur 'grur nas 'gro /rje 'bangs mi 'cham nang bye sngacabyed/ /gnod sbyin khengs log byung tsa na/ /ma rabs gonge ma'i steng du snyeg 1bkra mi shis pa'i 'dun ma gshom/ /sa g.yos sa 'gul chen po 'byung //'dzam bu gling gi rgyal phran 'khrug /gcig la gcig gis dmag drangs nas/ /'khrug pa chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de dus lha chos pastan pa nyams/ /gtsug lag khang du bshas khang byed/ /gsung rab chos la mal sog byed/ /sangs rgyas rten mtshod mgar tshang 'grem/ /yul 'phung rgyal po sdig can 'byung / /rgyal po'i khengs ni log tsa na/ /gtsug lag khang rnams re hrul 'gyur/ /bla ma bzang po sku che thung / /sangs rgyas dag pa'i zhing du bzhud/ /dad can lam sna khrid mkhan med/ /nus pa sdig phyogs 'don pa 'byung / /ma mo'i khengs log byung tsa na/ /rgyal khams thams cad nad yams 'gengs/ /da 'a nya dug gsum mthon po gsod/ /yul dbus khrug gi rgya mtshor 'khyi la/ /༷the'u brang khengs log byung tsa na/ /snying du 'dre zhugs rgyal khrims 'jig /'dzam gling 'di ru sde brgyad 'khrug /rta shing rtse ru dmag dpung 'cha'/ /phyogs nas dmag tu bsnyil nas khrid/ /mi gces tshe zad mang du 'byung / /klu yi khengs log byung tsa na/ /mi 'dod thams cad nang nas 'byung / /'dod dgu 'byung ba lha 'dres 'phrog /na na dga' ste nar mi btub/ /shi na dga' ste 'chir mi btub/ /pod na dga' ste yod mi btub/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad du18

bdud la 'bod/ /bkra mi shis pa mi yis byas/ /bka' chad sangs rgyas bston la 'byung / /sngar srol chos khrims rgyal khrims zhig /zo thang gong ma'i ri brgyud du/ /lha khang 'obs kyis bskor ba 'byung / /dkon gnyer mig gsum lag pa bzhi/ /ste gnyis yod pa gdug rtsub can/ /gzhu 'dom bco pargyad mtho bcu pa/ /lha 'dres mnga' gsol dur gnyan g.yeng / /gnam ri sgong btsan skye ba 'byung / 1mal gro gzi can khengs log 'byung / /hor rgyal kha la rgya mi nyan/ /mdung dmar rgya ral zangs rnga gling / /glu yi lag rtags bod du 'byung / /tor gyi bstan pa nyams pa'i rtags/ /tshong dpon nag po'i khengs log 'byung / /'brug ni thang 'bab mtsho chu 'thung / khams kyi bya thul khengs log 'byung / /dung gis chu srin gsod pa 'byung / /sa 'gul chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gangs gcung spa gro skyer chu'i lha/ kha rgyal zha mo 'od khengs log /dbus gtsang khams gsum rta rnams sdud/ /'khor gdug pa can bzhi khengs log dam sri mched bdun bod du 'byung / /mal gro'i btsun mo gnyis khengs log than chen char che mi stoms 'byung / /tshal nag glu ni khengs log pas/ /lo nad phyugs nad mi nad 'byung / /rgyang bu tshal klu khengs log pas//mi ma zha long rabs chad 'byung / /nag po klong brdol khengs log pas/ /dus —log bsam pa mi gcig 'byung / /lu ma nag po'i klu khengs log grags pagenyams 'gro rang gzhan 'phung / /skyid pa gar yang mi gda' 'byung / 1zangs gri mtsho sman klu khengs log /gad dmar mkha' rgyug 'bu yis 'debs/ /mi —bde ba yi 'tshub ma ldang / /can bzhi rgyal po'i sna 'dren pa'i /'bri zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs nas/ /brde sbrul lo snying stobs can/ /kun dga'i ming can sdig kham can/ /dge slong chas la sdig pa spyod/ /dmag dang 'khrug pa'i las byed pa/ /bod/'dir dmag rigs dgu khrid 'ong / /bod rnams lho mon mtha' la 513

thug sams pa /nga po dbus su 'byung / /bod kyi mkhas btsun bzang po rnams/ /bla mtshod tshul du khrid nas 'gro /ma chags sbas yul bros na thar/ /bod rnams 'dun ma phyogs gcig sgril/ 1klu yi kha bsgyur byas na zlog /pon ༷po'i klu 'apum dkar nag khra/ /klu yi spang skong phyogs bzhir 'don/ /sngags las chu gtor dkar gtor btang / /btsun pas mtha' bskor sman bla bya/ /shes rab snying po'i mdo sgrub bya1 /rgyal khrims chos khrims yul khrims bsdam/ /ri rgya klung rgya lam rgya 'dzugs/ /dbang khri byen mchod sgrub chen gzug /bshad nyan sgom sgrub dag ther 'don/ /de ltar byas na rgya dmag blog ma thub las sgo bzhi la 'bros1 /gtsang la gro mo las sgo yod/ /kong po brag gi las sgo yod//mon la sha 'ug stag sgo yod/ /gnyal la 'brin thang las sgo yod/ /gtsang rong gnyal rong sto rong dang / /kong po rong ste las sgo bzhi/ /ri ni mtshon cha gnam gzings 'dra/ /chu ni rba glong ral nag gsig /nags tshal rtsi shing mun gtibs 'dra/ /sa ni gzhu rgyud tsam pa la/ /gnam ni ral kri tsam las med/ /zas su sngo sad shing thog za/ /gos su me rlung sbyor ba gyon/ /gnas sa brag dang chu yod der/ /bros na kun gyis thar pa la1 /chos pa bshor po 'ga' re yas/ /'bros mkhan gcig kyang mi 'ong ngo / rgya dmag thub pa'i gnas bzhi ༷yod/ /yar klungs shel gyi brag 'khras sam/ /yar 'brog dang ler 'khras pa dang / /e pa yo la ri la 'khrus/ /lung gsum ljongs dang sham po gangs/ /'di la 'khras tshad phebs mi 'gyur/ /chos pa rnams ni dgon la chags/ /gzhan rnams las ngan tis ta 'khor/ /srid cing chags pas yul du 'phung / /lngags pa'i snyeng du bdud 'dre 'jug /bon po'i snying du btsan 'dre 'jug /skyes pa'i snying du rgyal 'gong 'jug bud med snying du bsen mo 'jug /byis —pa'i snying du the'u brang 'jug /de rnams zhugs pa'i chags sdang gis/ /'khor co30

rnams mnga' ris re la zhen/ /mi dbang thugs la gdon gsol nas/ /thams cad rgya nag dbang du 'gro /mi skyid 'byung tshul zad pa med/ /sdug pa 'ong ba bshad mi lang / /sham po gaparas zhol shar sto gnyal/ /gnyos kyi rgyal po me'abyug lo/ /'bum gyi ming can snying stobs can/ /thu mi'i skye bas dmag las byed/ /ya cha'i las la thug pa yin/ /sto brgyud rgyal por ngas lung bstan/ rdol gamum rgyal ba byang chub 'di/ /gu ge pu rangs mang yul du/ /tārti sde btsan lcags stag lo/ /yab mes bzang po'i srol lugs byed/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang 1 /chos kyi ro la spyod pa 'byung / /'di sras phun tshogs sde btsan zhes/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa 'byung / /chos kyi mdzod phyug yongs su 'dzin/ /sems can thar pa'i lam la 'jug /lha bla'i skye bar ngas lung bstan/ /rma rin mchog ces lo tsā 'di/ /la stod spyad lung rlum pa'i yul/ /mkhar dmar gnas chung zhes bya bar/ /rgyus nag jo phan zhes bya dang /gomon mo dug ge zhes bya'i sras/ /sidha rat+na shrī zhes pa/ /sa brgyad byang chub sems dpa' 'byung / /rgya gar rgya nag u rgyan yul/ /dad can mang po'i kha lo sgyur/ /mang yul lu yug ces bya bar/ /klu yi dbang po'i skye ba len/ / yab ni sangs rgyas skyabs zhes bya/ /mum ni g.yar mo 'kho skyid ces/ /gcung po bla ma mkhar chen zhes/ /sring mo tor lcam zhig mo zhes/ /sras che ba la bsod rgyal zhes/ /chung ba'i ming ni bha ru zhes/ /te gnas nam shi ro snye zhes/1skyal khur smyon pa mdo chung zhes/ /dus kyi mtha' la de ltar 'ong / /cog ro glu yi rgyal mtshan ni/ /ma 'ongs dbu ru tsha ba gru/ /brtson 'grus mtshan can byang chub sems/ /'khar los sgyur ba'i zhang rigs 'byung / /lo tsā dā na tegan 'di/ /mi tshos kha che'i yul du skyes/ /nā ro pa zhes pani ta/ /thub bstan sto+ong dang bzhi brgya na/ /lha sa'i darkan gnyer zhig tu skye/ /dge ba'i mtshanan61shā

can rta lo pa/ /sangs rgyas chos la rjes yi rangs/ /chos mdzad rnams kyi 'tsho sa ba sbyor/ /bla ma zhang gi sprul pa 'byung / /lo tsā be+e ro tsa na 'di/ /rgya gar thar pa lam ston skye/ /ma 'ongs sa skya dpal gyi mtshan/ /snyib/sa ma'i dus na yaja glungs su/ /bsod nams ming can tshos rgyal 'byung / /chos 'khor stod /blod mchod pa/ra byed/ /chos mdzad rnams kyi 'tsho ba sbyor/ /mkhas pa g.yu sku /snying po 'di/ /zheng khams tho ling zhes bya bar/ /po to ba zhes bya ba 'byung // mchod pa bzang po'i gtsug lag khang / /'gro ba mang po'i don byed 'gyur/ /chaganyags ban ku ma rā dza ni/ /o ta na yi gtsug lag tu/ /ta li sher bzang /ste/ba len/ /ma 'ongs dwags sgom zhes bya bar/ /rgyal mtshan ming can rta lo ༷pa/ /zla 'od gzhon nu'i sprul tha 'byung / /bsam gtan sgom pa pho mos bskor//—de tshogs bde ba can du 'gro /lha dpal ye shes bya ba khyod/ /ā kar shārti bya bar skye/ /ma 'ongs cung pa zhes bya bar/ /bsod nams ming can sgom gra ba'abyung / /dge slong ye shes dpal bya 'di/ /thub pa'i zhing khams sper zhes lasar/ /bsod nams mtshan can nges don sgom/ /pad 'byung bstan pa 'dzin pa ma'abyung / /lo tsā yon tan snying po 'di/ /gangs dkar snye mo ra sngas su/ /pha ltag ma spril khyung mgo'i bu/ /dge bshes khyung po rdza gi rje/ shī la gīrti tshos mkhas rigs/ /bla ma shangs par grags pa 'byung / khyim pa byang chub sems mched gsum/ /shangs mgon shangs dang shangs chung rnams/ /'dzam bu chu ༷bo gu lang sogs/ /kaser kha chen po bcu gasrum 'byung / /zhong zhong dgon ༷nas brgya rtsa brgyad/ /tshogs pa khrims 'tsho'i rgya mtsho 'byung / /snga bu lnga dang mabye bu gcig /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs/ /de nas zhing khams bde chin 'gro /lang 'gro dkon cog 'byung gnas 'di/ /rgya gar yul gyi ma ga hor/ khyim bdag spuyi seng ge'i bu/ /yum ni bhi ma na zhes bya/ rdomached lnga —522

mad pa'i gu pa ta/ /ma 'ongs yar klungs shel nyid du/ /dar ma'i ming can dri med 'byung / /byang chub sems dpa' dam chos 'bung / /phyi ma mkha' spyod bde chen 'gro/ /lo tsā rgyal ba mchog dbyangs 'di/ /rgya gar byang phyogs mu stegs yul/ /de ba tsan+d+rar skye ba len/ /bstan babs lnga bcu kha ral dus/ /chos dbyings mtshan can zhes bya 'byung / /bal po du har nag po 'di/ /rgya gar yul gyi yangs pa can/ /dge slong legs pa'i blo gros zhes//ma 'ongs zur zhes bya ba'i rigs/ /shākya'i ming can sngags 'chang 'byung / //rgyale ba phun sum tshogs pa'i stobs/ /longs sku'i bstan pa'i sgron me yin/ /tshe 'phos u rgyan yul du bye/ /dge slong gtsug gi rgyal mtshan 'di/ /yul grong sgang bu zhes bya bar/ /ye shes ming can bstan pa bsrung / /gshin /rje'i grub pa thob pa 'byung / /lo tsā ska ba dpal brtsegs 'di/ 1rgya gar yul gye bhe ga la/ / /khas pa nag po ro 'dzin zhes/ /mi yi lo kar skye ba len/ /bsam yas lho phyogs mon grwa phyi/ /bla ma bzang gsum zhes pa /'byung / /gang la dngos po ma mchis pa/ /tshom bu 'khor bcas bde ba can//chos kyi nyi mas dros pa 'byung / /u rgyan yul gyi rang byung gling / khe du ma sabu ri yi grong / /drang srong be ru sha zhes pa/ /za hor tsakra gīrte pa/ /thu mi sastor bod du skyes/ /da lta'i dharmo tī ra khyod/ /mi lus bdun gyi skye /mjug tu/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun long sa spyod pa/ /rin chen gzhon nu zhes pa 'byung / /sa brgyad non pa'i sems dpa' nyid/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa 'byung / /tshe 'phos nub phyogs bde ba can/ /'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim/ /zag bcas gser 'bum rlum po bzhengs/ /rab /gnas sto nub srin yul nas/ /u rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed/ /'gro don /lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin mo mkha' 'gros skor ba bshor/ 1mtshan spe+o 523

lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /bzang gsumosku 'bum bzhengs pa 'byung / /'dis rkyen byas nas dbus kye+ogs grwa /chos bdag skyes pa'i yul du ni/ /chos 'khor lha sa tsam zhig bzhe ngas/ /bdaga'abyung sku gathugs bzhengs par 'gyu de/ /sangs rgyas gsum gyi ring bsrel gsum/ khyor pa gang tsam bzhu gas par 'gyur/ /yid bzhin nor bu gcig kyang bzhugs/ /thun mong khyad par byin rlabs can/ /dam rdzas mang po dpag med bzhugs/ /rab gnas sto nub srin yul nas/ /u rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed1 /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin mo mkha' 'gros skoragapa bskor/ /mtshan mo/lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /de yi rab gnas legs pa yis/ /rgyal khams thams cad bde bar 'gyur/ /bstan pa'i rim gro glu kha bsgyur/ /dmag 'khrug thams cad chad par 'gyur/ /nyan 'chad sgrub pa rus su bton/ /rgyal po'i khrims kyang brtan pa/ra/'gyur/ /sangs rgyas gdul byar ma grur rnams/ khrims ni btsan pas chags par 'gyur/ /yar chen lha khang grags pa 'byung / /yul ni bkra shis mi bag dro/ /rkyen ngan mi 'byung zas nor 'phel/ /dbus pa'i bsod nams 'di las byung / /lo tsā rdo rje bdud 'dzoms 'di/ /ma 'ongs skan lung shāka gzhon zhes/ /gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas byed 'byung / /tshe 'phos nub phyogs bde ba can/ /zag bcas gser 'bum blum po bzhengs/ /rab gnas sto nub srin yul nas/ /u rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin par mkha' 'gros skor ba bskor/ /mtshan mo lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /srong btsan gser 'bum grags pa 'byung / /lo tsā mchims shāka bra bha wa/ /rgyas slon byang pa'i ri thang mtshams/ /shākya'i ming can but+ta 'byung / /gter min gter 'dras ma 624

bslus na/ /tshe 'phos nub phyogs bde ba can/ /zag bcas gser 'bum blum po bzhengs/ /rab gnas lho nub srin yul nas/ /u rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin par mkha' 'gros skor ba bskor/ /mtshan mo lha 'dre'i tshog kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /kā mā la shī la zhes bya 'di/ /sgra sgyur gling du mu stegs bkrongs/ /'brog mi lo tsā sgra par skye/ /'gong chung ming can srog tig za/ /chu mdor sa ba'i las sad 'byung / /pad 'byung bsnyan 'dze+en rdzogs chen gsung / /tshe 'phos nub phyogs bde ba can/ /zag bcas gser 'bum blum po bzhengs/ /rab gnas sto nub srin yul nas/ / u rgyan pad 'byu nga yis byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin par mkha' 'gros skor ba bskor/ /mtshan mo lha 'dre'i rgogs kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /sku 'bum lhun grub ces pa 'byung / /hā shang ma hā mā na 'di/ /nā ladī yi gtsug lag khang / /gaji yod smra ba'i sde pa / /mkhan po dge ba'i rnam rgyal lha/ /'on rked dkar po sa ru 'byung / /'tsho byed sman pa kun dga'i mabon/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi 'thungs pas ni/ /tshom bu 'khor bca sa mkha' spyod 'gro/ /zag chabacas gser 'bum blum po bzhengs1 /rab gnas sto nub srin yul nas/ //u rgyan pad 'byung nga yim byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi1gsum 'byung / /nyin lar mkha' 'gros skor ba bskor/ /mtshan mo lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /1mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /da lta'i dge slong ko ka li/ /'bre mtshams 'bring rje shāka brtson skye/ /bstan snyigs dus na kong smad rgathil/ /bsaspa gtan rtsi/nga can nges 'byung ldan /gsang sngags gdul byar ma 'gyur rnams1 /dpad 'byung lha khang bzhengs pa 'byung / /gter min gaster 'dra rdzun gyi gter// 'gong po spun dgus ma baspus na/ /rab gnas lho nub smin yul nas/ /u 525

rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin par mkha' 'gros skor ba bskor/ /mtshan mo/lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /tshe 'phos mkha' sgod bde can 'gro 1'o bran rteng chub mgon po 'di/ /za hor yul nas btsun ma 'phos/ /bde ba'i ye shes rgya ba yin/ /ma 'ongs gra shar lhab mi zhes1 /kun gyi ming can nga la mos/ ngas brtsams chos la yid 'ches pa/ /bla ma dar lung zhes bya 'byung / /tshe 'phos nub phyogs bde ba can/ /zag bcas gser 'bum thum po bzhengs/ /rab gnam sto nub srirna yul nas/ /u rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin par mkha' 'gros skor ba bskor/ 1mtshan mo lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /tsha rong rgyal po mdo bzher 'di/ /za hor yul nas btsun ma tshe 'phos nas/ /snyi ta nag po tog rtse ba/ /ma 'ongs ngas smras gter la mos/ /bla ma mchog rab ces pa 'byung / /tshe 'phos nub phyogs bde ba can/ /zag bcas phung po gser 'bum rlum/ /rab gnas sto nub srin yul nas/ /u rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin sngar mkha' 'gros skor ba paskor/ /mtshan mo lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /lo tsā de ba sam+bha 'di/ /yab ni rgyal po stobos dang ldan/ /yug ni bram ze sin dhi rī/ /mched lcam lnga yi che ba ni/ /dharma shī la zhes bya ba/ /tshe 'phos gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ /ma 'ongs dbus gra phyug rtse sgang / /kun dga'i mtshan can sngags sgom 'byung / /bka' gter chos dang chos min dbye/ che 'phos shar phyogs mngon par dga'/ /zhing khams 'od 'gro can du yal/ /zag bcas gser 'bum blum po bzhengs/ /rab gnas sto rdub srin yul nas//u rgyan pad 'byung nga yis byed/ /'gro don lha 'dre mi gsum 'byung / /nyin 636

par mkha' 'gros skor ba bskor/ /mtshan mo lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor/ mi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ /gser 'bum sku shas 'gro don brgyad/ /ma srid pa cig srid nas 'ongs/ /dus 'di 'gyur shing mi rtag ste/ /mi rabs bco brgyad brjes pa'i dus/ /rgya nag gong po ma du zhes bya nas/ /gnam sa 'gre log bsgyur pa 'byung / /de'i stobam pad 'byung lung 'dis kyang / /phan par sems nas lung 'dir bstan/ /zin chu khar rnams phebs tsa na/ /la stod don po ri zhes su/ /bde mchog dus snying/skye ba 'byung /zhu /su ka pha la zhes bya bas/ /bzang gsum sku sha zhebyin par 'gyur/ /rgyal gyi 'kho ra stod gnam 1 ru'i sar/ /dbus gtsang ban sngags tshogs nas su/ /bstan pa'i rim gror / sku sha bgo /sa steng yul ris mi gcig sbyin1 /de yis dar cig bzlog par4'gyur/ /kong chu kha ru phebs tsa na/ /kyi gu gnas gong zhes bya bar/ /dge ma lcam gyi skye ba 'byung / /dpe med dbang grags zhes bya ba/ /srong btsan gser 'bum sku sha 'byin/ /'phan gyi lcang bu dpag bsam du/ /dbuso gtsang ban sngags tshogs nas su/ /bstan pa'i rim gror sku sha bgo /sa steng yul ris mi gcig sbyin/ /de yis dar cig bzlog par 'gyur/ /dam ra cho lo gong phebs na/ /la stod mchod rten la kha ru/ /gyim shing kong jo'i skye ba 'byung / /yid bzhin mgon thur zhes bya bas/ /rtse thang gser 'bum sku sha 'byin/ /'phen yul jog po'i ri la khyer/ /dbus gtsang ban sngags tshogs nas su/ /bstan pa'i rim gror sku sha bgo /sa steng yul ris mi gcig sbyin/ 1de yis dar cig bzlog par 'gyur/ /rgya dmag mor rta mus su phepas/ /la7stod dgon khar la zhes par/ /bde chen seng ge zhes bya gag / khus pa'i gser 'bum sku sha 'byin/ /byang gi stag lung sa 'gyur du/ /dpus gtsang ban sngags tshogs nas gu/ /bstan pa'i rim gror sku sha bgo/ /sa steng yupa 527

ris mi gcig sbyin/ /de yis dar cig bzlog par 'gyur/ /srid par bcas pa'i 'jig rten du/ /mi blo 'dre yis 'phrog ba'i dus/ /stod lung la 'or mtsho lnga nas/ /myang stod dbang phyug rgyal mtshan che 'phos pa/ /slob dpon za re zhes bya bas/ /lhun grub gser 'bum sku sha 'byin/ /gtsang gi shab stod khyer bar 'gyur/ /dbus gtsang ban sngags tshogs nas sru/ /bstan pa'i rim gror sku sha pago/ /sa steng yul ris mi gcig sbyin/ /de yis du ru gi dmag bzlog shangs kyi tog tog brag ces par/ /don yod rdo rje'i skye ba 'byung //sto ti snyi ra tī zhes pas/ /'tsho byed gser 'bum sku sha 'byin/ /brag sgang dzo nag po la khyer/ /dbus gtsang ban sngags tshogs nas su/ /bstan pa'i rem gror sku sha bgo/ /sa steng yug ris mi gcig sbyin/ /de yis dar gcig bzlog par 'gyur/ /spa gro sto lung rtsa mtshams su/ 1glang khams go cha'i skye ba 'byung / /thugs rje chen po nag po zhes bya bas/ /dar lung gser 'bum sku sha 'byin/ /gu ge pu rangs mang yul khyer/ /dbus gtsang ban sngags tshogs nas thu / /bstan pa'i rim gror sku sha bgo /sa snyeng yul ris mi gcig sbyin/ /de yis dar cig bzlog par 'gyur/ /lo tsā khams pa dbye//slong rardo sar/ /'gos kyi phag ri mkhar gyi glang po mkhar/ /na ro'i lcam mo ni gu sa'i sprul ma/ /ma gcig phag 'bum zherga bya bas/rta /mchog rab gser 'bum sku sha 'byin/ /ru lag mang gar khri dgongs khyer/ /dbus gtsang bzhe sngags tshogs nas su/ /bstan pa'i rim gror sku sha bgo /sa steng yul ris mi gcig sbyin/ /de yis dar cig bzlog par 'gyur/ /nyon mobs pa las gyur pa'i ༷bgegs rigs mang / /bzang brgyud spel pa srid pa'i tha mar nyung / mgon skyabs byed pa'i la btsan dus su bskul/ /stobs ldan blo gsal dad can yid ra zhungs pas/ /'gro ba'i don du lus ngag yid gsum bgyed/ /1bdud 'gran 523

de yi ya ba srog la hur/ /zu gab pa ling log tshu gab 'gebs/ /'dre ku4ta gu ber shub ma shub/ /srin rag sha kha 'dar srags se srags/ /byur nyi mi lag bams se bam/ /ltas ngan bu she lcags mig no/ /ya mtshan/can bu gram pa ru ring / /sdig pa can bu shor ba stag nag 'dre ngan sri can bar chod la 'ong ston/ /phyi ma ci 'gyur gyi skabs te nyer brgyad pa'o// /bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong ba'i skabs/bstan nabs gter skyong gter min gter 'dra dbye/ / zhes pas/ /'di nas 'o ni lnga brgya dang gsum na/ /hor gyi dmag 'ong mi bde'i rlung 'tshub ldang / /las ldan 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa/ /sems can thams cad gsod par 'gyur/ /1shāka thub bston pa lnga brgya phrag bdun rjes/ /lhag ma stong tsho gcig dang lnga brgya na/ /lnga bcu kha ral bdud kyi bstan pa'i dus/ /sa tor bstan pa rgya nag rgyal pos 'joms/ /mdung dmar kha sgyu rgya ral bod du 'byung / /nga yis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos/ /sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin/ /sangs rgyas bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong / /de phyir gter ris bye ba lnga/ /ye sangs rgyas pa'i thugs gter dang / /thugs rje sprul pa'i dgongs gter dang / /dgongs pa lhun grub zab gter dang / /rgyal ba rigs dbye'i yang gter dang / /gang zag brgyud pa'i gsang gter ro/ /dang po ye sangs rgyas pa'i thugs gter ni/ /sems can 'dod chags che ba la/ /gser gyi 'khor lo lta bu'i chos/ /'dul ba nye ba'i rdo rje yis/ /grong khyer sa mchog gnas su sbas/ /dus phyis shākya 'od kyis phyungs/ /dang po sku yis 'dul ba yin/ /bar du gsung gis 'dul ba yin/ /sems can gti mug che 529

ba la/ /me long g.ya' dag lta bu'i chos/ /mdo sde rdo rje gdan du sas/ 1dge slong nar 'phan rag shis bton/ /mtha' ma thugs kyis 'dul ba yin/ 1sems can zhe sdang che ba la/ ༷/rgyal po'i bang mdzod lta bu'i chos/ /mngon pa be+e kā ma la shī lar/ /mngon pa'i chos la dgra lan gsum/ /ta zig rgyal po ༷hu lus bsregs/ /rgan mo rgan 'dra mu stegs bsregs/ /nyi ma dngos grub nyi bsgrubs bsregs/ /don gyi snying po gsang sngags la/ /mi dang lha srin bye ba na/ /'og min gnas dang lha yi gnas/ /mi yi gnas dang mi ma yin/ /gdug rtsub me dpung lta bu'i chos/ /ma gshin phur gsum gter du sbas/ /bton tshul de dag lo rgyus gsal/ /dang bo phur pa dar ba yin/ /sngags drig don du rgyas pas te/ /rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'i chos/ /bar du sgyu 'phrul gter du sbas/ /li tsa byi dri ma med dang dza/ /sems can bsod nams bri dus su/ /tshig nyung don gsal rin cen ltar/ /'di phyi gnyis ka rdzogs pas na/ /mtha' mar rigs gsum mgon chos sbas/ /bton tshul de dag lo rgyus gsal/ /de dus gzhan mas bka' gsang 'tshal/ /tshong 'dus 'o ma bzhin du bslad/ /bstan snyigs grub mtha' ngan pas bsgyur/ /sngags 'dra rtags cos dar bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa thugs rje sprul pa'i dgongs gter ni/ /dang po bde gshegs 'dus pa gter du sbas/ /bton tshul de dag lo rgyus gsal//bar du bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs gter du sbas/ /bton tshul de dag lo rgyus gsal/ /mtha' ma bka' 'dus gter du sbas/ /bton tshul de dag lo rgyus gsal/ /gsum pa dgongs pa lhun grub zab gaster ni/ /dgongs pa lhun gyis grub tshul bcu/ /gter chos don ma nor ba'i chos/ /gang zag gis ma bcom pa'i chos/ /dargas ched ma gab pa yi chos/ /rgyud ni ma dkrugs pa yi cos /bka' ni ma 'khyal pa yi chos/ /lung ni ma gcus pa yi chos/ /ma 530

rtagag 'chal pa med pa'i chos/ 1dgos don ma chad pa yi chos/ /rgyas med ma dgos pa yi chos/ /byin rlabs ma nyams pa yi chos/ /las can ma 'ongs rjes 'jug phyir/ /rgyud kyi 'khrugs pa rnams ni bsal/ /lung gi gcus pa rnams ni sdebs/ /man ngag gab pa rnams ni phyungs/ /don ma nor bar chirga don sbyar/ /gzhan gyi rang bzos bslad du med/ /rgyud kyi bka' chings lag len bkrol/ /ma bcos ma gab ma dkrugs shing / /rmongs par ma brgyud gter du bstsal/ /bka' 'byams 'dres khyer rgyud ma 'khyar/ /lhag cad skyon dang bral ba'i gter/ /yid spyod log shes the tshom can/ /rna bar me bsgrags gter du bstsal/ /gter sgo bye ba tsam zhig ni/ /lta klu mi yul rnams su sbas/ /mkha' 'gro rig 'dze+en rnams la gtade/ /skye ba sngon du dpang thob pa/ /gter chos phrad par smon lam btab/ /gtad rgya bkrol bas mkha' 'gros gnang / /gang zag mi yi brgyud ma tshud / /'jig rten chos brgyad lhad —ma zhugs/ /stod smad bde sdug grags ma grags/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed dega' ma chadaga'/ /de 'drar zong byed ngo re tsha/ 1bzang du re ba'i 'dod blos bcings/ /sems ngan chos phung dag pa yis/ /phan sems med pas chos spong las/ /smyon pa snying rlung 'di bya med/ 1bzhi pa rgyal ba rigs dbye'i ༷yang gter ni/ /mthong rgya chung zhing thos/rgya med pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams la tshad bzung nas/ /rang gzhan dang ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ / gsang sngags dbang bskur dam rjas bur chu byed/ /des dad 'jug pa'i spre ru ༷'gro snyam ste/ /rtsa ltung btsu gsum pa ni phog pa yin/ /'jig rten dag na /bde skyid chos yin te/ /bka' srung dam can rnams ni shin tu khros/ /ru nga /phrag dog bdud kyis brjis pas 'khrugs/ /gteri nas byang pemyo sa dkar dmar dam jis rnams/ /bde stong thob pa thar pa'i rgyu mthun 'phel/ /gter 531

ma dag las 'byung bar shes pa bya1 /lnga stong bstan pa'i snyang pa rgya gar yul/ / nga yi 'dul ba'i bstan pa la/ /lo ni lnga brgya phrag bcu dang /sum brgya dag ni gnas pa la/ /sum brgya la ni chos bsdus rte/ /lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas pa yin/ /nyis stong bdun brgya tsam nas ni/ /mtha' 'khob yul du dar bar 'gyur/ /sum brgya yan chod sde sdod gsum/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi bstan pa dang / /lnga brgya phrag bcu 'das pa na/ /nyis stong brgyad brgya bdunakecu rtsa brgyad nas/ /nges don bstan pa dar bar 'gyur/ /lnga brgya'i snyigs ma byung ba'i tshe/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bstan pa la/ /lo ni bdun brgya rtsa lnga na/ rdosangs rgyas thugs kyi bstan pa ni/ /lo ni drug cu rtsa lngar gnas/ /de nas bstan pa khad kyis 'jig /thub pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bdun rjes/ /rgyal srid thams cad 'khrugs par 'gyur/ /chos ma yin pa dar ba'i dus/ /rang rab bstan pa rang rang 'jig /gter rigs dbye ba byas nas des/ /phyi dge ba'i rnam thar pho tshugs la re yang / /nang na mi dge ngan pa cig yod pa'i rtags/ /gsung rab tshad mar chode log yin zhes zer/ /gsung rab tshad mas khyed la ci byas pa/ /lnga pa gang zag rgyu yi gsang gter ni/ /bal yul go de ba ri'i gtsug lag khang / /'gyur ni snga phyi gsar rnying rgyud kun rnams/ / dpe yi ming ni rkyang pa bris gyur kyang / /rgyas pa 'bum dang mnyam pa 'ong ba yin/ /thos mthong rgya med rmongs pa rnams/ /gter ma 'di la brgyud pa med ces zer/ /byin rlabs brgyud pa ma chad lnga las med/ /rgyal ba'i thugs brgyud ma chad pa cig yod/ /rigs 'dzin brda brgyud ma chad pa cig yod/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtad brgyud ma chad pa cig yod/ /smon lam tshig brgyud ma chad pa cig yod/ /bar skabs brgyud pa'i sel med pa1 /brgyud pa yis ni ma btub na/ /chos gsar brgyud pa 'phel mi btub/ /log pa'i zhibyams thub 532

tshabs ldog ste/ /de dang mthun/ba'i spyod pa'o/ /bstan zhabs gter gyis skyong ba'i skabs te nyer dgu pa'o// // gter min gter 'dra bstan pa'i skabs/garter min gter 'dra gter la gnod/ /chos ma yin ni tshos kyis )pham/ /grin po'i yul gling chen po bcu drug la/ /srin po'i grong khyer lnga brgyas bskor ba'i dbus/ /mar me mdzad kyi bstan pa 'das/ /shākya thub pa'i bstan pa ma shar bar/ /ru dra thar pa nag po'i bstan pa byung / /metags pa /ming gi ru bra/ sprul pa 'dod dgu skong ba'i ru dra/ ting nge 'dzin ye shes pu langs pa'i ru dra/ /ma bcos rnal du dbab ba'i ru dra/ rang bzhin lhun gyes grub pa'i ru dra1 a kar sha ru dra/ kha tram̐ kha ru dra1 ma trang kha ru dra/cha'ajig rten bde dang mi bde'i rnam pa kun/ /ru dra phyi nang gsang ba de khocan/ /ru dra lnga bcu rtsa bakhye+od sde dpung che/ /gter zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid byung / / ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba/byas/ /ngo bo zad mi shes pa wa/ /bsod nams spel cing dag pa yin/ /nges tshig yid bzhin nor bugo/ /dgos 'dod 'byung bas gter zhes bya/ /dbye ga bco brgyad dbye ba'o/ /gter du/dbugs dang ni gter sha gnyis/ /garter lngags gter spu gter snying khrug /gdīr gye sto/chil yan lag bdun/ /blu ba keng mar gtedi klad bcu/ 1thugs gter dgongs gter rdzas gtir lnga/ /bla gter gter bran gter smyon brgyad/ /rgya gter /bod gter rje blon gter/ /yab gter yum gter ma ning gter/ /phyi nang chag nga gter rdzun ma'i/gter/ /nor gter dang ni bco brgyad do/ /dus kyi /snyigs ma byung ba'i tshe/ /yid log dam med bstan 'jig sel/ /len ma phyong rgya33

ba'i lus blangs nas/ /mi dge'i snang ba rang shar te/ /'dre yis sked bsgul chor min 'chad/ /dbye gsal med pa'i yi ge'i rigs/ /nyon mongs ma bri mi masho bskor ba la/ /bka' dang 'brel med khungs ma ga la yin/ /dam tshig med la snying rje chung / /shes rab kha yan 'dod pa che/ /pad 'byung rkang 'dren bod du 'ong / /bstan pa'i chos dang mi mthun pa'i/ /bya ru mi rung sna tshogs byed1 /rdzun pas gter 'dra byed pa 'byung / /dam nyams bstan pa'i ru dra ni/ /'gong po spun dgu a tshi tshi/ /dam sri mched bdun a ma ma/ / 'byung 'gegs 'tshal ba mgo lnga 'byung / /brtsams chos byas pa'i zog po 'byung / /rang bla rang gis 'tshong ba 'byung / /rang sma rang gis 'bebs pa 'byung / mi mgo bskor bas rang mgo 'khor/ /chos pa yongs la gnod pa 'byung / mi min rmongs pas bzang por mthong / /mi dge'i sna len byed pa 'dra/ /lcags 'phreng nag po dmag sna 'dren/ /bstan pa'i chom rkun khyi mgo can/ /the'u brang stong 'khrug mi mgo can/ /yam shud dmar po sprel mgo can/ /'phu khang nag mo btsun ma'i mgo /mdza' bo dbyen 'jug me lcam can/ /mi yul mi srid srid pa pargyad/ /ru dra'i bstan pa shar ba'i rtags/ dug lnga 'phel zhing khong khro ldang / /bstan pa 'di nyid ru dra'i bstan/ /gdugargapa'i skad ngan rgyun du sgog /sems can bde ba skad cig med/ /'tsho bas rang ma sos pa dag /lung pa'i chu ngan brdol nas 'ong / /dam sri 'byung po khyu ru longs/ /de ltar dmu rgod mang du 'byung / /mi phung bdag brlag su ma tshangs/ /sangs rgyas bya ba ma yin 'dor khung bor/ /gter min gter 'dra'ilaskabs te sum cu pa'o// //534

mjug bsdu ba/bdag 'dra u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis1 /snang ba mtho' yas lung bstan sku sprul nas/ /rgya bod lo paṇa chen po bod du tshogs/ /lha 'dre shab ༷kyi 'bar ba nag po dang / /gnyan chen thang lha jo bo paṇa chen gsum/ /gzhi bdag sku lung btsan dang bzhis/ /gus pas phyag btsal gsol ba btab/ /sam 'ongs sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' skyong phyir/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i chos /bsgyur gter du sbas/ khyad par rgyal khrims brtan byed 'di skad gsu ngas/ /༷rgyal po khro gtum che na rgyal srid skyel/ /blon po ma 'chun srid kyi mkhar po ༷'jig 'chun chen mang na thugs tshod gzhan la 'chor/ /chos dang ldan na /'gro ba kun gyis 'khur/ /chos med rgyal po rang gi ma 'a ris tsam/ /gzhan gyis bsgyur ba byas na khrims nyams 'gro /phyogs cha ches na 'bangs kyi khengs log 'ong / /yin rung min rung dmag byed rang 'phung 'gro /sngar ༷thus 'gyod pa med na gros phugs brdugs/ /mi yul sa steng gtam ngan khyab bar 'gyur/ khong dal smra bden 'chad btsan phan gnod nus/ /sems rgyud shin tu rab tu dul zhing sgom/ /drang po'i sems 'jog ma bcol las mi 'jug snga gros mi zhan phyis ni 'gyod mi bsnan/ /mtho dman legs sbyor nyes mi sgrub pas 'tsho/ /blon po gros che bstan pa dar yun ring / kha 'jam /bong pa gdug pa blon po 'jigs/ /mi yi rgyal po'i dpe ni rgya mtsho 'dra/ /rgya mtsho g.yo ba med bzhin thugs mi g.yo/ /gting dpag dka' zhing thugs zab shes zhib bskyed/ /blon po rnams kyis skyon dor yon tan long / 1mtho /'grogs ma che ngan pa khyad ma gsod/ /'phung g.yos thams cad ngan pas byed 535

pa yin/ /'tsho shes blon chen rnams kyes mel tshe chol/ /mi ngan zas skom gosalanor phan ma gdags/ /lan cig na mas/ngan smras gtong du 'ong / /mi chos rgya mtsho 'dra ba legs pa'i gzhi/ /dha na ko sha g.yu yi mtsho mo'i dbus/ /me tog pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ /sku mchog sku yi mtshan mchog pad+ma 'byung //rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan khyod nyid nas /rgyal rabs bgrangs pa'i bco lnga thar tsa na/ /mtha' dmag byung ste rgyal khrims zhig par 'gru+or/ /mi dag srin pos bzung mang 'bros sems med/ /thar pa thob pa'i chos la 'jug tu gsha'/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gro yang brgyags phye med/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag brgyags phye 'khur du gsha'/ /lus sems ngan gyis byed kyang byed sems med/ /sems nyid 'gag med rtsa bral rtogs su gsha'/ /ngan song g.yang la lhungs kyang 'jigs sems med/ /sdom bsrungs mtho ris lam la 'gro ru gsha'/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du byings kyang don sems med1 1'khor ba rgyab bskrur byang chub bsgrub tu gsha'/ /mo ma pra se na yi kha la nyan/ /rtag tu bsam mno gtong ba'i sems rgya can/ /mi rtag 'gyur zhinge ldog pa'i blon po rnams/ /dma' sa bzung nas bstun na skyed par 'ong / /chos med grags pas bskrus pa'i chos mkhan rnams/ /yi ge med ma'i don stogs sangs rgyas thob/ /mkhas patsun bzang 'dod chos pa rang sems sdug /nyon mongs rags pas bzang 'ekhrul khar zhan 'phung / /sdom med nor jos gsog pa'i btsun pa rnams/ /chos spyod bcu la 'bad na tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /thos bsam dran pa zhid pa'i sgom chen rnams/ /blun sgom stong zhen bshig na rtogs pa 'khrungs/ /sgom yus bzang 'dod chos pa snying re rje/ /chos pa zog po mang po bod du 'byung / /bzang 'dod tshul 'tshos 'dod yon sred pa canardo /chog shes sked pas mi la khrum byed rnams/ /sto gos gnyis kyi sha la khye bzhin rgyug /ma shi 53nya

bar du brel las dal ba med/ /shi nas ro dal thams cad bzhag nas 'gro/ /shen chags ngakhrul gzhi yen tsam cig gis bslus/ /sems can lus skyes 'khor dbar 'khyams sdug bsngal/ /sangs rgyas lam ni snying la bstan gyur kyang / /rang rgyud thul dus med pa'i blon po rnams/ /ngan song gsum gyi jag pa byung tsa na/ /rang kha drag kyang mi phan che ba bskyungs/ /srid sde grogs dad che yang mi gtong ngo shes bor/ /'gying ra byang g.yag che yang lus sems 'bral/ /phyi rabs don du bstan pa gzhag pa'i phyir/ /don gyi sting po 'di las ngas ma bstan/ /zhen pa log pa'i dad pa ma skyes na/ /'khrul ba zhig pa'i 'bras bu mi 'thob bo/ /lta ba'i sems sod chos nyid zas su zo/ /sgom pa'i sims chagazung spyod pa'i 'ol kha sgyur/ /blon po sems chos rdo rus 'phrod par sprod/ /lngags pa rab 'bring mtha' ma rnam pa gsum/ /sngags pa rab la shar pa rnam pa lnga/ /sngags pa 'bring la gsal ba rnam pa lnga/ /sngags pa tha mar gzung ba rnam pa lnga/ /dang po sems can thams cad sangs rgyas shar ba yis/ /lam gyi ye gshes bgrod du med par shes/ /gnam sa ri brag yi dam lhar shar bas/ /'bras bu yid bzhin lhun grub rdzogs par shes/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bde chubar shar pa yis/ /snang ba sna tshogs lam du khyer bar shes/ /nyon mongs ༷thams cad ye shes shar ba yis/ /rang byung ye shes rang la gnas par shes/ /gnyis pa 'bring la gsal ba rnam pa lnga/ /stong gsum lha yi gzhal yas khang du chagasal/ /gzhal yas khang la yang dog med pa'i gnad/ /rang lus phung khams lha ru gsal ba yis/ /bar chod gdon bgegs ku na gyis mi tshugs gnad1 /phyi stod 'jig rten gtor snod gsal ba yis/ /gtor ma'i snod la bzang ngan med pa'i gnad/ /nang bcud sems can dam rdzas gsal ba yis/ /sadam can rnams kyi khu ldog mi 'ong gnad/ /gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gsal 537

ba yis/ /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba yi gnad/ /gsum pa sngags pa tha ma'i gzung ba lnga/ /lha la rtag par ther zug bzung / /'phrin las gyer sgom med par bzung 1 /sngags dang snying po rang rgyud bzung / /dzos dang gtor chung bshos bur bzung / /'bras bu 'jig rten ru drar bzung / /sngags pa rab dang blon po thang yig phrad/ /mnyam nyid 'khrul pa med pas thugs stobs che/ /pyang sems spyod pa sems can bye mig lta/ /3ོda pa gartsa cher byed pa'i dge slong ni/ /rab rtsal gtsang ma'i blo dang ldan pas su/ /sa ni dang po'i byang chub sems dpa' des/ / sems can don byed pa la dga' bas gu/ /'arom gling dbang po 'khor los sgyur bar sprul/ /gang zag pyo rnams gcig tu ma nges par/ /sems can mos pa bskyed pa'i don byed phyir/ /rdog pa'i gartad sa ma 'ongs sprul sku yin/ /rdog pa 'dred pa yong ngo u rgyan gling / /byed pa gzhan don byed pa zer skad kyang / /byung ba rang don ma byung nyen yad do/ /skal ldan slob ma nyin skar bas kyang dkon/ /gaper chos gdams ngag dam par ma byas na/ /sgod ngan lag tu 'grims na bka' chad 'ong / /chos la gces par ma byas byin rlabs yal1 /sbas dam thub la chos skyong chags/ /'dod tshad ma ster brgyud pa rab gis gzung / /skal ldan las 'phro can dang phrad par shog /sam ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gter rgya/ sbas rku/ gsang rgya/ zab rgya/gtad rgya/ rgya rgya rgya// // gu ru u rgyan gling pas yar glungs shel gye brag phug nas bton pa'o/ /shog ser shog dril gcig 'dug go /dza yan+tu/ rgyal rnams thugs rje'i 'od rdul lhung ba dag 'dab ma brgya pa'i mtshar sdug dga' ma yis/ /bzung zhing bskyed pa'i sprul sku pad+ma 'byung / /snyigs ma'i sems can phan drin mkha' dang mnyam/ /gang gi rnam thar yid kyi du38

mdza' na bo/ /'gugs byed dri za'i glu ltar snyan pa dang 1 1mi min me yi bdag po lo paṇa phreng / /btsun mo blon bcas gdams pa'i thang yig rnams/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab e 'a pa/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal srid spyong ba po/ /gang gi zhal mchid dbyangs kyi rgyal so yi/ /glu dang bsres ltar snyan pas bskul ba'i tshe/ /chab srid tha gru yangs pa'i nor 'dzin ma/ /sde sgod gsum 'dzin dge ba'i 'khor los sgyur/ /bla chen kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho zhes/ /grags pa'i zla 'od ldan pas par du bskrun/ /de las byung ba'i legasa'ibyas chab kyi rgyun/ /bla med byang chub rgya mtshor ro gcig tu1 /gzhar yang 'dzad du med par 'dres gyur te/ /lung rtogs nor bu'i dga' ston byed par shog /cis pa'i par byang nyung zad 'di yang ban+de tshul khams rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng du bris pasarba maṅga le//53gyi

sgo satsho choske4mtsham bo deba'adi ni sdedagegamarmagazhirabazunganasabasgrogs bsgrun paban/dpe sgrig 'gan 'khurab/ dbyangs canasangagebaka' thang sder/gu ru yurgyan gling pa4yar klungs shel gyi brag phug nas ba na pa/ rdo rje rgyal pos bsgrigs pa/mi rigs dpe spun khang gis bsgrun pa/1386lo'izla 12parapar gasgo1po bsgrig4pa/19gyi7lo'imirwaparabacin du par thengs 3pa brgyab gde lder sgorag8 80
